episodes.overview: Sameer is chatting with a mysterious woman who has added him recently. Just before they're about to meet, she sends strange pictures of his girlfriend Tina. Sameer rushes to her house in panic but finds her murdered. Who is this woman?

episodes.name: Pankaj Ka Faisla
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman accuses Pankaj as the only suspect in a murder case. Abhijeet gets furious on ACP. But ACP always doubts them when they're related directly or indirectly in the case. Will ACP lift his accusation on Pankaj?

episodes.name: Ped Mein Kankaal
episodes.overview: ACP, Daya and Abhijeet are in for a shock when they find graffiti scrawled across the walls of their homes. They begin their hunt for the person who wrote it, and for this allegedly murdered Sanjana Prakash. Who is Sanjana Prakash?

episodes.name: Khatarnak Abhijeet
episodes.overview: Abhijeet has been behaving very strangely after returning from a work trip in Delhi. He realizes he's suffering from a strange form of amnesia and hires a private detective to keep an eye on him 24x7. Will Abhijeet find out the truth?

episodes.name: Khooni Ghar
episodes.overview: Two high-profile tycoons have been killed by a kind of smart home run by a programmed voice that control electronics and appliances. CID realize that someone has tampered the system to be able to murder these people. But why?

episodes.name: Daya Ek Hatyara
episodes.overview: At the ransom exchange to save a kidnapped child, Daya shoots and kills the kidnapper by mistake, putting the kid's life is in danger. To make things worse, Daya is arrested for killing the man, though he insists that he didn't kill him.

episodes.name: Woh Kaun Tha
episodes.overview: Ranjan, a wealthy man, and his wife Sulekha are accused of dumped a dead woman in a lake, leading Ranjan to call CID for investigation. He's confused about if he's telling the truth or playing strange games.

episodes.name: Akash Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: Three people are involved in a private plane crash which kills all three and the pilot is nowhere to be found. The wives of the three dead approach CID to investigate the case after they tell CID that they were getting death threats a few days before the flig…

episodes.name: Putle Ki Maut
episodes.overview: A headless body of a woman is found in the workshop of a boutique. CID identify the woman and begin to investigate her private life and find that she apparently lived several secret lives under different names.

episodes.name: Khatarnak Din
episodes.overview: CID finally has a lead on the head of The Eye, the identity of their best hacker, Ajinkya. CID trail him and are about to catch him when, Ex-CID officer Shreya shows up with an IB team, also trying to catch Ajinkya.

episodes.name: C.I.D. Bees Saal Baad
episodes.overview: CID team has finally found and arrested the leader of The Eye but it is not over yet. They plan to transport him to a secret safe house to question him. But still, they are ambushed en route. Can CID overcome this obstacle after 20 years?

episodes.name: Waapsi
episodes.overview: A Mumbai colony experiences terror as a headless kidnapper returns after 12 years of death. CID investigates, finding residents convinced of the supernatural killer's identity, questioning if there's more to the story.

episodes.name: Paryavaran Prem
episodes.overview: Someone is wandering around the city, murdering people. CID find that the victims are people who were harming the environment. The killer disappears without a trace every time he's about to be caught.

episodes.name: Drugs Ki Taskari
episodes.overview: A couple staying in a hotel for their honeymoon is arrested by the police after drugs are found in their suitcase. The same day, CID inspects the dead body of a man who died in a club after a drug overdose. How are the incidents connected?

episodes.name: Chaal
episodes.overview: An old man witnesses a young girl being stabbed in the building opposite, but upon investigation, no signs of death or violence are found, raising questions about the victim.

episodes.name: Khooni Chaal
episodes.overview: Four young goons kidnap a wealthy man, who is later found dead. CID investigates murders of the kidnappers, questioning motives and potential innocence.

episodes.name: Darr Ki Awaaz
episodes.overview: A suicide helpline receives a call from a pregnant woman claiming to have committed suicide, but CID's forensic analysis reveals a murder being disguised as a suicide.

episodes.name: Khatarnak Qatil
episodes.overview: CID investigate a sinister cult targeting vulnerable individuals online, causing random murders without connection. They must find perpetrators before innocent people are massacred, as no one knows who has been targeted.

episodes.name: Khel Suraag Ka
episodes.overview: Dr. Salunkhe receives a gift card to a murder scene but discovers that it's evidence from stolen cases. Suspended, he pleads innocence, and CID wonders if they can solve the case without Salunkhe's help.

episodes.name: Khooni Aasmaan
episodes.overview: A paraglider and a trekker get shot while paragliding. CID are particularly confused by this case, because at such a height, there's no vantage point to take aim at the victims from. No chopper, no cable car, no plane or any flying object.

episodes.name: Muft Delivery
episodes.overview: Delivery boys of shopping websites are getting killed. CID find out that the victims are all being killed after being called to an abandoned location, leaving no clues for them to investigate.

episodes.name: Sach Ya Sapna
episodes.overview: Komal has been having strange nightmares about a woman, a house, a man and a murder. Her parents think it's some kind of mental illness but she insists that it's going to happen. She paints all the nightmares and takes them to the CID.

episodes.name: Chor Ke Khoon Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: Tony is killed mysteriously in his office by an unknown assailant. Dr. Salunkhe discovers strange coins in his stomach which the killer had fed him for some reason before killing him.

episodes.name: Mukhota Mein Khooni
episodes.overview: A masked man imitating from a popular TV show is stabbing random people in the city. The CID team find two young men are puppets, with someone else controlling their actions.

episodes.name: Nadi Mein Laash
episodes.overview: A group of fishermen are out on a fishing trip at a river. They cast their net and are surprised to find stacks of currency notes. They cast their net wider and to their shock, find 2 dead bodies as well.

episodes.name: Andher Nagari
episodes.overview: A new, murderous presence haunts the city, mystifying the CID after leaving a dead industrialist in its wake. The CID suspect a skilled, purposeful assassin using an ancient weapon and a Japanese connection.

episodes.name: Khooni Tasveer
episodes.overview: A wealthy couple anonymously receive a photoshopped family photo frame on their wedding anniversary. It has been sent by a photographer who is brutally killed. CID are on the case and realize that there is a dangerous family secret in it.

episodes.name: Daya Lapata
episodes.overview: CID investigates a double suicide case, where a husband shoots his wife and kills himself. Daya goes missing, and cops trace him to a baby trafficking ring.

episodes.name: Maut Ka Khel
episodes.overview: Cops find a strange man covered in blood. They find strange tattoos and symbols on his body pointing to 4 missing people. Cops need to solve these clues and find these people before it's too late and find who's behind all of this.

episodes.name: Hawai Jahaz Mein Khoon
episodes.overview: Abhijeet is on board a plane where a man is killed by a deadly nerve agent. There is a killer on board and every passenger is in danger. CID must race against time to solve a mystery and find the perpetrators and save the many lives.

episodes.name: Apaharan
episodes.overview: When a young boy goes missing for days, CID spring into action, only to find the kidnapper himself murdered in an ambulance. Soon after, the boy returns with a long stitch across his abdomen, but none of his organs are missing.

episodes.name: Jaadui Khooni
episodes.overview: A famous illusionist Zoravar is proven a fraud at his own show by a mysterious man by the name of Ilesh and hours later, the man is killed in a supernatural way. Everyone is baffled. CID has to prove that it's a human murder only.

episodes.name: Majboor Khooni
episodes.overview: Two murders: one in a disco and another in a café. The common thing in them is that when they were being killed, the murderer told the victims to run away. Why?

episodes.name: Chalti Gaadi Mein Maut
episodes.overview: A woman was shot in a moving vehicle, and her ex-husband was unaware. CID discovers she was shot from a nearby building, using a delaying tactic for a perfect aim.

episodes.name: Ichchadhari Saap Ka Raaz
episodes.overview: CID have been called to investigate a very strange case where the victim's mother believes that the killer is a dead snake's spirit. The cops don't believe it, but all their investigations lead back to this mysterious snake.

episodes.name: 100 Saal Baad
episodes.overview: Behram was a dreaded serial killer who killed hundreds of people a century ago. Now after all these years, a ruthless, psychotic killer who considers Behram his guru, is replicating his horrific crimes.

episodes.name: Adrushya Khooni
episodes.overview: A man with an organ transplant is murdered in broad daylight, seemingly driven by a genie. The case escalates when another organ transplant recipient is murdered, with the donor's younger brother claiming the killer is a genie.

episodes.name: Maut Ka Ghar
episodes.overview: Abhijeet has a terrifying experience in a haunted house which leaves him shaken. He remembers seeing 2 dead bodies inside but when the cops check the next day, there's no trace of anything suspicious.

episodes.name: Khooni Daya
episodes.overview: A man says that Daya has stabbed him and wants to kill him. CID realize that he has a condition which causes him to see Daya's face in everyone caused by excessive chemicals in his brain. Will CID find out why?

episodes.name: Daya Ki Shaadi
episodes.overview: A family is blown up in their house, leaving the daughter behind but no clues no trails. A new twist appears when a woman claims to be Daya's wife with evidence. Daya denies it all and somehow both the cases are linked.

episodes.name: Khooni Dhun
episodes.overview: A deadly serial killer escapes while being transferred to another prison. CID are baffled as he kills 3 people in quick succession, but his sister is sure that he's not the killer. Is it really the serial killer or a copycat?

episodes.name: Bhavishya Se Paigam: Part 1
episodes.overview: Abhijeet is being troubled by a mysterious entity, who warns him that the entire CID is going to die. Even as he prepares for a toughest case that'll test the very limits of CID, on the other end is CID's most formidable foe.

episodes.name: Bhavishya Se Paigam: Part 2
episodes.overview: After the CID walk into a trap laid by the Eye, they're seen as fugitives from the law. John Harris has been found murdered and the CID are the prime suspects. Meanwhile, the cops realize that the conspiracy is not limited to a murder.

episodes.name: Khooni Dimag
episodes.overview: People are hearing voices in their heads that are forcing them to kill specific people and then commit suicides. CID are baffled as they can't pinpoint if this state is natural or induced by a mastermind.

episodes.name: Nashe Ki Pathshala
episodes.overview: A student union leader dies due to drug overdose in a medical college. Someone signals the local cop that it's actually a murder. CID go undercover in the same college and discover a large racket of exam paper leak. How will they stop it?

episodes.name: Cricket Dhamaka
episodes.overview: The star batsman of a domestic cricket league team is killed in a blast in the middle of the game. The CID suspect a betting angle. However, they soon realize that the victim was a brash, arrogant player who had more enemies than friends.

episodes.name: 10 Saal Ka Badla: Part 1
episodes.overview: The CID come to know that a released prisoner Krakato has a plan to take down ACP Pradyuman for arresting him. Meanwhile, a dead body is found and the dead man is found to have a direct connection to Krakato.

episodes.name: 10 Saal Ka Badla: Part 2
episodes.overview: The cops confront Krakato but he challenges ACP to kill Abhijeet and Daya in exchange for his grandson. They try to outwit him but he outwits them by telling them that he doesn't know where ACP's grandson is.

episodes.name: Raaz Gayab Gaadiyon Ka
episodes.overview: A number of cars are stolen in the city and one of the owners is brutally murdered. The CID realize that the killers have targeted all five cars which were sold on the same day for a particular reason.

episodes.name: Khooni Jungle
episodes.overview: A dead man's skin has been removed and kept in 3 bags. The CID investigate his death which leads to another death in front of them from the poisoned garland around his neck. They try to save another victim but find her hanged.

episodes.name: Khoon Ki Taiyari
episodes.overview: While shooting for a film in a forest, a dead body is found buried. CID realize that he wasn't killed in the forest as the trail leads the cops to a flat with blood stains all over the floor.

episodes.name: Imtihaan Ki Ghadi
episodes.overview: Two men on the run are found in strange circumstances. One of them is dead and the other suffering from a mysterious condition. CID find a strange glow from their bodies and discover that a deadly nuclear weapon has entered the country.

episodes.name: Behosh Khooni
episodes.overview: Abhijeet receives voice notes with instructions while on a flight. He then discovers a dead passenger on one of the seats.

episodes.name: Sazaa-E-Maut
episodes.overview: In the garb of the kidnapping of school kids, CID is in for a shocking journey when Daya is kidnapped during the investigation by a man who swears on hanging Daya to his death, just like his own brother who is being hung due to CID.

episodes.name: Abhijeet Ka Insaaf
episodes.overview: Abhijit ends up killing a criminal during an interrogation. CID receives huge backlash for misusing their powers and Abhijit is suspended by ACP. A furious and heartbroken Abhijit is kidnapped by a mysterious vigilante group. They make him an offer to join th…

episodes.name: Rahasyamayi Gawah
episodes.overview: Cops are intrigued when a 17-year-old orphan suffering from a rare condition reports two murders. The problem is that she doesn't know when and where it happened and who was murdered. How will the cops solve this challenging case? Is the orphan saying the tru…

episodes.name: Rahasyamayi Hathyar: Part 1
episodes.overview: An investigation of a murder leads to death of Jimmy. Sheetal blames ACP to involve Jimmy in the case and ACP resigns from CID. Will ACP come back? Who will lead the team?

episodes.name: Rahasyamayi Hathyar: Part 2
episodes.overview: ACP is in the hunt to find Jimmy's killer but due to certain circumstance, he himself surrenders to the killer and then it's a race against time for the CID to save the ACP.

episodes.name: Aakhri Chunauti
episodes.overview: CID learn about the mysterious death of an internet celebrity named Siddharth. Daya and Abhijeet take up the case as ACP Pradyuman is busy with Jimmys birthday celebrations. Later, ACP Pradyuman is dejected learning that the case might be transferred to IB. T…

episodes.name: Satark Rahe
episodes.overview: Abhijeet gets a message on his phone. The message claims that information stored in a pen drive will lead the CID to the eye gang. The CID decide to find the pen drive. Meanwhile, ACP Pradyuman is in talks with a hacker to find out the trail of the eye gang.…

episodes.name: The Final Challenge
episodes.overview: CID is called to investigate a strange murder case. A decapitated head is found in a bowling alley. CID find the body and Dr. Salunkhe finds out that the victim was shot dead before his head was decapitated. Also found at the crime scene is a briefcase. CID f…

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: India's favourite crime thriller show is back! Abhijeet, Daya and other CID officers, led by ACP Pradyuman, join forces with forensic expert Dr Salunkhe to track down the perpetrators who have committed heinous crimes, using every small clue they can find.

episodes.name: Sniper Rifle Murderer
episodes.overview: During a critical rescue operation, Abhijeet tragically loses his daughter Shreya due to a minor error by Daya. Three months later, a mysterious shooting incident occurs on a metro, leaving a woman injured. How will ACP Pradyuman and his team uncover the trut…

episodes.name: A Mid-Air Murder
episodes.overview: On a mid-air flight, Abhijeet receives voice notes with certain instructions. He soon discovers a dead passenger on one of the seats. How will team CID aid Abhijeet solve the case and catch the culprit before the flight lands?

episodes.name: Body In The Red Suitcase
episodes.overview: During a journey from Nagpur to Mumbai, Richa's husband, Alok, vanishes under mysterious circumstances. Shockingly, his dismembered body is later discovered inside a suitcase. Who is behind this chilling crime?

episodes.name: Chehre Par Chehra
episodes.overview: CID officer Avni investigates a case involving her injured friend uncovering a tangled web of deception, identity twists, and a tragic past Can the team bring clarity to the chaos?

episodes.name: Murder On The Island
episodes.overview: Three charred bodies are discovered in a bungalow on a secluded island by catering staff. The CID team steps in to uncover the mystery behind the gruesome deaths. What secrets does the island hold?

episodes.name: Salunkhe's Catwalk
episodes.overview: The CID team investigates the mysterious death of Digvijay, an NRI groom, at his own wedding. As the case unfolds, they uncover a web of deception, hidden grudges, and unexpected twists, leading to a dramatic revelation about the true motive behind the crimes.

episodes.name: Grehani
episodes.overview: Vishal is a tech genius, whose AI, Grehani, leads to his mysterious death. The CID uncovers secrets of betrayal, rivalry, and a conspiracy surrounding the AI's dangerous potential.

episodes.name: Bank Robbery
episodes.overview: A bank robbery in Mumbai leaves manager Rahul as the sole victim of a planned attack. As CID investigates, they uncover a web of betting addiction, kidnapping, and betrayal involving Rahul, his sister-in-law Kanchan, and others.

episodes.name: Twelfth Victim
episodes.overview: A young man, Vasu, is jailed for his girlfriend Jhanvi’s murder, but years later, a serial killer confesses. CID uncovers a web of corruption, revenge, and deception tied to Jhanvi’s workplace, ultimately preventing a sinister plot and delivering justice.

episodes.name: Jungle
episodes.overview: A foreign photographer’s mysterious death in a forest sparks a CID investigation. As they uncover corruption, illegal activities, and local rituals, the team faces unforeseen challenges.

episodes.name: Gumnaam Hai Koi
episodes.overview: Tragedy strikes when a dancer suddenly collapses and dies while performing a hoola hoop routine on stage.

episodes.name: Ready to Eat
episodes.overview: The CID investigates a series of gruesome discoveries: fingers with numbers found in sausage packets. Tracing the source to a factory, they uncover a smuggling ring using victims to transport diamonds to Dubai.

episodes.name: Charcoal
episodes.overview: A corporate party turns deadly when a mysterious poison causes multiple deaths. The CID races against time, following clues to uncover the culprit and stop the poison's spread.

episodes.name: Katputli Ka Khel
episodes.overview: CID investigates a dancer's murder, uncovering a series of killings tied to an artistic pattern and a dark past. As they race to stop the next crime, the case leads to a dramatic showdown in an abandoned theatre.

episodes.name: Killer Route
episodes.overview: A series of gruesome murders targeting bus conductors on a specific route every Sunday baffles the CID, as victims are found beheaded with no trace of blood or their missing heads. Going undercover as conductors, the CID team hunts for the elusive killer.

episodes.name: The Last Fight
episodes.overview: The sudden death of a very famous underground fighter, Vikram in the ring. His girlfriend, sensing the situation, calls the CID.

episodes.name: Flat No 403
episodes.overview: A gunshot echoes through a society, leading CID to Vikrant's flat, where they find bloodstains and a skull on the wall. What mystery lies behind this chilling scene?

episodes.name: Mechanical Trap
episodes.overview: A deadly threat frames CID, putting Daya under suspicion. As the team investigates, they uncover a web of deception and the real mastermind behind the setup.

episodes.name: Haunted House
episodes.overview: Rajveer and his friends discover bloodstains in an abandoned bungalow and alert the CID. As the team investigates, they uncover something suspicious.

episodes.name: Murder In The House
episodes.overview: A woman is found dead in her home after a chandelier mysteriously falls on her. As CID investigates, they uncover suspicious details surrounding the incident.

episodes.name: Gilheri Rakshas
episodes.overview: A man discovers a dead body in the forest and suspects the Gilheri Rakshas is behind it. Can CID uncover the truth?

episodes.name: Death Of A Therapist
episodes.overview: Inspector Abhijeet discovers Dr. Meera dead at her clinic. As CID investigates, their search leads them to a Softech Solutions company. Who is behind the murder?

episodes.name: Not Guilty
episodes.overview: After an accident on a jungle road, Akshita seeks refuge with Dr. Salunkhe, who tries to shield her. As CID investigates, hidden truths unravel, leading to a shocking revelation.

episodes.name: Curse Of The Burning Man
episodes.overview: A man is found dead with burning footprints leading away. As the CID investigate, they uncover a deadly plot tied to an old shipyard legend.

episodes.name: Swimmers
episodes.overview: Three state-level swimmers go for a swim, but when one of them is found dead under mysterious circumstances, CID steps in. As they investigate, dark secrets and a cunning murder plot unravel, leading to a shocking truth.

episodes.name: Room No 804
episodes.overview: A man checks into Forest Woodland Resort only to realize that the eighth floor, which existed earlier, has mysteriously vanished. Later, CID arrives to investigate the murder of a girl found in Room 408. What is the truth behind this baffling case?

episodes.name: Baby Steps
episodes.overview: A yoga instructor, Rohini, mysteriously dies while on a call with CID, with only her baby present. Soon, another instructor, Puja, also dies. CID discovers both were killed remotely using Bluetooth hacks. How will CID solve this case?

episodes.name: The Talking Skeleton
episodes.overview: CID investigates a restaurant staff member’s death and uncovers hidden remains in a statue. As more victims emerge, they follow clues leading to a smuggling operation. How will CID get to the bottom of the case?

episodes.name: Men's Premier League
episodes.overview: The CID team is thrown into action when a biker hurls a duffel bag onto their car, raising bomb concerns. Upon inspection, they find cash and a tape recorder exposing a syndicate linked to match-fixing, with clues tied to cricket.

episodes.name: Nakabposh
episodes.overview: While Inspector Abhijeet pursues a criminal, he meets a man at a bus stop who claims to have a vision of a girl being murdered, with her hair being cut off. Soon after, CID investigates a case that matches his eerie prediction. Is this coincidence or somethin…

episodes.name: The End Of The Watch
episodes.overview: CID uncovers a bomb plot, only to realize it’s a trap by Barboza of the Golden Eye Gang. He hijacks the bureau and successfully kills ACP Pradyuman. Is this end of CID and ACP Pradyuman?

episodes.name: The Aftermath
episodes.overview: Barboza makes a threatening call to Daya, revealing ACP’s death. As the team reels from the loss, they prepare to take down Barboza and his gang. Meanwhile, Sachin remains in the ICU and Avni battles her injuries.

episodes.name: Ticket To Heaven
episodes.overview: Rajeev, a shopkeeper, is found dead on a bus under alarming circumstances - his face had turned cherry red with signs of rapid rigor mortis. CID officers Purvi and Pankaj are joined on the case by a couple of other officers, who doubt the team's capabilities…

episodes.name: Purze
episodes.overview: ACP Ayushmaan arrives as the new ACP and sets boundaries before the team. Team CID then investigates the cases of gruesome, organ-harvesting murders, where the victims are abducted and are operated on when alive.

episodes.name: Murder At The Studio
episodes.overview: Podcaster Aniket, who had recently uncovered the identity of the culprit behind a two-year-old murder case, is found dead in his studio with his throat slit. ACP Ayushmaan and the CID take charge of the investigation to uncover the truth behind this chilling…

episodes.name: Murder At The Railway Tracks
episodes.overview: A girl is found dead near the Mahim railway tracks, prompting CID to take charge of the investigation. Meanwhile, Sachin notices something suspicious about the victim's footwear and urgently asks to speak with Inspector Daya,

episodes.name: Death In The Car
episodes.overview: A company prepares for a grand launch of its latest car, meant to showcase the future of automobiles. But during the big reveal, a corpse is discovered in the driver's seat. How will CID solve the case?

episodes.name: The Silent Den
episodes.overview: A mysterious murder takes place inside a silent den, leaving Team CID with no clear leads. As suspicion spreads among the staff and guests, will they be able to uncover the killer hiding in plain sight?

episodes.name: CID Mein Gaddar
episodes.overview: Team CID arrives at a school under threat from an unknown man. Meanwhile, ACP Pradyuman and ACP Ayushmaan clash over the Barboza case, with Ayushmaan suspecting a mole within their own team

episodes.name: Accidental Death Or A Planned Murder?
episodes.overview: Two celebrities from a reality show meet a mysterious end, sending shockwaves through the industry. As the investigation unfolds, team CID is soon alerted to yet another tragic incident - the accidental death of rising star Dhwani. Are these deaths truly acci…

episodes.name: The Last Stroke
episodes.overview: A painter is found dead in his art gallery while working on a painting. As CID begins their investigation, they discover a lipstick mark on a cup, a diary, a photograph, and a mobile phone. Can these clues lead them to the killer?

episodes.name: Missing Flight
episodes.overview: Team CID is left baffled when they discover a corpse strapped to a seat, resembling a pilot who appears to have crashed. What is the mystery behind this strange death?

episodes.name: The Mysterious Death Of A Businessman
episodes.overview: A successful businessman is found dead while swimming in his pool at his farmhouse. Team CID investigates the case and is unable to find the cause of the death of the businessman. Soon after, another man is murdered. How will the team crack the cases?

episodes.name: Skeleton At A Construction Site
episodes.overview: CID team takes on a new case involving a skeleton found buried in the ground. With no initial clues, how will the team unravel the mystery?

episodes.name: Case Of Real Diamonds
episodes.overview: Two men are brutally murdered on the same night, one at home and the other at his office. The CID begins investigating and finds a diamond studed vase in both the crime scenes. Could there be a connection between the two cases?

episodes.name: The Last Call
episodes.overview: Unknown calls trigger deadly phone explosions across the city. CID discovers chips secretly installed in phones via a fake repair campaign. Linked to the old EchoNet project, the mastermind remains unknown.

episodes.name: Jewellery Theft
episodes.overview: A raid turns shocking when CID uncovers stolen jewellery in a godown - alongside Inspector Daya's badge. As suspicion clouds the team, a second daring heist strikes another jewellery store, carried out by masked men. Is Daya truly behind it, or is someone fra…

episodes.name: ACP Pradyuman Is Alive?
episodes.overview: Daya tells the CID team that ACP Pradyuman is alive-but in a shocking twist, he reveals that the ACP failed to recognize him and opened fire. As the team reels from the news, Daya exposes a dark secret about Barboza and his gang that shakes them to the core.…

episodes.name: ACP Pradyuman Tricks CID
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman escapes with Barboza, deceiving the entire CID team. When he walks into the bureau, Abhijeet refuses to believe his story. Later, ACP reveals the shocking truth behind how he survived the bureau blast.

episodes.name: Accident Or Murder?
episodes.overview: Purvi comes under suspicion as the team believes she's the mole, until the DIG arrives just in time to defend her. Meanwhile, CID investigates a minor car crash with a shocking twist. Was the driver killed in the accident, or was he already dead before the im…

episodes.name: Behind the Glamour
episodes.overview: Ira, an actress who had bagged a coveted role, is found hanging in her apartment. Team CID investigates the case as they find out about Ira's rival. Who killed Ira, and why?

episodes.name: Death In The Jungle
episodes.overview: While trekking, four friends stumble upon a headless body deep in the jungle. When CID investigates, they find something even stranger - the body has no blood. With no clues and rising fear, can CID uncover the truth behind this eerie mystery?

episodes.name: Dead Men In Uniform
episodes.overview: A group of kids find a gun in their society. Soon after, a policeman falls to his death. A young girl silently sees someone who looks like Daya behind a mask. Later, two more police officers are murdered. What is this case really about?

episodes.name: Janamdin Par Maut
episodes.overview: Officer Daya tampers some of the evidence of a case. Parallelly, a man is murdered as he enters his house for his surprise birthday party. Notably, while waiting for Salil to return, Dodo makes a statement about the incident of a man being killed on his birth…

episodes.name: Omkar Sawant Joins The Team
episodes.overview: Daya shoots Inspector Milan on a moving bus. As CID begins their investigation, Superintendent Omkar Sawant joins the team. While interrogating the passengers, they uncover four distinct personalities within the same man. Can they reach Daya in time and will…

episodes.name: Omkar Sawant Has A Breakthrough
episodes.overview: Superintendent Omkar Sawant announces that the death of Officer Milan has resulted in a breakthrough in the case. Soon after, he states that he has been tracing Officer Daya's moves. Meanwhile, team CID is notified about murder cases that lead to similar, tor…

episodes.name: Officer Daya Is On The Run
episodes.overview: Officer Daya disguises himself and boards a flight. The same flight happens to get hijacked. With team CID on the hunt for Officer Daya, will he be able to save the passengers, conceal his identity, and get away without drawing any attention towards him?

episodes.name: An Encrypted Message
episodes.overview: Team CID raids Officer Daya's house and discovers that he has escaped in disguise. While Officer Daya takes Shreya's help once he lands in Delhi, some of the members of Team CID decrypt his secret message left behind. What will the encrypted message lead to?

episodes.name: Purvi Receives A Message
episodes.overview: While team CID surrounds the Governor's residence, Daya succeeds in sending an encrypted message to Purvi. Daya and Shreya continue working on their operation. Will Purvi be able to decipher Daya's message?

episodes.name: Double Agent Daya
episodes.overview: When Omkar Sawant exposes Daya's truth, Abhijeet defends him and reveals the real mastermind. As Purvi and Abhijeet enter the building to rescue Daya and the Governor, will their mission succeed?

episodes.name: Team CID On A Vacation
episodes.overview: While team CID is on vacation at a resort, they discover that a comedian's manager named Mohan has been murdered after being hit on the head by a coconut. Can they solve the case while still on holiday?

episodes.name: Officer Purvi's Narrow Escape
episodes.overview: Team CID finds out the cause of Tanya's death. Soon after, Officer Purvi narrowly escapes acid being flung towards her. On further investigation, the team narrows down the list of suspects. Will the culprit outwit team CID?

episodes.name: Ekk Anokha Case
episodes.overview: Sarthak, a man who is found dead, writes in his suicide note about murdering somebody else. Team CID has 72 hours to crack the case and save the life of the victim. Who is the victim and why did Sarthak kill him before dying?

episodes.name: Dr Salunkhe Goes Missing
episodes.overview: With only 42 hours left, Dr. Salunkhe is missing. Meanwhile, the man impersonating him is found dead inside the jail. During the investigation, it is revealed that someone posing as Daya had visited Dr. Salunkhe in jail. Will CID be able to find the real Dr.…

episodes.name: CID Ke Naam Ek Gift
episodes.overview: ACP Pradyuman receives a mysterious call about a gift from someone calling himself the Chessmaster. CID finds themselves caught in a real-life game of chess as they race to solve the case. What danger lies ahead for the team?

episodes.name: Ekk Insaan, Do Maut
episodes.overview: Team CID investigates the death of a man and finds out that he has died twice. How will the team uncover this curious mystery, and what is the cause of the death?

episodes.name: Accident Ya Murder?
episodes.overview: A bike accident takes a shocking turn when the autopsy reveals hidden truths. The team begins to suspect foul play. Was it really an accident or a cleverly planned murder? The race to find out the truth begins.

episodes.name: Officer Abhijeet Witnesses A Crime
episodes.overview: While recovering at home from an injury, Officer Abhijeet believes that he has witnessed a crime take place in the apartment opposite his. Officer Daya arrives at the aforesaid apartment and finds the apartment bare. Team CID investigates whether a crime has…

episodes.name: Failed Transactions
episodes.overview: Multiple payment transactions fail across the city. Meanwhile, CID probes an accident involving a doctor set to receive an award on 15th August, only to discover he was responsible for YPI transaction security. What mystery will this investigation uncover?

episodes.name: Shraap
episodes.overview: CID investigates a case in a chawl where young Prasad collapses during Dahi Handi practice, his body twisted backwards from the waist. While an old lady calls it a curse, will CID uncover the real cause?

episodes.name: Dead Principal
episodes.overview: The principal of a college is found dead under mysterious circumstances. When CID investigates, they find red powder in his nails and deep scratches on his neck. Their suspicion falls on Professor Ajit, but is he really behind the murder or is there more to t…

episodes.name: Do Minute, Do Khoon
episodes.overview: As the organisers at Lunaro Art Gallery gear up for their most anticipated exhibition, Dr Myra and Vikram are found murdered. Team CID investigates the case but gets trapped at the gallery when the anti-theft alarm goes off. Will they solve the crime with dep…

episodes.name: Manch Par Maut
episodes.overview: Amid Ganpati celebrations, the CID team is called in to investigate the mysterious death of a famous dance teacher. While it appears to be a heart attack, suspicions of murder grow stronger. Will the truth come out?

episodes.name: The Headless Dead Body
episodes.overview: Team CID investigates the case of a headless dead body found in a trunk on top of a bus. Who is the victim, why was he murdered and who is the culprit?

episodes.name: An Author's Murder Mystery
episodes.overview: While Team CID is busy playing a game of chess, they receive news of the murder of renowned novelist Surya. The case appears to be a natural death at first, until they discover a burnt paper with details about the murder in his room. How will CID unravel this…

episodes.name: A Serial Killer's Revenge
episodes.overview: Chaos erupts when a feared serial killer breaks free, determined to hunt those behind his arrest. As fear grips the city, the CID team must stay one step ahead and track him down before his deadly revenge claims more victims.",shortDescription:"Chaos erupts w…

episodes.name: Shooting Stars
episodes.overview: Arpan mysteriously dies moments after proposing to his girlfriend through a video under a shooting star. When the CID begins its investigation, they discover his charred body at the very spot of the attack. Was Arpan truly killed by a celestial phenomenon, or…

episodes.name: High Security Murder
episodes.overview: Abhijeet receives a threat that his friend Dhanraj's life is in danger. With Dhanraj under high-profile security, can Abhijeet reach him before it's too late?

episodes.name: Haunted Amusement Park
episodes.overview: A social media experiment to revive an abandoned amusement park turns sinister when an influencer dies mid-stunt. Can the CID team uncover the dark truth hidden inside?

episodes.name: Bureau Mein Murder
episodes.overview: A man walks into the CID bureau to report a threat to his life and warns ACP Pradyuman about an impending attack in Mumbai. But before he can say more, he suddenly dies right there in the bureau. How will ACP Pradyuman and his team uncover the truth behind th…

episodes.name: Influencer Ki Maut
episodes.overview: On being called by Shanaya's concerned manager, team CID smashes Shanaya's door and finds her murdered. The top suspects involve Shanaya's current boyfriend and her ex-boyfriend. Based on the postmortem results, team CID hunts for an important clue. How will…

episodes.name: Pariyon Ki Duniya
episodes.overview: CID takes on a baffling case where people act possessed, speak of a fairyland, and then die by suicide. With no substances found in their bodies and all deaths occurring at the same time, what is really behind this mystery?

episodes.name: A Poisoned Necklace
episodes.overview: Shreya arrives to attend the engagement ceremony of Rashi and Aman. Soon after, Rashi is found murdered after having wom a poisoned necklace. Team CID investigates the case and finds out that a slow poison was being administered to Rashi since a while. Who is…

episodes.name: Curious Case Of Artificial Intelligence
episodes.overview: Cricketer Neerav's daughter is kidnapped from school, and CID steps in to investigate. They discover that an unknown person picked her up claiming to have Neerav's permission. How will CID crack the case?

episodes.name: Murder At The Resort
episodes.overview: Team CID reaches a resort to investigate the mysterious death of a young girl. Upon inspection, they discover she was stabbed in a fit of rage. Will CID uncover the truth behind Surbhi's death while questioning her friends?

episodes.name: Deadly Overtime
episodes.overview: A woman is murdered under mysterious circumstances while working late in her office. The CID team notices something strange in the CCTV footage. Motion sensors detect movement but no body appears. Forensics reveal unusual entry and exit wounds. Can the team s…

episodes.name: Bungalow Mein Maut
episodes.overview: CID investigates a shocking case where a man named Kunal is found dead, but the police discover that Kunal himself had reported his own death before it happened. What is the mystery behind this eerie case?

episodes.name: An Obsessed Fan
episodes.overview: Neha is found dead in actress Aisha's green room, stabbed in the back with a pair of scissors. During the investigation, Pankaj discovers a strange necklace with Aisha's photo made from blue hair. What dark secret lies behind this eerie clue?

episodes.name: RJ Ki Maut
episodes.overview: Pankaj is on a call with RJ Rishabh when suddenly, the RJ calls out for help and is then found murdered. When team CID investigates the case, they find a few dead honeybees in the room. Who is the culprit and why was the crime committed?

episodes.name: Karmo Ka Phal
episodes.overview: A man is found dead with his face crushed by a stone and a message scrawled in his blood at an isolated spot with no CCTV. Was his death a personal vendetta, or is there a darker motive behind it?

episodes.name: Death Of A Fortune Teller
episodes.overview: A crowd gathers to hear messages from their ancestors through a woman, but suddenly the woman collapses and dies right before their eyes. When CID arrives to investigate, they discover someone else's blood stains at the scene. What dark truth lies behind this…

episodes.name: Buried In Cement
episodes.overview: A unique case comes up for the CID team when a body is discovered buried in cement inside an abandoned bungalow. What clues will the team uncover from this corpse that has been lying there for months?

episodes.name: Cursed Mirror
episodes.overview: Actress Reva is found unconscious after a mysterious accident that appears to be deliberate. When CID takes charge of the investigation, they discover that Reva possessed a cursed mirror. What dark secret lies behind this shocking incident?

episodes.name: Death After Discharge
episodes.overview: Dhiren, a businessman, is found dead in his car after being discharged from the hospital. Team CID investigates the case and finds out more about his family dynamics and the ongoing politics in his business. Who murdered Dhiren and why?

episodes.name: Maut Ki Dhamki
episodes.overview: Businessman Kuldeep receives a threatening phone call over a bungalow dispute and is later found dead in his meditation room. Team CID investigates the case and discovers a broken window and aroma oil on his face. Who killed Kuldeep?

episodes.name: Apsara
episodes.overview: While team CID heads out for a picnic, they stumble upon a mysterious case involving a missing policeman. The prime suspect is a woman who lives by the lake and is known to lure men with her charm and jewellery. As the team dives deeper into the investigation…

episodes.name: Ekk Anokha Shadyantra
episodes.overview: Team CID investigates a case where they find a woman's body without the head. The entire team stitches various clues together and identifies the victim to be Alisha. On further investigation, the team narrows down the flow of the events leading to the murder.…

episodes.name: A Chain Of Murders
episodes.overview: The CID team stumbles upon a strange case where an auto-rickshaw driver is found strangled to death with no signs of struggle and no witnesses. Soon after, another eerily similar death is discovered not far from the first scene. Is a serial killer on the loos…

episodes.name: SOS Call
episodes.overview: Team CID follows a set of coordinates to a secluded location after receiving an SOS call. As they begin their search, they try to track down Officer Shreya and a woman named Sarla who was with her. What mystery lies behind this case, and where have Shreya and…

episodes.name: Rakshak Baba
episodes.overview: Three friends trespass onto land owned by Rakshak Baba. One escapes, but the other two are found decapitated and their bodies discovered deeper in the forest. How will CID piece the case together?

episodes.name: The Ghost Of Kalighati Village
episodes.overview: While on vacation, Daya discovers a village plagued by murders. Locals claim a witch is behind these deaths. Can he uncover the truth?

episodes.name: Murder At The Bureau
episodes.overview: When a serial killer dies in CID custody, suspicion falls on Abhijeet. ACP Pradyuman defends him as the team fights to clear his name.

episodes.name: Abhijeet's Secret Caller
episodes.overview: A truck driver named Munna is found dead and his partner is missing. CID is stunned to discover that the RDX once loaded in the truck has vanished. During the investigation, Abhijeet receives a rose and a call from a mysterious woman asking for help. Are thes…

episodes.name: Abhijeet Shoots Daya
episodes.overview: With Abhijeet suspected of having gone rogue, team CID attempts to track 400 kg of RDX across the city. The team follows a lead and tracks delivery boys in the city. Shortly after, during a shootout, Abhijeet fires at Daya before escaping. What is Abhijeet's…

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Working-class girl Geum Jan-di winds up at an exclusive prep academy and teams up with the popular boys of F4, who literally rule the school.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Just being rich isn't enough to survive the teen tyranny at Shinhwa – outsiders or loners are often marked as targets by the bored über-clique F4.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: A scandalous rumor is spread on the Internet that a second-year student at Shinhwa High School, identified as "Miss K," is pregnant.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Not keen to watch Jan-di dancing with one of his best friends, Jun-pyo leaves the ballroom and ends up taking out his frustrations by the poolside.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Making a sudden decision, Jan-di tells her mother she has to go somewhere and runs off, heading toward Namsan Tower.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Jan-di's bike is set on fire while she is assaulted with water balloons and blasted with a fire extinguisher.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: A psychic predicts that Jan-di will be losing something important.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Jun-pyo plans to evict his best friend and Jan-di out of Shinhwa High School – and out of F4.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Jan-di rushes to the hospital after hearing that Jun-pyo has been in an accident.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Yi-jung receives a hysterical call from his mother threatening to commit suicide because of his father.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Valentine's Day reveals hidden feelings. With the family dry cleaning business in serious trouble, Jan-di decides to take a new job.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: A note indicates that class has been moved to the science lab. The lab is empty, but Jan-di waits, not noticing that the room is filling with fumes.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Jan-di's father gets taken away by loan sharks, which inevitably forces Jan-di's mother to swallow her pride and beg Madam Kang for help.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: The F4 guys have moved on to university, while Jan-di has entered her final year of high school. She has not heard from Jun-pyo since he left.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Jan-di waits to hear the results of F4's meeting with Jun-pyo, and can tell from their expressions that it was not good.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: After treating Jan-di in a harsh manner, Mr. Jung prepares everything so that Jun-pyo can see her in Seoul. Can he go without Madam Kang finding out?

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Jan-di's family hears about Jun-pyo's engagement and asks her dejectedly if it's true.

episodes.name: Episode 17
episodes.overview: Ji-hoo can see how hurt Jan-di is by the kiss, and continues to follow her as she walks around in a daze.

episodes.name: Episode 18
episodes.overview: Jun-pyo starts seeing Jae-kyung in a different way, like he's seeing her for the first time as a potential friend – or maybe a kindred spirit.

episodes.name: Episode 19
episodes.overview: Woo-bin tries to talk some sense into Yi-jung, who is hell bent on drinking himself into oblivion.

episodes.name: Episode 20
episodes.overview: At home, Jun-hee thinks back to how her mother interfered in her life, in much the same way she's interfering in Jun-pyo's now.

episodes.name: Episode 21
episodes.overview: Yi-jung is happily waiting for Eun-jae, until he accidentally overhears her phone conversation, which sounds like she is talking to a boyfriend.

episodes.name: Episode 22
episodes.overview: Jun-pyo pleads for Jan-di to tell him not to get married.

episodes.name: Episode 23
episodes.overview: Jun-pyo tells Jan-di that he'll protect her, but to Jun-pyo's surprise, she says that she does not want to be protected or taken care of.

episodes.name: Episode 24
episodes.overview: Feeling it's time to reveal the truth, Mr. Jung leads Jun-hee to the mystery patient's bedside, and at the sight of her father, Jun-hee breaks down.

episodes.name: Episode 25
episodes.overview: Jun-pyo asks Yumi to make the lunchbox again, proving that Yumi had taken credit for the lunch that Jan-di had made for him.

seasons.name: Vampire Knight
seasons.overview: Yuki is a first-year student at Cross Academy, a prestigious institution that hosts regular classes by day and a school for vampires by night.

episodes.name: Night of Vampires
episodes.overview: Cross Academy has two sessions, the Day Class and the Night Class; the latter consists of students who are beautiful, intelligent ... and vampires!

episodes.name: Memories of Blood
episodes.overview: Yuki is busy patrolling the school grounds for Day Class girls who are trying to sneak chocolates to the Night Class boys for St. Xocolatl’s Day.

episodes.name: The Fang of Penitence
episodes.overview: When Zero suddenly leaves the school grounds, Yuki goes after him and roams the streets alone, until a mysterious mother and child appear before her.

episodes.name: Trigger of Condemnation
episodes.overview: Seeing the state Yuki is in, Kaname takes her from Zero, who is speechless when he realizes what he has done. Yuki cries, unaware of Zero’s secret.

episodes.name: Moonlight Festivities
episodes.overview: A new ethics teacher arrives at Cross Academy. His atypical looks are all the buzz among the Day Class; even Zero has lost his usual composure.

episodes.name: Their Choices
episodes.overview: Zero is tempted to sink his fangs into Yuki, and even though he's able to regain his composure, he finds himself the target of a teacher.

episodes.name: The Scarlet Maze
episodes.overview: Yuki makes a decision regarding Zero, who is determined to fight his affliction until the very end. Yuki feels guilty for betraying Kaname.

episodes.name: Gunshot of Sorrow
episodes.overview: There's a commotion in the Moon dormitory when the Night Class gets word that Takuma’s grandfather, a figure in the vampire world, will be visiting.

episodes.name: Crimson Gaze
episodes.overview: Day Class students are chasing after the Night Class due to the upcoming dance. Meanwhile, the Headmaster asks Yuki to show a transfer student around.

episodes.name: The Princess of Darkness
episodes.overview: Zero tutors Yuki for an exam, but all the while something is wrong with him. Meanwhile, at the Moon dormitory, Kaname confronts Maria in his room.

episodes.name: Consequence of Desire
episodes.overview: Maria’s masked servant reveals himself as a jealous figure from Zero's past whom Zero has not seen since their separation long ago.

episodes.name: Vow of the Pureblood
episodes.overview: Yuki learns Maria's true identity. With this new information, Yuki accepts a deal to offer her blood in order to save Zero.

episodes.name: Crimson Chains
episodes.overview: Shizuka suffers a wound. Meanwhile, Yuki and Zero try to find out where Shizuka may have gone, but Zero's constantly thwarted by his Level E seizures.

seasons.name: Vampire Knight: Guilty
seasons.overview: In Season 2, Cross Academy student Yuki is determined to uncover the truth about her past, but she will have to choose between Kaname and Zero.

episodes.name: Burden of Sinners
episodes.overview: After Shizuka Hio’s death, peace is restored at the academy. But when Zero returns, the vampires of the Senate accuse him of murder.

episodes.name: The Eternal Promise
episodes.overview: Yuki has a lot on her mind after almost being kissed by Zero. She asserts that she will not speak to Kaname until he admits to Zero’s innocence.

episodes.name: The Azure Portrait
episodes.overview: The Night Class goes to the Aido family’s vacation home during the long break, but Hanabusa decides to stay at the academy to investigate Kaname.

episodes.name: Devil's Awakening
episodes.overview: While the Night Class is at the Aido family’s vacation home, Yuki, driven by her desire to stop hurting Zero, tries to regain her memory of the past.

episodes.name: The Subordinate's Trap
episodes.overview: Yuki is continually haunted by visions of blood. Nevertheless, she is determined to find out about her past from Kaname.

episodes.name: The Fake Lovers
episodes.overview: Kaname asks Yuki to be his lover. The Night Class guards begin accompanying her everywhere, and Yuki cannot hide her embarrassment.

episodes.name: The Kiss of Thorns
episodes.overview: Senri returns to the Academy, but upon having a confidential talk with Ichiru, he becomes noticeably different from before.

episodes.name: Spiraling Recollections
episodes.overview: Yuki wakes up a vampire, and her memory of her childhood returns. She now remembers her father, her mother and her brother.

episodes.name: Revival of the Mad Emperor
episodes.overview: Yuki now understands who she really is. Worried about Zero, she sneaks out of her room to find him -- but he simply can't accept what she has become.

episodes.name: Prelude to the Battle
episodes.overview: The Headmaster calls for an emergency evacuation of the Day Class students, as Rido’s servant vampires begin attacking the students.

episodes.name: Two Souls
episodes.overview: In order to protect the academy, the Headmaster confronts the head of the Hunter Society while Rido is still on the rampage.

episodes.name: World's End
episodes.overview: Yuki decides that as Guardian, she must protect all the students at the academy and fight Rido.

episodes.name: Vampire Knight
episodes.overview: All of Zero’s strength is not enough to kill Rido -- he will need Kaname's help. But the fight will leave Cross Academy devastated.

seasons.name: Mobile Suit Gundam SEED
seasons.overview: C.E.70. The friction between the Naturals (the Earth Alliance) and the Coordinators (ZAFT), who seek to establish their own economic bloc, finally escalates into armed conflict with the "Bloody Valentine" tragedy. With its mobile suits, ZAFT is able to overwh…

episodes.name: False Peace
episodes.overview: The Orb Union space colony, Heliopolis, is attacked by ZAFT, despite its neutrality since the beginning of the Bloody Valentine War. Kira Yamato accidentally sees the Earth Alliance's new prototype mobile suits, which have been secretly constructed at the Hel…

episodes.name: Its Name is Gundam
episodes.overview: ZAFT is able to steal four of the five G-Project prototype mobile suits, leaving only the GAT-X105 Strike. With Murrue Ramius unable to pilot it effectively, Kira pilots the Strike and defends Heliopolis against the invading ZAFT forces to protect his friends…

episodes.name: Collapsing Land
episodes.overview: Lt. Murrue Ramius takes over as captain of the Archangel and Kira and his friends are detained for seeing top secret military weapons. Rau Le Creuset is determined to capture the Strike after seeing how well it moved and sends out mobile suits to retrieve it.…

episodes.name: Silent Run
episodes.overview: Kira discovers a malfunctioning lifeboat and brings it aboard the Archangel. Everyone is surprised to find Flay Allster as one of the rescued civilians. The Archangel decides to head for the Eurasian Federation military satellite Artemis to seek help. Rau Le…

episodes.name: Phase Shift Down
episodes.overview: Mu La Flaga and Kira launch a counteroffensive against the ZAFT ship Vesalius. The Strike's Phase Shift Armor runs out of power in the middle of the battle and Athrun uses this moment to grab the Strike so he can take Kira with him, but Kira frees himself wit…

episodes.name: The Vanishing Gundam
episodes.overview: The Archangel and its crew are held captive by the Artemis forces. Nicol Amalfi in his GAT-X207 Blitz attacks Artemis, using its Mirage Colloid armor to remain effectively invisible and destroys the Umbrella of Artemis, which protects the asteroid fortress. D…

episodes.name: The Scar of Space
episodes.overview: The Archangel forages for water in the Debris Belt. They are shocked to find themselves in the ruins of Junius Seven, so the crew decides to hold a memorial. As they are excavating ice found around the ruin, a ZAFT mobile suit attacks, but Kira dispatches him…

episodes.name: Songstress of the Enemy Forces
episodes.overview: Lacus Clyne, the daughter of PLANT Supreme Council Chairman Siegel Clyne, is found within the lifepod. Her presence causes tension within the crew, but when the crew receives a message from the 8th Fleet that they are being searched and rescued, they are over…

episodes.name: The Fading Light
episodes.overview: The Archangel is to meet with the 8th fleet but is attacked by the Le Creuset Team. Flay witnesses the death of her father when Kira fails to protect the escort ships. In desperation, the Archangel reveals Lacus is on board the ship, causing the attackers to…

episodes.name: Separate Ways
episodes.overview: With everything that has happened, Kira becomes depressed. He is comforted by Lacus, who is strolling around the ship without permission. Kira returns Lacus to Athrun against orders, but refuses Athrun's invitation to change sides.

episodes.name: The Awakening Sword
episodes.overview: Le Creuset launches an attack on the Archangel. Kira's desire to protect his friends awakens an unknown almost berserker ability. He single-handedly defeats the attacking GAT-X207 Blitz, GAT-X103 Buster, and GAT-X102 Duel.

episodes.overview: While on a field trip to a cave in Japan, Zoe is asked to sit next to a new student named Amy when she's on the bus, and just make her feel welcome. But as some girls in the row behind them start talking about lizards, Amy starts to feel a little sad, and she…

episodes.name: Just Plane Crazy
episodes.overview: When Dr. Reece takes Max, Rex, and Zoe to the airport, Zoe encounters an air traffic controller named Stanley. The Alpha Gang's latest transportation crashes with the airplane Rex, Ace, and Dr. Reece are in careening dangerously in the sky. Ursula, Zander, an…

episodes.name: A Loch Ness Mess
episodes.overview: An Amargasaurus has been activated in Loch Ness, Scotland and it's appearance in the lake cause people to think it's the Loch Ness Monster.

episodes.name: Fashion Victims
episodes.overview: An Anchiceratops has been activated in Paris, France at the same time when dinosaur fashion is big. The big problem is that Chomp is lost in Paris when Max's Dinoholder breaks.

episodes.name: A Miner Disaster
episodes.overview: The Alpha Gang arrive at some Japanese mines and successfully find a Futabasaurus card as well as trying to harvest Alpha Metal. When the D-Team encounters them, Ursula activates it to fend them off. However, Spiny and Tank end up turning against it leaving i…

episodes.name: Double or Nothing
episodes.overview: Max, Zoe, and Rex manage to thwart the robbery of 4 people that resemble Dr. Z and his three henchmen who end up escaping without the stolen money. This causes the Alpha Gang to seek them out. Soon, Dr. Z, Ed, Zander, and Ursula collaborate with them to pull…

episodes.name: Alien Parent Trap
episodes.overview: Max’s house vanishes with everyone’s parents inside.

episodes.name: Ancient Roman Holiday
episodes.overview: The D Team’s time machine lands in Ancient Rome where they battle a space pirate who has his own Dinosaurs.

episodes.name: Desperately Seeking Spartacus
episodes.overview: The D Team’s time machine lands in Ancient Rome where they battle a space pirate who has his own Dinosaurs.

episodes.name: Coliseum Clash
episodes.overview: Dinosaurs battle in Rome’s ancient Coliseum.

episodes.name: There's No Place Like Rome
episodes.overview: The legendary gladiator, Spartacus, is forced to battle a Dinosaur in Rome’s Coliseum.

episodes.name: Dinosaurs of the Caribbean
episodes.overview: The D-Team travels to the Caribbean Sea in the year 1718 where they find a treasure map that shows the location of the second Cosmos Stone.

episodes.name: X-treme Map Quest
episodes.overview: The Alpha Gang joins the D-Team to fight Blackbeard’s Pirates over a treasure map.

episodes.name: High Sea Chase
episodes.overview: The battle over the treasure map moves to the high seas.

episodes.name: Amazing Treasure Race
episodes.overview: Max and his friends, the Space Pirates and Blackbeard all get close to finding the buried treasure which is the Second Cosmos Stone.

episodes.name: Four Part Harmony
episodes.overview: Max and his friends chase the space pirates to Ancient China where they encounter a famous monk, Sanzo Hoshi (Shwan-dzang).

episodes.name: Elements of Surprise
episodes.overview: When Max and the gang use Sanzo Hoshi (Shwan-dzang) to track down the Space Pirates they get sidetracked defending a small village.

episodes.name: Monk in the Middle
episodes.overview: With Sanzo (Shwan-dzang) slowing down Max and his friends at every turn the gang decides to ditch the old monk so they can quickly catch up with the Space Pirates.

episodes.name: The Third Cosmos Stone
episodes.overview: Max and the gang must rescue Sanzo (Shwan-dzang) from the clutches of the Space Pirates before they force him to work his magic.

episodes.name: Two Shoguns Are Better Than One
episodes.overview: Max, Rex and Zoe are rescued from the plains of ancient China by Jonathan and are led by the Pterosaur to ancient Japan.

episodes.name: The No-Fun Shogun
episodes.overview: As Max and his friends accompany the Shogun to find the Cosmos Stone they’re stopped by the Space Pirates and a band of ninjas.

episodes.name: Dinosaurs, Ninjas and Bears! Oh My!
episodes.overview: When Max and the gang venture into a mysterious cave with the Shogun to try and find the Cosmos Stone they find the Space Pirates instead!

episodes.name: There's No Business Like Shogun Business
episodes.overview: When Zoe's father, posing as the Shogun, is about to lead a Japanese army into certain defeat, Max and the gang must race to save them.

episodes.name: The 39 Thieves
episodes.overview: The Pterosaur leads Max and friends to the desert of ancient Persia, where they meet a Princess who offers to help them find the next Cosmos Stone but also needs some help of her own.

episodes.name: Desert Heat
episodes.overview: Max and friends must take on the Alpha Gang and 39 thieves in order to save the Princess.

episodes.name: Princess of the City
episodes.overview: Max and the gang arrive at Princess Zahrah’s kingdom only to find that it’s been overrun by bandits and dinosaurs!

episodes.name: Malice in the Palace
episodes.overview: Max and friends must race to find the Cosmos Stone before the Space Pirates are able to snatch it.

episodes.name: The French Conniption
episodes.overview: In 17th-century Paris, Max and friends try to beat Shear and the Space Pirates to the next Cosmos Stone but end up butting heads with an orphan named D’Artagnan.

episodes.name: The Wee Musketeers
episodes.overview: Max and the gang hurry to find the next Cosmos Stone and warn Princess Anne that the evil Chancellor Richelieu is up to no good.

episodes.name: All For One
episodes.overview: The search for the next Cosmos Stone continues but with Chancellor Richelieu’s soldiers hiding behind every corner.

episodes.name: The Haunted Hunt
episodes.overview: Max and friends must search a haunted castle for the next Cosmos Stone but the real scares come from the Space Pirates.

episodes.name: Bad Deal
episodes.overview: When Max tries to make a deal with the Space Pirates it all goes horribly wrong and the gang ends up stuck in the Jurassic Period.

episodes.name: The Forest Fire Effect
episodes.overview: Max and the gang must travel back in time and fix a historical glitch.

episodes.name: The Search for the Last Cosmos Stone
episodes.overview: Max and the gang must find the last remaining Cosmos Stone before the Space Pirates get to it.

episodes.name: Clash for the Cosmos Stones
episodes.overview: Max and the gang are in a three way clash with the Space Pirates and Seth for the seven Cosmos Stones.

episodes.name: Fate of the Cosmos
episodes.overview: Now that the seven Cosmos Stones have merged, Max and the gang must find a way to keep all of time and space from sudden doom.

episodes.name: Bust Through the Heavens with Your Drill!!
episodes.overview: Living underground in Giha Village, Simon and Kamina dream of a life on the surface. When their home is invaded from above, it is up to them to activate the mysterious mecha Lagann and save their village.

episodes.name: I Said I'm Gonna Pilot That Thing!!
episodes.overview: Now that they've made it to the surface, Simon and Kamina must join together with Yoko and her village to defeat the Beastmen pursuing them.

episodes.name: Who Do You Think You Are, Having Two Faces!!
episodes.overview: Kamina and Simon must work together to defeat a dangerous new Beastman threat.

episodes.name: Having Lots of Faces Doesn't Make You Great!
episodes.overview: Team Gurren must work together with the eccentric Black Syblings to take down a Beastman foe on empty stomachs.

episodes.name: I Don't Get It, Not One Bit!
episodes.overview: Team Gurren must find their way out of a strange underground village where Gunmen are worshipped as divine beings.

episodes.name: Sit in the Hot Tub 'Til You're Sick!!
episodes.overview: Continuing to the Gunmen rallying point, Team Gurren finds themselves on a strange hot springs getaway.

episodes.name: You're Gonna Do It!!
episodes.overview: Thymilph, one of the Four Divine Generals of the mysterious Spiral King, arrives to support Viral's Enki, with the massive mobile Gunmen fortress, the Dai-Ganzan. Kamina and Simon pilot the Gurren-Lagann against seemingly overwhelming odds.

episodes.name: Later, Buddy
episodes.overview: Having temporarily stalled Viral and Thymilph in the last skirmish, the Team Gurren and their newly arrived allies join forces as "Team Dai-Gurren" and launch a decisive strike against the regrouping Gunmen force.

episodes.name: What, Exactly, Is a Human?
episodes.overview: Team Dai-Gurren managed to take control of the enemy fortress, but is still mourning the death of one of their own, especially Simon. After falling off a cliff, he notices a Gunman throw a capsule into a deep valley. Simon inspects it and finds he is able to…

episodes.name: Who Is This Bro?
episodes.overview: Nia true identity is revealed, as she flaunts her authority to get rid of another one of the Four Divine Generals, Adiane. The members of the Great Gurren Brigade are now suspicious of Nia and her true intentions, but she is only concerned about the depressed…

episodes.name: Simon, Hands Off
episodes.overview: Team Dai-Gurren falls into a trap set by the third member of the Four Divine Generals, Guame. The Team is taken captive and stored underground to await execution. While digging an escape path, Simon finally understands Kamina's last words to him and after hav…

episodes.name: Yoko, Will You Do Me a Favor?
episodes.overview: Team Dai-Gurren are now on their way to Beastmen's capital city, Teppelin but there's a vast ocean in their way. The only way for them to get across is for the Dai-Gurren to be modified, so while they wait everyone goes to chill out at the beach. Once prepara…

episodes.name: Eat Up Everyone!
episodes.overview: Trying to do her part in Team Dai-Gurren, Nia decides to become a cook, but just before the crew have a taste of her dishes, Cytomander, the fourth member of the Divine Generals, launches an aerial attack on the Dai-Gurren. Simon leads the counter-attack on t…

episodes.name: Well Met, Everyone
episodes.overview: At last, Team Dai-Gurren arrives at the outskirts of Teppelin, but before aiming to the city, they must face a combined full-scale attack of Cytomander and Guame's forces.

episodes.name: I Will Head Towards Tomorrow
episodes.overview: The last of the Divine Generals fall, and the city of Teppelin collapses, revealing a Gunman of gigantic proportions. Simon and Nia struggle to pass through it in order to confront her father, the Spiral King himself.

episodes.name: Compilation Episode
episodes.overview: A recap of the story's events from the previous episodes.

episodes.name: You Don't Know Anything!
episodes.overview: During the following seven years, a new civilization rises and prospers under Simon's leadership. However, these peaceful times come to end when the threat mentioned in Lordgenome's last words starts to reveal itself.

episodes.name: Tell Me the Secrets of This World
episodes.overview: After the Anti-Spirals' first attack and Nia's astonishing announcement, Simon looks desperately for her, while Rossiu finally completes his secret project.

episodes.name: We Will Survive By Any Means Necessary
episodes.overview: To soothe the public opinion, Rossiu overthrows Simon and puts him under arrest. But when the Anti-Spirals launch a large-scale attack on Kamina City, he is left with no option but to let Simon engage the enemy using the Gurren-Lagann, not before resorting to…

episodes.name: How Far Will God Test Us?
episodes.overview: As Simon arrives in prison, he unexpectedly meets Viral, who comments on how far he has fallen. Meanwhile, the truth about Rossiu's emergency plan and the consequences for those left behind on Earth are revealed.

episodes.name: You Are Someone Who Ought to Survive
episodes.overview: One year earlier, Yoko starts working as a schoolteacher on an island until she learns of the situation at Teppelin and returns to break Simon free. Once again reunited, Simon and the members of Team Dai-Gurren launch themselves into space to protect the Arc-…

episodes.name: This Is My Final Duty!
episodes.overview: The Gurren-Lagann and the Arc-Gurren join together to form the massive Arc-Gurren-Lagann and stop the Human Annihilation System.

episodes.name: Let's Go, This Is the Final Battle
episodes.overview: The members of Team Dai-Gurren make their preparations for the imminent war against the Anti-Spirals, but Rossiu is missing. However, when Kinon tells Simon about what he really intends to do, both start to look desperately for him.

episodes.name: I'll Never Forget This Minute, This Second
episodes.overview: Guided by Simon and Nia's feelings for each other, Team Dai-Gurren break through dimensions in search for the Anti-Spirals' homeworld. But after falling into the enemy's trap, they end up losing some of their most precious members, due to its vicious offensiv…

episodes.name: I Accept Your Last Wish!
episodes.overview: Team Dai-Gurren struggles to escape from the ocean of despair created by the Anti-Spirals without success, until history repeats itself, as another irreplaceable member of the Team sacrifices himself to save the others.

episodes.name: Let's Go, Buddy
episodes.overview: After finally transforming their flagship into the Super Galactic Gurren-Lagann, Simon and his friends successfully fight back against the enemy. When their enemy starts to use their own memories and desires against them, Kamina reappears to help.

episodes.name: The Lights in the Sky Are Stars
episodes.overview: At last, Simon and Nia are reunited, and by combining the power of its members, Team Dai-Gurren creates the galaxy-sized Tengen Toppa Gurren-Lagann, and engage the Anti-Spiral threat in a decisive battle to determine the fate of the universe.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: When Go Mi Nam is sent to the United States for corrective eye surgery, Manager Ma begs Go Mi Nyeo to dress as a boy and take her brother's place.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Mi Nam (as Gemma will now be referred to) wakes after a party to realize that she has kissed one of her band mates but can’t remember which one. More silliness ensues as Mi Nam attempts to set things right with Tae Kyung.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Having found out her true identity, Tae Kyung wants to kick Mi Nyeo out of the group, but she insists on staying until she finds her moth

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The band prepares for a performance at the music festival, where they meet Tae Kyung's mother and Yoo He Yi, a singer-actress with a fake personality.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Mi Nyeo spends time bonding with Shin Woo and Tae Kyung. Her aunt's arrival forces Mi Nyeo and Tae Kyung to make a difficult decision.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Mi Nyeo is unsettled after one night in Tae Kyung's room. He Yi finds out Mi Nyeo's secret and uses it to bribe Tae Kyung into being her boyfriend.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Unable to perform Tae Kyung's song satisfactorily, Mi Nyeo takes a trip to her father's hometown for his memorial ceremony. Tae Kyung joins her for the short retreat.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Tae Kyung, Mi Nyeo, and He Yi shoot a music video together, which make unspoken feelings rise up to the surface. Jeremy lets Mi Nyeo in on his secret bus and Tae Kyung confronts his distant mother.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: When Mi Nyeo loses her ribbon pin, Tae Kyung realizes how much she cared for something he gave her. He confronts her on whether she likes him or Shin Woo best.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: He Yi threatens Mi Nyeo about her secret, forcing Mi Nyeo to reveal her true identity to all the band mates and the press.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Now that the ANJells know Mi Nyeo's secret, they decide to protect her. Tae Kyung's jealousy rises as Shin Woo continues to treat Mi Nyeo as his girlfriend.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: During a photo shoot, He Yi plays around with Tae Kyung and Mi Nyeo's feelings. She dresses Mi Nyeo in a gown for Shin Woo and Tae Kyung to see.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Mi Nyeo must continue the ruse as her brother and as Shin Woo's girlfriend. Tae Kyung tests her to find out if she truly likes him or not.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Hwa Ran's close relationship to Mi Nyeo's deceased father creates trouble for Mi Nyeo and Tae Kyung's blossoming relationship.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: A trip to Japan forces Mi Nyeo and Tae Kyung to confront the truth about their parents' past. Mi Nam rejoins the band when they return to Seoul.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Mi Nyeo gets ready to leave for Africa. Tae Kyung sings one last song for her

episodes.name: Fullmetal Alchemist
episodes.overview: After escaping from Central Prison, the Freezing Alchemist, Isaac McDougal, sets his plan in motion to kill Führer King Bradley. However, under the command of Lt. Col. Roy Mustang, the military and State Alchemists attempt to stop him.

episodes.name: The First Day
episodes.overview: On the way to Lior, Ed and Al reminisce about the events that lead to them being trapped in their current bodies by breaking the taboo of human transmutation. Meanwhile, Colonel Mustang looks back on the first time he met the Elric brothers.

episodes.name: City of Heresy
episodes.overview: Ed and Al arrive at the city of Lior, hoping to find the legendary Philosopher's Stone so they can return their bodies back to normal. There, they meet a priest named Cornello, who is able to perform "miracles." As Ed and Al investigate, they find out the tru…

episodes.name: An Alchemist's Anguish
episodes.overview: Ed and Al become interested in biological transmutation after witnessing a chimera in Lior, so Colonel Mustang introduces them to an expert in the field, Shou Tucker, the Life-binding Alchemist. Meanwhile, a serial killer whose targets are only State Alchemis…

episodes.name: Rain of Sorrows
episodes.overview: After learning about what happened to Shou Tucker and his daughter Nina, the Elric brothers begin to question what alchemy really is. Meanwhile, Colonel Mustang and the other State Alchemists track down the serial killer Scar.

episodes.name: Road of Hope
episodes.overview: After their encounter with Scar, Ed's automail and Al's armor need to be repaired, so Major Armstrong escorts them to their hometown of Risembool. On their way there, they spot Dr. Marcoh, a scientist who helped create the Philosopher's Stone, and try to conv…

episodes.name: Hidden Truths
episodes.overview: When Ed and Al arrive at the Central Library they discover that it has been burnt to the ground and instead are taken to see Sheska, a former employee who may have the information they seek. Meanwhile, in East City an unexplained explosion causes Colonel Must…

episodes.name: The Fifth Laboratory
episodes.overview: Ed and Al sneak inside the Fifth Laboratory to search for more answers about the origins of the Philosopher's Stone. However, it is not long before they are each attacked by former death row murderers who now guard the complex.

episodes.name: Created Feelings
episodes.overview: Ed is now in a hospital recovering from his wounds and Al is unable to let go of what Number 66 told him back at the Fifth Laboratory. Meanwhile, Winry agrees to make a trip to Central in order to repair Ed's automail... again!

episodes.name: Separate Destinations
episodes.overview: When the conspiracy surrounding the Philosopher's Stone closes in on the highest ranks of the military, one of Mustang's most trusted and cherished allies is murdered.

episodes.name: Miracle at Rush Valley
episodes.overview: The Elrics, realizing alchemy has yet to unlock the mysteries of creating life, feel powerless when a new friend goes into labor. Winry, however, jumps into action with a young thief named Paninya.

episodes.name: One is All, All is One
episodes.overview: While visiting Izumi, their childhood teacher, the Elrics recall the early difficulties of grasping equivalent exchange. They also discover she shares their intimate knowledge of alchemy's greatest taboo.

episodes.name: Beasts of Dublith
episodes.overview: Al is abducted by chimeras led by the seemingly indestructible Homunculus known as Greed. When Ed's rescue attempt falls short, Izumi proves once more that she's got the brothers' best interests in mind.

episodes.name: Those Who Lurk Underground
episodes.overview: In a violent clash with Greed, King Bradley proves to be a brutal opponent. But the man who finally destroys the Ultimate Shield is more powerful than even the Fuhrer himself.

episodes.name: Envoy from the East
episodes.overview: The Elrics scuffle with Ling Yao and his attendants, Lan Fan and Fu, visitors from Xing seeking the Philosopher's Stone. Ed may not like him, but Ling Yao's not leaving until he gets what he wants.

episodes.name: Footsteps of a Comrade-in-Arms
episodes.overview: After learning of Hughes's fate, Ed and Al are ravaged by sadness and guilt. Envy still hides in plain sight among the State Alchemists, and another Homunculus is on the verge of infiltrating their ranks as well.

episodes.name: Cold Flame
