episodes.overview: A bite of the delicious Jewel Meat energizes Toriko, who uses a vicious Ten-Fold Spike Punch to put the hurt on a GT Robot! When the dust finally settles on the battlefield, dinner will be served!

episodes.name: The DNA's Carved Taste! Toriko, Search for the Blue Blood Corn!
episodes.overview: Komatsu must find an exquisite sauce to top a dish of very rare fish, and Toriko prepares to venture deep into the deadly Wu Jungle in search of food fit for a Battle Wolf!

episodes.name: A Talent for Fighting!! Look, Terry, the Quality of a Champion!
episodes.overview: Time is running out for Komatsu to complete his fishy dish, and Toriko watches as Terry faces off against a beastly Zombie Wood. Will the Battle Wolf show his true power - or fall to his ferocious foe?

episodes.name: For Terry’s Sake! Burst By Broiling Heat, BB Corn!
episodes.overview: Toriko and Terry finally find the deliciously elusive BB Corn, and Komatsu must depend on a special blend of spices to survive an encounter with a giant lizard!

episodes.name: The Gourmet Corps' Assassin! Toriko's Attack Instantaneously Evolves!
episodes.overview: Toriko must take his powers to the next level if he hopes to defeat a ravenous assassin from the Gourmet Corps. Elsewhere, Komatsu learns of the legendary ingredient with the power to stop - or start - wars!

episodes.name: The Pressure of Madness! Grinpatch vs. Toriko
episodes.overview: Toriko continues his battle with the corn-stealing, straw-wielding villain known as Grinpatch, and Komatsu desperately races to make it home before a rare dish of fish becomes nothing more than bubbles!

episodes.name: A Restaurant of Amusement! The Gluttonous City Gourmet Town!
episodes.overview: Toriko and Komatsu travel to the city of culinary dreams for a special dinner with a living gourmet legend! Elsewhere, the sinister Gourmet Corps reveal the secrets behind their desperate desire for the Jewel Meat!

episodes.name: A Time of Dreams! Setsuno's Century Soup!
episodes.overview: Komatsu and Toriko are treated to an ultra-exclusive tour of Setsuno's kitchen, including the top secret area where she prepares Century Soup! Inspired, they set off in search of the genuine article, but trouble lies ahead!

episodes.name: Meeting in a Barroom! The Powerful and Numerous Gourmet Hunters!
episodes.overview: Toriko, Komatsu, and a ravenous army of Gourmet Hunters set off in search of the legendary Century Soup. Their journey will take them to Ice Hell, but they'll have to survive a Sharkrocodile attack to arrive in one piece!

episodes.name: The Gourtmet Hunter Troops' Challenge! Arrival in the Frigid Hell!
episodes.overview: Tundra Dragons and killer icicles are just a few of the obstacles standing between Toriko and the Century Soup. If the elements don't kill him, there is a mean, green, GT Robot waiting to finish the job!

episodes.name: Hurry While It's Hot! A Survival Race On Ice!
episodes.overview: Zonge stumbles upon a group of angry Growlruses, Toriko and company go head-to-head with a herd of ferocious Freezer Bison, and a villainous vice chef unleashes an army of beastly insects!

episodes.name: The Explosive Fire Shakes Ice Mountain! The Identity of the Masked Man!
episodes.overview: Toriko and Komatsu team up to turn a deadly Silver Grizzly into a scrumptious soup. A villainous member of the Gourmet Corps is hot on their trail, but help is on the way in the form of a Heavenly King!

episodes.name: Glorious Bug Tamer! Tommyrod vs Toriko!
episodes.overview: When Toriko's hand is frozen solid during a deadly encounter with a Gourmet Corps bug tamer, the burden of collecting the Century Soup falls squarely on the small shoulders of Komatsu! Is the little chef up to such a big task?

episodes.name: Gratitude and Pride! Takimaru's Full-Out Corkscrew Shot!
episodes.overview: Toriko fights to survive a deadly swarm of insects, and Takimaru fights for his life against an unbreakable opponent. Meanwhile, Komatsu's quest to collect the Century Soup is monitored by GT Robot!

episodes.name: The Victory! Match and Takimaru's Desperate Attack
episodes.overview: Takimaru relies on lessons from his past to settle the score with his flexible foe, and Match puts his blade to the ultimate test against an opponent clad in Crash Turtle armor!

episodes.name: The Gourmet Reviver and the Legendary Soup's Location!
episodes.overview: Toriko heats things up in a heroic attempt to end the insect onslaught! Elsewhere, Komatsu finally reaches the location of the Century Soup - only to find that there is no soup!

episodes.name: A Competitive Fight! Fierce-Fighting Toriko vs. Tommyrod!
episodes.overview: Komatsu learns the amazing truth about his mysterious new friend, and Toriko relies on the power of his Gourmet Cells to even the odds in his brutal showdown with Tommyrod.

episodes.name: Desperate Struggle! Tommyrod's Explosive Serious Mode!
episodes.overview: Toriko attempts to end his epic battle with Tommyrod by unleashing a Thirteen-Hit Nail Punch, but the bug tamer counters by revealing the true depths of his devious strength.

episodes.name: Miraculous Power! Saiseiya Teppei Joins The Fray!
episodes.overview: The sudden arrival of a powerful Gourmet Reviver prompts Tommyrod to shed his skin, giving birth to a monstrous Parasite Emperor. The buggy beast is big and bad, but will he survive a bout with Hellboros, the ruler of Ice Hell?

episodes.name: The Last Drop! Whose Hands Will The Century Soup Fall Into?
episodes.overview: Komatsu was sad, failing to capture the Century Soup but Teppei has one more amazing trick up his sleeve. With evil forces bearing down on them, will any of our heroes live to tell of their adventure?.

episodes.name: Farewell, Ice Hell! Granny Setsu`s Hidden Power!
episodes.overview: After being rescued by Granny Setsu, the weary and wounded adventurers set a course for the healing country known as Life. Toriko has an arm to regenerate, and Komatsu is eager to recreate the Century Soup.

episodes.name: Splendid Healing! Here Comes the Gourmet Reviver, Yosaku!
episodes.overview: Toriko's gang arrives in the healing country of Life, an amazing land of curative creatures that can treat almost any ailment. After a chance meeting with Sani, the group visits Teppei's master, a renowned - and rowdy - Reviver.

episodes.name: Race to Finish! Will It Be Toriko's Recovery, or Komatsu's Soup?!
episodes.overview: Toriko's recovery progresses faster than expected, but the strain of growing a new arm may cost him his life. Meanwhile, Komatsu struggles to find the final ingredient for his Century Soup.

episodes.name: To the World of Ultimate Bliss! Taste the Century Soup!
episodes.overview: With the help of an unusual ingredient, Komatsu finally completes the Century Soup. Thanks to the little chef's big accomplishment, Toriko may get his arm back, and add an ingredient to his Full Course Menu of Life.

episodes.name: A Housewarming Party! Everyone Gathers at Sweets House!
episodes.overview: Toriko needs to build a new candy house and contracts an architect named Smile to do so.

episodes.name: The Gourmet King Deciding Battle! Find the Ultimate Sweets!
episodes.overview: Toriko, Sani, and Coco set out on a death-defying quest to see who can track down the most irresistible sweets for a starving Seven-Color Nessie.

episodes.name: The Dish of Bonds! Partners Are Forever
episodes.overview: Sharkbox Turtles, Honey Dragons, and a Chomp Urchin plague the Heavenly Kings in their mission to feed the Seven-Color Nessie. Can they survive this perilous quest and satisfy the starving beast?

episodes.name: White Hot! Toriko vs the IGO President
episodes.overview: Toriko tests out his new battle techniques - and his brand new arm - in a ferocious fistfight with the IGO President. Though his strength has improved, Toriko will need more training before he's ready for the Gourmet World.

episodes.name: The Vegetable Garden in the Ether, Vegetable Sky!
episodes.overview: Toriko begins his training with a mission to collect the delicious Ozone Grass. Komatsu is along for the ride, but is the little chef ready for brutal battles against Flying Sea Lions, Air Gorillas, and a Killer Bean Tree!?

episodes.name: Discovery! The King of Vegetables, the Ozone Herb!
episodes.overview: Toriko and Komatsu continue their quest to collect the Ozone Grass, but their journey only grows more difficult. Before they arrive at the garden in the sky, they must pass through a deadly thunderstorm.

episodes.name: Confession in the Sky! An Indestructible Combo is Formed!
episodes.overview: Toriko and Komatsu finally reach the Ozone Grass, but the legendary ingredient proves challenging to harvest. As the culinary adventurers struggle to satisfy their appetites, something sinister watches the scene unfold.

episodes.name: Shocking Encounter! A Mysterious Creature Appears!
episodes.overview: Before completing their mission to capture the Ozone Grass, Toriko and Komatsu encounter an unusual beast that's identical to a GT Robot. What is this new menace, and what does it want?

episodes.name: Toriko Plunges In! The Truth of Gourmet World!
episodes.overview: Eager to test his new abilities in the Gourmet World, Toriko ignores the warnings of his closest friends and goes in search of adventure. Meanwhile, Komatsu is shocked by an unexpected visitor.

episodes.name: An Astonishing Rescuer Appears! The True Meaning of a Partner!
episodes.overview: Toriko's expedition into the Gourmet World proves more dangerous than he expected, but luckily, someone back home is looking out for him. Will it be enough to keep him alive?

episodes.name: The Reunion of Toriko and Luffy! Find the Seafood Fruit! (I)
episodes.overview: Toriko and Komatsu capture a spring shark, only to find Luffy in its mouth. The pirate asks for their help finding a rare fruit to save a crew member. The crossover continues on One Piece E542 A Team Is Formed! Save Chopper (II).

episodes.name: Shock! The Broken Knife and Sharpener Melk!
episodes.overview: When Komatsu breaks his favorite knife, he and Toriko set out to find a famed craftsman who is said to forge the strongest blades imaginable. Their journey - plagued by Rock Wolves and Scale Kongs - will not be easy.

episodes.name: Tension! Toriko's Knife Vs Melk's Kitchen Knife!
episodes.overview: Toriko and Komatsu are shocked by who they find waiting at the home of Cutler Melk, and the legendary Gourmet Hunter's brash nature quickly leads to a knife fight.

episodes.name: Ultra Gravity! Take On Heavy Hole!
episodes.overview: Komatsu spends some quality time with Cutler Melk's apprentice, and Toriko delves deeper into the depths of Heavy Hole, where the gravity is intense and the Barbamoths are fierce.

episodes.name: Hidden Truth! Melk The First Appears!
episodes.overview: The intense gravity of Heavy Hole pushes Toriko's body to the breaking point. Back on the surface, Komatsu makes a shocking discovery about Culter Melk's apprentice.

episodes.name: Debut! Succeeding as the Second Generation and the Melk Stardust!
episodes.overview: Toriko delves into the various mysteries of Cutler Melk, including his unusual voice, and Komatsu uses his culinary skills to give Melk's apprentice a confidence boost.

episodes.name: A Work Made with All Her Might! The Completed Melk Knife!
episodes.overview: While Melk's apprentice works tirelessly to craft a special knife for Komatsu, the little chef and Toriko wait eagerly for the job to be finished - and the feast to begin.

episodes.name: Super Celebs! The Dream Trip on the Gourmet Coach!
episodes.overview: Toriko and Komatsu take a trip on the luxurious Gourmet Carriage, but there's more to this vacation than sight-seeing and fine food. The adventurous duo is headed for the gates of hell.

episodes.name: He Finally Appears! The Last of the Four Heavenly Kings, Zebra!
episodes.overview: Toriko and Komatsu explore the despicable depths of Honey Prison as they make their way to the one called Zebra. Dare they hope to survive such a deafening encounter!?

episodes.name: Unleash the Roar! The Release of the Condemned Criminal Zebra!
episodes.overview: The one they call Zebra is released from prison just in time for Monster Season and a showdown with the horrifying Forrest Goblin. After he eats lunch, of course.

episodes.name: Warning Issued! Zebra Lands on Sand Garden!
episodes.overview: Komatsu voices his concerns about travelling with such a dangerous criminal, and Zebra makes some new friends after a slugfest with a savage scorpion.

episodes.name: Komatsu Disappears! The Demonic Desert Labyrinth!
episodes.overview: A dangerous encounter with Desert Sharks leads to Komatsu's disappearance, which leads Toriko and Zebra to the foot of the Gourmet Pyramid.

episodes.name: Sealed Voice! The Different Dimension of Gourmet Pyramid!
episodes.overview: Komatsu is trapped within the labyrinthine Gourmet Pyramid, and only Zebra and Toriko can save him. Unfortunately, a deadly Gorgonclops and a hideous Unicorn Cerberus are standing in their way.

episodes.name: Bizarre! The Mysterious Ancient Document and the Creature in the Coffin!
episodes.overview: Zebra and Toriko must eat everything in their path in order to regain the strength needed for their daring rescue mission. Meanwhile, Komatsu struggles to survive on his own.

episodes.name: Shocking Showdown! Salamander Sphinx!
episodes.overview: Zebra and Toriko finally reunite with Komatsu, but their troubles are only just beginning. To acquire the Mellow Cola, they must defeat a ferocious Salamander Sphinx, but they have no idea how to kill it.

episodes.name: Cooperative Cooking! Komatsu Steers Toriko and Zebra!
episodes.overview: Zebra and Toriko carry out Komatsu's brutal orders as the little chef tells them exactly how to harvest the Mellow Cola. Their mission is on the verge of success when an unseen evil emerges.

episodes.name: Explosion of Combination Techniques! Taking the World's Best Cola!
episodes.overview: Toriko and Zebra must work together to defeat the mysterious monster that attacked Komatsu. There's just one problem: the two warriors are completely out of energy.

episodes.name: The Truth Comes to Light! Komatsu's Will and the Identity of the Mysterious Creatures!
episodes.overview: Komatsu must find the courage to stand up to Zebra and tell the truth about who he wants to be his partner. Later, the horrifying identity of the mysterious monster from the Gourmet Pyramid is finally revealed.

episodes.name: Surpass Father! Mid-Summer Gatsugatsu Curry!
episodes.overview: Toriko's trip to the beach turns into an adventure when he agrees to help his favorite curry shop track down some much needed - and very dangerous - ingredients. First on the list: Water Tiger.

episodes.name: Connecting Bonds! The Supoerb Gatsugatsu Curry!
episodes.overview: Toriko continues his heated battle with powerful Water Tiger, and Komatsu helps a heartbroken chef find the amazing curry cooking skills locked inside him.

episodes.name: A New Stage! Toriko's Determination and the Return of "Him"!
episodes.overview: Toriko's quest to get stronger leads the dynamic culinary duo to a remote cafe in the middle of a jet black lake. The food is fantastic, but the clientele is deadly.

episodes.name: A Flowing Food Luck! The Pilgrimage Gourmet Shrine!
episodes.overview: Toriko and Komatsu visit the legendary Gourmet Shrine where they seek to increase their food luck. After sampling many delicacies and taking in the sights, Komatsu takes center stage for a surprising feat of strength.

episodes.name: UWAAH! The Astonishing Surprise Apples!
episodes.overview: Toriko and Komatsu hope to have the element of surprise on their side as they travel to the explosive Surprise Island in search of the legendary Surprise Apple.

episodes.name: Chicken Egg! Memories of Old Man Yocchi and his Wife
episodes.overview: After his recent lottery win, Komatsu wants to buy Toriko a gift. There's just one problem. The legendary gourmet hunter has his heart set on a priceless piece of land where the Chicken Beast lays its eggs.

episodes.name: Glistening of a Crystal! Shining Gourami!
episodes.overview: Toriko, Komatsu, and Sani embark on a hair-raising quest to track down the Shining Gourami, an extremely rare sea creature that lives deep within Death Falls.

episodes.name: Impact of the Raging Rapids! The Giant Waterfall, the Death Falls!
episodes.overview: As the quest for the Shining Gourami continues, Toriko grows more and more impressed with Sani's training. An unexpected battle with a Hippo Shark gives the rainbow-haired gourmet hunter a chance to show off his strength.

episodes.name: Sani's New Technique! The Fruits of Magnificent Training!
episodes.overview: The devastating power of Death Falls sends Sani into a flashback where he reflects on the days spent battling beasts and honing his instincts on the Road of Three Hells.

episodes.name: A Combined 30-Fold! 36 Ren Twin Kugi Punch!
episodes.overview: Toriko and Sani must team up for a powerful combination move that's their only hope for surviving the journey through Death Falls. But even if they reach the other side, they'll need help to capture their prey.

episodes.name: Intuition Cooking! Komatsu and the Shining Gourami!
episodes.overview: Komatsu takes center stage as the little chef struggles to unlock the secret to preparing the Shining Gourami. Toriko and Sani are exhausted and hungry, and Komatsu must listen to his ingredients if he wants to feed his friends.

episodes.name: A Super Extravagant Production! The Ultimate Meal Service!
episodes.overview: When Melk the Second needs help finishing a very special knife, Toriko and Komatsu compete in a prestigious competition in an attempt to win the final ingredient needed to complete her project.

episodes.name: The Finest Chitose Ame! Komatsu and Yun's Tale
episodes.overview: Toriko and Komatsu are summoned to the Gourmet Temple to help the priests and staff in creating a very special candy but during the whole process of the two assisting the Temple Priests in making and finding the special ingredient for the creation of this can…

episodes.name: A Gathering at Autumn Mountain! Terrym Yun, Kiss, and Quin!
episodes.overview: Toriko, Komatsu, Yun and Terry all work with Sani and Coco, who, along with their own animal partners, each hunt for a very special ingredient and end up finding a surprise along the way.

episodes.name: Reunion! Take-chan of Otogi Castle!
episodes.overview: A sinister force is abducting the top chefs in the world, and an old friend of Komatsu's may be in great danger. Elsewhere, Toriko and Coco attempt to capture a rare appetizer.

episodes.name: A Parting of Ways! The Goals of Chefs
episodes.overview: Komatsu is shocked by the lack of culinary honor exhibited by his old friend. Meanwhile, Toriko and Coco team up to open a giant treasure chest - but what they find inside leaves them baffled.

episodes.name: Dramatic Transformation - The Beauty Parlor, Barber Gourmet!
episodes.overview: Toriko and Komatsu reunite for some much needed rest and relaxation at a gourmet barber shop. The food is superb, but their hair may never recover.

episodes.name: The Four Heavenly Kings Assemble! Miracle in Midwinter!
episodes.overview: Toriko, Sani, Coco, and Komatsu brave frigid temperatures and Bison Frogs as they search for a legendary tree that's entirely edible.

episodes.name: Merry Itadakimasu! Gourmet Santa's Presents!
episodes.overview: Chief recruits Toriko and the whole gang to help spread tasty Christmas cheer to hungry kids across the world. Even Zebra manages a good deed by mistake, and the holiday ends with a delicious miracle.

episodes.name: Heaven or Hell?! Plunge into Gourmet Casino!
episodes.overview: Toriko, Komatsu, and Coco venture into the Pleasure Zone on quest to track down some extremely rare Meteor Garlic, but they soon cross paths with an old friend who could use their help.

episodes.name: Appearance! The Boss of the Underground Cooking World, Livebearer!
episodes.overview: Toriko and the gang make a splash at the casino as they attempt to win enough cash and ingredients to gain admittance to the VIP area, but what lies ahead could prove deadly.

episodes.name: A Card Game with Your Life on the Line! Gourmet Tasting!
episodes.overview: Toriko, Komatsu, and Coco go head-to-head with Livebearer in a game of Gourmet Memory that could cost the loser all their memories of ever eating food!

episodes.name: Dead Heat! Coco VS Livebearer
episodes.overview: Coco and Livebearer continue their epic showdown, but Toriko does most of the heavy lifting, devouring a mountain of pudding and handful of acorns as hard as bullets.

episodes.name: Coco's Strategy! The Big-Miss Cards That Determine the Outcome!
episodes.overview: The deadly game unfolding between Coco and Livebearer reaches an unprecedented level of danger as Toriko must face off against a fearsome Hanya Panda to avoid the agony of defeat.

episodes.name: Eat or Be Eaten! Toriko vs. the Hannya Panda!
episodes.overview: Toriko's slug fest with the Hanya Panda proves to be more brutal than expected, and even if he survives, the difference between victory and defeat may ultimately lie with Komatsu.

episodes.name: Climax! The Remaining Worst Ingredients!
episodes.overview: Toriko keeps his team in the game by surviving mouthfuls of Shock Lemons and Nitro Cherries, but if Livebearer can withstand a bite of poison potato - all will be lost.

episodes.name: The Moment of Conclusion! Coko's Sublime Scenario!
episodes.overview: Coco explains his entire plan, while Livebearer cuts his pain sense and coats his intestines, but, because of Coco's plan, the coating is eaten by microbes and the casino room is transformed into a battle zone between Coco, Toriko, Komatsu, Match and his goon…

episodes.name: A Taste That's Out of this World! The Actual Eating of the Meteor Garlic!
episodes.overview: Komatsu gets help preparing the Meteor Garlic from a very unexpected source, and Granny Setsu is paid a visit by the IGO.

episodes.name: Pinnacle Showdown! Ichiryuu vs the Bishokukai's Midora!
episodes.overview: Toriko searches for more training ingredients, Komatsu impresses his boss with dazzling new cooking techniques, and Ichiryuu comes face-to-face with an old nemesis.

episodes.name: The Hidden Training Ingredient! Emergency Instructions from Ichiryuu!
episodes.overview: Before beginning the search for his next training ingredient, Toriko must defeat a ferocious Devil Planet Horse and then dine with a fortune telling sushi chef.

episodes.name: Run, Strongest Team! Toriko, Luffy, and Goku! (I)
episodes.overview: Luffy, Toriko, Goku and their friends enter the World’s Best Eating Contest to win the top prize, a piece of carat sizzled cattle meat! The crossover continues on One Piece E590 History's Strongest Collaboration vs. Glutton of the Sea (II).

episodes.name: Commemorating the Hundredth Episode, All Four Heavenly Kings Assemble!
episodes.overview: Toriko, Coco, Sani, Zebra, and Komatsu compete to see who'll be the first to snag the ultra-rare delicacy known as Madam Fish! Winner gets the first bite!

episodes.name: Toriko Fainting in Agony?! Capture the World's Smelliest Ingredient!
episodes.overview: Toriko and Komatsu set off for the Heavy Drinker Archipelago to seek out the King Vinegar. Then they must go after the most foul-smelling ingredient on the planet, the Dodurian Bomb!

episodes.name: Too Huge! With Pro Wrestling Moves, the Completion of the Ehou Maki!!
episodes.overview: Toriko and Komatsu visit an old friend who might be able to help them gather the seaweed they need to complete their epic Fortune Roll!

episodes.name: Hands Together and Bow! Gourmet Human National Treasure Chin Chinchin Appears!
episodes.overview: Toriko and Komatsu try to eat their way to destiny by devouring Monchy's Fortune Roll, but they soon get distracted by a vanishing restaurant where they meet the Master of the legendary Chourin temple and one of the only 4 national Gourmet treasures Chin Chin…

episodes.name: Those Without Gratitude Should Not Enter! The Fearsome Shokurin Temple!!
episodes.overview: The legendary Chourin Temple holds the ingredient sought by Toriko and Komatsu, but the adventurous eaters might not be ready for the teachings of the temple's Master!

episodes.name: Toriko, Completely Defeated?! The Delicate and Uninhibited Power of Food Honor!!
episodes.overview: Toriko's quest to attain the elusive Bubble Fruit hits a snag when he must fight a surprisingly formidable foe. If the gourmet hunter wants to complete his quest, he must learn to honor the food!

episodes.name: It's All About Appreciation! The Essentials of Food Honor!!
episodes.overview: Before they can truly honor the food, Toriko and Komatsu must master the art of gratitude by completing a series of tasks that prove far more difficult than originally expected!

episodes.name: An Approaching Threat! Hurry, Toriko! The Road to the Bubble Fruits!
episodes.overview: His training complete, Toriko embarks on a lengthy journey to capture the Bubble Fruit! Meanwhile, back at Chowlin Temple, something evil approaches!

episodes.name: Tragedy!! The Demise of Shokurin Temple... Farewell, Komatsu!!
episodes.overview: Toriko pushes himself to the breaking point on his hunt for the Bubble Fruit, and a Bishokukai raiding party wreaks havoc at Chowlin Temple!

episodes.name: Mighty and Unrivaled! One Who Has Mastered Food Honor!
episodes.overview: Toriko uses his new technique - and the strength he gained by eating the Bubble Fruit - to easily destroy a giant green monster, but the Master of Chowlin Temple may not be so lucky!

episodes.name: 'National Treasure Class' One-Swing 100 Million Yen Techniques! Toriko VS Granny Chiyo
episodes.overview: Toriko shows off an awesome array of powerful new techniques in his battle with Granny Chiyo, but the arrival of a mysterious and terrifying GT Robot puts their bout on hold!

episodes.name: The Phantasmal Ingredient 'Center' Ichiryuu and the Mighty 0th Biotope
episodes.overview: An unexpected visitor uses a dangerous technique in an attempt to heal Master Chin-Chin, and the strongest warriors from the IGO gather for dinner - and to prepare for war!

episodes.name: The Legendary Bee, the 'infini Bee' Toriko VS the New Model GT Robo
episodes.overview: Toriko and Komatsu are sent to search for Golden Wheat, but their mission is interrupted by the arrival of a terrifying and powerful new GT Robo!

episodes.name: Showing His True Strength! Komatsu's Food Honor The Actual Food! The Phantasmal Noodles, 'Zenmen'
episodes.overview: Toriko shocks the GT Robo with his amazing strength, and Komatsu gets an assignment from Granny Setsu that will put his powers of Honoring the Food to the ultimate test!

episodes.name: The Four Heavenly Kings Gather! The Gourmet World Beasts the 'Four Beasts' Awaken!
episodes.overview: The Four Heavenly Kings share a mega meal together, Komatsu learns the secret to preparing Bubble Fruit, and the human world braces for the arrival of the Four-Beasts!

episodes.name: The Battle to Determine the Fate of Mankind!! The Four Beasts VS the Four Heavenly Kings!!
episodes.overview: Humanity watches in horror as the Four-Beasts easily destroy the military's strongest weapons, but all hope is not lost - the Heavenly Kings are about to join the fight!

episodes.name: Toriko, Coco, Sani, Zebra The Four Heavenly Kings' Storm of Attacks!!
episodes.overview: The Four Heavenly Kings use every attack in their arsenal to survive their battle with the Four-Beasts, but there's a surprise in store for our heroes that could prove fatal!

episodes.name: Toriko's New Crisis The Creeping Four Beast's Main Body!
episodes.overview: Toriko, Coco, Sunny, and Zebra appear to have the upper hand in their battle with the Four-Beasts, but the monster's main body is about to wreak havoc on civilization!

episodes.name: The Four Beast's Shocking Union and the Green Rain!!
episodes.overview: While Toriko, Coco, Sunny, and Zebra battle the monstrous Four-Beasts, Komatsu rushes to make an edible antidote to the toxic Green Rain that's drenching the city!

episodes.name: The Four Heavenly Kings' Worst Dilemma! Komatsu's Determination!
episodes.overview: While Toriko, Coco, Sunny, and Zebra battle the monstrous Four-Beasts, Komatsu rushes to make an edible antidote to the toxic Green Rain that's drenching the city!

episodes.name: Save Mankind with your Miraculous Food Luck!!
episodes.overview: Komatsu makes great progress in his quest to create a delicious remedy for the Green Rain, but the Four Kings find their attacks failing and their strength fading in their battle against the Four-Beasts!

episodes.name: Explode! Curiosity for Taste! The Four Heavenly King's Combination Technique!!
episodes.overview: The Four Kings hover on the verge of death until they recall a powerful technique from their training days - turning appetite into punching power!

episodes.name: Ultimate Technique 'Dinner of the Kings'
episodes.overview: The Four Kings hover on the verge of death until they recall a powerful technique from their training days - turning appetite into punching power!

episodes.name: The Forthcoming Festival The Wriggling 'Dangerous Guys'
episodes.overview: The Four Kings hover on the verge of death until they recall a powerful technique from their training days - turning appetite into punching power!

episodes.name: Toriko VS the Gourmet World Monster 'Mon Planc'
episodes.overview: Toriko battles a Plant Beast from the Gourmet World, Komatsu worries about his performance in a famous cooking festival, and CoCo gambles for information!

episodes.name: Toriko's New Technique 'Nail Gun'!!
episodes.overview: Toriko must come up with some new moves to defeat the Mon Plan, Komatsu worries about the upcoming cooking festival, and Zebra returns to the home of Mellow Cola!

episodes.name: Great Imminent Troubles!? Cooking Fest Opens!!
episodes.overview: Audiences applaud wildly as Komatsu and the Four Kings arrive at the legendary Cooking Fest, but somewhere deep in the darkness, a powerful evil prepares to attack!

episodes.name: Komatsu in Trouble?! Triathlon Cooking!
episodes.overview: Komatsu is intimidated by the competition at the cooking festival, but he's got even bigger things to worry about: a grueling test of strength known as Triathlon Cooking!

episodes.name: The Legendary Chef Tengu Branchi Appears!!
episodes.overview: Komatsu falls far behind the field in the prestigious cooking festival, but when a top-ranked bad boy suddenly enters the competition, things could get even worse!

episodes.name: A Wild Ride of Super Foul Play! Branchi, Pulling Ahead!!
episodes.overview: Giraffe Birds and Sand Hamsters make their presence felt, Komatsu catches a lift with Brunch, and Triathlon Cooking kicks into high gear!

episodes.name: Live or Die? Death in the Balance Cooking!!
episodes.overview: Komatsu must reach the next round of the Cooking Fest without the help of his special Melk knife, but advancing could send the little chef headed toward a fiery fate!

episodes.name: Who are the Strongest Partners? Whole Island Cooking!
episodes.overview: Komatsu advances in the Cooking Fest, only to find out that his next challenge will be to cook an entire island! He recruits Toriko to help him out, but with the other Heavenly Kings cooking as well, the competition is anyone’s game.

episodes.name: The Outbreak of War! The Bishokukai.'s Fierce Full-scale Offensive!
episodes.overview: Komatsu's preparations for the next round of the Cooking Fest are interrupted by an old friend. Meanwhile, Toriko and the rest of the Four Kings brace for the arrival of evil!

episodes.name: Protect Komatsu! Toriko vs. Starjun!
episodes.overview: When Komatsu's life is threatened, Coco, Zebra, and Sunny spring into action to defend the little chef, but the main attraction is a brutal showdown between Toriko and Starjun!

episodes.name: Savage Battle! Toriko's Strongest Attack!
episodes.overview: Toriko pulls no punches in his slugfest with Starjun, Rin wages her own unique brand of war, and an army of chefs give the Gourmet Corp. more than they bargained for!

episodes.name: Top Showdown! IGO vs. Bishokukai
episodes.overview: The epic battle at Cooking Stadium rages on as Toriko and Starjun continue to throw down. If Toriko's going to be triumphant, he's can't pull any knife-and-fork punches.

episodes.name: The Terrible Trump Card! The Gourmet World Monsters, the 'Nitro'
episodes.overview: The IGO's chances for victory take a serious hit when the Gourmet Corp. unleashes the horrifying monsters Nitro and the Scum Beasts!

episodes.name: A Deadly Struggle! Coco VS Grinparch
episodes.overview: Thanks to Komatsu’s super culinary skills, Coco and Toriko have the strength to carry on their battles with two of the Gourmet Corp.’s most powerful monsters!

episodes.name: Duel! Sani VS Tommyrod
episodes.overview: Sunny puts his heroic hair to the ultimate test in a bombastic battle with Tommyrod and his grotesque army of deadly insects!

episodes.name: The End is Here! Sunny's Final Power!
episodes.overview: Sunny’s bloody battle with Tommyrod reaches its horrific end, and Brunch finds himself locked in an electrifying battle with an immortal warrior that cannot be destroyed!

episodes.name: Counterattack! Zebra Gets Moving!!
episodes.overview: Zebra evens the odds by unleashing the furious power of his voice, Setsuno tangles with an old rival, and Komatsu is shocked to find Toriko on the losing end of a battle!

episodes.name: Toriko's Counterattack! Ultimate Routine!!
episodes.overview: Komatsu’s heartbroken wailing helps revive a battered Toriko, who suddenly unleashes a devastating attack that harnesses the power of a great warrior’s imagination!

episodes.name: History's Greatest Enemy! 'Joa' Appears!!
episodes.overview: Toriko’s awesomely destructive battle with Starjun is interrupted by the arrival of Joie, an unbelievably deadly adversary who has the power to turn good into evil!

episodes.name: Shock! The True Identity of the Mastermind 'Joa'!!
episodes.overview: After the legendary Knocking Master Jiro unmasks the terrifying evil before them, his life is endangered by his affection for Granny Setsuno! Will Toriko arrive in time to save them both!?

episodes.name: The Beginning of the End! Toriko vs. Joa!!
episodes.overview: Toriko and Starjun forge an unlikely alliance to save Komatsu from a deadly adversary, and a riveting flashback reveals the tragic story of Froese the God Chef!

episodes.name: An Attack to Come Back from Hopelessness! The Four Heavenly Kings, the Ultimate Technique!!
episodes.overview: The Four Kings fight together against Joie, the strongest enemy they've ever faced and one who can't be eaten! Meanwhile, NEO gets ready to leave the chaos of the stadium and indeed the Human World behind them, but they also plan to take Komatsu with them, wh…

episodes.name: May Komatsu's Yells Reach Him! Toriko Awakens!!
episodes.overview: With the Four Kings utterly defeated, Joie is about to take Komatsu away, until Toriko tries one last, desperate gambit, which could make him lose control of himself and kill even his dearest friends! Meanwhile, the final battle between Ichiryu and Midora end…

episodes.name: Toriko and Komatsu Departure for a New Journey!!
episodes.overview: The finale of the battle between Toriko and Joie! The Human World is devastated by a storm of mysterious meteorites! Amongst a backdrop of hope, forgiveness, and devious plans, Toriko and Komatsu embark on their greatest challenge: surviving a new world!

episodes.name: I First Met Her in a Dream... or Something
episodes.overview: Madoka Kaname, an eighth grader who lives such a peaceful life, has a loving family and best friends. She laughs and cries from time to time. One night, she has a strange dream. It was supposed to be an usual routine day, but the arrival of Homura Akemi - a t…

episodes.name: That Would Be Truly Wonderful
episodes.overview: While rescuing Kyubey from being attacked by Homura, Madoka and Sayaka lose their way in a mysterious space. They find themselves in a desperate situation and are rescued by Mami Tomoe, a magical girl. Afterward, Mami invites them to her room.

episodes.name: I'm Not Afraid of Anything Anymore
episodes.overview: Madoka and Sayaka are getting used to Mami's witch hunting trial run. Yet their wishes remain undecided. Mami reveals her past to the anxious two girls. Sayaka asks, "Does my wish have to be for myself?"

episodes.name: Miracles and Magic Are Real
episodes.overview: The day after the fierce battle between Mami and the witch was a normal peaceful day. After what they witnessed, Madoka and Sayaka fully realize the demands of being involved in the magical world, and give up becoming on magical girls.

episodes.name: There's No Way I'll Ever Regret It
episodes.overview: As a magical girl, Sayaka rescues Madoka and Hitomi from a witch. Now that her wish has come true by signing Kyubey's contract, her mind is clear and she doesn't seem to regret becoming a magical girl.

episodes.name: This Just Can't Be Right
episodes.overview: Homura appears suddenly on Sayaka and Kyoko's battlefield. She intervenes and knocks Sayaka unconscious with a single blow. After seeing this, Kyoko is on her guard against Homura, and leaves, putting an end to the battle.

episodes.name: Can You Face Your True Feelings?
episodes.overview: Sayaka discovers the truth about her own body as a magical girl. She wavers between the wish that came true by accepting the destiny to fight and the high price she paid for it. Sayaka is in low spirits at home when Kyoko Sakura shows up.

episodes.name: I Was Stupid... So Stupid
episodes.overview: Despite her own injury, Sayaka keeps shredding the witch in front of her. Thanks to healing magic, she wins without a scratch at the end. But she seems extremely exhausted.

episodes.name: I'd Never Allow That to Happen
episodes.overview: Sayaka's Soul Gem turns into a jet-black grief seed, which hatches and a new witch emerges. Carrying Sayaka's body, Kyoko focuses on defending against the approaching witch's attacks. Homura cuts into the witch's labyrinth and leads Kyoko to escape.

episodes.name: I Won't Rely on Anyone Anymore
episodes.overview: A scene depicting a female transfer student. The timid girl is so nervous and meek. She introduces herself shyly while feeling the eyes of all the students in the class. At recess, other girls gather around her and ask questions curiously.

episodes.name: The Only Thing I Have Left to Guide Me
episodes.overview: Sayaka's funeral was held in the rain. Madoka returns home with vacant eyes. She barely says anything to Junko who met her at the front door, and goes into her room. Kyubey appears in front of Madoka, who is lost in her grief, alone.

episodes.name: My Very Best Friend
episodes.overview: Homura challenges Walpurgisnacht alone and is seriously wounded. She despairs because she can't win no matter how many times she tries. Her actions are making Madoka suffer even more, and she becomes despondent. Her Soul Gem begins to turn black.

episodes.name: The Birth of a Genius Basketman?!?
episodes.overview: After being dumped by Yoko, a girl he really liked in Junior High, Sakuragi Hanamichi was devastated. On the first day of school, he was approached by a girl who asked him whether he likes basketball or not. He immediately said he loves it although he has no…

episodes.name: Die Basketball! Hanamichi vs. Rukawa
episodes.overview: After Rukawa beats up those thugs, Hanamichi is shocked and asks him for his name. When he discovers that he is the one that Haruko has a crush on, he becaomes angry. Then, Haruko comes and helps Rukawa with his wounds, but he dismisses her and this makes Han…

episodes.name: Gorilla vs. Hanamichi! Big Showdown!
episodes.overview: When Hanamichi calls basketball a 'dumb game', the captain of the basketball team challenges him because Hanamichi had made fun of his favorite game of all!

episodes.name: Basketball Man Hanamichi Joins the Team
episodes.overview: Sakuragi mananges to dunk over/through Akagi. Akagi is intrigued by Sakuragi's raw power, but doesn't think he's got the drive to make it on the team. Still, he ponders what the team would be like if he was to join.

episodes.name: A Gutless Afternoon
episodes.overview: Sakuragi Hanamichi has been training in the basics for two weeks under Ayako and he wants to play with the other. Akagi refused to let him play. Out of frustration, he quits the team. But after seeing Haruko's face, he changes his mind again.

episodes.name: Rukawa vs. Akagi. The Real Showdown!
episodes.overview: Akagi decides to test Rukawa's skills against his own to see if Rukawa really has the talent everyone says he does.

episodes.name: Hanamichi's Debut! Dunk Attack
episodes.overview: After successfully persuading Anzai to let him join the game, Sakuragi shows how much he has improved in basic skills such as dribbling. But in the game, he refuses to pass the ball to Rukawa out of jealousy.

episodes.name: Hanamichi's Crisis! The Judo Man's Snare
episodes.overview: Impressed by Sakuragi's raw power and general brute force, the captain of the judo club tries to recruit him away from the Basketball team.

episodes.name: I Will Play Basketball!
episodes.overview: Sakuragi declines Aota's offer of joining the Judo club. Kogure and Ayako were overjoyed at Sakuragi's refusal and Akagi was very much impressed by Sakuragi's words.

episodes.name: The 'Beginner's Shot' ....Is Hard!
episodes.overview: After getting the permission to allow Sakuragi to learn the basics of shooting, Akagi asked Rukawa to demonstrate how to do lay-up shot. But Sakuragi got into a fight with Rukawa instead.

episodes.name: Special Secret Love Training for Two!?
episodes.overview: Having mastered dribbling and passing, Sakuragi moves on to shooting, which is a lot harder than he had anticipated. Frustrated by his lack of skil, Sakuragi gets some extra help from an unlikely source: Haruko.

episodes.name: Beat Ryonan! Hard Training Before the Decisive Game
episodes.overview: The night before their game with Ryounan, Akagi decides to try and teach Sakuragi basic defense, starting with rebounding. Learning quickly, Sakuragi impresses Akagi. After the practice session, Sakuragi encounters a scout from Ryounan, and fills him in on wh…

episodes.name: Shohoku vs Ryonan the Fired Up Captain!
episodes.overview: Sakuragi is eager to play too, thinking of what Akagi has told him the previuos night. At Ryonan High, Anzai is greeted by Ryonan coach, Moichi Taoka. In the locker room, Anzai finally announces the starting five players who are Akagi, Yasuda, Shiozaki, Kogur…

episodes.name: Super Basketball Match! Ryonan's Attack of Angry Waves
episodes.overview: Sakuragi keeps begging Anzai to let him join the game. At 14 mins, Ryonan has a 0-15 lead, with everyone cheering for Sendoh. Sendoh and Uozumi, both play briliantly. The first half ends with a score of 42-50.

episodes.name: Hanamichi's Nervous Big Start
episodes.overview: Finally, Sakuragi got a chance to play when Akagi was hurt while playing. Now, there is only about 9 minutes left on the clock.

episodes.name: Who Is This Guy?! Taoka's Miscalculation
episodes.overview: With just 8 minutes left in the second half, Ryonan is still leading. Taoka tells the Ryonan to continue to attack. Sakuragi plays whole-heartily and this impressed Sendoh.

episodes.name: Rebound King. Hanamichi Sakuragi's Agony
episodes.overview: Ryonan is leading with 3 points ahead of Shohoku, Taoka said that the game will depends on how Sakuragi plays. Meanwhile, Sakuragi begins to realize how important rebounds are.

episodes.name: The Last Two Minutes! I'm Taking Sendo Down!
episodes.overview: Sendoh is amazed at how good Shohoku has become, thus begins to take the game seriously. Anzai then, calls both Rukawa and Sakuragi to approach, to tell them of his plan.

episodes.name: Time Up! The Ryonan Game Is Over
episodes.overview: Although Shohoku has lost the game, Sakuragi played very well for his first game. Sakuragi and Rukawa vowed that in their next game with Ryonan, they will beat Sendoh.

episodes.name: Basketball Shoes
episodes.overview: The next day, Haruko has to accompany Sakuragi to the sports shop to buy a new pair of shoes because his old shoes are in a bad shape after the practice game with Ryonan.

episodes.name: Super Problems! Hanamichi vs. Miyagi
episodes.overview: Ryota Miyagi returns to basketball after beening injured in a fight. Ayako heard rumors that Miyagi was back in school, so she decided to investigate. She brings along Sakuragi and see that Miyagi is into another fight realizing that Ayako and Sakuragi are to…

episodes.name: The Fool with the Worst Record, A Combination is Born
episodes.overview: It seemed like a disaster for two trouble makers in Miyagi and Sakuragi to collide with each other, but it seems things hae turned out much better than expected.

episodes.name: Shohoku Basketball Team's Last Day
episodes.overview: A former member of the Shohoku team returns with a major axe to grind, which spells doom for the team.

episodes.name: The Allies of Justice, Sakuragi's Army Visits
episodes.overview: After Ayako was slapped by one of the invading students, Miyagi joined in the fight, as well as Rukawa. However, Tetsuo easily took both of them down. Sakuragi steps up to the plate, outnumbered. Things change when Sakuragi's friends appear in an unlikely fas…

episodes.name: The Guy Who Wanted to Conquer the World
episodes.overview: Mitsui and Tetsuo were defeated, but Mitsui still continued to fight. Though when Akagi enters, the atmosphere becomes dense. Akagi slaps Mitsui around. Kogure then informs everyone that Mitsui use to be an excellent basketball player, and was even on the tea…

episodes.name: Mitsui's Peak, Trouble at 15
episodes.overview: It seems that Mitsui was once a great basketball player himself before High School. Though something happened during practice that changed his life forever.

episodes.name: I Want to Play Basketball!
episodes.overview: After suffering through his horrible injury, Mitsui quit on basketball. Though two years later, in his attempt to sabotage Shohoku from participating in the tournament, his feelings for the sport are growing stronger once again.

episodes.name: The Beginning of Interhigh Preliminaries
episodes.overview: The tournament is finally making its approach. Sakuragi is anxious to play against Sendo again, but Shohoku will have to deal with Miuradai first.

episodes.name: Hanamichi! Pennant Race Debut
episodes.overview: The match starts, and Anzai refuses to put Sakuragi, Rukawa, Mitsui, and Miyagi, in the starting line-up. For what reason? As punishment for fighting. Will Anzai keep it like this for the entire game?

episodes.name: The Introspective Army's Big Counterattack
episodes.overview: With four of Shohoku's best players finally entering in the game, the tables turn quickly as they narrow the lead down to only 2. Sakuragi was hacked on a play, giving him two shots at the freethrow line. Though things were tough for him, as nervousness broke…

episodes.name: Formidable Enemy Miuradai's Secret Weapon
episodes.overview: Miuradai revealed a secret weapon of theirs that'll help them try and overcome Shohoku, and that's the ox Nato.

episodes.name: Genius Hanamichi! Certain Death Dunk
episodes.overview: Miuradai started gaining control of the game, until Nato started finally guarding Rukawa instead of Sakuragi. Rukawa exploited his weakness, and this caused an instant shift, favouring Shohoku.

episodes.name: Walkout King!? Sakuragi's Righteousness
episodes.overview: Shohoku's next match is against Gohoku. While they have been exceeding almost everyone's expectations, Sakuragi continues to be laughed at for his nonsensical and pointless fouls. He starts to realize that he might not be so great after all.

episodes.name: Gorilla's Initiation, Kill with Your Eyes!
episodes.overview: Sakuragi and his fouling troubles continue. He unconsciously went to Akagi's house for help, and in order to help Sakuragi a little bit, Akagi gives him one piece of advice... instill his opponents with fear using his eyes. Sakuragi takes this too literally,…

episodes.name: Hot Blooded Guys
episodes.overview: Mitsui got himself caught up in a fight between Ryo and Tetsuo, and was eventually beaten himself. However, an unlikely Sakuragi pops out of nowhere, and comes to aid his teammate when trying to get to the gym.

episodes.name: A Well Seeded School, Enter Shoyo
episodes.overview: Sakuragi is still upset at Akagi for telling him a false technique in defense, and tries harder the next game against Tsukubu. While he gets fouled out, he's improving rather quickly, and he'll need it against a powerhouse team like Shoyo, who's the second ra…

episodes.name: Hanamichi's First Start
episodes.overview: Anzai-sensei decides to start Sakuragi, much to everyone's shock. He figures that with his height and drive he'll be the perfect weapon to use against Shoyo.

episodes.name: Rukawa's Counterattack!
episodes.overview: With the the Shohoku offense stalled by Shoyo's defense, Rukawa takes it upon himself to lead the offensive charge.

episodes.name: Lightning Flash Ryota!
episodes.overview: With Rukawa taking the heat off of the rest of the team, Miyagi gets a chance to show off his skills as a point guard and his speed on the court.

episodes.name: Hanamichi the Genius shows off!
episodes.overview: With Mitsui's 3 point shot, Shohoku finally caught up with Shoyo. It seemed like Fujima had enough, but Hanagata asked him to trust him for a little while longer. Fujima made a good decision in trusting his star center, for Shoyo pulled away from Shohoku agai…

episodes.name: Shoyo Coach Enters the Court
episodes.overview: Driven hard by by Rukawa's offense and Sakuragi's rebounding, Fujima comes off the bench to lead his team to victory.

episodes.name: Shoyo Ace Fujima's Real Ability
episodes.overview: Fujima is leading a strong charge for Shoyo against Shohoku, taking the lead once again. Though Shohoku has other problems besides Fujima; Mitsui is already very tired. Will Kogure be able to take his place?

episodes.name: Has Mitsui Reached His Limit!?
episodes.overview: Shohoku's problems continue piling up. Mitsui can't get a 3 pointer to go in, forcing all the burden on Rukawa. Plus, Sakuragi is on the brink of fouling out, one more and he's gone. Is this the end for Shohoku?

episodes.name: Mitsui! Stormy 3 Points
episodes.overview: Mitsui, reminiscing upon the past, gets the energy to play and lead his team. In just a matter of time, he scored 9 consecutive points thanks to his impressive shooting, but is it enough to overcome Shoyo?

episodes.name: Imminent Walkout!? Hanamichi's Pinch
episodes.overview: While Mitsui has increased his efficiency during the game, Sakuragi still faces the brink of being dismissed. After a few destructive words from Rukawa, Sakuragi is fueled with fire.

episodes.name: Hanamichi, Hot Dunk
episodes.overview: Thanks to a basket from Rukawa, Shohoku has finally taken the lead in a critical time. Sakuragi, wanting to feel important, jumped up at the same time as two opposing Shoyo players as he was going for the dunk. It seems like Sakuragi's long desire to perform…

episodes.name: Challenge from a Rival
episodes.overview: Shohoku has defeated Shoyo, and Sakuragi is quick to spread the word, especially after his ferocious slam dunk on Hanagata. It seems like Oda, a person that went to the same junior high as him, is going to be facing Kainan. They're also hoping to pull off an…

episodes.name: The Guy Who Pledged to Defeat Kainan
episodes.overview: Sakuragi skips practice in order to investigate on why Yohko was acting so strangely. When they get to Takezono, he is immediately met by hordes of girls who misjudge his delinquent looks as someone who came to beat up Oda in order to Sabotage Takezono's chan…

episodes.name: Takezono, Last Fight
episodes.overview: The match between Takezono and Kainan starts. Kainan only put in two starters the entire game, but it seemed like it was enough to take care of their opponents. That wasn't Takezono's only problem; Oda's injury remains ignorant to everyone but Yohko and Sakur…

episodes.name: Outside Accounts!? Hanamichi at His Best!
episodes.overview: The match between Shohoku and Kainan has been tight and intense all the way through, but it was Sakuragi who stood out the most with his cocky attitude and amazing athleticism. However, Kainan's coach is planning something to get Sakuragi off the court.

episodes.name: Sakuragi's Confinement's Secret Weapon
episodes.overview: Takato seemed to have devised the perfect plan to counter-attack against Sakuragi, which is sending in the extremely small and weak Miyamasu. In an unbelievable turn around, the plan worked in which Sakuragi was horrible embarassed, allowing Kainan to widen t…

episodes.name: The Gorilla's Injury! Desperate Situation!?
episodes.overview: Shohoku isn't about to let their chances slip away against Kainan, however, things quickly changed when Akagi injured his ankle, forcing Sakuragi to take over his spot as center.

episodes.name: King Kong, Younger Brother
episodes.overview: Sakuragi did a pretty good job of filling in for Akagi, though it was Rukawa who pushed Shohoku into a fierce comeback against Kainan. He single handedly brought Shohoku back within five points.

episodes.name: The One that Dominates the Game
episodes.overview: Rukawa's strong performance made it seem like Shohoku has a chance of winning, but what got everyone's attention was when Akagi came back from the locker room.

episodes.name: Ace Shepherd, Full Throttle
episodes.overview: Akagi coming back in for Shohoku seemed like they would be in great position to win, but Maki displayed to everyone why he's the best player in the region, giving Jin a ton of open looks for three pointers.

episodes.name: Anzai, Bet on Victory!
episodes.overview: Anzai formulated a plan to destroy Kainan's formidable backcourt combo of Jin and Maki by playing zone defense, and their offense started crumbling. Sakuragi, when shooting from the free throw line, decided to shoot it differently by throwing up a granny shot.

episodes.name: Stubborn Guys!
episodes.overview: Shohoku and Kainan refuse to give up on each other with the match going back and forth like a see saw.

episodes.name: Last 10 Seconds! A Perfect Conclusion
episodes.overview: The last ten seconds of the game are approaching, and Shohoku is only down by four. The one who'll decide this match will be Sakuragi.

episodes.name: To relieve guilt: Shave Head ?!
episodes.overview: Sakuragi is in an emotional hangover after the events of the previous match, so in order to come to himself, he decides to change his appearance.

episodes.name: Baldy attacks back!
episodes.overview: Sakuragi's new haircut was the news of the school the next day. During practice, he decided to work twice as hard in order to prevent another mistake like that happening again. When Mitsui was the one guarding Sakuragi, all of his weaknesses and shortcomings…

episodes.name: Three-day super training
episodes.overview: Akagi really wants Sakuragi to become part of their offense, so he trains him for three days straight on his shooting. To his surprise, Sakuragi was pretty enthusiastic about it.

episodes.name: Ryonan's genius plan
episodes.overview: The anticipated match up between two of the best teams in the region commences. One of the biggest surprises was how Sendoh was handling point guard duties, and was doing an efficient job of it with Ryonan getting a head start against Kainan.

episodes.name: Kainan rebounds!
episodes.overview: Sendoh is the entire pillar that's pushing his team forward right now, but the tables turn when Uozumo decides to argue a call from the referee.

episodes.name: The strongest rival
episodes.overview: Due to Uozumi being fouled out, and Fukuda being a terrible defensive player, Sendoh was forced to carry Ryonan on his shoulders all by himself. Though for Shohoku, greater events have become more of a priority.

episodes.name: Sendoh's scheme
episodes.overview: Shohoku's representatives rush to Anzai's aid, and are surprised at how efficiently Sakuragi acquired a doctor. Meanwhile, Kainan was too strong for Ryonan and Sendoh to handle. They'll have to do better now that they're up against Shohoku.

episodes.name: The final battle!
episodes.overview: One of the more exciting matches in the tournament is about to start, as it's Ryonan vs. Shohoku. Though people have already been speculating Shohoku's chances of a victory, as their coach is absent, resting himself in the hospital.

episodes.name: Sakuragi Hanamichi comes to rescue!
episodes.overview: Due to Fukuda's terrible defense and Sakuragi's equally atrocious offense, Taoka thought it'd be a harmless idea to match Fukuda up with him. However, it seems that the entire gym was in for a surprise as Sakuragi showed off his jumper.

episodes.name: Gorilla goes astray
episodes.overview: Something appears to be wrong with Akagi; after getting knocked down by Uozumi, he started playing horribly. Kogure was forced to call a timeout in order to straighten things out.

episodes.name: King Kong number two!
episodes.overview: In order to make Akagi come back to his senses, Sakuragi pulls off his cocky routine that more than motivates him back into playing normally.

episodes.name: Gorilla revives!
episodes.overview: It seems that things are back to normal psychologically for Shohoku as Sakuragi wasn't as raged as expected by his friends, and Akagi finally solved some internal problems. The true match is about to start.

episodes.name: The greatest shame of one's life
episodes.overview: Ryonan's offense was concentrated around Fukuda, who has been constantly defeating Sakuragi. He was forced to sit out, sulking to himself of being beaten fair and square. While Sakuragi was defeated, Shohoku wasn't, as Mitsui's three pointers pulled his team…

episodes.name: Rukawa Kaede, gambling on the 2nd half
episodes.overview: Everyone was confused on Rukawa's performance so far, scoring only two points. Though it became apparent in the second half; he saved up his energy for the second half in order to prevent what had happened to him during the final minutes against Kainan!

episodes.name: The most dangerous challenger!
episodes.overview: With Rukawa and Sendoh at full strength against each other, they've both carried their teams, advancing point by point in hopes of defeating one another.

episodes.name: Peak performance
episodes.overview: Sendoh and Rukawa continue to push against each other in the second half, but the highlight of it so far is Uozumi being forced to sit out with four fouls.

episodes.name: The feeling of victory
episodes.overview: Uozumi gets a flashback of Coach Taoka's promise of bringing him to the national scene, but that promise is looking a little fuzzy with Shohoku dominating.

episodes.name: You guys are strong!
episodes.overview: Uozumi has to sit out due to his fouls, which causes Akagi to dominate the paint and score easy baskets.

episodes.name: Uozumi Revives
episodes.overview: Coach Taoka's patience ran dry as he subbed Uozumi back in to help shoulder some of Sendoh's responsibilities on the court.

episodes.name: Blue waves - Ryonan attacks back!
episodes.overview: The shift of momentum started turning into Ryonan's favour as soon as Uozumi came back with four fouls, making defensive stops and scoring points.

episodes.name: Shohoku's problems
episodes.overview: Coach Taoka exploited Shohoku's foul trouble problem, and made good use of it. Shohoku will continue to be in the hot seat if this continues.

episodes.name: Sendoh attacks! Shohoku loses
episodes.overview: Sendoh's strong offensive play continues to push Ryonan closer to Shohoku, and their defensive stops aren't allowing Shohoku to score any points.

episodes.name: Amateur Sakuragi Hanamichi shows off!
episodes.overview: Mitsui collapsed due to exhaustion, and while his lost presence was dire for Shohoku, they remained formidable behind Sakuragi's strong play.

episodes.name: Kogure's determination
episodes.overview: Kogure spotted up for a 3 pointer. During the ball's journey there to the net, Kogure gets flashbackes of the basketball trials he faced to get to the position he's currently at.

episodes.name: Win or Lose
episodes.overview: Kogure's 3 pointer put Shohoku up, but Sendoh wouldn't let his team get defeated so easily.

episodes.name: New Challenge: the national championship!
episodes.overview: Expectedly, the Shohoku basketball team is all the talk at Shohoku school, and everyone won't leave them alone, especially the school's news reporter Mari.

episodes.name: Rukawa Kaede's Ambition
episodes.overview: Hikiochi's sister desperately wants to interview Sendoh, but when doing so, eavesdropped on the announcement of Uozumi and Ikegami's retirement.

episodes.name: Japan's number basketball player
episodes.overview: Sakuragi goes with Maki to scout out some teams who'll also be heading into the national tournament. One freshman center instantly caught their attention.

episodes.name: The basketball kingdom - United States of America
episodes.overview: Rukawa pleads to Anzai about his decision to play in America, though he rejects the idea. Rukawa is told the emotional story of Yazawa, a person like him who flew over to America in order to face better competition.

episodes.name: Rukawa Kaede's spirit
episodes.overview: Understanding Anzai's words, Rukawa immediately makes it his goal to become the best player in Japan, even taking it at a higher level during practice against his own teammates.

episodes.name: Shohoku's real ace
episodes.overview: It's a battle between Mitsui and Rukawa to see who the real ace is for Shohoku.

episodes.name: The sudden barrier to the nationals
episodes.overview: It seems that some of Shohoku's players have more things to worry about other than the fearful opponents at the nationals. Their marks have been poor, and if they don't pass their upcoming tests, they'll be forbidden to play! Akagi decides to take in his team…

episodes.name: Guys - Sakuragi Gang
episodes.overview: The Sakuragi gang look for jobs in order to collect money to afford train tickets to the national games.

episodes.name: Going toward 20000 shoots
episodes.overview: Anzai decides to incorporate Sakuragi into the Shohoku offense, making him go through rigorous shooting training.

episodes.name: Shohoku vs. Jousei
episodes.overview: Sakuragi continues his shooting practice while his team is off at Josei, battling equally with the former eight ranked team without Sakuragi's rebounding prowess.

episodes.name: The day when Sakuragi's fired up!
episodes.overview: Haruka decides to reward Sakuragi for his hard practicing by taking him to the festival. Sakuragi sees this as an opportunity to try and get with her, but the process became harder then he had expected.

episodes.name: Basketball Shoes Part II
episodes.overview: Sakuragi has been working hard for the past months to improve his basketball skills, but as a result, his shoes have torn. He visits none other than the man that gave him his first shoes.

episodes.name: Mixed Feelings, Uozumi returns
episodes.overview: When a couple of Shoyo players decided to give their goodlucks to Shohoku, Sakuragi comes up with a suggestion; a game against Shoyo and Ryonan!

episodes.name: Shohoku vs. Shoyo/Ryonan
episodes.overview: Rukawa garnered all the attention with his strong start to the game, but it was Sendoh who soon stole that spotlight when he entered the gym in his fishing clothes.

episodes.name: Facing the strongest team, Shohoku in danger!
episodes.overview: The combination team has become even more formidable by adding Sendoh and Fukuda to their lineup, and while Sakuragi is still struggling, Shohoku retains the lead.

episodes.name: The one who brought forth a miracle - Sakuragi!
episodes.overview: Fujima starts passing more and shooting less 3 pointers, giving hims teammates more open looks and easy opportunities to score. But is it enough to overcome Shohoku?

episodes.name: SLAM DUNK!
episodes.overview: The battle between the combo team and Shohoku has reached its climax, and the one deciding its conclusion is Sakuragi with a Slam Dunk. Though Shohoku has more important things to look forward to, such as the Inter High Tournament.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Admiral Choi Young, a fierce warrior from Korea's Goryeo Dynasty, abducts Dr. Eun Soo 700 years into the future and soon falls for her.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Princess Nogoog gets injured but there is no doctor in Goryeo that can save her from dying. So King Gongmin orders General Choi Young to go through "heaven's door" and find God's doctor.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Now that the Princess is out of danger, General Choi Young wants to return Doctor Yoo Eun Soo to where she belongs as he promised her. But King Gongmin has other plans for her and wants to keep her in Goryeo.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: After the king's order forces him to renege on his word of honor, Choi Young impales himself on his sword, Eun-soo steps in, intent on saving his life. Choi Young wakes in the morning, he issues instructions for immediate departure. The party arrives in the c…

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Doctor Yoo Eun Soo is still trying to assimilate the fact that she is hundreds of years in the past. The King asks Doctor Yoo Eun Soo to be the Royal Doctor of the Palace. Rumors spread throughout town, that the Doctor/God from heaven can bring the dead back…

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Prince Cheol tries to ridicule the king, saying that General Choi Young has made up everything about the Doctor coming from heaven. General's wound gets infected/heart stops beating, Doctor does CPR brings him back to life. Prince Cheol confesses he killed th…

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: General Choi Young goes to save the High Doctor from Prince Gi Cheol. Prince Gi Cheol tells them that the High Doctor must go and heal Prince Kyeong Chang (who was supposed to be King but is dying from an illness). If High Doctor is unable to heal the Prince…

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: General Choi Young and Doctor Eun Soo escape, and take the young Prince Kyeong Chang to a safe place. Woodalchi Warriors are all arrested and accused of betraying the King, for secretly keeping in contact with General Choi Young. In order to save General Choi…

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: General Choi Young is arrested and charged for treason. High Doctor is taken away by Prince Gi Choel. High Doctor asks Prince Gi Choel to save Choi Young, he tells her that she must give him her heart in order to save Choi Young. King personally interrogates…

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: King summons General Choi Young and the Woodalchi Warriors, charges against Choi Young are lifted and Woodalchi Warriors given a special right where no one is to interfere with them. Queen pretends to be ill in order to bring Doctor Eun Soo back to the palace…

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: With the help of the Woodalchi Warriors, the King tries to mobilize supporters but things doesn't go as planned when Prince Gi Choel gets a hold of the list, which contains the names of the potential supporters. Meanwhile, tension is high between Choi Young a…

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Ki Chul threatens King Gong Min with people's lives, and Choi Young counterattacks and manages to save Eun Soo.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Ready to die, Choi Young throws himself in a one-on-one battle with Ki Chul. Eun Soo goes back to save Choi Young and offers to be his partner.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Thanks to Eun Soo, Choi Young finds happiness again, but Ki Chul plots to name Duk Heung-gun as the new king. No Guk worries about King Gong Min.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Choi Young confessed that he was bribed and the king sentenced him to one year of hard labor, but he escapes and run away with the High Doctor..meanwhile the king's uncle, who is trying to become king, announces to Court Lady Choi(choi young's aunt) that the…

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Eun Soo is in and out of consciousness, and Jang Bin warns that she may not survive the day. Choi Young finds Duk Heung-gun to ask for the antidote.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: With Cho Il Shin's rebellion, Gong Min has no choice but to flee the palace, while Duk Heung continues his dangerous deal with the throne at stake.

episodes.name: Episode 17
episodes.overview: Choi Young find out Eun Soo's part in why he was kept alive and sets out to save her. Meanwhile, the King, staying in his own palace in the village, recive Goryeo's new seal and have to deal with the consequences of what Eun Soo's and Prince Deok Heung's deal…

episodes.name: Episode 18
episodes.overview: Choi Young stops Eun Soo's wedding and waits for Gong Min while laying out recapture plans. Duk Heung is cornered and threatens Eun Soo.

episodes.name: Episode 19
episodes.overview: The envoy from Won says he will give the throne to whoever is willing to give up sovereignty. Choi Young takes on a journey to let Eun Soo go.

episodes.name: Episode 20
episodes.overview: No Guk's kidnapping turns the palace upside down, and Gong Min starts to waiver. Choi Young and Eun Soo both return to devise a plan to save No Guk.

episodes.name: Episode 21
episodes.overview: Eun Soo is a member of Woo Dal Chi and accompanies Choi Young. Ki Chul is furious about the betrayal and plans to attack the palace with Duk Heung.

episodes.name: Episode 22
episodes.overview: Gong Min brings an attack against all those in favor of Won. Choi Young wants to keep Eun Soo by his side and gets more and more nervous.

episodes.name: Episode 23
episodes.overview: Choi Young is unwilling to let go of Eun Soo even for one moment. Eun Soo hasn't given hope on the antidote and examines Choi Young's hand.

episodes.name: Episode 24
episodes.overview: Eun Soo, who has been suffering from fever all night long, is kidnapped by Ki Chul, and Ki Chul wants to go to the heavens with her.

episodes.name: I Am Kuroko
episodes.overview: While recruiting for the basketball club, the Seirin Private High school has managed to pick up some impressive players; a power house, former American player, and a member of the “Generation of Miracles.

episodes.name: I'm Serious
episodes.overview: Before anyone can become an official member of the Basketball Club, they first must do display courage. Afterwards, a surprising guest appears on the school grounds with a shocking offer.

episodes.name: It's Better If I Can't Win
episodes.overview: Seirin basketball club is playing a practice game at Kaijo High School, the school where Kise attends. After a display of power from Kagami, it forces the Kaijo coach to take Seirin serious.

episodes.name: Take Care of the Counter Attack!
episodes.overview: The only way to stop Kise is to challenge him with a style he can't copy, Kurokos! The new offensive from Seirin is closing the point gap, until an injury might derail Serin's chance at victory.

episodes.name: Your Basketball
episodes.overview: Serin is victorious against Kaijo, barely. It is a shock to Kise, who has never lost in his life. After the game, another former Teiko Middle school player, Midorima, has a few words for Kise.

episodes.name: Let Me Tell You Two Things
episodes.overview: Serins first opponent in the inter-high tournament is Shinkyo high, a middle tier school until last year. With the addition of a two meter tall, 87 kilogram player from Senegal, Shinkyo is a new threat to Serins championship hopes.

episodes.name: You'll See Something Amazing
episodes.overview: After their win over Shinkyo, Seirin goes on to crush their next few opponents. Realizing too much confidence is brewing, the team is taken to watch a Shutoku match. After seeing how Shutoku, one of the three Emperor teams of basketball, dominates their oppos…

episodes.name: Now That I Think About It
episodes.overview: Seirin takes on Seiho, a squad built around an invincible defense. The unorthodox manner in the way Seiko moves is finally understood, but it may be too late. Will Seirin's streak finally be shutdown?

episodes.name: To Win
episodes.overview: Seirin's game continues against Seiho with neither team giving up points. Kuroko and Kagami are pulled after the first quarter, to preserve their strength. Can their team mates bring home the victory?

episodes.name: I Can't Have That

episodes.name: That's Not It

episodes.name: What Is "Victory"

episodes.name: I Believed in You

episodes.name: You Look Just Like Him

episodes.name: Don't Make Me Laugh

episodes.name: Let's Go

episodes.name: You're All Ridiculous

episodes.name: No!!
episodes.overview: Aomie is unstoppable, but Serin hasn't given up yet. But with Kagami pulled in the last few minutes, can the team play without him?

episodes.name: On to a New Challenge

episodes.name: I Don't Want to Be
episodes.overview: Kiyoshi has a plan for Kuroko and Kagami to get them over their slump. Kuroko, on the other hand, think he needs to be pulled.

episodes.name: Let's Get Started

episodes.name: I'll Win Even If It Kills Me

episodes.name: I'm Not Mature!

episodes.name: Don't Get the Wrong Idea

episodes.name: Our Basketball

episodes.overview: As the second half of the match between Shutoku and Rakuzan starts, Akashi uses his eye, it is revealed that Akashi was the one who found Kuroko's talent by using his eye on him, which meant that the eye can see potential of people, but it is said that in mat…

episodes.overview: Facing Akashi's Emperor Eye, which sees the future movements of the opponents, Shutoku looks like they had no hand to play. But the will to fight once again lights up within the eyes of the team members, and they face Rakuzan with the spirit of "unyielding te…

episodes.overview: The Seirin-Kaijo game was white-hot due to the battle between their ace players. With the defense and offense reversed now, Seirin goes on the offensive. As the last one to awaken, and one with potential comparable to the Generation of Miracles, Kagami was on…

episodes.overview: Kise's injury becomes worse. His coach orders him to step down the court for a while and rest until the last two minutes of the last quarter wherein he could use his Perfect Copy. Kagami's talents give way to Seirin having a 15-point gap in the lead with four…

episodes.overview: Kise recovers and manages to fill the 15-point gap. Kaijo becomes the lead with a score of 78-77. Seirin becomes restless and their moves become stiff as Kise's fast recovery and Kaijo's persistence to win makes the crowds cheer, putting Seirin under pressure…

episodes.name: He is the Best Player
episodes.overview: Kuroko finally finds a way to stop Kise, and Seirin wins with a deciding shot made by Kuroko. The episode ends with Kuroko telling a story about his past

episodes.overview: Kuroko is first placed into Teiko's third string basketball team. However, after practicing everyday after school with Aomine, Akashi realised Kuroko talent as the "Phantom 6th Man." During a game between the third and second string, Kuroko proved himself and…
