seasons.name: Phantom Blood & Battle Tendency
seasons.overview: Jonathan Joestar's antagonistic relationship with his adopted brother Dio begins a truly bizarre lineage, which is continued by his grandson Joseph.

episodes.name: Dio the Invader
episodes.overview: England, 1868. A thief tries to raid an overturned carriage, but discovers that two of the occupants, a man and his young son are still alive. The man, George Joestar, proclaims he will forever be indebted to his savior, who reveals himself to be Dario Brando.

episodes.name: A Letter from the Past
episodes.overview: Seven years later in 1888, JoJo and Dio are supposedly getting along, though JoJo is still fearful of Dio. Meanwhile, Dio plots to liberate the Joestar family of their fortune.

episodes.name: Youth with Dio
episodes.overview: JoJo prepares to turn Dio in to the police.

episodes.name: Overdrive
episodes.overview: Three days after the incident, JoJo awakens to find Erina nursing him back to health in the hospital. As they rekindle their friendship, they encounter a strange man named Will A. Zeppeli.

episodes.name: The Dark Knights
episodes.overview: A talented young pickpocket named Poco unwittingly lures JoJo and company into an encounter with Dio, Tarukus, and Blueford.

episodes.name: Tomorrow's Courage
episodes.overview: The encounter between JoJo and the Knights continues.

episodes.name: Sorrowful Successor
episodes.overview: The encounter against Tarukus comes to an end. Poco's family is in grave danger. JoJo meets Dire, Straizo, and Tonpetty.

episodes.name: Bloody Battle! JoJo & Dio
episodes.overview: The party are received by Doobie. Dire faces off against Dio. Straizo takes on Pajyu, Jones, Pluton, and Barnum.

episodes.name: The Final Ripple!
episodes.overview: As Dio falls following his battle with JoJo, he decapitates himself before the ripple reaches his head, which is recovered by his zombie servant Wang Chung.

episodes.name: New York's JoJo
episodes.overview: In 1938, 49 years after Jonathan Joestar's death, Speedwagon and Straizo travel to Mexico, where they discover an underground room filled with similar looking masks and a petrified body believed to be the being who created them.

episodes.name: The Game Master
episodes.overview: As expected, Straizo recovers from Joseph's attack and uses the laser eye attack Dio used to seemingly pierce through JoJo's head and neck. However, this turns out to be a clever trick by Joseph.

episodes.name: The Pillar Man
episodes.overview: Joseph is confronted by one of Stroheim's men, Donovan, but manages to subdue him, learning that Speedwagon is still alive.

episodes.name: JoJo vs. the Ultimate Lifeform
episodes.overview: As Joseph begins to fight against Santana, Joseph finds his Ripple to not be effective against Santana, but it still helps protect him from the Pillar Man's attacks. Joseph appears to be unconscious after receiving a powerful hit.

episodes.name: Ultimate Warriors from Ancient Times
episodes.overview: Speedwagon brings statued remains of Santana to the headquarters of his foundation in Washington, D.C., where it is shown Santana is still alive, but his scientists are able to keep him dormant through the use of ultraviolet light.

episodes.name: A Hero's Proof
episodes.overview: Caesar engages Wamuu in battle for killing Mark, using his Bubble Launcher technique to surround the Pillar Man in Ripple enfused bubbles.

episodes.name: Lisa Lisa, Hamon Coach
episodes.overview: Wanting to teach JoJo to control his Ripple powers, Caesar takes him to Venice to meet his teacher, Lisa Lisa.

episodes.name: The Deeper Plan
episodes.overview: Lisa Lisa explains to JoJo and Caesar how the creator of the Stone Mask, Kars, is seeking a perfectly cut Red Stone of Aja known as the Super Aja to power the Stone Mask and become the ultimate life form.

episodes.name: Von Stroheim's Revenge
episodes.overview: As JoJo awaits to warn Lisa Lisa about the Pillar Men, Esidisi's brain takes over the body of Suzi Q and sends the Super Aja off on a boat bound for Venice before confronting Lisa Lisa.

episodes.name: A Race Toward the Brink
episodes.overview: Stroheim starts using his new mechanical body, which was designed to surpass Santana, to fight against Kars. However, it proves futile against Kars' Light Mode.

episodes.name: Young Caesar
episodes.overview: Lisa Lisa tells JoJo of Caesar's childhood, in which he took to crime at a young age after being abandoned by his debt-ridden father, Mario.

episodes.name: A Hundred Against Two
episodes.overview: Whilst following Wamuu's trail of blood, JoJo and Lisa Lisa encounter another vampire named Wired Beck.

episodes.name: A True Warrior
episodes.overview: Before JoJo's and Wamuu's race begins, it is revealed that during each lap, there will be a different weapon for whoever can grab it from a pillar first.

episodes.name: The Warrior of Wind
episodes.overview: Launching his Final Mode attack, Gathering Gale, which starts peeling away his own body, Wamuu begins firing a stream of wind capable of cutting stone towards JoJo.

episodes.name: The Ties That Bind JoJo
episodes.overview: Being forced to cling onto a rope to stop Lisa Lisa from falling to her death, JoJo is at a huge disadvantage against Kars.

episodes.name: The Birth of a Superbeing
episodes.overview: Kars demonstrates his new powers, turning his hand into a flesh-eating squirrel that deals damage to Stroheim. The sun rises, leaving a shocking discovery.

episodes.name: The Ascendant One
episodes.overview: JoJo's victory, along with his arm, is cut short when Kars manages to survive the volcano by forming a shield of air bubbles to protect him from its deadly lava.

seasons.name: Stardust Crusaders
seasons.overview: Joseph Joestar's grandson Jotaro Kujo has a strange new superpower, which turns out to be connected to the reemergence of old foe Dio Brando.

episodes.name: The Man Possessed by an Evil Spirit
episodes.overview: In 1987, in Japan, a boy named Jotaro Kujo has willingly turned himself into jail, refusing to leave. Jotaro's mother, Holly, requests help from her father, Joseph Joestar, who travels to Japan alongside an acquaintance, Mohammed Abdul.

episodes.name: Who Will Be the Judge!?
episodes.overview: Jotaro heads to school and encounters a mysterious transfer student named Noriaki Kakyoin.

episodes.name: The Curse of DIO
episodes.overview: Jotaro is able to defeat Kakyoin. He takes the wounded Kakyoin back to his house, hoping to get some information about DIO.

episodes.name: Tower of Grey
episodes.overview: If they do not defeat DIO within 50 days, Holly could die - Jotaro and crew head to Egypt, where they think DIO is hiding. While on the plane, they run into another one of DIO's assassins.

episodes.name: Silver Chariot
episodes.overview: DIO's next assassin, Polnareff attacks Jotaro and crew, Abdul faces him with his Magician's Red.

episodes.name: Dark Blue Moon
episodes.overview: With a new person in their party, they head to Singapore with the boat the Speedwagon Foundation provided them, during their journey Jotaro is targeted by an enemy Stand from within the water.

episodes.name: Strength
episodes.overview: A giant ship shows itself. On board, they realize they can't seem to find a crew, but an orangutan.

episodes.name: The Devil
episodes.overview: Arrived in Singapore, Jotaro's group stays at a hotel individually. A new Stand owner who is known as "Devo the Cursed" is awaiting Polnareff in his room. Devo's Stand increases its power as its user's hatred towards the opponent increases. Polnareff gets int…

episodes.name: Yellow Temperance
episodes.overview: Joseph uses Hermit Purple to create a message using the TV, which tells them that Kakyoin is a traitor.

episodes.name: The Emperor and the Hanged Man (1)
episodes.overview: The group travels to India. In a restaurant Polnareff is attacked by a mysterious Stand that is inside a mirror.

episodes.name: The Emperor and the Hanged Man (2)
episodes.overview: In an effort to save Polnareff, Abdul is injured by the enemy. Then J. Geil's Stand, Hanged Man attacks.

episodes.name: Empress
episodes.overview: The group heads toward Varanasi. On the way, Joseph realizes his arm is quite swollen.

episodes.name: Wheel of Fortune
episodes.overview: Jotaro and the others head toward Pakistan in a car. Polnareff is driving the car on a very dangerous mountain road, and recklessly passes a slow moving vehicle that was in front of him.

episodes.name: Justice (1)
episodes.overview: Jotaro and the others successfully survive another attack from the enemy Stand users and make it into Pakistan. However, they decide to find an inn at a nearby village because of the dense fog they suddenly hit. The village they get to is rather quiet and all…

episodes.name: Justice (2)
episodes.overview: Polnareff finally realizes that Enyaba is another assassin from DIO. He tries to warn the others, but Enyaba's Stand, Justice, has the ability to take control of people's bodies and corpses, and he is pursued. The whole village had already been under Enyaba's…

episodes.name: Lovers (1)
episodes.overview: After surviving Enyaba's attack, Jotaro and crew make it to Pakistan's capital, Karachi. There, they encounter DIO's next assassin, Steely Dan. Following DIO's orders, Steely Dan ruthlessly kills Enyaba in front of them. Jotaro and the others can't help but f…

episodes.name: Lovers (2)
episodes.overview: Steely Dan's Stand, The Lovers, has entered Joseph's brain. Dan puts himself at an advantage, with having Joseph's life on the line, and tells Jotaro to do various things for him, knowing Jotaro has no choice but to obey. Meanwhile, Kakyoin and Polnareff also…

episodes.name: Sun
episodes.overview: Jotaro and the others continue their journey through the desert, trying to get to Cairo. They travel with camels and can't shake the feeling that someone is following them, but no one is in sight. Traveling in the killer heat, they realize that it's still bri…

episodes.name: Death 13 (1)
episodes.overview: Kakyoin is dreaming and dreams about being in a strange amusement park, where he encounters the Death tarot card. While in the dream, he witnesses Death 13 cut down a dog. Kakyoin wakes up screaming, but can't remember what his bad dream was about.

episodes.name: Death 13 (2)
episodes.overview: Kakyoin tries to convince the others that the baby is suspicious, but that backfires and his friends start to doubt his sanity. Kakyoin then tries to convince them that he's not crazy, and shows them his arm that has "Baby Stand" carved into it... but that ju…

episodes.name: Judgement (1)
episodes.overview: While on an island on the edge of the Red Sea where Mohammed Abdul's father is said to live, Polnareff uncovers a magic lamp and its genie Cameo offers him three wishes, although all is not as it seems.

episodes.name: Judgement (2)
episodes.overview: Polnareff must find out a way to escape the attacks of Cameo and his Stand Judgement who has apparently turned his sister Cherie and Abdul into zombies.

episodes.name: High Priestess (1)
episodes.overview: Jotaro and the others obtain a submarine as a new means of travel. Through the Red Sea, they try to head toward Egypt where DIO awaits. Using the sonar to detect any threats on the outside, the submarine quietly dives in. They however realize that if they're…

episodes.name: High Priestess (2)
episodes.overview: The group must find a way off of the submarine and away from the attacks of High Priestess.

episodes.name: Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'Doul (1)
episodes.overview: Jotaro's group encounters N'Doul's Stand "Geb", and Iggy's "The Fool".

episodes.name: Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'Doul (2)
episodes.overview: The group's encounter with "Geb" and "The Fool" continues.

episodes.name: Khnum's Zenyatta and Thoth's Mondatta
episodes.overview: As the Joestar group arrives in Aswan they encounter Oingo's Stand "Khnum" and Boingo's Stand "Thoth".

episodes.name: Anubis (1)
episodes.overview: Jotaro's group encounters the Stand "Anubis".

episodes.name: Anubis (2)
episodes.overview: The encounter with the Stand "Anubis" continues.

episodes.name: Mariah's Divine Bastet (1)
episodes.overview: Jotaro and the others arrive in Luxor. While heading there, Joseph notices an electrical outlet in a rock. Obviously fascinated by the electrical outlet in the rock, Joseph gets closer, and he gets shocked.

episodes.name: Mariah's Divine Bastet (2)
episodes.overview: Due to the powers of an enemy Stand, Joseph's body becomes magnetised. While chasing after the woman that seemed to be the Stand user, Abdul also touches the electrical outlet and becomes magnetised as well.

episodes.name: Alessi's Divine Set (1)
episodes.overview: While Joseph and Avdol were fighting with Mariah, Jotaro gets concerned that they haven't shown up yet, and goes to look for them around Luxor. Then, Polnareff senses someone following them and confronts the man.

episodes.name: Alessi's Divine Set (2)
episodes.overview: Because of the power of Alessi's Stand, Set, Polnareff is turned back into a child. The one who came to his aid amidst his confusion was a woman named Marena. However, Alessi's evil hands followed Polnareff into her house.

episodes.name: D'Arby the Gambler (1)
episodes.overview: After a long journey, Jotaro and the others finally reach Cairo. They go to a cafe and ask if anyone knows where DIO's mansion is located by showing the picture around. Then, someone says that they have seen the building before.

episodes.name: D'Arby the Gambler (2)
episodes.overview: Souls are on the line as a game of poker continues.

episodes.name: Hol Horse and Mondatta (1)
episodes.overview: Hol Horse arrives at Cairo in order to pursue Jotaro and the others. He has joined forces with another partner and is after the lives of Jotaro and crew once more. That partner, is none other than Boingo.

episodes.name: Hol Horse and Mondatta (2)
episodes.overview: Hol Horse and Boingo followed Jotaro and the others to Cairo and as Boingo's book said, Hol Horse stuck his fingers into Polnareff's nose... but he didn't know what to do from there. Then Jotaro and the others, who were looking for Polnareff, show up, but thi…

episodes.name: The Gatekeeper of Hell, Pet Shop (1)
episodes.overview: Jojo and the others continue to look for DIO's mansion in Cairo. Following Abdul's advice, they have a beggar look for the mansion and wait. Meanwhile, Iggy, who is wandering the city alone, gets confronted by two large dogs. The dogs are freaked out by Iggy'…

episodes.name: The Gatekeeper of Hell, Pet Shop (2)
episodes.overview: Iggy ends up in a battle to the death in the sewers against the falcon that guards DIO's mansion, Pet Shop. Pet Shop shows no mercy, and goes after Iggy at a frightening speed. Iggy, despite being injured, runs into the river, making a dome made out of dirt t…

episodes.name: D'Arby the Player (1)
episodes.overview: Despite Iggy's injuries, Jojo and company finally make it to DIO's mansion. Once they entered, a butler named D'Arby the Younger was awaiting their arrival. The younger brother of the defeated D'Arby the Elder, he immediately shows off his Stand, Atum's power.

episodes.name: D'Arby the Player (2)
episodes.overview: The battle for souls with D'Arby continues. Kakyoin challenged D'Arby to a race game, but ends up losing and D'Arby steals his soul. Before Joseph really has time to react, Jotaro picks the next game.

episodes.name: The Miasma of the Void, Cool Ice (1)
episodes.overview: The baseball match with D'Arby continues within DIO's mansion. For some reason, Jotaro starts declaring his pitches to D'Arby. D'Arby finds Jotaro's actions strange, but still believes he has the upperhand because of his Stand's abilities.

episodes.name: The Miasma of the Void, Cool Ice (2)
episodes.overview: After a long, hard journey, they are faced with a sudden goodbye of a friend. Because it's so sudden, Polnareff can't control his emotions. He starts brandishing his sword toward the unseen enemy with very little success.

episodes.name: The Miasma of the Void, Cool Ice (3)
episodes.overview: Polnareff is pushed to his limits with Vanilla Ice's merciless attacks. He finally awaits death, but is saved at the last minute by the dying Iggy. Iggy uses the last bit of his energy, but his Stand is obviously losing power. Polnareff then stabs Vanilla Ice…

episodes.name: Dio's World (1)
episodes.overview: Polnareff encounters the Stand "The World".

episodes.name: Dio's World (2)
episodes.overview: The group tries to identify DIO's Stand.

episodes.name: Dio's World (3)
episodes.overview: The fight continues.

episodes.name: Long Journey Farewell, My Friends
episodes.overview: The final battle!

seasons.name: Diamond Is Unbreakable
seasons.overview: It's the year 1999, 11 years after Jotaro Kujo's desperate fight against DIO in Egypt. Jotaro meets with Josuke Higashikata, the illegitimate son of his grandfather Joseph Joestar. He discovers that Josuke also has the same "Stand" power and that a new threat…

episodes.name: Jotaro Kujo! Meets Josuke Higashikata
episodes.overview: April 1999. Jotaro Kujo arrives to Morioh City in search of someone named Higashikata, and ends up running into a young man surrounded by delinquents. Jotaro then finds out that his name is Josuke Higashikata, and was exactly the person he was looking for.

episodes.name: Josuke Higashikata! Meets Angelo
episodes.overview: Josuke spots the terrible and violent villain Angelo's Stand, and tells Jotaro about that incident. Jotaro figures it's a Stand that can somehow enter people, so he warns Josuke to not eat or drink anything until he can get to him. Right when he's told that,…

episodes.name: The Nijimura Brothers (1)
episodes.overview: Angelo's Stand ability was brought forth by the mysterious bow and arrow, and apparently they're also connected to Dio. After defeating Angelo, Jotaro thought that the danger had left the city, and tries to find the whereabouts of the bow and arrow. A few day…

episodes.name: The Nijimura Brothers (2)
episodes.overview: In order to save Koichi, Josuke goes further into the Nijimura household. Suddenly, he's attacked from many tiny beams of light. Josuke manages to dodge the attack, but it hits Okuyasu right in the face. Josuke tells Okuyasu that he'll heal his wounds if he t…

episodes.name: The Nijimura Brothers (3)
episodes.overview: Josuke and Koichi defeat Keicho. They go further into the Nijimura house, in order to destroy the bow and arrow to make sure there will be no more victims. However, they end up hearing strange noises in the dark room they happen upon. As soon as Josuke tries…

episodes.name: Koichi Hirose (Reverb)
episodes.overview: Riding his bike to school, Koichi accidentally runs over a bag that was in the road that had a cat inside. Koichi is instantly overwhelmed by what happend. Then suddenly, a man named Tamami Kobayashi appears. Despite it being an accident, he demands money fro…

episodes.name: Toshikazu Hazamada (Show Off)
episodes.overview: Josuke and Koichi hear from Tamami that a high school student named Hazamada might also be a Stand user, so the two go to the school and investigate. Josuke checks inside Hazamada's locker, and finds a strange wooden doll inside, but nothing else out of the o…

episodes.name: Yukako Yamagishi Falls in Love (1)
episodes.overview: Koichi is asked out by another student in his grade named Yukako Yamagishi. At first, he couldn't hide his joy from being asked out, but quickly has second thoughts when she suddenly loses her temper with him. The next day, she knitted him a sweater, made him…

episodes.name: Yukako Yamagishi Falls in Love (2)
episodes.overview: Koichi can't handle living in captivity any longer and tries to plan his escape. While talking to Yukako, Koichi finds out that there's a payphone nearby, and has Echoes go find it. He tries to contact Josuke and Okuyasu, but Yukako already figured out what h…

episodes.name: Let's Go Eat Some Italian Food
episodes.overview: Josuke and Okuyasu visit a brand new Italian restaurant in Morioh. Rather than customers choosing items from a menu, the chef, Tonio, decides what the customer will eat after he looks at them. Tonio wants Okuyasu to feel better, and first, offers him water. O…

episodes.overview: Red Hot Chili Pepper shows himself in front of Josuke. He seems to be more powerful than Jotaro, and is able to travel anywhere where electricity flows. Jotaro summons Josuke, Okuyasu, and Koichi and tells them that a certain someone is heading toward Morioh.…

episodes.name: Chili Pepper (2)
episodes.overview: In order to defeat Red Hot Chili Pepper, who intends on killing Joseph Joestar, Josuke and the others head to the harbor. Jotaro believes that Red Hot Chili Pepper will try to get to Joseph's boat with something that requires a battery, so he leaves Josuke an…

episodes.name: We Picked Up Something Crazy!
episodes.overview: Josuke and the others successfully capture Akira Otoishi and safely retrieve the bow and arrow. Peace is back in Morioh, but Josuke still faces a big problem... He still can't seem to get closer to his father he just met, Joseph. He agrees to let Joseph look…

episodes.overview: Koichi and Hazamada find out that the famous comic artist, Rohan Kishibe, who draws "Pink Dark Boy," lives in Morioh and they go to his house to get an autograph. Not only did Rohan promise them autographs, but invited them inside to see his work space, and t…

episodes.overview: Koichi suddenly arrives at Rohan's house. Koichi carefully goes inside and finds Rohan drawing manga at an incredible speed. Apparently he can't stop himself from drawing after reading about Koichi's experiences. Rohan attempts to tear another page from Koich…

episodes.name: Let's Go Hunting!
episodes.overview: Josuke suddenly gets invited to go hunting by Jotaro. The purpose of this hunting trip was to hunt down the rat that gained Stand abilities after Akira Otoishi shot it with the bow and arrow. As they trace the rat to a drainage canal, they see a clump of four…

episodes.name: Rohan Kishibe's Adventure
episodes.overview: Koichi and Rohan discover a bizarre sight. Before them lies an alley that's not listed on any map. They decide to go down the alley and find only empty houses that are also not listed on the map. While wandering they realize that no matter which way they turn…

episodes.name: Shigechi's Harvest (1)
episodes.overview: As Josuke was worrying about not having any money, a tiny little Stand holding a 1-yen coin appeared in front of him. A surprised Josuke follows it and encounters a new Stand user name Shigekiyo Yangyu (Shigechi)! Josuke is moved by the fact that Shigechi use…

episodes.name: Shigechi's Harvest (2)
episodes.overview: Josuke and the others head to the bank with their lottery ticket, but the bank is suspicious if that ticket really belongs to them. Josuke insists that they bought the ticket, but they find out that someone else's name and phone number are written on the back…

episodes.name: Yukako Yamagishi Dreams of Cinderella
episodes.overview: Yukako, who was depressed because Koichi wouldn't look her way, sees a mysterious shop one day called Salon Cinderella. Unlike other salons, apparently this was a salon that created faces to bring people fortune. The esthetician, Aya Tsuji, gives Yukako a fac…

episodes.name: Yoshikage Kira Just Wants to Live Quietly (1)
episodes.overview: As Yoshikage walked through the town at lunchtime, declined the offer to eat lunch with his female coworkers, and heads to a bakery to buy lunch. While enjoying his lunch outdoors, Shigechi walks by and accidentally takes Kira's sandwich bag by mistake, think…

episodes.overview: Yoshikage Kira was the killer hiding in Morioh and is also a Stand user. Shigechi finds out this secret, so Kira tries to dispose of him, but Shigechi fights back with Harvest. However, because of Kira's Stand, Killer Queen, he suffers a mortal wound and lose…

episodes.name: Heart Attack (1)
episodes.overview: Jotaro and Koichi try to track down the owner of the button and run into the murderer, Yoshikage Kira and his Stand, Killer Queen's bomb, Heart Attack at Centipede Shoes. Koichi wants to go after Kira, but Jotaro tells him not to. However, Koichi isn't satisf…

episodes.name: Heart Attack (2)
episodes.overview: Koichi manages to survive because Echoes Act 3 made Sheer Heart Attack heavy, but then the murderer, Yoshikage Kira shows up! Feeling intense anger against the murderer, Koichi fights Kira with Act 3, but doesn't stand a chance. Kira is infuriated by the fact…

episodes.name: Heart Father
episodes.overview: Josuke and the others head to the house that Yoshikage Kira used to live to try to find some clues on him. Kira had very few unique characteristics, but Jotaro comes to the conclusion that he hid all of his potential on purpose so he wouldn't stand out. They…

episodes.name: Janken Boy Is Coming!
episodes.overview: Yoshihiro successfully steals the bow and arrow from Josuke and the others and is on the run to try to find other people to make into potential Stand users to protect his son, Yoshikage. He tells the arrow to choose someone, and shoots them. Meanwhile, Rohan…

episodes.name: I'm an Alien
episodes.overview: Kira had been living as Kosaku Kawajiri ever since he stole his face, but he starts to realize just how hard it is to live controlling his urge to kill. Kira sees a woman pass by and he wants to show her his true self and strangle her slender neck. He tries t…

episodes.overview: Rohan has a feeling that Josuke is cheating at cee-lo, and cuts off his own pinky. If he is unable to figure out Josuke's trick in the next round, he says he will pay him 2 million yen to have him use Shining Diamond to fix his finger. But if Rohan does figur…

episodes.name: Highway Go Go (2)
episodes.overview: Jotaro tries to track down the mysterious foot print Stand's user. He manages to outrun the Stand with a motorcycle, and thinks to call Koichi and ask him to find the user by using Echoes. Meanwhile, the mysterious Stand keeps chasing Jotaro. Jotaro manages t…

episodes.overview: Kawajiri hears from Shinobu that there is a British Blue cat in the basement with a hole in its neck. Kawajiri wonders if it was shot with the arrow, and goes down to check, however all he finds is a dead cat. Shinobu, frightened by the cat, started to swing…
