episodes.overview: Yoshihiro looks for his missing son, Yoshikage Kira, when he spots Kosaku Kawajiri. He is convinced that he is his son, Yoshikage, and tries to get close, but the he spots Hayato taking video of him. Seeing that Rohan and Jotaro are also looking for Yoshikage…

episodes.name: July 15th (Thurs) (2)
episodes.overview: In order to get estimates for the fire damage and restoration costs to Rohan's house, the architect, Masazo Kinoto comes by. Rohan invites him into his house, but Rohan can't help but wonder about Kinoto's odd obsession... Meanwhile, in order to save Mikitaka…

episodes.name: July 15th (Thurs) (3)
episodes.overview: Rohan ends up looking at Masazo Kinoto's back, and becomes possessed by the Stand Cheap Trick. Because any attack on Cheap Trick would just come back to Rohan, he can't attack it, which puts him into a dilemma. Meanwhile, Josuke and Fungami are looking for Ko…

episodes.name: July 15th (Thurs) (4)
episodes.overview: At his wit's end with Cheap Trick, Rohan calls Koichi over to his house and asks him for help. Rohan does everything in his power not to show Koichi the Stand that's on his back, which just makes Koichi believe that he's just playing a trick on him, and Koich…

episodes.name: Bites the Dust (1)
episodes.overview: After being cornered, Kosaku Kawajiri gets rid of Hayato. Though he made it look like an accident, Rohan and the others have spotted Hayato, and were coming to the Kawajiri household the next day to ask him some questions. At this rate, he's going to be found…

episodes.name: Bites the Dust (2)
episodes.overview: After blowing up Rohan Kishibe with Killer Queen's third ability, Bites the Dust, Hayato is told by Kira as to what happened and returns to the same morning. He then thinks that the only people who could defeat Kira are people with abilities like Rohan, and t…

episodes.name: Shining D (Diamond) Is Unbreakable (1)
episodes.overview: Hayato's plan to kill Kira with Stray Cat's air bullets failed. Kira realizes that Hayato has repeated the same morning numerous times, and realizes that it's becoming dangerous for Hayato to repeat the same morning any longer, and considers undoing Bites the…

episodes.name: Shining D (Diamond) Is Unbreakable (2)
episodes.overview: Josuke and Hayato try to force Killer Queen and Stray Cat into close-quarters combat by going into a nearby house. However, air bullets start to show up in the house. Josuke tries to dodge them by throwing around ash from an ashtray so he can see where they a…

episodes.name: Goodbye, Morioh – The Heart of Gold
episodes.overview: Josuke and the others finally corner Kira. Jotaro also arrives but Kira uses Bites the Dust on a paramedic who came to help and tries to blow away time gain. He tells the woman his true identity, causing Bites the Dust to activate. The final battle in Morioh…

seasons.name: Golden Wind
seasons.overview: In Naples, Italy, the suspected son of Joestar family arch nemesis Dio dreams of becoming a Gang Star so he can bring down the local mafia from within.

episodes.name: Golden Wind
episodes.overview: Koichi arrives in Italy on a mission from Jotaro to find Giorno; they meet haphazardly when Giorno steals Koichi's luggage, and the ensuing chase leads Giorno into a Stand battle with the gangster Leaky Eye Luca.

episodes.name: Bucciarati Is Coming
episodes.overview: Faced with Bucciarati's Stand, Sticky Fingers, Giorno desperately uses Gold Experience to defend himself.

episodes.name: Meet the Gangster Behind the Wall
episodes.overview: Giorno is interviewed by a strange man to enter the Passione gang and achieve his dream of becoming a "Gang-Star".

episodes.name: Joining the Gang
episodes.overview: After apparently failing Polpo's test, Giorno is attacked by his stand, Black Sabbath, who tries to pierce his soul with a stand arrow.

episodes.name: Find Polpo's Fortune!
episodes.overview: News of Polpo's death reach the organization, along with word that he had a huge fortune hidden somewhere. Meanwhile, Giorno meets Bucciarati's gang.

episodes.name: Moody Jazz's Counterattack
episodes.overview: Bucciarati and Abbacchio are the only members of the gang left in the yacht. They have to find out where the enemy stand is hiding and how does it work.

episodes.name: Six Bullets Appears (1)
episodes.overview: After defeating Zucchero, the gang realizes that he has already told someone else where they were going and why.

episodes.name: Six Bullets Appears (2)
episodes.overview: Mista chases a Passione member named Sale to stop him from finding Polpo's treasure.

episodes.name: The First Mission from the Boss
episodes.overview: After being promoted to capo, Bucciarati and his gang are tasked to protect the boss' daughter.

episodes.name: Hitman Team
episodes.overview: Narancia discovers that he is slowly shrinking due to the wound Formaggio's stand, Little Feet, had inflicted on him.

episodes.name: Narancia's Li'l Bomber
episodes.overview: Formaggio traps the now miniature Narancia beneath his foot and attempts to interrogate him, but Narancia resists. A flashback shows Narancia's early life on the streets and his rescue by Bucciarati.

episodes.name: The Second Mission from the Boss
episodes.overview: In order to protect Trish from the Hitman Team, Bucciarati and crew's second mission from the boss was to go find a key in Pompei for some kind of vehicle that should aid them later on. Following orders, Giorno, Abbacchio, and Fugo head to Pompei to retrieve…

episodes.name: Mirror Man and Purple Smoke
episodes.overview: The person hiding in the mirror was Illuso from the Hitman Team. Fugo ends up being dragged into the mirror by Illuso's Stand, Man in the Mirror. Fugo then summons his own Stand, Purple Haze. Despite Giorno wanting to find Fugo, Abbacchio decides to go look f…

episodes.name: Express Train to Florence
episodes.overview: "Take Trish to Venice." With their next order from the boss, Bucciarati and his crew head to Naples Station. "Use the key at the water fountain with the turtle on the 6th platform." They find the water fountain, but can't find the place to use the key. Meanwh…

episodes.name: The Thankful Death (1)
episodes.overview: The Grateful Dead slowly begins to age everybody on the train. With his teammates affected, Mista goes alone to confront the enemy, only to encounter Pesci and his Beach Boy.

episodes.name: The Thankful Death (2)
episodes.overview: Number Six from Sex Pistols manages to warn Bucciarati about the enemies and fights back, but The Grateful Dead's powers are taking a toll on him. Bucciarati steels his resolve and throws himself out with Prosciutto out of the train that's going 150kph. Barel…

episodes.name: Babyhead
episodes.overview: After defeating Proscuitto and Pesci, Bucciarati and the others head to Venice in a car. Melone from the Hitman Team finds some of Bucciarati's blood at the scene where the train had stopped and then activates Babyface. The powerful remote-control Stand creat…

episodes.name: Head to Venice!
episodes.overview: Using Babyface's Stand's ability to turn human parts into other things, Giorno uses his Golden Wind to make parts for the human body. He rebuilds his own body and fights back. Meanwhile, another member of the Hitman Team who's also after Trish, Ghiaccio, was…

episodes.name: White Ice
episodes.overview: Ghiaccio's Stand, White Album is able to envelop him like a bodysuit and able to freeze everything around him to extremely low temperatures. Giorno and Mista somewhat make it to Venice, despite being partially frozen by Ghiaccio. But in order to try to get aw…

episodes.name: The Final Mission from the Boss
episodes.overview: Mista and Giorno were able to defeat Ghiaccio. They then confirm the mission on the disc and head to the location they're supposed to take Trish. Bucciarati goes up the tower with Trish, but while they're in the elevator, Trish suddenly disappears. Bucciarati…

episodes.name: The Mystery of Emperor Crimson
episodes.overview: Bucciarati finds out that the boss's true motive is to eliminate Trish because of her relationship with him, causing him to betray the boss and save Trish. Meanwhile, Giorno feels something bizarre is going on as they waited for Bucciarati's return. The boss'…

episodes.name: The "G" in Guts
episodes.overview: Because of their own wills and their sense of justice, Bucciarati and the others end up betraying the organization. Trish also wants to find out who her father truly is, so she tells the others that her mother met her father in Sardinia. They all decide to ha…

episodes.name: Crush and Talking Mouth
episodes.overview: The Stand that attacked Narancia was named Crush and belonged to Squallo, a member of the boss's elite guard. On top of that, Narancia suddenly can only say the exact opposite of what he's thinking, thanks to the ability of Talking Mouth, the Stand of Squallo…

episodes.name: Notorious Chase
episodes.overview: After defeating Squallo and Tiziano, Bucciarati and the others head off to Sardinia to find out about the boss's past. They head to Marco Polo International Airport in order to get a jet, but a strange man was following them. Mista manages to kill the strange…

episodes.name: Spicy Lady
episodes.overview: Trapped in the cabin of a flying plane with Notorious B.I.G, Trish has noticed that Giorno's brooch is turning into a brand new hand that will allow him to regain his powers. However, the movement of the transformation is attracting the enemy Stand. As the pl…

episodes.name: A Little Story from the Past ~My Name Is Doppio~
episodes.overview: On the island of Sardinia, a boy named Doppio is searching for Trish and the others on orders from Passione's boss. But Doppio has a dark secret, one that becomes apparent when he encounters Risotto of La Squadra.

episodes.name: Emperor Crimson vs. Metallic
episodes.overview: Doppio, the alter ego of Passione's boss, continues to fight against Risotto and his iron controlling Metallica. Doppio struggles against the powerful assassin, but is armed with King Crimson's Epitaph, which allows him to see the future.

episodes.name: Beneath a Sky on the Verge of Falling
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of the battle between Risotto and Doppio, Abbacchio uses Moody Blues to try and uncover the boss's identity. But the boss is adamant about keeping his identity a secret and executes his next gambit against the group.

episodes.name: Get to the Roman Colosseum!
episodes.overview: After his death, Abbacchio was able to leave the others a copy of the boss’s face and fingerprints with Moody Blues' replay. The others try to find out who the boss is with the fingerprint and suddenly get contacted by someone. The mysterious man tells them t…

episodes.name: Green Tea and Sanctuary (1)
episodes.overview: The gang are under attack by the last two members of the Elite Squad. Cioccolata uses his Green Day to spread a toxic mold over the island while Secco uses Oasis to swim through rock for stealth attacks, leaving the gang in a pinch.

episodes.name: Green Tea and Sanctuary (2)
episodes.overview: While Bruno stays on the ground to fight against Secco's Oasis, Giorno and Mista head upwards towards Cioccolata to stop the power of his Green Day. But Cioccolata has another dangerous trick up his sleeve, pushing the two into a corner.

episodes.name: Green Tea and Sanctuary (3)
episodes.overview: Bruno and Secco are both racing towards the man at the Colloseum whilst trying to kill each other.

episodes.name: His Name Is Diavolo
episodes.overview: Bruno unknowingly leads Doppio to the Colosseum while the rest of the gang is searching for their leader.

episodes.name: The Requiem Quietly Plays (1)
episodes.overview: Everyone wakes up from a deep sleep to discover their souls have been swapped.

episodes.name: The Requiem Quietly Plays (2)
episodes.overview: The gang desperately tries to reach the Stand arrow whilst looking for Diavolo.

episodes.name: Diavolo Surfaces
episodes.overview: Everyone continues to desperately chase after the Requiem in order to obtain the Stand arrow. Diavolo's soul is then forced to show itself, but he will not quit until he obtains the arrow for himself.

episodes.name: King of Kings
episodes.overview: The Stand arrow's rightful owner is finally revealed.

episodes.name: Golden Wind Requiem
episodes.overview: Giorno achieves his dream and destiny of becoming a Gang-star.

episodes.name: The Sleeping Slave
episodes.overview: In the past, Bruno and his team investigated the mysterious death of a girl and how it ties into the power known as Rolling Stones. And in the present, the final fate of Giorno and the gang is revealed as Golden Wind comes to a close.

seasons.name: STONE OCEAN
seasons.overview: The legacy of the Joestar family continues with Jolyne as she and her companions take on new Stand users behind the bars of Green Dolphin Street Prison.

episodes.name: Stone Ocean
episodes.overview: Jolyne Cujoh is framed for a crime and sent to prison. When she touches a pendant she received from her father, a mysterious power begins to awaken.

episodes.name: Prisoner FE40536: Jolyne Cujoh
episodes.overview: Jolyne begins her life in prison, but her erratic cellmate causes a major problem when she uses Jolyne's pendant to awaken her own Stand ability.

episodes.name: The Visitor (1)
episodes.overview: Jolyne encounters a strange boy who warns her not to meet with a future visitor. The next day, her father Jotaro Kujo comes to see her.

episodes.name: The Visitor (2)
episodes.overview: Jotaro tells Jolyne that Johngalli A., a former minion of DIO, is behind the recent events. Before she can react, Johngalli A.'s stand attacks them.

episodes.name: Prisoner of Love
episodes.overview: Jotaro and Jolyne awake from the dream that the enemy Stand had shown them. After they escape the visitation room, a new enemy creeps toward them.

episodes.name: Ermes's Stickers
episodes.overview: Jolyne decides to return to the prison to retrieve Jotaro's discs. An odd male prisoner appears before Ermes Costello, who has also awakened a Stand.

episodes.name: There's Six of Us!
episodes.overview: Hoping to locate Pale Snake's discs, Ermes and Jolyne join a search party for two missing inmates. During the search, Ermes notices something strange.

episodes.name: F.F.
episodes.overview: Ermes and Jolyne face off against the Stand that attacked the search party: F.F., a mass of plankton that has been granted intelligence by Pale Snake.

episodes.name: Debt Collector Mary Lynn Manson
episodes.overview: F.F. borrows the appearance of a dead inmate to be around Jolyne and Ermes. While they play catch one day, another inmate approaches them with a bet.

episodes.name: Operation Savage Guardian (Head to the Courtyard!) (1)
episodes.overview: Jolyne must quickly evade security and hand Jotaro's Stand disc over to the Speedwagon Foundation. Emporio appears and leads her to a mysterious room.

episodes.name: Operation Savage Guardian (Head to the Courtyard!) (2)
episodes.overview: Jolyne and Weather Forecast are attacked by a new enemy, Lang Rangler, whose Stand renders them weightless and creates a life-threatening vacuum.

episodes.name: Torrential Downpour Warning
episodes.overview: Before she can reach the courtyard, Jolyne encounters Father Pucchi, who she begs to let her proceed. He agrees, but has sent another pursuer ahead.

episodes.name: Smack of Love and Revenge (1)
episodes.overview: Realizing she hasn't seen Ermes for a few days, a curious Jolyne looks into her past and discovers that she came to the prison for a certain purpose.

episodes.name: Smack of Love and Revenge (2)
episodes.overview: F.F. and Jolyne try to assist Ermes in her fight against Sports Maximum, but they struggle against his Stand's ability to control the dead.

episodes.name: Ultra Security House Unit
episodes.overview: In a bid to find the bone, Jolyne intentionally gets sent to the Ultra Security House Unit. Hoping to save her, F.F. turns to Anastasia for help.

episodes.name: The Secret of Guard Westwood
episodes.overview: The Stand Survivor sparks brawls throughout the Disciplinary Wing. While fighting off a prison guard, Jolyne realizes that he is also a Stand User.

episodes.name: Enter the Drake's Dream
episodes.overview: A victorious Jolyne looks out over the remaining prisoners. An old man approaches her and reveals he is a Stand User who has been sent by Pale Snake.

episodes.name: Enter the F.F.
episodes.overview: Jolyne notices that F.F. is becoming dangerously dehydrated in the fight against Kenzou and pleads with Anastasia to step in and help, but he refuses.

episodes.name: Birth of the "Green"
episodes.overview: After Jolyne and her companions catch up to the man who has the bone, they notice strange plant growths emerging from the nearby fallen prisoners.

episodes.name: F.F. - The Witness
episodes.overview: In a boat piloted by the obedient YA-YA MA, Jolyne and Anastasia flee through the wetlands. However, YA-YA MA attacks them with an invisible ability.

episodes.name: AWAKEN
episodes.overview: After realizing the connection between Father Pucchi and Pale Snake, F.F. defeats D an' G. As YA-YA MA disintegrates, the egg it swallowed hatches.

episodes.name: Time for Heaven! New Moon! New Priest!
episodes.overview: Weather Forecast summons some rain, which saves F.F. from the brink of destruction. They reunite with Jolyne and Anastasia, but the group gets attacked.

episodes.name: Lock of the Jail!
episodes.overview: Jolyne resolves to escape Green Dolphin Island and put a stop to Father Pucchi's ambitions. A prison guard brings her a message from Pale Snake.

episodes.name: Jailbreak...
episodes.overview: Guided by the words on her hand, Jolyne fights her fading memories, evades the prison guards and reaches the hidden room — just as Mew Mew planned.

episodes.name: Bohemian Ecstatic (1)
episodes.overview: With just five days until the new moon, Father Pucchi heads north and tries to stay ahead of Jolyne, but he is held hostage outside a hospital.

episodes.name: Bohemian Ecstatic (2)
episodes.overview: Splitting up with Weather Forecast, Anastasia tries to recover his physical body after the enemy Stand Bohemian Ecstatic separates it from his soul.

episodes.name: Sky Guy
episodes.overview: As Jolyne and her companions head toward Cape Canaveral in Romeo's helicopter, they are struck by something that forces their eyelids to close.

episodes.name: Heaven Is at Hand: Three Days Until the New Moon
episodes.overview: Jolyne learns a shocking truth about Weather Forecast after her fight with Rikiel. She and Ermes enter the hospital and find a hole dug in the floor.

episodes.name: Netherworld
episodes.overview: Trapped by Versus's Stand in the memory of the crashed plane, Jolyne leaps from the aircraft and launches an attack, but it fails to affect Versus.

episodes.name: Heavy Forecast (1)
episodes.overview: With Weather Forecast's memories restored, his powerful ability Heavy Forecast triggers automatically, turning everyone affected by it into snails.

episodes.name: Heavy Forecast (2)
episodes.overview: Father Pucchi is born alongside his twin brother, who is switched with an ill-fated baby. As a young adult, he meets a strange man called DIO.

episodes.name: Heavy Forecast (3)
episodes.overview: Jolyne's group hurries to find Weather Forecast and stop his Stand. Meanwhile, Weather Forecast resolves to settle the score with Father Pucchi.

episodes.name: Gravity of the New Moon
episodes.overview: With Weather Forecast's Stand disc in hand, Jolyne and her allies head to Cape Canaveral in pursuit of Father Pucchi, whose body begins to change.

episodes.name: See Moon (1)
episodes.overview: Jolyne struggles against Father Pucchi's new Stand See Moon, a combination of Pale Snake and The Green Baby, which can invert anything it touches.

episodes.name: See Moon (2)
episodes.overview: Although See Moon has inverted Jolyne, Father Pucchi senses that she is still alive and pursues her in hopes of ending the Joestar bloodline for good.

episodes.name: Maiden Heaven (1)
episodes.overview: After shafts of bright light shine from Father Pucchi, Jolyne and her companions awake to find that he is gone and gravity has returned to normal.

episodes.name: Maiden Heaven (2)
episodes.overview: Father Pucchi's new Stand Maiden Heaven overwhelms Jolyne's group with its sheer speed. Anastasia acts as bait while Jotaro prepares to attack.

episodes.name: It's a Wonderful World
episodes.overview: The unstoppable acceleration of time brings the universe full circle. Emporio awakes in Green Dolphin Street Prison, and humanity enters a new world.

seasons.name: STEEL BALL RUN
seasons.overview: America, 1890. Johnny Joestar, a genius jockey now paralyzed from the waist down, chases after outlaw Gyro Zeppeli in a tough cross-continent horse race.

episodes.name: STEEL BALL RUN
episodes.overview: After a fateful encounter with outlaw Gyro Zeppeli, former racing prodigy Johnny Joestar enters the Steel Ball Run, the first horse race across America.

episodes.name: The Sheriff's Request to Mountain Tim
episodes.overview: After a shocking end to the 1st STAGE, abnormal murders unfold. Legendary cowboy Mountain Tim steps in to investigate as the tense 2nd STAGE begins.

episodes.name: The Desert-Born Outlaws
episodes.overview: At camp, Johnny catches a glimpse of Gyro's past. Then the Boomboom Family strikes with an otherworldly power. The duo escape — or so they think.

episodes.name: The Devil's Palm
episodes.overview: Caught in the Boombooms' trap, a magnetic force threatens to tear Johnny, Gyro and Mountain Tim apart. They learn about "Stands" and Johnny's body reacts.

episodes.name: The Terrorist from a Faraway Country
episodes.overview: At a checkpoint, Oye — a man who knows Gyro's past — confronts the duo. His power to turn anything he touches into a bomb leaves them with nowhere to run.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Deep within the Hidden Leaf Village, young ninja Naruto Uzumaki carries sealed inside him the Nine-Tailed Fox Spirit, which once almost destroyed the village. Always an outcast because of his secret, now Naruto battles alongside his teammates Sasuke and Sakur…

episodes.name: Enter: Naruto Uzumaki!
episodes.overview: Welcome to the Village Hidden in the Leaves, where deadly serious Ninja roam the landscape and the seriously mischievous Naruto Uzumaki causes trouble everywhere he goes. But when he steals the ancient scroll of sealing, he unleashes a rare power rarely seen…

episodes.name: My Name Is Konohamaru!
episodes.overview: Naruto finally graduates from the Ninja Academy and claims to know it all. Well, at least that what he tells Konohamaru, the Village elder's pint-size grandson. Much to the dismay of Ebisu, Konohamaru's teacher and mentor, Naruto teaches him the hormonally le…

episodes.name: Sasuke and Sakura: Friends or Foes?
episodes.overview: On the way to becoming a ninja, Naruto must team up with his classmates, the pretty Sakura and the pretty serious Sasuke...

episodes.name: Pass or Fail: Survival Test
episodes.overview: Now that Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura are a team, they meet with their sensei, the enigmatic and aloof Kakashi.

episodes.name: You Failed! Kakashi's Final Decision
episodes.overview: With the threat of failure hanging over their heads, Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura try everything they know to pass the grueling survival test.

episodes.name: A Dangerous Mission! Journey to the Land of Waves!
episodes.overview: Tired of doing lame missions, Naruto asks the Hokage to give them something challenging. The Hokage caves and gives them a C-rank mission. They will be bodyguards for a bridge builder. It appears to be a simple mission, until the group is attacked by somethin…

episodes.name: The Assassin of the Mist!
episodes.overview: Naruto and his squad arrive in the Land of the Waves and learn that an evil businessman named Gato has taken over the land.

episodes.name: The Oath of Pain
episodes.overview: With Kakashi captured, Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura must defend against Zabuza's attacks. Naruto realizes that working together with Sasuke may be the only way to save Kakashi. Will the combined effort of the two be enough to free Kakashi and defeat Zabuza?

episodes.name: Kakashi: Sharingan Warrior
episodes.overview: With Kakashi free, the fight between him and Zabuza resumes. Kakashi decides to show Zabuza what the Sharingan is really capable of. Can Kakashi's Sharingan defeat Zabuza? And who is the mysterious person watching the fight?

episodes.name: The Forest of Chakra
episodes.overview: With Zabuza gone things are now settling and Tazuna can go and build the bridge without fear. Or so everyone thinks. Kakashi believes something is wrong with Zabuza's death and teaches Naruto, Sakura, and Sasuke a way to train so they could better use their c…

episodes.name: The Land Where a Hero Once Lived
episodes.overview: While Naruto and Sasuke train, Sakura watches over Tazuna. During a nice dinner, Sakura notices a man's face torn from a picture. The man's name was Kaiza, and he was what the country called...a "hero". What happened to cause Inari so much pain?

episodes.name: Battle on the Bridge! Zabuza Returns!
episodes.overview: Naruto has a dangerous encounter with Haku in the forest, but is Haku there to cause trouble? Naruto and Sasuke better complete their training, as Zabuza is alive and has returned for round 2. Will Kakashi, Sasuke, and Sakura be able to defeat the Demon of th…

episodes.name: Haku's Secret Jutsu: Crystal Ice Mirrors
episodes.overview: Round two with Zabuza has started, but this time...Zabuza has Haku fighting along side him. Haku and Sasuke go at it with Sasuke falling behind until he manages to get a kick in. Meanwhile Naruto deals with some of Gato's henchmen. Back at the bridge Haku use…

episodes.name: The Number One Hyperactive, Knucklehead Ninja Joins the Fight!
episodes.overview: Naruto finally joins the battle on the bridge. But when Naruto stupidly gets caught in the middle of Haku's jutsu as well, he and Sasuke must work together to escape. Kakashi is unable to help them, as he must deal with Zabuza to protect Sakura and Tazuna. Ho…

episodes.name: Zero Visibility: The Sharingan Shatters
episodes.overview: Naruto and Sasuke continue to fight Haku and are getting beaten bad. After having Naruto try and escape a few times, Sasuke begins to see a pattern. Meanwhile, outside Kakashi and Zabuza begin their fight. Can Naruto and Sasuke escape from Haku's jutsu? What…

episodes.name: The Broken Seal
episodes.overview: Naruto and Sasuke continue their rigorous battle against Haku. When Haku targets a vulnerable Naruto, Sasuke risks everything to save him. Seeing his friend lie before him, a powerful force awakens inside Naruto. Has Kyubi been set free. If so, can anyone sto…

episodes.name: White Past: Hidden Ambition
episodes.overview: Naruto takes out his rage on Haku, who doesn't stand a chance. However, Naruto realises that Haku is the boy he met back at the forest. Haku tells Naruto the story of his past and asks for Naruto to do him one favour..... Will Naruto do the one thing he could…

episodes.name: The Weapons Known as Shinobi
episodes.overview: Kakashi prepares to stop Zabuza once and for all, but Haku has other plans. Zabuza's employer shows up and he's decided to take matters into his own hands...

episodes.name: The Demon in the Snow
episodes.overview: Thinking of Haku, Naruto angrily confronts Zabuza, but he learns that cruel reality is the fate of a ninja.

episodes.name: A New Chapter Begins: The Chunin Exam!
episodes.overview: Naruto and his team return to the Village Hidden in the Leaves after their battle in Land of Waves.

episodes.name: Identify Yourself: Powerful New Rivals
episodes.overview: After the three ninjas take their leave, Sasuke realizes he has a powerful rival out there. The next day, Kakashi announces that he has recommended all of them for the Chuunin Exams. While Naruto and Sasuke are pleased, Sakura is afraid of letting everyone do…

episodes.name: Chunin Challenge: Rock Lee vs. Sasuke!
episodes.overview: Rock Lee challenges Sasuke to a one-on-one fight. Naruto grows angry and attacks him, only to be beaten in one attack. Sasuke realizes the challenge and eagerly accepts. But will Sasuke be defeated just as easily by this mysterious ninja? Sasuke's only advant…

episodes.name: Genin Takedown! All Nine Rookies Face Off!
episodes.overview: A reunion of all the rookies isn't a very happy one, as all of them prepare to take the Chuunin Exam. With so many rivals around, Naruto's team will need help from a fellow ninja named Kabuto to know what they're up against. Will the group be able to last thr…

episodes.name: Start Your Engines: The Chunin Exam Begins!
episodes.overview: The first test of the Chuunin Exam is just that, a written test. When Ibiki issues a strict set of rules, Naruto fails to realize the true objective of the test. Can Naruto realize the truth before time runs out? And what about the tenth question?

episodes.name: The Tenth Question: All or Nothing!
episodes.overview: Ibiki declares what seems like a harsh and unreasonable rule for the hardest part of the first exam.

episodes.name: Special Report: Live from the Forest of Death!
episodes.overview: Konohamaru, the grandson of Leaf Village's Third Hokage, shows up at the Chunin Exam site. He comes along with Moegi and Udon to cover the events for the Ninja Academy's school newspaper. Konohamaru looks up to Naruto like an older brother and through intervi…

episodes.name: The Chunin Exam Stage 2: The Forest of Death
episodes.overview: The second exam is about to begin, and every ninja must sign a form so that their team can get either the Heaven or Earth Scroll. The goal is to get one of each scroll and make it to the tower in five days.

episodes.name: Eat or Be Eaten: Panic in the Forest
episodes.overview: To prevent further problems, Sasuke thinks up a password to determine friend from foe, but will it be that simple? Meanwhile Naruto has his hands full with a giant snake. Can he handle this on his own and what about Sasuke and Sakura, can they survive the ord…

episodes.name: Naruto's Counterattack: Never Give In!
episodes.overview: Sasuke is about to give up and give their scroll to the enemy, when Naruto stops him and accuses him of being a fake. Naruto then turns his attention to the Grass Ninja.... The battle is intense and when the Grass Ninja appears to get the upper hand, can Sasu…

episodes.name: The Sharingan Revived: Dragon-Flame Jutsu!
episodes.overview: Sasuke is still stuck in his trance and even Sakura's pleas can't get him back to normal. Meanwhile, Anko searches for the grass ninja fake. When the team appear to get the upper hand the question begs to be asked. Are the ninja truly defeated, or is there mo…

episodes.name: Bushy Brow's Pledge: Undying Love and Protection!
episodes.overview: Since Sakura was the only one who did not get injured in the previous battle she must watch over and protect her teammates. Unknown to her though, there are enemies watching from the trees.... They attack, but a friend arrives to help. Will it be enough?

episodes.name: Sakura Blossoms!
episodes.overview: Lee in his weakened state is having trouble defeating Dosu. Sakura realises everyone has been protecting her until now and that its her time to protect them! Can Sakura succeed where even Lee failed?

episodes.name: Battle Formation: Ino-Shika-Cho!
episodes.overview: With Sakura defeated and facing certain death, more reinforcements step into the fray. However, they sense an even bigger level of power, and its not coming from the sound trio! Meanwhile Sasuke wakes up with an ominous dark aura surrounding him and the myste…

episodes.name: Akamaru Trembles: Gaara's Cruel Strength!
episodes.overview: Kiba, Shino, and Hinata decide to try and eliminate their opponents by taking more scrolls. They arrive upon a battlefield where three Rain ninjas are battling Gaara, Kankuro, and Temari. They remain hidden and observe the battle, thinking one of the Rain nin…

episodes.name: The Scroll's Secret: No Peeking Allowed
episodes.overview: To heal their wounds, Naruto and his team take a much-needed rest after their battle against the Sound ninja. But it has already been four days since the start of the exam and there is only one day remaining until time expires.

episodes.name: Clone vs. Clone: Mine Are Better Than Yours!
episodes.overview: Naruto's team joins Kabuto on their journey to the tower, but on the way, they are trapped by the genjutsu (illusion technique) of the Hidden Rain Village's genin (low rank ninja), Oboro's team.

episodes.name: Surviving the Cut! The Rookie Nine Together Again!
episodes.overview: The exam is over, but did they truly pass? An old friend arrives to explain and show his concern. Meanwhile, Anko informs the ANBU about Orochimaru, the S-Class criminal who even they cannot stop. Later the Third Hokage explains to everyone what the third exa…

episodes.name: Narrowing the Field: Sudden Death Elimination!
episodes.overview: With so many participants still left, the groups are told that they will be pitted against each other in preliminary matches. Kabuto leaves, then Sasuke is told he has to fight. They know that Sasuke was given the cursed seal and if it takes over they will st…

episodes.name: Bushy Brow's Jealousy: Barrage of Lions Unleashed!
episodes.overview: The preliminaries of the third exam consist of one-on-one combat, and the first match is between Sasuke and Orochimaru's minion Yoroi.

episodes.name: Kakashi and Orochimaru: Face-to-Face!
episodes.overview: While Shino and Zaku finish their fight, Kakashi works on Sasuke's cursed seal. However, someone sinister shows up to ruin things, will Kakashi be able to protect Sasuke from this skilled foe?

episodes.name: Kunoichi Rumble: The Rivals Get Serious!
episodes.overview: Kankuro takes on Kabuto's teammate, Misumi, in a quick battle, proving how tough the Sand ninja really are. However, the real match comes when Sakura and Ino are pitted against one another!

episodes.name: The Ultimate Battle: Cha!
episodes.overview: Sakura and Ino prepare to settle the score once and for all! However, when Sakura becomes the victim of Ino's Mind-Body Switch Justu, will she be forced to give up the match?

episodes.name: Killer Kunoichi and a Shaky Shikamaru
episodes.overview: Temari of the Sand Village battles against Tenten from the Leaf Village. After the battle its Shikamaru's turn, but can he defeat an opponent who has already seen his moves once before?

episodes.name: Akamaru Unleashed! Who's Top Dog Now?
episodes.overview: The match between Kiba and Naruto kicks off, with Kiba immediately proving he has the upper hand in the battle. Everyone still believes Naruto is the weak ninja he's always been, everyone except for Hinata, Kakashi, and Sakura. Now it's Naruto's time to shine…

episodes.name: Surprise Attack! Naruto's Secret Weapon!
episodes.overview: The battle between Naruto and Kiba draws to a close, with each of them giving it everything they've got. After being tricked by Naruto, Kiba can no longer rely on Akamaru's help. Naruto decides now is the time to release his new jutsu, only Kiba won't give hi…

episodes.name: Byakugan Battle: Hinata Grows Bold!
episodes.overview: Kiba alerts Hinata, as he's being taken away, that there are only a few fighters left. He warns her that if she fights Gaara, she has to give up immediately or she could be killed. He also tells her to give up if paired against Neji, because Neji already has…

episodes.name: A Failure Stands Tall!
episodes.overview: Hinata will not give up so easily, especially with Naruto watching her. Will Hinata be willing to give up her own life in order to prove herself, or will the match be stopped before Neji can connect a killing move?

episodes.name: Gaara vs. Rock Lee: The Power of Youth Explodes!
episodes.overview: The second-to-last match finally arrives! Rock Lee must face down the mysterious and dangerous Gaara, a ninja who is said to have never been truly injured in a fight before.

episodes.name: Lee's Hidden Strength: Forbidden Secret Jutsu!
episodes.overview: As the battle between Lee and Gaara continues, Gai remembers how hard Lee used to train and how Lee has pretty much no ninjutsu or genjutsu skills. Lee is also a dropout, like Naruto. In order to defeat Gaara, Lee will have to use the move Gai forbade him to…

episodes.name: The Fifth Gate: A Splendid Ninja Is Born
episodes.overview: The match between Gaara and Lee draws to an end as Lee unleashes his ultimate move. But will even this be enough to defeat Gaara? Even if Lee does make it out in one piece, even more shocking news awaits him.

episodes.name: A Shadow in the Darkness: Danger Approaches Sasuke
episodes.overview: As Chouji faces off against Dosu, Orochimaru gives an order for Kabuto to abduct Sasuke. He also tells Kabuto that if he wants to stop him, he'll have to kill Sasuke. As Kabuto approaches Sasuke, he hesitates on what to do. His spy cover is soon blown though,…

episodes.name: Ebisu Returns: Naruto's Toughest Training Yet!
episodes.overview: Naruto wants Kakashi to train him, but Kakashi has other plans. Ebisu arrives to an unhappy Naruto and makes a deal with him. If Naruto can get away from Ebisu, he'll make Kakashi train him. Naruto decides to accept Ebisu's challenge, but can he win?

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Before the final round of the Chunin Exam, Naruto receives some special training from the legendary Toad Sage, Jiraiya. When the battles resume, Naruto is ready, but what about Sasuke? He's about to face the one ninja no one, not even Naruto thinks he can bea…

episodes.name: Long Time No See: Jiraiya Returns!
episodes.overview: While Ebisu trains Naruto at a hotspring, he spots someone trying to peep on the women bathing! Ebisu attacks, but it doesn't go quite as planned. Naruto then demands that the stranger become his teacher instead, but he's going to need some convincing. Does N…

episodes.name: The Summoning Jutsu: Wisdom of the Toad Sage!
episodes.overview: While Jiraiya attempts to teach Naruto the Summoning Jutsu, while doing research as well, Dosu learns the hard way why Gaara is so dangerous. Meanwhile, Baki and Kabuto secretly meet and reveal a sinister plot against Konoha. When Hayate discovers this dark s…

episodes.name: A Feeling of Yearning, a Flower Full of Hope
episodes.overview: Sakura goes to visit Sasuke and Lee in the hospital, along the way, she meets up with Ino and the two make the trip together. Lee tries to resume his training with limited success, making Sakura worry more about him and Sasuke.

episodes.name: Live or Die: Risk It All to Win It All!
episodes.overview: Since Naruto is having little to no success at summoning frogs, Jiraiya figures that if Naruto's to learn how summon Kyubi's chakra, he's going to need to be put into a life-threating situation. After having Naruto do a bunch of tasks, he throws Naruto off a…

episodes.name: He Flies! He Jumps! He Lurks! Chief Toad Appears!
episodes.overview: Overjoyed at his success, Naruto manages to enrage Gamabunta. With him not willing to accept that Naruto was able to summon him, Naruto challenges Gamabunta to accept him as his subordinate if he is able to stay on his back until sundown.

episodes.name: Hospital Besieged: The Evil Hand Revealed!
episodes.overview: Due to the events with Gamabunta, Naruto is now stuck in the hospital. Shikamaru unexpectedly pays him a visit, saying the two of them are the types who never get girls to visit them. Meanwhile, Gaara approaches an unconscious Rock Lee, with the full intentio…

episodes.name: The Final Rounds: Rush to the Battle Arena!
episodes.overview: Waking up late, Naruto hurries to the stadium where the Chuunin matches will be held, along the way he stops at his old training ground and meets up with Hinata. Naruto tells Hinata that he's afraid he'll lose, but with Hinata's encouragement and sort-of-conf…

episodes.name: Byakugan vs. Shadow Clone Jutsu!
episodes.overview: The opening ceremony to the Final Matches begins and Sasuke is missing, worrying Naruto. The ceremony ends and Naruto starts his fight with Neji. Will Naruto's confidence lead him to a victory or are Neji's skills to much for him? And where is Sasuke?

episodes.name: Ultimate Defense: Zero Blind Spot!
episodes.overview: Naruto begins his assault with his Shadow Clones but Neji analyses Naruto's actions and determines what he believes to be the real one. Unable to figure out why Naruto won't admit defeat, he takes off his headband and reveals a mysterious mark on his forehead…

episodes.name: A Failure's True Power
episodes.overview: When it looks as if Naruto can't win, Neji continues to tell him that he cannot change his fate and that he has no idea what it feels like to carry a seal that cannot be removed. Naruto thinks back about his childhood and how he was treated because of the Nin…

episodes.name: Hit It or Quit It: The Final Rounds Get Complicated!
episodes.overview: With Sasuke still absent, and everyone anxiously anticipating his match against Gaara, the tournament is forced to move on to the next round. Meanwhile, Neji learns the shocking truth about his father.

episodes.name: Zero Motivation: The Guy with Cloud Envy!
episodes.overview: Shikamaru takes on Temari, only he doesn't want to fight. Can the lazy Shikamaru even last the round? Or is there more to Shikamaru than meets the eye?

episodes.name: Dancing Leaf, Squirming Sand
episodes.overview: It's time for Sasuke's match against Gaara, only Sasuke has yet to show up. Normally they'd disqualify him, but everyone's anxiously awaiting the match. Therefore, they give Sasuke a time limit before disqualifying him. As time slowly begins to run out, only…

episodes.name: Bushy Brow's Jutsu: Sasuke Style!
episodes.overview: Sasuke's match against Gaara finally begins! Gaara seems to have the upper hand at the beginning, until Sasuke shows off his newly found taijutsu techniques. Gaara is reliving the battle against Rock Lee all over again, only this time he's facing an opponent…

episodes.name: Late for the Show, But Ready to Go! The Ultimate Secret Technique is Born!
episodes.overview: With Gaara's ultimate defense in place, Sasuke's only hope of winning lies within the move Kakashi taught him...Chidori. But, how will Gaara react when Sasuke causes him to bleed?

episodes.name: Zero Hour! The Destruction of the Hidden Leaf Village Begins!
episodes.overview: Sasuke's match is interrupted when Orochimaru puts his plan into action. Temari and Kankuro are ordered to get Gaara to safety until he recovers, leaving Sasuke to chase after them. War has begun!

episodes.name: Village in Distress: A New A-Ranked Mission!
episodes.overview: Knowing that Sasuke is in over his head, Kakashi sends Naruto, Sakura, and Shikamaru, being guided by a dog named Pakkun, to stop Sasuke from pursuing Gaara.

episodes.name: A Shirker's Call to Action: Layabout No More!
episodes.overview: Naruto, Sakura, Shikamaru, and Pakkun are being chased down by several Sound ninja. Shikamaru decides to stop and try to hold them off so the others can catch up to Sasuke without fear of pursuit. Shikamaru is the logical choice because of his Shadow Possessi…

episodes.name: An Unrivaled Match: Hokage Battle Royale!
episodes.overview: The battle of kings has begun as Orochimaru has summoned some unexpected help. How can the Third Hokage handle this uncomfortable situation? Meanwhile, Sasuke finally catches up with Kakurou, Gaara and Temari...

episodes.name: A Mistake from the Past: A Face Revealed!
episodes.overview: While Naruto and Sakura continue to catch up to Sasuke, Temari trys to stall Sasuke long enough for Kankuro to get Gaara to safety, but Sasuke doesn't have time to waste on her! Meanwhile, The Third Hokage continues his battle with Orochimaru and is ready to…

episodes.name: Forbidden Secret Technique: Reaper Death Seal!
episodes.overview: An unlikely ally appears to help Sasuke and allows him to continue to pursue Gaara. Meanwhile, the Hokage prepares to make the ultimate sacrifice to rid his village of Orochimaru!

episodes.name: Astonishing Truth! Gaara's Identity Emerges!
episodes.overview: While Shino and Kankuro fight the match they should've fought back during the Chuunin Exam, Naruto, Sakura, and Pakkun slowly catch up to Sasuke. Meanwhile, Sasuke has finally caught up with Gaara and Temari, but is he ready to face true horror when Gaara rev…

episodes.name: Sasuke's Decision: Pushed to the Edge!
episodes.overview: Sasuke struggles to keep up with Gaara's monstrous capacity. Only able to use Chidori twice in normal circumstances, Sasuke remembers that tragic day when his family died and realises he must risk the use of Chidori beyond his limit if he is to defeat Gaara.…

episodes.name: Assassin of the Moonlit Night
episodes.overview: As Sasuke is about to be defeated, Naruto and Sakura show up to save him. With this Gaara begins to have flashbacks of his childhood. What happened in Gaara's past to make him experience so much suffering?

episodes.name: Light vs. Dark: The Two Faces of Gaara
episodes.overview: Gaara continues to talk about his past. When Gaara states that Naruto can't become stronger when he fights for everyone else, Naruto recalls that if he didn't meet his friends, he would be the same as Gaara. Realizing that he has to protect his friends, Narut…

episodes.name: Naruto's Ninja Handbook
episodes.overview: Naruto and Gaara continue their fight. Naruto begins to get an advantage, and Gaara transforms into the final form of Shukaku of the Sand. As he begins to put the squeeze on Naruto, Naruto summons Gamabunta Oyabun, and his comeback begins. Once again, Naruto…

episodes.name: Beyond the Limit of Darkness and Light
episodes.overview: Transformed into Kyubi, Naruto and Gamabunta prepare to stop Shukaku by waking Gaara up. Though they succeed, the battle is far from over as Gaara won't stop until Naruto is dead. Naruto and Gaara prepare for their final attacks. Meanwhile, Sarutobi continues…

episodes.name: The Third Hokage, Forever...
episodes.overview: As the war draws to a close, Gaara admits his defeat to Naruto, and Orochimaru is forced to retreat as Sarutobi took away his arms. Now, all of the Konoha shinobi gather together to pay their respects to the person whom they respected the most...Sarutobi, the…

episodes.name: Return of the Morning Mist
episodes.overview: Two mysterious ninja infiltrate Konoha, and one of them bares the Sharingan. Just what are these two after? Why has Itachi Uchiha returned to Konoha?

episodes.name: Eye to Eye: Sharingan vs. Sharingan!
episodes.overview: Kakashi takes on Itachi, with both of them using the Sharingan. However, Kakashi soon realizes that he stands no chance against the legendary ninja. Itachi reveals that he has not come for his little brother, but instead he's come to do something else...abduc…

episodes.name: Jiraiya: Naruto's Potential Disaster!
episodes.overview: Jiraiya and Naruto begin their search for Tsunade, but are constantly sidetracked by Jiraiya's peeping and hitting on pretty girls. Jiraiya tells Naruto some stories about the 3rd and 4th Hokages. Meanwhile, Sasuke learns that his brother, Itachi, is after Na…

episodes.name: Roar, Chidori! Brother vs. Brother!
episodes.overview: Sasuke remembers the day that Itachi single-handedly wiped out the entire Uchiha clan as he desperately searches for Naruto. However, Itachi and Kisame have already found him.

episodes.name: Hate Among the Uchihas: The Last of the Clan
episodes.overview: Jiraiya and Naruto look on as Sasuke takes on Itachi alone. However, when the young ninja is severely outclassed, Jiraiya is forced to step in. Itachi and Kisame try to flee, but Jiraiya isn't about to let them get away so easily.

episodes.name: A New Training Begins: I Will Be Strong
episodes.overview: Now that Sasuke is in safe hands, Naruto and Jiraiya can continue their search for Tsunade. When they arrive at a city with a festival on the way, Jiraiya and Naruto have some fun, at least until Naruto puts a stain on a man's shirt. Jiraiya uses a new techni…

episodes.name: Keep on Training: Pop Goes the Water Balloon!
episodes.overview: Jiraiya gives Naruto the task of rotating the water in a balloon until it pops. Naruto is confident that he will accomplish this stage of the training by night, but soon learns it's not as easy as expected.

episodes.name: Focal Point: The Mark of the Leaf
episodes.overview: After passing stage one of the training, Naruto moves into stage two: power training. Jiraiya realizes that, like him, Naruto has a hard time concentrating, so he paints a spiral in the palm of Naruto's hand to help him to focus. With the aid of the spiral an…

episodes.name: An Impossible Choice: The Pain Within Tsunade's Heart
episodes.overview: Naruto continues his training of the Rasengan, having mastered the stages of spin and power. The final stage proves to be the most difficult: control. Meanwhile, Orochimaru and Kabuto accost Tsunade and ask her to restore Orochimaru's arms. If she restores Or…

episodes.name: Unforgivable! A Total Lack of Respect!
episodes.overview: Jiraiya and Naruto catch up to Tsunade, whereupon she learns that Konoha wants her to be the 5th Hokage. She refuses the title, angering Naruto, who mistakes her for being a weakling. Naruto learns first-hand how strong she really is. Naruto decides now is th…

episodes.name: Inheritance! The Necklace of Death!
episodes.overview: Naruto makes a bet with Tsunade, that if he can master the Rasengan in one week, she'll give him a necklace belonging the to the First Hokage. However, Shizune reveals some startling information. Everybody, except for Tsunade, who's worn that necklace has die…

episodes.name: A Dubious Offer! Tsunade's Choice!
episodes.overview: While Naruto continues to try and master the third step, Tsunade continues to think about Orochimaru's offer. Jiraiya tries to convince her by taking her out for a drink, only she slipped a paralyzing potion into his drink while he wasn't looking. Will Tsunad…

episodes.name: Breakdown! The Deal is Off!
episodes.overview: Because Orochimaru lied to her about not attacking Konoha, Tsunade begins her onslaught against him and Kabuto. Kabuto eats a food pill and begins to attack Tsunade with his medical techniques but are they enough to defeat her? Will Jiraiya, Shizune and Narut…

episodes.name: Attack! Fury of the Rasengan!
episodes.overview: With Tsunade still paralized with fear and Naruto being a low level ninja, it is up to Shizune and Jiraiya to defeat Kabuto and Orochimaru. Orochimaru and Kabuto summon two giant snakes while Jiraiya summons Gamakichi, who does nothing. Naruto tries to help J…

episodes.name: The Fifth Hokage! A Life on the Line!
episodes.overview: Naruto finally lands a Rasengan into Kabuto's stomach, but not before Kabuto assures Naruto's certain death. Can Tsunade save him and protect him from Orochimaru?

episodes.name: Deadlock! Sannin Showdown!
episodes.overview: With Tsunade in her current conidtion, and Jiraiya still under the effects of the drug, Tsunade and Jiraiya must work together to defeat Orochimaru. And with all three ninja having summoned their signature beasts, it's sure to be one heck of a battle!

episodes.name: Kidnapped! Naruto's Hot Spring Adventure!
episodes.overview: The group are on their way back to Konoha when they stop at a town with hotsprings. Unknown to them they are being watched by men looking for Tsunade. Naruto's room gets raided and the necklace he was given goes missing with nothing but a ransom note left beh…

episodes.name: Tsunade's Warning: Ninja No More!
episodes.overview: Naruto, Tsunade, and Shizune finally return to Konoha so Tsunade can take over and become Hokage. Konohamaru finds out that Tsunade is the Fifth but refuses to believe it. Naruto then takes Tsunade to the hospital so she can heal Sasuke, Kakashi, and Lee. She…

episodes.name: The Will of Fire Still Burns!
episodes.overview: Konohamaru locks himself in the office used by the 3rd to stop them from replacing his grandfather, the previous Hokage. Tsunade spends the day locked out of her office and researches a way to heal Rock Lee so he has a better chance of surviving the operation,

episodes.name: Sensei and Student: The Bond of a Shinobi!
episodes.overview: As Lee decides whether or not to go through with the operation, Gai decides to give him some motivation. Meanwhile, Tsunade frantically struggles to increase the operation's success rate.

episodes.name: Gotta See! Gotta Know! Kakashi-Sensei's True Face!
episodes.overview: After their mission, Naruto persuades Sakura and Sasuke to help him unmask their sensei, Kakashi. However, Squad 7 soon finds out that this is easier said than done...

episodes.name: Mission: Help an Old Friend in the Land of Tea
episodes.overview: Naruto, Sakura and Sasuke find out their newest mission will be without Kakashi who has responsibilities elsewhere. Tsunade sends them to the Tea Country to protect someone, but the details are vague at best. Along the way they meet Idate Morino who causes th…

episodes.name: The Race is On! Trouble on the High Seas!
episodes.overview: The trio continue to follow Idate while fending off attacks by three Shinobi sent to kill him. They find out later just how important winning this race is to the Wasabi clan's future...

episodes.name: Run Idate, Run! Nagi Island Awaits!
episodes.overview: While the Shinobi that is working for Wasarabi begins to beat up Idate, Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura finally reach the same island. However, some old enemies appear to get in their way once again! Will they manage to find Idate and rescue him before its too late?

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Naruto returns from his training journey eager to see his friend Sasuke. But Sasuke has only one thing on his mind: his quest for revenge against his older brother. His unquenchable thirst for power knows no bounds, and soon he is lured from the Leaf Village…

episodes.name: A Fierce Battle of Rolling Thunder!
episodes.overview: With Naruto's help, Idate reaches the Modoroki Shrine... But just as he's about to cross the bridge, an old nemesis stands in his way.

episodes.name: The Last Leg: A Final Act of Desperation
episodes.overview: Now that Sasuke and Sakura are trapped at the bottom of a cliff, it's up the Number One Knucklehead Ninja to defeat the malevolent Aoi and help Idate cross the finish line.

episodes.name: The Battle Begins: Naruto vs. Sasuke
episodes.overview: Hospital bound and feeling his pride shattered, Sasuke finds there is only way to redeem himself: Battle Naruto! Meanwhile, the Ino-Shika-Cho Squad sit down for some barbeque to celebrate a special occasion!

episodes.name: Bitter Rivals and Broken Bonds
episodes.overview: As their rivalry reaches a fever pitch, Kakashi-sensei breaks up the battle and sends Naruto and Sasuke to their corners. Meanwhile, Four Sound ninja enter the Hidden Leaf Village with only one thing on their mind... Sasuke!

episodes.name: An Invitation from the Sound
episodes.overview: Sasuke takes on all four Sound Ninja, but soon learns it's going to take more than Chidori to defeat them!

episodes.name: Formation! The Sasuke Retrieval Squad
episodes.overview: Now that word of Sasuke's departure has spread to the Fifth Hokage, she calls upon the newest Chunin, Shikamaru, to put together a squad to bring Sasuke back to the village.

episodes.name: Sound vs. Leaf
episodes.overview: The Sound Ninja have Sasuke in their clutches and it's up to the Hidden Leaf Village's top Shinobi to stop them.

episodes.name: Squad Mutiny: Everything Falls Apart!
episodes.overview: As Shikamaru and the rest of the squad move in, Jirobo, one of the Sound Ninja, traps them within an Earth Dome Prison and sucks up their chakra!

episodes.name: Full Throttle Power! Choji, Ablaze!
episodes.overview: Upon breaking free from the Earth Dome Prison, The Sasuke Retrieval Squad realize they don't have enough chakra to take on Jirobo... but Choji's got another idea up his sleeve.

episodes.name: Good-bye Old Friend...! I'll Always Believe in You!
episodes.overview: With his life on the line against the Sound Ninja Jirobo, Choji looks back on the seeds of his friendship with Shikamaru. Can he defeat his fearsome opponent without any Chakra?

episodes.name: Your Opponent Is Me!
episodes.overview: Hot on Sasuke's trail, Shikamaru and his squad get caught up in a web of unparalled chakra when they tangle with the six-armed Kidomaru!

episodes.name: 360 Degrees of Vision: The Byakugan's Blind Spot
episodes.overview: While Naruto and the others go after Sasuke and the other Sound Ninja, Neji is locked in a desperate no-holds-barred battle with Kidomaru.

episodes.name: Losing is Not an Option!
episodes.overview: Neji's on the run from Kidomaru's bow and arrow attacks. Will Neji make it out alive or will his new-found enemy hit his blindspot dead on?

episodes.name: The Vessel Arrives Too Late
episodes.overview: In pursuit of the Sound Ninja, Naruto, Kiba and Shikamaru strike at dawn to retrieve Sasuke and bring him back to the Hidden Leaf Village.

episodes.name: Miscalculation: A New Enemy Appears!
episodes.overview: Naruto, Kiba and Shikamaru intercept Sasuke from the Sound Ninja Four, but little do they know that another ninja from the Sound Village has been dispatched to grab Sasuke as well.

episodes.name: Roar and Howl! The Ultimate Tag-Team!
episodes.overview: Faced against the vicious twin duo of Sakon and Ukon, Kiba and Akamaru team up to take them out, using their most powerful jutsu.

episodes.name: To Each His Own Battle
episodes.overview: With the Sasuke retrieval squad now split into individual battles, it's up to Naruto, Kiba and Shikamaru to stop the sound ninja. But little do they realize that there's more to their opponents than their basic techniques.

episodes.name: Fakeout: Shikamaru's Comeback!
episodes.overview: Shikamaru's got his hands full with Tayuya and her melodic attacks. Can he stop her and put an end to her malevolent flute playing?

episodes.name: The Leaf's Handsome Devil!
episodes.overview: Naruto's Shadow Clones are no match for Kimimaro's attacks. But when an old bushy-browed buddy from the Leaf Village shows up, all bets are off!

episodes.name: The Beast Within
episodes.overview: Rock Lee's back and he's full of a special medicine that has Kimimaro on the run! Can he take out the fifth Sound Ninja?

episodes.name: The Sand Shinobi: Allies of the Leaf
episodes.overview: Down for the count and at the mercy of the Sound Ninja, Kiba, Shikamaru and Rock Lee get help from an unlikely bunch of new allies.

episodes.name: Showdown: Gaara vs. Kimimaro
episodes.overview: Itching to fight and with a sense of guilt from the past, Gaara tells Rock Lee to stand down and let him take on Kimimaro. Meanwhile, Naruto continues on his quest to catch the runaway Sasuke.

episodes.name: Vengeful Strike! The Bracken Dance!
episodes.overview: As Gaara demonstrates he has more than enough backbone to take on Kimimaro, Orochimaru recollects on how he brought him as a young man into the Sound Village.

episodes.name: A Cry on Deaf Ears
episodes.overview: Finally catching up to Sasuke, Naruto does all he can to keep him from going to Orochimaru. Does he have enough strength to stop him or is Sasuke gone for good?

episodes.name: Brothers: Distance Among the Uchihas
episodes.overview: Naruto and Sasuke face off in battle as we get a glimpse into Sasuke's past where his achievements were ignored by his father and his brother Itachi's behavior began to take a turn for the worst.

episodes.name: Father and Son, the Broken Crest
episodes.overview: As Sasuke squares off against Naruto, he reflects on his past when he was neglected by both his stern father and Itachi, his brooding older brother.

episodes.name: The Secrets of the Mangekyo Sharingan!
episodes.overview: While Naruto is busy underwater, Sasuke remembers the fateful day in which his clan was killed. He remembers why Itachi spared his life, and why Itachi did what what he did. Now, in order to gain the same power as his brother, he must kill his closest friend.…

episodes.name: For a Friend
episodes.overview: Kakashi learns the truth about the chase after Sasuke, and orders his dogs, including Pakkun, to go find Naruto and Sasuke. However, things are looking grim as the clash between the Chidori and the Rasengan ensues. The attacks are even, causing Naruto and Sas…

episodes.name: A Plea from a Friend
episodes.overview: Naruto proves to be too much for Sasuke to handle as Naruto fights back with renewed vigour. Finally acknowledging Naruto's strength, Sasuke puts on his forehead protector, symbolizing both as equals. But when Sasuke's Sharingan is upgraded to level 3, the ta…

episodes.name: The End of Tears
episodes.overview: The battle between Naruto and Sasuke comes to a close, as One-Tailed Naruto takes on Cursed Seal Level 2 Sasuke in one final Rasengan vs. Chidori clash! And this time...only one person will emerge victorious. Will Kakashi and Pakkun make it in time? And who i…

episodes.name: The Promise That Could Not Be Kept
episodes.overview: Shikamaru's group is brought back to Konoha with many injuries. Neji and Chouji could possibly die, Kiba has a deep wound but nothing too serious, and Naruto and Shimakamru have a few injuries. When Sakura finds out they are back ,she goes immediatley to see…

episodes.name: Deep Cover?! A Super S-Ranked Mission!
episodes.overview: Jiraiya begins to worry about Naruto and Sakura's wellbeing. He then requests that Tsunade send them on a mission with him. He finds Naruto telling Sakura he is not going to stop her from going after Sasuke, but he is going with her, and tells them about the…

episodes.name: A Town of Outlaws, The Shadow of the Fuma Clan
episodes.overview: Naruto, Sakura and Jiraiya end up in a town that is even worse than the one they were chased out of. Jiraiya heads off and leaves Naruto and Sakura to get some food. Along the way they find the ninja that attacked them before, but things are not as clearcut a…

episodes.name: Pure Betrayal, and a Fleeting Plea!
episodes.overview: When Sasame drugs the gang, she prepares to hand them over to Orochimaru. But, when she discovers that they are to be killed, she has a change of heart...

episodes.name: Pure Terror! The House of Orochimaru
episodes.overview: Sasame leads Naruto, Jiraiya, and Sakura to Orochimaru's hideout. They send Sasame back to the village because of the danger level. Jiraiya summons Gamakichi to go in first and investigate. The four come to three tunnels. Jiraiya goes off to the right, Naruto…

episodes.name: Two Heartbeats: Kabuto's Trap
episodes.overview: Naruto arrives in the nick of time to save Sakura, but not before Kabuto tells her that Sasuke is dead! Naruto attacks but ends up tangled in a deadly trap of Kabuto's. Is it all over for our hero and will they find Arashi?

episodes.name: Sakura's Determination
episodes.overview: The battle between Naruto and Arashi continues, but Naruto's injury is making it difficult for him to succeed. Sasame jumps in to try to save Naruto but will it be enough?

episodes.name: The Three Villains from the Maximum Security Prison
episodes.overview: With the events of the Rice Field Country behind them, everyone prepares for their training. But a new threat soon arises. Remember Mizuki? He's back and he's planning to break out of Konoha's Correctional

episodes.name: Tonton! I'm Counting on You!
episodes.overview: Shizune and her team encounter Mizuki, but it doesn't go as planned! When Ton-ton comes back to warn Tsunade, Naruto takes the initiative to find Shizune with Ton-ton's help. Kakashi arrives and lends Pakkun's assistance to Iruka before departing on a mission…

episodes.name: A New Squad! Two People and a Dog?!
episodes.overview: Naruto is having trouble with the two brothers and Iruka is having his share of difficulties with Mizuki! Iruka struggles to try and get the old Mizuki back but he doesn't have much success.... Meanwhile, when things are looking bleak for Naruto, can 3 friend…

episodes.name: A New Formation: Ino-Shika-Cho!
episodes.overview: Naruto's backup has arrived and they are Shikamaru, Ino, and Chouji. They tell Naruto that they will take care of the brothers. Naruto leaves to catch up to Iruka, who is fighting Mizuki. Can Naruto arrive before Mizuki kills Iruka? And can Shikamaru, Ino, an…

episodes.name: Orochimaru's Shadow
episodes.overview: Naruto, Iruka and Pakkun meet up with Mizuki's fiancee Tsubaki and she has come to offer help to the three. Meanwhile, Shikamaru, Ino and Chouji are having trouble holding the two brothers at bay. While this is going on, Tsunade discovers a startling secret a…

episodes.name: A Clash of Fate: You Can't Bring Me Down!
episodes.overview: Mizuki is determined to make Naruto and Iruka suffer and it appears that he has the upper edge with his improved strength and speed! Shikamaru, Ino and Chouji are also at their limits and now Fuujin and Raijin are free. Can Tsunade arrive in time to help?

episodes.name: Search for the Rare Bikochu Beetle
episodes.overview: Naruto is unable to search for Sasuke due to Tsunade's orders, while Kiba and Hinata wonder how they can help him out. Shino remembers a special type of bug that if it is found, could easily track Sasuke down. they go and discuss it with Tsunade, who agrees t…

episodes.name: What's the Difference? Don't All Insects Look Alike?
episodes.overview: The group struggles to find a Bikouchuu, but seem to fail at every turn. When it starts to rain they realise they only have one more chance to find it, will Hinata's Byakugan be enough?

episodes.name: A Battle of Bugs: The Deceivers and the Deceived
episodes.overview: With Hinata's safety in danger, the group must try and figure out a way to save her and protect the Bikouchuu at the same time. Every time one side seems to have an edge though, the other reveals yet a new trick. As dawn approaches, they don't have long left.…

episodes.name: Blaze Away, Byakugan! This is My Ninja Way!
episodes.overview: With the group trapped, Shino makes a deal to trade the Bikouchuu for Hinata. Unfortunately for the opponents, Hinata got away, making the deal worthless! They begin to attack but can Hinata show up to save the day?

episodes.name: Funeral March for the Living
episodes.overview: When Naruto rescues three strangers he finds himself dragged into yet another mission. However, this time he doesn't want to partake in it! That is until he hears that there might be a connection to Akatsuki. With Neji, Lee and Tenten as his teammates, will h…

episodes.name: A Lesson Learned: The Iron Fist of Love!
episodes.overview: Out to try and save Rourusuke, Naruto and the others ambush members of the Kurosuke Family and save an old man. They soon hear the funeral bell and go and save Rourusuke. However, Rock lee meets an old friend among the group, and Lee must now convince Kurashi…

episodes.name: The Enemy of the Byakugan
episodes.overview: Naruto, Tenten, Neji and Lee continue their mission to stop Raiga and save the Rourusuke Family. They try to work out a plan but the thick fog makes it difficult for them to see. Even Neji's Byakugan doesn't seem to help. Lee fights Raiga and manages to knock…

episodes.name: The Dark Creeping Clouds
episodes.overview: With Raiga seemingly defeated, the group can get on with clearing up the remaining enemy Ninja and returning the village to normal. However, what will they do with Ranmaru who tells them about his tragic past?

episodes.name: Raiga's Counterattack
episodes.overview: Ranmaru is determined to bring Raiga back from the dead and appears to suceed! An enraged raiga now goes on the offensive, starting with Tenten. Karashi runs back to the Curry House to tell the others what has happened, but who's side is he really on?

episodes.name: Run! The Curry of Life

episodes.overview: Leorio's confrontation with Ging earns him the respect of his fellow Hunters and make him one of the frontrunners for the election. Meanwhile, Illumi begins an attack on Killua as part of his plan to kill Alluka, assisted by Hisoka, who has other plans for he…

episodes.name: Needles x And x Debt
episodes.overview: Gotoh is killed by Hisoka, while the other butlers keep following Killua until he manages to shake them off. Meanwhile, Illumi uses his needles to take control of several people to assist on his plans and when news of it come to the Association, a team of Hun…

episodes.name: Sin x And x Claw
episodes.overview: The election proceeds without a winner determined yet, and Killua is cornered by Illumi, who demands him to reveal which secrets he is hiding regarding Alluka's powers. Meanwhile, Hisoka keeps murdering other hunters just to amuse himself.

episodes.name: Approval x And x Coalition
episodes.overview: With only four candidates left, the election draws to its conclusion and has an unexpected turn when Leorio receives the support from two of the other remaining contestants, who are eager to prevent Pariston from winning. Meanwhile, Killua and Alluka finally…

episodes.name: Defeat x And x Reunion
episodes.overview: Leorio is about to win the election, but loses all motivation to continue after a fully healed Gon appears before him, thanks to the power of Alluka, opening the way to Pariston's victory. Surrounded by his friends and the other hunters who celebrate his reco…

episodes.name: Chairman x And x Release
episodes.overview: Gon apologizes to Ging for failing to save Kite and his father instructs him to apologize to Kite himself instead, affirming that he will wait for him to return. Meanwhile, Pariston wins the election, but renounces in favor of fellow Zodiac Cheadle and Killua…

episodes.name: Salvation x And x Future
episodes.overview: Gon apologizes to Kite for not being strong enough to save him. Kite tells him they'll always be friends and that he should go get to know his dad. Gon returns to the Election Hall only to find a note that Ging has gone to the World Tree. Gon, Killua, and All…

episodes.name: Past x And x Future
episodes.overview: Gon climbs to the top of the World Tree where Ging is expecting him, and the two finally have a heart to heart. In this occasion, Ging reveals his intentions to explore the world beyond the current boundaries known to mankind and Gon tells him of all his adve…

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Abandoned by his mother as a child and raised by the Park family, Oh Soo is a notorious gambler in the neighborhood of Cheongdam. After the death of his first love, he is left heartbroken and cold, not caring about anybody else. Soo is then thrown into prison…

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: When Oh Young, the millionaire heiress of the PL Group, receives a letter from her long-lost brother Oh Soo, she ventures out to find him in spite of her visual disability.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: When Soo is mistaken to be Young's brother, he quickly begins a long con in order to win her trust... and eventually her money.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Young's fiancé, Lee Myeongho, is suspicious of Soo and runs a DNA test to prove that he is not Young's actual brother.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Soo helps Young to rejoin the outside world and confront the people she fears.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Soo and Young's trip to the beach ends abruptly when Soo forgets that it's the anniversary of Moon Heejoo's death.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Just as Soo acknowledges his feelings for Young, she takes steps towards marrying Myeongho.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Secretary Wang Hyeji and Soo are determined to discover each other's true motives towards Young.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Young asks Soo to escort her at PL Group's anniversary party, but problems arise when Jin Sora returns.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: After a particularly painful spell, Young becomes increasingly suspicious of Soo's true motives and identity.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Though Young's brain tumor has relapsed, she refuses to have surgery even though Soo and Secretary Wang demand it.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: After Soo desperately pleads with him, Jo Moocheol finally agrees to ask his sister, the country's top neurosurgeon, to look at Young.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Soo convinces Young to go through with a high-risk surgery and contemplates telling her the truth.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Although Young discovers the truth about Soo, she contemplates going along with his ruse regardless.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Soo spends his last day with Young.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: The date for Young's surgery approaches, and she starts cutting people off from her life.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Forgiveness is not easy, but Young does promise to see Soo again after her surgery - which occurs during his pivotal game against Boss Kim.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Kim Tan is the heir to Empire Group who has been sent to study abroad in the U.S. In reality it's a form of exile, as his elder half-brother back home schemes to take over the family business. While in the States, Tan meets Cha Eun-sang, who arrived from Kore…

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Choe Yeong-do and his father meet with Yu Rachel and her mother, but it doesn't go well. Cha Eun-sang is stunned by news about her sister in America.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: With nowhere to go, Eun-sang accepts Tan's offer to stay at his palatial beachfront house, where Rachel shows up announcing herself as Tan's fiancée.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: After getting a call from Seoul, Tan goes to meet his brother Won, who's not happy to see him. Tan and Eun-sang get stranded in the middle of nowhere.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Eun-sang and Rachel end up on the same flight back to Seoul. Irritated at finding Yeong-do waiting for her, Rachel provokes him by talking about Tan.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Tan is shocked to see Eun-sang again -- and living at his house. Tan is dismayed by news that Won has moved out. His father's latest order upsets Won.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Tan and Yeong-do have a tense reunion. Viewing Tan's aloofness as a personal affront, Rachel is furious about Eun-sang enrolling at their school.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Yeong-do tries to bait Tan, but he refuses to bite. Tan's mother asks Eun-sang to keep an eye on Tan but makes sure that Eun-sang knows her place.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Eun-sang is distressed that Tan keeps telling her what to do and can't fathom what he wants. Won sees Hyeon-ju getting out of someone else's car.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Eun-sang receives help from someone unexpected. The tension brewing between Tan and Yeong-do turns explosive, but Rachel takes it out on Eun-sang.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Tan apologizes to Yeong-do's father, but this makes Yeong-do's situation worse. Tan warns Yeong-do and wants to keep their families out of their fight.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Tan demands to know what Eun-sang is doing with Yeong-do, but she wants them to stop putting her in the middle of their feud. Eun-sang faces Yeong-do.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Tan hears the truth from Yeong-do. Yeong-do tries to comfort Eun-sang. The other students start to suspect that Yeong-do's feelings may be sincere.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Rachel and her mother are livid about what they learn. Yeong-do makes an unexpected move. Tan and Eun-sang spend the night at a friend's place.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Tan comes to blows with Yeong-do -- and Eun-sang is caught in the middle again. Eun-sang is forced to rummage through the trash because of Rachel.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Yeong-do has stern words for Rachel. Won and Yeong-do's father are called to school and told that Tan is ranked in 100th place and Yeong-do 98th.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Tan's father meets Eun-sang. Having witnessed the fierce battles over his grandfather's legacy, Won doesn't see the point of trying to understand Tan.

episodes.name: Episode 17
episodes.overview: Tan goes to his father demanding to know what happened to Eun-sang. Yeong-do is overwhelmed and relieved to see that Eun-sang is safe and sound.

episodes.name: Episode 18
episodes.overview: When Tan comes home bloody and beaten up, Won tries to talk some sense into him. Won runs into Yeong-do and wants to know why Tan's in such a bad state.

episodes.name: Episode 19
episodes.overview: At Tan's party, Won meets his match -- for a marriage arranged by his father. Won and Tan discuss what their father's condition means for the company.

episodes.name: Episode 20
episodes.overview: Hyeon-ju lets go of Won. Tan wants to know why Won has to make a sacrifice, but Won says it's necessary for the company and his responsibility to bear.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Park Soo Ha met Jang Hye Sung when he was eight years old and she stood witness to his father's murder. He has been looking for her ever since then.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Jang Hye Sung gets hired as a public defender. Her first case involves Park Soo Ha's classmate, Go Sung Bin.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: To find evidences of Sung Bin's innocence, Hye Sung and Gwan Woo visit Sung Bin's school dressed as high school students.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Min Joon Gook is planning his revenge on Hye Sung. Meanwhile, Hye Sung and Gwan Woo both receive a case involving twin brothers.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Hye Sung and Gwan Woo work together on the case involving the twins. Meanwhile, Min Joon Gook moves away.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Soo Ha tells Hye Sung that the twins planned the murder, therefore Hye Sung agrees to help Do Hyun prove the twins are guilty.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Cha Gwan Woo tells Hye Sung that he likes her and that they should date.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Hye Sung's mother is murdered and Gwan Woo is assigned to Min Joon Gook's case.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Unable to accept the verdict for Min Joon Gook's case, Soo Ha takes the matter into his own hands, but the consequences are far more severe than he or Hye Sung could have imagined.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Hye Sung finally reunites with Soo Ha after a year of no contact, only to find him suspect to a murder and a with serious case of amnesia.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Hye Sung and Gwan Woo work together again to help with Park Soo Ha's case.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Do Hyun and Gwan Woo both find evidence that Min Joon Gook may still alive.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Attorney Shin asks for Hye Sung's help with Hwang Dal Joong's case.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Hye Sung debates on whether to tell Do Hyun about her birth parents.

episodes.name: Episode 15
