episodes.overview: The Director offers the 3rd Sales division a major project, but Oh is suspicious. Kim Dong-shik gets into an argument with coworkers who insulted Oh.

episodes.name: Episode 18
episodes.overview: Oh decides to accept the Director’s proposal, but the team quickly runs into difficulties. Kim and the others suggest to withdraw, but Oh is not sure.

episodes.name: Episode 19
episodes.overview: The 3rd Sales division is uneasy after Geu-rae voices suspicions about the Director’s project with Seok. The head office launches an investigation.

episodes.name: Episode 20
episodes.overview: After the turmoil, the 3rd Sales division finally returns to normal. A new boss arrives with new methods. Meanwhile, Geu-rae’s contract nears its end.

episodes.name: First, I'm a Teacher
episodes.overview: A former delinquent and gang member's dreams to become a teacher come true but on the condition that he will quit immediately if he causes any problems. Onizuka is handed the most notorious 2-4 class and the students are already prepared with plans to get him…

episodes.name: The Pervert Teacher and the Madonna Teacher
The Dangerous Teacher Who Puts Out His Hand to a Student's Mother
The Teacher Who Does Compensated Dating
The Teacher Who Was Fired in the Opening Ceremony of the Second Semester
The Teacher Who Has Students Withdraw from School by Force
The Teacher Who Gets Excited Over Staying at Fuyutsuki's Room
The Violent Teacher Who Was Scolded by a Beautiful Nurse

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Nanami Momozono is alone and homeless after her dad skips town to evade his gambling debts and the debt collectors kick her out of her apartment. So when a man she's just saved from a dog offers her his home, she jumps at the opportunity. But it turns out tha…

episodes.name: Nanami Becomes a God
episodes.overview: Abandoned by her father, Nanami finds herself homeless when she meets a man who offers his own home to her. His home turns out to be a shrine where his supernatural household awaits the return of their lord and master after a 20-year absence.

episodes.name: The God Becomes a Target
episodes.overview: Nanami discovers that Kurama, a famous pop star, has transferred to her high school, which spurs her to return to school. However, as a weak land god, her life may be at risk if she wanders outside the shrine alone.

episodes.name: The God Makes a Match
episodes.overview: The land under Mikage Shrine's protection includes Isara Swamp and Himemiko, its guardian mistress, comes to pay her respects to the new land god. And Nanami's divine matchmaking powers are put to the test for the first time.

episodes.name: The God Is Kidnapped
episodes.overview: Nanami saves a pretty white snake at school and for her trouble, she becomes marked as the snake's intended. Tomoe transfers into Nanami's class to protect her, but the snake comes for her anyway.

episodes.name: The God Loses Her Home
episodes.overview: Narukami, god of thunder, has always wanted Tomoe as a familiar for herself. Now that the god he serves is Nanami, a human girl, Narukami sees her chance to take away Nanami's godhood and make Tomoe hers.

episodes.name: The God Catches a Cold
episodes.overview: Nanami stays home with a cold while Tomoe goes to school disguised as her in order to keep her attendance rate from slipping. Mizuki takes advantage of Tomoe's absence to pay Nanami a visit.

episodes.name: The God Asks a Boy Out on a Date
episodes.overview: Nanami experiments a little with her divine powers while she struggles to define exactly how she feels about Tomoe. And Kurama, being the yokai who has more experience with humans, offers some words of advice to Tomoe.

episodes.name: The God Goes to the Beach
episodes.overview: Summer break is here and Nanami goes to the beach with her friends to take her mind off her broken heart. Trouble ensues when Tomoe accompanies her and goes into the ocean against his better judgment.

episodes.name: The God Goes to the Dragon King's Palace
episodes.overview: In her quest to recover the stolen Dragon King's right eye and return it to him in exchange for Tomoe's freedom, Nanami travels back in time and gets a glimpse of Tomoe's past.

episodes.name: Tomoe Becomes a Familiar / The God Goes to a Mixer
episodes.overview: Flashing back to the past, some of what Tomoe went through with Mikage is revealed. And returning to the present for the second part, Nanami gets dragged off to a mixer with her friends.

episodes.name: The Familiar Goes Into Town
episodes.overview: Mizuki ventures into the city alone to learn the secret to making it in human society like the super popular pop star Kurama. And Nanami drags Tomoe off on a date to the amusement park.

episodes.name: Nanami Quits Being a God
episodes.overview: Nanami decides to hold an autumn festival at the shrine to let the locals know that it's not abandoned or haunted. But as she prepares for the festival, Otohiko comes along to throw a wrench into things.

episodes.name: I've Started the "Being a God" Thing
episodes.overview: Unable to exorcise the miasma encroaching on the shrine, Nanami believes she is useless and leaves. Finding her gone, Tomoe and Mizuki go searching for her, leaving the shrine and the miasma to Onikiri and Kotetsu.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: After a rough start as a newly ordained god, Nanami’s finally finding her land legs in the world of gods, demons, and spirits. However, not everything is going magically well. Nanami’s feelings for Tomoe are growing stronger, but Tomoe goes from hot to cold f…

episodes.name: I've Started the "Being a God" Thing Again
episodes.overview: As the land god of the Mikage Shrine, Nanami is invited to the annual gathering of the gods in Izumo, but on the one condition that she must pass a test administered by Otohiko.

episodes.name: The God Goes to Izumo
episodes.overview: Now that Nanami is set to go to Izumo to attend the Divine Assembly, she must decide who goes with her - Tomoe or Mizuki. And she must also face the consequences of attending a divine event as a mortal being.

episodes.name: The God Falls Into the Netherworld
episodes.overview: Okuninushi, the god hosting the Divine Assembly, asks Nanami to go handle a situation happening on the border between the worlds of the living and the dead.

episodes.name: The God Races Across the Netherworld
episodes.overview: Izanami imprisons Kirihito and refuses to allow Nanami to return to the surface with him. Nanami must decide how much she believes in her own powers and what she is willing to risk to save him.

episodes.name: The God Makes Her Second Romantic Confession
episodes.overview: When Tomoe reverted to being a wild fox to save Nanami, he undid his contract as her familiar. And now, he takes this opportunity to reconsider whether he wants to go back to Nanami or not.

episodes.name: The God Meets a Little Tengu
episodes.overview: On her way home, Nanami runs into Himemiko and they spend some quality girl time together. Later, she meets a little tengu on a mission.

episodes.name: The God Goes to Mount Kurama
episodes.overview: Kurama returns to Mount Kurama with Nanami and Tomoe to take Botanmaru home and see if he can help his ailing father.

episodes.name: The God Sneaks In
episodes.overview: Kurama's father is sick, but there is no easy way to get in to see him, so the gang must devise a way to get past Jiro's defenses.

episodes.name: The God Is Blindsided
episodes.overview: The ruse is simple. Nanami confers her godly powers to Kurama, so he can pretend to be a god, someone Jiro cannot turn away from the gates. While Kurama and Tomoe distract Jiro, Nanami sneaks in to deliver the cure.

episodes.name: The God Receives a Romantic Confession
episodes.overview: The search for the Sojobo's soul leads to an unexpected place and an unexpected confession.

episodes.name: The God Goes Back to Being a Child
episodes.overview: Kirihito, aka Akura-oh, has not given up on getting his body back from the Netherworld. But in the meantime, Nanami and her familiars go to see the Year God, to receive a talisman for the new year.

episodes.name: The God Receives a Marriage Proposal
episodes.overview: Tomoe gets some insight into Nanami's childhood. And they finally get through the torii gates to see the Year God.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Saitama is a hero who only became a hero for fun. After three years of “special” training, though, he’s become so strong that he’s practically invincible. In fact, he’s too strong—even his mightiest opponents are taken out with a single punch, and it turns ou…

episodes.name: The Strongest Man
episodes.overview: Saitama is a guy who’s a hero for fun. After saving a child from certain death, he decided to become a hero and trained hard for three years. Though he’s now so strong he can defeat any opponent with a single punch, lately he feels as if, in exchange for over…

episodes.name: The Lone Cyborg
episodes.overview: A monster is moving toward City Z, one that has been created by the mysterious organization known as The House of Evolution. Genos, a young cyborg, attempts to stop it, but gets in over his head before Saitama happens along.

episodes.name: The Obsessive Scientist
episodes.overview: Saitama and Genos glean information about The House of Evolution and its founder Dr. Genus, a scientist with dangerous ideas on artificial human evolution. Meanwhile, Dr. Genus learns of Saitama’s amazing strength and has plans of his own for One-Punch Man.

episodes.name: The Modern Ninja
episodes.overview: A group of battlesuit-clad terrorists called “The Paradisers” appears in City F, led by an enormous man known as Hammerhead. Calling for the redistribution of wealth, the group targets the fat-cat Zeniru, who in turn dispatches his bodyguard to defeat them. U…

episodes.name: The Ultimate Master
episodes.overview: Though he’s been doing the hero gig for three years, Saitama realizes that the public knows nothing about him. Determined to get a little recognition, he decides to become a pro hero, but first he must pass the Hero Association tests and become a full-fledged…

episodes.name: The Terrifying City
episodes.overview: It’s been five days since Saitama became a professional hero and he has yet to do anything heroic. When Genos informs him that C-class heroes who don’t fight bad guys are dropped from the hero registry after a week of inaction, Saitama heads out on patrol, ye…

episodes.name: The Ultimate Disciple
episodes.overview: An enormous meteor hurtles toward City Z, forcing the Hero Association to ask its S Class heroes to respond. When all their efforts prove in vain, Genos decides it’s up to him to protect the home of his master and stop the meteor, no matter what the cost.

episodes.name: The Deep Sea King
episodes.overview: A pack of monsters calling themselves the “Clan of the Seafolk” arrive on the shores of City J intent on invading the land. When the hero sent to fight them is defeated easily by the Deep Sea King himself, Saitama and Genos head for the city to help.

episodes.name: Unyielding Justice
episodes.overview: As the battle with the Deep Sea King reaches its climax, more heroes fall to the aquatic despot’s brutal attacks. Which of them has what it takes to be a true hero?

episodes.name: Unparalleled Peril
episodes.overview: Saitama tags along to an emergency meeting of Class S heroes and discovers that a seer has foretold a serious danger threatening the Earth. Though the crisis could occur anytime in the next six months, the heroes are surprised to hear the roar of explosions t…

episodes.name: The Dominator of the Universe
episodes.overview: As a colossal spaceship floats in the skies above City A, a member of its monstrous crew battles on the ground against a group of S Class heroes. Despite their powers, they can’t seem to finish it off. Meanwhile, Saitama has boarded the enemy ship on his own.

episodes.name: The Strongest Hero
episodes.overview: The inconceivably powerful Lord Boros has traveled untold distances in search of someone who can cure his boredom: Saitama! With the fate of humanity in the balance, will the two champions at last find in each other the worthy opponent they’ve been searching…

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Saitama, alongside his cyborg disciple Genos, is ready to begin his official duties as a professional hero. But when a new friendship and interest in martial arts prove distracting, the Hero Association is left to deal with a sinister new wave of monster atta…

episodes.name: Return of the Hero
episodes.overview: Saitama is out shopping with Genos in tow when the pair come across G4, a demonic robot on a mission to eliminate King. Elsewhere, Sitch attempts to recruit various cutthroats, villains and assassins of the underworld to help the Hero Association.

episodes.name: Human Monster
episodes.overview: Garou issues a declaration of war on the Hero Association through terrifying means, Hellish Blizzard gives Saitama an ultimatum, and Genos decides to eliminate his master's stalker, Speed-o'-Sound Sonic.

episodes.name: The Hunt Begins
episodes.overview: Garou, out hunting heroes, can barely contain his excitement when he gets the chance to battle the S Class hero Tank-top Master. Meanwhile, Silverfang shutters his dojo to begin his own hunt of his former disciple.

episodes.name: Metal Bat
episodes.overview: Assigned to guard a VIP and his son, Metal Bat couldn't be less thrilled. But when the group is suddenly attacked all hell breaks loose. Meanwhile, Saitama has disguised himself as Charanko in order to enter the “Super Fight” martial arts tournament.

episodes.name: Martial Arts Tournament
episodes.overview: Monsters from the Monster Association launch simultaneous attacks on all the human cities, attempting to overwhelm the forces of the Hero Association. Meanwhile, the “Super Fight” martial arts tournament kicks off.

episodes.name: The Uprising of the Monsters
episodes.overview: The Super Fight tournament kicks off while Genos takes on multiple monsters who have appeared in City C. Elsewhere, countless monsters are wreaking havoc in multiple areas, but the Hero Association is being overwhelmed by the sheer number of threats.

episodes.name: Class S Heroes
episodes.overview: As the Super Fight tournament heads for its grand finale, the Class S heroes battle to hold back the tide of monster incursions. Meanwhile, Atomic Samurai is setting in motion a plan of his own.

episodes.name: The Strong Ones Fight Back
episodes.overview: Goketsu, the first Super Fight Tournament champion, arrives in the stadium. Having now become a monster, he’s aiming to force the Super Fight competitors to turn into monsters themselves. When several do, it’s up to Suiryu to take them on alone.

episodes.name: The Ultimate Dilemma
episodes.overview: Just as Suiryu finds himself in the depths of despair, Saitama suddenly appears to help him out. But despite all Saitama’s strength, there’s still something bugging the hero that he just can’t seem to shake.

episodes.name: The Encircling Net of Justice
episodes.overview: The Monster Association issues a challenge to the Hero Association, telling them they have only three days to rescue the hostage Waganma. Elsewhere, Garou tries to recover from his constant fighting, but things don’t quite go as planned.

episodes.name: Everyone's Dignity
episodes.overview: Garou is at last surrounded by multiple heroes and forced to fight, even though he’s covered in wounds and nearly at his limit. The hero hunter still has his incredible ability to read opponents’ fighting styles, but there are surprises in store for all.

episodes.name: Cleaning Up the Disciple's Mess
episodes.overview: Silverfang and Bomb catch up with Garou while the hero hunter is battling Genos, starting a whirlwind battle that draws in more and more combatants as it marches towards its hair-raising climax!

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Alongside Genos, his faithful disciple, Saitama performs his official hero duties as a member of the Hero Association. One day, monsters claiming to be from the Monster Association suddenly appeared, taking a child of the Hero Association executive hostage. T…

episodes.name: Strategy Meeting
episodes.overview: The heroes plan a rescue of a child kidnapped by monsters, while Garou awakens deep underground.

episodes.name: Monster Traits
episodes.overview: On his way to hunt heroes, Garou dines and dashes at a restaurant, but is chased by Saitama.

episodes.name: Organism Limits
episodes.overview: Garou fights Insect God and King the Ripper, while Tareo gets kidnapped. Dr. Kuseno visits Saitama.

episodes.name: Counterattack Signal
episodes.overview: The heroes prepare for battle without Silverfang and Genos. Garou attacks the Monster Association.

episodes.name: Monster King
episodes.overview: Garou rescues Tareo but is struck by Overgrown Pochi, falling to Orochi and Gyoro-Gyoro.

episodes.name: Motley Heroes
episodes.overview: Class-S heroes plan the Monster Association assault, but Amai Mask arrives and clashes with them.

episodes.name: Counterstrike
episodes.overview: Heroes arrive in Z City but face a monster ambush. A-class aids while Gyoro-Gyoro watches the fight.

episodes.name: Ninja Tale
episodes.overview: Tempest Wind and Hellfire Flame, who were ninjas but are now monsters, battle with Flashy Flash.

episodes.name: Brave Child
episodes.overview: Child Emperor finds Waganma and faces Phoenix Man, using his ultimate weapon to protect him.

episodes.name: Immortal Bloodbath
episodes.overview: Zombieman faces Vampire, a descendant of a supernatural bloodline, in a brutal, deadly showdown.

episodes.name: Top Dragons
episodes.overview: Child Emperor rescues Waganma. The heroes take on threat-level Dragon monsters in a deadly fight.

episodes.name: Ultimate Lifeform
episodes.overview: The heroes battle monsters while Terrible Tornado faces Gyoro-Gyoro. Orochi appears before Saitama.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Communicating via a walkie-talkie that transcends time, a profiler from 2015 and a detective from 1989 join forces to tackle crimes and injustice.

episodes.name: You're Doomed
episodes.overview: Profiler Park Hae-young hears a man calling his name through a discarded two-way radio. The voice starts talking about an unsolved crime.

episodes.name: We Still Have a Chance
episodes.overview: The statute of limitations is lifted after the suspect's arrest. Hae-young joins Soo-hyun's team for the newly established cold case squad.

episodes.name: We Can Prevent the Killings
episodes.overview: Reality changes after Hae-young exchanges information with Jae-han. Hae-young tries to work together with Jae-han in 1989 to prevent the next murder.

episodes.name: We Found the Killer
episodes.overview: The ninth victim is Won-kyung, the woman Jae-han loves. A driver turns himself in, but Soo-hyun and Jae-han determine that his son is the real killer.

episodes.name: Changing the Past Alters the Present
episodes.overview: Hae-young starts to investigate Jae-han's disappearance. Jae-han's former colleagues get suspicious about seeing Hae-young digging into the past.

episodes.name: Catch Him by All Means
episodes.overview: Seeking vengeance for the events that lead to the death of his daughter, Kyung-tae commits a kidnapping after getting out of prison for burglary.

episodes.name: We Must Dig Deeper
episodes.overview: Jae-han arrests Se-kyu for the serial burglary case, but the culprit is freed after serving a short sentence; Kyung-tae still commits murder.

episodes.name: How Are You Alive?
episodes.overview: Soo-hyun and Hae-young notice a connection between the burglary case and Da-hye, the woman who killed herself twenty years ago.

episodes.name: Hongwon-dong Case
episodes.overview: Hae-young learns that Chi-soo and Jae-han met in 1999 during a case in Inju. After serving time for the crime, Hae-young's brother had killed himself.

episodes.name: Someone Has to Stop the Bad Guys
episodes.overview: The bodies discovered in the mountains appear to be more victims of the 1997 serial murder case. Jae-han learns that Soo-hyun became team leader.

episodes.name: The One Last Case
episodes.overview: Hae-young and Soo-hyun arrest Jin-woo after coming to the conclusion that he is the killer. Hae-young asks Jae-han about the Inju rape case.

episodes.name: The Case Was Manipulated
episodes.overview: Hae-young becomes a suspect for the murder of Chi-soo. Jae-han realizes who the principle offender of the attack on Hye-seung is.

episodes.name: The Real Assailant
episodes.overview: Soo-hyun and the others mourn after confirming that the remains belong to Jae-han. Hae-young learns that Jae-han used to look after him in the past.

episodes.name: Not Now, but Maybe in the Past
episodes.overview: Hae-young realizes the possibility that his brother could have been murdered after learning from Hye-seung that Sun-woo was not guilty.

episodes.name: Is It Really You?
episodes.overview: Hae-young is arrested for the murder of Chi-soo. Soo-hyun hears Jae-han apologizing over the radio for not being able to prevent Sun-woo's death.

episodes.name: If You Don't Give Up
episodes.overview: Hae-young is in critical condition after being shot while meeting with Sung-bum. In 2000, Jae-han has been captured by Bum-joo.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: For his entire life, Izuku has dreamed of being a hero—an ambitious goal for anyone, but an especially challenging one for a boy without superpowers. That’s right: in a world where 80% of the population has some sort of special Gift, Izuku was unlucky enough…

episodes.name: Izuku Midoriya: Origin
episodes.overview: Izuku Midoriya desperately wants to be a hero, but he is one of the few in his generation born without a Quirk. Will meeting the number one hero, All Might, change his fate?

episodes.name: What It Takes to Be a Hero
episodes.overview: Izuku accidentally learns of All Might’s secret, but there’s trouble in town again before Izuku has time to process it. Will All Might be able to save the day again?

episodes.name: Roaring Muscles
episodes.overview: All Might tells Izuku that he can become a hero, but does he really have what it takes to become one?

episodes.name: Start Line
episodes.overview: At the entrance exam, Izuku falls behind as the other students defeat faux villains left and right. Will he be able to get enough points to pass?

episodes.name: What I Can Do for Now
episodes.overview: It’s Izuku’s first day of high school, and he still can’t control his new Quirk. Will he make it to the second day of school with his eccentric new teacher?

episodes.name: Rage, You Damn Nerd
episodes.overview: Izuku somehow gets through his first day of school and falls into a regular schedule of classes and training at U.A. In their first class with All Might…

episodes.name: Deku vs. Kacchan
episodes.overview: Izuku is up against Katsuki in their first class with All Might! Can he and Uraraka beat the villain team of Katsuki and Tenya before time runs out?

episodes.name: Bakugo’s Start Line
episodes.overview: After the combat training lesson, the students and All Might reflect on their matches as they think about their next steps.

episodes.name: Yeah, Just Do Your Best, Iida!
episodes.overview: Class 1-A has to elect a class representative, and everyone wants the job! How will they choose? And what lies in wait for them at the next class?

episodes.name: Encounter with the Unknown
episodes.overview: Villains have attacked USJ, and it’s up to Class 1-A to stop them. What are the villains after? Will All Might be able to save the day again?

episodes.name: Game Over
episodes.overview: The students of Class 1-A are up against the League of Villains. Will they survive long enough for help to arrive?

episodes.name: All Might
episodes.overview: All Might has finally shown up, but will he be able to defeat Nomu and save the day?!

episodes.name: In Each of Our Hearts
episodes.overview: As the battle at USJ winds down, Izuku and All Might think about its repercussions. Meanwhile, the villains slink home to plan their next move.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: U.A. High School's most prestigious event begins: the Sports Festival, an opportunity for aspiring heroes to showcase their skills to both the public and potential recruiters. However, the path to glory is never easy, especially for Izuku Midoriya, who must n…

episodes.name: That’s the Idea, Ochaco
episodes.overview: As U.A. students and teachers recover from the League of Villains attack on USJ, Izuku learns about why Ochaco wants to become a hero.

episodes.name: Roaring Sports Festival
episodes.overview: The U.A. sports festival begins and all eyes are on the first-years as they start their qualifying round—the obstacle course race.

episodes.name: In Their Own Quirky Ways
episodes.overview: The first years try to stand out as they struggle to finish the obstacle course and qualify for a spot in the next round.

episodes.name: Strategy, Strategy, Strategy
episodes.overview: Izuku’s having trouble finding a team for the cavalry battle in the next round of the U.A. sports festival. Luckily, he has a plan.

episodes.name: Cavalry Battle Finale
episodes.overview: Fighting it out in the second half of the cavalry battle, does Team Midoriya have what it takes to stay in the top four?

episodes.name: The Boy Born with Everything
episodes.overview: Izuku learns more about Todoroki’s past as the first-years head into the final round of the sports festival.

episodes.name: Victory or Defeat
episodes.overview: Izuku is up against Shinso in the first match of the finals, but can he overcome Shinso’s Quirk to advance to the next round?

episodes.name: Battle on, Challengers!
episodes.overview: It’s one match after another in the first round of the finals tournament. Who will advance to second round?

episodes.name: Bakugo vs. Uraraka
episodes.overview: Bakugo seems almost villainous when he’s up against Uraraka, but she has a plan to keep it from being a one-sided match.

episodes.name: Shoto Todoroki: Origin
episodes.overview: Izuku forces Todoroki to face his past in a chilling battle as the two class rivals finally go head to head!

episodes.name: Fight On, Iida
episodes.overview: It’s class rep versus child prodigy as Iida and Todoroki square off. Will Iida’s Reciproburst be enough to beat the boy of fire and ice?

episodes.name: Todoroki vs. Bakugo
episodes.overview: The explosive showdown between Todoroki and Bakugo begins. Only one can take the title of first-year champion!

episodes.name: Time to Pick Some Names
episodes.overview: Following their epic debut at the sports festival, it’s time for the first-years to pick the most important part of their identities—their hero name!

episodes.name: Bizarre! Gran Torino Appears
episodes.overview: The internships begin! While everyone adjusts to their new tasks, Izuku starts training with Gran Torino, the same man who once taught All Might.

episodes.name: Midoriya and Shigaraki
episodes.overview: The U.A. students are finally starting to get the hang of their internships, but Izuku has much more to learn about One For All.

episodes.name: Hero Killer: Stain vs U.A. Students
episodes.overview: Stain strikes again, and this time some U.A. students are around when it happens. Will they be able to hold him off until the pros come?

episodes.name: Climax
episodes.overview: It all comes to a head as Izuku, Iida, and Todoroki face off against Stain while the pro heroes in Hosu City fight against the Nomus.

episodes.name: The Aftermath of Hero Killer: Stain
episodes.overview: Stain is finally captured, but while the hero community deals with the consequences, an even greater challenge is set in motion.

episodes.name: Everyone's Internships
episodes.overview: As Izuku, Iida, and Todoroki recover from their fight with Stain, the other members of Class 1-A work hard at their own internships.

episodes.name: Listen Up!! A Tale from the Past
episodes.overview: The students return to their daily lives while All Might has a special history lesson for Izuku. It’s time to learn about One For All!

episodes.name: Gear up for Final Exams
episodes.overview: Finals are coming up and Class 1-A is going to need more than a cram session. This year, the teachers are changing the practical exams.

episodes.name: Yaoyorozu: Rising
episodes.overview: The exams are turning out to be much more challenging than the students expected. Can any of the teams hold their own against a teacher?

episodes.name: Stripping the Varnish
episodes.overview: As the students of Class 1-A fight in their practical exams, their resolve to become heroes is put to the test.

episodes.name: Katsuki Bakugo: Origin
episodes.overview: It’s finally time for Izuku and Bakugo’s practical exam. How can they challenge All Might without a plan?

episodes.name: Encounter
episodes.overview: Class 1-A goes shopping for training camp supplies, but things get out of hand when a villain pulls Izuku aside.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Summer is here and the heroes of Rooms A and B are in for the toughest training camp of their lives! A group of seasoned professionals will push the students individualities to the next level with one new challenge after another. Braving the elements of this…

episodes.name: Game Start
episodes.overview: Before the U.A. students head to their training camp, Class 1-A goes to the pool for extra training, and the League of Villains plots their next move.

episodes.name: Wild, Wild Pussycats
episodes.overview: Class 1-A faces the first challenge of their summer training camp when they have to fight their way through “The Beast’s Forest” before lunch.

episodes.name: Kota
episodes.overview: Izuku tries to talk with Kota as the first-years start their training in earnest. Little do they know what awaits them in the forest.

episodes.name: My Hero
episodes.overview: The villains launch their attack, and only Izuku knows where Kota is. Can he get to him in time?

episodes.name: Drive It Home, Iron Fist!!!
episodes.overview: Izuku finally makes it back to the training camp only to leave again with a message for Mandalay to broadcast.

episodes.name: Roaring Upheaval
episodes.overview: The students and teachers of U.A. are still fighting in the woods, but has the Vanguard Action Squad accomplished its mission already…?!

episodes.name: What a Twist!
episodes.overview: The battle at the training camp concludes, and now the students and teachers of U.A. have to deal with the aftermath.

episodes.name: From Iida to Midoriya
episodes.overview: Todoroki, Kirishima, and Midoriya want to go after Bakugo, but the class rep is standing in their way. Meanwhile, Shigaraki makes Bakugo an offer…

episodes.name: All For One
episodes.overview: The heroes and U.A. students close in on the League of Villains’ hideouts, but the League still has an ace up its sleeve.

episodes.name: Symbol of Peace
episodes.overview: As the fight against the League of Villains escalates, can the U.A. students get Bakugo out in time for All Might to make a big comeback?

episodes.name: One For All
episodes.overview: All Might’s time is running out as he faces his ultimate nemesis head on. Will he finally be able to defeat All For One once and for all?

episodes.name: End of the Beginning, Beginning of the End
episodes.overview: After All Might and All For One’s fight, the students go back home while the U.A. teachers decide how to deal with the aftermath.

episodes.name: Moving into Dorms
episodes.overview: The students of Class 1-A move into their dorms and hold a competition to determine who has the best room.

episodes.name: Create Those Ultimate Moves
episodes.overview: Class 1-A works on developing their Quirks and creating ultimate moves to prepare for the provisional hero licensing exam.

episodes.name: The Test
episodes.overview: Izuku and his classmates make some final adjustments to their ultimate moves and then head off to the provisional licensing exam.

episodes.name: Shiketsu High Lurking
episodes.overview: The exam has begun, and everyone’s after Class 1-A! Can the first-years last long enough to pass this first test?

episodes.name: Class 1-A
episodes.overview: Todoroki’s on his own against Seijin High, and Yaoyorozu’s group is pitted against Seiai Academy as they and the rest of Class 1-A fight to pass the first test.

episodes.name: RUSH!
episodes.overview: It’s down to the final minutes of the first test and almost half of Class 1-A has yet to earn a passing score!

episodes.name: Rescue Exercises
episodes.overview: The second test of the provisional licensing has begun, and the hero candidates are suddenly thrust into a rescue operation.

episodes.name: Special Episode: Save the World with Love!
episodes.overview: We take a break from the provisional licensing exam to visit a class held before the summer training camp!

episodes.name: What’s the Big Idea?
episodes.overview: The exam nears its end, but Izuku and the other hero candidates must fend off Gang Orca to finish the rescue mission.

episodes.name: A Talk about Your Quirk
episodes.overview: While the U.A. students finish up the provisional licensing exam and get their results, All Might has a talk with All For One.

episodes.name: Deku vs. Kacchan, Part 2
episodes.overview: Following the provisional licensing exam, Izuku tries out his Shoot Style on Bakugo as they have a heart-to-heart through their fight.

episodes.name: A Season for Encounters
episodes.overview: The world has changed for villains and heroes alike in the weeks after All Might’s fight with All For One, and the U.A. students start their second semester.

episodes.name: Unrivaled
episodes.overview: The students of Class 1-A learn about work studies from the Big Three. Meanwhile, the villains also prepare their next steps.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: With All for One out of the game, the evil world is on the brink of war. Shigaraki of the League of Villains and Overhaul of the Yakuza vie for dominance of the underworld. Meanwhile, Deku finds himself in another dangerous internship with his senior Mirio.

episodes.name: The Scoop on U.A. Class 1-A
episodes.overview: After All Might announces his retirement, freelance reporter Taneo Tokuda goes to the dorms to investigate U.A. Class 1-A.

episodes.name: Overhaul
episodes.overview: Overhaul pays a visit to the League of Villains, and Midoriya tries to find a place to do his work study.

episodes.name: Boy Meets…
episodes.overview: Izuku battles Sir Nighteye so he can do his work study at Nighteye’s agency, but Nighteye has someone else in mind to be All Might’s successor…

episodes.name: Fighting Fate
episodes.overview: Izuku’s mind is swirling with feelings from his work study, so he goes and talks to All Might about it and learns about All Might’s fate.

episodes.name: Let’s Go, Gutsy Red Riot
episodes.overview: The U.A. work study students go out with their respective heroes and become involved in some big fights.

episodes.name: An Unpleasant Talk
episodes.overview: The work study students from U.A. attend a meeting of heroes gathered by Sir Nighteye and leave with new resolve.

episodes.name: GO!!
episodes.overview: The work study students wait until the pro heroes find Eri and it’s time to start the operation to save her.

episodes.name: Suneater of the Big Three
episodes.overview: The Shie Hassaikai is going all out to stop the heroes, and Suneater volunteers to take out the first batch of Eight Bullets members in their way.

episodes.name: Red Riot
episodes.overview: As the fight with the Shie Hassaikai continues, Kirishima has to face his past when he and Fat Gum get separated from the others.

episodes.name: Temp Squad
episodes.overview: The Hassaikai gets some help from the League of Villains as the heroes continue to make their way to Chisaki to rescue Eri.

episodes.name: Lemillion
episodes.overview: The League of Villains stay true to their name in their fight. Meanwhile, Togata catches up to Chisaki and Eri first…

episodes.name: Unforeseen Hope
episodes.overview: Izuku, Eraser Head, and Sir Nighteye finally reach the area where Chisaki and the others are and find Togata past his limit…

episodes.name: Infinite 100%
episodes.overview: As the fight with the Shie Hassaikai reaches its climax, Chisaki looks back on how it all started, and Izuku uses All For One at 100%.

episodes.name: Bright Future
episodes.overview: As the heroes deal with the aftermath of the fight with the Shie Hassaikai, the vehicle transporting Chisaki has an encounter with the League of Villains…

episodes.name: Smoldering Flames
episodes.overview: After the fight with the Shie Hassaikai, a new villain emerges, and the students who participated reflect on their own roles as future heroes.

episodes.name: Win Those Kids’ Hearts
episodes.overview: Camie joins the provisional license training course and is added to the team working with the kids from Masegaki. Meanwhile, Endeavor has a serious talk with All Might.

episodes.name: Relief for License Trainees
episodes.overview: The trainees bond with the precocious Masegaki kids and life at U.A. goes back to normal as autumn approaches, but Aoyama has been acting strangely…

episodes.name: School Festival
episodes.overview: As the students of U.A. prepare for their school festival, Deku and Togata visit Eri in the hospital. Meanwhile, a new villain named Gentle Criminal begins his reign of crime.

episodes.name: Prepping for the School Festival Is the Most Fun Part
episodes.overview: Class 1-A assigns roles for their performance at the school festival, and Gentle starts preparing his next plan.

episodes.name: Gold Tips Imperial
episodes.overview: Eri visits U.A. while the students are preparing for the school festival, and Gentle finalizes his plans.

episodes.name: Deku vs. Gentle Criminal
episodes.overview: As Deku buys some last-minute supplies for the school festival, he encounters a mysterious man wrapped in a trench coat…

episodes.name: School Festival Start!!
episodes.overview: Izuku must stop Gentle Criminal and his partner, La Brava, or else the school festival will be cancelled.

episodes.name: Let It Flow! School Festival!
episodes.overview: Izuku rushes back to the school festival after his encounter with Gentleman and La Brava, but will he make it in time for his performance?

episodes.name: Japanese Hero Billboard Chart
episodes.overview: It’s time for the next Japanese Hero Billboard Chart rankings to be announced, and this time, all the top ten heroes make an appearance.

episodes.name: His Start
episodes.overview: Endeavor and Hawks are up against High-End, and it’s Endeavor’s chance to show the world what the new number one hero is like.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: Deku's next challenge, in order to become the "best hero," is a rivalry with Class 1-B, who also intend to prove that they are true heroes, with all their pride on the line! The students' morale is boosted by a direct confrontation that hasn't occurred since…

episodes.name: All Hands on Deck! Class 1-A
episodes.overview: There's an emergency drill at U.A. High School, and Class 1-A is requested to report for duty!

episodes.name: Vestiges
episodes.overview: After their fight with the Nomu, Hawks and Endeavor return to daily life, and Izuku dreams of One For All…

episodes.name: Clash! Class A vs. Class B!
episodes.overview: Class A and Class B are joined by a special guest as they battle it out during their joint combat training.

episodes.name: Make It Happen, Shinso!
episodes.overview: The Class A team tries to put Shinso and his new equipment to good use in the first match against Class B.

episodes.name: Operation New Improv Moves
episodes.overview: It's darkness versus darkness as Tokoyami and Kuroiro face off in the second match of the class battles!

episodes.name: Foresight
episodes.overview: Separated from her team, Yaoyorozu's leadership skills are put to the test in the second match of the class battles.

episodes.name: Match 3
episodes.overview: In the third match of the class battles, Honenuki leads the Class B team against a well-balanced Class A team.

episodes.name: Match 3 Conclusion
episodes.overview: It's still anybody's game as the the third match continues with an endurance battle between Todoroki and Tetsutetsu.

episodes.name: Early Bird!
episodes.overview: Bakugo shows a different side of himself in the fourth team match as the class battles continue.

episodes.name: That Which Is Inherited
episodes.overview: Midoriya and Shinso face off for the first time since the sports festival in the last fight of the class battles.

episodes.name: Our Brawl
episodes.overview: It's an all-out brawl as the last two teams from Class A and Class B fight it out to the finish!

episodes.name: The New Power and All For One
episodes.overview: As the class battles conclude, Midoriya works with All Might and Bakugo on learning more about his new power.

episodes.name: Have a Merry Christmas!
episodes.overview: It's Christmas at U.A. and the Class 1-A students celebrate with a Christmas party.

episodes.name: Off to Endeavor's Agency!
episodes.overview: Hawks acts strange when he meets Endeavor and his work study students on their way to Endeavor Agency.

episodes.name: One Thing at a Time
episodes.overview: As the villains continue to move behind the scenes, Endeavor helps his work study students with the next steps in their training.

episodes.name: Long Time No See, Selkie
episodes.overview: Ryukyu brings her work study students with her when Selkie asks her to team up with him.

episodes.name: The Hellish Todoroki Family
episodes.overview: Endeavor brings his work study students over for dinner at Fuyumi's request but faces awkward conversations at home.

episodes.name: The Unforgiven
episodes.overview: One of Endeavor's biggest fans shows up to settle some unfinished business, and he expects far more than an autograph.

episodes.name: More of a Hero Than Anyone
episodes.overview: When an unsettling discovery is made regarding Kurogiri, Aizawa and Present Mic are summoned to interrogate him.

episodes.name: My Villain Academia
episodes.overview: A series of surprise encounters helps give Shigaraki a new sense of direction for the League of Villains.

episodes.name: Revival Party
episodes.overview: The League of Villains waits for Gigantomachia to wake up as they clash with the Meta Liberation Army.

episodes.name: Sad Man's Parade
episodes.overview: As Twice tries to save Toga, he thinks back on his past and makes a realization that helps him overcome it.

episodes.name: Tenko Shimura: Origin
episodes.overview: Memories from Shigaraki's past as Tenko Shimura resurface as he confronts Re-Destro.

episodes.name: Tomura Shigaraki: Origin
episodes.overview: Shigaraki remembers his first encounter with All For One during the climax of his battle with Re-Destro.

episodes.name: The High, Deep Blue Sky
episodes.overview: Both sides prepare for the confrontation between the heroes and the Paranormal Liberation Front as Class 1-A finishes their first year of high school.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Along with Bakugo and Todoroki, Deku interned at the office of the No. 1 Hero, Endeavor. Working hard in an environment rich in lessons, he improved as a hero and used Black Whip, a new Quirk that was hidden within One For All.

episodes.name: A Quiet Beginning
episodes.overview: Using the information Hawks gathered, the heroes and their work study students get ready for an attack on the Paranormal Liberation Front led by Shigaraki.

episodes.name: Mirko, the No. 5 Hero
episodes.overview: As Endeavor and the others fight the Nomus at the hospital, Mirko goes against Kyudai Garaki's best soldiers, the High-Ends. Meanwhile, Kaminari steels his resolve to save those he cares about and goes to the front line of team Edgeshot.

episodes.name: One's Justice
episodes.overview: Inside Gunga Villa, the Paranormal Liberation Front realizes that they are under attack, and Twice confronts Hawks about his betrayal.

episodes.name: Inheritance
episodes.overview: An enraged Dabi confronts Hawks after Twice's death, meanwhile at the Hospital Endeavor, Eraser head, Crust, Present Mic and X-less finally arrive to help Mirko, who's risking her life to stop Shigaraki's awakening.

episodes.name: The Thrill of Destruction
episodes.overview: The fight against the High-End Nomus in Jaku Hospital continues however they are unaware that Tomura Shigaraki has awakened. Whilst this is happening, Tokoyami flies in to try and save Hawks from Dabi.

episodes.name: Encounter, Part 2
episodes.overview: Gigantomachia and the rest of the Paranormal Liberation Front gain the upper hand at the Gunga Mountain Villa as the newly awakened Tomura Shigaraki finds a new objective; steal One for All from Izuku Midoriya.

episodes.name: Disaster Walker
episodes.overview: The fight against Shigaraki continues while other heroes fight the new Nomus that Shigaraki summoned. While this is happening Team Edgeshot tries to stop Gigantomachia from making it to Jaku City.

episodes.name: League of Villains vs. U.A. Students
episodes.overview: The pro heroes' defensive net was broken through. Facing the monstrous giant are the U.A. hero course students. Class A and Class B work together to start a big operation to block Gigantomachia.

episodes.name: Katsuki Bakugo: Rising
episodes.overview: As Aizawa seems to be out of the battle, Midoriya tries to keep Shigaraki in the air utilizing all of his quirks. Knowing his limit is near, Bakugo comes up with a plan to help him.

episodes.name: The Ones Within Us
episodes.overview: Shigaraki's attack pierced right through Kacchan. Deku loses himself to his rage and thrust himself to Shigaraki. However, things change suddenly. In the world of One For All, Deku stand against Shigaraki and All For One.

episodes.name: Dabi's Dance
episodes.overview: As Ochaco and Toga exchange words and blows, Gigantomachia reaches Shigaraki and the heroes, and Dabi reveals the secret of his past.

episodes.name: Threads of Hope
episodes.overview: Best Jeanist appears and spins together the hopes of all the heroes in this fight as the climax of the all-out war draws near.

episodes.name: Final Performance
episodes.overview: Thinking of his great-great-grandfather, Mr. Compress performs his greatest trick in order to save the League of Villains.

episodes.name: Hellish Hell
episodes.overview: The heroes wrestle with changing public opinion as they deal with the aftermath of the fierce battle and mourn those they lost in the fight.

episodes.name: Tartarus
episodes.overview: Under All For One's control, Shigaraki attacks Tartarus with the Nomus to free All For One's body, freeing many other prisoners in the process.

episodes.name: The Hellish Todoroki Family, Part 2
episodes.overview: As heroes deal with criticism from the public, Hawks thinks back on his past with his family, and Endeavor's family visits him in the hospital.

episodes.name: The Wrong Way to Put Out a Fire
episodes.overview: Endeavor and his family reflect on Toya's past and the events that led to his death, and Hawks and Best Jeanist bring them a proposition.

episodes.name: Izuku Midoriya and Tomura Shigaraki
episodes.overview: Inside One For All, Izuku talks with the past wielders as the top three heroes deal with public sentiment after Dabi's revelation.

episodes.name: Full Power!!
episodes.overview: After Izuku decides not to go back to U.A., he finds himself facing Muscular, who was broken out of jail, again and uses the Quirks of the past wielders against him.

episodes.name: Hired Gun
episodes.overview: The top three heroes continue to face criticism as they deal with jailbreakers and look for hints about All For One and Shigaraki's whereabouts, and Izuku comes across a villain from Tartarus.

episodes.name: The Lovely Lady Nagant
episodes.overview: During Izuku's fight with Lady Nagant, she tells him secrets about hero society that further solidify his resolve to help those who need his help.

episodes.name: Friend
episodes.overview: As Izuku goes off alone in his quest for justice, his classmates realize something is wrong and try to find a way to help him.

episodes.name: Deku vs. Class A
episodes.overview: As Deku tries to run away, Class A draws him back by recounting their memories with him and reminding him of his own words.

episodes.name: A Young Woman's Declaration
episodes.overview: As the evacuees at U.A. voice their dissent, Ochaco speaks up to try and sway them. Onlookers with ties to Izuku try to figure out if it's time for them to speak out, too.

episodes.name: No Man Is an Island
episodes.overview: As Izuku tries to rest and recover back at U.A. with his classmates, All Might has an encounter with Stain that leads to new information about Shigaraki and All For One.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview: Following an all-out battle with the Paranormal Liberation Front, it is difficult for the people of Japan to continue placing faith in their heroes. To combat the combined power of Tomura Shigaraki and All For One, All Might calls for his ally from the West—t…

episodes.name: In the Nick of Time! A Big-Time Maverick from the West
episodes.overview: As jailbreakers run rampant in Japan, Star and Stripe flies from the U.S. to Japan to help and finds Shigaraki waiting for her in the middle of her flight path.

episodes.name: Specter
episodes.overview: The fight between Star and Stripe and Shigaraki is coming to an end, but Star has one more trick up her sleeve with New Order.

episodes.name: Villain
episodes.overview: After failing to steal Star's Quirk, New Order, and losing many other Quirks, Shigaraki and All For One prepare for their next move. Who is the traitor at U.A.?!

episodes.name: The Story of How We All Became Heroes
episodes.overview: Due to his relationship with All For One, Yuga Aoyama calls himself a villain, but Deku tells him that he can still be a hero and reaches a hand out to him.

episodes.name: Let You Down
episodes.overview: As heroes and villains get ready for the coming battle, Deku and the others leave U.A., and Deku is called out by Aoyama, who is supposed to be in a police cell. What does Aoyama want?

episodes.name: Division
episodes.overview: It's finally time for the decisive battle between heroes and villains! The plan by All Might, Aizawa, and the others has them start their fights in various places around Japan!

episodes.name: Inflation
episodes.overview: Even though Shigaraki's Quirks are sealed, he attacks Bakugo and the others with a strange new appearance and power. Meanwhile, Deku is pulled to where Toga was warped and Todoroki and Dabi face off!

episodes.name: Two Flashfires
episodes.overview: Eleven years ago, Toya Todoroki was burned by his own flames and became Dabi. Todoroki faces Dabi's blue flames with a new move of his own. Will he be able to stop his brother?

episodes.name: Extras
episodes.overview: Shoto Todoroki stopped Dabi with his Great Glacial Aegir, and reports of that bolstered the spirits of the heroes fighting in other locations. And Shoto and Dabi's father, Endeavor, is facing the greatest evil, All For One, with Hawks!

episodes.name: Wounded Hero, Burning Bright and True!!
episodes.overview: Before the threat of All For One, Endeavor falls, and Hawks, Jiro, and Tokoyami are also cornered. Even so, Jiro acts like a hero! Endeavor is also encouraged after looking back at his own life.

episodes.name: Light Fades to Rain
episodes.overview: Bakugo's Howitzer Impact didn't work against Shigaraki/All For One, either, and Bakugo is pushed into a corner by Shigaraki's power and words. In order to get him out of that predicament, U.A.'s Big Three take a stand!

episodes.name: Those Who Defend, Those Who Violate
episodes.overview: Bakugo surprised Shigaraki/All For One with Cluster but was then cruelly pierced through. The heroes in all the different locations are getting pushed back... But even so, they will not give up!

episodes.name: A Chain of Events, Across the Ages
episodes.overview: Deku finally arrives at the Coffin in the Sky! Seeing Bakugo and the others defeated by Shigaraki/All For One, Deku shakes with anger. Can he control his feelings and win against Shigaraki? It's finally time for a showdown!

episodes.name: Together with Shoji
episodes.overview: Spinner takes heteromorphs who are exploding with resentment from being persecuted to Central Hospital to get Kurogiri back. Shoji, whose Quirk also makes him a heteromorph, shouts his feelings to them.

episodes.name: Butterfly Effect
episodes.overview: Spinner and Present Mic both yell their hearts out. Will the one waking up to their voices be Kurogiri, or Shirakumo? Meanwhile, fighting Ochaco and the others on Okuto Island, Toga is finally going to use her secret weapon...!

episodes.name: The Chain Thus Far
episodes.overview: Toga consumed Twice's blood, and with Kurogiri's Warp, infinite doubles of Twice appear. Shigaraki's Decay is also released, and the heroes seem to be in a state of despair. But then, help comes from an unexpected quarter...

episodes.name: Hopes
episodes.overview: With the addition of Gentle, La Brava, and Lady Nagant, Deku is able to restrain Shigaraki's hands and confront him on the ground. Meanwhile, at the Gunga Villa site, the rewound All For One shows off his awful power...

episodes.name: It's a Small World
episodes.overview: Shishikura and the other members of Shiketsu High join the fight at the Gunga Villa site, and it's do-or-die as the heroes unite to fight back! But as All For One gets younger, he gets stronger. That's when unexpected backup arrives...!

episodes.name: I Am Here
episodes.overview: Trampling the heroes, All For One flies to become one with Shigaraki, and Dabi is about to explode with the heat he's been storing up in his body. Will the Symbol be able change this hopeless situation?

episodes.name: A Girl's Ego
episodes.overview: Toga transforms into Twice and backs the heroes into a corner with Infinite Doubles. In the midst of that, Ochaco does her best to get close to Toga to talk to her. How does Toga respond...?

episodes.name: Battle Without a Quirk
episodes.overview: Toga returns the smile of Ochaco, who tried to be friends with her. What does Toga do to the seriously-injured Ochaco? Meanwhile, All Might uses "power" developed by a friend to face All For One!

seasons.name: FINAL SEASON
seasons.overview: Deku and the heroes are plunged into a final battle against villains across Japan. Deku, by fully unleashing One For All Quirks, faces off against Shigaraki. A young and refreshed All For One faces Armored All Might, Quirkless in his powered armor suit. Will…

episodes.name: Toshinori Yagi: Rising/Origin
episodes.overview: The fierce battle continues between Armored All Might and All For One. Can All Might possibly win?

episodes.name: The End of an Era, and the Beginning
episodes.overview: All Might receives help from an unexpected source when Stain joins him in the battle against All For One.

episodes.name: The Final Boss!!
episodes.overview: Bakugo is back on his feet! Can he rescue All Might from All For One, and defeat the villain in battle?

episodes.name: Quirk: Explosion!!
episodes.overview: The fierce battle with Bakugo reminds All For One of his and his brother Yoichi's origins.

episodes.name: History's Greatest Villain
episodes.overview: The balance of power shifts between Izuku and Shigaraki when the latter steals a Quirk from One For All.

episodes.name: Wrench It Open, Izuku Midoriya!!
episodes.overview: Izuku attempts to forcefully transfer One For All to Shigaraki, as this might prove to be the key to victory.

episodes.name: From Aizawa
episodes.overview: Izuku dives deep into Shigaraki's mind, in search of the villain's origin: the tragic Tenko Shimura.

episodes.name: Izuku Midoriya: Rising
episodes.overview: After All For One takes over Shigaraki's body, the heroes must fight as one big team to defeat him.

episodes.name: Epilogue, The Hellish Todoroki Family: Final
episodes.overview: With the long conflict over at last, the time has come to rebuild. Both on a societal and personal level.

episodes.name: The Girl Who Loves Smiles
episodes.overview: The struggle against the villains may be over, but Izuku and Ochaco both still have internal demons to face.

episodes.name: My Hero Academia
episodes.overview: How has the world changed in the eight years since Izuku and the heroes defeated All For One and Shigaraki?

episodes.name: Those Who Are Destined to Meet
episodes.overview: Yoo Hye Jung, a rebellious teenager, ends up in the care of her grandmother. She doesn't back down from anyone, whether adults, another youth, or even gang members. Unfortunately, she butts heads with Professor Hong Ji-Hong who turns out to be her new classro…

episodes.name: Love Comes from the Brain
episodes.overview: Jo-Hong takes a new approach in instructing Hye Jung. When Ji-hong and Hye-Jung save a pregnant woman, she becomes inspired and decides to change her life around. Hye-Jung finds friendship in Chun Soon-hee and Jin Seo-woo.

episodes.name: The Insanity Called Love
episodes.overview: Seo-Woo's jealousy leads to drastic events and destroys the friendship bonds. Soon-Hee stays loyal to Hye-Jung. Kang Mal-Soon, Hye-Jung's grandmother, goes in for an operation. Ji Hong tenders his resignation as a teacher.

episodes.name: The Unresolved Past
episodes.overview: 13 years after the big rift, Hye-Jung transfers to Gul Il Medical Center as a Surgeon. Although happy to reunite with her friend, Soon-Hee, she is not welcomed by everyone. She starts off on the bad side of Dr. Jung Yoon-Do and some old enemies.

episodes.name: Habits and Forgiveness
episodes.overview: Ji-Hong and Hye-Jung have a sparring match and later confesses his feelings to her. Director Myung-Ho plots to maintain and solidify his control over the hospital. Hye-Jung discovers a suspicious person.

episodes.name: Little Things in Life
episodes.overview: Hye-Jung asks Ji Hong to retrieve a patient's file that she does not have access to. Hye-Jung is surprised by a new patient. Ji-Hong steps up his courtship game.

episodes.name: Love and Fear
episodes.overview: As budding romances start budding and dying, things start popping at Soon-Hee's "Sooni Hawaii" cafe. Ji-Hong takes on a special patient. Hye-Jung is surprised by an old friend which leaves Yoon-Do and Ji-Hong feeling jealous.

episodes.name: The Best Gift
episodes.overview: Soo-Chul is badly injured in a motorcycle accident. Doo-Shik attempts to clear his reputation. Lee-Soo-Jung, an Olympic Gold Medalist, undergoes surgery. Yoo Min-Ho attempts to reestablish family ties with Hye-Jung. A celebration party at Sooni Hawaii takes a…

episodes.name: Trust and Betrayal
episodes.overview: A quality fishing trip gets broken up when news of a unannounced National Tax Service inspection on the hospital is received. Hye-Jung grants Intern Kang-Soo and Nurse Hyun Soo-Jin a special favor.

episodes.name: True Relationship
episodes.overview: Hye-Jung is called in for questioning by Internal Affairs. The staff prepares for the upcoming surgery for Hong Doo-Shik, Ji-Hong's father.

episodes.name: What Real Love Does to You
episodes.overview: Old scars for Ji-Hong to do some self-reflection after he oversteps his boundaries with Hye-Jung. Do Jo In-Joo returns to Guk Il Medical Center as Staff Surgeon in the general surgery department. A distraught husband brings a wife in that has fallen and is co…

episodes.name: The Essence of Life
episodes.overview: Jin Sung-Jong takes the helm as Director. Patient Jo Su-Ji's case takes an unexpected turn. Empty nested Yoon-Do's home isn't so sweet since encroachers arrived.

episodes.name: The Key of Love
episodes.overview: Director Jin Myung-Hoon is basking in his own glory. Nam Ba-Ram brings his children in for a checkup. Office romance is in full bloom and hard for Ji-Hong and Hye-Jung to hide. Yoon-Do is missing his own sweet pad.

episodes.name: Scars
episodes.overview: Ji-Hong wants to start the process of healing by identifying old scars. Nam Ba-Ram is at wits end from coping with the pressures concerning payment demands. Second Year Resident Doctor Ahn Jong-Dae is on the lamb due to the abuse he has suffered.

episodes.name: Miracle
episodes.overview: Hye-Jung and Mr. Nam help each other to heal some of their life's trauma. Jong-Dae is busted and dragged back to work. Seo-Woo does some major growing up. A couple on their wedding day are involved in an automobile accident. The beagles have taken over Yoon-D…

episodes.name: Danger Comes Without Warning
episodes.overview: Kang-Soo runs into trouble and starts doubting himself. Soon-Hee tells Hye-Jung she is going to divorce her. Complications arise in Congressmen Nam In-Soon's case. Jin Myung-Hoon seizes an opportunity to rid himself of a pest.

episodes.name: The Past and the Present
episodes.overview: Hye-Jung goes before the Disciplinary Board. Kang-Soo collapses. Hye Jung finally gets the anesthesiology report, but things don't go according to plan.

episodes.name: Karma
episodes.overview: Hye-Jung threatens Myung-Hoon. Ji-Hong is transferred to a research branch. The Board convenes to vote on the Geriatrics Center issue. Ji-Hong and Tae-Ho try to find out what Doo-Shik had on Sung-Jong and Myung-Hoon.

episodes.name: Sacrifice
episodes.overview: Things are turning disastrous for the Jin family. Seo-Woo discovers the secret between Hye-Jung and her father. Stress is taking a toll on her father, Myung-Hoon.

episodes.name: Real Love
episodes.overview: Director Jin Myung-Hoon undergoes surgery. Hye-Jung has to make a difficult decision. Seo-Woo finally gets a boyfriend. Lee Hi-Young has her baby.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Needing money to pursue art in Italy, Gong Shim rents out her rooftop room to a pro bono lawyer, who begins shaking up her otherwise dispiriting life.

episodes.name: Are you a perverted lawyer?
episodes.overview: Ahn Dan-tae meets Gong Shim for the first time because she drops a pot from the rooftop. She sees him again around the neighborhood, seemingly bullying students and taking their money. This is a misunderstanding, and they just can't seem to avoid running into…

episodes.name: Are you my stalker?
episodes.overview: Shim visits Dan-tae's law office to ask about suing the lady that assaulted her at the gas station. Gong Mi removes the security camera evidence from the gas station to prevent her sister from filing a case. She requests that Shim drop her case. Meanwhile, Sh…

episodes.name: Do you want to do this by law or by fist?
episodes.overview: Shim finally gets her first full-time job! After seeing Dan-tae with Chairman Nam, Seok Dae-hwang gets Shim to investigate Dan-tae. Shim tries to get Dan-tae drunk to find out more about him but ends up making a fatal mistake.

episodes.name: I was curious about you ever since we first met
episodes.overview: Mi uses the information she gets from Shim to try and get closer to Jun-su. Dan-tae unknowingly confesses his feelings for Shim and gets embarrassed. Shim is confused by Dan-tae who keeps going back and forth. Meanwhile, Chairman Nam receives Seok Jun-pyo's n…

episodes.name: What do you think of Shim?
episodes.overview: Jun-su is surprised by Shim acting cold towards him in the office. While waiting for the chairman, Dan-tae overhears a shocking conversation between her and Jun-su. Meanwhile, Mi is about to get fired from her job for evidence manipulation.

episodes.name: Don’t stay close to other guys
episodes.overview: Dan-tae, Shim, and Jun-su have lunch together at the company cafeteria. Dan-tae gets jealous that Shim is so nice to Jun-su. In a battle of pride, he and Jun-su play basketball with the winner paying for coffee. All of this leaves Shim very confused.

episodes.name: Stop caring about me then
episodes.overview: Dan-tae teaches the secretaries that are talking behind Shim's back a lesson. He gives Shim a special gift since she's still upset about a misunderstanding they had. Meanwhile, Jun-su warns his mother to leave Shim alone when she tries to fire her for no good…

episodes.name: We can’t let them find him
episodes.overview: Yeom Tae-hui requests Yeom Tae-cheol to watch Dan-tae as he is starting to search for Jun-pyo. Tae-cheol visits Dan-tae's law office and discovers a shocking truth. Meanwhile, Mi joins the Star Group legal team at Dae-hwang and Tae-hui's request. She even get…

episodes.name: Should I go or not?
episodes.overview: Shim leaves for a horticulture center in Jeju Island. Dan-tae tells Chairman Nam that it'll be hard to find Jun-pyo and that he's very sorry. Shim continues to see things associated with Dan-tae wherever she goes in Jeju Island. Meanwhile, Dan-tae has that re…

episodes.name: I doubt the secret will last long
episodes.overview: Dan-tae asks Chairman Nam for a job! He runs into Mi at the company, and she begs him to keep it secret that she is Shim's sister. Meanwhile, Shim chases after the manager that ran off with her and her co-workers' pay and somehow ends up getting help from Dan…

episodes.name: Find out who this badge belongs to
episodes.overview: Dan-tae is working hard to find the person that left his father in a coma. But he is confused by the culprit's meticulous attack. Meanwhile, Shim enters a competition to design the character for the local octopus restaurant. She's only able to do so because D…

episodes.name: Did all of our information leak?
episodes.overview: Jun-su is shocked after finding out about Shim and Dan-tae's relationship. A strange tension grows between Dan-tae and Jun-su and they start to become distant. Meanwhile, Tae-cheol falls for the trap laid by Dan-tae and revisits the arboretum which is the sce…

episodes.name: Are you really coming with me?
episodes.overview: Jun-su gets drunk and ends up sleeping at Dan-tae's place. He is shocked by a memo left by Dan-tae on his calendar. Meanwhile, Shim can't hide her feelings for Dan-tae and goes all out to try and woo her crush. At Gong Cheol's request, she goes on a trip with…

episodes.name: I remember
episodes.overview: Jun-su starts to suspect Dan-tae's identity. Dan-tae acts really distant with Jun-su in order to hide the fact that he's Jun-pyo. Meanwhile, Dan-tae visits Chairman Nam's house and some of his childhood memories return to him.

episodes.name: I think Lawyer Ahn Dan-tae is Jun-pyo
episodes.overview: Dan-tae spots Jun-su continuing to act suspiciously. He loses his trust in Jun-su and suffers from the thought of not being able to be friends like they once were. Meanwhile, Jun-su waits for the results of Dan-tae's DNA test convicted that Dan-tae is Jun-pyo…

episodes.name: Stop looking for Jun-pyo
episodes.overview: Jun-su returns from a business trip and is shocked by the result of Dan-tae's DNA test. He goes to meet with Dan-tae. Meanwhile, Dan-tae can no longer stand to see Shim suffer from her one-way attraction and asks to meet her.

episodes.name: Can you quit working at Jun-su's company?
episodes.overview: Dan-tae discovers that the new job Shim got was at Jun-su's company. He doesn't like the fact that Jun-su and Shim will always be around each other. Meanwhile, Tae-cheol is pleased that his plan of splitting up Dan-tae and Jun-su is working. He believes that…

episodes.name: You’re the one who kidnapped Jun-pyo
episodes.overview: Dan-tae discovers that it was Tae-cheol who kidnapped Jun-pyo. He pays Tae-cheol a visit and gives him a stern warning. Meanwhile, Jun-su is devastated to learn that his mother was in on the kidnapping. He decides to join forces with his uncle.

episodes.name: Let’s end it now
episodes.overview: Dan-tae and Jun-su set a trap for Tae-cheol in order to secure evidence that he carried out the kidnapping. Meanwhile, Shim is pressured by the fact that Dan-tae was the heir of a conglomerate. But Dan-tae confesses his feelings for her, and they no longer ha…

episodes.name: How can you do this to me?
episodes.overview: Tae-cheol's underling tries to run Shim over as she leaves work. Jun-su sees this happen and is shocked. Meanwhile, Dan-tae wants to ask Shim to go to the U.S. with him but it's not so simple for him to do so.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Catching the eye of a wealthy gentleman, spunky Ha-won gets hired to live with his three immature grandsons so she can whip them into shape.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: High school student Ha-won works hard at her jobs while being mistreated by her stepfamily. Impressed by her spirit, Hyun-min makes her an offer.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: While posing as Hyun-min's fiancée, Ha-won encounters Ji-woon, who like Hyun-min is also a grandson of the Haneul Group chairman.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Ha-won comes to live with the chairman's three grandsons. Amid the odd circumstances, the chairman orders her to get everyone to dine together.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Yoon-sung tells Ha-won of the trauma the three grandsons have suffered. She presses on in her quest to bring them together.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Hye-ji recalls Ji-woon's promise to look after her, while Ha-won offers to help the chairman see his grandsons attend their fathers' memorial service.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The three cousins are moved by Ha-won and show up to pay their respects. Ha-won leaves the Haneul home and goes to stay with Hye-ji.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Hyun-min is humiliated after video of his confession spreads online. Ji-woon reveals the truth to Ha-won and brings her back home.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Ha-won is delighted at her success in bringing the boys on a trip together. Meanwhile, her stepmother searches for Ha-won's biological father.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Ha-won spies Yoon-sung heading into an organ transplantation center. Seo-woo's manager summons him to the office and shows him something.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Hye-ji's confession sends shock waves through both Ji-woon and Hyun-min. Ha-won hatches a plan to find out Ji-woon's true feelings.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: The romantic tension heats up as Hye-ji comes to stay with the Haneul family. Ha-won works on drawing attention to herself.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Distraught by the appearance of a man claiming to be her father, Ha-won finds comfort in Ji-woon's arms. Seo-woo pours out his heart on the radio.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Ha-won faces a difficult choice when the chairman finds out about her and Ji-woon. Yoon-sung spies on the chairman's wife.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Blaming herself for the chairman's collapse, Ha-won disappears. Seo-woo and Hyun-min volunteer as potential liver donors.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Hwa-ja finally makes her power grab. The chairman's grandsons are united in their hope for his recovery, but the operation poses serious risk.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: The transplant surgery is successful but Ji-woon remains unconscious. Hyun-min finds Ha-won and presents her with a pair of shoes.

episodes.name: The Disastrous Life of a Psychic + The Worst of the Worst?! Riki Nendou + Shun Kaidou, AKA The Jet-Black Wings + Intelligent and Beautiful! Kokomi Teruhashi
episodes.overview: Kusuo Saiki thought he could have an easy life despite his psychic abilities, but his sophomore year of high school quickly proves him wrong.

episodes.name: Hot-Blooded! Dodgeball! + Reach Him! Sign of Love + Saiki Family Home Renovation?! Drastic Makeover!! + Deceive! Mind Control
episodes.overview: Kusuo inadvertently makes a brilliant dodgeball play in gym class, putting him on a collision course with his athletic classmates Kineshi and Riki.

episodes.name: A Genius Magician?! Uryoku Chouno + Second Encounter (on TV)! Uryoku Chouno + How Shady! Dark Reunion! + Beachside Summer Story + A New School Term Starts! The…
episodes.overview: Kusuo's extrasensory perception makes him unable to enjoy famous illusionist Uryoku Chono's show. Annoyed, Chono dares him to display his own magic.

episodes.name: Please Make Me Your Apprentice! + Psychic Medium in the Class Next Door + Kineshi Hairo, in Search of Lumber + Home Alone Disaster + Crisis in Three-Month Rela…
episodes.overview: Young medium Reita Toritsuka, who can see ghosts, asks Kusuo to take him on as a student in ESP, but Reita's motivations are anything but noble.

episodes.name: Escape Using an Invincible Suit of Camouflage! + Get Fired Up! PK Academy Sports Day + Don’t Catch Fire! Safety Drill!
episodes.overview: Kusuo changes his routine so that he can get home from school in time to watch anime. His worried friends, meanwhile, are searching all over for him.

episodes.name: Enticing Premium Quality Coffee Jello + In Order to Avoid Misfortunes... + Teruhashi’s Biggest Trial + The Disastrous Life of the Psychic Medium Reita Toritsuk…
episodes.overview: Kusuo heads to the grocery store to buy dessert and has to decide which coffee jelly will give him the most satisfaction. Luckily, he has ESP!

episodes.name: Reign of the Small King + Frolic! Silent Night + Noisy New Year's
episodes.overview: Kusuo isn't a fan of cats or dogs because his telepathy and X-ray vision let him see animals as they really are. Then he meets a cat in a tight spot.

episodes.name: The Scariest! Mr. Matsuzaki + Chocolate Festival + Absolutely the Worst! Nendou’s Father + Totally Trusting! Kurumi Saiki + Telepathy Silencer
episodes.overview: Kusuo "overhears" his classmates planning to steal a confiscated item back from a terrifying teacher and has to decide whether or not to rat them out.

episodes.name: The Superstar Returns! + Cast the Die! An Upset in the Finals + Second Encounter (for Real This Time)! Uryoku Chouno + Mera’s Money Situation
episodes.overview: Kokomi worries that Kusuo will think she's dating the idol Toru Mugami. When Kusuo's mom becomes Mugami's newest fan, things get complicated.

episodes.name: Reignited! Physical Fitness Test! + Little Love Story + The Latest Crappy Game! Olfana’s Story + Welcome Home! Mama + The Best Way of Confessing Love?! Spirit-…
episodes.overview: The day of the sports test in gym class is not Kusuo's favorite. But it's paradise for Kineshi and Riki, who may have finally found worthy opponents.

episodes.name: Jump! Cyborg Cider-Man No. 2 + Industry-Leading, Top-Ranking Company?! Father’s Job + Cider-Man No. 2 vs. The Lemonade Fiend + Kusuo Saiki’s Holiday + Kusuo Sa…
episodes.overview: No good deed goes unpunished, as Kusuo learns when he retrieves a child named Yuta's balloon with his ESP and Yuta decides he's secretly a superhero.

episodes.name: Okinawa School Trip (Part 1)
episodes.overview: As a teleporter, Kusuo doesn't share his classmates' excitement about their class trip. He gets caught up in schemes about trip groups regardless.

episodes.name: Okinawa School Trip (Part 2)
episodes.overview: Kusuo wakes up at the beach to find that the hotel he was supposed to stay at has disappeared. An old sunken ship suddenly appears out of nowhere.

episodes.name: ’Sup Homies!! Outsider + A Transfer Student: The First Encounters + Mr. and Mrs. Nendou Together! + Reviving Café Mami! + Guilty or Not Guilty?! A Theft Case
episodes.overview: Bespectacled transfer student Aren Kuboyasu decides to use his new surroundings as an opportunity to distance himself from his delinquent past.

episodes.name: Which Idea Will Be Picked?! School Festival Planning + Sing! Reita’s Recital! + PK Academy School Festival
episodes.overview: The school festival draws near, and Kusuo's classmate Kineshi has a terrible idea: folding 50,000 paper cranes. Everyone else is opposed.

episodes.name: The Perfect Pretty Girl vs. the Super Stubborn Guy + Psychic Santa Claus + Let’s Go Buy the Latest Electronics! + New Year’s Cycle
episodes.overview: Kokomi's brother asks Kusuo for a favor about filming in their neighborhood. The next day at school, Kokomi invites him on a date as an apology.

episodes.name: Kaidou's Suspicion + No Intervention Needed?! Nendou vs. Kaidou + The Worst Part-Timer + Fierce Run! Runners Psi!
episodes.overview: On his way to school, Shun encounters Aren in the middle of the street. He's stumbled into a revenge plot, but it may be too late to escape.

episodes.name: Teruhashi's Second Visit to the Saiki Residence + It's a Piece of Cake! The Straw Millionaire + Transformation! Super Size + He Should Repeat the Grade + Max E…
episodes.overview: Kokomi drops by the Saiki household to get a cooking lesson from Kurumi, but Yuta is extremely suspicious of her, and Kusuo is in over his head.

episodes.name: Hurray! Tsundere Grandpa + Hip, Hip, Hurray! Tsundere Grandpa + Welcome to the Farthest Amusement Park! + See You Again! Saying Goodbye to the Grandparents + C…
episodes.overview: Kusuo and his family visit his mother's parents, the very kind Kumi and the very forbidding Kumagoro, whose bark is much worse than his bite.

episodes.name: Toritsuka's Plan to Get Popular + The PK Occult Club + The Worst Cooks + Kokomins Trial + The Disastrous ___th Episode of the Anime
episodes.overview: Kusuo overhears girls gossiping about their crushes on Reita, whose band made a big splash at the school festival, possibly for a sinister reason.

episodes.name: Here Comes the Mad Scientist + Run for It! A Battle of Wits + Please at Least Be Quiet in the Art Museum
episodes.overview: After Kusuo takes a direct hit from a baseball to his head walking past the field, he realizes one of the control devices on his head is missing.

episodes.name: Summer Break! The Occult Club Training Camp + The Tennis Club Training Camp + Clinical Testing Job + License Training Camp + A Date with Teruhashi
episodes.overview: Summer vacation approaches. Kusuo can hardly wait for some peace and quiet! However, his calendar quickly fills up with one annoyance after another.

episodes.name: The Heir to a Conglomerate Makes His Appearance + Tsundere Grandpa Returns! + Holding a Halloween Party + The Saiko Family's Unbeatable Financial Power
episodes.overview: Transfer student Metori Saiko joins the class, but his haughty attitude is as big as his family's fortune. Kusuo wonders if he has an ulterior motive.

episodes.name: Talent Blossoms?! Melancholy of a Popular Magician + An Exercise in Runaway Delusion + Break-time Disaster + Crushed! Surprise Party
episodes.overview: Kusuo receives an invitation to a magic show featuring Chono and Michael, whose powers have apparently grown prodigiously.

episodes.name: Restarting! Everyday Life, “As Usual” + Another Christmas Challenge! + First Experiences of the Year Are Important + Courtside Love Game + Dessert Buffet Disas…
episodes.overview: One week after the events of last season, psychic Kusuo Saiki hopes to return to his normal life. Except, life is very far from normal, as always.

episodes.name: Firsthand Science Fiction + 'Sup! Love Challenge + Fashion Sense out of Stock
episodes.overview: Kusuo's parents celebrate their wedding anniversary but he ignores them. The next day, he makes a mistake that puts all of their futures in danger.

episodes.name: Midwinter Disaster + The Saiko Conglomerate Home Visit + Come On Over to Saiko Land! + Invincible Disaster Prevention Measures + Congratulations on Your Gradua…
