episodes.overview: Kusuo and his friends brave the bitter cold to go to school but it's freezing inside. Just as things look really bad, a warmhearted savior arrives.

episodes.name: The Disastrous Life of Imu Rifuta + April Fools' Deceit! + Spring's Ultimate Weapon + Recycle! Trash Cleanup Competition + Cutting Through the Silence, the Gho…
episodes.overview: Cute new student Imu Rifuta's appearance has the schoolboys psyched up. But Kokomi stands in the way of her dominance of school cuteness.

episodes.name: Rematch! Rifuta vs Teruhashi + Gifts of the Magi + The Lost Hamster with a Kansai Dialect + The Transient Miniature Animal + Massage Disaster
episodes.overview: Kokomi may have knocked Imu down, but she's not out yet. Sensing her rival likes Kusuo, she goes after him. Oddly, this is exactly what he wants...?

episodes.name: The Saiko Conglomerate's Luxurious Cruise + The Shipwreck of Saiki K. (Part 1)
episodes.overview: Metori plans a luxurious weekend cruise to his private island, but the yacht taking everyone there has some unforeseen (Saiki) issues leaving them stranded on a deserted island.

episodes.name: The Shipwreck of Saiki K. (Part 2) + The PK Academy Press Club Guillotine + Farewell! The Last Day of Summer Break
episodes.overview: The classmates are still stuck on the island but manage to complete a raft. Metori demands they decide who will ride and who gets to stay behind.

episodes.name: A Totally Bad News Transfer Student Appears! + Escape the Aural Sight! + The Circumstances of Delicate Children + Another Time Leap Challenge! + The Disastrous…
episodes.overview: Sexy student Mikoto Aiura transfers in and impresses everyone with her fortunetelling. Kusuo realizes she may be the real deal and thus his rival.

episodes.name: Psychics Should Exercise Extreme Caution + The Psychic Circus of Dreams + Hope You Get Well Soon!
episodes.overview: Kusuo's managed to escape identification by Mikoto by hiding his aura, but she's not about to give up on her search for the mysterious "S. K."

episodes.name: Preventing a Scam! + The Saiki Family Reunion! + The Rural Mad Scientist + PK Academy Psykickers Assemble!
episodes.overview: Kusuo's grandfather Kumagoro gets a suspicious call asking for money and quickly realizes it's a scam. He asks Kusuo for help with revenge.

episodes.name: An Ugly Bolt Out of the Blue + Conceal Your Hidden Power! + A Fight Between the Two Worst People + A Miraculously Average Guy Appears! + Disaster in the Librar…
episodes.overview: Riki Nendo gets a love letter from a freshman coed and Kusuo figures it's a prank, but he soon realizes she's serious. Nendo, being Nendo, wants to say no.

episodes.name: A Strong Declaration of Friendship + The Best Wing Girl!? + The Adventures of Riki Jr. No. 2, Small and Smart + The Disastrous Life of Hiroshi Satou + Trim a B…
episodes.overview: In order to win against school idol Kokomi, Imu attempts to profess her love for Kusuo. Riki's pet hamster wreaks havoc inside the school.

episodes.name: Chisato Mera's Reunion + An Abnormality with Silent Cyborg + The Ultimate Spot Claimers + Preface to the Final Episode
episodes.overview: Kusuo and Mikoto visit Chisato, who's working new jobs to save up enough money to visit her dad in Puerto Rico. But Mikoto soon divines a surprise.

episodes.name: The Saiko Family's Greatest Trial + Psychic Sidekicks + The Occult Club's Final Scream Scheme + Love Score Showdown + The Master Artist's Classroom
episodes.overview: Forced to survive for 24 hours without relying on his rich family, Metori Saiko enlists the help of Riki and the others.

episodes.name: Rebuilding the Baseball Team! + Eat Your Vegetables Too! The Yakiniku Epilogue + Dad's New Job!? + Birthday Present Demands
episodes.overview: Kusuo and his friends decide to follow Riki after hearing that he is going to go help the Baseball Club, which results in one cliché after another.

episodes.name: If You're Looking for a Boyfriend... + The Best Present for a Beloved Sister + The Spirit Medium Debuts Again + The High Tech Soldier, 100 Yen Man! + Inside th…
episodes.overview: Imu begs Kusuo to help her find a suitable boy before she goes absolutely crazy over Kokomi. Self-professed "love-master" Chiyo steps in to help.

episodes.name: He's Back! The Brother's Five Directives + Let's Go to the Zoo! + The Disastrous Work of a New Manga Author + The Disastrous Lives of the Kaidou Brothers + A G…
episodes.overview: Kusuo receives an explosive surprise from his brother Kusuke, who has a challenge for him. If Kusuo fails, Kusuke will expose him as a psychic to the world via firework.

episodes.name: Touma Akechi, the Transfer Student Who Never Shuts Up + The Transfer Student's Still Talking! + Sweet Potato Digging Disaster + Putting the Mascot Characters i…
episodes.overview: New student Touma Akechi joins the class but there's something about him that's different from the other transfers, besides his extreme verbosity.

episodes.name: Class Disaster + PK Academy Cultural Festival
episodes.overview: The school festival is coming up and Kusuo's class must pick a boy-girl pair to volunteer, setting the stage for an intense battle of wits.

episodes.name: Impersonation via Hypnosis + High Expectations on the New, Fully Functional Mascot + This Year's the Last Time! New Year's Eve + Silent New Year's
episodes.overview: After accidentally turning Riki and Shun into stone, Kusuo comes up with a plan to hypnotically substitute them with other friends. Hilarity ensues.

episodes.name: Chronicles of the Grandparents' Travels + Returning the Favor, Toritsuka's Ascetic Fasting + A Misunderstanding Between Opposite Sex Friends + A Big Scoop!
episodes.overview: Kusuo's grandparents are visiting but get delayed on the way to the house. Luckily, or perhaps unluckily, his friends soon find them and try to help.

episodes.name: Choosing the Best Person to Walk Home With + Details Wanted! The Super Idol's Secret + Division of Labor + Facing the Unexpected
episodes.overview: After getting blamed alongside his friends when they cause trouble, Kusuo vows to go home alone the next day. But then Kineshi insists on joining him.

episodes.name: Facing an Unusual Past
episodes.overview: With Touma Akechi about to find out his secret, Kusuo goes back in time to elementary school to keep Touma from even suspecting that Kusuo has psychic powers.

episodes.name: Trial of the Perfect Beautiful Girl + Make Your Investigation, Psykickers! + Disaster Back from the Holidays + Remembering the Cast
episodes.overview: Kokomi's beauty and kindness are admired by all but her efforts spark some unexpected actions among her male classmates, leading to trouble.

seasons.name: Dr. Romantic
seasons.overview: Bu Yong-ju was once a famous surgeon at the peak of his career at a major hospital. But he suddenly gives it all up one day to live in seclusion and work as a neighborhood doctor in a small town. He now goes by Teacher Kim and refers to himself as the “Romant…

episodes.name: How to Put an Elephant into a Fridge?
episodes.overview: A heroic doctor steps in to help a distraught boy. Intern Gang Dong-ju helps Dr. Yun Seo-jeong with emergencies at Geosan University Medical Center.

episodes.name: The Result of the Hypersecretion of Adrenaline
episodes.overview: Dong-ju wonders whether hard work is enough to get ahead. Doldam Hospital gets a new doctor in general surgery. Seo-jeong sees a face from the past.

episodes.name: Friday of 13 People
episodes.overview: Dong-ju questions Teacher Kim's ways, despite his awe-inspiring skills. Seo-jeong must deal with the ramifications of her actions.

episodes.name: Necessary and Sufficient Condition
episodes.overview: Dong-ju finds that he's no match for Teacher Kim and becomes desperate to leave. Doldam receives a VIP visitor. Seo-jeong gets a new role.

episodes.name: Principle of Relative
episodes.overview: Being principled may be relative. It's all hands on deck after a major highway accident. Dong-ju tries to find out more about Teacher Kim's identity.

episodes.name: Motivation
episodes.overview: Teacher Kim makes demands of his own. Myeong-sim shows the staff how it's done. Associates from Seoul stop by Doldam. In-beom makes a gut call.

episodes.name: Unstable Factor
episodes.overview: When Doldam gets a surprise, everyone tries to cope. Dong-ju wants to know where he stands. Teacher Kim gets what he wants -- for now.

episodes.name: The Manifestation of Humanism
episodes.overview: A patient comes first -- no matter what. Seo-jeong gets an unexpected pep talk. Teacher Kim's compassion proves to be multilayered.

episodes.name: The Boundary of Good
episodes.overview: Dong-ju makes a call -- to Chairman Shin. Teacher Kim reminds Yun-wan of the importance of basics. Seo-jeong vexes an old mentor. It's Friday at Doldam.

episodes.name: Crush
episodes.overview: The inspector from Geosan tries to stop the Doldam staff from treating patients. But there's a multicar accident -- and a drunk driver at the scene.

episodes.name: Psychological Entropy
episodes.overview: Yun-wan wants to know if Dong-ju is on his side. A soldier goes missing. Seo-jeong doesn't back down, but Teacher Kim shows her how it's truly done.

episodes.name: The Boiling Point
episodes.overview: Dong-ju gets bad advice and faces the consequences. Seo-jeong gets put on the spot. Yun-wan dials up the pressure but Teacher Kim pushes back.

episodes.name: The Art of Turmoil
episodes.overview: The staff starts preparing for Chairman Shin's surgery and Seo-jeong gets her big chance. Doldam may have an epidemic on its hands.

episodes.name: Paragonimiasis Effect
episodes.overview: Seo-jeong volunteers to deal with a critical patient. Doldam averts a crisis. Dong-ju shows his appreciation. Teacher Kim catches In-beom's mistake.

episodes.name: The Cornered Stone Syndrome
episodes.overview: In a twisted world that demands blind obedience to its rules, there's no room for those with integrity and ability. Shin's surgery gets complicated.

episodes.name: Burden of Risk
episodes.overview: Teacher Kim plans to do the impossible, and Yun-wan will do anything to stop him. In-beom wants to do the surgery -- for the team, not his father.

episodes.name: Moment of Truth
episodes.overview: A large audience waits outside the operating room -- and not everyone wants the team to prevail. A shifty reporter starts lurking around Doldam.

episodes.name: Whether You Want It or Not
episodes.overview: It's only after time passes that seemingly minor moments in life start taking on greater meaning. Yun-wan gets his way -- and orders Doldam's closure.

episodes.name: Doctors and Righteous People
episodes.overview: Yun-wan makes sure that old wounds don't lie dormant. The furtive reporter keeps snooping around. Dong-ju confronts Teacher Kim about the past.

episodes.name: The Law of Conservation of Romance
episodes.overview: Teacher Kim takes the staff to Seoul. Yun-wan won't let his old rival have the spotlight. Bu Yong-ju is hurt but stands by romance and his principles.

seasons.name: Dr. Romantic 2
seasons.overview: Along with genius Teacher Kim, Cha Eun-jae is a second-year fellow in the cardio surgery department who enjoys studying and has confidently walked the path of an elite student for most of her life. Seo U-jin, a cynical second year fellow who doesn’t believe i…

episodes.name: Rainmaker
episodes.overview: During his trip to the main hospital, Teacher Kim leaves an impression — especially on three young doctors who find themselves in his hospital lobby.

episodes.name: Mechanism of Accidents
episodes.overview: Teacher Kim shocks Seo U-jin with his unconventional approach to saving a high-ranking official, and bans Cha Eun-jae from assisting his surgeries.

episodes.name: Undefined Setting Value
episodes.overview: Do Yun-wan creates chaos by bringing his own team of doctors. U-jin's participation in Park Min-guk's surgery sparks a misunderstanding.

episodes.name: Utilizing Conflict
episodes.overview: U-jin gets caught in the middle of two feuding teams of doctors when the family of a patient threatens to sue for malpractice.

episodes.name: A Living Friday Night
episodes.overview: New doctors get a taste of their first Friday at Doldam Hospital. U-jin refuses to treat a patient who triggers his childhood trauma.

episodes.name: Placebo
episodes.overview: Teacher Kim leads his team in saving two critical patients at the same time. Eun-jae steps in to protect a woman from her abusive husband.

episodes.name: The Line that Should be Protected
episodes.overview: Min-guk becomes determined to turn people away from Teacher Kim. A situation Eun-jae tries to mitigate takes a turn for the worse.

episodes.name: Walk of Respect
episodes.overview: Even in her final moments, a paramedic helps save another's life. U-jin shows Eun-jae his way of resetting the mind from worries.

episodes.name: Trauma
episodes.overview: U-jin looks into diagnoses for Teacher Kim's arm pain. A bus accident conjures up a regretful moment that haunts Min-guk's conscience.

episodes.name: The Effects of an Adequate Amount of Anxiety
episodes.overview: Yoon A-reum protects a patient's rape kit from falling into wrong hands. Min-guk finally brings up the bus accident from 11 years ago to Teacher Kim.

episodes.name: Minimum Boundaries
episodes.overview: Min-guk asserts his authority by restructuring the hospital staff. U-jin is stunned to learn which surgeon was behind a faulty operation.

episodes.name: An Error of Exchange of Equivalents
episodes.overview: A recruiter with bitter resentment for U-jin tries to tempt staff members to leave Doldam Hospital. Eunjae's mom asks for a favor.

episodes.name: Defense Mechanism
episodes.overview: Eun-jae panics when she runs out of medication from Teacher Kim before surgery. U-jin gets coerced into leaving Doldam Hospital.

episodes.name: Selective Dyslexia
episodes.overview: Teacher Kim tasks U-jin with a final assignment. Min-guk performs surgery on a VIP patient despite pushback from Shim Hye-jin.

episodes.name: Rapport; Trust Relationship
episodes.overview: Do In-beom returns to Doldam Hospital to investigate an unsuccessful surgery. Min-guk decides between his greed and the truth.

episodes.name: Koi's Law
episodes.overview: Bae Mun-jeong comes clean to U-jin about the connection between their families. Teacher Kim secures a safe future for Doldam Hospital.

seasons.name: Dr. Romantic 3
seasons.overview: Teacher Kim used to be alone in protecting Doldam Hospital, but now he's not alone anymore. With the mindset that he'll did anything if it gives money, there is Seo U-jin who has been reborn as a doctor who truly knows how to care for patients. There is Cha E…

episodes.name: Break Line
episodes.overview: The medical staff of Doldam Hospital fly out in a helicopter to a ship lost out at sea on behalf of Teacher Kim, who is absent on vacation.

episodes.name: Between Ethics and Reality
episodes.overview: As the patient's lung condition deteriorates due to tuberculosis, Teacher Kim opens the trauma centre operating room for Ri Bok-young's surgery.

episodes.name: How to Put an Elephant into a Fridge? Part 2
episodes.overview: Doldam Hospital hires new personnel. The people of Doldam, who thought Teacher Kim would be the new head of the trauma centre, hold an emergency meeting.

episodes.name: Abracadabra
episodes.overview: Patients injured in a residential fire are rushed into the emergency room. Seo U-jin treats the suspected arsonist despite Jang Dong-hwa's criticism.

episodes.name: Code Clear
episodes.overview: Cha Jin-man hates that Teacher Kim's methods are deeply rooted into Doldam Hospital and takes everyone except Lee Seon-ung and Dong-hwa to the trauma centre.

episodes.name: Empathy & Sympathy
episodes.overview: The trauma centre loses a patient and receives another patient in critical condition. Meanwhile, a child visits Teacher Kim at Doldam Hospital.

episodes.name: Inciting Hope
episodes.overview: Wounded soldiers are rushed to Doldam Hospital. A-reum is left alone to tend to the emergency room when rogue patients suddenly cause a scene.

episodes.name: Underdog Effect
episodes.overview: Patients rush into the emergency room while the staff tends to surgeries. Doldam Hospital falls into chaos as the gunman's identity is revealed.

episodes.name: The Righteous Doctor Complex
episodes.overview: When an old building collapses resulting in several casualties, a disaster medical support team is dispatched to the site.

episodes.name: The Abuse of Justice
episodes.overview: Doldam Hospital receives news of a second collapse, but the place is still full of injured people. Teacher Kim leaves everything and heads to the scene.

episodes.name: The Certainty of Uncertainty
episodes.overview: Go Gyeong-suk does not give up the legal battle over her son's death. She proposes a secret deal to bring down Jin-man, but Teacher Kim opposes to it.

episodes.name: The Courage to be Ordinary
episodes.overview: Jin-man fails to find the culprit who broke into the director's office. His reputation is further ruined as incidents from his past become known.

episodes.name: The Parrotbill Paradox
episodes.overview: Gang Dong-ju returns to Doldam Hospital, with his unconventional proposals causing a stir in the trauma centre.

episodes.name: The Addiction to Success
episodes.overview: Eun-jae performs emergency surgery on a non-trauma patient while she must join another surgery for a patient with multiple traumas.

episodes.name: The Game Changer
episodes.overview: People injured from a forest fire rush into Doldam Hospital. Yet, the trauma centre is empty due to the staff staging a boycott against Dong-ju.

episodes.name: Dreamers
episodes.overview: A fire approaches as if it would devour Doldam Hospital at any moment. Only after evacuating all the patients do the staff realise Teacher Kim was gone.

episodes.name: Starting Over
episodes.overview: Akko is finally matriculating at Luna Nova Witchcraft Academy! But she faces expulsion if she doesn't get to the entrance ceremony.

episodes.name: Pappiliodya
episodes.overview: Akko is excited when her classes finally start, but learning magic turns out to be boring. Worse, her classmates make fun of her for admiring Chariot.

episodes.name: Don't Stop Me Now
episodes.overview: Akko starts flying lessons using a broom that Professor Ursula gives her, but she struggles -- and the Academy's broom relay race is coming up.

episodes.name: Night Fall
episodes.overview: Akko, Lotte and Sucy receive detention for stealing a tart. They're also forbidden to go into town, even though Lotte is dying to go to a book event.

episodes.name: Pact of the Dragon
episodes.overview: After getting into a fight in class, Akko and Amanda have detention together: They must clean the New Moon Tower, where they find dragons.

episodes.name: The Fountain
episodes.overview: Unable to master even basic transformation magic, Akko is relegated to her room and must miss the welcome party for a VIP and his handsome son.

episodes.name: Orange Submariner
episodes.overview: Akko gets serious about studying but can't master the basics, even with Professor Ursula's help. She flubs test after test, risking her enrollment.

episodes.name: Akko's Adventure in Sucyworld
episodes.overview: After drinking an experimental brew, Sucy falls into a deep sleep and won't wake up. To save her, Lotte sends Akko into Sucy's mushroom-filled dream.

episodes.name: Undead Travelogue
episodes.overview: On a trip off school grounds, Akko breaks the no-magic rule and raises a skeleton from the dead. When it runs off, she and her friends must chase it.

episodes.name: Bee Affection
episodes.overview: Akko and her friends invite themselves to Andrew's party, where Sucy releases a magical bee whose sting ignites a deep infatuation in its victims.

episodes.name: Blue Moon
episodes.overview: Desperate to know if she can ever overcome her magical difficulties to be like Shiny Chariot, Akko uses the blue moon's power to search for an answer.

episodes.name: What You Will
episodes.overview: Akko hopes to win the same award at the upcoming school magic festival that Shiny Chariot won years ago, but Diana looks to be the prime candidate.

episodes.name: Samhain Magic Festival
episodes.overview: As the festival draws nearer, Akko has a novel idea for spicing up the sacrificial ceremony. But she'll need a lot of help to pull it off.

episodes.name: New Age Magic
episodes.overview: The school's fairies go on strike and cut off Luna Nova's source of magic. A new teacher arrives and proposes a non-traditional mechanical solution.

episodes.name: Chariot of Fire
episodes.overview: Akko agrees to let Professor Croix conduct a magical analysis of the Shiny Rod. Professor Ursula senses danger and rushes to Croix's tower.

episodes.name: Pohjola's Ordeal
episodes.overview: While visiting Lotte’s parents, Akko wakes up to find the town's residents struck by a mysterious ailment that can only be cured by a witch.

episodes.name: Amanda O'Neill and the Holy Grail
episodes.overview: Akko's quest to find Shiny Chariot leads her to seek a special chalice hidden at Andrew's prestigious all-boys school. She and Amanda sneak in.

episodes.name: Stanship Take Off!
episodes.overview: As the annual Wild Hunt approaches, Akko tries to help her taciturn classmate Constanze, with mixed results. Professor Croix hatches a plot.

episodes.name: Cavendish
episodes.overview: A family situation forces Diana to quit Luna Nova and head home, shocking the school. Refusing to accept the loss of her "rival," Akko follows her.

episodes.name: Intellect and Sensibility
episodes.overview: Diana enters the Cavendish family sanctuary. Akko and Andrew overhear Daryl gloating about trapping Diana to prevent her completing the ceremony.

episodes.name: Discipline
episodes.overview: Croix tells Akko the sixth word is related to the wagandea tree, but Ursula forbids her from going. Andrew hears about a mind-altering new app.

episodes.name: Things We Said Today
episodes.overview: Ursula tells Akko the seventh word although she herself doesn't know its meaning. She's about to reveal everything when a message arrives from Andrew.

episodes.name: Yesterday
episodes.overview: Akko disappears after she learns the truth, and her friends are worried. Ursula recalls her past with Croix before Diana confronts her.

episodes.name: A Road to Arcturus
episodes.overview: Ursula confronts Croix, but fails to prevent her carrying out her plan. Akko, Diana and their friends are swept into the Arcturus Forest.

episodes.name: Changing at the Edge of the World
episodes.overview: Everyone seems powerless to stop the magical missile. But Akko believes otherwise, and her friends the "New Nine Witches" follow her lead.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: While strange rumors about their ill king grip a kingdom, the crown prince becomes their only hope against a mysterious plague overtaking the land.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Officials find notices in Hanyang alleging the king is dead. Crown Prince Lee Chang tries to check on his father, but the young queen stands in his way.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Prince Chang and Mu-yeong arrive at Jiyulheon, where they make a horrific discovery. Seo-bi’s story of what she saw eerily resonates with Prince Chang.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Night leads to chaos in Dongnae. Cho Hak-ju and the queen oversee the king’s care. Prince Chang reaches a disquieting conclusion and vows to fight back.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: On his way to seek Lord Ahn Hyeon’s help, Prince Chang encounters a group of stranded survivors and leads them to Jiyulheon, following Seo-bi’s advice.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Prince Chang’s group comes across a village that oddly seems to be well-fed. While taking refuge at Lord Ahn Hyeon’s, Seo-bi notes something peculiar.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Cho Hak-ju has chilling words for the queen, who’s hiding a sinister secret. Prince Chang orders Sangju’s defenses, but Seo-bi senses something awry.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The outbreak leaves no one safe. But the infected are not the only monsters in Prince Chang's way as he fights to protect the kingdom.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: An unexpected setback in Sangju poses new problems for Prince Chang and the others. Seo-bi and Cho Beom-pal seek safety with Cho Hak-ju.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: After Prince Chang breaks into Mungyeong Saejae, a nightmare unfolds. Officials search the queen's home, suspecting she is hiding something.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: When Cho Hak-ju is taken from his custody, Prince Chang goes after him. Seo-bi looks for a way to treat the disease. The queen awaits her prince.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Seo-bi shares a critical discovery with Prince Chang, who has a favor to ask of her. Cho Hak-ju visits the queen and demands she tell him the truth.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: To save innocent lives, Prince Chang and his men take over Hanyang. The queen determines that if she can't have the throne, no one can.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: With the palace painted red with blood, Prince Chang is forced to pursue a risky strategy. Seo-bi takes the baby and hides.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In need of a bodyguard, a longtime celeb hires a secret agent. Together, they solve crimes, fight the bad guys and get tangled up in a love triangle.

episodes.name: Ghost Agent K
episodes.overview: We meet Kim Seol-woo during a hostage situation, where he takes out the hostage takers against orders. He's recruited by the NIS to become a ghost agent: deeply planted into organizations, fake identities and operating discreetly.

episodes.name: Working for Un Gwang
episodes.overview: Neither Woon-Gwang nor his chief celeb manager Cha Do-Ha likes his new bodyguard. If they can't make him leave, they'll just make him want to leave.

episodes.name: Visiting Chairman Victor
episodes.overview: After leavening that Woon-Gwang has been involved in a similar accident before, Seol-Woo relays his suspicions to Lee Dong-Hyun, his comrade and mentor.

episodes.name: Did You Think I Liked You?
episodes.overview: From Chairman Victor's private collection of precious cultural artefacts, a wood carving catches Seol-Woo's eye. Then the power suddenly goes out.

episodes.name: Go with Your Feelings
episodes.overview: For his next task, Seol-woo must get close to Do-ha, but it isn't so easy when she has forbidden him to approach her within a 1-meter radius

episodes.name: Goldfinger Is Back
episodes.overview: Seol-woo gets drunk and sends cute text messages, all in the name of his mission. Meanwhile, Congressman Baek tries to make a deal with Jang Tae-ho.

episodes.name: From This Moment, I Resign
episodes.overview: To stop Seol-woo from blowing his cover, Dong-hyun tells him to stay out of the investigation. However, Seol-woo continues his search for the culprit.

episodes.name: Being a Bodyguard Was a Disguise
episodes.overview: Do-ha asks to hear the truth directly from Seol-woo. Meanwhile, Dong-hyun and Seol-woo begin preparation for their next mission, the Black Auction.

episodes.name: The Black Auction Mission
episodes.overview: For the country and Do-ha's father, Un-kwang decides to help Seol-woo. Do-ha, not able to trust Seol-woo, requires him to sign a contract.

episodes.name: An Agent's Tactic
episodes.overview: Jang Tae-ho lays down his conditions to Mo Seung-jae. For their new mission to commence, Seol-woo and Do-ha must first get the approval of Un-kwang.

episodes.name: Finding the Mole
episodes.overview: Seol-woo doesn't pick up Do-ha's phone calls, so she decides to check his workroom. Dong-hyun visits Jang Tae-ho and asks if he knows where K is.

episodes.name: The Path
episodes.overview: All sides involved, including Lee Dong-hyun, Mo Seung-jae and the National Intelligence Service, are continuing the search for the missing videotapes.

episodes.name: A Message From "Y"
episodes.overview: Jang Tae-ho and Lee Dong-hyun discuss Song Mi-eun and her past: She decided to marry Mo Seung-jae, not for his wealth but for her own survival.

episodes.name: Lovers Tactic
episodes.overview: The police find the vehicle involved in the hit-and-run accident. Determined to kill off the bad guys, Seol-woo gets his gun from his workroom.

episodes.name: Only the Truth Can Save You
episodes.overview: For Seol-woo, it's finally time for revenge. For all involved, it's finally time for closure and for punishments to be given where they are due.

episodes.name: Life Must Go On
episodes.overview: For Seol-woo, it's finally time for revenge. For all involved, it's finally time for closure and for punishments to be given where they are due.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: An unlikely partnership is forged, between a passionate cop and an emotionless prosecutor, to bring an evasive serial killer to justice.

episodes.name: I Am Innocent
episodes.overview: As a teen, prosecutor Hwang Si-mok received surgical treatment for his abnormally developed brain, but the procedure left behind serious side effects.

episodes.name: Just Turn On The Lights
episodes.overview: The convict's strong plea for his innocence prompts Si-mok to review the CCTV clip. At the Yongsan police station, he runs into officer Han Yeo-jin.

episodes.name: A New Possible Suspect
episodes.overview: Si-mok volunteers to appear on live national TV to discuss Kang Jin-seob. He also makes a bold promise to find the culprit within two months.

episodes.name: Kwon Min Ah
episodes.overview: Rumors quickly spread about Si-mok's violent nature. Regardless, he persists in his investigation. He finds his mentee, Young Eun-su, suspicious.

episodes.name: The Second Huam-dong Case
episodes.overview: Si-mok, puzzled by the details of the most recent murder case, visits the victim's home to seek more clues. Yeo-jin joins him in the investigation.

episodes.name: The Ringtone
episodes.overview: New pieces of evidence only increase the list of possible suspects. In the midst of the confusion, a few begin to question Si-mok's innocence.

episodes.name: Ga Young's Phone
episodes.overview: Si-mok and Yeo-jin team up to covertly pursue Seo Dong-jae. Just as Dong-jae is about to throw something into the Han River, Yeo-jin stops him.

episodes.name: Western Seoul Prosecutors' Office
episodes.overview: Enraged by what the police did to Park Kyung-wan, Yeo-jin tries to confront her superior but is stopped by Si-mok, who warns her of the consequences.

episodes.name: Special Investigation
episodes.overview: Si-mok selects key lawyers and police officers to be part of the special investigations team. Their probe begins with Dong-jae as the starting point.

episodes.name: Revelation
episodes.overview: Fearing for Ga-young's safety, Yeo-jin proceeds to transfer her to a different hospital. A nurse informs Yeo-jin of something strange that happened.

episodes.name: Cold and Damp
episodes.overview: The truth behind Ga-young's convulsions is revealed. Chang-jun's wife receives a travel ban. Woo-gyun asks Chang-jun to help him get out of his mess.

episodes.name: Disbandment
episodes.overview: Si-mok and Yeo-jin discover perplexing leads while searching Kyung-wan's basement. Dong-jae goes back to Chang-jun's office to fetch his cell phone.

episodes.name: 0 and 7
episodes.overview: Returning home from the rooftop party, Si-mok discovers that an intruder has left something in his bedroom. Yeo-jin and Geon come over right away.

episodes.name: Another Body
episodes.overview: Yeo-jin suspects a new killer is involved in the latest murder incident. Meanwhile, Si-mok collapses after leaving the autopsy.

episodes.name: Accomplice
episodes.overview: Yeo-jin collects evidence as Si-mok interrogates the suspect. Many questions get answered, but the most important problem of all remains to be solved.

episodes.name: A Monster
episodes.overview: Si-mok sets out to meet the one he believes is the real murderer. He gets his hands on a bag that will determine the futures of many people.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In the midst of a power clash between prosecutors and police, Si-mok and Yeo-jin uncover murky secrets as they pursue a labyrinth of intertwined cases.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: On a foggy night, two college students drown at the beach. While Si-mok investigates, Yeo-jin tracks down a man who was at the scene of the incident.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Police and prosecutors each prepare members for joint discussions on investigative authority. Dong-jae brings Woo Tae-ha some cases of interest.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Yeo-jin recruits Geon. Digging into a policeman's death ruled as suicide, Si-mok and Dong-jae find signs that point toward a different story.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: In a heated first session with prosecutors, Geon makes a pointed argument. At Hanjo, Lee Yeon-jae faces an oncoming family power struggle.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: At the prison to interrogate an inmate, Yeo-jin runs into Si-mok and Dong-jae. Choi Bit has Yeo-jin deliver a mysterious file to an assemblyman.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Si-mok is ordered to find out what Yeo-jin knows about Bit's file. Ahead of a vote on the fate of her seat, Yeon-jae sets up an important meeting.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: When Si-mok hears who’s gone missing, he starts gathering clues by going through phone records. Yeo-jin begins her own investigation.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Leading police efforts to locate Dong-jae, Yeo-jin connects the case to that of the dead policeman. Si-mok pays Yeon-jae a visit.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: A perplexing photo containing a disturbing message surfaces. The police consider the possibility of the culprit being one of their own.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Si-mok turns his attention to an unusual case involving the sudden death of a former prosecutor, and finds that nothing quite adds up.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: A witness, who says he saw the kidnapping, steps forward to identify the perpetrator. His claims could mean serious trouble for the police.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Taken off the case, Si-mok and Yeo-jin return to their work on the police-prosecutor council. Tae-ha and Bit head to a sensitive meeting together.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Kang Won-chul weighs a dilemma, and fields questions from Si-mok about the deceased attorney. A young prosecutor has something to show Si-mok.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: A suspect is arrested, but Dong-jae remains nowhere to be found. In the interrogation room, Si-mok and Yeo-jin try to draw out a confession.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: While getting to the truth about the night of the attorney's death, Si-mok and Yeo-jin learn about the involvement of a mystery person.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Details of the cover-up become public, but Si-mok isn't finished asking questions. The police-prosecutor council is called off.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When his wife is accused of witchcraft and executed by the church, Dracula declares war on humanity and unleashes an army of monsters upon Wallachia. Trevor Belmont, the last surviving member of a disgraced family of monster hunters, sets out to stop Dracula…

episodes.name: Witchbottle
episodes.overview: A headstrong young woman seeks out forbidden knowledge, and a corrupt bishop courts disaster by enraging a legend.

episodes.name: Necropolis
episodes.overview: Trevor Belmont drifts into the panicked city of Gresit, where he learns of an ancient evil and makes a surprising vow.

episodes.name: Labyrinth
episodes.overview: Belmont explores the catacombs of Gresit and makes a disturbing discovery. As night falls on the city, the beasts return for blood.

episodes.name: Monument
episodes.overview: Belmont strives to save Gresit from certain doom and comes face to face with a shocking truth.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: As Dracula and his legion of vampires prepare to rid the world of humanity's stain, an unlikely trio of heroes dares to stand in their way.

episodes.name: War Council
episodes.overview: Dracula entrusts a deadly -- and personal -- mission with two humans who truly hate humanity, not knowing that he himself has become a target.

episodes.name: Old Homes
episodes.overview: As Belmont shares a bold strategy with Alucard and Sypha, Dracula addresses a conflict within his ranks. Isaac recalls a painful encounter.

episodes.name: Shadow Battles
episodes.overview: Belmont travels to his family's archives, along with Sypha and a cynical Alucard. Godbrand voices a suspicion about Dracula's motives.

episodes.name: Broken Mast
episodes.overview: As Godbrand's thirst grows stronger, Carmilla tries to recruit Hector. Isaac shows his loyalty, and Belmont shares a family story with Sypha.

episodes.name: Last Spell
episodes.overview: Carmilla presses forward with her plan despite Godbrand's disappearance. Sypha makes a startling discovery while combing the archives.

episodes.name: The River
episodes.overview: Does he really have what it takes to live up to his family's reputation? It's time for Belmont to pick his fate. Also, Dracula prepares for the fight.

episodes.name: For Love
episodes.overview: With nothing less than the future of humanity at stake, Belmont, Alucard and Sypha do battle with their immortal enemy: Dracula.

episodes.name: End Times
episodes.overview: With the war between humans and vampires seemingly settled, the survivors -- both good and evil -- look toward the future.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Belmont and Sypha settle into a village with sinister secrets, Alucard mentors a pair of admirers, and Isaac embarks on a quest to locate Hector.

episodes.name: Bless Your Dead Little Hearts
episodes.overview: Alucard adjusts to his lonely new life, Belmont and Sypha pay a visit to an eerie and unusual town, and Carmilla returns home with a prize.

episodes.name: The Reparation of My Heart
episodes.overview: Isaac gets some unexpected help in his search for Hector. Meanwhile, Carmilla plots a land grab and Alucard meets some fans.

episodes.name: Investigators
episodes.overview: Belmont and Sypha's plan to leave Lindenfeld hits a snag. Isaac and the Captain debate the merits of humanity. Hector tries to get a read on Lenore.

episodes.name: I Have a Scheme
episodes.overview: Sumi and Taka share their history with Alucard. Also, Saint Germain gains entrance to the priory, and Isaac receives an icy welcome in Genoa.

episodes.name: A Seat of Civilisation and Refinement
episodes.overview: Belmont and the Judge discover an ominous symbol, Saint Germain's treasure hunt is cut short, and Alucard's bond with Sumi and Taka continues to grow.

episodes.name: The Good Dream
episodes.overview: Lenore continues to spend time with Hector, slowly earning his trust. Saint Germain experiences a telling nightmare about the Infinite Corridor.

episodes.name: Worse Things Than Betrayal
episodes.overview: As Saint Germain makes unsettling discoveries, Isaac marches toward a showdown. Meanwhile, Belmont and Sypha question a monk — aggressively.

episodes.name: What the Night Brings
episodes.overview: Something is alive in the priory's basement, and for Belmont and Sypha, time is of the essence. Lenore opens up to Hector about Carmilla's plans.

episodes.name: The Harvest
episodes.overview: Night falls on Lindenfeld and all manner of hell breaks loose. Also, Isaac meets the Magician, Hector makes a pledge, and Sumi and Taka make a move.

episodes.name: Abandon All Hope
episodes.overview: With the portal to hell open, Trevor and Sypha must battle an onslaught. Meanwhile, the Judge shares a disturbing legacy, and Hector learns his fate.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Dracula's influence looms large as Belmont and Sypha investigate plans to resurrect the notorious vampire. Alucard struggles to embrace his humanity.

episodes.name: Murder Wakes It Up
episodes.overview: Belmont and Sypha continue to battle beasts loyal to Dracula, but it's getting a little old. Meanwhile, Alucard receives a guest.

episodes.name: Having the World
episodes.overview: Lenore urges Hector to not test Carmilla's patience. Belmont and Sypha cross paths with Zamfir, a fearsome guard with a suspicious mind.

episodes.name: Walk Away
episodes.overview: Isaac gets under Varney's skin. Vampires Morana and Striga receive an urgent message from Carmilla. Belmont and Sypha get a look at Targoviste.

episodes.name: You Must Sacrifice
episodes.overview: Alucard travels to Danesti, where he makes a dramatic entrance in the nick of time. Also, the scholar Saint Germain reflects on his own twisted path.

episodes.name: Back in the World
episodes.overview: With Greta's help, Alucard sets out to guide the villagers to his castle for protection. Sypha pushes back on Zamfir's leadership. Isaac makes a move.

episodes.name: You Don't Deserve My Blood
episodes.overview: As Isaac and his army of night creatures descend on Carmilla's castle, Hector rushes to finish his preparations before the bloody reunion begins.

episodes.name: The Great Work
episodes.overview: Varney and Ratko discover their plan is working — but who gets the credit? Also, Zamfir finally takes Belmont and Sypha underground.

episodes.name: Death Magic
episodes.overview: Belmont, Sypha and Zamfir battle Varney, Ratko and their unholy army. Alucard's castle falls under attack, and Saint Germain shares his scheme.

episodes.name: The Endings
episodes.overview: Belmont and Sypha join forces with their old friend Alucard — and not a moment too soon. As the battle rages, Varney reveals his true form.

episodes.name: It's Been a Strange Ride
episodes.overview: Not content to live in a cage, Lenore chooses another fate. Alucard opens his castle. Sypha wonders if she's lost Belmont for good.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Gyeon Woo's pleasure at returning home from abroad is cut short when his attempt to help out a drunk woman leads to an unfortunate misunderstanding.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: After Princess Hye-myeong shames Gyeon Woo as a pervert, he is left with no choice but to help her find her lost ring.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Gyeon Woo and Hye-myeong take risks to find the ring. Gyeon Woo discovers it's with an unexpected person and goes to the lantern festival to get it back.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The king receives an ominous message by arrow, and searches for the sender. Gyeon Woo goes to save Hye-myeong and is wounded.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: After the princess is caught up in scandal, the king locks her in her room. Gyeon Woo becomes curious about the previous owner of Hye-myeong's ring.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Gyeon Woo hides the princess from a dangerous man who's searching for her. She ends up being found somewhere surprising.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: The man the princess waits for is in danger, and vanished before her eyes. Ignoring the king's orders, she sets out to look for him.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: The king's court makes an appeal for him to dethrone the princess. With his lofty position on the line, Gyeon Woo chooses to keep Hye-myeong's secret.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: The Prince of Qing comes to propose to the princess. Caught between love and duty, Gyeon Woo has no choice but to accompany them.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: The prince expresses his deep feelings for the princess and prepares for a big day. Gyeon Woo investigates how this arranged marriage came about.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: The Prince of Qing returns home, and the king decided to interrogate a conspirator. Gyeon Wop and Hye-myeong both suffer from mysterious nightmares.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Gyeon Woo goes to meet an informant, but appears to come back empty-handed. He is torn over whether to tell Hye-myeong the truth.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Gyeon Woo and Hye-myeong go in pursuit of the masked man who could put pressure on Jung Ki-jun. However, the king plans to find him first.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: After blacking out, Gyeon Woo recalls that he was connected to the deposed queen. Kang Jun-yeong interrogates the person who threatened the masked man.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Gyeon Woo reveals some incriminating evidence that throws the king into anguish. The queen is questioned closely about her past actions.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Ki-jun is driven into a frenzy when masked men appear, and is shocked when one of the men removes his mask. Hye-myeong has an unexpected reunion.

seasons.name: Limited Series
seasons.overview: Life turns on a dime for a thriving prosecutor after meeting his new perky intern, who becomes a prime murder suspect soon after joining his office.

episodes.name: Hope for the Future (1)
episodes.overview: Eun Bong-Hee seeks revenge on her cheating boyfriend, but her knight in shining armor turns out to be Noh Ji-Wook, a prosecutor she earlier accused of being a pervert.

episodes.name: Hope for the Future (2)
episodes.overview: Bong-Hee secures herself a legal internship, unaware that her instructor will be Ji-Wook, who remembers her antics well.

episodes.name: The Murder (1)
episodes.overview: The tables are turned when Bong-Hee suddenly finds herself accused of murder. The situation only worsens when Ji-Wook is made the case's prosecutor, his future dependent on her confession.

episodes.name: The Murder (2)
episodes.overview: Ji-Wook finds a bloody knife at the scene of the crime that could greatly affect the case. Bong-Hee's murder trial begins.

episodes.name: Interpretation of a Juristic Act (1)
episodes.overview: Bong-Hee tries to find Hee-Joon's real murderer, but her only hint is a melody. Ji-Wook has trouble adjusting to no longer being a prosecutor.

episodes.name: Interpretation of a Juristic Act (2)
episodes.overview: Bong-Hee and Ji-Wook take on opposing clients, but they realize they must work together when things go awry.

episodes.name: Reunion and Reunion (1)
episodes.overview: Bong-Hee has a close encounter with the culprit. Ji-Wook notices District Attorney Jang keeping an eye on Bong-Hee.

episodes.name: Reunion and Reunion (2)
episodes.overview: Bong-Hee searches for work while living at Ji-Wook’s house. Ji-Wook’s ex, Yoo-Jung, comes back to town with a mission in her mind.

episodes.name: Mankind, Held Hostage (1)
episodes.overview: Bong-Hee pretends to be Ji-Wook's girlfriend in front of Yoo-Jung. Ji-Wook hands in his resignation letter.

episodes.name: Mankind, Held Hostage (2)
episodes.overview: Ji-Wook sets up his own law firm and begins recruiting employees. Lawyer Ji’s backstory with Ji-Wook is revealed.

episodes.name: The Beginning That Hasn't Begun (1)
episodes.overview: Ji-Wook quickly becomes frustrated with his newly-assembled team. The suspect of a murder and robbery case requests Bong-Hee as his lawyer.

episodes.name: The Beginning That Hasn't Begun (2)
episodes.overview: Bong-Hee has a dangerous confrontation with District Attorney Jang. Jung Hyun-Soo’s lack of an alibi creates difficulty for Ji-Wook’s team.

episodes.name: Alibi (1)
episodes.overview: Bong-Hee struggles to reset her feelings for Ji-Wook after being denied. Details of a past assault case arise concerning Jung Hyun-Soo.

episodes.name: Alibi (2)
episodes.overview: Ji-Wook faces off with unreliable witnesses in the courtroom. Later, he answers a call that could change everything.

episodes.name: Untruthful Truth and Dare (1)
episodes.overview: Ji-Wook tries to find out more about Hyun-Soo while keeping his team in the dark. Lawyer Ji's excitement for a special day is quickly dampened.

episodes.name: Untruthful Truth and Dare (2)
episodes.overview: Hyun-Soo begins to catch on to Ji-Wook's suspicions. Bong-Hee has trouble moving on from Ji-Wook when he can't seem to leave her alone.

episodes.name: Eun Bong-Hee's Golden Age (1)
episodes.overview: Go Chan-Ho resorts to desperate measures to get away from Hyun-Soo. Ji-Wook comes to terms with his feelings, but is he too late?

episodes.name: Eun Bong-Hee's Golden Age (2)
episodes.overview: Bong-Hee decides to help lawyer Byun out with his "heroic" DUI case. District Attorney Jang asks Yoo-Jung and Ji-Hye to help him reinvestigate Hee-Joon's murder.

episodes.name: Truth vs Secrecy (1)
episodes.overview: Lawyer Ji receives a strange request from a client and is faced with a dilemma he can't consult his team on.

episodes.name: Truth vs Secrecy (2)
episodes.overview: Bong-Hee becomes determined to figure out the Park Sung-Eun case, even if she has to forgo bathing. Ji-Wook tells Bong-Hee about his family’s past.

episodes.name: In This Finite World (1)
episodes.overview: Ji-Wook takes on a seemingly psychic client who has a vision that could affect more than just his case. Bong-Hee and Ji-Wook receive a new clue regarding Hee-Joon’s murder.

episodes.name: In This Finite World (2)
episodes.overview: A frightening realization comes crashing down on Bong-Hee. So Jung-Ha's predictions freak out the firm.

episodes.name: 48 Hours Later (1)
episodes.overview: Bong-Hee’s old friend calls her for help after she’s attacked. Ji-Wook’s firm wants to continue investigating Jung Hyun-Soo, but they need help.

episodes.name: 48 Hours Later (2)
episodes.overview: Bong-Hee and Ji-Wook search for a witness or a weapon from Yeon-Woo's attack. Social media-savvy Lawyer Ji then takes things into his own hands.

episodes.name: Attributable Reasons (1)
episodes.overview: Chief Bang is rushed to the hospital, his fate unknown. Tensions rise at the firm as Ji-Wook begins thinking about revenge.

episodes.name: Attributable Reasons (2)
episodes.overview: The firm contemplates if fabricating evidence is their only option for having Hyun-Soo arrested.

episodes.name: The Memory of That Day (1)
episodes.overview: Hyun-Soo is admitted to the hospital while still unconscious, therefore putting his arrest on hold. Ji-Wook wonders who could have planted the bloody knife.

episodes.name: The Memory of That Day (2)
episodes.overview: An arson case brings back painful memories of the past. Bong-Hee and Ji-Wook go out on an arcade date, but run into unexpected company.

episodes.name: Postponement (1)
episodes.overview: Ji-Wook is at a loss after seeing the photo on Bong-Hee's nightstand, and he decides to delve deeper into the past.

episodes.name: Postponement (2)
episodes.overview: Bong-Hee notices Ji-Wook's strange behavior as they investigate the arson case. Eun-Hyuk goes to Yoo-Jung for help.

episodes.name: The Discovery of a Memory (1)
episodes.overview: Bong-Hee breaks up with Ji-Wook, but is left with nowhere to go. Ji-Wook goes to see District Attorney Jang.

episodes.name: The Discovery of a Memory (2)
episodes.overview: A child from Bong-Hee's Taekwondo classes witnesses a murder, but claims he doesn't remember the killer's face.

episodes.name: Testing the Waters (1)
episodes.overview: Hyun-Soo wakes up, but seemingly can't remember anything, which leaves Ji-Wook suspicious.

episodes.name: Testing the Waters (2)
episodes.overview: The firm looks deeper into Hyun-Soo's past, as he is presented with his own belongings to help jog his memory.

episodes.name: Return (1)
episodes.overview: Hyun-Soo's whereabouts are unknown, and no one knows just how much of his memory has returned.

episodes.name: Return (2)
episodes.overview: Ji-Wook must tell Bong-Hee the truth about their parents' deaths. District Attorney Jang re-examines his son's murder case.

episodes.name: In Court (1)
episodes.overview: District Attorney Jang and Hyun-Soo disappear together. Ji-Wook and Bong-Hee search for them, afraid of what might happen.

episodes.name: In Court (2)
episodes.overview: Hyun-Soo's trial begins, but Ji-Wook doesn't plan to charge him with murder. Instead, he comes up with a new plan.

episodes.name: Return to the Daily Life (1)
episodes.overview: Bong-Hee worries about all that could go wrong if she gets back together with Ji-Wook. Hyun-Soo's final trial arrives.

episodes.name: Return to the Daily Life (2)
episodes.overview: A new case causes conflict between Bong-Hee and Ji-Wook as they learn more about how to love each other.

seasons.name: Limited Series
seasons.overview: With his major league baseball debut right around the corner, a star pitcher lands in prison and must learn to navigate his new world.

episodes.name: The Sentence
episodes.overview: Baseball pitcher Kim Je-hyeok gets slapped with a completely unexpected prison sentence only days before his flight to Boston to join the Red Sox.

episodes.name: The Second Trial
episodes.overview: Je-hyeok's appeal is a week away, and everyone seems sure he'll win the case. Seagull demands that the Errand Boy sneak him a knife.

episodes.name: Seobu Penitentiary
episodes.overview: After he's transferred to a new facility, Je-hyeok shares a cell with an interesting group of inmates and begins working at a prison woodshop.

episodes.name: Retirement
episodes.overview: With a big prize at stake for the winner of a singing contest, the inmates get busy practicing. Je-hyeok needs permission to get outside medical care.

episodes.name: I'm Going to Quit Baseball
episodes.overview: After the big announcement that broke the hearts of many, Je-hyeok starts showing interest in other career paths. Jean Valjean is soon to be released.

episodes.name: The Ramyeon Box
episodes.overview: The arrival of the new inmate has everyone on edge. Various competitions are being held with boxes of ramen – and something else – up for grabs.

episodes.name: Starting Baseball Again
episodes.overview: No one seems to know what kind of person Captain Yoo really is. Meanwhile at the woodshop, there's growing discontent toward the new chief.

episodes.name: Bak-sa's Abdominal Pain
episodes.overview: Dr. Ko needs a medical exam for his abdominal pain, but with the upcoming audit, Captain Na is pickier than ever in giving out authorizations.

episodes.name: New Troublesome Inmates
episodes.overview: New inmates, including one with particularly troubling behavior, get assigned to Joon-ho's wing. Min-chul seeks to find out what's worrying Dr. Ko.

episodes.name: The 140 km Pitch
episodes.overview: Captain Yoo's chance at a retrial depends completely on a witness's willingness to testify. One inmate from Je-hyeok's cell prepares to say goodbye.

episodes.name: The New Prisoner
episodes.overview: Led by Min-chul, Je-hyeok's cellmates are on a mission to protect Je-hyeok from the newest inmate, who's plotting to take revenge.

episodes.name: Fire Drill
episodes.overview: While deciding which team he'll play for, Je-hyeok sets a condition that is very unlike him. Meanwhile, Crony continues his plan for payback.

episodes.name: Unanswered Calls
episodes.overview: Je-hyeok needs to talk to Ji-ho while he has phone privileges, but time is running out. Je-hyeok's cellmates share surprising details of their pasts.

episodes.name: A New Obstacle
episodes.overview: Things finally seem to be looking up for Je-hyeok until another calamity strikes. Meanwhile, Looney and Jung-woo continue to bicker like preschoolers.

episodes.name: The Special Pardon
episodes.overview: Someone is plotting to make Je-hyeok's remaining months in prison as unpleasant as possible. Min-chul anxiously awaits the decision on his parole.

episodes.name: The Last Chapter
episodes.overview: Even for a man as patient and steadfast as Je-hyeok, sometimes life in prison just gets to be too much, which leads him to come to a drastic decision.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In 2017, Son O-gong and Devil King Woo are in conflict with each other as they look for a true light in a dark world where evil thrives. From there, O-gong is bound to his protective role towards Jin Seon-mi, the little girl he had met years ago. Having made…

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: While fulfilling her part of the deal with a so-called "fairy," young Seon-mi makes a critical mistake that catches up with her 25 years later.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Desperate for help in dealing with O-gong, Seon-mi seeks out Devil King Woo, who, as the head of an entertainment agency, is judging for an audition.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: As Geumganggo works its magic on O-gong, he gets frustrated by the conflicting feelings he has toward Seon-mi. Meanwhile, a young woman goes missing.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: To get O-gong off his back, Devil King is forced to make a big compromise. O-gong brings something -- or someone -- very stinky to Devil King's house.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Devil King donates an object of cultural importance to a museum, where historical artifacts on exhibit still bear the souls of the original owners.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Loyal Ms. Ma can't allow herself to just watch as Devil King suffers. Seon-mi feels torn as she knows all too well that O-gong's love isn't real.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Devil King Woo seeks Seon-mi's help in dealing with a troublesome prince who refuses to return home until he finds a runaway mermaid.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: When the plan to make O-gong jealous misfires, Devil King shows Seon-mi something to provoke her. An evil spirit is using social media to spread hate.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Seon-mi can't stop thinking about the moment the bell rang and what it means for her. An evil spirit is suspected of stealing children's souls.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: The fulfillment of Seon-mi's wish to be ordinary has far-reaching consequences on not only O-gong but also Devil King Woo, Richie and even Pal-kye.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: An assailant attacks Devil King Woo at a torch relay. Richie prepares to say her goodbyes. Ms. Ma finds out that a black bell has gone missing.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: O-gong realizes that the Geumganggo has the power to take his life. Kang Dae-seong devises a plan to get rid of his annoyances altogether.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Asanyeo pursues what she didn't achieve more than 1,000 years ago. Aware of Devil King Woo's weakness, she decides to use it to her advantage.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Relentless in her desire to be stronger, Asanyeo orders General Winter to get her incense burner back. Seon-mi mentions the love bell to O-gong.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: To avoid exacerbating the dilemma regarding Asanyeo, O-gong must pretend not to know the truth, and General Winter must be found as soon as possible.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: In an uncanny dream, a woman shows O-gong the moment that Samjang was born. Asanyeo demonstrates what she's capable of doing for Kang Dae-seong.

episodes.name: Episode 17
episodes.overview: O-gong refuses to accept his and Seon-mi's fates. Devil King Woo wants to believe Asanyeo despite others' warnings that he's being deceived.

episodes.name: Episode 18
episodes.overview: As O-gong prepares to sacrifice himself in place of Seon-mi, Devil King Woo, feeling sorry for both, tries to solve the mystery behind the Geumganggo.

episodes.name: Episode 19
episodes.overview: While Seon-mi is away at the Lotus Village trying to figure out exactly what her mission is, O-gong hurries to begin the ritual to summon the dragon.

episodes.name: Episode 20
episodes.overview: Both the Spiritual Realm and Devil King Woo try to get O-gong to come out of Sureumdong, where he's shut himself in after the fateful day.

episodes.name: I Need You
episodes.overview: Ryo, a young professor returning from research abroad, takes his pure-hearted, crybaby friend Akira to a decadent party, where things turn demonic.

episodes.name: One Hand Is Enough
episodes.overview: Akira has become a completely different man -- he's stronger and hungrier than ever before. He seeks out Ryo for answers.

episodes.name: Believe Me!
episodes.overview: After getting shut down by his editor, paparazzo Nagasaki gets desperate. Silene and Kaim learn what happened to their missing fellow demon, Amon.

episodes.name: Come, Akira
episodes.overview: Akira's mother calls and says she'll be home soon. Everyone is looking forward to seeing her, but Ryo warns Akira not to trust any human.

episodes.name: Beautiful Silene
episodes.overview: Silene tracks down Amon, hoping to reawaken his demonic side. But in the ensuing battle, the human soul of Akira remains powerful.

episodes.name: Neither Demon Nor Human
episodes.overview: At a widely broadcast track meet, Ryo plans to expose high school athlete Koda as a demon, thereby spreading fear and distrust throughout society.

episodes.name: Weak Humans, Wise Demons
episodes.overview: With the fear of demons gripping the world, humanity devolves into paranoia and violence. Akira tries to save other demon-human hybrids like himself.

episodes.name: I Must Know Myself
episodes.overview: Ryo's actions and motives remain a mystery to himself, so he revisits his past for answers. Miki's father searches for his missing wife and son.

episodes.name: Go to Hell, You Mortals
episodes.overview: Betrayed and exposed, Akira becomes a target. After Miki takes to social media to defend his human soul, she and Miko find themselves under attack.

episodes.name: Crybaby
episodes.overview: Confronted by Akira, Ryo reveals the truth about demonkind and himself. Humans, demons and devilmen gather for an ultimate battle for the world.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The war is over, and Violet Evergarden needs a job. Scarred and emotionless, she takes a job as a letter writer to understand herself and her past.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Hodgins retrieves Violet from the hospital, as Major Gilbert asked him to look out for her. After they meet Gilbert's relatives, he offers her a job.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Violet tries to adjust to her new job: she needs to learn typing, and her coworkers question whether she has the right demeanor for letter writing.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Violet enrolls in a Doll training course. Her classmate Luculia befriends her, though she has her own problems with her war veteran brother.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: When Iris goes to her home village on an assignment, Violet accompanies her. Iris's birthday party sparks a disagreement with her family.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Princess Charlotte is to have a public correspondence with her betrothed, and Violet is entrusted with writing the letters on her highness’s behalf.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Violet travels to the country of Astrea to work with transcribers copying damaged manuscripts. Her partner Leon has a past not unlike hers.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: A playwright with writer's block and a tragic past summons Violet to the country of Genetrix to help him finish a script. They both learn about grief.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Violet learns that Major Gilbert is listed as missing in action, but his family members think he is dead. Unable to cope, she remembers the war.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Heartbroken, Violet withdraws from her job and questions whether she even has the right to be an Auto Memory Doll. Then, she receives a letter.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Violet travels to a countryside mansion to write a letter for a gravely ill war widow, but her young daughter Ann resents Violet's presence.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Against Hodgins' wishes, Violet takes a job from a soldier at a military base in Ctrigall, a former enemy nation now engulfed in civil war.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: The Major's older brother is ordered to defend the signing ceremony from former Gardarik forces opposed to peace. Violet intercepts his train.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: The signing ceremony concludes, officially bringing an end to the war. While writing letters for an air show, Violet composes a letter to the Major.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A young boy who ends up in the US after the 1871 Shinmiyangyo incident returns to Korea at a historical turning point and falls for a noblewoman.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Joseon stands firm against U.S. incursion. Yu-jin survives in America — as Eugene. Ae-sin knows that great change is afoot with global ramifications.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: The empress has been murdered: For Ae-sin, words are useless against rapacious foreign powers; she’ll take up arms instead. Eugene gets a new post.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: In an age of imported coffee and fashions, Ae-sin prefers her German gun, but wonders what the English word “love” means and whether Eugene is a friend.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Suspicions run deep as U.S. troops lose a gun on a train. Ae-sin shows Dong-mae compassion, Hui-seong returns to Joseon, and Eugene considers revenge.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Ae-sin meets Hui-seong for coffee at the hotel. Eugene deals with Japanese troops at the U.S. legation, and wants to know why Ae-sin defends Joseon.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Ae-sin gets a new mission. Eugene, Dong-mae and Hui-seong have something in common. Eugene delves into his past, and finally gives Ae-sin his answer.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Ae-sin learns love’s real meaning and crushes a thug. Emperor Gojong asserts Joseon’s authority. Eugene reveals his Korean name to Ae-sin.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Despite being advised to lay low as a noble lady, Ae-sin undertakes a dangerous operation. Eugene makes a surprising move and Hui-seong probes his past.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Eugene wants to know why Ae-sin can’t pull back, but her path is with the Righteous Army. Hui-seong disagrees with Ae-sin and offers an alternative.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: The emperor seeks Eugene’s aid. Hui-seong visits the tailor. Ae-sin feels conflicted after hearing Eugene’s story, but later sees him on a snowy night.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Ae-sin apologizes to Eugene, but he hopes that she’ll keep fighting for her Joseon. Hui-seong takes a streetcar ride with Ae-sin and proposes a plan.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Reaffirming her commitment, Ae-sin stands by her decision and settles on an unforeseen pact over castella cake. Eugene investigates an old photograph.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Ae-sin and Eugene take a ride out to the sea. A nefarious traitor shows great interest in Hui-seong and Eugene. Lord Go Sa-hong meets with Hui-seong.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Eugene gets devastating news, Dong-mae is apprehended, Ae-sin asks Hina for help and Hui-seong comes to the rescue when Eugene finds himself cornered.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: A disquieting sight vexes Emperor Gojong. Ae-sin defies Lord Go, Eugene refuses to forgive, and Hui-seong visits the Go family estate.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Hui-seong starts a newspaper and makes a personal sacrifice. Lord Go marshals support, Ae-sin imagines a different life, and Eugene goes to the palace.

episodes.name: Episode 17
episodes.overview: After giving up that which means the most to him, Hui-seong gets a friend a gift. Lord Go leads an urgent appeal, and Ae-sin faces Japanese troops.

episodes.name: Episode 18
episodes.overview: Eugene contends with a viperous imperialist. Seeing Lord Go’s incarceration, Hui-seong publishes a special edition. Ae-sin snubs a Japanese official.

episodes.name: Episode 19
episodes.overview: Lady Ae-sin loses a part of herself. Lord Go counters mounting imperialist schemes, Hui-seong avenges Ae-sin and Emperor Gojong strikes down a snake.

episodes.name: Episode 20
episodes.overview: The Righteous Army retaliates against Japanese troops and Ae-sin seeks justice. War breaks out in Joseon -- and Eugene gets orders to return to the U.S.

episodes.name: Episode 21
episodes.overview: Called an American imperialist, Eugene later asks Ae-sin why she persists in a futile cause. Hui-seong helps Ae-sin out of a bind. An ally joins Ae-sin.

episodes.name: Episode 22
episodes.overview: Emperor Gojong tries to shield the nation but is thrust into an impasse. Finding herself behind the eight ball, Ae-sin concedes that words have power.

episodes.name: Episode 23
episodes.overview: Seeing the explosion, Hui-seong, Dong-mae and Eugene fear the worst. The world’s indifference dismays Emperor Gojong, but Joseon’s defiance gets bolder.

episodes.name: Episode 24
episodes.overview: Joseon remains steadfast. The Righteous Army perseveres on its course. Ae-sin keeps her flame ablaze, while Hui-seong, Dong-mae and Eugene try to help.

episodes.name: Voting Rock-Paper-Scissors (1)
episodes.overview: Unaware of her new school's ways, transfer student Yumeko Jabami is offered a high-stakes game of rock-paper-scissors against her classmate, Mary.

episodes.name: Voting Rock-Paper-Scissors (2)
episodes.overview: Having lost her initial buy-in against Mary, Yumeko raises the stakes even higher by reburying into the match with an extremely large bet.

episodes.name: Double Concentration
episodes.overview: Student board member Itsuki challenges Yumeko to a game of pairs. Rumored to have never lost in this game, Itsuki lays a shrewed trap agaisnt her.

episodes.name: Life or Death: Mary vs Yuriko
episodes.overview: Desperate to regain her status in the school hierarchy, Mary duels student board member Yuriko in a game of "life or death" as Yumeko looks on.

episodes.name: Life or Death: Yumeko vs Yuriko
episodes.overview: Yumeko takes Yuriko on and taunts her as if she knows something about the trap Yuriko has laid against her.

episodes.name: Debt Swapping Game Begins
episodes.overview: After a monumental outcome, Yumeko receives a cryptic file form the student board. Meanwhile, a card game for those heavily in debt commences.

episodes.name: Debt Swapping Game: Indian Poker
episodes.overview: Yumeko and Mary pair up for a game of Indian poker against Kiwatari, the class bully known for manipulating others through fear and intimidation.

episodes.name: Debt Swapping Game Concludes
episodes.overview: Although able to repay her losses, Yumeko chooses to remain in debt in order to qualify for an official match with the student board president.

episodes.name: ESP Game (1)
episodes.overview: Yumeko agrees to go up against the Beautification Committee Chair in an ESP card game involving Russian roulette.

episodes.name: ESP Game (2)
episodes.overview: A nervous Suzui serves as dealer for Yumeko's deadly duel with Midari. Meanwhile, student board member Manyuda summons Mary for a surprising proposal.

episodes.name: Yumemi’s Special Live
episodes.overview: Pop idol sensation Yumemi challenges Yumeko to a gambling match, but Yumeko knows that Yumemi is hiding a dark ambition beneath her sweet exterior.

episodes.name: Top Idol Championship: Battle It Out! (1)
episodes.overview: The crowd goes wild for the Yumeko versus Yumemi pop idol show down. The girls are all smiles on stage, but they've each put everything on the line.

episodes.name: Top Idol Championship: Battle It Out! (2)
episodes.overview: Yumemi’s scheme doesn’t go according to plan, forcing her to throw her fate to pure luck. Later, Yumemi reveals the existence of an unknown saboteur.

episodes.name: Choice Poker (1)
episodes.overview: Yumeko challenges Manyuda to a public match. Unable to back out, he wagers the vast war chest in his control as student council treasurer.

episodes.name: Choice Poker (2)
episodes.overview: Manyuda goes all-in, betting all of the funds in his control. Desperate to continue gambling, Yumeko pushes Itsuki to wager more than she can afford.

episodes.name: 50,000-Dollar Trap
episodes.overview: Park Dong-hoon has a lot on his shoulders, including supporting a mother and two out-of-work brothers. One day, he receives a mysterious package.

episodes.name: Survive
episodes.overview: A misunderstanding causes Dong-hoon to be interrogated for bribery. Lee Ji-an is the only witness, but she has no interest in helping him out.

episodes.name: Will You Hate Me, Please?
episodes.overview: Ji-an plants a bug in Park Dong-un's office. Unaware of who she's working for, Dong-hoon agrees to buy her dinner for a month.

episodes.name: A Diligent Lifer
episodes.overview: Fearing Ji-an's recklessness, Do Jun-yeong does some digging of his own to find out who he's dealing with. Dong-hoon's brothers launch a new business.

episodes.name: The Pay Phone
episodes.overview: Ji-an taps Dong-hoon's phone. When she overhears that he's gotten a hold of Jun-yeong's phone records, she alerts corporate investigators.

episodes.name: Betrayal
episodes.overview: Kang Yun-hui advises Dong-hoon to quit his job and start his own business. Unfortunately for her, he knows exactly what she's trying to hide.

episodes.name: Camping Site
episodes.overview: Dong-hoon confronts Jun-yeong at a secluded campsite to put his scheming to an end. For a while, Jun-yeong seems to do as he's told.

episodes.name: 30,000 Years Old
episodes.overview: Lee Gwang-il watches from a distance as Ji-an warms up to Dong-hoon. Dong-hoon is offered a seat on the board, giving him the chance for revenge.

episodes.name: The Envelope
episodes.overview: Jun-yeong realizes that Ji-an could be his surest weapon. Dong-hoon's family gets ahead of themselves when they learn he could be promoted.

episodes.name: The Slippers
episodes.overview: Dong-hoon refuses to tell anyone the real cause of his injuries. Ji-an fully pays off her debt to keep Gwang-il from hurting anyone else.

episodes.name: Out Of All, Why?
episodes.overview: Before the interview, a few directors try to build Dong-hoon an airtight case, knowing his connection with Ji-an will be brought into question.

episodes.name: I Wanted You To Be Happy
episodes.overview: Upon hearing Yun-hui's side of things, Dong-hoon rethinks his priorities. Ji-an continues to make uncomfortable advances toward Dong-hoon.

episodes.name: Can I Hug You?
episodes.overview: Ji-an's testimony catches Dong-hoon's opponents off-guard. Dong-un comes close to catching those responsible for his misfortune.

episodes.name: Would You Be Happy To See Me?
episodes.overview: When Ji-an's past is exposed, she goes into hiding. Meanwhile, her recordings fall into the hands of those looking to make some money.

episodes.name: I’m Sorry
episodes.overview: Even after realizing what Ji-an has done to them, Dong-hoon and Yun-hui seek to protect her. But it seems everyone else wants justice.

episodes.name: Ji. An.
episodes.overview: Jun-yeong may walk free due to a sorry lack of evidence. When Ji-an loses a loved one, Dong-hoon's brothers make sure she is not left alone.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Tsubasa Ozora is an 11-year-old who dreams of becoming the world's best football player and winning the World Cup, his thoughts and dreams revolve almost entirely around the joy of football. Tsubasa moves with his mother to Nankatsu to pursue his dream, where…

episodes.name: Take Flight
episodes.overview: Tsubasa Oozora has just moved to Nankatsu in Shizuoka. He is a passionate soccer boy and instead of helping with the move, he runs away to dribble his ball around the city. What happens next is close to a fated encounter. He meets Genzo Wakabayashi. He is a y…

episodes.name: He's flying!
episodes.overview: Wakabayashi received a challenge from Tsubasa. He couldn’t hide the confusion about the immense power of Tsubasa’s kick and says that he will accept his challenge if he can face the B-team of Wakabayashi’s school of which he is the captain. While Ishizaki com…

episodes.name: A New Beginning for the Nankatsu Football Club
episodes.overview: The former Brazilian professional soccer player Roberto Hongo started free-loading in Tsubasa’s house. He also declared himself the trainer of the Nankatsu elementary school soccer club and told Tsubasa he has a ‘thank you present’. It turns out it was a prac…

episodes.name: Tsubasa and Roberto
episodes.overview: Number 10, the tricot number of desire. Roberto shows Tsubasa his old tricot from the time he played for Brazil and Tsubasa gets all excited and says, ‘One day, I will become a player of the Japanese national team and will fight the world!’ Roberto shows a st…

episodes.name: On The Way To The Inter-School Tournament
episodes.overview: To prepare for the game against the Shutetsu Elementary team, Tsubasa trains every morning with Roberto. When Tsubasa and the rest of the soccer club find out that Wakabayashi and the others have a practice game, they head there to watch them. Their team is f…

episodes.name: Kick-Off! Nankatsu vs Shuutetsu
episodes.overview: The game against Shutetsu Elementary School has started! After the schools competed in baseball, volleyball, and judo, now the final game is soccer and it will decide which school will win the festival.

episodes.name: Fantasista Tsubasa
episodes.overview: Wakabayashi is furious about Nankatsu’s unexpected strategy to keep striker Tsubasa in defense and orders his team to score 50 goals to challenge Tsubasa.

episodes.name: Birth of Nankatsu Golden Duo
episodes.overview: The second half of the match against Shutetsu starts.

episodes.name: Kojiro Arrives
episodes.overview: The Nankatsu Shonen Soccer Club starts preparing to join the Nankatsu SC for the National Youth Soccer Tournament. Tsubasa and the others were among 30 other boys who were chosen to start training together and have a chance to become a part of the final 15 bo…

episodes.name: A Surprisingly Difficult Match
episodes.overview: The National Youth Soccer Tournament for Shizuoka prefecture has started.

episodes.name: Crushing Wakabayashi
episodes.overview: After leaving Shimada, the Nankatsu SC is in the final departmental against Shimizu FC. With the return of Wakabayashi in goal, the team has every chance of winning the ticket for the national tournament, but it is not counting on an opponent who will target…

episodes.name: Now it's All Country!
episodes.overview: Winner of Shimizu FC, the Nankatsu SC validates the ticket for the national tournament. The team will unfortunately have to do without the services of Wakabayashi, whose injury proved to be worse than expected ...

episodes.name: Nankatsu burns to beat Meiwa
episodes.overview: The national tournament begins with a dream poster: Nankatsu vs. Meiwa! Spectators came in droves to attend this match which will have for main attraction the duel between Tsubasa and Hyuga...

episodes.name: I will not lose, because it is my dream!
