episodes.overview: The match between Nankatsu and Meiwa keeps its promises, as does the duel between Tsubasa and Hyuga. Despite the intense heat, both teams remain elbow-to-elbow. Who from Tsubasa or Hyuga will manage to tip definitely the balance in favor of his team?

episodes.name: 4 Minutes left! A decisive battle in mid-air!
Tough match between Meiwa and Furano!
Prefectural Tournament Final Game! Falcon Shoot Appeared!
Incandescent Fighters, the Fierce Tiger and Tsubasa

seasons.name: Junior Youth Arc
seasons.overview: The International Junior Youth Tournament in Paris, France, is about to begin, and Tsubasa, Misaki, Wakabayashi, Hyuga, and Wakashimazu are ready. Japan’s team of elite players is to face off against the best the soccer world has to offer. Germany’s Schneider…

episodes.name: A New Challenge
episodes.overview: The deciding match of the All Japan Junior Youth Soccer Tournament ends in an unprecedented twist. Now, with Tsubasa Ozora out, it’s Kojiro Hyuga’s turn! An intimidating match of formidable high school students awaits. Will they step up to the challenge?

episodes.name: Greetings to an Old Rival
episodes.overview: The team to travel to Europe has been announced! Hyuga is captain, but Tsubasa is determined to play in the French tournament in two weeks. In Germany, a practice match reunites the team with Wakabayashi, who shocks the team with his unusual comment.

episodes.name: Professional Warrior
episodes.overview: Team Japan and Hamburg have a practice match, and Wakabayashi shows off his iron defense. Schneider initiates a fierce attack and makes scoring impossible. Hyuga meanwhile is furious. Then there’s Tsubasa…

episodes.name: Starting Again from Zero
episodes.overview: While the practice match against Hamburg has proven disastrous for Japan, they vow to start afresh. Captain Matsuyama desires his teammates’ trust, while Hyuga focuses on overcoming Schneider. Meanwhile, Wakabayashi makes a surprising announcement.

episodes.name: Another Heavy Hitter
episodes.overview: Taro Misaki, now in France, has received a request to join Japan Junior Youth. The three years he’s spent away hasn’t helped his confidence, but playing with Tsubasa again appeals. Now Misaki challenges Team France to prove he’s still got it!

episodes.name: Action! Japan Junior Youth!
episodes.overview: Tsubasa returns to the field in style! Early in the match against Munich, he makes a decisive move. With Tsubasa back in action, his teammates play like completely different athletes. Then Hyuga and Tsubasa decide to make things even more interesting.

episodes.name: Converge on Paris!!
episodes.overview: The team lands in France, with games starting soon. Coach orders a rest day, but Tsubasa can’t sit still. As he dribbles around Paris, he passes someone practicing just like him. The boy, it turns out, is a familiar face with amazing skills.

episodes.name: I'm Taro Misaki
episodes.overview: It’s the opening ceremony of the International Junior Youth Tournament. As players from twelve participating countries gather, Misaki thinks back about his time in Japan and how far he’s really come. But the memories aren’t all happy. He remembers not only ho…

episodes.name: A Great Journey
episodes.overview: It’s Japan versus Italy in the opening game of the tournament, and tensions are running high. Team Japan’s tempers are flared over Italy’s previous comments about how they weren’t worth their time back before the practice match that never was. Still, having b…

episodes.name: They've Returned the Golden Duo
episodes.overview: Italy's goalkeeper, Zino Hernandez, makes incredible saves. So much so that his perfect record has earned him the reputation as Europe’s best goalie. His skill puts Japan on the offensive, but Misaki is watching. Then the coach makes a surprising move.

episodes.name: The Fierce Tiger Awakens
episodes.overview: Thanks to Tsubasa and Misaki, Japan manages to tie with Italy, leaving the Europeans to tighten their defenses in the hope achieving a draw. Meanwhile, the crowd is in thrall to Japan and cheers them on with only one minute to go. Tsubasa then makes one final…

episodes.name: Destined for Victory
episodes.overview: The host country, France, has its first match against England, and the stadium is buzzing with excitement. Elle Sid Pierre, France’s captain, wows with his elegant dribbling. Meanwhile, Tsubasa and his friends take note and are impressed. But as host, Team Fr…

episodes.name: A Pledge in the Starry Sky
episodes.overview: Former Brazilian soccer player Roberto Hongo makes a visit to a soccer stadium in the outskirts of Paris where he speaks with Katagiri of the All Japan Soccer Association. Roberto makes himself clear; he does not want Tsubasa knowing he is merely miles away i…

episodes.name: Never Give Up
episodes.overview: It’s Japan versus Argentina, and the winner progresses to the finals. Tsubasa, however, is preoccupied. While on the pitch, he learns that his former coach, Roberto, who has since remained incognito, is now in the stands somewhere watching.

episodes.name: Japan Junior Youth Strikes Back
episodes.overview: While Japan reels from Diaz’s latest soccer feat, Tsubasa and Hyuga join forces for a special attack. Tsubasa has got his groove back. Taking the opportunity, the Tachibana Twins and Jito dash toward the goal. The time to strike back is now!

episodes.name: A Battle of Ups and Downs
episodes.overview: Misaki makes a miracle shot, tying the score for Japan. But a tie isn’t good enough if they want to make it to the semifinals. With both teams unwilling to give an inch, it’s anyone’s guess who will walk away the victor.

episodes.name: The Young Noble of the Field Returns!!
episodes.overview: It's the second half, 4 to 4. To break the impasse, Japan puts in Jun Misugi, an amazingly skilled player who also has a heart condition. It’s been three years, but finally, Jun can stand on the same field as Tsubasa. Argentina is in for a fight!

episodes.name: The Top Four Assemble!
episodes.overview: Thanks to Misugi’s overhead, Team Japan manages to take the lead, a first for this match. But the self-declared genius is ready and launches his infamous Banana Shot over everyone’s heads, etching a giant arc in the sky. Who will make it to the top four?

episodes.name: The Ball of Fire Revealed
episodes.overview: It's the first match of the final tournament. Uruguay begins with some lightning-fast attacks, which achieves a goal in just the first fifty seconds. But Germany’s Schneider manages to even the score. Which ace striker will dominate is anyone’s guess…

episodes.name: The Battle Begins!! Japan vs. France
episodes.overview: In the second match of the finals Japan faces host France in a stadium filled with fans for the home team. Still Japan pulls off a three-way attack, stealing the ball back from a furious French captain, Pierre, who now seems to be planning something…

episodes.name: 10 vs. 11
episodes.overview: Ten minutes into the first half, Soda is given his second yellow card, forcing Japan to play on with only ten players. Then, Pierre gets a penalty kick, upping the score 2 to 1. Hyuga doesn’t give up, but luck just doesn’t seem be on Japan’s side…

episodes.name: The Elegant Beast Attacks
episodes.overview: In the second half rain is pelting the players and the pitch. France turns on a furious attack, but Japan ends up saved. But Izawa is now badly injured. In his place steps Misugi, who’s confidant the tables can turn. Let the clash of captains begin!

episodes.name: Misaki vs. Pierre
episodes.overview: Behold, France’s enigmatic Eiffel Attack! Team Japan stands at the ready, reflexes primed, but it’s Pierre and Napoleon all the way. Perfect pass work epitomizes the French forces as they make their way to the goal. Can Tsubasa resuscitate the team?

episodes.name: Overtime in the Rain
episodes.overview: Thanks to Misaki, the score is tied, initiating the first overtime of the tournament. But Coach Mikami is out of substitutions, and everyone is more than fatigued. Now Japan’s worst fears have become a reality. Things are not looking good…

episodes.name: A Wounded Final Defense
episodes.overview: It’s overtime, and Hyuga is ready to fight. He takes on Pierre, but Hyuga’s badly injured leg allows his opponent to swipe the ball out from underneath him. France continues to launch a brutal wave of attacks. Meanwhile, Wakashimazu is writhing in pain.

episodes.name: The Miracle Fist
episodes.overview: Overtime in the second match of the finals is underway, but a winner has yet to be declared. Now five representatives from each team are to join the kickoff. First up is France’s captain, Pierre. The whistle sounds. Whom will fortune smile on today?

episodes.name: The Lions of the Final
episodes.overview: At last the final. Japan is to face off against Germany. While Team Japan has managed to survive so far, it’s a team of injured players. And the big surprise is the starting lineup. Wakabayashi’s debut is now. Japan is now the strongest is has ever been!

episodes.name: A Shooting Storm
episodes.overview: The time for kickoff at the finals has arrived! Wakabayashi’s research on Team Germany has proven successful as Japan manages to dominate early on. Only this time Germany’s goalie is the elusive and intensely foreboding Steel Giant, Deuter Muller.

episodes.name: Schneider vs. Wakabayashi
episodes.overview: Japan is stunned by Muller’s ability to block all shots. Suddenly Muller makes a massive kick, launching a super-long-distance pass over to Schneider directly in front of Japan’s goal. Once teammates, Wakabayashi and Schneider battle is just beginning!

episodes.name: A Blazing First Point
episodes.overview: In the first half, Wakabayashi’s research has given the advantage to Team Japan. Then Japan gets another chance at that prized first point with a free kick. But strangely, Goalie Muller wants nothing standing between him in front of the goal and Tsubasa.

episodes.name: The Most Powerful Shot in History
episodes.overview: Schneider’s Fire Shot may’ve dashed Japan’s hopes of a first point, but Hyuga is already devising a comeback. With Tsubasa’s help, he is about to unleash something no one could have anticipated—the fiercest kick in soccer history!

episodes.name: A Hat in Tatters
episodes.overview: Twenty-five minutes into the first half, Tsubasa and Misaki combine forces to tie up the game. Schneider now is even more revved up and goes head-to-head with Goalie Wakabayashi. Then Schneider boldly unleashes his Fire Shot. The result? Sparks fly.

episodes.name: Respond to the Message!
episodes.overview: Something has been weighing on Tsubasa’s mind. Katagiri’s cryptic message from halftime about page 52 must be a reference to the notebook, the one into which Roberto put all he knew. Soon Tsubasa traces his memories, stirring up lessons from the past.

episodes.name: A Glimpse at Global Greatness!?
episodes.overview: Japan pulls off a second point and Germany is frantic! What’s more, Schneider has no feeling in his left leg. Just as Germany’s offense appears to have cracked under the pressure, Schneider wakes up his teammates. Now Germany’s Workman, Kaltz, is pumped.

episodes.name: It's Done!
episodes.overview: Schneider evens the score with only seven minutes to go. Now it’s an all-out war. Tsubasa tries to break through by dribbling, but is brutally tackled by Kaltz midair, sending Tsubasa crashing to the ground. The tournament ends now!

episodes.name: A Promise to the Heavens
episodes.overview: Japan is world champion! Elated, Tsubasa and his teammates converge on the pitch. Meanwhile, Schneider has something to say to Tsubasa. Through his interviewers, Tsubasa tells the world about the dream he’s held dear since childhood.

episodes.name: Confession!
episodes.overview: Having returned from France, Tsubasa becomes coach of Nankatsu MS’s soccer team. Soon Manager Kumi is confessing her love to Tsubasa, despite knowing that Sanae and Tsubasa already have feelings for each other. Time is running out before Brazil.

episodes.name: To a New Era!
episodes.overview: A month has passed since the International Junior Youth Tournament in France, and Japan’s athletes are beginning to go their separate ways. Tsubasa is using the time he has left before graduation to practice with a new club team, impressing the coach who is c…

episodes.name: Tsubasa Takes Off
episodes.overview: Tsubasa is in a whole new league now. Gone are the days of Junior Youth. At an entirely new international competition, Tsubasa is more than ready to get out on the pitch and play. Then the stands call in unison. Tsubasa… Tsubasa…

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In a world powered by advanced technology, crime and action sweep through the archipelagic nation of cremona. Chief among the major players is “Killer B” — a serial killer who has thrown the city into chaos. The stories of Koku, the protagonist, Keith, a lege…

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Keith rejoins the RIS just in time to work a brutal double murder involving "Killer B." Then an unknown group steals a military vehicle for a rampage.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: The RIS investigates a death that appears to be linked to Killer B, though Keith disagrees. Another body leads them to stake out a high-powered party.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Kaela battles the hackers as the poison gas release ticks closer. Keith drags Boris on a chase outside the city, pursuing Koku and one of the gang.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Koku and Keith both pay visits to the Royal Library. Afterward, Lily heads to Keith's apartment to discuss her thoughts on the Killer B case.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: The team members grapple with the attack on one of their own, and the fact that there must be a traitor on the inside. Koku realizes who Canopus is.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: After confronting Keith on the roof of the hospital, Koku agrees to meet him at a temple the next day. Keith is declared a murder suspect.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Minatsuki gives the OK for the others to attack Koku, but Keith intervenes to protect him. The RIS receives an ultimatum.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Eric implores Keith to return to the RIS, then suspends Lily in an effort to track Keith down. Minatsuki sends Takeru after Koku.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Keith turns himself in and the RIS decides to spend the few remaining hours laying a trap for the suspected head of Market Maker, using Lily as bait.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Koku searches for the zeppelin containing Market Maker and Yuna. Meanwhile, Keith, Eric and Kaela frantically search for Gilbert and Lily.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Keith sets off in pursuit of Gilbert once more. Koku finds the zeppelin and Minatsuki, but Laica escapes with Yuna in accordance with the prophecy.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: The RIS races to the scene, while Keith confronts Gilbert at the old Jaula Blanca facility. Koku fights Laica for his and Yuna's survival.

seasons.name: Season 2 Succession
seasons.overview: When Keith is abducted and a friend from Koku’s past resurfaces, Killer B returns and everyone is pulled into a conspiracy involving the crown.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Koku is approached by Kirisame, a figure from his childhood who he thought was dead. He asks Koku to join him in his fight for a new world order.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Kirisame's subordinates force Koku into carrying out an act of violence against a senator. Then Koku breaks into the royal palace.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The royal palace refuses to fully cooperate with the RIS investigation. Lily and Koku head out to get more information on Keith's disappearance.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Keith's friends narrow down possible locations where he's being held, but with Keith already starting to hallucinate from hunger, time is running out.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Koku, Izanami and Yuna have to fight off an ambush from Kirisame's subordinates. Lily gets pulled over while driving with the king in her car.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: With the RIS continuing their pursuit of Killer B, Koku goes into hiding, but Kirisame seeks him out for a final confrontation.

episodes.name: The Song of Healing
episodes.overview: A young girl named Rin lives with her younger brother Al, older sister Mel and grandfather Talgia Hawkray in the faraway Dandera Village deep within a forest. Rin is devoted to go to the Capital and sing in the Court Orchestra, while Al is determined to show…

episodes.name: The Song of Departure
episodes.overview: Henry returns to the Capital, only to be told that a war is upon the country in its competition for the power of their songstress, later recognized as Finis, whose songs can rejuvenate and heal soldiers. Henry refuses to see Finis as a tool to be used in war.…

episodes.name: The Song of Love
episodes.overview: The innkeepers sell out Rin, Al and Pony to some knights of the Capital Army. Pony attempts to stall them, but she is knocked out. Al then throws a Star Bomb, a type of firecracker bomb invention that can act as a smoke screen. However, Al gets stabbed by a d…

episodes.name: The Song of Depravity
episodes.overview: Henry fights in the front lines alongside comrades Berrow and Snore. Finis later arrives on the front lines and put her life in danger to use her Song of Healing in order to revive the soldiers. Henry then hears word that Finis plans to use the destructive We…

episodes.name: The Song of Encounter
episodes.overview: Corte realizes that a frail Finis is using her powers for war to protect Henry. Being told that Rudo would execute Henry if Finis did not use her powers against the enemy, Corte runs into the forest to gather herbs. When a knight tells Corte that Finis has go…

episodes.name: The Song of Goodbye
episodes.overview: Henry reunites with Finis, Berrow and Snore in the forest. Although Corte is relieved to find them, Rudo arrives to take Finis to the Montvale Fortress, but Henry proposes that it can be captured without the use of Finis. Henry, Berrow and Snore ultimately co…

episodes.name: The Song of Mortality
episodes.overview: While the front line knights celebrate with a banquet in honor of their victory at their army camp, Corte sternly warns Finis and Henry to run away.

episodes.name: The Song of Eternity
episodes.overview: In an alternate timeline, astronomer Henry predicts that the Moon has changed its orbit and will collide into Earth in about 60,000 years. When Henry and Finis meet, she tells him that she is a songstress who was blessed with the power to make miracles, until…

episodes.name: The Song of Nostalgia
episodes.overview: Finis, now in cloaked attire, is told by Bazra that her power of songs will achieve world domination, but she states that their prior agreement was for her to sing her Song of Mortality during the Starsong Festival. Rin, Pony, Monica and Allu realize that Fin…

episodes.name: The Song of Determination
episodes.overview: Rin was taken in by Talgia and Mel as a baby. Talgia was against Bazra's views of using Finis's power of songs as a tool of war. While dueling, Bazra used a fire echo device to disable Talgia's right arm from wielding his sword. After Talgia later held Rin by…

episodes.name: The Song of Silence
episodes.overview: Al reveals that his jet pack is powered by wind echo devices, but the weight of Rin causes both of them to fall. While Rin, Al, Pony, Monica, Allu, Henry, Berrow and Snore camp out, they spot an airship, which they assume that Bazra is heading to the Capital.

episodes.name: The Song of Beginning
episodes.overview: Finis and the Court Orchestra perform the Song of Mortality, forcing the Moon to start falling towards Earth. Henry, Berrow and Snore fight against Bazra, who is equipped with the new Symphony Killer.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Reunited with her best friend’s younger brother, who’s back from a stint abroad, a recently dumped career woman begins to see him in a new light.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: From a breakup to work stress, life isn't all that peachy for 35-year-old Jin-a. Meanwhile, Jun-hui arrives back in Korea after three years abroad.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: One of Jin-a's co-workers takes a liking to Jun-hui. Jin-a's mom begins to worry because Jin-a isn't preparing to get married like others her age.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Gyu-min goes around saying that Jin-a likes Jun-hui, but no one believes him. Jun-hui seems to think Jin-a wants to get back together with Gyu-min.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Although happily in love, Jin-a still has concerns about her relationship. She volunteers to go on a business trip that no one else wants to take on.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Setting aside her guilt, Jin-a spends the night at Jun-hui's place. Back at work after the business trip, she gets called to Director Nam's office.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: For Jun-hui, keeping his relationship a secret starts to get frustrating. President Jo asks the female employees to bring forth their grievances.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Seung-ho is angry with Jun-hui. Jin-a runs into issues while trying to replace her broken smartphone because the account is under Gyu-min's name.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: When no one seems to know where Jin-a is, Jun-hui starts to panic. Worried for her safety, he tries to get hold of Gyu-min.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Refusing help from her dad and Jun-hui, Jin-a plans to break the news to her mom and Gyeong-seon herself, but it doesn't go as smoothly as she hoped.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: As everyone predicted, Jin-a's mom reacts rather melodramatically to Jin-a's news, injuring herself and hurting others' feelings in the process.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Jun-hui is more concerned about Jin-a's feelings than his own and refuses to give up his relationship with Jin-a despite her mom's hurtful words.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: With Gyeong-seon and Jun-hui's dad sitting close by, Jin-a isn't able to focus on her blind date, who takes notice and obviously isn't pleased.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Furious at Jin-a, Jun-hui cuts off communication with her completely, which makes her worry. Jun-hui's dad calls Jin-a's dad and asks to meet.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: After making her shocking announcement, Jin-a pays a surprise late-night visit to Jun-hui's place. Jin-a is told by her mom to move out of the house.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Jin-a tries to keep her housing situation a secret from Jun-hui. Meanwhile at Jin-a's company, there's much scheming going on behind her back.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Memories of their happy past come flooding back when Jin-a and Jun-hui see each other for the first time in months, but this only adds to their pain.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: An unexpected romance blooms between a germophobic CEO of a cleaning company and a woman not prone to neatness in this K-drama based on a webtoon.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: While looking for his beloved robot vacuum, fastidious CEO Jang Seon-gyeol runs into Gil O-sol, a job seeker who doesn’t mind a bit of untidiness.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Seon-gyeol gives O-sol one week to pay for damages. Growing more desperate, she decides to apply to one more place, where her skills may come in handy.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: O-sol runs into Seon-gyeol at her new job. When he later finds her drunk on the street, he reluctantly gives her a ride home but ends up regretting it.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Seon-gyeol wakes up in the hospital but has no idea how he got there. O-sol tries to comfort her father and astounds everyone at work with her new look.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Seon-gyeol makes a rash decision that he soon regrets but keeps doing things he can’t explain. O-sol is stunned to learn about Seon-gyeol’s condition.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Seon-gyeol becomes distraught when he learns about O-sol’s new assignment, but can’t get hold of her. O-sol is bewildered by Seon-gyeol’s actions.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Baffled by Seon-gyeol, O-sol pours her heart out to a neighbor. Distracted at work, Seon-gyeol comes to realize something -- but it may be too late.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Choe Ha-in’s revelation catches O-sol off guard, but his words keep swirling in her mind. O-sol helps Seon-gyeol during a precarious situation.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: O-sol grasps what her job means to her and resumes work. When she’s falsely accused by a client, Seon-gyeol defends her, putting the company at risk.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Seon-gyeol is puzzled to find O-sol at his place, but things get more awkward when his mom stops by, and he later sees changes at home and in himself.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: O-sol is perplexed by Seon-gyeol’s attentive behavior. Seon-gyeol panics when an unwelcome visitor arrives, and his mother later asks O-sol for a favor.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: O-sol keeps telling Seon-gyeol that she’s not looking to date, but he arranges an impromptu surprise for her and reveals another side of himself.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Seon-gyeol admits O-sol is the first person to be empathetic about his quirks, but she decides to move out after coming to terms with her feelings.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Seon-gyeol is resolute about curing his mysophobia, but O-sol reaches a drastic verdict after her family discovers his grandfather’s identity.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Devastated by his grandfather’s revelation about AG Group, Seon-gyeol discovers he’s been betrayed by someone he implicitly trusted.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: O-sol hears that Seon-gyeol is leaving for the U.S. O-sol’s family receives an overdue apology. Seon-gyeol wants to start over, but it may be too late.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Frustrated with her thankless office job, Retsuko the Red Panda copes with her daily struggles by belting out death metal karaoke after work.

episodes.name: A Day in the Life of Retsuko
episodes.overview: As Retsuko enters her fifth year at a prestigious trading firm, she struggles to motivate herself everyday as the daily stress from work takes a toll.

episodes.name: A Good, Hard-working Girl
episodes.overview: Tired of her wholesome good-girl persona at work, Retsuko is drawn to the free-spirited lifestyle of her former high school classmate, Puko.

episodes.name: Short-timer
episodes.overview: Retsuko loses the will to tackle the daily grind after Puko asks her to join a new business venture. A fed up Retsuko talks back to her supervisor.

episodes.name: Walking Down the Aisle
episodes.overview: When plans to leave her thankless job fall through, Retsuko continues to work in hopes of some day marrying and becoming a full-time house wife.

episodes.name: Exposed
episodes.overview: The solitary life Retsuko leads is about to change when Director Gori and Washimi take her to a karaoke bar after yoga class.

episodes.name: Stoking Rebellion
episodes.overview: Washimi acknowledges Retsuko's efforts to make things right with Director Ton, using her position as assistant to the president as leverage to help.

episodes.name: The Duel
episodes.overview: After the president cautions Director Ton on his abrasive behavior, his unusually polite demeanor puzzles and frightens his direct reports.

episodes.name: The Out of Pocket Prince
episodes.overview: Persuaded by her colleagues Director Gori and Washimi, a reluctant Retsuko agrees to join a company singles mixer hosted by Tsunoda.

episodes.name: A Rosy World
episodes.overview: Supervisor Tsubone sends Retsuko on an errand to the sales department where she falls for a fellow colleague, Resasuke, whom she met the night before.

episodes.name: The Dream Ends
episodes.overview: A happy but frustrated Retsuko increasingly makes mistakes at work. Meanwhile, a busy quarterly reporting period looms ahead for the accounting team.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: From her mother meddling in her personal affairs to a nightmarish new coworker, Retsuko's still got a lot to rage about in her karaoke sessions.

episodes.name: Time to Grow Up
episodes.overview: Retsuko becomes increasingly frustrated with her mother's overbearing ways. Director Ton demands the team be tough on their incoming new hire.

episodes.name: The New Hire Named Anai
episodes.overview: Without Retsuko's approval, her mother sets up an arranged marriage meeting. At first glance, new hire Anai seems like a nice and eager employee.

episodes.name: Double Moratorium
episodes.overview: Director Ton berates Retsuko for Anai's lack of progress on the job. Meanwhile, Anai continues to react very badly to any feedback from Retsuko.

episodes.name: Unavoidable Impact
episodes.overview: Retsuko and Anai have to host a food stall for the company’s Family Appreciation Day event, but Retsuko does all the work herself to avoid conflict.

episodes.name: United Front
episodes.overview: Everybody hates Retsuko’s badly-prepared yakisoba. Anai doesn’t lift a finger to help, until Kabae gives him some words of encouragement.

episodes.name: Unknown Future
episodes.overview: Hearing that Shirota has officially moved on, Retsuko lets herself be talked into attending a matchmaking event -- where she runs into Director Gori.

episodes.name: Growing Affection
episodes.overview: Now with a driver's license, Retsuko takes Gori and Washimi on a road trip, but things go south when the two ladies get into a heated argument.

episodes.name: He Lives Above the Clouds
episodes.overview: The unassuming Tadano turns out to be a rising tech mogul. He offers to take Retsuko out for ramen, but it's nothing like she imagined.

episodes.name: She's Dreaming
episodes.overview: Retsuko begins to dream of a happy future with Tadano. She joins him on a business-related golf outing, and is horrified when Director Ton shows up.

episodes.name: Wonderful Life
episodes.overview: The world learns all about Retsuko’s high profile relationship and Tadano declares that he wants to be with her forever -- without getting married.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Retsuko’s rage rises another octave when she finds herself moonlighting with an underground idol group to pay off her debts.

episodes.name: The Blessings of Life
episodes.overview: With her romance over, Retsuko fills the void with a virtual boyfriend. Her savings take a massive hit when she spends recklessly on in-game purchases.

episodes.name: Deep in the Hole
episodes.overview: Retsuko inadvertently backs into a parked car, damaging the other vehicle. Desperate for repair money, she reaches out to Gori for a loan.

episodes.name: A Sheltered Life
episodes.overview: To repay her debt, Retsuko starts working as the accounting manager for an underground idol group. In reality, she's at their beck and call.

episodes.name: Winds of Change
episodes.overview: The OTMGirls turn a profit for the first time thanks to Retsuko’s business acumen. Haida hits it off with Inui after an unexpected encounter.

episodes.name: An Urchin in the Desert
episodes.overview: After seeing Retsuko sing, Hyodo proposes that Retsuko become the lead vocalist, demoting Manaka in the process.

episodes.name: Crossroads
episodes.overview: The group’s popularity soars after a blogger's favorable review. Concerned by Retsuko's recent odd behavior, Haida secretly tails her to Hokkaido.

episodes.name: An Impenetrable Wall
episodes.overview: The OTMGirls receive an offer to perform at a rock festival. Hyodo rebrands the idols as a band, and the members must now learn to play instruments.

episodes.name: Bursting Her Bubble
episodes.overview: Manaka’s devotion to instrumental mastery inspires others to step up. Haida agrees to teach Retsuko guitar, but he invites Inui over on the same day.

episodes.name: The End of the Moratorium
episodes.overview: Inui opens up to Haida about her feelings, but he's unable to respond. Director Ton lectures Retsuko when he learns she has a side gig.

episodes.name: When You Count to Ten
episodes.overview: She's shaken, but Retsuko acts normal in front of her bandmates after a deranged fan accosts her. Haida struggles to choose between Retsuko and Inui.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Retsuko turns up the volume to stop Haida from making the biggest mistake ever when a sly new company president takes the office to a new extreme.

episodes.name: Someone from Work
episodes.overview: With a new apartment and a collection of weapons, Retsuko moves forward after her attack, but her relationship with Haida remains at a standstill.

episodes.name: The New Boss
episodes.overview: Haida helps the company president to the hospital after avoiding Retsuko. Changes come to the office when Himuro is chosen as the company new lead.

episodes.name: Dirty Work
episodes.overview: Retsuko and Haida's relationship worsens, and Fenneko panics. Himuro orders Ton to lay off several workers to save costs, but Ton refuses.

episodes.name: Unkept Promises
episodes.overview: Retsuko and Fenneko blab to Himuro about Ton's past work harassment during a night of drinking. Retsuko tells Haida she only wants to be friends.

episodes.name: Options
episodes.overview: Ton despairs about his demotion while Yagyu becomes the new director. Haida gains a confidence boost after Retsuko reaches out to him.

episodes.name: Struggle for Survival
episodes.overview: Ton resigns without telling his family. Yagyu nags Kabae after she leaves early to care for her son. Retsuko and her friends worry about more changes.

episodes.name: Moving Up
episodes.overview: Himuro praises Haida's work; Retsuko learns about Ton's new job. Feeling guilty, she tries to talk to Haida, but he's too busy doing Himuro's bidding.

episodes.name: Headhunting
episodes.overview: Encouraged by Tadano, Retsuko tries to get Ton to manage her Death-Voice channel. Haida accepts a nefarious task from Himuro.

episodes.name: Unauthorized Access
episodes.overview: Retsuko uncovers Haida's actions after he gets his own office and seeks advice from Ton. Finally, Retsuko decides to confront Haida.

episodes.name: Rendezvous
episodes.overview: Retsuko's friends join up to gather evidence of fraud. After Haida admits his involvement and Retsuko berates him, he makes one last critical decision.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: In this final season, Retsuko faces her biggest challenge yet when she's thrown head first into the world of politics. Get out the vote for Retsuko!

episodes.name: A Prison Called Freedom
episodes.overview: Haida still doesn't have a job, and doesn't seem interested in getting another one any time soon – which makes Retsuko feel uneasy.

episodes.name: Spooky Shikabane
episodes.overview: With no job, no home and no girlfriend, Haida hunkers down in an internet cafe and, mortifyingly, bumps into an online friend in real life.

episodes.name: ANAGURA and Reality
episodes.overview: Under the avatar "Fennelope," Fenneko befriends Haida and Shikabane in the online game and sets up a meeting with them in real life.

episodes.name: Restart
episodes.overview: Haida now has to visit Retsuko's parents in two weeks. He'll have to tell them that he's unemployed — unless he can find a job before then.

episodes.name: A Mysterious Messenger
episodes.overview: A suspicious looking man comes up to Manaka after an OTM Girls' show and asks her about "Aggressive Retsuko." Haida meets up with Tadano.

episodes.name: A Family Emergency
episodes.overview: Haida tells her she doesn't have to come, but Retsuko insists on going with him to visit his family home — and it's nothing like what she expected.

episodes.name: Rage Mission
episodes.overview: Retsuko gets approached by a suspicious, but somewhat familiar-looking man who really, really wants her to run for office.

episodes.name: Rising to the Challenge
episodes.overview: The day after taking to the stage with Ikari, Retsuko is filled with stress and regret. Time for an epic karaoke session!

episodes.name: A Disconnected World
episodes.overview: Running for office isn't for the faint hearted — or the empty pocketed. They need to come up with a 3 million yen deposit fast.

episodes.name: The Other Side of Rage
episodes.overview: The pressure almost gets the better of her, but after a quick interaction with Ton, Retsuko picks up the microphone to speak to her potential voters.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A teenaged gang leader in New York City faces his abuser and rival gangs alongside a photojournalist from Japan as they investigate a deadly new drug.

episodes.name: A Perfect Day for Bananafish
episodes.overview: In New York, Ash Lynx a boy with an perfect appearance and outstanding fighting power has been leading a street gang at the age of 17. One night, Ash is told the word "Banana Fish" from a man shot by his own subordinate. The word was that Griffin, his brother…

episodes.name: In Another Country
episodes.overview: Skip and Eiji were taken away by Frederick Arthur's gangs. Ash is caught by Marvin, a subordinate of Golzine who has joined hands with Arthur, when he rushed out to save the two who were taken away. The three tries to escape with Ash's tact. However, Shorter…

episodes.name: Across the River and into the Trees
episodes.overview: Ash is sent to prison. The journalist Max who was in the same room was asked to look after Ash by Charlie, a detective. However, a young and good-looking Ash is attacked by Garvey, a prisoner who was under the patronage of Golzine. But in the medical office h…

episodes.name: This Side of Paradise
episodes.overview: It was Arthur who appeared before Eiji who was visiting Meredith's medical clinic after being asked by Ash. However, seeing Griffin coming out of the back room of the medical clinic, Abraham becomes confused all of a sudden and shoots Griffin. Eiji presumes t…

episodes.name: From Death to Morning
episodes.overview: With Jenkins' discretion, Ash is released. Upon finding out that Griffin has died, Ash tries to go to Golzine by himself. But Eiji insists that the reason Griffin died was because of him, and forcibly follows Ash.

episodes.name: My Lost City
episodes.overview: In the hope that Griffin has left materials and photos of "Banana Fish", Ash and his group headed to Cape Cod, Ash's hometown. Although Ash arrives at his home, his father Jim treats him coldly. When Eiji and Max asks Jim, who is trying to kick out Ash, why h…

episodes.name: The Rich Boy
episodes.overview: Ash and his group heads to Los Angeles with the address "102, 42 Westwood" after getting away from Golzine's posses. After stopping by Max's ex-wife Jessica and his son Michael's house, they head to the place of the mysterious address. There, they find a mans…

episodes.name: Banal Story
episodes.overview: Jessica and Michael are attacked by someone. Ash and Max go to help the two, and Eiji, Shorter and Ibe were waiting for Ash and Max to come back. However, Eiji is kidnapped by Yut Lung's ruse. Ash returns to the mansion after sensing something wrong...

episodes.name: Save Me The Waltz
episodes.overview: Eiji and Shorter are taken to Golzine's residence, but Shorter is restrained by Golzine's men. Meanwhile, Ash and Max were also headed toward Golzine's residence. In the laboratory there, Abraham is preparing for some type of experiment.

episodes.name: Babylon Revisited
episodes.overview: Shorter being dead, Ash is devastated. Outside, Sing and Alex are carefully planning their rescue mission, to get Ash and Shorter out of Golzine's mansion. Meanwhile, Golzine leaves, taking Arthur with him. Yut Lung witnesses this, and notices something very…

episodes.name: The Beautiful and Damned
episodes.overview: Ash and his guys have escaped from Golzine's mansion. Golzine is furious as his mansion is set on fire, and is even angrier to have had Ash slip away from his hands. Ash is back in his hideout, and is spending some quiet time with Eiji but soon enough, he set…

episodes.name: To Have and Have Not
episodes.overview: Arthur's guys are killed by Ash back to back, including Wookie. Ash instructs his guys to chase the gangs that are working with Arthur out of Manhattan, all the while making arrangements to send Eiji back to Japan.

episodes.name: The Snows of Kilimanjaro
episodes.overview: Ash heads to the agreed place where he shall face Arthur to settle it once and for all. Eiji, who had been left behind, wakes up and is told to head back to Japan by Ash's guys. However, as he finds out that Ash is facing Arthur, despite being stopped, he hur…

episodes.name: Tender is the Night
episodes.overview: Ash is in the hospital, in critical condition, after being stabbed by Arthur. Max and Ibe are waiting for Eiji at the airport but hear about the incident on the news and contacts Charlie immediately. Eiji is locked up together with gang members, and Ash's wor…

episodes.name: The Garden of Eden
episodes.overview: Eiji hears that Ash is dead, but just can't believe it. He takes Yut Lung hostage to get out of the mansion. Once out, Eiji tries to leave Yut Lung but Yut Lung tells Eiji to go ahead and kill himself. Meanwhile, Max, George and Captain Jenkins head to the Na…

episodes.name: Lo, the Poor Peacock
episodes.overview: Ash steals the ID of a security guard and succeeds in fleeing. He takes Dawson with him. The guards notice, but can't get hold of them. Meantime, Max and Ibe, who got into the National Mental Health Institute posing as some random head to rescue Ash...

episodes.name: The Killers
episodes.overview: Ash has fled from the National Mental Health Institute and is heading to Sing's hideout. There, he sees Eiji again. Sing finds out why Shorter was killed and tries to tell the others but Ash stops him. Tension fills the air. Meanwhile, Hua-Lung asks for Golzi…

episodes.name: Islands in the Stream
episodes.overview: Ash returns from Kippard's room and Eiji happily starts looking after him. One day, Ash goes out into town with Max, and there, he hears about Holstock's death. Ash is convinced that Kippard and Holstock were murdered by someone. The one who did it was actual…

episodes.name: Ice Palace
episodes.overview: Ash falls into the hands of Golzine, following a deal with Yut Lung. Eiji senses that Yut Lung has something to do with Ash not coming back and goes to see Sing to find out more about it. Meanwhile, Yut Lung approaches Blanca, who has just sealed the deal wit…

episodes.name: The Unvanquished
episodes.overview: Eiji finds out that Ash will be present at a party hosted by Golzine, and heads there with Sing, Cain, and Alex. Accompanying Yut Lung to the same party is Blanca. He secretly approaches Ash, who has gone temporarily blind due to some medication he was given.

episodes.name: The Undefeated
episodes.overview: Ash and the other guys successfully flee from Golzine and Yut Lung. A wounded Sing also manages to return to their place, but his guys have been taken hostage by Yut Lung. Ash and Cain set about coming up with a way to rescue them. Meanwhile, Yut Lung, with Y…

episodes.name: As I Lay Dying
episodes.overview: As Max and the guys are being held captive, Ash goes to face Foxx. In the meantime, Max and the guys are taken to the National Mental Health Institute. Eiji and Sing head to rescue Ash together with Cain, and Alex follows the car with Max and the guys on it.

episodes.name: For Whom the Bell Tolls
episodes.overview: Eiji is shot, and is taken to the hospital. Ash tries to go with him, but it's none other than Blanca who stops him. Blanca tries to take care of Ash's wound, but Ash points a gun at him. Meanwhile, Sing who is feeling guilty for two of his guys shooting Eiji…

episodes.name: The Catcher in the Rye
episodes.overview: Ash demands to have the hostages released, in exchange for sparing Golzine's life. But that's when Foxx betrays Golzine. Cain, Sing, and Blanca quickly take action to save the hostages together with Ash. Meanwhile, Eiji, who's in the hospital, decides to fina…

episodes.name: Synchronicity
episodes.overview: Underground martial arts promoter Tokugawa warns champion Baki that five violent death row escapees from around the world are all heading for Tokyo.

episodes.name: Dark Martial Arts
episodes.overview: While Baki easily subdues the thugs hired by delinquents from his own school, death row escapee Spec pays a visit to assess the champion's abilities.

episodes.name: They're Finally Here!!
episodes.overview: Death row escapee Dorian barges into the Shinshinkai Dojo and is confronted by Sea King Retsu, who's there coaching students in Chinese martial arts.

episodes.name: The Battle Begins
episodes.overview: With all five death row escapees and their opponents assembled inside the underground arena, Tokugawa officially declares the beginning of battle.

episodes.name: Want some more?
episodes.overview: While out with Kozue, Baki is almost ambushed by Spec, but he' s spared a fight when Kaoru suddenly appears to protect the couple from harm's way.

episodes.name: Sergeant Katahira’s Report
episodes.overview: Spec unleashes moves lethal enough to take out even the strongest of opponents in one strike, but Hanayama counters with improbable moves of his own.

episodes.name: A Formidable Team
episodes.overview: Ambushed by Doyle while in class, Baki leads Doyle away from the classroom only to encounter Yanagi in disguise outside.

episodes.name: A Match vs. A True Fight
episodes.overview: While Baki and his allies discuss the events that transpired at his school, Dorian appears, infiltrating Tokugawa's heavily guarded compound.

episodes.name: Shaken Shinshinkai
episodes.overview: Kiyosumi Kato, known as one of the strongest fighters of Shinshinkai Karate, confronts Dorian deep inside his secret underground hideout.

episodes.name: Air Duel
episodes.overview: Boasting one million members nationwide, the Shinshinkai lures Dorian to an amusement park, where Kato's peer Suedo immediately strikes.

episodes.name: Tiger Slayer
episodes.overview: As Dorian's past comes to light, Shinshinkai founder and "tiger killer" Doppo Orochi takes him on in an all-out karate versus kempo battle.

episodes.name: Candy
episodes.overview: Doppo Orochi pummels the life out of terror-stricken Dorian before bringing the equally injured Kiyosumi Kato over to administer the finishing blows.

episodes.name: Mr. Oliva
episodes.overview: Biscuit Oliva arrives in Tokyo to capture the remaining convicts. Sikorsky lures Baki into battle with help from an unlikely source.

episodes.name: Unforgivable Freedom
episodes.overview: While searching the police database for clues, an unsuspecting Biscuit Oliva is ambushed by Doyle, who shows up dressed as a female police officer.

episodes.name: Tremendous Muscle Power
episodes.overview: While searching the police database for clues, an unsuspecting Biscuit Oliva is ambushed by Doyle, who shows up dressed as a female police officer.

episodes.name: Slash
episodes.overview: Biscuit Oliva thinks he should get a black belt if he can score a point against every officer on the judo team, but Sonoda resists giving him one.

episodes.name: Dad!!
episodes.overview: The deadly fight between Kosho Shinogi and Doyle reaches its spectacular climax. Meanwhile, Yujiro pays a visit to an unsuspecting Baki and Kozue.

episodes.name: Thanks
episodes.overview: Known as the pinnacle master of Chinese martial arts, Sea King Retsu displays his masterful use of weaponry against a fully armed Hector Doyle.

episodes.name: Admission of Defeat
episodes.overview: After setting off an explosion inside Shinshinkai's dojo, Doyle is confronted by its founder, Doppo. Tokugawa pays a visit to Ryukoh Yanagi's master.

episodes.name: Saga
episodes.overview: Tokugawa learns of the Poison Hand: the ultimate killer move of the "kudo" martial art form. Baki takes the next step in his relationship with Kozue.

episodes.name: Punishment
episodes.overview: A newly invigorated Baki easily handles attacks from both Ryukoh Yanagi and Sikorsky, but before finishing them off, Baki makes an unusual move.

episodes.name: Clash of the Alphas
episodes.overview: Baki's half-brother Jack Hammer challenges Sikorsky at a local park, where a battle inside the most inconceivable of places goes down.

episodes.name: The Real Attack
episodes.overview: Sikorsky is brought inside an unground battle arena to face Gaia, whose unorthodox fighting method slowly wears out the ruthless Russian killer.

episodes.name: Defeat
episodes.overview: With Ryukoh Yanagi's poison hand no longer a threat, Yujiro Hanma urges him to admit defeat against the sword-wielding jujutsu fighter Izo Motobe.

episodes.name: God and the Devil
episodes.overview: Legendary world heavyweight boxing champion Arai reflects on his tense encounter with a young Yujiro Hanma.

episodes.name: The Centennial Tournament
episodes.overview: Retsu pleads with his mentor, Sea King Ryu, to grant a mortally poisoned Baki special entry into the Raitai martial arts tournament.

seasons.name: Great Raitai Tournament / Godlike Clash of the Kids Saga

episodes.name: Begin! The Centennial Tournament
episodes.overview: Mohammad Alai Jr. tests a battle-eager Yujiro. Even though he's been poisoned, Sea King Retsu enters Baki into the Great Raitai Tournament in China.

episodes.name: Turnaround
episodes.overview: Alai Jr.'s deadly speed makes quick work of his opponent. A severely emaciated Baki faces Sea King Li, the greatest Poison Hand user in all of China.

episodes.name: Revived!
episodes.overview: Sea Emperor Kaku is 121 years older than his opponent, but the legendary reigning champion doesn't hesitate to face Sea King Samwan in the arena.

episodes.name: Team Formed!
episodes.overview: Sea King Chin and Japan's sole Sea King, Jaku, battle on the tournament floor. Meanwhile, Baki provokes Yujiro into fighting him offstage.

episodes.name: Hand Pocket
episodes.overview: Biscuit Oliva's sheer power is unrivaled, but Shobun Ron and his unconventional fighting stance are unbothered. It's brute strength versus iai kenpo.

episodes.name: Excellennnnt!
episodes.overview: A genius of Chinese kenpo, Retsu is the superior fighter, but Jaku's dirty techniques and tactical prowess make him a formidable foe.

episodes.name: Kaioh
episodes.overview: Sea Emperor Kaku is the embodiment of Chinese kenpo. Yujiro Hanma is known as the strongest creature on Earth. A battle unlike any other begins!

episodes.name: The Title of the Strongest
episodes.overview: Yujiro pits his raw power against Kaku's martial arts skills, which he's honed for over a century. The match's shocking outcome stuns everyone.

episodes.name: The Master vs the Boxer
episodes.overview: Alai Jr. proposes to Kozue, who's dumbfounded. To prove he's a better man than Baki, Alai Jr. challenges the elderly aikido master Goki Shibukawa.

episodes.name: Stand and Fight
episodes.overview: Alai Jr. continues testing his skill against notable fighters, but Baki's half-brother Jack Hammer is unlike any combatant he's faced before.

episodes.name: Awakening
episodes.overview: Badly injured from his street fights, Alai Jr. returns to his hotel room. There his father, the greatest boxer of all time, challenges him to a match.

episodes.name: Completion
episodes.overview: A battle between the sons of two legendary fighters begins deep below Tokyo Dome. It’s Baki versus Alai Jr., and the winner is anyone's guess.

episodes.name: Revenge Tokyo
episodes.overview: After Ryukoh Yanagi escapes from prison, Inspector Sonoda attempts to locate the other death row inmates who wreaked havoc on Tokyo.

episodes.name: ROUND 1
episodes.overview: The year is 1991 and 6th grader Yaguchi Haruo only has video games to live for. He's not popular in school and he's neither handsome, funny, nice nor even friendly. The only thing he has going for him is that he is good at video games. One day at the local ar…

episodes.name: ROUND 2
episodes.overview: Akira brings Haruo his homework when he misses school with a fever. In return, Haruo lets her play with his collection of PC Engine games.

episodes.name: ROUND 3
episodes.overview: With summer vacation coming to an end, Haruo and Akira join their classmates on a trip to the flower park, but eye the amusement park next door.

episodes.name: ROUND 4
episodes.overview: Haruo invites classmate Hidaka to play a game of Street Fighter II Dash when she's caught in a snowstorm on her way home from school.

episodes.name: ROUND 5
episodes.overview: Haruo is taken aback after witnessing Hidaka eliminate Sub-Zero with a complex "FATALITY" move while playing Mortal Kombat for the first time.

episodes.name: ROUND 6
episodes.overview: As Haruo pulls off Guile's super combo moves on the newly added Super Street Fighter II X machine, a familiar face returns to the local arcade scene.

episodes.name: ROUND 7
episodes.overview: Eager to play with Haruo, Hidaka buys a copy of Final Fight for the Super Famicom console. Haruo and class head to Kyoto for an overnight school trip.

episodes.name: ROUND 8
episodes.overview: With tours of historic landmarks over for the day, Haruo sneaks off alone to the city of Osaka to compete in the Super Street Fighter II X tournament.

episodes.name: ROUND 9
episodes.overview: With high school entrance exams coming up next year, Haruo fears his time playing fighting games at the arcade with Akira will soon come to an end.

episodes.name: ROUND 10
episodes.overview: Now in his first year of high school, Haruo realizes his time playing the new Sega Saturn console at home have greatly diminished his arcade skills.

episodes.name: ROUND 11
episodes.overview: Hidaka asks Akira about her feelings toward Haruo while playing Virtua Cop in co-op mode. Out of his funk, Haruo searches for Akira at local arcades.

episodes.name: ROUND 12
episodes.overview: Stranded out late with Akira, Haruo asks his mother to help him find a place to stay. Hidaka visits Haruo's house to lend him her PlayStation console.

episodes.name: ROUND 16
episodes.overview: Moemi has pushed Akira to excel her whole life, but all she cared about was arcade games. She still likes games, but she also likes Haruo.

episodes.name: ROUND 17
episodes.overview: Completely oblivious, Haruo watches in awe as Koharu and Akira duke it out on Virtua Fighter 2. At the game center, Koharu can't help but taunt him.

episodes.name: ROUND 18
episodes.overview: Representing Shibuya, Haruo faces players from Mizonokuchi, including Koharu, in a 10-person Street Fighter Zero 2 arcade battle.

episodes.name: ROUND 19
episodes.overview: When Makoto presses him about his feelings towards Akira and Koharu, Haruo flees. Out on the street, he's abducted by a group of men in suits.

episodes.name: ROUND 20
episodes.overview: Koharu challenges Akira to a Super Street Fighter II X match. For her, there's more riding on the game than which of them is the arcade champion.

episodes.name: ROUND 21
episodes.overview: Haruo realizes how much Akira means to him and visits Miyao to confirm it. To prove himself, he invites Akira to join him at a tournament in Osaka.

episodes.name: ROUND 22
episodes.overview: Akira keeps her impending move to Los Angeles a secret. In Osaka, she and Haruo spend their time on the eve of the tournament in various arcades.

episodes.name: ROUND 23
episodes.overview: The tournament begins with Haruo running on very little sleep. After he advances in his own match, he's dumbfounded to see the result of Akira's.

episodes.name: ROUND 24
episodes.overview: Akira and Haruo face off in the tournament's final round. Months later, Haruo hasn't recovered and Akira's departure nears. Then Makoto comes to visit.

seasons.name: Limited Series
seasons.overview: This series tells the story of Kang Mi-rae, a girl once bullied for her looks. As a result, she became insecure, cautious around people and withdrawn. However, Mi-rae decides she wants a fresh start away from bullying and gets plastic surgery to transform her…

episodes.name: I'm Pretty Starting from Today
episodes.overview: Tormented for her looks throughout most of her life, Kang Mi-rae makes a big decision to make sure that college will be different.

episodes.name: You Should've Been Pretty from the Get-go
episodes.overview: Mi-rae shows her new face to her father. At school, she attracts the attention of students including Do Kyeong-seok, who knows about her past.

episodes.name: You Don’t Even Know
episodes.overview: A bully brings out Mi-rae's insecurities, while rumors of her past connection to Kyeong-seok start to spread around school.

episodes.name: You’ve Grown Up So Much
episodes.overview: Kyeong-seok feels conflicted about the CEO of a perfume company, who becomes a new role model for Mi-rae.

episodes.name: The Handsome Guy’s Counterattack
episodes.overview: Mi-rae has a heart-to-heart chat with Kyeong-seok, while plans for the college festival make her uneasy when she sees the outfit she's supposed to wear.

episodes.name: The Handsome Guy’s Counterattack Part 2
episodes.overview: Mi-rae runs into an old classmate at the festival and notices that there's something odd about Hyeon Su-a.

episodes.name: A Guy Friend
episodes.overview: The campus is abuzz with gossip about his privileged background, as Kyeong-seok arrives at an ugly truth about his broken family.

episodes.name: Basic Instinct
episodes.overview: Mi-rae and Kyeong-seok go to the movies and have dinner together. Kyeong-seok goes in search for new lodging.

episodes.name: The Survival Story of a 20-Year-Old
episodes.overview: The newly independent Kyeong-seok looks for a job, starts over with his mother, and decides to be honest about his feelings for Mi-rae.

episodes.name: I Can Be Your Boyfriend
episodes.overview: Kyeong-seok and Yeon U-yeong compete for Mi-rae's affections. Mi-rae deals with her low self-confidence when Su-a reveals her true colors.

episodes.name: Your ID is Gangnam Beauty
episodes.overview: Believing she's not good enough for Kyeong-seok, Mi-rae tries to distance herself but can't avoid him when they start a part-time job at the same place.

episodes.name: Don't You Have Feelings for Me?
episodes.overview: Mi-rae says she only thinks of him as a friend, but Kyeong-seok doesn't give up. An unexpected talk with U-yeong puts Mi-rae in a bind.

episodes.name: It’s My First Love
episodes.overview: Mi-rae starts to see herself in a new light after she gets a worrying glimpse of Su-a -- and also makes a decision about Kyeong-seok.

episodes.name: Start Secretly
episodes.overview: Trying to date in secret proves to be a challenge for Mi-rae and Kyeong-seok. Su-a is perturbed by photos of her circulating online.

episodes.name: My Boyfriend is Do Kyeong-seok
episodes.overview: Su-a confronts the wrong person about the photos. Mi-rae and Kyeong-seok decide to tell their classmates about their relationship.

episodes.name: Even Though We Don't Know Much About Life Yet
episodes.overview: Su-a escapes a bad situation with Mi-rae's help and decides to make some changes. Mi-rae plans a surprise for Kyeong-seok's birthday.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: With aliens once again threatening Earth, young Shinjiro must now don the metallic Ultraman Suit to become Ultraman -- like his father before him.

episodes.name: A Power That Does Not Belong On Earth
episodes.overview: Decades since he last merged with Ultraman, Shin Hayata learns of a new threat to Earth. His son, Shinjiro, also shows signs of superhuman strength.

episodes.name: An Inevitable Fate
episodes.overview: Wearing a protosuit, Shin is critically injured while saving Shinjiro from Bemular's attack. In desperation, Shinjiro returns to rescue his father.

episodes.name: Being Ultraman Isn't So Bad
episodes.overview: With Bemular paving the way for other alien species to attack Earth, SSSP's Edo asks Shinjiro to take on the mantle of Ultraman.

episodes.name: Release the Limiter!
episodes.overview: Shinjiro is sent on a mission to exterminate a hostile alien, but the target flees into the city, endangering countless civilians.

episodes.name: An Alien Town
episodes.overview: After uncovering evidence of alien involvement in a string of bizarre homicides, SSSP agent Moroboshi contacts an informant inside an alien enclave.

episodes.name: The Curse That Is Ultraman
episodes.overview: Shinjiro’s reluctance to execute homicidal aliens deeply concerns agent Moroboshi. Shin shares with his son what it truly means to be Ultraman.

episodes.name: Hidden Thoughts
episodes.overview: Embattled at first, Shinjiro finds his resolve and activates a latent power during his fight against a hostile alien. Rena prepares for a big concert.

episodes.name: The Dawn of Truth
episodes.overview: At Rena's concert, an alien calling himself Adad demands a confrontation with Ultraman. Things go from bad to worse when Bemular joins the fray.

episodes.name: Nice To Meet You, Big Brother
episodes.overview: Shinijiro fears that his cover may be blown by an underclassman. Later on, he's taken aback when a rogue Ultraman shows up to aid him in battle.

episodes.name: Star Cluster Council
episodes.overview: Seiji dreams of a day when aliens are accepted openly on Earth. Hoping to fight for this cause, he pleads with the SSSP to bring him on board.

episodes.name: Always Stay the Way You Are
episodes.overview: Seiji has a tense confrontation with Shinjiro and Moroboshi over the use of his powers. Rena asks Shinjiro to give Ultraman a message.

episodes.name: Ace Killer
episodes.overview: Moroboshi, Shinjiro and the might of the SSSP sets out to protect Seiji on his quest to punish those responsible for the airline tragedy 12 years ago.

episodes.name: The Real Ultraman
episodes.overview: The Ultraman trio are fighting a losing battle against the mercenaries, but just when things seem hopeless, Shinjiro's dormant power finally awakens.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Ultraman teams up with Seven, Ace, Zoffy, Jack and Taro, and together, the united Ultraman brotherhood takes on a new alien threat.

episodes.name: The Man from NY
episodes.overview: While meeting with Rena, Shinjiro suddenly gets a call to stop a rampaging alien. Journalist Kotaro Higashi witnesses the whole incident.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: As public sentiment turns against Ultraman, Shinjiro learns that his inherited powers may come with a heavy price, in this exciting series conclusion.

episodes.name: The Sign of a New Awakening
episodes.overview: Shinjiro agrees to help test out and develop a new suit better adapted to his changing powers — and he finds himself using it much sooner than planned.

episodes.name: The Curse of Ultraman
episodes.overview: He can't remember what he did, but Shinjiro's forbidden from wearing his suit for a while. His father can't help but feel that there's an Ultraman curse.

episodes.name: The Choice of a Hero
episodes.overview: Determined to do something, Shinjiro heads out to get his revenge. But then once again, he wakes up with no memory of what happened.

episodes.name: No One to Trust
episodes.overview: Public sentiment has turned completely against Ultraman. Then suddenly, Mephisto hijacks the airwaves to deliver a message directly to the people.

episodes.name: Hide and Seek
episodes.overview: Ide sends Taro and Moroboshi out to search for Shinjiro, who remains on the run, confused by everything that's been happening to him.

episodes.name: A Warrior's Return
episodes.overview: Back in his hideout, Daisuke Arashi tells Shinjiro about his father's past, and they try to narrow down who Mephisto's next target might be.

episodes.name: The Fourth Successor
episodes.overview: After getting devastating news, Rena meets with Seiji Hokuto. Shinjiro talks to Daisuke about the strange dreams he's been having about Zetton.

episodes.name: TARO vs ULTRAMAN
episodes.overview: Rena can't understand what just happened to her, so Seiji brings her to meet the alien who raised him. Taro finally finds Shinjiro.

episodes.name: Time of Awakening
episodes.overview: Jack shows up, surprising Taro and Shinjiro. Rena seeks some answers about where her powers come from. The SSSP gets raided by the police.

episodes.name: The Disaster
episodes.overview: The fight against Mephisto only strengthens the anti-Ultraman sentiment. Moroboshi and Shinjiro try to break into the heavily guarded SSSP headquarters.

episodes.name: A Nightmare Come True
episodes.overview: Shinjiro and Rena reveal some secrets to each other. Joined by his friends, Ultraman faces a powerful enemy from the past.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.overview: As Shinjiro struggles in his own fight, his friends put everything they can into defeating Zetton. A new chapter begins for the SSSP.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Upon losing his memory, a crown prince encounters a commoner’s life and experiences unforgettable love as the husband to Joseon’s oldest bachelorette.

episodes.name: Today Is Your Only Chance to Cry
episodes.overview: Yul falls in love with Yun Yi-seo the son of Yun Bu-jun at first sight. Yul sneaks into Yi-seo's house, but the abrupt rebellion turns her house into chaos. Yi-seo and Yul are forever apart.

episodes.name: Crown Prince in Great Agony
episodes.overview: Under the crown prince's command, a spinster Hong Shim is about to become a concubine of lord Park.

episodes.name: Your Name Is Won Deuk
episodes.overview: After losing memory, Yul becomes Won-deuk and marries Hong Shim. Awkward and unfamiliar marriage begins.

episodes.name: The Newlywed Couple in Debt
episodes.overview: Hong Shim is busy taking care of the mess that useless Won-deuk caused. In the palace, people are sent to Mt. Cheongwoosan to find the missing crown prince.

episodes.name: Do You Not Consider Me Your Daughter Anymore?
episodes.overview: Cha-eon searching for the crown prince finds the corpse in the prince's outfit at Mt. Cheongwoosan.

episodes.name: Do You Know How Much I Missed You?
episodes.overview: At the market, Hong Shim chases after a guy who looks like her brother. While Kim Cha-eon hurriedly prepares a funeral for the crown prince, Je-yun is busy solving the puzzle that the prince left.

episodes.name: Stay with Me
episodes.overview: With the secret letter that Yul left, Je-yun asks Kim Cha-eon to meet privately. Won-deuk who was looking for Hong Shim gets attacked by the gangsters.

episodes.name: You Are Not Won Deuk
episodes.overview: Kim Cha-eon pressures the king to depose the queen and the prince Seo-won. Hong-shim is uncomfortable about the present that Won-deuk gave her.

episodes.name: Everything I Told about You Is Not True
episodes.overview: Yul figured that he is not Won-deuk after all. To find the truth, he goes to Hanyang with Gu-dol. Je-yun becomes the new lord of Songju province and meets Hong Shim.

episodes.name: They Say His Highness Is Alive
episodes.overview: Won-deuk and Hong Shim realize feelings for each other. As the day when Hong Shim and her brother promised to leave comes, Hong Shim's concern deepens. The king who feared the increasing power of Kim Cha-eon meets Jeong Sa-yeop.

episodes.name: Vice-Premier Kim Is Missing
episodes.overview: Won-deuk and Hong Shim prepare for a fleeting together. Je-yun starts investigating Won-deuk's real identity. While Cha-eon is missing after being attacked by the assassins, people suggest Seo-won as the crown prince.

episodes.name: The Return of the Crown Prince
episodes.overview: Won-deuk comes back as the crown prince Yi Yul, but the palace doesn't feel like home, and can't stop worrying Hong Shim.

episodes.name: Demand from Ming’s Envoy
episodes.overview: Hong Shim tries to avoid Yul to leave with Mu-yeon. Due to the scheme of the queen, Yul attends the banquet to welcome the ambassador from Ming.

episodes.name: We Must Solve the Riddle
episodes.overview: In Hanyang, Hong Shim looks for Mu-yeon. In the meantime, Yul solves the puzzles with Je-yun to find memory.

episodes.name: Evidence of Vice-Premier’s Evil Deeds
episodes.overview: Yul recalls everything from the past and goes to So-hye. Hong Shim and the Songju province neighbors go to Kim Cha-eon's house to find Mu-yeon.

episodes.name: The End of War between Crown Prince and Vice-Premier
episodes.overview: For Yi-seo, Yul goes to war. There, he encounters Kim Cha-eon's private soldiers.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Corporate worker Mikami Satoru is stabbed by a random killer, and is reborn to an alternate world. But he turns out to be reborn a slime! Thrown into this new world with the name Rimuru, he begins his quest to create a world that’s welcoming to all races.

episodes.name: The Storm Dragon, Veldora
episodes.overview: Mikami Satoru, a businessman, is stabbed by a criminal on the street and killed. When he regains consciousness in the darkness, he finds that he's been reincarnated as a slime! With nothing better to do, he spends his time devouring all the rare herbs and pre…

episodes.name: Meeting the Goblins
episodes.overview: The slime Mikami and the Storm Dragon Veldora decide to give each other names. Veldora gives the slime Mikami the name "Rimuru," and Rimuru comes up with a family name for both of them: "Tempest." Then Rimuru uses his Predator skill to take Veldora into his b…

episodes.name: Battle at the Goblin Village
episodes.overview: After leaving the cave, Rimuru encounters a village of Goblins under attack by a clan of Direwolves. Caught in the heat of the moment, Rimuru agrees to help the Goblins in their battle. That night, the Direwolves arrive to try to take over as the new rulers o…

episodes.name: In the Kingdom of the Dwarves
episodes.overview: Rimuru and his companions visit the Dwarven Kingdom, the Armed Nation of Dwargon, in search of some artisans to help the Goblins learn to supply their own food, shelter, and clothing. However, a skirmish just outside the city gate lands Rimuru and Gobta in a…

episodes.name: Hero King, Gazel Dwargo
episodes.overview: Thanks to Rimuru's skill, Kaijin was able to finish all the longswords and deliver them to the king, so the two of them celebrate by heading to a bar staffed by lots of elf girls. One of them reads Rimuru's fortune for fun, and sees an image in her crystal ba…

episodes.name: Shizu
episodes.overview: One day, in the midst of the improvements on the Goblin Village with the help of Kaijin and the dwarves, Rimuru meets a trio of adventurers from the Guild who've been temporarily joined by a masked woman named Shizu. Shizu turns out to be the person Rimuru is…

episodes.name: Conqueror of Flames
episodes.overview: The Demon Lord Leon Cromwell summoned Shizu out of Tokyo as it burned during in the air raids, then forced the high-ranked spirit Ifrit to possess her. After taking over Shizu's body, Ifrit begins to rampage.

episodes.name: Inherited Will
episodes.overview: When Shizu was still with Demon Lord Leon, it was a Hero who rescued her. That Hero was Shizu's inspiration to help as many people as she could for many years. She even worked as a teacher for children who'd come from other worlds. And now, as her time comes…

episodes.name: Attack of the Ogres
episodes.overview: Rimuru and the Goblins' village is developing nicely. The Dwarves are building all kinds of houses and furniture, and the local Goblin Lords have appointed Rigurd as the Goblin King. As Rimuru watches everything come together, he decides to return to the cave…

episodes.name: The Orc Lord
episodes.overview: Six Ogres are all that remain of their clan after an attack by an Orc army. They say that the Orcs were traveling with a mysterious majin who wore plate mail and a clown mask. Rimuru proposes that the Ogres join his ranks, and they accept on the condition tha…

episodes.name: Gabiru is Here!
episodes.overview: Rimuru's village has gained Benimaru and the other five Ogres as its newest allies. Soon after, the Lizardman Gabiru visits the village, having heard rumors about it. Gabiru has been visiting Goblin villages throughout the Great Forest of Jura to enlist their…

episodes.name: The Gears Spin Out of Control
episodes.overview: The Orc army, led by the Orc Lord, continues its conquest throughout the Great Forest of Jura. The crisis has spurred Treyni of the Dryads, the caretakers of the forest, to take action. She has had her eye on Rimuru after noticing his rise to prominence in th…

episodes.name: The Great Clash
episodes.overview: Rimuru and his Goblin riders set out for the marshlands to finalize their alliance with the Lizardmen. On the way, they save a Lizardman who'd been attacked by the Orcs. The victim turns out to be Gabiru's younger sister, who reveals that Gabiru led an insurr…

episodes.name: The One Who Devours All
episodes.overview: The majin Gelmud makes his appearance at last. His true goal was to evolve the Orc Lord into the Orc Disaster, a Demon Lord, and have him reign over the Forest of Jura. Upon learning this, the Orc Lord takes action...

episodes.name: The Jura Forest Alliance
episodes.overview: Post-war arrangements following the battle with the Orcs have begun. At the meeting, Rimuru reveals that he made a promise with the Orc Disaster, Geld, to take all of the Orcs' sins upon himself. When the Ogres and Lizardmen hear this...

episodes.name: Demon Lord Milim Attacks
episodes.overview: The Jura Tempest Federation, with Rimuru as its leader, has formed an alliance with the Armed Nation of Dwargon. Just as Rimuru thinks there are only peaceful days ahead, he senses an enormous mass of magical power heading straight for his location at an incr…

episodes.name: The Gathering
episodes.overview: The Demon Lord Carrion has sent one of his Three Beastketeers, Phobio, on a raid of Rimuru's city. However, Phobio is quickly defeated when Milim meets his attack with her own. Rimuru and his subordinates then ask Phobio why he has come to their town.

episodes.name: Evil Creeps Closer
episodes.overview: Phobio can't restrain his anger toward Milim. He finds himself faced with Footman and Tear, two masked members of the Moderate Harlequin Alliance, who suggest that he become a Demon Lord to take revenge on Milim. They tell him that he can accomplish this usin…

episodes.name: Charybdis
episodes.overview: Its seal removed, the calamity-class monster Charybdis and its Medalodon minions advance on the capital city of Rimuru. The Jura Tempest Federation combines all its forces under Rimuru to intercept the attack. King Gazel even sends 100 of his Pegasus Knights…

episodes.name: Yuuki Kagurazaka
episodes.overview: The threat of Charybdis has gone. That night, Rimuru has a dream in which he sees Shizu teaching children at her school in the Kingdom of Ingrassia—a dream showing Shizu's lingering regret. To see her wishes through, Rimuru leaves the Jura Tempest Federation…

episodes.name: Shizu-san's Students
episodes.overview: Rimuru becomes the new teacher for Shizu's students. However, having been summoned into this world against their will and facing shortened lifespans as a result, the children's feelings are complicated, and they're reluctant to accept Rimuru. So Rimuru propos…

episodes.name: Conquering the Labyrinth
episodes.overview: Rimuru tries to think of a way to save the children of Freedom Academy who are fated to die. The idea he comes up with is to have superior spirits inhabit each of them, as Shizu had, so their lives won't end prematurely. Determined to whatever it takes to sav…

episodes.name: Saved Souls
episodes.overview: Rimuru and the children reach the deepest level of the Dwelling of Spirits, where they stand on a pedestal bathed in light to summon superior spirits. Will their summoning be successful? Amidst the uncertainty, the first to attempt the summoning is Gale, foll…

episodes.name: Black and the Mask
episodes.overview: This story takes place before Rimuru's reincarnation. Shizu, also known as the Conqueror of Flames, responds to an urgent request calling her to the Kingdom of Filtwood. When she reaches the castle, many adventurers are already there. What request could have…

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Now that the Jura Tempest Alliance is growing even further, they will now be meeting the animal kingdom of Eurazania, reuniting with King Gazel, rising tensions between monsters and humans, and Rimuru encountering the strongest enemy he’s ever faced.

episodes.name: Rimuru's Busy Life
episodes.overview: Rimuru sends a delegation led by Benimaru to the Animal Kingdom of Eurazania, ruled by the Demon Lord Carrion, also known as the Beastmaster, to establish diplomatic relations after becoming indebted to him in the battle against Charybdis. A delegation from E…

episodes.name: Trade with the Animal Kingdom
episodes.overview: Despite the initial conflict, Eurazania and Tempest have deemed each other to be worthy of establishing friendly relations, and diplomacy between them officially begins. Tempest agrees to share its industrial techniques in return for Eurazania's agricultural…

episodes.name: Paradise, Once More
episodes.overview: Rimuru completes the two very important duties of a discussion with King Dwargon and a public speech announcing the two nations' friendship to the people. Now it's time to head out for a little fun at the paradise he promised Gobta... while making sure Shuna…

episodes.name: The Scheming Kingdom of Falmuth
episodes.overview: Tempest is preparing a feast in celebration of Rimuru's return home. Then a newcomer, the majin Myulan, arrives to scope out Tempest on the Demon Lord Clayman's orders, having joined up with Youm's crew as their military advisor in order to enter the nation.…

episodes.name: Prelude to the Disaster
episodes.overview: Following Clayman's orders, Myulan ignores the words of Youm and Grucius, both of whom have fallen in love with her, and activates the Anti-Magic Area spell. At the same time, Reyheim also activates Prison Field. The double barrier prevents Shion and the othe…

episodes.name: The Beauty Makes Her Move
episodes.overview: At the same time as the attack on Tempest, Rimuru is also under attack. With one look, Rimuru realizes that his assailant is one of Shizu's former students, an Otherworlder, and the woman then introduces herself as the strongest of the Holy Knights, Hinata Sa…

episodes.name: Despair
episodes.overview: Rimuru faced grave danger in his battle with Hinata, but he managed to escape in the nick of time by using a doppelganger to take the damage while he rushed back to Tempest. Upon arrival, he found the city in a tragic state, engulfed by blood and smoke. Benim…

episodes.name: Hope
episodes.overview: Rimuru learns about Clayman and the schemes of the Kingdom of Falmuth, but no matter how hard he wishes for it, his fallen comrades and their peaceful lifestyle will never return. He's just about to give up when Eren tells him of a fairy tale that might offer…
