episodes.name: Putting Everything on the Line
episodes.overview: In order to come to terms with his own negligence and revive Shion, Gobta, and his other fallen comrades, Rimuru reveals that he used to be a human. But his allies think nothing of it and accept him regardless, as if it's the natural thing to do. Filled with…

episodes.name: Megiddo
episodes.overview: The battle for revenge has begun. Benimaru and his trusted companions carry out their respective missions, while Hakurou and his party face Shogo and Kyoya once again. And Rimuru's fury rains down upon the army from Falmuth.

episodes.name: Birth of a Demon Lord
episodes.overview: Rimuru succeeds in collecting enough souls to carry out his plan to evolve, and the Harvest Festival begins. But he's suddenly overcome by intense sleepiness at the same time, so he summons a demon to stop Razen, the one target who escaped alive. Then, upon r…

episodes.name: The One Unleashed
episodes.overview: Shion and the rest of the fallen are revived, Diablo has joined the team... It seems as if all is going smoothly, but Rimuru then receives a report that Milim has declared war and Eurazania has been destroyed, and there's still the matter of the Western Holy…

episodes.name: The Visitors
episodes.overview: A feast is thrown to celebrate the revival of Tempest's fallen and the return of Veldora. After enjoying a brief, peaceful respite, Rimuru tells everyone his future plans: he's going to get the word out to the whole world that he's a Demon Lord and declare wa…

episodes.name: A Meeting of Humans and Monsters
episodes.overview: As prominent figures from several nations assemble in Tempest for a meeting, Laplace and his companions formulate a plan centered around Clayman. Then someone familiar joins the discussion...

episodes.name: Ramiris's Warning
episodes.overview: Rimuru announces his plan to back Youm as the new king of Falmuth. After hearing this, Gazel tests Youm to see if he has what it takes to be a ruler, and Youm answers with full sincerity. Erald also takes a liking to Rimuru after hearing him say he just wants…

episodes.name: The Congress Dances
episodes.overview: A new force has suddenly risen to power in the Great Forest of Jura, and its leader, Clayman, proposes that the Demon Lords hold Walpurgis with the goal of sanctioning the slime who deceived him. Rimuru also begins to prepare for a battle with Clayman, but ob…

episodes.name: The Eve of Battle
episodes.overview: To put a stop to Clayman's plans, Rimuru uses transport magic on a large scale to both move Tempest's army to Eurazania and evacuate the people of Eurazania to Tempest. Rimuru also decides to crash Walpurgis, the Demon Lords' banquet, in order to settle the s…

episodes.name: The Demon Lords
episodes.overview: Benimaru leads his army to Eurazania, and Youm heads to Falmuth to take it over along with his buddies and Diablo. Rimuru succeeds in outwitting Clayman by transporting all of Eurazania's refugees to Tempest. Since Clayman has been striving to evolve into an…

episodes.name: The Signal to Begin the Banquet
episodes.overview: Rimuru continues with preparations for Walpurgis, including making Treyni evolve into a Dryas Doll Dryad. Meanwhile, Benimaru and his forces have arrived in Eurazania via transport magic, and they promptly run Clayman's army into a trap set by Geld. The Three…

episodes.name: On This Land Where It All Happened
episodes.overview: Gabiru narrowly wins his battle against Hermes. Watching their outcome is Middray of the Dragon Faithful, whose skill was enough to overwhelm even Suphia. Though he looks like a human, he is actually a Dragonewt like Gabiru. Meanwhile, Yamza uses his artifact…

episodes.name: Adalman, the Index Finger
episodes.overview: With all the preparations complete, Rimuru heads out to attend Walpurgis with Shion and Ranga, while Ramiris takes Beretta and Treyni. In the meantime, Shuna, Hakuro, and Soei find both their vision and their magic detection abilities hindered by a thick fog…

episodes.name: Demon Lords' Banquet ~Walpurgis~
episodes.overview: Clayman tries to convince the other Demon Lords that Rimuru should be purged, but Guy tells him that if he is truly a Demon Lord, he should defeat Rimuru himself. What should be a one-on-one battle between Rimuru and Clayman is joined by Milim, who has been b…

episodes.name: Returning from the Brink
episodes.overview: Clayman and his pawns stand no chance against Rimuru and his allies. At a loss, Clayman orders Milim to use Stampede to kill everyone present, but Milim reveals he was never controlling her from the start. It was all an act to expose Clayman's plans and ident…

episodes.name: Octagram
episodes.overview: Rimuru backs Clayman into a corner trying to get him to reveal who he's working for, but even on death's door, Clayman's lips are sealed. Left with no other choice, Rimuru finishes Clayman off. With Clayman dead and Carrion and Frey announcing that they're st…

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: After Clayman’s defeat, Rimuru returns home and learns that Diablo healed the nobles of Falmuth, securing their alliance with Tempest. Meanwhile, Hinata becomes suspicious of Rimuru’s growing power and confronts him—unaware that a powerful organization is pul…

episodes.name: Demons and Strategies
episodes.overview: Rimuru has returned to Jura after having attended Walpurgis. Diablo informs Rimuru of his mission to deal with the Kingdom of Falmuth. Having presented the kingdom with three options at a resolution, the clock on the week for their answer ticks down.

episodes.name: The Saint's Intentions
episodes.overview: Yuuki is saddened by the death of Clayman, and Luminus is saddened by the death of Roy. Steeped in sadness, and having lost their friends, they seek their next move against Rimuru, who has grown in power and become a true Demon Lord.

episodes.name: Peaceful Days
episodes.overview: Expecting visitors from all races to come calling after learning that Rimuru now controls the entire Great Forest of Jura, Rimuru decides to hold a festival to introduce himself and Tempest to the world, with the goal of attracting new citizens.

episodes.name: Everyone Has a Part to Play
episodes.overview: Responding to Rimuru's concerns about monsters in the forest harming humans, Vesta and Kaijin reveal a new invention they hope will keep the road to Tempest safe. Also, Rimuru assigns a new task to Geld.

episodes.name: Meeting of Both Sides
episodes.overview: A war council led by Hinata is held in the Holy Empire of Lubelius. Moments after Hinata declares her intent to meet Rimuru and talk to him, she receives a hostile message from Rimuru.

episodes.name: Those Approaching
episodes.overview: The spread of false information causes the Temple Knights to assemble, endangering Diablo's plan to conquer Falmuth. Meanwhile, Rimuru learns that Hinata is on her way to Tempest.

episodes.name: Saint and Demon Clash
episodes.overview: As Hinata makes her way to Tempest, the ramen and well-built roads she sees along the way prove to her that Rimuru genuinely wants monsters and humans to coexist. But against her wishes, one of her men is also on his way to Tempest...

episodes.name: Misunderstanding
episodes.overview: The Crusaders have reached Tempest, and the battle is on. Hinata lays everything she learned from her mentor, Shizu, on the line in a life-or-death showdown against Rimuru.

episodes.name: The Scheming of the Seven Days
episodes.overview: Diablo descends before the enemy, King Edward of Falmuth. Also present are Saare and Glenda, two of the three Battlesages who are regarded as the most brilliant among the Master Rooks.

episodes.name: God and Demon Lord
episodes.overview: Just after the end of Hinata and Rimuru's duel, Hinata's sword moves on its own and targets Rimuru. Hinata jumps in its way to protect him and is gravely injured. Then the masterminds behind the whole conflict show up...

episodes.name: Reconciliation and Agreement
episodes.overview: The Seven Days Clergy have been purged, and the battle is over. Rimuru and Hinata hold a meeting to discuss future relations between their two nations, and the masterminds behind the whole conflict, the Eastern merchants, are revealed.

episodes.name: Festival Preparations
episodes.overview: Everyone in Tempest is busy preparing for the festival to celebrate the country's opening. Rimuru visits Mjöllmile to share ideas on forms of entertainment that will keep people coming back for more.

episodes.name: Invitation for All Nations
episodes.overview: Demon Lord Ramiris tries to argue her way into moving to Tempest, where there's great food, hot springs, and ample entertainment. Rimuru happens to walk into the argument and comes up with a way to make use of Ramiris's skills.

episodes.name: Labyrinth and Storm Dragon
episodes.overview: Rimuru is building a dungeon in preparation for the upcoming festival. It will feature treasure chests containing weapons made by Kurobe, and Veldora will inhabit the deepest floor as the final boss. Then Milim suddenly shows up with a suggestion...

episodes.name: Audience
episodes.overview: Numerous representatives from across the Great Forest of Jura have assembled in Tempest to congratulate Rimuru on his appointment to Demon Lord. Shuna requests holding a three-day audience to meet with them.

episodes.name: Benimaru's Ordeal
episodes.overview: On the last day of the audience, Rimuru meets Momiji, the representative of the Tengu clan. Their meeting comes after Rimuru had sent Benimaru to the Tengu village to request their permission to build a tunnel through the Kusha Mountains.

episodes.name: The Lightspeed Hero
episodes.overview: After learning about an elf slave trade, Rimuru had Soei investigate, but it turns out the slave traders have already been shut down by Masayuki, the Lightspeed Hero. Word is now spreading that the Hero is headed to Tempest to slay a Demon Lord...

episodes.name: A Throng of Visitors
episodes.overview: After meeting with the kings of various nations, Rimuru heads to Engrassia to invite his former students to the festival. The kids are thrilled to go back with him to Tempest, but then the hero Masayuki arrives as well...

episodes.name: Festival Eve
episodes.overview: The night before the Opening Festival, Rimuru throws a lavish banquet for all the nobles and royalty visiting Tempest. When the party is in full swing, Empress Elmesia of the Sorcerous Dynasty of Thalion arrives, throwing everyone into chaos.

episodes.name: Nation's Opening Festival
episodes.overview: It's day one of the festival, and Rimuru finally gets to see all of his friends' performances and presentations. As he's enjoying the festivities, he's summoned by Luminus...

episodes.name: The Martial Arts Tournament
episodes.overview: A martial arts tournament is being held! The winner will be given the right to challenge Rimuru. The hero, Masayuki, will be participating in the tournament. Rimuru wants to uncover the hero's true strength, so they get Geld and Gobta to participate.

episodes.name: Settling the Score with the Hero
episodes.overview: Gazel and Elmesia pledge to assist Rimuru with Tempest's lack of funding. Elmesia then proposes an alliance, but she's concerned about the danger Diablo poses.

episodes.name: The Labyrinth Is Opened
episodes.overview: Rimuru's dungeon is finally revealed, and his new ally Masayuki is among its first challengers. Later, after the festival is over, Rimuru's biggest job still awaits.

episodes.name: After the Festival
episodes.overview: Rimuru pays the merchants with the gold coins he's procured. The merchants try to garner futher favor, but Rimuru ceases trading with them. Rimuru then gathers his allies and calls for action again the eastern merchants who are operating in secret.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Demon Lord Rimuru's dream of creating an alliance between humans and monsters takes a step closer to being realized. As Tempest continues to prosper, Granville Rozzo and his granddaughter, Maribel Rozzo, clash with Demon Lord Rimuru over their plan to protect…

episodes.name: New Days
episodes.overview: Tempest is thriving after the success of its festival, but unexpected trouble has arisen with the new dungeon.

episodes.name: The Dungeon Evolves
episodes.overview: Rimuru and his trusted companions discuss ideas for improving the dungeon.

episodes.name: The Avatar Team Is Formed
episodes.overview: Rimuru, Ramiris, Veldora, and Milim work on perfecting their avatars before facing Team Green Fury.

episodes.name: Invitation
episodes.overview: The Council of the West deliberates on whether to grant membership to Tempest.

episodes.name: The First Step
episodes.overview: Rimuru attends the meeting that will determine Tempest's membership in the Council of the West.

episodes.name: The Council of the West
episodes.overview: A list of unreasonable demands from the Council makes Rimuru realize that a deeper plot is in motion.

episodes.name: The Mastermind's Identity
episodes.overview: An interrogation of Prince Elric's would-be shooter reveals who's pulling the strings behind the Council.

episodes.name: The Groundwork of Greed
episodes.overview: Glenda reveals all she knows about the Council and the Rozzos, and Rimuru prepares to inspect ancient ruins.

episodes.name: Investigating the Ruins
episodes.overview: The investigation of the ancient ruins of Amrita begins.

episodes.name: The Master of Greed
episodes.overview: Rimuru and Mirabel come face-to-face at last in the ancient ruins.

episodes.name: Milim's Friend
episodes.overview: Rimuru helps Milim confront the Chaos Dragon, a corrupted form of the baby dragon that was once her friend.

episodes.name: Tempest Evolves
episodes.overview: Rimuru shares his plans for Tempest's future, including a new system of government and Council representation.

episodes.name: New Companions
episodes.overview: Ramiris and Veldora are feeling overworked, so they ask Rimuru to find assistants for them.

episodes.name: The Black Numbers
episodes.overview: Diablo returns with new demon subordinates to add to Tempest's ranks.

episodes.name: An Unsettling Feeling
episodes.overview: As Tempest continues to grow and evolve, the Moderate Harlequin Alliance approaches Demon Lord Leon.

episodes.name: Gran, the Hero of Dawn
episodes.overview: Luminus meets with Rimuru to discuss Gran and future plans.

episodes.name: Lubelius, the Point of Convergence
episodes.overview: While Leon seeks Elmesia's help in finding Chloe, Granville's forces invade Lubelius.

episodes.name: Turbulence in the West
episodes.overview: An army of demons advances from the north, leaving the Western Nations in turmoil.

episodes.name: Death and Loss
episodes.overview: Granville's true plan is revealed, but it may already be too late to stop it.

episodes.name: Chronoa the Hero (1)
episodes.overview: When Chloe's Time Traveler skill kicks in, Hinata's soul is sent to the past along with her.

episodes.name: Chronoa the Hero (2)
episodes.overview: Chloe and Hinata meet Luminus and begin their journey as Chronoa.

episodes.name: Where the Soul Resides
episodes.overview: Chronoa is freed from her seal—not as a Hero, but as an avatar of destruction.

episodes.name: Granville's Hope
episodes.overview: Shion and Ranga continue to battle Razul while Rimuru struggles to save Chloe and Hinata.

episodes.name: The Hero Awakens
episodes.overview: Rimuru has Raphael interfere in Chronoa's Unlimited Imprisonment skill to save Hinata and Chloe.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The Four Cardinal Heroes are a group of ordinary men from modern-day Japan summoned to the kingdom of Melromarc to become its saviors. Melromarc is a country plagued by the Waves of Catastrophe that have repeatedly ravaged the land and brought disaster to its…

episodes.name: The Shield Hero
episodes.overview: College student Iwatani Naofumi is reading a book titled "The Records of the Four Cardinal Weapons" in the library when he is suddenly summoned to another world and told he has to save the world as the Shield Hero, one of the Four Cardinal Heroes. And one mor…

episodes.name: The Slave Girl
episodes.overview: Naofumi follows the slave merchant to his store, where he looks for a partner to act as his sword. But all he has the money to buy is a diseased demi-human girl named Raphtalia, whom he then forces into an incredibly harsh battle.

episodes.name: Wave of Catastrophe
episodes.overview: Naofumi has obtained a whole load of abilities and skills, and his teamwork with Raphtalia is reaching perfection, too. To prepare for the incoming Wave, he upgrades their equipment and heads to the dragon hourglass to find out exactly when it will arrive. Bu…

episodes.name: Lullaby at Dawn
episodes.overview: The Wave is gone, but Naofumi's relief is short-lived as Motoyasu challenges him to a duel in the middle of the celebratory banquet held in Melromarc Castle. Motoyasu insists that owning a slave is unbecoming for a hero and that Naofumi free Raphtalia at once.

episodes.name: Filo
episodes.overview: After Aultcray reluctantly offers Naofumi a paltry reward, he heads to the slave merchant to redo the slave crest as per Raphtalia's wishes. He also buys a monster egg there, which hatches a few days later and gives him a new party member. Meanwhile, Myne sho…

episodes.name: A New Comrade
episodes.overview: The mysterious girl that showed up out of nowhere was actually Filo. She's a filolial queen with an advanced transformation ability, and she can even take human form thanks to it. However, her clothes get ripped every time she transforms, meaning Naofumi has…

episodes.name: The Savior of the Heavenly Fowl
episodes.overview: After hearing of a village that's in immediate need of herbicide, Naofumi and his party head there to do business. The village has been overrun by plants that have turned into monsters, and its residents were forced to abandon it. These plants can even take r…

episodes.name: Curse Shield
episodes.overview: After hearing of a village in the East that's being ravaged by an epidemic, Naofumi and his party head there to deliver medicine. The epidemic was caused by the corpse of a dragon that had been killed a month before and left there to rot. Naofumi's party acce…

episodes.name: Melty
episodes.overview: In the Eastern village, Naofumi meets a girl named Melty. She instantly becomes friends with Filo and then requests to accompany the party on their journey. It seems she got separated from her guards. They travel together for a while, but when they reach the…

episodes.name: In the Midst of Turmoil
episodes.overview: After refusing to hear Melty out, Naofumi switches to planning for the next Wave. When a bunch of young soldiers ask to join his party, he agrees, but on a certain condition. At the same time, he also tries to upgrade Raphtalia's class after she hits the leve…

episodes.name: Catastrophe Returns
episodes.overview: Naofumi faces another Wave, this time in a remote village. With the help of the soldiers who volunteered to join him, he's able to secure the safety of the villagers, but the Wave shows no signs of letting up. He heads to fight with the other heroes, only to…

episodes.name: The Raven Invader
episodes.overview: A mysterious woman showed up out of nowhere and destroyed the second Soul Eater in a single blow. She then proclaimed the start of the "true battle of the wave" and blew away the other three heroes when they attacked her. With Naofumi's party proving ineffect…

episodes.name: The Devil of the Shield
episodes.overview: Naofumi foils the attempt to take Melty's life and fights off the royal knights, but he's then framed for abducting Melty and killing several knights, so the party is forced to go on the run. With security tightened and checkpoints everywhere, the party recei…

episodes.name: Everlasting Memory
episodes.overview: Due to Myne recklessly starting a forest fire, Naofumi and his party are forced to flee to a village at the base of the mountain. However, it won't be easy to break through the knights' net. Melty suggests going to a noble she knows for help, and it just so h…

episodes.name: Raphtalia
episodes.overview: Raphtalia corners Idol with vengeance in her eyes, her bloodthirsty blade reaching for his throat. Naofumi's words bring her back to her senses momentarily, but when Idol attacks her once again...

episodes.name: Filolial Queen
episodes.overview: As Naofumi and his party try to get the weakened kids to safety, Tyrant attacks them. Once Naofumi realizes that he's actually after Filo, he hatches a plan to lure him outside the city, but they can't even put a scratch on its massive body.

episodes.name: A Promise Made
episodes.overview: Fitoria tells Naofumi that she'll kill all Four Cardinal Heroes if they don't get back on the same page. She even takes Melty hostage, but Naofumi continues to refuse. Understanding where he's coming from, Fitoria instead proposes a one-on-one duel with Filo.

episodes.name: A Conspiracy Linked
episodes.overview: Naofumi decides to go straight up to the checkpost in order to talk it out with the other heroes. But there, he finds the one guy least likely to listen to him, Motoyasu, who attacks Naofumi without bothering to listen to what he has to say. Why could Motoyas…

episodes.name: The Four Cardinal Heroes
episodes.overview: The Pope holds in his hands the ultimate weapon, which possesses the properties of all four cardinal weapons. Faced with its attack skill, "Judgment," and its powerful defensive force field, Naofumi and gang are rendered helpless. As the crisis worsens, Motoy…

episodes.name: Battle of Good and Evil
episodes.overview: Naofumi and gang stay on the attack despite being trapped in the Pope's Great Cathedral, but its sacred subspace nullifies his Curse Shield, leaving them one step short. Naofumi turns to another, newly unlocked Curse Shield, but the dragon's wrath threatens t…

episodes.name: Naofumi's Triumphant Return
episodes.overview: After Naofumi survives thanks to Mirelia's help, she comes to visit him and tells him the truth behind the summoning of the heroes and the discrimination against the Shield Hero. She also promises to clear his name, and holds a trial for Aultcray and Myne's c…

episodes.name: Four Heroes Council
episodes.overview: After being unable to for so long, Naofumi finally gets to upgrade his party's classes. He then takes part in a meeting of the Four Cardinal Heroes, held under the guise of a celebratory banquet. There, he learns of the existence of a bonus stage, with increa…

episodes.name: Cal Mira Archipelago
episodes.overview: On the ship to Cal Mira, Naofumi once again runs into L'arc, who keeps throwing him off. However, the strange man's friendly nature shines through, and Naofumi quickly takes a liking to him. After having a fun time grinding levels and a lively meal, Naofumi f…

episodes.name: Guardians of Another World
episodes.overview: Melromarc brings a large fleet to fight the Wave out at sea. While the queen takes charge and leads the operation well, the other three heroes prove useless yet again, leaving Naofumi to do it all alone. Later, he gets help from L'arc and Therese to fend off…

episodes.name: The Rising of the Shield Hero
episodes.overview: It turns out that Glass, like L'arc, is also a hero from other world. Naofumi barely fights off their combo attacks and then corners Glass in a one-on-one battle, but is then faced with an all-important question: does he truly wish to protect this world?

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: With another Wave happening in a week, Naofumi Iwatani and his party have no time to waste. However, when bat familiars raid Lurolona Village and the Wave countdown comes to a halt, the Four Cardinal Heroes reconvene with the queen, Mirelia Q Melromarc, for a…

episodes.name: A New Roar
episodes.overview: Mysterious monsters appear as Naofumi is preparing for the next Wave. At the same time they show up, the Wave countdown stops. The Queen summons the Four Cardinal Heroes, and tells them that the Spirit Tortoise has revived.

episodes.name: Footprints of the Spirit Tortoise
episodes.overview: The leaders of all the nations’ militaries gather in the Spirit Tortoise Kingdom. Naofumi is there as well, and promises to offer his help as one of the heroes. But just before they decide on a plan, a mysterious woman appears…

episodes.name: Shaking Land
episodes.overview: The Spirit Tortoise begins its march once more, appearing at the border of the kingdom bearing its name. Naofumi volunteers to lure away its familiars while the army tries to bring it to the mountains. The Spirit Tortoise’s familiar, Ost, fights alongside the…

episodes.name: Ruins in the Fog
episodes.overview: The Spirit Tortoise’s head was cut off, but Ost, its familiar, is still alive. It could revive at any moment. The allied armies need to get back into fighting shape, and fast. Naofumi makes the risky move of heading onto the Tortoise’s back with only a small…

episodes.name: Ost Hourai
episodes.overview: Naofumi is met by L’Arc, Glass, and Therese. They’re after the person who broke the Spirit Tortoise’s seal and is controlling it. L’Arc proposes teaming up again…

episodes.name: Racing to Catch Up
episodes.overview: Fitoria appears when the Spirit Tortoise revives, and with her help, Naofumi attempts to destroy its heart and cut off its head at the same time. L’Arc arrives as well, but all of them are helpless before Kyo’s overwhelming power.

episodes.name: Infinite Labyrinth
episodes.overview: Naofumi wakes up in a strange prison to find him and his party at level 1, and Filo missing. They start to raise their levels in order to escape, but things quickly turn against them when a dangerous monster suddenly appears…

episodes.name: A Parting in the Snow
episodes.overview: Naofumi’s party heads for the Dragon Hourglass of Mikakage, in order to get to Sikul, the country that summoned Kizuna. Along the way, he sells rare healing items to make a hefty profit. He hears a rumor about a genius mage…

episodes.name: Humming Fairy
episodes.overview: Naofumis party is teleported to Sikul, where Kizuna introduces the Vassal Weapon Hero, Ethnobalt. He soys he can use a piece of Raphtalia's hair and Naofumis blood as a catalyst that can create a shikigami to find her. He creates the shikigami, and they find.

episodes.name: Katana Hero
episodes.overview: Raphtalia is imprisoned in a Raybul Kingdom prison. She’s wary of L’Arc’s team, who is also imprisoned there, but asks them for help in escaping. Glass is weakened by the draining power of the prison. Raphtalia has a plan to escape, but…

episodes.name: Kizuna
episodes.overview: Naofumi's party is overjoyed to be reunited with Raphtalia. Kizuna criticizes Glass for invading another world. Glass and L'Arc swear they won't fight Naofumi anymore, and instead find another way to solve their problem. Meanwhile, Kyo's plot proceeds.

episodes.name: Reason to Fight
episodes.overview: The Wave appears before its scheduled time. Kizuna's group is teleported to it while Naofumi and his party head for Kyo's lab on Ethnobalt's ship. There, they see the true depths of Kyo's wickedness...

episodes.name: Flowers Offered in Recollection
episodes.overview: Raphtalia recalls having to buy clothing for her smaller self. Kizuna remembers being alone for so long. Rishia remembers Ost trying to give advice.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: After defeating the Spirit Tortoise, Naofumi has no time for rest. An attack from the next Guardian Beast is imminent, but the three other Cardinal Heroes have gone missing. So, Naofumi and his party set out to search for the legendary trio.

episodes.name: The Dark Coliseum
episodes.overview: Seeking to reunite the scattered inhabitants of Lurolona Village who were sold into slavery, the Shield Hero and his party head to Zeltoble to secretly compete in the underground fights at the coliseum.

episodes.name: Nadia
episodes.overview: Naofumi's party enters the underground arena while concealing their identity. As they win and rise through the ranks, they're forced to confront the greed and lawlessness that lurks both without and within the arena. And when the final battle arrives, Raphtal…

episodes.name: The White Tiger Siblings
episodes.overview: Naofumi visits the slave market, where the demi-human slave Fohl asks him to save his sick sister. Naofumi asks him if he's prepared to pay the price, but… Meanwhile, Lurolona Village is beginning to come back to life as the rescued demi-humans return, but a…

episodes.name: The Operation to Capture the Spear Hero
episodes.overview: The Spear Hero, Motoyasu, has been sighted, and Mirelia asks Naofumi to persuade him to return. Naofumi is about to leave his lands to Eclair and go look for Motoyasu when an unexpected visitor arrives. And they also meet someone unexpected in the town where…

episodes.name: Each of Their Paths
episodes.overview: Naofumi's party is attacked by a pair of mysterious and powerful men. S'yne arrives during the battle and finally attempts to explain why she wants to become one of Naofumi's followers. Meanwhile, more villagers are training in Hengen Muso.

episodes.name: Where You Point Your Strength
episodes.overview: Ren is haunted by the deaths of his party members in a failed attempt to defeat the Spirit Tortoise, and doesn't want to believe that he might be responsible for what happened. Myne seems ready to take his side and support him, but...

episodes.name: The Girl and the Dragon
episodes.overview: Keel and other demi-human children in the village are starting to learn how to assume therianthrope form like Sadeena. Ren is now staying in the village while suffering the effects of the Curse swords, and doing his best to fit in.

episodes.name: Dragon's Den
episodes.overview: Naofumi assembles a party to pursue Gaelion, who has consumed the Emperor Dragon's Core. Gaelion's transformation is profoundly sickening Filo, so Naofumi must return Gaelion to normal within the next two days.

episodes.name: Emperor Dragon
episodes.overview: Naofumi's party regroups and plans another assault on the Emperor Dragon. While their plan of attack comes together, Wyndia explains her connection to the dragon. This causes Wyndia to remember something very significant...

episodes.name: Perfect Hidden Justice
episodes.overview: Filo has recovered but needs to gain experience to replace her lost levels. S'yne returns from the underground arena bearing a tale of a suspiciously familiar new fighter who uses a bow and goes by the alias Perfect Hidden Justice.

episodes.name: Justice VS Justice
episodes.overview: Rishia faces Itsuki in the underground arena. As Itsuki rants and raves, it's clear that he's also come under the mental influence of Myne and unlocked a Curse series. Naofumi evacuates the children as Rishia enters her most dangerous fight yet.

episodes.name: The Ones We Must Protect
episodes.overview: Naofumi begins training in the Way of the Dragon Vein with Sadeena and Gaelion. Back at the village, the blacksmith visits, bringing new equipment for Raphtalia. When she tries it on, it reveals a shocking secret about her past...

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: As Naofumi prepares for the Phoenix’s return, assassins from Q’ten Lo target Raphtalia, mistaking her for a throne usurper. To resolve the conflict, Naofumi journeys to Siltvelt, where he is hailed as a demi-human savior, but not all welcome him. In political…

episodes.name: Siltvelt
episodes.overview: Naofumi stops at Siltvelt on his journey to Q'ten Lo. The people there worship him as a king.

episodes.name: Official Welcome
episodes.overview: Naofumi and Raph-chan stay in the castle while the rest of the party tours the town.

episodes.name: A True People
episodes.overview: The Schiltwelt Castle is shaken by a poisoned breakfast room disturbance. Atra, who is incensed by the ugly war of words between the various factions, tries to blackmail the heavy hitters and speak highly of Shobun's greatness. Shobun then discovers the real…

episodes.name: Entrusted Power
episodes.overview: Fohl battles the cunning and sneaky Jaralis while Atla challenges the veteran warrior Lyceras.

episodes.name: White Tiger
episodes.overview: When Fohl is about to be defeated, Naofumi asks him if he has the resolve to become stronger.

episodes.name: Leaving Port
episodes.overview: Naofumi returns, temporarily, to Lurolona Village, and decides who he’s going to take with him.

episodes.name: Arriving in Q'ten Lo
episodes.overview: In Q’ten Lo, the party finds that it’s forbidden to kill an animal, and that the people are heavily taxed.

episodes.name: Orochi
episodes.overview: The Emperor’s blessing causes the “Sealed Orochi” to revive.

episodes.name: Zodia
episodes.overview: A lost girl named "Zodia" appears as Muramasa suggests a drinking party.

episodes.name: Prayers
episodes.overview: Raphtalia goes to meet the shrine maiden of the water dragon, Shildina.

episodes.name: Oracle Miko
episodes.overview: Shildina appears at the old capital and asks for a duel between representatives of both sides.

episodes.name: Return of the Emperor
episodes.overview: The emperor challenges Raphtalia to a one-on-one duel!

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: It all started with an encounter between a young, ordinary man and a woman whose life has been designed by her influential parents. May it be fate or sheer coincidence, it was a picturesque sunset-lit evening in Cuba that brought them together. And as if they…

episodes.name: Enchanted
episodes.overview: While in Havana on a business trip, Cha Su-hyeon meets Kim Jin-hyeok, a tourist she spends an impromptu romantic evening with around the city.

episodes.name: We Sincerely Welcome You
episodes.overview: Upon learning Jin-hyeok is a new employee at her hotel, Su-hyeon looks through his file. Later, she proposes they grab a meal together.

episodes.name: Yearning
episodes.overview: After photos of herself and Jin-hyeok together make the news, Su-hyeon asks Jung U-seok to speak to his meddling mother.

episodes.name: That's Why I'm Trying to Stop
episodes.overview: Jang Mi-jin shows up in Jin-hyeok's neighborhood with a message. A false online post threatens to turn Su-hyeon's employees against her.

episodes.name: I’m Good at Holding Back
episodes.overview: To protect Su-hyeon, Jin-hyeok makes a bold move in front of their coworkers. The pair plays hooky from work to enjoy an afternoon together.

episodes.name: It’s Already Spring for Us
episodes.overview: Su-hyeon and Jin-hyeok put a name to their relationship. On the day of the opening of a new hotel, Kim Hwa-jin has nasty words for Jin-hyeok.

episodes.name: Sudden Personnel Appointment
episodes.overview: Su-hyeon's gutsy announcement to the world comes with consequences for both herself and Jin-hyeok. Cho Hye-in warns Jin-hyeok to be careful.

episodes.name: Party Must Go On
episodes.overview: Jin-hyeok and Su-hyeon bid each other a temporary farewell as he's transferred to another office. At the hotel, a masquerade ball rings in the new year.

episodes.name: Don’t Be Afraid
episodes.overview: With his identity revealed as Su-hyeon's boyfriend, Jin-hyeok faces new challenges. U-seok makes a heartfelt proposal.

episodes.name: It Proves That I Was the First to like You
episodes.overview: A plot to hurt Su-hyeon's standing places her efforts to buy a property at risk. To fix the situation, Jin-hyeok books a plane ticket back to Cuba.

episodes.name: My Heart Is Full of You
episodes.overview: Jin-hyeok returns to the Seoul office, Su-hyeon searches for answers and U-seok sends an incriminating video to his mother's lackey.

episodes.name: I Cherish You Very Much
episodes.overview: Intent on getting his way, U-seok has himself named the co-CEO of the hotel. Su-hyeon must make a difficult choice between heart and duty.

episodes.name: I Can No Longer Live Without You
episodes.overview: A surprise confession halts the company board's vote. Meanwhile, not everyone in Jin-hyeok's family feels comfortable with him dating Su-hyeon.

episodes.name: It’s Your First Love Too
episodes.overview: Su-hyeon grapples with the future of her relationship with Jin-hyeok. Elsewhere, her father makes an unanticipated move in his political career.

episodes.name: I’m Sorry
episodes.overview: Su-hyeon believes she's doing the right thing by ending it with Jin-hyeok. Heartbroken, he struggles to understand her decision.

episodes.name: I’ll Wait in My Place
episodes.overview: Su-hyeon's father does the only thing he can to truly free his daughter from Taegyeong Group's grasp. Jin-hyeok prepares a meaningful gift for Su-hyeon.

episodes.name: True Colors
episodes.overview: Small town girl Tuesday takes the midnight train to Alba City, leaving home for her dreams. There, she sees city girl Carole singing on a bridge.

episodes.name: Born to Run
episodes.overview: Top producer Tao begins working with Angela, who's yearned for a music career. Carole and Tuesday sneak into a concert hall to practice their song.

episodes.name: Fire and Rain
episodes.overview: With some trepidation, Carole and Tuesday agree to take Gus on as their manager. He hatches a plan to get them featured by the famous DJ Ertegun.

episodes.name: Video Killed the Radio Star
episodes.overview: Gus's next plan to get Carole and Tuesday their big break is to make a music video. He buys a weird film directing bot and asks his ex-wife for help.

episodes.name: Every Breath You Take
episodes.overview: Tuesday's brother Spencer heads to Alba City to search for her. Gus implements Plan C: gigging for exposure! Starting with a one-song gig at a bar.

episodes.name: Life is a Carnival
episodes.overview: Gus somehow gets Carole and Tuesday a gig on the main stage at a huge festival. The catch: they're a standby act for the famous, difficult Joshua.

episodes.name: Show Me the Way
episodes.overview: If new media fails, go old school! Gus gets Carole and Tuesday to try out for the amateur singing show, Mars Brightest. Tao wants Angela on it too.

episodes.name: All the Young Dudes
episodes.overview: The duo make the cut for Mars Brightest, along with Angela and a Tuesday mega-fan named Cybelle. Now they just have to perform their very best!

episodes.name: Dancing Queen
episodes.overview: Carole and Tuesday attend the Mars Brightest broadcast on their day off. Before she faces Angela, Cybelle makes a startling request of Tuesday.

episodes.name: River Deep, Mountain High
episodes.overview: The Mars Brightest semifinals begin with Ertegun as guest judge. Tao tells Angela to change her song, and Cybelle's visit raises Carole's suspicions.

episodes.name: With or Without You
episodes.overview: With Tuesday injured, she and Carole frantically try to think of a piano-only song they can perform. The attack incites recriminations backstage.

episodes.name: We've Only Just Begun
episodes.overview: It seems like all is lost, but Gus encourages Carole not to give up. With time running out before the final, they launch a rescue operation.

episodes.name: Walk This Way
episodes.overview: Carole and Tuesday are an instant sensation. But fame has its drawbacks, and they face tough choices about the next stage in their career.

episodes.name: The Kids are Alright
episodes.overview: Going indie means finding people themselves. Gus persuades the legendary and very strange Tobe to work with the duo. Angela enters the studio.

episodes.name: God Only Knows
episodes.overview: After their debut single's release, the duo get an invitation from a reclusive living legend. Tuesday's mother takes the stage for a campaign debate.

episodes.name: A Natural Woman
episodes.overview: The single charts, and Gus decides they'll play South by Southwest. On the way home from rehearsal one night they meet Carole's childhood idol, Flora.

episodes.name: Head Over Heels
episodes.overview: One morning, Ertegun wakes up bankrupt: his AI manager stole all his money and vanished. Carole and Tuesday enter the studio, but Tobe's not happy.

episodes.name: Only Love Can Break Your Heart
episodes.overview: While Ertegun and Tao squabble over her single, Angela tries to deal with a stalker. Tuesday meets with Kyle as her mother's campaign heats up.

episodes.name: People Get Ready
episodes.overview: Tao offers to track down Angela's stalker once Dahlia tells him all about it. Things come to a head as Angela takes the stage at the Cydonia Festival.

episodes.name: Immigrant Song
episodes.overview: Carole and Tuesday start rehearsing for their performance as Mars Grammy nominees. Tao runs afoul of the law just as Angela's replica is completed.

episodes.name: It's Too Late
episodes.overview: With Tao arrested and her mother hospitalized, Angela is all alone. Carole and Tuesday struggle to come up with a song to close their album.

episodes.name: Just Like Heaven
episodes.overview: A suggestion from Crystal inspires the duo to write a new song for their Grammys performance. Dahlia's condition puts Angela's attendance in doubt.

episodes.name: Don't Stop Believin'
episodes.overview: After Skip gets arrested, the duo and their industry colleagues decide to create a supergroup song opposing Valerie's policies. Tao is still at large.

episodes.name: A Change is Gonna Come
episodes.overview: Tao appears to tell Angela the truth. With Carole & Tuesday's first album finished, the supergroup performance is scheduled for New Year's Eve.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Two teen cricket prodigies struggle against their overbearing father and a system stacked against them to realize their own ambitions and identities.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Intent on landing his sons professional cricket contracts on Selection Day, Mohan brings them from their village to Mumbai months before the trials.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Mohan's sons learn Mumbai cricket clubs value member fees over talent. Watching the boys play, an infamous former coach is moved to fulfill an old vow.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The boys start at Weinberg Academy, but Mohan mistrusts Tommy and investigates him while working at a new job. Anand gets stuck in a financial bind.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Mohan makes a scene at the school after one of his sons is punished. Tension builds between Manju and Javed. Anand takes a big financial risk.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: At the team’s first tournament match, Radha aims to impress a talent scout while Manju is distracted by a cryptic poem. Anand has an awkward encounter.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Javed’s envy grows with Radha’s glory. When Mohan and the boys are evicted, Anand seizes a chance. Radha gives worried Manju their aunt's phone number.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Manju feels torn between loyalty to his family and Javed’s new gestures of friendship. Mohan receives an unexpected business proposal.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Radha prepares to play in the Harris Shield semifinals. With his double life weighing on him, Manju must make a tough choice on the day of the match.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Mohan’s business takes off, while a resentful Manju has heated confrontations with Javed and Radha. Anand receives a threat.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: The Harris Shield final begins with a curveball that leaves everyone gobsmacked -- and the surprises keep coming. Meanwhile, Mohan makes a confession.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Manju and Radha receive some important news. Distressed about his mother’s whereabouts, Radha crosses a line. A major accusation leads to a showdown.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: With mere hours to go before Selection Day, Manju pays Javed a visit that could risk everything. Anand has some tough questions to answer.

seasons.name: Part I
seasons.overview: After a rash of mysterious deaths, Crown prosecutor Sarah Sinclair and SSC agent James Blood discover a conspiracy surrounding uncanny new bio-masks.

seasons.name: Part II
seasons.overview: A former LIVE scientist's daughter may hold the key to exposing its crimes, if James can keep her alive and the SSC can fend off their new director.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: The SSC's new director has his own ideas about how to operate the organisation. Eddy's research turns up a lead: former scientist William Herst

episodes.name: Episode 17
episodes.overview: Connor and Creighton break into Herst's house to get ot Tina. William fails to hold them off, but James and Wyatt show up to confront the intruders

episodes.name: Episode 18
episodes.overview: Harry leads a team into assaulting the supposedly secure SSC safe house where James and Tina are holed up. Somehow, SSC must have been compromised.

episodes.name: Episode 19
episodes.overview: While on the run from the SSC, James and Tina are deliberately hit by a truck. Looking for answers, James makes contact with Anna Winehouse.

episodes.name: Episode 20
episodes.overview: With Eddy's help, James tries to infiltrate the site where Tina is being held. Connor tells Tina about her family's involvement with the masks.

episodes.name: Episode 21
episodes.overview: James hands Connor over to Wyatt. In custody, Connor maintains his silence until Anna asks to question him herself.

episodes.name: Episode 22
episodes.overview: Anna tells Tina about the research that proceeded her birth. William Herst regains consciousness. Coates meets with a mysterious individual.

episodes.name: Episode 23
episodes.overview: Waiting for her father, Tina looks at Anna's old pictures of her parents. Wyatt and Eddy work together to find Gary Evans and stumble into an ambush.

episodes.name: Episode 24
episodes.overview: Coates puts out a warrant on Evans. James, Anna, Tina and Herst try to escape the hospital via helicopter, but Connor is already inside.

episodes.name: Cherry Blossom
episodes.overview: Kaoru is dejected when her friends' busy lives prevent them from attending their annual Hanami. Rilakkuma can’t make pancakes without burning them.

episodes.name: Kidnapped
episodes.overview: A sense of panic takes over Kaoru when she receives a ransom note demanding a stack of pancakes in exchange for the safe return of Rilakkuma.

episodes.name: Rainy Season
episodes.overview: Heavy rains bring an unlikely growth of mushrooms inside the home, and Kaoru's spirits are dampened when she's the subject of office gossip.

episodes.name: Fireworks
episodes.overview: While Rilakkuma is able to wholeheartedly enjoy the food and games at the summer festival, Kaoru grows frustrated by her own perpetual indecisiveness.

episodes.name: Ghost Girl
episodes.overview: During a sudden power outage, Kaoru and her friends are stopped dead in their tracks when a spirit from beyond the grave makes a surprise visit.

episodes.name: Fortune-Telling
episodes.overview: After a streak of bad luck in the last days of summer, Kaoru sees a psychic, who implies that her three roommates are the cause of her problems.

episodes.name: Slim Down
episodes.overview: To help her lose weight -- and to catch a glimpse of the cute deliveryman -- Kaoru keeps ordering more and more costly exercise equipment online.

episodes.name: Getting a Job
episodes.overview: Seeing Kaoru struggle with her finances, Rilakkuma, Korilakkuma and Kiiroitori take it upon themselves to find part-time jobs -- with mixed results.

episodes.name: Snowman
episodes.overview: With a blanket of December snow covering the entire neighborhood, Rilakkuma offers his knit cap to a poor snowman who looks so cold.

episodes.name: Hawaii
episodes.overview: The roommates bring the sounds of aloha into their home to brighten Kaoru's day when a colleague's engagement in Hawaii brings her down.

episodes.name: Sleepless Night
episodes.overview: Thinking a streak of light in the night sky was a UFO, Korilakkuma tries to call it back by building a pyramid-shaped beacon out of junk.

episodes.name: The First Day
episodes.overview: In this flashback episode, Kaoru reminisces about the time she wanted a pet cat, but met the delightful bears who would become her roommates instead.

episodes.name: Moving Out
episodes.overview: As their apartment's demolition date draws near, Kaoru searches for a new place, and they all do their best to toss out the things they don't need.

episodes.name: A Big Sister I Know, Kang Dan-i
episodes.overview: On her wedding day, Kang Dan-i hides out in Cha Eun-ho’s car. After her divorce, she secretly cleans Eun-ho’s place while trying to restart her career.

episodes.name: You Were Hiding In My House?
episodes.overview: Eun-ho is dismayed to see Dan-i among the job applicants, but she resolves to rediscover what she wants to do with her life and move on from the past.

episodes.name: People Calling Me By My Name
episodes.overview: Eun-ho demands to know what’s going on with Dan-i, who runs into Ji Seo-jun while looking for a room to rent and later receives a kind gesture.

episodes.name: Everybody Turn Their Backs On Me
episodes.overview: Eun-ho can’t recall what he did the previous night. Dan-i stumbles across Seo-jun’s dog and agrees to have ramen with the new neighborhood friend.

episodes.name: I'm Curious Too, About My Feelings
episodes.overview: Dani works hard to study marketing and make up for the lost time. Eunho is always by her side encouraging and supporting her so she finds the courage to try again. They then celebrate her first month of employment. Their new book project faces an obstacle so…

episodes.name: I Think I Already Knew It From The Beginning
episodes.overview: When Haeri suddenly stopped by the house, Dani waited outside and accidentally met Seojun. The meeting between Dani, Eunho, and Seojun had both men bickering and Eunho all riled up after. The company goes to volunteer in an orphanage and their trip ends with…

episodes.name: Tell Him I'm Waiting Here
episodes.overview: Seojun asks Dani for a dinner date after work which had Eunho very annoyed. Ji Yul's mum falls for her dating lie and tries to intimidate park hoon. Eunho is ecstatic with how the dinner ended. The company directors have a big fight yet they come together esp…

episodes.name: Moon is Beautiful, Snow is Beautiful
episodes.overview: Seojun is trying to court Dani and his efforts give Eunho a hard time. The company receives a manuscript for a big new project that Eunho and Dani were instructed to work on. A club Night ends up wilder and with more surprises than planned. Dani starts to hav…

episodes.name: That Old Book Is Like The First Time Reading
episodes.overview: Eun-ho's reply thrusts Dan-i into a daze, as it contradicts her memory of recent events, and she muses how a dog-eared book can suddenly seem new.

episodes.name: There Are Days Like This
episodes.overview: Dan-i's confusion becomes worry when Eun-ho doesn't answer her texts or come home. When he doesn't appear at the office, she's at a loss for what to do.

episodes.name: We Have To Be Together, Why Do You Want To Break Up?
episodes.overview: Dan-i tries to downplay the episode with Eun-ho, but he sees their situation differently. When the book concert hits a snag, her past comes in handy.

episodes.name: How About A Title For Your First Date?
episodes.overview: Dan-i revels in her latest feat at work and celebrates with Eun-ho, but he's given a tough order to execute after questions about her résumé emerge.

episodes.name: Did It Hurt Because Of Me?
episodes.overview: Eun-ho faces hurdles while making job inquiries for Dan-i and realizes how impossible it is for women trying to return to the workplace after a hiatus.

episodes.name: You Know Me, Right?
episodes.overview: An unexpected source reaches out to help Dan-i land a new job after she tenders her resignation. Dan-i learns that Eun-ho's been hiding something.

episodes.name: I Should Have Known If You Didn't Say Anything...
episodes.overview: Eun-ho wants Dan-i to say he did the right thing, and tries to figure out who's behind a mysterious manuscript. But he isn't the only one investigating.

episodes.name: As If I Had Met You In a Book and Received Warm Comfort...
episodes.overview: Eun-ho gets a call from Gapyeong and is urged to live his life so that he may be like a book in someone’s life. Dan-i focuses on a cherished tome.

seasons.name: Unwavering Resolve Arc
seasons.overview: It is the Taisho Period in Japan. Tanjiro, a kindhearted boy who sells charcoal for a living, finds his family slaughtered by a demon. To make matters worse, his younger sister Nezuko, the sole survivor, has been transformed into a demon herself. Though devas…

episodes.name: Cruelty
episodes.overview: It is the Taisho Period (i.e. 1912-1926). Tanjiro Kamado is living a modest but blissful life in the mountains with his family. One day, when he returns from selling charcoal in town, he finds the remains of his slaughtered family in pools of blood after a de…

episodes.name: Trainer Sakonji Urokodaki
episodes.overview: At Giyu Tomioka's urging, Tanjiro heads for Mt. Sagiri with his sister Nezuko who's been turned into a demon. During the night, Tanjiro catches the smell of blood from inside a temple. He enters, thinking that someone might be hurt, only to come upon a man-ea…

episodes.name: Sabito and Makomo
episodes.overview: The Demon Slayer Corps... An organization that's been hunting down demons since ancient times. Sakonji Urokodaki starts training Tanjiro for Final Selection, the test for joining the unit. Navigating a mountain riddled with booby traps, dry sword swings, wate…

episodes.name: Final Selection
episodes.overview: To pass Final Selection, one must survive for seven days on Mt. Fujikasane where demons captured by the Demon Slayers have been imprisoned. So begins the battle for survival between the young swordsmen and the demons. Armed with the breathing techniques and s…

episodes.name: My Own Steel
episodes.overview: When day breaks, there are only four swordsmen left standing after the seven-day battle. The guides who greet Tanjiro and the other survivors explain the Demon Slayer Corps system. All four are issued uniforms and Kasugai Crows as messengers, after which they…

episodes.name: Swordsman Accompanying a Demon
episodes.overview: Tanjiro is now clad in the uniform of the Demon Slayer Corps. His Nichirin Sword on his hip, and Nezuko, now awake, in a special box made by Urokodaki on his back, he heads out for his first assignment. A town to the northwest where girls have been vanishing…

episodes.name: Muzan Kibutsuji
episodes.overview: Now split into three, the demons have driven Tanjiro into a corner. It is then that Nezuko attacks. Now that she’s become a demon herself, she’s no longer so weak that she needs protection. His mind made up, Tanjiro follows one of the demons into the swamp no…

episodes.name: The Smell of Enchanting Blood
episodes.overview: The next mission is in Asakusa, Tokyo. Tanjiro is taken aback by the opulent Taisho Era cityscape, but soon picks up the demon’s scent there. His pursuit of the scent leads him to Muzan Kibutsuji. Tanjiro attempts to strike him down. But Kibutsuji transforms…

episodes.name: Temari Demon and Arrow Demon
episodes.overview: It was two demons named Tamayo and Yushiro who came to Tanjiro’s rescue. Using the “Eyeblind” spell, Tamayo guides Tanjiro and Nezuko to her house. There, through his conversation with Tamayo, Tanjiro learns that there is a way to return demons to human form.…

episodes.name: Together Forever
episodes.overview: Tanjiro’s crisis continues. He uses multiple forms of the Water Breathing technique to hold out against Yahaba’s final Blood Demon Art, the "Kouketsu Arrow." Meanwhile, Nezuko and Susamaru are still battling it out. Worried about the outcome, Tamayo unleashes…

episodes.name: Tsuzumi Mansion
episodes.overview: Tanjiro's next destination, according to his Kasugai Crow, is to the south-southeast. On the way, Tanjiro runs into his fellow Final Selection survivor, the swordsman Zenitsu Agatsuma. Tanjiro has a hard time dealing with Zenitsu's passive attitude as they he…

episodes.name: The Boar Bares Its Fangs, Zenitsu Sleeps
episodes.overview: Inside the house, where the rooms spin each time the tsuzumi is played, Tanjiro gets separated from Zenitsu Agatsuma. Without Tanjiro by his side, Zenitsu is overcome by fear and despair as he takes Shoichi through the house. Meanwhile, Tanjiro meets the mast…

episodes.name: Something More Important Than Life
episodes.overview: Every time Kyogai, the master of house, plays his tsuzumi, the room spins and Tanjiro struggles. Debilitated by the fractured bones he sustained in his previous battle, Tanjiro tries to fire himself up as he desperately fights on, but he is overwhelmed by Kyo…

episodes.name: The House With the Wisteria Family Crest
episodes.overview: After a desperate fight to the death, Tanjiro prevails over Kyogai. He exits the house to find Zenitsu who had escaped earlier. But it is then that he sees the strange circumstances before him... The battered Zenitsu holding the box containing Nezuko in his a…

episodes.name: Mount Natagumo
episodes.overview: Their next destination is to the north-northwest. Tanjiro and Nezuko head towards Mount Natagumo with Zenitsu and Inosuke. This mountain is covered with spider webs and is swarming with innumerable spiders. Leaving the cowering Zenitsu behind, Tanjiro and Ino…

episodes.name: Letting Someone Else Go First
episodes.overview: Tanjiro and Inosuke battle the Demon Slayers trapped by spider webs. After slashing the threads and destroying the webs, they head deeper into the mountain. The farther they advance through the forest, the thicker the threads become, and those under their con…

episodes.name: You Must Master a Single Thing
episodes.overview: One of the Twelve Kizuki, a direct subordinate of Muzan Kibutsuji, is here somewhere. When Tanjiro slays the Mother Spider Demon of Mt. Natagumo, he learns that a demon who might hold the key to turning Nezuko back into a human is somewhere in this very fores…

episodes.name: A Forged Bond
episodes.overview: Tanjiro and Inosuke face off against the Father Spider Demon of Mt. Natagumo. Tanjiro unleashes an attack, only to get hurled away by the demon's overwhelming power. Landing near a river, he comes upon the young demon Rui torturing the Sister Spider Demon. Wh…

episodes.name: Hinokami
episodes.overview: Swordsmen in the Demon Slayer Corps known as Hashiras have arrived on Mt. Natagumo. Giyu Tomioka, the Water Hashira, slays the Father Spider Demon with a single strike. Inosuke, thrilled to see such a display of swordsmanship by someone in a totally different…

episodes.name: Pretend Family
episodes.overview: When Rui assaults him with his Blood Demon Art, Tanjiro braces himself for certain death. As his life flashes before his eyes, he suddenly remembers his father's dance, the kagura, and unleashes a new, non-Water Breathing attack. Hinokami Kagura Dance. Knowin…

episodes.name: Against Corps Rules
episodes.overview: Seeing Tanjiro try to protect Nezuko even as he collapses triggers memories of Rui’s own past. Once a sickly boy, he became a demon after meeting Muzan Kibutsuji who gave him a share of his blood. But after he turns into a demon, his own parents try to kill h…

episodes.name: Master of the Mansion
episodes.overview: After the battle is over, Tanjiro and Nezuko are taken to the Demon Slayer Corps headquarters. This is where the Hashira Meeting between the Corps leader, Ubuyashiki, and the Hashiras, the most powerful swordsmen in the Corps, is to be held. The Hashiras cens…

episodes.name: Hashira Meeting
episodes.overview: Ubuyashiki, the leader of the Demon Slayer Corps, finally appears before Tanjiro. He tells him that he will allow Tanjiro and Nezuko to join the Corps. But the Hashiras are unable to accept this decision right away. The Wind Hashira, Sanemi Shinazugawa, slash…

episodes.name: Rehabilitation Training
episodes.overview: The injured Tanjiro, Zenitsu and Inosuke are sent to the home of the Insect Hashira, Shinobu Kocho, for treatment. Two weeks later, Tanjiro and Inosuke start rehabilitation training. But the drills are brutal, and they find themselves broken in spirit. Unawar…

episodes.name: Tsuguko, Kanao Tsuyuri
episodes.overview: Tanjiro, who's undergoing rehabilitation training at the Butterfly Mansion, works hard to keep up his Total Concentration Breathing techniques all day long. Though at first, he's helpless against Kanao, a swordswoman in his class who's training him, he slowly…

episodes.name: New Mission
episodes.overview: As Tanjiro and the others are devoted to their rehabilitation training, the absolute master of the demons, Muzan Kibutsuji, gathers the Lower Ranks of the Twelve Kizuki. The demons, too, are preparing to make their next move. As training draws to a close, Tan…

seasons.name: Mugen Train Arc
seasons.overview: Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku receives new orders: Travel to the Mugen Train, where over forty people have gone missing, and conduct an investigation. Leaving the Demon Slayer Corps Headquarters, he sets off on this new mission. Tanjiro's group, fresh from co…

episodes.name: Flame Hashira: Kyojuro Rengoku
episodes.overview: Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku receives new orders: Travel to the Mugen Train, where over forty people have gone missing, and conduct an investigation. Leaving the Demon Slayer Corps Headquarters, he sets off on this new mission.

episodes.name: Deep Sleep
episodes.overview: Tanjiro's group, fresh from completing their training at the Butterfly Mansion, head to their next mission, the Mugen Train. There they rendezvous with Rengoku, who arrived ahead of them. Tanjiro is overwhelmed by the always-energetic Rengoku, Zenitsu is frig…

episodes.name: Should Have Been
episodes.overview: Tanjiro, Nezuko, Zenitsu and Inosuke join Rengoku on the Mugen Train. Having heard that there may be demons on the train, they are on high alert, but they find themselves falling into a slumber. Within his dream, Tanjiro is reunited with his long lost family.…

episodes.name: Insult
episodes.overview: Tanjiro, Zenitsu, Inosuke and Rengoku have fallen into a deep sleep while under the control of Enmu's Blood Demon Art. As Enmu attempts to use his accomplices to destroy the spiritual cores of Tanjiro and his companions in order to defeat them, Tanjiro realiz…

episodes.name: Move Forward!
episodes.overview: After waking up from his dream by cutting his own neck, Tanjiro battles Enmu, who is the source of all the turmoil on the train. Enmu appears to be getting pleasure from inflicting pain on the passengers, which only infuriates Tanjiro even more. Tanjiro succe…

episodes.name: Akaza
episodes.overview: Nezuko, Zenitsu and Rengoku fight against Enmu to protect the passengers. Meanwhile, Tanjiro and Inosuke discover the location of Enmu's neck. They work in tandem to thwart Enmu's Blood Demon Art and sever Enmu's neck. The Mugen Train writhes in pain and dera…

episodes.name: Set Your Heart Ablaze
episodes.overview: The demon that appeared before Tanjiro and Rengoku after they defeated Enmu was the Upper Three, Akaza. While injured and on the ground, Tanjiro is almost attacked by Akaza and narrowly escapes death when Rengoku quickly strikes back. During the intense battl…

seasons.name: Entertainment District Arc
seasons.overview: After visiting the Rengoku residence, Tanjirou and his comrades volunteer for a mission within the Entertainment District, a place where desires are sold and demons dwell. They journey alongside the flashy Sound Hashira, Tengen Uzui, in search of a monstrous…

episodes.name: Sound Hashira: Tengen Uzui
episodes.overview: After the Mugen Train incident, Akaza visits Muzan Kibutsuji. Guided by a crow, Tanjiro Kamado heads off to the Rengoku residence to convey Kyojuro Rengoku's last messages to his father and little brother. Tanjiro's group return to the Butterfly Mansion.

episodes.name: Infiltrating the Entertainment District
episodes.overview: After Tanjiro visits the Rengoku residence and meets Kyojuro's younger brother, Senjuro, to deliver Kyojuro's last message, Tanjiro spends his days training and completing missions. One day, he returns to the Butterfly Mansion to find Sound Hashira, Tengen Uz…

episodes.name: What Are You?
episodes.overview: After arriving at the Entertainment District, Tanjiro and his comrades infiltrate each House where Uzui's wives, Suma, Makio and Hinatsuru, work. While working as apprentices and searching for their whereabouts, Inosuke hears that Makio has been shutting hers…

episodes.name: Tonight
episodes.overview: As Tanjiro close in on the demon that has been preying upon the entertainment district. But even as he closes in, the others continue to follow their leads toward their query. Who will find the demon first? And will they be able to survive the confrontation w…

episodes.name: Things Are Gonna Get Real Flashy!!
episodes.overview: After being told of Zenitsu’s disappearance and to leave the Entertainment District by Uzui, Tanjiro and Inosuke decide that they will rescue Zenitsu. That evening, Tanjiro picks up a scent of a demon, which leads him to Koinatsu Oiran being swallowed by Daki…

episodes.name: Layered Memories
episodes.overview: During the fierce battle with Daki, Tanjiro continues to unleash the Hinokami Kagura, which causes a huge strain on his body. Meanwhile, Inosuke reaches the Belt Demon’s nest and saves people who have been captured. Makio, Suma, and Zenitsu, who have been fre…

episodes.name: Transformation
episodes.overview: Enraged by Daki's contempt for human life, Tanjiro attacks her with more intensity and gradually corners the demon. But he's already gone past his physical limit. As Tanjiro collapses and all seems lost again, Nezuko appears. A vicious battle ensues and Nezuk…

episodes.name: Gathering
episodes.overview: After Nezuko attempts to attack innocent bystanders as her demon form advances, Tanjiro is finally able to make her fall asleep by singing a lullaby. Meanwhile, another demon emerges out of Daki's body after being beheaded by Uzui - Gyutaro, Daki's older brot…

episodes.name: Defeating an Upper Rank Demon
episodes.overview: Tanjiro, Zenitsu and Inosuke have joined Uzui in battle. While Zenitsu and Inosuke take on Daki, Tanjiro and Uzui deal with Gyutaro; however, they struggle as the demons have the upper hand with their coordinated attacks. But thanks to Hinatsuru's help and so…

episodes.name: Never Give Up
episodes.overview: Tanjiro and Uzui have been separated by Gyutaro’s Blood Demon Art. As Tanjiro joins the struggling Zenitsu and Inosuke, they manage to decapitate Daki at last thanks to their coordinated barrage of sword strikes. However, when Inosuke tries to run off with Da…

episodes.name: No Matter How Many Lives
episodes.overview: Uzui deflects all of Gyutaro's Blood Demon Art attacks, and despite getting pierced in the jaw, Tanjiro is able to slice off Gyutaro's head. Though wounded from head to toe, Zenitsu and Inosuke also behead Daki, and they succeed in decapitating both demons at…

seasons.name: Swordsmith Village Arc
seasons.overview: Tanjiro’s journey leads him to the Swordsmith Village, where he reunites with two Hashira, members of the Demon Slayer Corps’ highest-ranking swordsmen - Mist Hashira Muichiro Tokito and Love Hashira Mitsuri Kanroji. With the shadows of demons lurking near, a…

episodes.name: Someone's Dream
episodes.overview: An Upper Rank Demon has been defeated for the first time in a hundred years by Uzui, Tanjiro, and his comrades' effort. This news causes a ripple effect not only among the members of the Demon Slayer Corps, but also the Upper Rank Demons, who have been summon…

episodes.name: Yoriichi Type Zero
episodes.overview: Tanjiro intervenes during an argument between a pillar and an apprentice blacksmith and learns of the existence of an amazing training method.

episodes.name: A Sword From Over 300 Years Ago
episodes.overview: Tanjiro begins his training with Yoriichi Type Zero and is pushed to the limits by Kotetsu's relentless coaching and extreme training. Through this experience, Tanjiro masters a new skill of predicting where the opponent's next move will hit by using his sens…

episodes.name: Thank You, Tokito
episodes.overview: Hantengu's head is slashed by Muichiro and he splits into two clones. Muichiro is blown away by Karaku. Tanjiro, Nezuko and Genya are stunned when the clones split into more clones. Muichiro rescues Kotetsu from a Goldfish Demon.

episodes.name: Bright Red Sword
episodes.overview: Tokito continues advancing through the forest and finds Mr. Kanamori. As soon as they arrive at the work hut in the middle of the forest, they are welcomed by Gyokko. Meanwhile, Tanjiro continues his fight against Hantengu.

episodes.name: Aren't You Going to Become a Hashira?
episodes.overview: Two simultaneous fights continue, Tanjiro, Nezuko and Genya against Hantengu and Tokito against Gyokko. Genya began to show a demonic form. Tanjiro asks him to look for Hantengu's real body, but memories of the past begin to plague Genya.

episodes.name: Awful Villain
episodes.overview: Genya aims for the neck of the fifth demon that split off from Hantengu, but the demon's neck is shockingly hard, and his sword snaps in half in his attempt to strike it. His gun is also ineffective and Genya is driven into a corner. Realizing that he is unab…

episodes.name: The Mu in Muichiro
episodes.overview: Muichiro, with the help of air blown by Kotetsu to him, escapes Gyokko's Water Prison Pot. Muichiro finally recalls his tragic past.

episodes.name: Mist Hashira: Muichiro Tokito
episodes.overview: Armed with his memories, Muichiro feels powerful and invincible, convinced that the demonic fifth moon has no chance against him.

episodes.name: Love Hashira: Mitsuri Kanroji
episodes.overview: Tanjiro, Nezuko, and Genya are struggling through an arduous battle against Zohakuten and his five tree dragons. They are forced to fight defensively against the tree dragons using the four emotion demon's powers, and Tanjiro is swallowed by one of them amids…

episodes.name: A Connected Bond: Daybreak and First Light
episodes.overview: Tanjiro continues the fight against Hantengu. Amidst all his injuries and the Superior Four's skill, will he be able to defeat him? As the battle draws to a close, the Demon Slayer Squad must race against time to end the fight before dawn.

seasons.name: Hashira Training Arc
seasons.overview: The members of the Demon Slayer Corps and their highest-ranking swordsmen, the Hashira. In preparation for the forthcoming final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji, the Hashira Training commences. While each carry faith and determination within their hearts, Tanj…

episodes.name: To Defeat Muzan Kibutsuji
episodes.overview: The Hashira, Sanemi and Iguro, along with their comrades head to an abandoned castle on top of a mountain for a mission, while Tanjiro is being treated at the Butterfly Mansion for the wounds he suffered at the Swordsmith Village. Later on, the Hashira gather…

episodes.name: Water Hashira Giyu Tomioka's Pain
episodes.overview: Kagaya's Kasugai Crow suddenly appears in front of Tamayo and invites her to the Demon Slayer headquarters — even though she is a demon. Meanwhile, after receiving a letter from Kagaya at the Butterfly Mansion, Tanjiro pays a visit to Giyu, who is not partici…

episodes.name: Fully Recovered Tanjiro Joins the Hashira Training!!
episodes.overview: After talking with Tanjiro, Giyu is able to overcome his past self and decides to join the training. Meanwhile, Tanjiro's wounds have healed enough to join the training, and heads to his first training with the former Hashira, Uzui.

episodes.name: To Bring a Smile to One's Face
episodes.overview: After completing training with Uzui, Tanjiro visits the Tokito residence next. The Demon Slayer swordsmen who have already started the training are dispirited by Muichiro's intense training and harsh words. Tanjiro hears the swordsmen discussing if there's an…

episodes.name: I Even Ate Demons…
episodes.overview: After completing Mitsuri's training, Tanjiro heads to train with Iguro. When he arrives at the training site, Iguro is waiting for him, visibly angry. Will he be able to complete this horrifying training where he'll have to fix his sword skills?

episodes.name: The Strongest of the Demon Slayer Corps
episodes.overview: Tanjiro and Zenitsu head to Himejima's training site deep in the mountains and reunite with Inosuke and Murata. Tanjiro first starts the training by being hit by a waterfall but struggles with the coldness and weight of the water.

episodes.name: Stone Hashira: Gyōmei Himejima
episodes.overview: Tanjiro was struggling with Himejima's tasks. Now he finally manages to move the boulder after receiving advice from Genya, whom he meets by chance. With this breakthrough, will Tanjiro be able to overcome Himejima's rigorous training?

episodes.name: The Hashira Unite
episodes.overview: During a silent night when the moon shines, Kagaya finally meets Muzan Kibutsuji, who appears at the Ubuyashiki Mansion.

episodes.name: Spring Begins
episodes.overview: Along with three others, Natsu wakes up with no idea what's happened. The four of them reach an island and try to figure out a way to survive.

episodes.name: Insects Awaken
episodes.overview: Convinced that Botan has kidnapped them, Natsu and Arashi sneak out of camp and run into another survivor. Finally, Botan reveals what she knows.

episodes.name: Light Snow
episodes.overview: Natsu's clumsiness indirectly leads Team Summer B to the rest of their group. Her memories help them figure out their location, and their next moves.

episodes.name: Autumn Begins
episodes.overview: Arashi, Natsu and Semimaru stumble upon the Team Autumn settlement in the former Kobe region. They seem to be thriving, but their leaders are tyrants.

episodes.name: Heavy Snow
episodes.overview: In the ruins of Tokyo, Natsu, Arashi and Semimaru meet the sole survivor of Team Winter. Team Spring reaches Mt. Ogino Fuji and finds Natsu's message.

episodes.name: Grain Rain
episodes.overview: Aramaki joins Team Spring, despite Fujiko's doubts. Hana decides to search for Arashi after hearing that Aramaki met someone who fits his description.

episodes.name: Winter Solstice
episodes.overview: Hana and her companions discover a massive underground shelter. They find a survivor’s diary and learn the cruel fate of those who took refuge there.

episodes.name: Summer Solstice
episodes.overview: Hana's group and the Team Autumn survivors find the Spring settlement destroyed and abandoned. Momotaro wakes up among strangers.

episodes.name: Lesser Heat
episodes.overview: To survive, Hana and the others work together with Team Summer A. On the ship, Hotaru's cousin Hibari tells Natsu that Hotaru is slowly dying.

episodes.name: Cold Dew
episodes.overview: Ango recalls his harsh upbringing in the program and the brutal graduation test that winnowed the survivors down to the final Team Summer A members.

episodes.name: Greater Heat
episodes.overview: Hana becomes convinced that Ango will kill her if she stays in the village. Natsu and the others make landfall near the former Autumn settlement.

episodes.name: End of Heat
episodes.overview: Ryo orders Hana to join him in searching for a water source underground, putting her in a vulnerable position. In the caves, Ango recalls Shigeru.

episodes.name: Frost Descends
episodes.overview: Team Summer A banishes Ango and Ryo as Haru and the others mourn the missing Hana. Aramaki leaves the settlement believing she is still alive.

episodes.name: Summer Begins
episodes.overview: Expecting a trap, Ango and Ryo find and observe Team Summer B, but they are unexpectedly welcomed by the easygoing group.

episodes.name: Grain in Ear
episodes.overview: The two newcomers help Team Summer B. As they get to know the group, Ryo doubts their ability to survive. Ango begins to see Natsu as Shigeru.

episodes.name: Autumnal Equinox
episodes.overview: The carefree group enjoys life at sea, but Ryo tests their survival skills. Natsu reveals that Team Summer B is for dropouts, angering Ango.

episodes.name: Vernal Equinox
episodes.overview: Suspicious, Botan searches Ryo and Ango's belongings while the others look for Arashi. Elsewhere, another survivor learns about the wilderness.

episodes.name: White Dew
episodes.overview: Team Summer B gets stuck in a bed of dense algae. they find a large ship and investigate, but Botan is wary. Stranded, Arashi sees the ship's kite.

episodes.name: Winter Begins
episodes.overview: The team members are separated after the ship's sudden movement. Arashi makes his way to help as Botan's group makes a discovery.

episodes.name: Lesser Cold
episodes.overview: Ango's hallucinations lead to perilous situations for him and Arashi. Semimaru has a brush with death while Natsu gathers her courage.

episodes.name: Grain Full
episodes.overview: A sanctuary in nature becomes a trap for small mammals and humans alike. Meanwhile, an iron-eating bacteria begins to spread throughout the ship.

episodes.name: Rain Water
episodes.overview: Fujiko and Chisa reunite with Hana. On the ship, the missiles begin launch prep while Team Summer B learns about Ango's past and the test.

episodes.name: Greater Cold
episodes.overview: Hana readjusts to other humans. Team Summer B works together to manually disable the missiles, but a series of passcodes complicates the process.

episodes.name: Pure Brightness
episodes.overview: Problems persist in the ship as the spreading bacteria begins attacking. The missile countdown continues as the team makes a mad dash to exit.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: After five years of harboring unspoken feelings, Taiju Ooki is finally ready to confess his love to Yuzuriha Ogawa. Just when Taiju begins his confession however, a blinding green light strikes the Earth and petrifies mankind around the world—turning every si…

episodes.name: Stone World
episodes.overview: Several thousand years after a mysterious phenomenon turns all of humanity to stone, the extraordinarily intelligent, science-driven boy, Senku Ishigami, awakens from petrification. Facing a world of stone and the total collapse of civilization, Senku makes u…

episodes.name: King of the Stone World
episodes.overview: Facing immediate danger from wild animals Senku and Taiju are forced to revive Tsukasa Shishio "The Strongest High School Primate". Although Tsukasa has tremendous fighting ability and provides abundant food as their hunter, their new ally harbors an opposing…

episodes.name: Weapons of Science
episodes.overview: Senku does not trust the motivation of Shishio, so he will try to hide his plans from a new and unforeseen enemy for his plan to revive civilization.

episodes.name: Fire the Smoke Signal
episodes.overview: Senku has the idea of ​​creating gunpowder to have a way to balance the scale and have a chance to defeat Shishio. The production of gunpowder causes a fire. Shortly thereafter, Senku and the others discover smoke signals on the horizon. An accident? Hardly l…

episodes.name: Stone World The Beginning
episodes.overview: Shishio is determined to end Senku's life if he does not promise at that moment that he will abandon his idea of ​​recovering civilization as it was before the incident.

episodes.name: Two Nations of the Stone World
