episodes.overview: Taiju and Yuzuriha figure out Senku's secret to reviving him. But now that he's back, they need to deal with Tsukasa.

episodes.name: Where Two Million Years Have Gone
episodes.overview: Kohaku shows Senku to her village, but it's going to take some convincing before they let him in. In the meantime, he makes friends with a like-minded, promising "sorcerer."

episodes.name: Stone Road
episodes.overview: Kohaku's sister, village priestess Ruri, is gravely ill. Senku, Chrome and Kohaku begin their quest to make antibiotics to save her life.

episodes.name: Let There Be the Light of Science
episodes.overview: Senku starts a ramen stand in hopes of winning over support for his kingdom of science, but some people are too principled to take such a bribe. Mentalist Asagiri Gen is not one of them.

episodes.name: A Flimsy Alliance
episodes.overview: Senku and his kingdom of science successfully test the first lightbulb since the collapse. Meanwhile, Asagiri Gen, a spy from Tsukasa's empire, is killed by an unknown attacker.

episodes.name: Clear World
episodes.overview: The development of glassworks, an important step for making sulfa drugs and for chemistry as a whole, turns out to have a surprising benefit for Suika.

episodes.name: Buddies Back to Back
episodes.overview: To make antibiotics, Senku and his kingdom need to obtain sulfuric acid from a fountain of the stuff. The team goes prepared, but there's no guarantee that they'll make it back alive.

episodes.name: Masked Warrior
episodes.overview: All that's needed to make antibiotics is alcohol. The best way to get some is to win the Grand Bout, which the Senku and his kingdom will also need to do in order to keep Magma away from Ruri and give her the drug.

episodes.name: Master of Flame
episodes.overview: After Magma's series of tricks to reach the final match, Chrome reveals a trick of his own! With a little extra help from Gen, Chrome just may be able to pull this one off!

episodes.name: The Culmination of Two Million Years
episodes.overview: After Senku's unlikely victory, quick marriage, and even hastier divorce, the kingdom of science is back to work to finally finish Ruri's medicine!

episodes.name: A Tale for the Ages
episodes.overview: Ruri reveals the origin of the village's name and Senku learns of his father's fate!

episodes.name: A Hundred Nights and a Thousand Skies
episodes.overview: Byakuya and the astronauts' story continues, and Senku's connection to Ishigami Village and the Hundred Tales is finally revealed.

episodes.name: Stone Wars
episodes.overview: Tsukasa's army is coming! Kinro struggles to hold the bridge against the deadly spearman Hyoga and his shock troops, but Senku and the villagers are ready with deadly new weapons of science!

episodes.name: To Modernity
episodes.overview: Hyoga is disarmed, but the kingdom of science is still in danger - Ishigami village is in flames! And Tsukasa will soon know that Senku is still alive... How will the villagers fight off the coming invasion?

episodes.name: The Age of Energy
episodes.overview: Work begins on creating the components for Senku's cell phone, but spinning gold wire is proving to be quite the task! Luckily, Chrome and Kaseki "invent" the water wheel and drastically improve the process!

episodes.name: Spartan Crafts Club
episodes.overview: With Chrome and Kaseki’s water wheel finished, Ishigami Village moves into the age of electricity! But with the primitive materials available to him, will Senku be able to create a filament that can withstand the intense heat of operating a vacuum tube?

episodes.name: The Treasure
episodes.overview: Senku, Chrome, and Magma venture into a cave in search of Tungsten, but there's a suspicious accident that leaves Senku and Chrome trapped at the bottom of a pit! What is Magma up to?!

episodes.name: Wave of Science
episodes.overview: Senku and the rest of the village get to work on making the components for the cell phone. It's hard work but everyone is pumped!

episodes.name: Voices Over Infinite Distance
episodes.overview: After a successful test of their new cell phone, Senku learns of a mysterious tale about a bee named Speaker who can play the voices of the dead.

seasons.name: Stone Wars
seasons.overview: Senkuu has made it his goal to bring back two million years of human achievement and revive the entirety of those turned to statues. However, one man stands in his way: Tsukasa Shishiou, who believes that only the fittest of those petrified should be revived.…

episodes.name: Stone Wars Beginning
episodes.overview: Senku continues in trying to advance the Stone World, this time he makes "space food", it is in actuality cup noodles. After Senku finishes his project, Gen has an epiphany and devises a plan to take down Tsukasa's army without violence.

episodes.name: Hot Line
episodes.overview: While Senku's diversion buys Gen and others some time, soon Homura realizes something is not right.

episodes.name: Call from the Dead
episodes.overview: Taiju and Yuzuriha are on the verge of tears after they hear Senku's voice, and Senku informs them of his plan to win the war without any bloodshed.

episodes.name: Full Assault
episodes.overview: Chrome and Magma struggle with Ukyo, while Senku, gets his hands busy with building up an invention; a new hope.

episodes.name: Steam Gorilla
episodes.overview: The final touches to the automobile are made and it is used to transport the science supplies to a fortified cliffside that's close to the Tsukasa empire. From there the automobile is upgraded into a tank, but unbeknownst to the rescue group preparations by t…

episodes.name: Prison Break
episodes.overview: Chrome must use all of his scientific knowledge to escape from his prison and save Senku and others.

episodes.name: Secret Mission
episodes.overview: Senku decides to use the Steam-Gorilla to capture The Miracle Cave. Using Lillian's recording, Senku gains the trust of more of Tsukasa's men. Ukyo reveals he saw Yuzuriha's secret mission to reassemble the fragments of statues Tsukasa destroyed.

episodes.name: Final Battle
episodes.overview: The Final Battle for the miracle cave starts as Senku and the Kingdom of Science conduct a frontal assault on the cave.

episodes.name: To Destroy and to Save
episodes.overview: Tsukasa and Hyoga are coming to capture the miracle cave. The Kingdom of Science must buy Senku and Chrome some time to turn the tide, or it is all over.

episodes.name: Humanity's Strongest Tag Team
episodes.overview: Senku demands a truce from Tsukasa in return for reviving his sister, Mirai, who Tsukasa comes to know is alive, but a new problem shows up when Hyoga shows his true self.

episodes.name: PROLOGUE OF Dr. STONE
episodes.overview: The Kingdom of Science is victorious, however it is not over for Senku. Senku must use all of his knowledge to cure Tsukasa who is severly injured.

seasons.name: New World
seasons.overview: With the ambitious Ryuusui Nanami on board, Senkuu Ishigami and his team are almost ready to sail the seas and reach the other side of the world—where the bizarre green light that petrified humanity originated. Thanks to the revival of a skillful chef, enough…

episodes.name: NEW WORLD MAP
episodes.overview: While continuing to use the hot air balloon to search for the oil, it's decided that Ishigami Village needs to take up agriculture to prevent future food shortages, as well as to produce preserved food for their upcoming sea voyage.

episodes.name: Greed Equals Justice
episodes.overview: The Kingdom of Science will need rations to last them through their voyage to the other side of the world. But Senku, being no professional, burns all the bread he attempts to bake.

episodes.name: First Contact
episodes.overview: Senku, brings along a team to look for the Sagara Oil Fields. Meanwhile, Suika and Francois go truffle hunting.

episodes.name: Eyes of Science
episodes.overview: The morse code signal reading "WHY" saturates the airwaves too much for Ukyo to pinpoint a direction, so the Kingdom of Science works on a way to visualize the signal.

episodes.name: Science Vessel Perseus
episodes.overview: Kaseki's efforts to build the science vessel Perseus hit a roadblock when he realizes that it's impossible to get all the parts to fit in practice.

episodes.name: TREASURE BOX
episodes.overview: The Perseus crew are on their way to the treasure island, the birthplace of the Hundred Tales, where they hope to locate the treasure box left behind by the Soyuz crew.

episodes.name: Ray of Despair, Ray of Hope
episodes.overview: The Perseus arrives at the treasure island. A recon squad consisting of Senku, Soyuz, Kohaku, and Gen set off to locate the platinum and make contact with the islanders. Ukyo later discovers something on the seafloor and send Ginro to investigate.

episodes.name: The Trump Card Aboard the Science Vessel
episodes.overview: Amaryllis explains how she evaded petrification and how she came to her decision to sneak into the inner palace.

episodes.name: Beautiful Science
episodes.overview: Suika and Ginro work together to rescue the mobile lab from the Perseus. Reunited with Senku and the others, the group works on items to help Kohaku with the selection process.

episodes.name: SCIENCE WARS
episodes.overview: Amaryllis, Ginro and Kohaku are chosen to join the inner palace. The science team will need a way to communicate with them in secret, and, eventually, a way for them with the science team.

episodes.name: With This Fist, a Miracle
episodes.overview: Kohaku has located the treasure left behind by Byakuya and the others, but it's encased in concrete. Senku has to devise a plan to quietly get at the contents inside, so as to not alert the guards.

episodes.name: The Kingdom of Science's Counterattack
episodes.overview: Kohaku is forced to destroy Ryusui's statue to prove that she isn't a spy.

episodes.name: The Medusa's True Face
episodes.overview: The team revives Kaseki to work on the drone. Meanwhile, Ginro is called to see the Master.

episodes.name: Deal Game, Test of Wit
episodes.overview: More of the Kingdom of Science is brought back from petrification, but they are discovered in the cave by Moz.

episodes.name: Battle in Three Dimensions
episodes.overview: Moz and the Kingdom of Science form a tenuous, temporary alliance against Ibara. How long it will last is a question they can't afford to concern themselves with just yet.

episodes.name: Total War
episodes.overview: The Kingdom of Science attacks and tries to execute their plan to steal the petrification device. Moz convinces Kirisame to use the device, but Ryusui's instincts tell him something is off about the situation.

episodes.name: JOKER
episodes.overview: The Kingdom of Science members launch an attack on the islanders aboard the Perseus, but Moz isn't far behind and Senku and the others are forced to retreat inside the vessel. Ibara has them cornered, but Senku unleashes his Joker card.

episodes.name: Flicker of Doom
episodes.overview: Yo and the Kingdom of Science capture the petrification device, but Ibara isn't going down without a fight.

episodes.name: LAST MAN STANDING
episodes.overview: Much to Ibara's shock and dismay, Senku devised a plan and managed to escape petrification. Now the two enter into a head-to-head battle for control of the Medusa device.

episodes.name: FIRST DREAM
episodes.overview: Senku stands victorious. He then works on reviving the others and fixing their communications device, but while they are talking with Ruri they encounter a strong interference with the signal.

episodes.name: Treasure Island
episodes.overview: To the moon! That's the plan, at least. Senku and the Kingdom of Science need to devise a means with which to go to the moon and deal with Why-Man. The first step is allying with the people of Treasure Island and enlisting their help with some new crafts.

episodes.name: BEYOND THE NEW WORLD
episodes.overview: With the petrification device in the Kingdom's hands, it's time to revive Tsukasa. But there's just one problem: the device is out of batteries.

seasons.name: Science Future
seasons.overview: Having resolved the crisis in the Petrification Kingdom, Senkuu and his companions gear up to deal directly with the mastermind behind the petrification phenomenon—who supposedly resides on the moon. The ambitious spaceship project, however, requires immense…

episodes.name: RYUSUI VS. SENKU
episodes.overview: Senku and his companions finally set off for America in search of corn. However, a dispute arises between Ryusui and Senku shortly after they depart.

episodes.name: SCIENCE JOURNEY
episodes.overview: Maintaining morale will be critical on the long journey to the Americas. Knowing where on the ocean you are is pretty important, too. The crew of the Perseus discuss.

episodes.name: Light Trap in the Darkness
episodes.overview: The Perseus lands in the Americas. They first head to Northern California in search of yellow dent corn, but discover a lot more than that.

episodes.name: Dr. X
episodes.overview: The search party narrowly escaped enemy machine gun fire. Unfortunately, the respite was short-lived.

episodes.name: DOCTOR VS. DOCTOR
episodes.overview: Tensions rise as Dr. Xeno makes his introductions to the Perseus.

episodes.name: SCIENCE IS ELEGANT
episodes.overview: Stanley orders Luna to infiltrate the Perseus and identify Doctor Taiju. Things go sideways when it turns out to be a little too easy.

episodes.name: The Two Scientists
episodes.overview: Senku had gotten his start in rocket building through an email exchange with Doctor Xeno. Their approaches to science soon diverged.

episodes.name: LOCK ON
episodes.overview: NASA scientist Dr. Xeno attempts to pick off the leader of the Kingdom of Science.

episodes.name: Light of Science
episodes.overview: With Senku having been shot, the Kingdom of Science plots its retaliation against Dr. Xeno.

episodes.name: Dirty Roads
episodes.overview: With Senku still confined to the bed, Chrome's team begins work on the tunnel to Xeno's base.

episodes.name: Those Who Know the Rules; Those Who Make Them
episodes.overview: Ryusui and Senku take to the skies in a science versus science dogfight while Xeno's forces mount a ground counterattack.

episodes.name: Reunion
episodes.overview: Xeno's army attacks and when all seems lost, Chrome and his friends finish the tunnel and capture Xeno.

episodes.name: Watching the Same Moon
episodes.overview: The team head to the source of the petrification beam in South America as they flee from Stanley's ship.

episodes.name: EARTH RACE
episodes.overview: Senku and company must flee from Stanley's ship, but they have to make stops to refuel.

episodes.name: The Escape
episodes.overview: With Stanley's ship hot on their tail, can science help Senku and company escape?

episodes.name: Medusa Mechanism
episodes.overview: The team is going to need a weapon for when Stanley inevitably catches up to them.

episodes.name: Sickening Yet Beautiful
episodes.overview: Senku and his team have lost Stanley for now, but they aren't out of — or rather, in — the woods just yet.

episodes.name: Diamond Heart
episodes.overview: The team discovers a giant pile of petrification devices. They take them apart to see what makes them tick.

episodes.name: Stone Sanctuary
episodes.overview: The team begins making, digging for, and polishing diamonds to replace the burnt-out ones inside the devices.

episodes.name: What I Once Sought to Destroy
episodes.overview: Suika is in charge of making sure Senku's plan works, but her kindness becomes an obstacle.

episodes.name: Our Dr. Stone
episodes.overview: With the revival team captured, it's up to Luna and Chelsea to revive everyone when the time comes.

episodes.name: Until We Meet Again
episodes.overview: With the petrification beam approaching, who will get their hands on the revival fluid?

episodes.name: Scientist, All Alone
episodes.overview: Suika gathers the team's statues, sets up camp and gets to work doing science.

episodes.name: Whole New World
episodes.overview: With Senku back, it's only a matter of time before the rest of the Kingdom of Science is revived.

episodes.name: Future Engine
episodes.overview: Senku and Dr. Xeno team up to gather the materials needed to make a rocket engine.

episodes.name: Fire
episodes.overview: The crew arrives in Spain, where they collect fluorite, olive oil and some treats.

episodes.name: The Universe Is Written in the Language of Mathematics
episodes.overview: The New Perseus sets out to India to recruit mathematicians for the space program.

episodes.name: Dawn of the Computer
episodes.overview: The computer that the team is building is a series of toroidal tubes. Senku explains.

episodes.name: The Truth About the Rocket
episodes.overview: The team gets to work wiring up several megabits' worth of memory donuts for their computer.

episodes.name: Stone to Space
episodes.overview: The team will need a stupidly insane amount of electricity to turn their bauxite into an aluminum rocket body.

episodes.name: Unknown Known
episodes.overview: With the computer completed, the team will need a user interface: a TV.

episodes.name: Challengers of Science
episodes.overview: The Kingdom of Science's rocket launches are mired by a string of rapid unscheduled disassemblies.

episodes.name: Wanting Everything
episodes.overview: The team is too small to build a round-trip rocket. They'll need to enlist help from around the world.

episodes.name: Countdown
episodes.overview: Ryusui may need to defer to a better pilot for the moon mission.

episodes.name: Giant Step
episodes.overview: The rocket needs to be assembled in space. Not an easy feat in the 21st century, let alone in the stone world.

episodes.name: Why-Man
episodes.overview: The team sets foot on the moon to confront Why-Man.

episodes.name: Ushers of an Exhilarating Future
episodes.overview: Senku offers Why-Man more exhilaration than they can handle.

episodes.name: The Acting President
episodes.overview: While driving with his family, Park Mu-jin sees that the unthinkable has happened at the National Assembly and soon finds his life turning upside down.

episodes.name: Commander-In-Chief
episodes.overview: Surrounded by generals and officials clamoring over what must be done, Park Mu-jin decides to pursue a hunch despite opposition from his own advisers.

episodes.name: Maintaining Status Quo
episodes.overview: Han Na-gyeong makes a startling connection after uncovering a clue. As a political rival incites public fear, Park Mu-jin weighs his options.

episodes.name: Confession
episodes.overview: A survivor is found at the disaster scene. Cha Yeong-jin’s briefing about approval ratings and presidential election polls makes Park Mu-jin uneasy.

episodes.name: A Good Person
episodes.overview: Park Mu-jin’s live interview alarms the public and the Blue House staff. Jeong Han-mo questions Na-gyeong’s suspicions about Oh Yeong-seok.

episodes.name: Command
episodes.overview: As the staff tries to find ways to allay the public’s growing fear, Park Mu-jin makes an unexpected suggestion. Na-gyeong asks Yun Chan-gyeong for help.

episodes.name: Governance
episodes.overview: Han Ju-seung returns to the Blue House, Na-gyeong divulges a troubling detail to Han-mo, and Yun Chan-gyeong threatens Park Mu-jin with impeachment.

episodes.name: Doubt
episodes.overview: Yeong-jin thinks he’s found his candidate. Na-gyeong uncovers footage implicating Yeong-seok and urges Han-mo to brief Park Mu-jin before it’s too late.

episodes.name: Scandal
episodes.overview: The staff tries to control rumors brewing around Park Mu-jin, but he remains reticent. Ji Yun-bae tells Han-mo that he’s the only one who can save him.

episodes.name: Accomplice
episodes.overview: Park Mu-jin receives distressing information from an unforeseen source -- and is told not to trust anyone. Cha Yeong-jin still doesn’t have his answer.

episodes.name: The Acting President, Oh Yeong-seok
episodes.overview: Kang Dae-han interrogates Na-gyeong, who insists on briefing Park Mu-jin in person. The staff doesn’t know what to make of Yeong-seok’s actions.

episodes.name: Answer
episodes.overview: Yeong-seok’s opportunistic maneuvering doesn’t go unnoticed. Choe Gang-yeon fears that Park Mu-jin has made his choice. Na-gyeong probes Yeong-jin.

episodes.name: Presidential Candidate
episodes.overview: Yeong-seok has cutting words for Park Mu-jin. Despite Ju-seung’s counsel, Yeong-jin starts preparing his candidate. Na-gyeong tries to assure Han-mo.

episodes.name: The Outcome
episodes.overview: As his advisers wonder whether Park Mu-jin is making decisions as an acting president or as a candidate, Yeong-seok informs him about his intentions.

episodes.name: The Trap
episodes.overview: Park Mu-jin tries dealing with a military threat by taking a gamble on Lee Gwan-muk. Yeong-jin receives photos putting a candidate in a delicate spot.

episodes.name: The Last Choice
episodes.overview: With limited time left as acting president, Park Mu-jin and his staff scramble to solve the case -- but the mysterious tailor remains an enigma.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Hae Il is a priest in a small town. He takes care of problems in the neighbourhood, but things always get physical. He gets arrested while trying to stop a fraud. He has to leave the neighbourhood to avoid accusation. Meanwhile, Kyeong Seon who is a prosecuto…

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Hae Il leaves Yeosu and head to Gudam. He stays at the Catholic church of Father Lee Young Jun who is like a real father to him. Dae Young is a detective at Gudam Police Station. He goes out to support a local event, and protestors appear at the scene. Meanwh…

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Hae Il helps out the protestors at the ceremony and confronts Cheol Bum. Kyeong Seon gets a bribe from the accused of her case. New recruit Seung Ah joins Dae Young's team and becomes his partner. Meanwhile, Jang Ryong and his men make a scene at the church.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Jan Ryong and his men are released without any penalty. Father Lee gets a call in the middle of the night. Next day, he is found dead at a mountain nearby. Hae Il requests an investigation, but the Gudam Police and the prosecutor refuse. Police announce that…

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: When his fellow clergyman dies under shady circumstances, a hot-tempered priest who's unable to turn a blind eye to injustice hunts for answers.

episodes.name: We're Back
episodes.overview: Father Michael Kim Haeil returns, ready to take down a notorious and powerful drug cartel in Busan.

episodes.name: When in Busan
episodes.overview: Haeil takes up teaching at a seminary in Busan, as drug lord Kim Hongsik arrives in the city.

episodes.name: Somewhere in Between Heaven and Hell
episodes.overview: Haeil digs into the cartel, while Hongsik begins building his empire in Busan.

episodes.name: Within the Devil's Circle
episodes.overview: Hae-il and Dae-young rescue Ja-young, while a suspect in interrogation suffers an accident amid the chaos, and the three decide to team up in their pursuit of the drug cartel; with his drug plant operational, Hong-sik begins expanding his reach.

episodes.name: Hard Measures for Insanity
episodes.overview: Haeil and Hongsik sense the tension as strong rivals, while Kyungsun gains Duhun's favor.

episodes.name: The Devil is Not as Black as He is Painted
episodes.overview: Haeil's pressure on Hongsik and the cartel grows, leading Hongsik to plot a fierce counterstrike.

episodes.name: A Priest's Duty Begins with Fury
episodes.overview: When the Virgin Mary statue is set ablaze, Haeil is certain it is the work of the drug cartel.

episodes.name: A Worm Gets Crushed When Stepped on
episodes.overview: Haeil discovers Hongsik's true identity, leading to an intense face-off between the two.

episodes.name: Stand Up Again
episodes.overview: Haeil's fall signals a new resolve. His team unites, prepared to crush the forces of darkness.

episodes.name: Blessings Start Rough
episodes.overview: Under flawless disguise, Haeil and Kyungsun infiltrate the ship, but Kyungsun faces danger.

episodes.name: Real Prayers are Made on the Move
episodes.overview: Haeil and Kyungsun narrowly escape danger, while Duhun and Hongsik each plot their own survival

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Ahn Eun-young enters the forbidden basement as Hong In-pyo reluctantly trails along. They join hands when a dark secret shakes up the school.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: When the bond between two troublemaking students catches Eun-young's eye, In-pyo proposes unconventional ideas to split and keep them apart.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Eun-young and In-pyo get knotty behind closed doors. With Mackenzie’s support, a student settles the score with the basketball team.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Baek Hye-min introduces herself to Eun-young as a new transfer student and presents a solution to a mite infestation that's hard to stomach.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Eun-young reunites with an old friend. With sympathy for Hye-min's lonely world, Eun-young seeks out ways to help her outlive her fate.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Evil floods the school with uncontrollable negative energy. Eun-young reaches her limit and makes a difficult decision with In-pyo by her side.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: As Delhi reels in the aftermath of a gang rape, DCP Vartika Chaturvedi leads a painstaking search for the culprits. Inspired by the 2012 Nirbhaya case.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After two victims of a brutal crime are found on a roadside, DCP Vartika Chaturvedi assigns only her most trusted officers to lead the investigation.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: With few leads to go on, Vartika's team focuses on identifying the exact bus where the crime occurred. Media leaks trigger backlash against the police.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Disturbing details about the night of the crime emerge when bus driver Jai Singh is interrogated further. The hunt begins for his five accomplices.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The fourth suspect is captured. As public outrage mounts, Vartika and Commissioner Kumar Vijay must defend the police against rumors of misconduct.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: The pursuit of the final two suspects escalates. Vartika must manage the team’s anger, her child’s fears and her own guilt. Kumar faces irate activists.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Male victim Akash is tempted to speak to the media, to Vartika’s dismay. The chief minister continues with his mission to take down Vartika and Kumar.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: The fifth suspect surprises the police. Protests outside Parliament become riots. The search for the final suspect leads to a chase in Naxal territory.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: When a chain of distinctly grisly murders suggests the return of a feared criminal gang, DCP Vartika heads the case under media and public pressure. Inspired by the Chaddi Baniyan Gang.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Vartika and her team are alerted about a gruesome quadruple murder. Evidence points to a crime syndicate not seen in the city for 20 years.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: After another murder, veteran inspector Viren Chaddha joins the team. As case details leak to the press, Vartika suspects an informant among the police.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The team's investigation of two suspects leads to eye-opening findings. Amid pressure to appease the media and the public, Vartika faces a moral dilemma.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Against a ticking clock, Vartika takes the case in a new direction. Neeti finds a common link between the murders. Another tip-off leads to a suspect.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: The team finds the suspects' hideout. But with Lata still missing, Vartika must determine if she's running or hiding — and finally uncover her story.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Season 3 focuses on human trafficking, as two different cases unfold: one with Deputy Commissioner of Police (DCP) Vartika Chaturvedi (Shah) investigating a truck full of missing young women; and the other by Neeti Singh IPS (Dugal), who is trying to find the…

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After her transfer to Assam, Vartika unearths a network smuggling young women to Delhi under the guise of jobs. Neeti probes an injured baby's case.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Vartika's investigation uncovers deeper connections as Khushi reveals startling truths about Baby Noor. Kalyani's court hearing takes a shocking turn.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Rahul's confessions about working with Kalyani help the team draw links to the bride trade. Neeti and Simran edge closer to the missing mother's location.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The hunt for Shabnam intensifies, revealing fresh leads. Kusum gets bail and meets Meena. A deeper probe into the Santro car lands Simran in trouble.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: As Vartika's meeting with Mithul Khanna goes awry, Shabnam has a tearful reunion with her children. Neeti searches for her missing colleague.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Shaken by tragic news, the team races to find the missing women as Vartika's career hangs in the balance. Will they catch Meena before all hope is lost?

episodes.name: A Close Friend -- Who’s Only Just a Friend
episodes.overview: On his 20th birthday, Yun Tae-o gets his grandfather’s house but soon finds that living by himself doesn’t come with all the perks he had imagined.

episodes.name: I Need a Room and You Have Many
episodes.overview: Han Song-i, Seo Do-hyeon, Oh Ga-rin, and Choe Hun all end up going to Tae-o’s place but he’s not home. Tae-o gets alarming news about Song-i.

episodes.name: Fretting about Someone
episodes.overview: Without knowing how it happened, Tae-o gets stuck having housemates and learns more bad news about Song-i when he goes home for dinner with his family.

episodes.name: The Guy You Told Me About
episodes.overview: Tae-o contemplates what he overheard and is convinced he knows what it means. To show her appreciation, Ga-rin throws a party, which Do-hyeon attends.

episodes.name: Saying I Like You
episodes.overview: Tae-o keeps misreading Song-i, exacerbating the confusion between them. Do-hyeon wants to know more about Song-i’s relationship with Tae-o.

episodes.name: Confession Day
episodes.overview: Tae-o makes a breakthrough with Ryu Se-hyeon but is shocked when he sees her house. Do-hyeon and Song-i try to figure out where they stand.

episodes.name: A Rain Shower
episodes.overview: As Tae-o’s complaints about Song-i’s mysterious boyfriend grow, she becomes cross when she learns his crush is someone she knows -- and doesn’t like.

episodes.name: Turning Point
episodes.overview: After Tae-o proposes the housemates take a road trip, they're joined by Do-hyeon and Se-hyeon. Tae-o sees Song-i with someone he didn’t expect.

episodes.name: The Real Reason
episodes.overview: Tae-o accepts the situation between Song-i and Do-hyeon and tries to offer advice, but Do-hyeon is adamant about doing things his way.

episodes.name: His Priority
episodes.overview: Tae-o gets an ultimatum and realizes something about himself. Song-i announces her plans to move out after Hun and Ga-rin decide to leave the house.

episodes.name: Five Degrees of Separation
episodes.overview: Do-hyeon and his father have a candid conversation about the family finances. Song-i heads to Jeonju and is surprised to run into someone she knows.

episodes.name: Alone, Together
episodes.overview: Song-i comes to realize that Tae-o has always been there throughout her life. Do-hyeon gets upset when Song-i doesn’t answer her phone.

episodes.name: Unspeakable Secrets
episodes.overview: Song-i stops by the house to return something to Tae-o, who reminds her how things used to be between them. Tae-o’s family tries to hide a secret.

episodes.name: Something Only I Can Do
episodes.overview: Hun and Ga-rin have news for the group. Song-i decides to talk to Tae-o’s father. Tae-o ends up going on an outing with Song-i.

episodes.name: Watching Her Watching Him
episodes.overview: Tae-o tells Song-i about something odd he noticed at the restaurant and resolves to find out the whole truth from his father.

episodes.name: My First First Love
episodes.overview: There may be more changes in the house, as Tae-o and his friends learn the true meaning of friendship, family and love. Song-i has a job interview.

episodes.name: How Dare You?
episodes.overview: Art curator Sung Duk-mi is passionate about her work -- and her secret hobby. At an auction, she enters a bidding race against famous artist Ryan Gold.

episodes.name: You Are Fired
episodes.overview: When Ryan becomes her new boss, Duk-mi is concerned about the changes he brings to the museum -- and that he might recognize her from the airport.

episodes.name: A Rumor
episodes.overview: A meeting at a special collector's home leads to trouble for Duk-mi, who finds herself swept up in noisy rumors.

episodes.name: She Is My Girlfriend
episodes.overview: Ryan has an idea for a way to get Duk-mi out of the scandal, to Nam Eun-gi's displeasure. Cha Si-an has an unfortunate run-in with a fan.

episodes.name: Ryan and Deok Mi’s Relationship
episodes.overview: The museum's new intern poses a problem for Duk-mi. Si-an agrees to join an exhibition. Ryan sets out to procure a photographer's final work.

episodes.name: Do You Really Think You Are My Girlfriend?
episodes.overview: Ryan figures out Duk-mi's secret, and decides to have some fun with it. To the delight of the museum staff, Si-an comes for a visit.

episodes.name: Shi An’s Autograph Event
episodes.overview: Duk-mi's parents invite Ryan over for an impromptu dinner. Sindy and Duk-mi both win spots at Si-an's fan event.

episodes.name: The Visual Art Director
episodes.overview: To save the exhibition, Ryan and Deok Mi attempt to persuade Choi Da In, a visual art director, to work with Cha Shi An so he can participate. However, while helping to convince her, Da In finds out Ryan and Deok Mi's relationship is fake. Later, Da In tells…

episodes.name: Is It Really Over?
episodes.overview: Ryan is shocked when he hears Deok Mi say that she wants to end their fake relationship. Although the words "end it" came out of her mouth, Deok Mi can't ignore the feelings she has for Ryan. At the end of finishing off an awkward day of feeling out each othe…

episodes.name: Ms. Sung, I Like You
episodes.overview: Ryan finally tells Deok Mi how feels about her, and asks her to be in a relationship for real. Deok Mi and Ryan spend happy days together but Eun Gi, who has no idea about their relationship, plans to confess his feeling towards Deok Mi. Meanwhile, Seon Joo g…

episodes.name: Have You Ever Been Hit by Reality?
episodes.overview: "When did you find out that I was Shi An is My Life?" When Ryan confesses the fact that he knew she was Shi An is My Life all along, Deok Mi is appalled. On top of that, Eun Gi who is defending Deok Mi, confesses that he has feelings for her! The sparks of an…

episodes.name: The Fact That I'm Your Fan Means I'm on Your Side
episodes.overview: Deok Mi can't leave her teary man alone and invites him to stay the night at her house. The lucky Lion gets to spend the whole night with Deok Mi, and Da In and Eun Gi get closer by sharing their feelings through a drunk conversation. Meanwhile, the painting…

episodes.name: Always With You, Even When You're Alone
episodes.overview: Deok Mi and Ryan start to sum up all the clues regarding artist Lee Sol's identity. And as they get closer to the truth, Deok Mi sees how frustrated, confused, and painful it is for Ryan. She stays by his side to console him but also gives him the space he ne…

episodes.name: A Star That Shines My Dark Heart
episodes.overview: Ryan finally gets to meet his biological mother. However, the 26 years of being separated don't make it easy for a passionate reunion. Moreover, the words she speaks differ from his memories, making it even harder for him to understand. It's not until he disc…

episodes.name: You Are My Home
episodes.overview: It’s Deok Mi’s birthday and Ryan makes it very special for her. When the day couldn’t get any better, Deok Mi learns the truth about the boy, Yoon Jae, and also realizes that she had been the only one who was living in the dark. When she comes around to under…

episodes.name: Finale Episode, To New York
episodes.overview: Deok Mi looks at Ryan’s paintings and feels like she’s holding back his career that should be blossoming more in New York where he’s from. She’s in a dilemma as she loves her job but at the same time, she’d like to cheer for her boyfriend’s dream. What choice…

episodes.name: Limbhad
episodes.overview: Thirteen-year-old Jack has no idea about his connection to Idhun, but he knows his family is missing and strange and powerful beings have come for him.

episodes.name: You're not yet ready
episodes.overview: Jack wants to help when Victoria is stalked by Kirtash, but Alsan worries he'll put the mission at risk. Victoria discovers new aspects of her powers.

episodes.name: The staff of Ayshel
episodes.overview: Kirtash spins a masterful trap and forces Jack and Victoria to make an impossible choice in order to save Alsan's life.

episodes.name: Rescue plans
episodes.overview: Shail tells Jack the true story of the unicorns and dragons, and is forced to oversee Jack and Victoria as they take charge of their developing powers.

episodes.name: Come with me
episodes.overview: The Resistance is in disarray as Jack looks for Alsan and Victoria vows to avenge a loss. But Kirtash, having lied to the necromancer, has other plans.

episodes.name: Re-encounter
episodes.overview: When Jack tracks him down, Alsan/Alexander sees it as a sign to revive the Resistance. But things remain unsettled between Victoria and Kirtash.

episodes.name: Secrets
episodes.overview: Trapped between duty and love, Kirtash tries to find a balance and reveals his true nature to Victoria — and to Jack, whom he's determined to kill.

episodes.name: Their True Nature
episodes.overview: An epic duel, on the battlefield and in Victoria's heart, pits Jack and Kirtash against each other for Idhun's future.

episodes.name: The Eye of The Serpent
episodes.overview: Ashran, the necromancer, unleashes Gerde, forcing Victoria, Jack and Alexander to fight for their lives. Victoria's grandmother reveals a secret.

episodes.name: Victoria's Light
episodes.overview: The unexpected return of a friend helps Jack understand his true self, and the fate he shares with Victoria.

episodes.name: A Flower for Mom
episodes.overview: All Bheem wants to do is chase a flower in the woods, but can he grab it before a hungry lion gets him?

episodes.name: Dancing Bheem
episodes.overview: When a dance show comes to town, Bheem can’t help but move to the music and make his way to center stage!

episodes.name: Spicy Surprise
episodes.overview: Bheem’s new playmate is twice his size, but he's jealous that Bheem is stronger -- and he plans a nasty prank.

episodes.name: Honey Bheem
episodes.overview: Bheem loves his first taste of honey, and so does his friend. Do the bees have enough for them both?

episodes.name: Mighty Hiccups
episodes.overview: When Bheem gets the hiccups, he and his monkey friend have a forest adventure to get rid of them.

episodes.name: Bheem's Blanket
episodes.overview: When Bheem’s blanket is used to steal a carriage, he takes the ride of his life to hunt down the thief.

episodes.name: Mighty Muscles
episodes.overview: A strongman amazes the town with his feats. How will he feel when Bheem easily upstages him?

episodes.name: A Babysitter's Nightmare
episodes.overview: Bheem’s new babysitter has many plans for playtime, but his animal friends may be too much for her!

episodes.name: Come Out and Play
episodes.overview: When Bheem and his buddy sneak out to play with a friendly elephant, things get very messy, very quickly!

episodes.name: Follow the Laddoos
episodes.overview: While Mom’s away, Bheem spies a trayful of his favorite laddoos. Will he get to them before she’s home?

episodes.name: Dirty Little Piggie
episodes.overview: Mom wants Bheem to bathe, but he has other things to do -- like keeping a pig from eating his snacks!

episodes.name: Mister Joker
episodes.overview: Inspired by the clown in town, Bheem is all too excited to try some impressive tricks of his own.

episodes.name: The King's Crown
episodes.overview: A thief has stolen the king’s crown, but Bheem won’t make it so easy for him to get away with it!

episodes.name: Bheem with a Beat
episodes.overview: Bheem’s new drum set is way too loud. But when Mom takes it away, he finds other ways to make music.

episodes.name: Mango Run
episodes.overview: Bheem and his pal get spotted by a hungry lion -- but Bheem has some funny ways to fend him off!

episodes.name: Doctor Bheem
episodes.overview: After a health checkup, Bheem wants to be a doctor himself. His patients? His animal pals, of course!

episodes.name: The Green Ball
episodes.overview: Bheem searches for his green ball in the woods, but what he finds is quite different from what he lost.

episodes.name: Gardening with Bheem
episodes.overview: While trying to help their mothers in the garden, Bheem and his friend stir up some innocent mischief.

episodes.name: Red Balloon
episodes.overview: Separated from Mom at the fair, Bheem keeps busy chasing balloons, enjoying laddoos and playing games.

episodes.name: A Big Ball of Yarn
episodes.overview: When a big ball of yarn creates havoc at home, will Bheem and his friend get tangled up in the mess?

episodes.name: Hats Off to Bheem
episodes.overview: Bheem finds a hat. But before he can claim it, he must face some tough competitors who want it, too.

episodes.name: Painting with Bheem
episodes.overview: Bheem begins monkeying around with mom's paint. But will it lead to a colorful mess -- or a work of art?

episodes.name: Mistaken Identities
episodes.overview: When Bheem is mistaken for a princess and kidnapped, he uses some tricks of his own to escape!

episodes.name: Birdie Bheem
episodes.overview: Bheem may not have wings, but he's in for a sky-high adventure when he encounters three eggs in a bird's nest.

episodes.name: The Swamp Thing
episodes.overview: A tumble into a swamp leaves Bheem covered in mud. Now a hunter thinks he's an exotic creature and wants to catch him!

episodes.name: The Lost Pup
episodes.overview: Titli is looking for her furry sidekick. But can Bheem help her find him before he gets to Mom's laundry.

episodes.name: Busy As A Bheem
episodes.overview: Bheem's out to retrieve Mom's precious necklace from a cheeky monkey -- and the job is anything but simple.

episodes.name: Rice Rice Baby
episodes.overview: Mom wants Bheem to wait with the babysitter while she shops for rice. But he's hardly one to sit for long!

episodes.name: Sticky Bheem
episodes.overview: Bheem's love for gooey treat gets him -- and a four-legged friend -- into quite the sticky situation.

episodes.name: Bheem Meets Bunty
episodes.overview: The small woodland animals don't want to play with Bunty, the big elephant. Can Bheem help them all be friends?

episodes.name: Kalia's Wagon Ride
episodes.overview: When Kalia gets a new wagon, Bheem takes him for a heart-pounding ride that neither of them will soon forget.

episodes.name: Disappearing Bheem
episodes.overview: When Bheem unexpectedly becomes a part of a magician's act, he adds a bit of his own chaos and comedy to the show.

episodes.name: Diaper Disaster
episodes.overview: Bheem must get creative to take his diaper back from a mischievous monkey, who won't return it so easily!

episodes.name: Kalia's Creepy Shed
episodes.overview: The toys and tricks inside a dark shed have Kalia terrified, but Bheem's having the time of his life!

episodes.name: Twin Trouble
episodes.overview: It's double trouble for Bheem when his doll gets swiped by a pair of twins. But can he show them how to share?

episodes.name: Bear Hug
episodes.overview: A mean hunter is out to capture a friendly bear -- unless Bheem can step in with his super strength!

episodes.name: Kalia's Birthday
episodes.overview: It's his buddy's birthday party, but Bheem has trouble parting with a gift he wants to keep for himself.

episodes.name: Bheem's Baby Owl
episodes.overview: Bheem's on a mission to help a young owl get safely back to his nest -- and his strategies are a hoot!

episodes.name: Bheem's Sick Day
episodes.overview: With everyone fussing over Bheem, who's sick in bed, an envious Kalia tries to attract some attention.

episodes.name: Let's Be Friends
episodes.overview: A big bully has intimidated all the kids. But does he really stand a chance against the ever-friendly Bheem?

episodes.name: Titli's Cooking Day
episodes.overview: Bheem and Kalia can't wait to taste what Titli's cooking up -- but will the wait be worth it in the end?

episodes.name: Caterpillar's Day Out
episodes.overview: Bheem is fascinated by a young caterpillar but must rescue it from becoming a hungry bird's lunch.

episodes.name: Bheem of Light
episodes.overview: Sleeping in the dark can be scary for Bheem. Can he create a night light that will calm all his fears?

episodes.name: Off On A Ride
episodes.overview: An evil bandit is scheming to capture a horse, but Bheem -- and an angry cow -- won't make it easy!

episodes.name: Bheem Takes the Cake
episodes.overview: When Bheem and Kalia are left alone with some cake batter, will they stir up something delicious -- or disastrous?

episodes.name: The Bull Fighter
episodes.overview: It's Bheem against an angry bull. But he isn't interested in fighting; he just wants to have some fun!

episodes.name: Sleep Crawling
episodes.overview: It may be naptime, but from riding unicorns to battling sea creatures, Bheem's having a wild adventure in his dreams!

episodes.name: Bheem's Masterpiece
episodes.overview: Bheem and Kalia break a sculpture that's meant for an important guest. Will their quick fix be a wreck ... or a piece of art?

episodes.name: A Birthday Surprise
episodes.overview: A lion is scheming to trap Bheem for his next meal. Little does he know, Bheem's got better plans!

episodes.name: A Dogsitter’s Nightmare
episodes.overview: When his babysitter falls asleep, Bheem befriends an adorable pup ... but this pooch is even more mischievous than he is!

episodes.name: Kalia vs Scarecrow
episodes.overview: Kalia believes that a scarecrow has eaten Bheem! Can he set his fears aside to battle the straw-stuffed enemy?

episodes.name: Bheem's New Tooth
episodes.overview: What’s the best teething toy for a baby with the strength of a Titan? Bheem’s babysitter is about to find out!

episodes.name: Kalia and the Carrots
episodes.overview: When a hungry Kalia refuses to eat a healthy snack, Bheem tries to convince him to give it a try.

episodes.name: A Day with a Peacock
episodes.overview: A beautiful peacock has had one of her most important feathers stolen! Now it’s up to Bheem to retrieve it — or replace it.

episodes.name: Tiger Trouble
episodes.overview: Bheem comes to the aid of a baby tiger stuck in a tree, but is he prepared for the cub’s much larger parent?

episodes.name: Bheem’s Monsoon Monday
episodes.overview: Bheem will do anything to keep the monsoon rain clouds away. But maybe they're not so bad after all.

episodes.name: Titli’s Arts and Crafts Day
episodes.overview: While playing with Titli’s bottle of glue, Bheem causes a sticky mess — then gets a smart idea!

episodes.name: Grand Indian Wedding
episodes.overview: As friends celebrate a wedding, a jealous Bheem is anything but pleased and will stop at nothing to wreak havoc at the event!

episodes.name: A Day at the Marketplace
episodes.overview: From loading trucks to taming angry chickens, Bheem’s superhuman strength and quick thinking come in handy at the market.

episodes.name: Bheem at the Playground
episodes.overview: Kalia won’t let any animal friends into the new park. Can Bheem show him that playtime is for everyone?

episodes.name: A Trip to the Moon
episodes.overview: A game of catch with the moon turns into a magical overnight adventure as Bheem heads to the skies to meet his new playmate!

episodes.name: Buttery Bheem
episodes.overview: An accidental fall into a block of greasy butter sends Bheem slipping and sliding into some unexpected fun!

episodes.name: Kalia the Wrestler
episodes.overview: When Kalia faces a much larger opponent at a wrestling match, Bheem steps into the ring to lend a helping hand.

episodes.name: Bheem’s Snow Day
episodes.overview: On a snowy winter day, Bheem helps a jolly visitor out of a tough spot — and learns that dreams really can come true.

seasons.name: Arthdal Chronicles
seasons.overview: Arthdal Chronicles depicts the birth of civilization and nations in ancient times. It is a story of mythical heroes, their struggle, unity and love of people living in a virtual land called Arth. The storyline of Arthdal Chronicles is centered around the anci…

episodes.name: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy I
episodes.overview: Sanung and the Saram propose an alliance with the blue-eyed Neanthal, but when things don’t go as expected, Tagon takes command of the Great Hunt.

episodes.name: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy II
episodes.overview: The villagers cast suspicion on Eunseom upon learning that he has dreams. Tanya questions her destiny. Tagon greets his men in an unlikely place.

episodes.name: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy III
episodes.overview: Upon finding Doti, Eunseom devises a plan to rescue the Wahan and is dismayed to learn the significance of Igutu - and what this means for him.

episodes.name: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy IV
episodes.overview: Eunseom and Doti run into a familiar face in Arthdal and make an alarming discovery. Sanung grows suspicious of his son. Tanya stands up for her tribe.

episodes.name: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy V
episodes.overview: As Tagon’s declaration ripples through Arthdal, Eunseom contemplates the significance of what he saw. Mubaek seeks advice and is given a quest.

episodes.name: Part 1: The Children of Prophecy VI
episodes.overview: Taealha counsels Tagon about the impending meeting with Eunseom. Mihol tries to persuade Asa Ron to expose the truth. Tanya sees a mystifying vision.

episodes.name: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land I
episodes.overview: After a chance encounter, Tanya starts to grasp the meaning of the dream. Tagon’s plan upsets Taealha. Mubaek learns something astounding about Eunseom.

episodes.name: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land II
episodes.overview: Saya has chilling words for Taealha. Tagon strengthens his grip over Arthdal. Tanya receives news of Eunseom and wonders what Saya’s dreams might mean.

episodes.name: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land III
episodes.overview: Tanya proposes an alliance with Saya that proves to be useful for them both, Eunseom refuses to deny who he is, and ominous signs appear in Arthdal.

episodes.name: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land IV
episodes.overview: Tagon visits Tanya and asks about the Wahan. After hearing about Tanya's dreams, Saya decides to tell her his story. Mubaek comes across something odd.

episodes.name: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land V
episodes.overview: Harim makes a startling confession to Mubaek. Chaeeun goes to see Tanya and tells her the truth about Eunseom. Mihol offers Taealha a way out.

episodes.name: Part 2: The Sky Turning Inside Out, Rising Land VI
episodes.overview: Tagon becomes enraged when he discovers Mihol is behind Tanya’s abduction, and the two later meet to discuss her fate. Eunseom orchestrates an escape.

episodes.name: Part 3: Arth, the Prelude to All Legends I
episodes.overview: Tanya becomes overwhelmed by Arthdal’s reception of her new role, and demands that Taealha and Tagon keep their end of the bargain.

episodes.name: Part 3: Arth, the Prelude to All Legends II
episodes.overview: Mihol informs Tagon about the finer points of being a king. Saya’s appearance bewilders the Wahan. Eunseom receives help from the Neanthal.

episodes.name: Part 3: Arth, the Prelude to All Legends III
episodes.overview: Surviving in Arthdal means knowing how to choose the side that holds power. Taealha is attacked, and Tagon silences those who’ve uncovered his secret.

episodes.name: Part 3: Arth, the Prelude to All Legends IV
episodes.overview: Tanya tries to uphold the ways of the Wahan but is dismayed to find that they have changed. Tagon’s guards make a gruesome discovery.

episodes.name: Part 3: Arth, the Prelude to All Legends V
episodes.overview: Eunseom wrestles with a proposition and ponders how he’ll find Tanya. Saya plots a strategy for Tagon to be king. Mihol gives Taealha a stern warning.

episodes.name: Part 3: Arth, the Prelude to All Legends VI
episodes.overview: Tanya receives word of the Wahan and meets someone who’s seen Eunseom. Saya grows increasingly leery of those around him. Tagon gets what he wants.

seasons.name: The Sword of Aramun
seasons.overview: The second season of 'Arthdal Chronicles', a drama that unfolds depicting the fateful tales of Tagon, Eunseom, Tanya, and Taealha, who inscribe diverse legends in the ancient land of Arth. In this new season, the story is set in a world that takes place appro…

episodes.name: Weak Ones
episodes.overview: Eight years has passed since Tagon took the throne as the second coming of Aramun. Eunseom succeeded in uniting the Ago clans as the second coming of Inaishingi and he leads them to the great war against Arthdal. Meanwhile, Saya must prove his worth to succee…

episodes.name: War of Twins
episodes.overview: The first battle between Arthdal, led by Saya, and the united Ago forces, led by Eunseom, takes place in Hanchoa. Eunseom and the Ago forces gets overwhelmed by Arthdal's military power. Meanwhile, Tagon realizes the elevated status of Tanya as the second com…

episodes.name: Wahan's Lover
episodes.overview: The united Ago forces faces an unforeseen situation, causing anxiety among its leadership that the alliance, which has been unified for 200 years, may fall apart. Meanwhile, Tanya is confronted with a truly incredible situation.

episodes.name: Purple Blood
episodes.overview: Prince Arok, the son of Tagon and Taealha, is abducted, and the Arthdal Palace is in an uproar. Meanwhile, someone approaches Tanya and leads her to a place that has been kept secret for a long time.

episodes.name: The Sword of Aramun
episodes.overview: The last prophecy by Aramun is announced. Eunseom, Tanya, and Saya try to figure out what it means!

episodes.name: Fake Inaishingi
episodes.overview: Saya tries to take over the Ago Union. Tanya sets a great plan in motion, and Taealha gets closer to the truth. With Tagon's orders, Arthdal faces a new crisis.

episodes.name: Ikomahis
episodes.overview: Eunseom finds an unexpected breakthrough in despair. Saya's plan envelops Arthdal in fear.

episodes.name: The Strongest Creature in the World
episodes.overview: They need to stop Tagon. A brutal night falls on Arthdal. Eunseom advances close to Arthdal.

episodes.name: Remember My Face
episodes.overview: The day of Tagon and Eunseom's battle comes. Tagon faces a shocking truth.

episodes.name: Whirlwind Fire
episodes.overview: Eunseom's Ago Union and Tagon's Arthdal have the final battle in the Arth Forest.

episodes.name: Heroines
episodes.overview: Tanya who wants to change Arthdal's owner and Taealha who wants to protect Arthdal fight.

episodes.name: Arthdal Chronicles
episodes.overview: The final battle between the Ago Union and Arthdal has come. Tagon prepares for a personal war. Tanya, Taealha, Saya, and Eunseom make one final move to protect what's most precious to them. Who will take over Arthdal?

episodes.name: Renew My Contract
episodes.overview: Jung Gal-hee is a diligent secretary to her boss Do Min-ik who is hoping to become CEO. Min-ik has one rule: he only keeps a secretary for one year before replacing her. Gal-hui works to convince him to renew her contract.

episodes.name: Director Do, Are You Okay?
episodes.overview: After getting fired, Gal-hee and the other secretaries are prepared to give Min-ik a piece of their minds. CEO Sim starts to turn board members against Min-ik. Min-ik is attacked and is dealt a devastating fall.

episodes.name: Director Do's Prosopagnosia
episodes.overview: While suffering from face blindness, Min-ik realises that the only face he can see is Gal-hee's. Min-ik asks Gal-hee to help him navigate his new life and continue to be his secretary until the CEO election.

episodes.name: Secretary Jeong's Holiday
episodes.overview: Min-ik tries to convince Gal-hee to return as his secretary, offering her a permanent contract. Gal-hee takes time off to decide while Min-ik works with the police to discover who attacked him and why.

episodes.name: Jeong Gal Hee Back at Your Service
episodes.overview: Gal Hee starts her work as secretary of Do Min Ik once again, but under better working conditions. Meanwhile, Min Ik decides to call off the investigation regarding his attack. Min Ik also decides to go on a blind date with the famed movie titan, Veronica Par…

episodes.name: Veronica Park and Director Do
episodes.overview: Min Ik comes up with a way to start recognizing people without knowing their faces by compiling data of the physical features of each person. He is scheduled to go on a blind date with the famed movie titan, Veronica Park but misinformation leads to them arri…

episodes.name: Gal Hee and Director Do

episodes.overview: After the meeting, Jung Gal-Hee leaves her job and visits her sister's performance along with her brother. Meanwhile, Do Min-Ik regrets letting Gal-Hee go and plans on treating her to a meal. But seeing her with a man he can't recognize, he feels jealous and…

episodes.name: Min Ik with the Jeong Family
episodes.overview: Jung Gal-Hee and Do Min-Ik take a day off work to spend some time together and go on a date, but Gal-Hee's siblings get in the way of their date plans. Eventually, they have no chance but to spend the night at the beach along with her siblings.

episodes.overview: Jung Gal-Hee feels conflicted as her fellow secretaries start up a protest against the company leadership. Eventually, she sides with them and joins in on the fasting. Worried about Gal-Hee's health, Do Min-Ik gives up his CEO application to allow a negotiati…

episodes.overview: When Jung Gal-Hee finds out that Do Min-Ik had given up his application to become CEO, she feels somewhat responsible and is upset. But he later reveals that he had convinced Ki Dae-Joo into running for the position. Eventually, Ki Dae-Joo becomes the CEO of…

episodes.overview: Do Min-Ik misinterprets his doctor and believes that an intimate night with his girlfriend would bring his heartbeat up. Later, he gets stuck in an elevator and when he does get out, his facial vision is temporarily restored. He uses this chance to see Gal-He…

seasons.overview: Thorfinn pursues a journey with his father's killer in order to take revenge and end his life in a duel as an honorable warrior and pay his father a homage.

episodes.name: Somewhere Not Here
episodes.overview: Thorfinn, a boy living in Iceland, longs for adventure and is eager to know more about the world. He dreams of a land of paradise called Vinland that he hears about from the adventurer Leif, while he leads his peaceful life with this father Thors, a former wa…

episodes.overview: In the year 1002, the war between England and Denmark was intensifying. One day, the Jomsvikings pay a visit to Thorfinn's village in order to bring back Thors, their former commander, to prepare for the impending battle. Thors is forced to join the war in or…

episodes.name: Troll
episodes.overview: Askeladd, the leader of a Viking army of a hundred men, receives orders from Floki of the Jomsvikings to kill Thors, who was once known as the Troll of Jom. However, the villagers, completely unaware of the order, buzz with excitement as they prepare for thei…

episodes.name: A True Warrior
episodes.overview: Thors and his men fall for Askeladd's trap and faces a dangerous situation, but Thors defeats many of Askeladd's men with his overpowering strength. However, Thors knows that it will be difficult to save everyone, including his son, who've been living in a pe…

episodes.name: The Troll's Son
episodes.overview: After Askeladd kills Thorfinn's father Thors, Thorfinn hides inside Thor's ship and bides his time until the opportunity to take revenge. However, life on the ship is harsh without any food or water, and Thorfinn grows weaker day by day. One day, Thorfinn, ar…

episodes.name: The Journey Begins
episodes.overview: Thorfinn kills his first man. As more time goes on Thorfinn kills more men and becomes more skilled. One day when Thorfinn is in battle he gets shot with an arrow and ends up unconscious. An English woman and her daughter help him recover.

episodes.name: Normanni
episodes.overview: Askeladd withdraws temporarily from the war against England. While searching for a new source of income, he encounters a skirmish among the Franks and hatches a plot to steal their treasure. Askeladd sends 16 years old Thorfinn, who has grown up into a cold-h…

episodes.name: Beyond the Edge of the Sea
episodes.overview: After capturing the treasure from the Franks, Askeladd's men return to the village of Gorm on the Jutland Peninsula in Denmark to pass the winter. Thorfinn challenges Askeladd to a duel as a reward for bringing him the head of the captain of the clan of Frank…

episodes.name: The Battle of London Bridge
episodes.overview: In October 1013, King Sweyn leads a fleet of Danish and Viking ships in an attempt to take London Bridge of England. Askeladd's army, hired by the army of Denmark, was among them. However, after the betrayal of Thorkell the Tall, a Viking known for his overpo…

episodes.name: Ragnarok
episodes.overview: Askeladd's army separates from the army of Denmark and attacks a village 100 km to the west. Thorfinn leaves the soldiers behind in disgust and climbs up a hill overlooking the village, where he pledges revenge for his father. However, he encounters Askeladd…

episodes.name: A Gamble
episodes.overview: Thorkell takes Canute hostage and follows after the main army of Denmark. Ragnar objects to Thorkell’s plan to take on the entire army of Denmark, boasting 16,000 soldiers, with only 500 men. Thorkell then begins to tell Ragnar the story of Valhalla, the prid…

episodes.name: The Land on the Far Bank
episodes.overview: Askeladd and his men continue their march to escape from Thorkell. However, their march comes to a halt at the Severn River. Askeladd hands a letter to an old man operating a ferry across the river and tells him to deliver the letter to the other side immedia…

episodes.overview: Askeladd crosses the river and escapes from Thorkell into Wales with Canute. However, Askeladd’s men are ambushed by a group of soldiers hiding behind the boulders at the border of the kingdom of Brycheiniog. Askeladd attempts to negotiate with their messenge…

episodes.name: The Light of Dawn
episodes.overview: Askeladd and his men change course and decide to return to Gainsborough, by crossing through the Earldom of Mercia in the midst of a harsh snowstorm, where the main army of Denmark awaits. The men spot a small village in the blizzard and make their move.

episodes.name: After Yule
episodes.overview: After losing Canute, Thorkell decides to halt his advance in central England. Thorkell hears that the end of the war between Denmark and England is near, and bemoans the end of the war. However, he later gets wind of an interesting piece of news.

episodes.name: History of Beasts
episodes.overview: Askeladd and his men are attacked by the English army in the village where they had planned to camp during the winter. Askeladd captures their captain and interrogates him to find out how the English knew where they were, and discovers that Thorkell is fast a…

episodes.name: Servant
episodes.overview: Askeladd's men continued their march to escape Thorkell. However, Torgrim and his friends were hatching a plot to switch sides and join Thorkell, taking Canute with them. Torgrim finally launches his rebellion and corners Askeladd, negotiating with him to han…

episodes.name: Out of the Cradle
episodes.overview: Thorfinn and Thorkell agree to have a duel over the fate of Askeladd. Thorkell looks forward to facing off against Thors’s son, Thorfinn, and asks him what a true warrior really is. Meanwhile, Canute is suddenly ambushed while he attempts to escape, and has a…

episodes.overview: Thorfinn suffers a serious injury in his fight against Thorkell. Thorfinn is told to think about what he has to do to beat Thorkell. Askeladd treats Thorfinn’s wounds so that he may fight again someday, and proposes a joint strategy to help the two of them su…

episodes.name: Crown
episodes.overview: After the fighting dies down, Canute takes in Askeladd and Thorkell as his followers, and returns to Gainsborough. Canute goes through an awakening when he realizes the meaning of love in the aftermath of Ragnar’s death. Canute throws away what little feeling…

episodes.name: Reunion
episodes.overview: Canute’s party arrives in York to attend the Imperial Council. Although Canute had wanted to strike out against King Sweyn, the King was being guarded by the most powerful Jomsviking unit in the Northern Sea while keeping a close eye on Canute. With the situa…

episodes.name: Lone Wolf
episodes.overview: Thorfinn begins his duel against Askeladd with Canute and Thorkell as witnesses. However, Thorfinn is unable to strike as he stands overwhelmed by the extraordinary mood that overtakes Askeladd after Bjorn's departure. Having noticed Thorfinn's hesitation, As…

episodes.name: Miscalculation
episodes.overview: After the assassination attempt on Canute’s life, rumors spread through York saying that the king is trying to kill Canute. As a result, the king is unable to issue any orders that would put Canute in harm, and Askeladd is pleased that everything is proceedin…

episodes.name: End of the Prologue
episodes.overview: Askeladd comes forth before King Sweyn and implores him to halt his invasion of Wales. Meanwhile, Thorfinn decides to return home at Leif’s urging. However, the moment before he boards the ship, Thorfinn catches a glimpse of a single tern taking off into the…

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: As a new millennium dawns, Thorfinn struggles to find meaning in his life. Meanwhile, the new King of England seeks to expand his territory.

episodes.name: Slave
episodes.overview: Einar lives peacefully in northern England with his mother and sister, but then one day, their village comes under attack.

episodes.name: Ketil's Farm
episodes.overview: Einar and Thorfinn are told to convert a wild forest into a wheat field; and if they succeed, they will have the chance to buy their own freedom.

episodes.name: Snake
episodes.overview: The farm guards convince Ketil’s 17-year-old son that he needs to make his first killing to become a man.

episodes.name: Awakening
episodes.overview: After everything that happened, Einar asks Thorfinn if he's ever fought in a war — and if he's ever killed a man.

episodes.name: Path of Blood
episodes.overview: After the sudden turn of events, young Canute must rise up to claim the throne to a kingdom much reduced and under attack.

episodes.name: We Need a Horse
episodes.overview: Thorfinn and Einar are working themselves to the bone to clear the forest, but there's only so much they can do without the help of horses.

episodes.name: Iron Fist Ketil
episodes.overview: Thieves have been stealing food from Ketil's farm. Meanwhile, Ketil's eldest son Thorgil returns home.

episodes.name: An Empty Man
episodes.overview: Thorfinn has nightmares almost every night, but he can never remember what he dreamed about — and that bothers him.

episodes.name: Oath
episodes.overview: Thorfinn wakes up in a peaceful place and he sees his father again. But then things quickly turn dark, and Thorfinn must face his painful past.

episodes.name: The Cursed Head
episodes.overview: Finally, after three long years, Einar and Thorfinn chop down the final tree in the forest. With hope in their hearts, they talk about the future.

episodes.name: Kings and Swords
episodes.overview: While in Jelling, Ketil, Thorgil and Olmar meet a man named Leif Erikson who is searching for Thorfinn, the son of his close friend.

episodes.name: For Lost Love
episodes.overview: Olmar feels insulted by Canute's messenger and, encouraged by his older brother Thorgil, takes matters into his own hands.

episodes.name: Dark Clouds
episodes.overview: Einar says that even if he gains his freedom, he wants to stay near Arnheid. Snake hears news of a slave who killed his owners, and is now on the run.

episodes.name: Freedom
episodes.overview: A runaway slave appears on Ketil's farm, claiming to be Arnheid's husband. But before he can free her, he's confronted by Snake.

episodes.name: Storm
episodes.overview: Arnheid comes to the fortress where Gardar is imprisoned. She wants to see her husband and treat his injuries.

episodes.name: Great Purpose
episodes.overview: As Snake intensifies his search, Arnheid tells Einar and Thorfinn everything she's done. Knowing the risks, Einar and Thorfinn offer to help her.

episodes.name: The Road Home
episodes.overview: Snake strikes quickly, surprising Thorfinn with his speed and agility. As he lies wounded, Gardar thinks back on the life he shared with Arnheid.

episodes.name: The First Method
episodes.overview: After returning home to his farm, an exhausted Ketil starts searching for Arnheid, only to find out what happened in his absence.

episodes.name: The Battle of Ketil's Farm
episodes.overview: Amidst the confusion of a peasant uprising, Thorfinn and the others try to escape, carrying a severely injured and pregnant Arnheid.

episodes.name: Pain
episodes.overview: As Thorfinn and Einar head for their escape, Arnheid regains consciousness and asks where they are going — and if there are slaves and wars there, too.

episodes.name: Courage
episodes.overview: The battle has left heartbreaking casualties in its wake. Though Thorgil and Ketil's wife want to continue the fight, Canute demands their surrender.

episodes.name: The King of Rebellion
episodes.overview: Snake tries to put a stop to it, but Thorfinn insists on receiving all 100 blows from Canute's brutish guard Drott, shocking the rowdy onlookers.

episodes.name: Two Paths
episodes.overview: Thorfinn and Einar have said their piece, but Canute stubbornly refuses to give up Ketil's Farm. Then, Thorfinn breaks the standoff with a decision.

episodes.name: Home
episodes.overview: At long last, Thorfinn returns to Iceland and finds a moment of happiness, reunited with his loved ones. But soon, he opens up about his next journey.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In a city of coaching centers known to train India’s finest collegiate minds, an earnest but unexceptional student and his friends navigate campus life.

episodes.name: Inventory
episodes.overview: Hoping to pass the IIT entrance exams, teen Vaibhav arrives in Kota with one goal: to nab a seat at the best coaching center in the city.

episodes.name: Assembly Line
episodes.overview: Canteen food, insomnia and studying weigh on Vaibhav, but when his friends’ tips don’t help, Professor Jeetu offers his campus-life survival strategies.

episodes.name: Optimization
episodes.overview: Struggling with Inorganic Chemistry, Vaibhav plots to have his instructor replaced, but his problem with the subject may not be the person teaching it.

episodes.name: Shutdown
episodes.overview: Given several days off before exams begin, Vaibhav, Meena and Uday each use the revision period to pursue romantic possibilities, with mixed results.

episodes.name: Overhaul
episodes.overview: Standing at a crossroads in his academic journey, Vaibhav is torn between his heart and his mind before making a big decision about his next steps.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Continuing their pursuit of a coveted IIT seat, Vaibhav and his friends try not to let academic pressure — or adolescent angst — get the best of them.

episodes.name: Reasoning
episodes.overview: With their new classes off to a bleak start, Vaibhav and his peers question the value of the IIT dream and seek inspiration from a trusted source.

episodes.name: Control System
episodes.overview: Struggling with Physics, Vaibhav attempts to bend the rules to attend Jeetu’s classes. Meena frets that teenage hormones will get the best of him.

episodes.name: Atmospheric Pressure
episodes.overview: Jeetu searches for staff for his institute, making some reluctant choices along the way. Filled with self-doubt, Vartika evades practice tests at Aimers.

episodes.name: Repair & Maintenance
episodes.overview: When a bout of jaundice slows Vaibhav down in his studying, Jeetu insists he calls his only hope to get well quickly: his mother.

episodes.name: Packaging
episodes.overview: JEE results send Kota into celebration mode and give Vaibhav, Meena and Uday glimpses into their own futures, but the occasion comes with sad truths.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: As the all-important exam nears, Jeetu and the students face an uphill challenge with ambition, loss and grueling pressure taking their toll.

episodes.name: Mission Statement
episodes.overview: Jeetu struggles to cope with the loss of a student. Vaibhav doubts his own path to success when his cricket-playing cousin visits Kota.

episodes.name: Fault Mitigation
episodes.overview: Facing financial stress, Meena begins tutoring an eager student to earn extra cash. Vaibhav's attitude forces Vartika to find a new study partner.

episodes.name: Benchmarking
episodes.overview: A clash with Gagan causes Jeetu to spiral. Shivangi feels the strain of the NEET prep, while Vaibhav and Meena compete for ranks in a test series.

episodes.name: Emergency Response
episodes.overview: Jeetu receives an offer that affects the future of Aimers. Uday’s error in judgment leads to serious trouble. Exam pressure takes its toll on Vaibhav.

episodes.name: Product Delivery
episodes.overview: Prayers and prep take hold as the final countdown to the exam approaches. Jeetu makes a startling announcement to his students.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In a world where an app alerts people if someone in the vicinity likes them, Kim Jojo experiences young love while coping with personal adversities.

episodes.name: The Flash of Lightning Before It Thunders
episodes.overview: Unlike her friends, Kim Jojo has more pressing things on her mind than dating. Upon returning from abroad, Hwang Sun-oh goes to see Lee Hye-yeong.

episodes.name: There’s Nothing Anyone Can Do When You Like Someone
episodes.overview: Sun-oh wants to know whether Hye-yeong has feelings for Jojo and tells him what he did. Jang Il-sik gets into a fight with Sun-oh and Hye-yeong.

episodes.name: The Miracle of Two People Liking Each Other
episodes.overview: Jojo confronts Sun-oh about the photos. As rumors spread at school, Jang-go gets mad at Jojo for lying. Il-sik confronts Jang-go about what she did.

episodes.name: The Best Feeling in the World Is Knowing There’s Someone on My Side
episodes.overview: Sun-oh asks Jojo about the school trip and realizes there’s not much he can do for her. Il-sik tells Jang-go something she doesn’t want to hear.

episodes.name: The Gravity of Liking Someone
episodes.overview: Jojo tells Sun-oh about her parents and makes a surprising suggestion. She later confronts Jang-go after overhearing something.

episodes.name: Your Heart Is Safe Now
episodes.overview: News of the tragedy hits the airwaves. Hye-yeong finds Jojo at the library and informs her that he plans to court her the old-fashioned way.

episodes.name: Something I’ve Been Holding Back and Can Only Say to You
episodes.overview: Jojo tries to put a shield around herself and tells Hye-yeong she doesn’t need his help, but he offers to take her somewhere special.

episodes.name: One Is Bigger Than Any Other Number in the World
episodes.overview: Jojo ponders what it means to like someone and realizes a shield may not be necessary. Sun-oh wants to know whether she still has feelings for him.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Longing for resounding proof of her feelings, Jojo sets out to uninstall the shield and make the app ring for her one true love.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Curious about her true feelings for Hye-yeong, Jojo returns to her alma mater in search of information on Chon Duk-gu — and runs into her past.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Jojo asks Brian Chon about the shield at an event attended by the Badge Club members, including Sun-oh. Hye-yeong comes face-to-face with his father.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Jojo offers Hye-yeong a shoulder to cry on after a punishing day. Unable to cope with knowledge of the shield, Sun-oh turns to Jojo for the truth.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: With video of his lecture hall visit gone viral, Sun-oh comes to blows with Hye-yeong. Jojo receives a special gift from an unknown sender.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Park Gul-mi reaches a digital milestone. Brian grills Jojo about the shield, spear and Duk-gu — and shatters reality for a bystanding listener.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Revealing the identity and inspiration behind The Ringing World, Jojo reconciles with the past. Duk-gu keeps his end of the bargain.

seasons.name: Season 1

episodes.overview: Tae-jun contends with a rival staff member. Yun Hye-won volunteers to talk to a key witness. Kang Seon-yeong becomes concerned about Lee Seong-min.
