episodes.name: Dilemma
episodes.overview: Tae-jun grapples with a dilemma. Song Hui-seop’s impatience grows as Seon-yeong shifts her strategy. Do-gyeong asks Hye-won a delicate question.

episodes.name: Firelight
episodes.overview: Tae-jun and Seon-yeong enjoy an evening out together, but soon find that someone knows about them. News of a factory worker’s death alarms Do-gyeong.

episodes.name: Knot
episodes.overview: Hui-seop invites Seong-min to join his party. Seon-yeong gives Tae-jun a stern warning, but he doesn’t waver. Do-gyeong makes a costly misstep.

episodes.name: Decapitation
episodes.overview: As the confirmation hearing gets underway, Tae-jun is caught off guard by Hui-seop’s self-serving machinations and scrambles to survive.

episodes.name: 6g's Price
episodes.overview: Tae-jun struggles with the ramifications of Seong-min’s decision. Do-gyeong has information that may help Tae-jun. Won-sik grows suspicious of Hye-won.

episodes.name: Irreducible
episodes.overview: Seon-yeong’s career is in peril, rumors unsettle Won-sik, Do-gyeong returns to the team, and Tae-jun determines to go down a path that he may regret.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The real political players behind the spotlight take a dangerous gamble. Super Adviser Jang Tae Joon heads towards the peak of power and fiercely struggles for survival. Jang Tae Joon worked as the chief aide to Lawmaker Lawmaker Song Hee Sub. He now returns…

episodes.name: Breakaway
episodes.overview: With eyes on the target, Tae-jun sets the wheels in motion. Seon-yeong looks into a suspicious death, and sees Lee Ji-eun return as her chief of staff.

episodes.name: Poisonous Fang
episodes.overview: Seon-yeong requests the truth from Tae-jun, and joins forces with him to go after Lee Chang-jin. Hui-seop deals with a betrayal.

episodes.name: Swamp
episodes.overview: Shaken up by Chang-jin's tactics, Seon-yeong and Tae-jun search for more evidence against him. Choe Gyeong-cheol launches an investigation.

episodes.name: Achilles Tendon
episodes.overview: A scandal threatens to derail Tae-jun. Gyeong-cheol stays out of Hui-seop's political plays. Seon-yeong puts Joojin Chemical under further scrutiny.

episodes.name: Shadow
episodes.overview: Things seem to be back on track for Seon-yeong and Tae-jun as they prepare for the parliamentary inquiry. Feeling the heat, Hui-seop retaliates.

episodes.name: Maze
episodes.overview: While Tae-jun works on a new plan to turn Chang-jin and Hui-seop against each other, Yun Hye-won and Han Do-gyeong try to pin down a mole.

episodes.name: Scapegoat
episodes.overview: Needing more information on Hui-seop's slush funds, Tae-jun and Seon-yeong place Oh Won-sik in a sticky situation.

episodes.name: Hunt
episodes.overview: Knowing the consequences, Seon-yeong holds a press conference. Hui-seop treads on thin ice with Sung Yeong-gi. Won-sik runs out of options.

episodes.name: Hibernation
episodes.overview: Vowing to finish what Tae-jun started, Seon-yeong pushes for a special probe into the slush funds, but Hui-seop tries to stop her.

episodes.name: Weight of 6 Grams
episodes.overview: While Hui-seop does whatever he must to save himself, Tae-jun, Seon-yeong and their staff get ready for his hearing. Gyeong-cheol seeks justice.

episodes.name: NO NOISE NO LIFE - Sustainable War
episodes.overview: The United States, 2045. Working as mercenaries, the Major and her team, including newbie Stan, defend a gated town from outlaws. Togusa takes a call.

episodes.name: AT YOUR OWN RISK - Divided by a Wall
episodes.overview: Armed by a generous patron, the Nomads attack Section 9 with AI drones. Togusa accepts a new mission from Japan's peace-seeking Prime Minister.

episodes.name: MAVERICK - MIA
episodes.overview: As Togusa dives into cyberspace to track his former team members, the group is detained by a mysterious American organization seeking to employ them.

episodes.name: SACRIFICIAL PAWN - Emissary from the Divide
episodes.overview: While researching the team's disappearance and John Smith, Togusa takes a calculated risk. The GHOST members question the true nature of their mission.

episodes.name: PATRICK HUGE - Gift from God
episodes.overview: Aramaki sets off after Kusanagi in a race against time. GHOST begin their assignment, but Huge's cybernetic security forces them to alter their plans.

episodes.name: DISCLOSURE - Quantized Gospel
episodes.overview: Following the Section 9 reunion, Kusanagi and her colleagues learn about the "post-humans," a previously unknown threat to humanity.

episodes.name: PIE IN THE SKY - First Bank Robbery
episodes.overview: Back in Japan after six years, Batou decides to take a break while waiting for his delayed team. Then some amateur bank robbers interrupt his fun.

episodes.name: ASSEMBLE - What Came About as a Result of Togusa’s Death
episodes.overview: The Major and Smith clash over Section 9's new mission hunting post-humans. She orders Togusa to investigate a suspected spy near the Prime Minister.

episodes.name: IDENTITY THEFT - The Lonely Struggle
episodes.overview: Problems arise for Section 9 after one of the three post-humans in Japan murders several politicians, then targets the Prime Minister's father-in-law.

episodes.name: NET PEOPLE - Reasons Leading to Flameout
episodes.overview: Section 9 investigates a possible post-human hacker who uses the web to incite physical attacks on people. The trail leads to a high school student.

episodes.name: EDGELORD - The Revolution of the 14-year-olds
episodes.overview: Pudding helps analyze the Thinkpol program while the Major and Togusa search for clues about the post-human middle school student Takashi Shimamura.

episodes.name: NOSTALGIA - All Will Become N
episodes.overview: Togusa has a strange episode while analyzing the data confiscated from Shimamura. When he wakes up, he and Batou head out to investigate.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: After tracking down a source in California, Major Motoko Kusanagi and the Section 9 crew head back to Tokyo as the posthuman threat grows bolder.

episodes.name: DOMINO EFFECT / Silly Kukushkin
episodes.overview: Members of Section 9 seek out a man named Philip Kukushkin, a Russian national who seems to know a lot about the creation of posthumans.

episodes.name: CLOSE CALL / I've Awoken
episodes.overview: US special operations forces join the Section 9 team in their fight against a relentless posthuman named Suzuka Mizukane.

episodes.name: FACTOR / 1A84
episodes.overview: While extracting information from Kukushkin, the Section 9 team uncovers some shocking information about an AI program developed by the US government.

episodes.name: MEMORIES / Born in Heaven
episodes.overview: Worried Purin might be a spy for the Americans, the Major sends out a crew of Tachikoma to look into her hidden past.

episodes.name: ROOM 101 / Man's Search for Meaning
episodes.overview: Togusa finally realizes that he's been trapped in his own memories — and suddenly finds himself in a devastated Tokyo in the year 2045.

episodes.name: N-POWER / How to Build an Independent Nation
episodes.overview: After hearing from Togusa, Batou and the others head to Tokyo. Back in Fukuoka, the Major learns that a posthuman has hijacked a nuclear submarine.

episodes.name: TRUTH POINT OF CONTACT / Bridge of Promise
episodes.overview: Resurrected as a full-body prosthetic cyborg, Purin tries to hitchhike her way to Tokyo. US special operations forces face Mizukane's wrath.

episodes.name: DEMI DEUS / Those Who Evolve Toward Divinity
episodes.overview: Batou and the group get an update on the posthuman situation from Standard. The Major and Purin join the rest of the crew in Tokyo.

episodes.name: LAST RESORT / A Long Slumber
episodes.overview: To take back control of the hijacked nuclear submarine, the Section 9 team targets Mizukane and Takashi Shimamura.

episodes.name: OPERATION STANDOFF / The Battle Begins
episodes.overview: Shimamura wakes up and makes a desperate move, putting Kusanagi and her crew in an impossible position.

episodes.name: DOOMSDAY / The Moon over the Ruined Castle
episodes.overview: Kusanagi and her team do everything they can to stop the US from implementing their draconian plan to end the nuclear standoff with "N."

episodes.name: DOUBLE THINK / Event Boundary
episodes.overview: The Section 9 crew start living their regular lives as if nothing ever happened — and the only one who finds it strange is Kusanagi.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A misunderstood loner is drawn out of his shell after transferring to another high school, where he comes across new ordeals -- and first love.

episodes.name: The Nameless Kid, Choe Jun-u
episodes.overview: Not long after arriving at a new high school, where he's shown around by star student Ma Hwi-yeong, Choe Jun-u faces an unfair accusation.

episodes.name: A Moment I Want to Run Away
episodes.overview: Jun-u prepares to transfer schools again. Yu Su-bin doesn't believe Jun-u took the watch. Hwi-yeong won't own up to what he did.

episodes.name: It Always Rains on a Sad Day
episodes.overview: Jun-u beats out Hwi-yeong to pair up with Su-bin for a class assignment, and receives an urgent call about an old friend.

episodes.name: Happiness and Sadness Come and Go Instantly
episodes.overview: Su-bin and Jun-u continue practicing their English for the upcoming evaluation. Sin Jeong-hu writes a letter, and makes a heartfelt apology.

episodes.name: After that Long and Sad Day
episodes.overview: Jun-u's outburst of rage panics Hwi-yeong, who has something to cover up. O Han-kyeol visits someone who can testify to the truth.

episodes.name: The Timing of Action and Reaction
episodes.overview: Fighting with her mother, Su-bin doesn't go home. Determined to reveal Hwi-yeong's true nature, Jun-u starts to gain insight into his behavior.

episodes.name: Romeo and Juliet
episodes.overview: Su-bin and Jun-u can't stop thinking about each other -- but don't know what to do about it. Hwi-yeong agonizes over one wrong answer on a math test.

episodes.name: The Moment of Your First Love
episodes.overview: Even as Su-bin learns she's not the only one who likes Jun-u, she's excited for their first date. Jo Sang-hun goes up against Hwi-yeong's parents.

episodes.name: I'm Sorry
episodes.overview: Hwi-yeong sends Su-bin something that cuts her date with Jun-u short. Han-kyeol turns away a bribe. Yun Song-hui searches for a driver.

episodes.name: The Night That Will Never Return
episodes.overview: When the class goes on a trip together, the students bring with them a tangled mess of relationship and personal dramas.

episodes.name: The Emotions That I Got to Know Through You
episodes.overview: Han-kyeol deals with a petition to replace him. Hwi-yeong removes Su-bin from the tutor group, which bothers Song-hui more than it does her.

episodes.name: Being More Mature Than Adults at the Age of 18
episodes.overview: A rumor about Hwi-yeong's grades being rigged spreads like wildfire. Su-bin hesitates to tell Song-hui something, and meets with her father.

episodes.name: I Should Still Like You
episodes.overview: Finals approach, Song-hui's disapproval forces Su-bin and Jun-u apart, and Han-kyeol tracks down Hwi-yeong's old teacher.

episodes.name: Happy Birthday to You
episodes.overview: Everyone worries when the rumor about Hwi-yeong gets him into real trouble. Jun-u tells Han-kyeol about his newfound goal.

episodes.name: Ways to Embrace Your Scar
episodes.overview: Song-hui remains stubborn about Su-bin and Jun-u, who enters an art academy. The school board investigates Hwi-yeong's case.

episodes.name: This Goodbye Isn't Forever
episodes.overview: Hwi-yeong makes peace with the others -- and himself. Jun-u realizes his mother's situation, and must break difficult news to Su-bin.

episodes.name: Welcome to Hotel Del Luna
episodes.overview: On a day when the full moon has risen, Hotel Del Luna resumes its business. Two guests visit the hotel. One is a female dead soul who used to be a policewoman, but ended up being drowned in the water. The other one is a man who isn’t technically dead yet, but…

episodes.name: Catch a Tiger
episodes.overview: Chan Seong keeps seeing the dead souls. He comes to visit Man Weol and tells her to make him not to see the ghosts anymore. However, he’s given a mission to complete, and that is to catch a tiger. Meanwhile, Manager No, the only human in Hotel Del Luna, retir…

episodes.name: In a Dream
episodes.overview: Chan Seong sees a woman in his dream, and the woman looks like Man Weol. Chan Seong wants to know about the history of Hotel Del Luna and Man Weol’s past, but the staff at the hotel wouldn’t tell him. Meanwhile, a dead soul that committed suicide by leaping f…

episodes.name: Room 13
episodes.overview: Man Weol tells Chan Seong to take good care of her. As Man Weol opens her heart to Chan Seong, new leaves start to sprout from the Moon Tree. Such a change agitates Man Weol and the staff of the hotel. They start to think everything has begun to change after…

episodes.name: Dead Bride's Wish
episodes.overview: A dead bride’s spirit comes to visit Hotel Del Luna. Chan Seong kindly shows in the guest. Seeing him taking good care of the female guest makes Man Weol jealous and upset. Meanwhile, a red pocket is found at a park. Any man who picks up the red pocket has to…

episodes.name: Chan-sung's Ex-girlfriend
episodes.overview: Man Weol plans to go out for a meal with Chan Seong. However, she hears from Sanchez that Mi Ra, Chan Seong’s ex-girlfriend, has shown up. Man Weol starts to feel jealous. Meanwhile, the spirit of a king of Joseon Dynasty checks in to Hotel Del Luna. All the…

episodes.name: Rival in Love
episodes.overview: The evil spirit that has escaped from Room 13 continues to harm men. The spirit gets closer to the one that she’s after. Chan Seong decides to become the bait himself to catch the spirit. Meanwhile, Man Weol runs into Mi Ra who had an ill-fated relationship w…

episodes.name: Man-wol and Princess Song-hwa
episodes.overview: Chan Seong finds out why Man Weol is tied down to Hotel Del Luna. In dreams, he happens to see what happened between Man Weol and Princess Song Hwa in the past. Meanwhile, Man Weol invites Mi Ra to Hotel Del Luna and plans to torment her.

episodes.name: Where Are You, Man-wol?
episodes.overview: Hotel Del Luna disappears overnight. Chan Seong begins to trace Man Weol. The hotel staffers are having difficulty in dealing with all the work without Chan Seong. Meanwhile, Hyun Joong and Yu Na meet a group of spirits in the mountains on their way to the ne…

episodes.name: Chairman Wang's Offer
episodes.overview: Man Weol realizes that Yeon Woo has been reincarnated as a man named Yeong Su and is now a detective in this world. And Mi Ra runs into Yeong Su on the street. Meanwhile, Chairman Wang says that he would like to arrange a date between his granddaughter and Ch…

episodes.name: Lunar Eclipse
episodes.overview: Man Weol and Chan Seong start to date without telling anyone in the hotel. A lunar eclipse occurs in 39 years, and humans get to see the presence of Hotel Del Luna. To greet special guests visiting on the day of the lunar eclipse, Chan Seong opens the door of…

episodes.name: Ill-fated Relationship
episodes.overview: Chan Seong is attacked by the serial killer, Seol Ji Won. Man Weol keeps calling Chan Seong, but he won’t answer. Man Weol thinks that something bad has happened to him. Then, Yu Na tells that she has seen an ambulance take a man to the hospital. Everyone at…

episodes.name: Seo-hee's Resentment
episodes.overview: The flowers in the hotel start withering. The staff of the hotel wonders if it’s time to prepare to leave for the afterlife. Meanwhile, Seo Hee recognizes a new male guest. She realizes that it is a chance to resolve her deep sorrow and resentment before goin…

episodes.name: Man-wol's Choice
episodes.overview: Man Weol is obsessed with the thought that Chung Myung might have been reincarnated as Chan Seong. She finally faces a choice for Chan Seong. Meanwhile, Chan Seong and the Grim Reaper find where Seol Ji Won is. When they arrive at the place, they meet Man Weo…

episodes.name: Chan-sung's Time Travel
episodes.overview: While crossing the bridge to the afterlife, Man Weol starts to forget her memories piece by piece. Will Man Weol come back to Chan Seong? Meanwhile, Chan Seong travels back in time and gets to meet Man Weol in Joseon Dynasty. He has to find a herb there and r…

episodes.name: Time to Say Goodbye
episodes.overview: The staffers at the hotel prepare to leave for the afterlife one by one. Man Weol sees them off herself and realizes that there isn’t much time left for her. She also prepares to leave. Meanwhile, Mr. Kim decides to leave for the afterlife before he gets humi…

episodes.name: Kengan
episodes.overview: Chairman Nogi suddenly calls low-level employee Kazuo Yamashita into a meeting and gives him an unexpected -- and unwanted -- new assignment.

episodes.name: Super Human
episodes.overview: For his debut kengan match, Ohma calmly faces Yoshitake Real Estate's Lihito, an arrogant fighter with a superhuman vice-like grip.

episodes.name: Tough Guy
episodes.overview: Ohma thinks he's got the upper hand, but Jun Sekibayashi quickly reminds him: pro-wrestlers are great actors, and they love to put on a show.

episodes.name: Reunited
episodes.overview: Chairman Nogi refuses to enter Ohma into the Annihilation Tournament, but there's another way for him to qualify -- and he'll need Yamashita's help.

episodes.name: Brawl
episodes.overview: Unexpectedly, Ohma is thrown into an all-out brawl. Over 100 fighters are locked in a room, but only five can make it into the tournament finals.

episodes.name: Pulling Strings
episodes.overview: While some try to enjoy their time on the luxury liner, others strategize behind the scenes, with one savvy shogi player pulling a surprising move.

episodes.name: The Night Before
episodes.overview: In a tense backroom meeting with all the corporate participants, the tournament brackets are finally decided. Tomorrow, the battles begin.

episodes.name: The Battle Begins
episodes.overview: The Kengan Annihilation Tournament kicks off with great fanfare. First up, jujitsu master Cosmo Imai goes up against American brawler Adam Dudley.

episodes.name: Justice
episodes.overview: Nentendo's Haruo Kohno combines his monstrous size with surprising speed and agility, but riot cop Seishu Akoya's got a secret plan in place.

episodes.name: Sister
episodes.overview: In a battle between two storied lineages, Raian of the lethal Kure clan takes on Mokichi Robinson, scion of a legendary 19th century kengan fighter.

episodes.name: Ashura
episodes.overview: Ohma goes into his first fight of the tournament with confidence, but he struggles against Ryo Inaba's creepy, unorthodox fighting style.

episodes.name: Father and Son
episodes.overview: The tournament continues with plenty of rule-bending and inner-dealings in and out of the arena. Ohma chafes under Yamashita's fatherly affection.

episodes.name: Convictions
episodes.overview: Kiohzan Takeru looks like he's using MMA moves against “Hell's Angel” Jun Sekibayashi, but his all-out style is how sumo was originally fought.

episodes.name: Master and Pupil
episodes.overview: Gladiators and spectators enjoy a night off. Ohma visualizes his matches against formidable opponents -- including his former master, Niko Tokita.

episodes.name: The Fisherman
episodes.overview: Ajiro Fisheries' Yoshinari Karo faces Saw Paing Yoroizuka. The fix is in: the match is rigged. But Karo and his harpoon aren't following the script.

episodes.name: The Rakshasa
episodes.overview: Destinyland's Masami Nezu takes on Rei Mikazuchi, the scion of an assassin sect. Ren Nikaido's uncanny move against Setsuna Kiryu backfires.

episodes.name: The Devil Lance
episodes.overview: Lihito's hot-headed and arrogant, but Motor Head Motors' Gensai Kuroki isn't fazed by his taunts. It's youth versus age and the Kaiwan style.

episodes.name: Oddities
episodes.overview: Sen Hatsumi faces Takayuki Chiba, mimicker of other fighters' moves. Hajime Hanafusa enters the ring with orders to kill death row inmate Yohei Bando.

episodes.name: Volition
episodes.overview: Thai boxer Kaolan Wongsawat fights for his country and sworn liege. Suekichi Kaneda's clearly outmatched, but he's got a cunning and unshakable will.

episodes.name: Champions
episodes.overview: Naoya Ohkubo is known as the King of Combat, but crowd favorite Agito Kanoh is undefeated with 157 straight wins. It's a matchup for the ages.

episodes.name: The Abyss
episodes.overview: The second round begins. At a huge size disadvantage, Cosmo Imai discards his signature grappling moves when facing the monolithic Seishu Akoya.

episodes.name: Deathmatch
episodes.overview: Seishu Akoya lives by his own code of sadistic justice. On the brink of death, Cosmo Imai has a revelation that puts him back in the fight.

episodes.name: The Devil
episodes.overview: As Ohma faces Raian of the Kure clan, other Kure assassins are on the move outside the ring. The life of Yamashita's eldest son hangs in the balance.

episodes.name: Father
episodes.overview: Just when the match seems over, Ohma has a vision and unlocks a new level of his abilities for an epic showdown against Raian.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The second round of the Kengan Life-or-Death Tournament continues — without Ohma. As the mighty gladiators clash, a shadowy figure plots a violent coup.

episodes.name: Omen
episodes.overview: Despite insisting that he's fine, Ohma ends up collapsing — and recalls a childhood memory. Then, the Kengan Life-or-Death Tournament kicks off again.

episodes.name: Blast Core
episodes.overview: Takeshi Wakatsuki was raised to be the ultimate fighter for Furumi Pharma, but even he's intimidated by his opponent, Julius Reinhold.

episodes.name: The Clown
episodes.overview: The crowd goes wild when Jun Sekibayashi enters the arena as Marvelous Seki, his legendary pro-wrestler persona.

episodes.name: Dignity
episodes.overview: During his match against Muteba, Jun Sekibayashi remembers how his life changed when he began training as a pro wrestler at 15-years-old.

episodes.name: Suicide Attack
episodes.overview: Saw Paing is known for his match-ending head-butts, but his lightning-fast opponent Rei Mikazuchi might not let him get close enough to use it.

episodes.name: An Old Friend
episodes.overview: All Setsuna Kiryu wants to do is win this match — and the next two matches — so he can face the man he's been dreaming of: Ohma himself.

episodes.name: Hell
episodes.overview: The bout between Setsuna and Gensai Kuroki comes to an end. Ohma remains hospitalized, leaving the Nogi Group with Sen Hatsumi as their only fighter.

episodes.name: Resurrection
episodes.overview: Having survived 45 hanging attempts, death row convict Yohei Bando has a certain physical advantage that he deploys against Sen Hatsumi.

episodes.name: Superiority
episodes.overview: While facing Kaolan Wongsawat, Agito Kanoh begins moving in a strange way; he seems to have developed a brand new fighting style during their match.

episodes.name: Life and Death
episodes.overview: After the match between Kaolan and Agito, round two of the Kengan Life-or-Death Tournament comes to an end. Suddenly, a change of schedule is announced.

episodes.name: Rebel Flag
episodes.overview: Hayami gives everyone a choice; either join him, or die. When Ohma was a kid in the slums, Niko Tokita trained him the ways of the Niko fighting style.

episodes.name: Melee
episodes.overview: With Ohma still in his hospital room, Hayami and his men attempt to complete their coup — but there might be a traitor foiling their plans.

episodes.name: Headstrong
episodes.overview: Cosmo Imai is told in no uncertain terms that Nishihonji Security Services won't be using him for the next round, but he's still determined to fight.

episodes.name: Reflecting Water
episodes.overview: Familiar with his opponent's every move, the fighter for Nishihonji Security Services is able to keep the match neck-and-neck — but for how long?

episodes.name: Ace in the Hole
episodes.overview: With special guest Jun Sekibayashi providing ring-side commentary, the next match starts off with an explosive move by Takeshi Wakatsuki.

episodes.name: Culmination
episodes.overview: Rei Mikazuchi steps into the ring to fight for pride, love and desire, but can his Lightning Spirit Style overpower the impregnable Gensai Kuroki?

episodes.name: Gathering Clouds
episodes.overview: It's Nogi versus Metsudo in the final match of the third round. But before the Floating Cloud can face off with the Fang, Kanoh must defend his position.

episodes.name: The Floating Cloud
episodes.overview: As Sen looks back on his past and how he turned down an opportunity to become the next Fang, the fight ramps up and takes a shockingly devastating turn.

episodes.name: Predicament
episodes.overview: On the eve of the final round, Setsuna Kiryu recalls the inhumane treatment he endured on The Inside, and the fateful meeting that saved his life.

episodes.name: Demon
episodes.overview: Ohma finally recovers a crucial memory of who taught him Life Advance, revealing his and Setsuna's complicated pasts.

episodes.name: Farewell
episodes.overview: With a flurry of powerful Rakshasa's Palm strikes, Setsuna finally gets his wish and faces Ohma in an intense fight that pushes his sanity to the limit.

episodes.name: Wakatsuki
episodes.overview: The long-awaited semifinals kick-off and Yamashita receives an ominous visit from Chairman Nogi, who demands the fight be rigged in Furumi Pharma's favor.

episodes.name: Wholehearted
episodes.overview: While Yamashita learns about his surprisingly deep ties to the Kengan Association and Nogi Group, Ohma must find a way to best Wakatsuki in the ring.

episodes.name: Supreme Strength
episodes.overview: In the highly anticipated second semifinal match, the two massive titans of martial arts, Kuroki and Kanoh, clash in a battle of supreme strength.

episodes.name: Giant Star
episodes.overview: Pushing each other to their limits, Kuroki and Kanoh continue to evolve their fighting styles. Which of these giants will advance to the finals?

episodes.name: The Finals
episodes.overview: Before their fight, Kuroki unveils the truth behind Niko Style to Ohma. As Ohma prepares to enter the finals, Yamashita gives him one last pep talk.

episodes.name: Victory
episodes.overview: As the intense battle with Kuroki reaches its peak, Ohma waits to unleash Niko Style and Life Advance simultaneously — despite Yamashita's objections.

episodes.name: Finale
episodes.overview: Takakaze approaches Chairman Nogi with an unexpected proposal. As life returns to normal for everybody else, Yamashita reflects on his time with "The Ashura."

episodes.name: Between hope and despair
episodes.overview: Hours before leaving the country, Kang Si-yeong steps in as a correctional physician and saves a life with the helping hand of Cha Yo-han.

episodes.name: 0.00001% hope
episodes.overview: Lee Yu-jun warns Si-yeong about Yo-han. When she confronts Yo-han about his diagnosis and crime, he questions the source of her anger.

episodes.name: Champions
episodes.overview: Yo-han's past precedes him at his new workplace. Dreading a painful future, a famous athlete makes a heart-stopping request.

episodes.name: Facing your fears
episodes.overview: Si-yeong begins to understand Yo-han’s philosophy on pain management upon hearing the full account of the events from three years ago.

episodes.name: 21g, the Weight of a Soul
episodes.overview: As patients fill the Pain Management Center, one in particular catches Yo-han's eye with his lack of symptoms. Son Seok-gi approaches Si-yeong.

episodes.name: Memories of pain
episodes.overview: Yo-han lets history convince a young patient to undergo major surgery. Si-yeong wins Yo-han's praises for finding answers through patients' stories.

episodes.name: Secrets & lies
episodes.overview: Si-yeong becomes the first person to learn of Yo-han's secret. A suspected pandemic-infected patient enters the Pain Management Center.

episodes.name: Understanding someone
episodes.overview: The pain management team diagnoses a patient at war with unknown demons. Heo Jun asks for forgiveness. Si-yeong confesses her feelings.

episodes.name: Terminal: Terminally ill, incurable
episodes.overview: A former actress receives treatment for a rare kind of cancer. Yo-han starts to experience worrying symptoms.

episodes.name: An ominous foreboding on a sunny afternoon
episodes.overview: Yo-han's doctor tells him to choose between his career and his life. Min Tae-gyeong makes up her mind about her husband. A patient loses all hope.

episodes.name: Up
episodes.overview: During an investigation into a patient's switched-off ventilator, Seok-gi is surprised by the findings and Yo-han's actions.

episodes.name: Schrödinger's Cat
episodes.overview: Si-yeong embraces her role as Yo-han's guardian. A young patient returns with new symptoms. Yo-han and Seok-gi learn about each other's conditions.

episodes.name: The promise of trying
episodes.overview: Without consulting Seok-gi, Chae Eun-jeong takes matters into her own hands by publicly questioning Yo-han's qualifications to treat patients.

episodes.name: Select any
episodes.overview: Seok-gi gets a tip from an unexpected source. At the disciplinary hearing, Yo-han's supporters advocate on his behalf.

episodes.name: The mind of the departed
episodes.overview: Si-yeong tearfully bids farewell to loved ones. After pushing her away out of fear, Yo-han finally gives her his answer.

episodes.name: Breaking up is like breaking up with someone you hope to see again someday
episodes.overview: To Si-yeong's relief and disbelief, Yo-han reappears in front of her after three years of silence. His vision for healing comes to fruition.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Goo Hae-ryung tells Goo Jae-gyeong that she doesn’t want to get married. Yi Rim is curious about how the public truly feels about his writing.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Hae Ryung gets distressing news from Jae Gyeong about her betrothal. The king finds out about Yi Rim’s activities. Yi Jin makes a controversial ruling.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Hae Ryung sits for the examination and contends with Yi Jin’s questions about her point of view. Yi Rim tries to find the woman impersonating Maehwa.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Song Sa Hui tells Hae Ryung that she can take care of herself. Min U Won proposes to teach the recruits after they’re browbeaten by ladies-in-waiting.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Yi Rim briefs Yi Jin about the attack. Hae Ryung learns the truth about Maehwa and regrets what this may mean. Yi Jin asks Hae Ryung about his brother.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Hae Ryung is vilified for writing an appeal. Yi Jin asks Sa Hui why she chose to become a historian. Hae Ryung and Yi Rim find themselves in a bind.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: The king dispatches Yi Rim to visit the region when advisers raise concerns about an epidemic. Hae-Ryung volunteers to go and sees someone she knows.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Had-Ryung entreaty Yi Rim to allow a controversial procedure that may ease the epidemic, but U-won questions whether she grasps her role as a historian.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Yi Rim gets a visit from Queen Dowager Im. The historians face a dilemma about their duty to record. Yi Jin approaches U-won with a delicate request.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: An unexpected appeal is presented to Yi Jin, which forces U-won into a difficult position. Yi Rim asks Hae-ryung her opinion about the other historians.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: With instructions from U-won, Hae-ryung heads to the king’s palace but is turned away. The historians grapple with a dubious royal order.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Hae-ryung tries to keep up with sudden changes in the king’s daily activities. Sa-hui accompanies Yi Jin on a trip outside the palace.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Officials search the palace for a prisoner on the loose. U-won shields a fellow historian at great risk to himself. Yi Jin receives troubling news.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Hae-ryung criticizes a tale told by Yi Rim. Yi Jin defies the king with a royal decree. One of the historians makes a startling confession to U-won.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Hae-ryung tries to enjoy a rare day off when Yi Rim shows up unannounced. Yi Jin hears an appeal submitted by U-won, which upsets the historians.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Queen Dowager Im responds to Yi Rim’s earnest plea. Hae-ryung’s new assignment proves to be taxing. Sa-hui realizes her fate may not be in her control.

episodes.name: Episode 17
episodes.overview: U-won receives a royal visitor at home. Yi Jin strikes back at growing rumors. Queen Dowager Im confronts Jae-gyeong. Yi Rim’s entourage is ambushed.

episodes.name: Episode 18
episodes.overview: As they try to decipher the mystery, Hae-ryung reveals a secret about her past to Yi Rim, who wants to know what happened the day that he was born.

episodes.name: Episode 19
episodes.overview: Yi Jin warns the king about Min Ik-pyeong and hears something staggering. Yi Rim speaks frankly with Queen Dowager Im. Hae-ryung seeks U-won’s advice.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: In school, Oh Jisoo maintains a low-key existence. Outside of it, he masterminds a risky side hustle that no one can ever know about.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Jisoo panics when the phone he uses to run the business falls into the hands of an unknown blackmailer. Seo Minhee tries to get back to work.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Jisoo searches for his father while pushing away Bae Gyuri, who wants in on the operation and offers a solution to his new financial problems.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The business is running again, but Jisoo no longer has a safe place to keep his incoming cash. Meanwhile, the school bully finds his latest target.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: An incident at school puts Gyuri in a tense exchange with her mother. Kwak Kitae's reaction to his birthday present frustrates Minhee.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: After Minhee attracts the interest of an observant police officer, she's dismissed from her job. Upset, she asks Jisoo to accompany her somewhere.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Stuck in a dicey encounter, Jisoo calls Gyuri, hoping she can help get him out — but balks when she takes things in an unthinkable direction.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Gyuri prepares to meet Ryu Daeyeol, who's got shocking news for Jisoo. Mr. Lee makes a narrow escape from the police at the hospital.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: When Gyuri is kidnapped, Jisoo is told to come alone if he wants to save her. Mr. Lee and Kitae each set out for Daeyeol's blood.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Gyuri tells Jisoo she's not done with the business, despite everything that's happened. The case's remaining questions bother Lee Haegyoung.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In a civilized society of anthropomorphic animals, an uneasy tension exists between carnivores and herbivores. At Cherryton Academy, this mutual distrust peaks after a predation incident results in the death of Tem, an alpaca in the school's drama club. Tem's…

episodes.name: The Moon and the Beast
episodes.overview: An herbivore's murder unsettles Cherryton Academy, with some suspecting grey wolf Legoshi. Dwarf rabbit Haru struggles with her classmates' bullying.

episodes.name: The Academy's Top Dogs
episodes.overview: Legoshi ponders his own ferocious impulses; an altercation at breakfast unsettles him further. The theater students prepare for their play.

episodes.name: A Wolf Is Born
episodes.overview: Haru and Legoshi's interaction ends extremely awkwardly. With two days to the performance, the school newspaper is sniffing out what Louis is hiding.

episodes.name: Give It Your All
episodes.overview: The drama club switches up parts after the last performance. Tapped to appear onstage, Legoshi confronts the new lead actor about a dangerous issue.

episodes.name: Two Sides to the Story
episodes.overview: Legoshi deals with misplaced notoriety after the chaotic but successful play, with Jack's support. Haru and Louis have a clandestine encounter.

episodes.name: Blurred Vision – Dream or Reality?
episodes.overview: After another murder, herbivores are confined to campus. Out in town, the theater club carnivores enter a shady district for adult meat eaters.

episodes.name: Below the Fur Coat
episodes.overview: The mystery of Legoshi's favorite lunch is solved. Haru recalls her first encounter with a vulnerable Louis, who has a fiancée.

episodes.name: Caught Like Floss in a Canine's Teeth
episodes.overview: Legoshi offers to escort Haru home; on the way she attempts to become better friends with him, unaware of his guilt. Juno has a revelation.

episodes.name: Into the Lion's Den
episodes.overview: Louis recalls his harrowing past, and Legoshi makes a personal vow despite conflicting feelings. Meanwhile, Haru is kidnapped for ransom by carnivores.

episodes.name: A Wolf in Sheep's Clothing
episodes.overview: Legoshi risks his life to find the Shishi-Gumi. A friend helps him channel and control his inner beast so that he can save Haru.

episodes.name: To the Neon District
episodes.overview: A ferocious Legoshi wreaks havoc to save Haru, while an unknown ally assists in their escape. Awkward timing causes some awkward situations afterward.

episodes.name: In the Storm's Wake
episodes.overview: Haru and Legoshi return to school after their strange night. As the festival gets underway, Juno challenges Haru for Legoshi's affections.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: "Beastar"—a title awarded to beasts who prove their excellence through fighting inequality to unite carnivores and herbivores in an anthropomorphic animal society. Cherryton Academy has gone five years without one such leader. However, following the murder of…

episodes.name: A Teen's Never-Ending Alarm
episodes.overview: Things are somewhat calm again, but with Tem's murder unsolved and Louis missing, the school is filled with rumors of hauntings and strange occurrences.

episodes.name: The Grey Police Hound Runs
episodes.overview: Rokume, a giant rattlesnake claiming to be the only security guard in the school, approaches Legoshi and asks him to track down the murderer.

episodes.name: Changes
episodes.overview: After taking a drastic step against the Shishi-Gumi, Louis faces an impossible choice. The drama club gets a new, very confident member.

episodes.name: Entangled
episodes.overview: Legoshi is attacked by a powerful carnivore. As Louis earns the trust of the Shishi-Gumi, he loses his own health and peace of mind.

episodes.name: Call It Like It Is
episodes.overview: While attending school during the day, Legoshi spends his nights in intense training sessions with Gohin.

episodes.name: Fly, O Corrupt One
episodes.overview: Louis wants to officially quit school to make a break with his past, but his father refuses to allow it. Haru and Legoshi talk things out.

episodes.name: Unforgettable Sweetness
episodes.overview: Tao — a black panther — accidentally injures another student. After Legoshi confronts them, the killer thinks back on how and why they murdered Tem.

episodes.name: Laughing at the Shadows We Cast
episodes.overview: After clapping a muzzle on Legoshi, Gohin orders him to capture a beast in the throes of a flesh addiction. Juno ends up spending some time with Haru.

episodes.name: A Busted Electric Fan
episodes.overview: Legoshi is shocked when he meets Louis in the Black Market district. At school, he's disgusted to hear Riz say he'll visit Kibi in the hospital.

episodes.name: The Chef's Suspense
episodes.overview: After Pina makes it clear he won't be intimidated by Riz, Legoshi gets into a bloody bare-knuckled fight with the bear.

episodes.name: Scatter Your Scales
episodes.overview: To grow stronger for his New Year's Day confrontation with Riz, Legoshi tries ingesting a moth larva and has an intense hallucination.

episodes.name: The Taste of Rebellion
episodes.overview: While getting pummeled by Riz, Legoshi realizes that they're not so different: he could easily have succumbed to his carnivorous instincts, too.

seasons.name: Final Season
seasons.overview: Following the unmasking of the carnivorous murderer, Cherryton Academy introduces a segregation policy to protect herbivores, further fueling public disdain for carnivores. Meanwhile, the black market for meat thrives like never before, and the Shishi-gumi fa…

episodes.name: An Itchy Collar
episodes.overview: While Legoshi adjusts to a new life outside Cherryton, the school announces a new segregation policy. The current BEASTAR takes an interest in Legoshi.

episodes.name: The Shiny Black Nose Before Me
episodes.overview: Legoshi's meat withdrawal causes trouble with his new neighbor. The Shishi-Gumi's enigmatic new leader plans to distribute a dangerous energy drink.

episodes.name: An Old Dragon's Wrath
episodes.overview: Recalling Louis's words, Legoshi beats up the energy drink pushers. As the drama club makes a tough decision, the wolf finds a familiar face waiting.

episodes.name: The Gravity of Being a Land Dweller
episodes.overview: Gosha shocks his grandson with his fighting prowess. Yahya remembers his history with Gosha. Later, a kind seal teaches Legoshi about the marine world.

episodes.name: In the Food Chain
episodes.overview: After catching up with his old drama club friends, Legoshi meets with Yahya. Meanwhile, a cunning civet forces the Shishi-Gumi to work with him.

episodes.name: The Guy Born in Spring
episodes.overview: As Legoshi recovers under Gohin's care, Yahya investigates Melon, a gazelle therapist. Haru reaches a sobering conclusion on interspecies relationships.

episodes.name: Eat My Vow
episodes.overview: On a birthday date, Legoshi confesses everything to Haru. Determined to take their relationship seriously, she makes a daring and dangerous request.

episodes.name: What Lies at the End of the Melon Patch
episodes.overview: While the Black Market is abuzz with shocking rumors, Yahya makes plans to catch Melon. The 500 Cornered Rats continue their underground surveillance.

episodes.name: The Rotten Egg Hatches
episodes.overview: The drama club members chafe against the interspecies restrictions. Enticed by Yahya's promise, Legoshi infiltrates Melon's underground party.

episodes.name: Bambi Is Alive and Well
episodes.overview: Louis's investigations into the spiked energy drink take him back to the Black Market, where he runs into his old comrades — and their new leader.

episodes.name: Peeling Back the Layers
episodes.overview: Eager to learn more about the effects of Kines, Louis goes undercover and meets Deshico. Legoshi continues his investigation into Melon alone.

episodes.name: Tragedy on the Waves
episodes.overview: Unable to get a meeting with Yahya, Louis sneaks in. Meanwhile, Legoshi follows the clues from the tattoo parlor. Will he be able to find Melon?

episodes.name: A Threefold Dilemma
episodes.overview: After his showdown with Melon, Legoshi finds himself at the mercy of the ocean. Meanwhile, Haru encounters an unfortunate scene that rouses her suspicion.

episodes.name: Six Tails in a Row
episodes.overview: While the drama club tries to get their interspecies script approved, Melon's interest in Haru grows. Later, Legoshi reunites with his canine friends.

episodes.name: In a Dusty Universe
episodes.overview: Jack confides in Legoshi about his struggles in school, while Yahya visits Deshico for a lead. Melon's fascination with Haru takes a dangerous turn.

episodes.name: The Red in Our Lives
episodes.overview: Legoshi awakens with a start to find Haru missing. The mayor approaches Louis with a meaty proposition. Pina stirs up trouble during rehearsal.

episodes.name: Sweet Hunger
episodes.overview: Struggling to understand a herbivore's perspective, Juno seeks acting advice from Louis. Meanwhile, trouble brews in the Black Market alleys.

episodes.name: Upon a Nest of Dried Noodles
episodes.overview: A quick meal turns into a moral conflict for Bill. Meanwhile, a string of unexplained interspecies attacks erupt around the city. Louis and Haru catch up.

episodes.name: Feline Fall
episodes.overview: On the night of the Odd Soul Festival, Legoshi meets Melon in Haru's place, determined to stop him once and for all — but the villain pulls a gun on him.

episodes.name: Gotta Buy a Step Stool
episodes.overview: With Melon on the loose, Legoshi arms Haru with self-defense gear — but he has bigger things to worry about. There's a warrant out for his arrest!

episodes.name: The Demon King of Beasts
episodes.overview: After a charged encounter, Haru bonds with Gosha. Louis reveals his true feelings to his fiancée. Melon asserts his dominance over the Shishi-Gumi.

episodes.name: Words That Slipped Out
episodes.overview: Set on challenging Melon, Legoshi enters the Turf War, but must first pass a deadly quiz. Meanwhile, Deshico makes a critical discovery in his lab.

episodes.name: Blood in the Disco Ball
episodes.overview: Louis's butler reveals the truth behind Ogma's behavior. Meanwhile, Melon incites the crowd and a riot breaks out. Can Legoshi survive the night?

episodes.name: Interspecies Exchange
episodes.overview: Despite winning the Doku-Gumi's approval, Legoshi must still face the Inari-Gumi's foxy boss. The mayor drops a bombshell that blindsides Louis.

episodes.name: Runaway Raccoon
episodes.overview: Fleeing persecution as a beastman, Michiru journeys to Anima-City, where she meets wolf Shirou amidst the celebrations for the city's 10th anniversary.

episodes.name: Rabbit Town
episodes.overview: Michiru can't prove she was human without her stolen student ID, so she heads to Rabbit Town to retrieve it. Shirou meets with the mayor.

episodes.name: Rhino Melancholy
episodes.overview: The mayor asks Shirou to investigate a series of bombings. Michiru talks her way into joining him, with the goal of protecting a medical center.

episodes.name: Dolphin Daydream
episodes.overview: Using an illegal SIM card, Michiru befriends influencer Nina, who's fascinated by humans. The two of them sneak out to a party in the human world.

episodes.name: Greedy Bears
episodes.overview: Though she prefers basketball, Michiru reluctantly joins a hard-luck baseball team whose hangdog coach is on the sports betting take.

episodes.name: Fox Waltz
episodes.overview: The Church of the Silver Wolf arrives in Anima-City. Michiru is shocked to learn that their leader is her friend Nazuna, who was once human like her.

episodes.name: Easy Albatross
episodes.overview: Michiru meets albatross beastman Pingua when he crash lands in her house. Shirou has an encounter with Alan Sylvasta in the mayor's office.

episodes.name: The Mole Rat Speaks
episodes.overview: After a visit from Boris, Yaba morphs into an uncontrollable beast form. The mayor tells Michiru the true history of the silver wolf.

episodes.name: Human Scapegoat
episodes.overview: While Shirou investigates what happened to Yaba, Michiru sneaks into the Sylvasta medical center after seeing Nazuna kidnapped once again.

episodes.name: Rabid Wolf
episodes.overview: Shirou and Michiru set out to subdue another monstrous beastman. After Sylvasta's machines interfere, Alan tells them about Nirvasyl Syndrome.

episodes.name: A Beastly Feast
episodes.overview: Nazuna decides to reveal she's human during her concert. While the mayor escapes detention in Japan, Shirou and Flip put their own plans into action.

episodes.name: Anima-City
episodes.overview: The mayor proves that a serum based on Michiru's blood cures Nirvasyl Syndrome, but Alan moves forward with his plan to "solve" the beastman problem.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Flower Crew decides to take on the task of arranging the wedding between Gae Ttong and Kim Soo. The preparations go along quickly and smoothly until Soo suddenly disappears. Gae Ttong and Hoon set out to look for Soo, but their search seems hopeless.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Hoon decides to allow Gae Ttong to join Flower Crew as a three-month apprentice. Meanwhile, Flower Crew is going through a dry spell of clients after what happened with Gae Ttong’s wedding. They finally get a request from the first-place winner of the tempora…

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Hoon lets Gae Ttong in the house again. They spend some time together and feel subtle emotions toward each other. Gae Ttong promises to leave the Flower Crew if she fails to persuade Scholar Lee within three days. Meanwhile, Soo orders to reinvestigate on the…

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Hoon is blindfolded and taken to the palace where he meets Soo, who is now the king. Soo asks Hoon to take care of Gae Ttong for him until he gains enough power to bring her to the palace. Meanwhile, Flower Crew needs someone to pretend to be a noble lady, as…

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Hoon is flustered from the unexpected kiss with Gae Ttong, but the next morning, she doesn’t seem to remember that it even happened. Meanwhile, Scholar Lee asks Gae Ttong, who helped change his mind about whom he should marry, to deliver his napchae documents…

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: The Rogue dies a mysterious death in prison and his last words to Hoon are “the Fox Guard”. Hoon and Joon start looking for the culprit who killed the Rogue. Meanwhile, Gae Ttong finally reunites with her brother, Kang. However, Ji Hwa begins to grow suspicio…

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Soo and Gae Ttong finally reunite. Soo promises that he will marry Gae Ttong once everything is settled. However, Hoon begins to have strange feelings for Gae Ttong and turns down her request of making her into a noble lady. Meanwhile, Hoon’s investigations i…

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Hoon realizes that Gae Ttong is in danger because of his father and decides to take on Soo’s marriage. As the Chief State Councillor searches for Lady Yim, his niece-in-law, to bestow an unwanted honor upon her, Lady Yim hides herself away even more, for the…

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Gae Ttong and Joon are upset about what Lady Kang says during her visit with Hoon. Nevertheless, Gae Ttong’s training to become a noble lady continues. As Joon helps Lady Yim out of trouble, he realizes that his memories of his mother were wrong this whole ti…

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Gae Ttong’s sudden declaration of love leaves Hoon feeling flustered. He tries to avoid Gae Ttong, but she refuses to let him ignore her feelings. Meanwhile, Soo feels anxious after overhearing Gae Ttong and Hoon's conversation. He agrees to meet with Lady Ka…

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Hoon and Gae Ttong declare their love for one another, but the palace decrees a marriage ban until after the royal wedding. Meanwhile, Hyun begins to search for Gae Ttong as the Chief State Councillor instructs. As Lord Kang searches for information about Flo…

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Hoon declares to Soo that his marriage with Gae Ttong is canceled. Lady Kang, who knows Gae Ttong’s secret, forces Gae Ttong to participate in the queen selection process. Hoon and Joon are anxious, knowing that the women they love are at the palace for the f…

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Gae Ttong is furious about Soo and Hoon’s deceit about her marriage and declares that she no longer wants to live as a noble lady. However, Moon Seok visits her out of the blue and tells her that many people’s lives depend on her becoming the queen. After spe…

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Gae Ttong goes to the second queen selection process with tears in her eyes. She faces an obstacle when the astrologist says that she has the fortune of the dead. Meanwhile, Soo discovers the Chief State Councillor’s scheme and intervenes. Finally, the Second…

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: The Chief and Second State Councillors join hands and plot to commit treason. Meanwhile, the Chief State Councillor kidnaps Gae Ttong in hopes of making Hoon take his side as Young Soo is taken prisoner by the Second State Councillor. Joon uses all his resour…

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Cha Dal-geon encourages his nephew to go to Morocco with the taekwondo demonstration group. Go Hae-ri walks in late to a meeting at the Korean embassy.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Cha Dal-geon makes a disquieting announcement to the other bereaving families and implores Go Hae-ri for help, but she seems to be hiding something.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Hae-ri remains skeptical about the flight-deck voice recording but is told that the evidence points to a faulty aircraft. Dal-geon is ambushed.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Dal-geon gets a call from someone out of the blue and is approached by a journalist, who claims to be pursuing a story about the plane crash.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Dal-geon attempts to alert the press about what he knows -- but someone interferes. Hae-ri contacts Gi Tae-ung to get answers about the flash drive.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The NIS takes Dal-geon to a safe house. Tae-ung questions O Sang-mi about her husband’s involvement in the plane crash but is ordered to release her.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Dal-geon sees someone who’s supposed to be dead. Hae-ri and Tae-ung head to Morocco to capture their suspect. The NIS takes Jessica Lee into custody.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Dal-geon runs into trouble while trying to carry out his own search. Tae-ung is displeased that the operation in Morocco doesn’t go as planned.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Dal-geon and the agents try to keep Kim Woo-gi alive, and request NIS backup. Jessica moves to pin the plane crash on someone else.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: After running from the embassy, Dal-geon and the others head back to Korea another way. Min Jae-sik confronts Gang Ju-cheol.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Dal-geon and Hae-ri make contact with Jae-sik. Jessica and Yun Han-gi see a big win at the National Assembly. Tae-ung undergoes scrutiny.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: The plan to get Woo-gi safely to the courthouse takes an unanticipated turn -- and throws the Blue House into panic mode.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Dal-geon's explosive on-air accusation toward the president sparks a media storm. Jessica's press conference goes south quick.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: When O Sang-mi disappears, Dal-geon and Hae-ri realize there's more to the situation. Meanwhile, Hong Sun-jo takes advantage of the crisis.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Sang-mi leaves behind a warning about a shady figure named Samael, putting everything Dal-geon thought he knew about the crash into question.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: When Jessica asks for NIS protection in exchange for Samael's identity, Hae-ri heads to prison undercover. In hiding, Dal-geon plans his next steps.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in children's games. Inside, a tempting prize awaits — with deadly high stakes.

episodes.name: Red Light, Green Light
episodes.overview: Hoping to win easy money, a broke and desperate Gi-hun agrees to take part in an enigmatic game. Not long into the first round, unforeseen horrors unfold.

episodes.name: Hell
episodes.overview: Split on whether to continue or quit, the group holds a vote. But their realities in the outside world may prove to be just as unforgiving as the game.

episodes.name: The Man with the Umbrella
episodes.overview: A few players enter the next round — which promises equal doses of sweet and deadly — with hidden advantages. Meanwhile, Jun-ho sneaks his way inside.

episodes.name: Stick to the Team
episodes.overview: As alliances form among the players, no one is safe in the dorm after lights-out. The third game challenges Gi-hun's team to think strategically.

episodes.name: A Fair World
episodes.overview: Gi-hun and his team take turns keeping guard through the night. The masked men encounter trouble with their co-conspirators.

episodes.name: Gganbu
episodes.overview: Players pair off for the fourth game. Gi-hun grapples with a moral dilemma, Sang-woo chooses self-preservation and Sae-byeok shares her untold story.

episodes.name: VIPS
episodes.overview: The Masked Leader welcomes VIP guests to the facility for a front-row viewing of the show. In the fifth game, some players crack under pressure.

episodes.name: Front Man
episodes.overview: Ahead of the last round, distrust and disgust run deep among the finalists. Jun-ho makes a getaway, determined to expose the game's dirty secrets.

episodes.name: One Lucky Day
episodes.overview: The final round presents another cruel test — but this time, how it ends depends on just one player. The game's creator steps out of the shadows.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Ready to run for your lives? Player 456 returns for more heart-pounding children's games, facing deadly new challenges — but armed with a hidden agenda.

episodes.name: Bread and Lottery
episodes.overview: A vengeful Gi-hun makes a U-turn at the airport. Later, in his hideout, he intensifies his search for the elusive recruiter who is seeking new players.

episodes.name: Halloween Party
episodes.overview: Gi-hun finally gets hold of an invitation, marked for Halloween day. In a tense moment facing Jun-ho, they reveal their truths to each other.
New players gather for a chance to win 45.6 billion won. After an intense first round, the survivors' fates hang in the balance — down to one final vote.

episodes.name: Six Legs
episodes.overview: The players prepare for the next game: a six-legged pentathlon, where each team member must clear a mini-game to survive — or face collective elimination.

episodes.name: One More Game
episodes.overview: Kang No-eul earns enemies for her unruly actions. Nerves fray to the breaking point as the remaining players vote on whether to move to the next round.

episodes.name: O X
episodes.overview: Jun-ho and his team prepare to infiltrate a suspicious island. As monetary stakes and tensions rise, players split into two opposing factions.

episodes.name: Friend or Foe
episodes.overview: The remaining players strategize on how to survive the night. Gi-hun proposes a risky plan — but he will need trustworthy allies to carry it out.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Gi-hun is devastated by the loss of his best friend and sinks into deep despair after discovering that the Game Master had hidden his true identity to secretly infiltrate the game.

episodes.name: Keys and Knives
episodes.overview: No-eul infiltrates a dangerous operation with a risky plan. A new game is announced: hide-and-seek, where one group holds a key and the other a knife.

episodes.name: The Starry Night
episodes.overview: The games resume, and Gi-hun fixates on confronting Kang Dae-ho. Meanwhile, Kim Jun-hee faces a sudden crisis that pushes her willpower to its limits.

episodes.name: It's Not Your Fault
episodes.overview: Jun-ho's team gets close to finding the island. Jang Geum-ja makes a desperate plea to Gi-hun to help Jun-hee. The VIPs discuss a cruel proposal.
Even as Gi-hun supports Jun-hee amid rising tensions, she must make a pivotal decision. Before the final game, the Front Man gives Gi-hun an ultimatum.
No-eul tries to gain the upper hand in negotiations, but her plans backfire. Gi-hun faces a moral crossroads, testing his limits — how far will he go?

episodes.name: Humans Are...
episodes.overview: As Jun-ho races to reach the island, tensions peak in the final round. The last players face an impossible situation in the closing minutes of the game.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Seo Hwi and Nam Seon-ho want to take an exam to join the military, though for different reasons. They meet Han Hui-jae, who's trying to evade capture.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: At the exam, Hwi tastes injustice, and Seon-ho faces an outcome he never desired. Despite warnings, Hui-jae keeps helping Hwi.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: There are those who resolve to forget -- and those who don’t. Hui-jae confronts Seon-ho about what happened. Park Chi-do finds Hwi on the battlefield.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: While on the run, Hwi hears a difficult truth from Seon-ho. Hui-jae travels with Yi Bang-won as he escorts Queen Sindeok and her sons to safety.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Hwi stays away from Hui-jae, who holds on to hope that he is still alive, and keeps an eye on Seo Yeon. A high-ranking nobleman is kidnapped.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Seon-ho requests power from Yi Seong-gye. Ihwaru covers up a murder. Hwi and his friends hatch a plan involving Bang-won.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Wary of Hwi's intentions, Bang-won tries to figure out what he's after. Seong-gye's council calls for Seon-ho's punishment.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Hui-jae comes across a man who haunts her memories. Seong-gye issues a warning to Nam Jeon, and declares the heir to his throne.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Jeon's true objectives -- as well as Hwi's -- are made clear to Bang-won. Fearing for Yeon's safety, Seon-ho takes her and runs.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Devastated by a sudden loss, Hwi takes his rage to Jeon. Six years later, Seon-ho hunts down a thief who's been intercepting precious cargo.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Hwi, seeking revenge, conspires with Bang-won. Seon-ho advises Seong-gye on what must be done in order to protect his crown.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Bang-won's rebellion strikes, and Seong-gye realizes it too late. Hwi has just one target -- but Seon-ho stands in his way.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: With no further reason to stay by Bang-won's side, Hwi walks away -- but finds he must contend with Seong-gye's revenge.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Seon-ho acquires soldiers. Hui-jae mourns all that Ihwaru has lost. Hwi and Bang-won fool Yi Bang-gan into feeling a false sense of security.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Seon-ho acquires soldiers. Hui-jae mourns all that Ihwaru has lost. Hwi and Bang-won fool Yi Bang-gan into feeling a false sense of security.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Ahead of the ceremony, Bang-won and Seong-gye each send men after Hwi and Seon-ho, who know what must be done to keep everyone safe.

episodes.name: Case 1_1: Los Angeles Connection
episodes.overview: Makoto and his partner make their living conning the innocent. But when a simple scam on a tourist goes awry, he's soon out of his depth in Los Angeles.

episodes.name: Case 1_2: Los Angeles Connection
episodes.overview: Dangling from the Hollywood sign, Makoto recalls his path from salesman to a life of crime. Back on the ground, he learns more about "confidence men."

episodes.name: Case 1_3: Los Angeles Connection
episodes.overview: Makoto tells Laurent how he got into Eddie's good graces, but keeping up the con isn't easy, and the LAPD is monitoring the situation closely.

episodes.name: Case 1_4: Los Angeles Connection
episodes.overview: With construction proceeding on the new lab, Makoto enjoys LA in the company of Eddie's enforcer, and Pola Dickens sets her sights on him.

episodes.name: Case 1_5: Los Angeles Connection
episodes.overview: The pressure is on as everyone watches Makoto make the first batch of Sakura Magic, but with Agent Dickens in his ear, things take a very serious turn.

episodes.name: Case 2_1: Singapore Sky
episodes.overview: Two years later, Makoto gets an honest job as a mechanic once he gets out, while Laurent and the crew reunite for a job in Las Vegas.

episodes.name: Case 2_2: Singapore Sky
episodes.overview: The crew heads to Singapore to begin the con on the two princes and the fixed Path Finder Air Race, but Makoto has concerns about Abbie's mental state.

episodes.name: Case 2_3: Singapore Sky
episodes.overview: When their first strategy fails, Laurent recruits some extra help, using Makoto's skills as a mechanic to deal with the stubborn elder prince.

episodes.name: Case 2_4: Singapore Sky
episodes.overview: Not realizing who the bookies are, the greedy prince places a series of eye-popping wagers. Abbie's harrowing past begins to affect her focus.

episodes.name: Case 2_5: Singapore Sky
episodes.overview: With the air race finals on the horizon, all the pieces move into place. Makoto has a serious talk with each pilot before making a wager of his own.

episodes.name: Case 3_1: Snow of London
episodes.overview: Working as a sushi chef while living in France, Makoto attempts to plan a con without Laurent's help after a pompous Englishman terrorizes the locals.

episodes.name: Case 3_2: Snow of London
episodes.overview: In London, Laurent and the team put their payback con against the "007 of the art world" into action. Cynthia reminisces about art and love.

episodes.name: Case 3_3: Snow of London
episodes.overview: Makoto searches for Thomas, the art forger connected to Cynthia, to create a fake version of "Snow of London." Laurent and Abbie's plan continues.

episodes.name: Case 3_4: Snow of London
episodes.overview: Laurent's fake dark auction begins with outrageous prices. Among the bidders, Coleman and Cynthia vie over "Snow of London."

episodes.name: Case 4_1: Wizard of Far East
episodes.overview: Determined to rebuild his life, Makoto parts ways with the team and returns to Japan. He lands a job, but doesn't know what he's gotten himself into.

episodes.name: Case 4_2: Wizard of Far East
episodes.overview: Cynthia and Shi-won arrive in Japan to start the con on Scarlet Company. Makoto and his boss accompany them to the UAE to witness a kidnapping.

episodes.name: Case 4_3: Wizard of Far East
episodes.overview: A delegation from the Shanghai branch of the Suzaku Group arrives in Tokyo. Summoned to translate, Makoto realizes the interpreter looks familiar.

episodes.name: Case 4_4: Wizard of Far East
episodes.overview: Two months after the end of the con, Makoto still works for Akemi. One night he receives a visit from a man he thought he saw die in front of him.

episodes.name: Case 4_5: Wizard of Far East
episodes.overview: A younger Laurent joins a group of con artists including Oz after unknowingly aiding them in Paris. As they travel around the world, he falls in love.

episodes.name: Case 4_6: Wizard of Far East
episodes.overview: On their last job, the team passes Dorothy off as an Ethiopian princess and stages her kidnapping for the Shanghai group. Then it all goes wrong.

episodes.name: Case 4_7: Wizard of Far East
episodes.overview: The final phase of the con on the Shanghai group starts when Laurent returns to the city. The stakes are higher than ever, with no margin for error.

episodes.name: Case 4_8: Wizard of Far East
episodes.overview: Both sides prepare for a fateful meeting in Tokyo, with Laurent and Makoto acting as translators. Everything depends on Makoto's choice.

episodes.name: Case 4_9: Wizard of Far East
episodes.overview: The Wizard of the Far East pulls off one final magic trick, and some people finally get what's coming to them.

seasons.name: razbliuto
seasons.overview: Presumed dead, master con artist and recovering amnesiac Dorothy is discovered by Shanghai Longu-bang, a mob who wants payback for her conning them. With no memories and nowhere to go, she must rely on a local crime underboss to elude Taipei's criminal underw…

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Lee Gon mourns the tragic death of his father. Lee Lim goes on the run — and finds escape when he comes across a door to a parallel universe.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Gon insists he is an emperor from another world. An incredulous Jeong Tae-eul takes him to the police station, where he sees a familiar face.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Though Tae-eul finds Gon's story difficult to believe, some things about him are completely inexplicable. At work, she gets busy with a murder case.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: When Tae-eul loses her police badge, she can't help but think about Gon. Meanwhile, Kang Sin-jae has had it with his mother's bad habits.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Being introduced to Gon's world is a lot to process for Tae-eul, who's taken to the palace. A disgruntled Jo Yeong keeps an eye on her.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: A potential military conflict threatens the kingdom. Gon promises Tae-eul he will return to her, and steps forward to take care of the situation.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Gon brings Yeong along on his trip back to Tae-eul. He has a favor to ask of her, while she's found something troubling to share with him.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: In Corea, Luna is set free. In Korea, Gon and Yeong run into a man who recognizes them, and Sin-jae experiences childhood flashbacks.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Gon draws closer to tracking down Lim, and asks Jo Eun-sup to trade places with Yeong. Mail from an unknown sender bothers Koo Seo-ryeong.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: On Lunar New Year, Gon and Lim come face-to-face in a public standoff. Tae-eul opens up to Sin-jae about the other world and her ongoing case.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: A compelling offer finds its way to Luna. Gon's investigation into a devastating murder leads him to an old traitor and a clearer idea of Lim's schemes.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Frightening circumstances land Tae-eul back in Gon's arms. When Yeong runs into a woman who looks strikingly familiar, he follows her.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Knowing Seo-ryeong is up to no good, Gon throws her in a tight spot. Upon returning to her world, Tae-eul realizes Luna is there, too.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Gon and Tae-eul are separated when he sets out to fulfill what's been his fate all along. Sin-jae makes a startling discovery.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Lim plots his next meeting with Gon. Understanding there's only one thing he can do to right wrongs, Gon comes to a heart-wrenching decision.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: A final attempt to put a stop to Lim's ambitions comes with profound consequences. Gon travels far and wide in search of Tae-eul.

episodes.name: Toppled
episodes.overview: The peaceful Mexican town of San Simon and a trio of Daoist martial arts pupils are attacked by a mutated initiate from an occult crime organization.

episodes.name: Grief
episodes.overview: Chiu's students are left reeling in the wake of their loss. El Balde summons his fellow jefes and transforms them into flesh-eating monsters.

episodes.name: Night of the Wolves
episodes.overview: Brister and Garcia seek clues to the origins of the demonic creatures while Isabela, Jesus and Silencio do the same as they mourn their fallen master.

episodes.name: Caged Dogs
episodes.overview: After uncovering the truth about their peaceful town, Isabela and Jesus are arrested while Silencio becomes a fugitive. El Balde comes to San Simon.

episodes.name: Blindfold
episodes.overview: El Balde terrorizes the town of San Simon while Chiu's students meet Lo, their former master's brother. Brister and Garcia try to rescue Garabina.

episodes.name: Reunion
episodes.overview: Lo's true nature emerges. Isabela, Silencio and Jesus join forces with Brister and Garcia to raid El Balde's compound and find his mother, Alejandra.

episodes.name: Between This World and the Next
episodes.overview: An earth-shattering showdown unfolds between El Balde and his mother, Alejandra, who has possessed the body of Isabela. Silencio succumbs to anger.

episodes.name: The Empty Place
episodes.overview: The team battles a surprising nemesis with seemingly insurmountable powers. He reveals Chiu's secret past -- and offers Silencio a fateful choice.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Amnesiac Caiman seeks to undo his lizard head curse by killing the sorcerer responsible, with his friend Nikaido's help. In the Hole, that's a threat.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Caiman and Nikaido hunt for the sorcerer who cursed him with a lizard's head, while Fujita returns to the Hole to avenge Matsumura's death.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: "Cleaners" Shin and Noi get to work in the Hole. Meanwhile, Caiman and Nikaido search for a sorcerer who uses acupuncture to change faces.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Caiman and Nikaido take part in the annual Night of the Living Dead. But before they can finish their mission, Shin and Noi show up to finish them.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: En consults his comrade Turkey, whose magical dolls may identify the "lizard guy." Caiman and Nikaido visit Kasukabe, a professor studying sorcerers.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: In the sorcerers' world, Caiman and Nikaido locate a man with cross eyes, but the trail goes cold when Shin and Noi show up on a mission.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: En's mushroom magic gravely injures Nikaido when she infiltrates his mansion. Dr. Vaux and Professor Kasukabe tell Caiman about Shin's dark past.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Plotting to avenge Matsumura, Fujita joins the Hole Peace Hospital's baseball team: their rival team has his friend's killer Caiman on the roster.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Fearing for Nikaido's safety, Caiman returns to the sorcerers' world alone. The En family begins preparations for the Blue Night Party festivities.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Caiman sneaks into the festival grounds in pursuit of Risu. Meanwhile, En tells Fujita the story of how Shin and Noi became partners.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Nikaido dons a powerful mask to defeat her enemy, only to find the attack was a trap by En. With Tanba's help, Caiman visits one of the Cross-Eyes.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: As a member of the family, Nikaido learns why En needs a sorcerer who can manipulate time. Caiman disguises himself as Tanba's wife to rescue her.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Caiman tries to convince Nikaido to return to the Hole with him, but her contract with En binds her. After the fight, En launches a search for her.

episodes.name: LET'S USE OUR RESOURCES WITH CARE / HORROR! BLOODY MANSION SLAUGHTER DANCE
episodes.overview: While Risu tracks down the Cross-Eyes' hideout, Kasukabe's group heads off to find the professor's estranged wife, only to make a gruesome discovery.

episodes.name: MEOTO ZENZAI / MASTEMA SUBNADE / THE TRAGIC TALE OF THE CROSS-EYES
episodes.overview: The battle heats up as Shin and Noi fight for their lives. Caiman and Nikaido find themselves being followed as they explore a bustling underground city.

episodes.name: SWEET HOME / SHINING YOUTH / MEMORIES KEEP CIRCLING ROUND AND ROUND / COME BACK HOME
episodes.overview: Ebisu regains her memories after eating En's new product. Meanwhile, Caiman experiences a violent flashback and Kasukabe goes grave-digging in the Hole.

episodes.name: GOLDEN BEETLES ARE RICH / CUTE BUTCHER / DOOR TO THE PAST
episodes.overview: So the Cross-Eyes gang figured they’d make the landlord’s murder look like a suicide, huh? As for Asu, who dared to keep things from me, I made sure he paid for it.

episodes.name: MEETING IN THE RAIN / TRAVEL COMPANIONS / FINAL NIGHT FOR TWO
episodes.overview: Looks like Ebisu got her memory back, thanks to eating some weird mushrooms, and now she’s all eager to head back to her parents’ place.

episodes.name: FAREWELL, CAIMAN / MEMORY BUBBLES
episodes.overview: En’s found the lizard guy and Nikaido, and they’re going at it hard. Meanwhile, the Cross-Eyes guys are sitting around swapping stories about their boss.

episodes.name: MY SECRET PLAN / CROSS-EYE EXPEDITION / DEFORMED REUNION
episodes.overview: Fujita's losing his mind trying to get Kikurage to bring Ebisu back to life. The Cross-Eyes guys are scrambling for cash, and things around En are starting to get kind of dicey.

episodes.name: CHAOS SHOCK / BLACK BOX / ROOM 501
episodes.overview: I never imagined En would go down that easily. The sorcerers are thrown into total chaos. And now I get why Nikaido doesn't use magic.

episodes.name: MOSH PIT / CROSS-EYES IN THE NEWS
episodes.overview: The Cross-Eyes boss has finally shown up. The En Family's been wiped out, and it looks like the Cross-Eyes have taken over that huge mansion.

episodes.name: LUCKY JERK / ADVANCED MAGIC
episodes.overview: Looks like they've found missing Kikurage. And that bastard Asu, well, Kawajiri now, is sneaking around, up to something weird again. That Haru chick’s getting a little too carried away.

episodes.name: BALLAD OF THE HAPPY DESTRUCTION / QUESTION & ANSWER
episodes.overview: Looks like Kawajiri and Nikaido have slipped into En's mansion, which the Cross-Eyes have taken over. There, Nikaido runs right into Aikawa. The mystery surrounding the Cross-Eyes boss just keeps getting deeper.

episodes.name: Hand
episodes.overview: Jo Tae-sik inspects an apparent suicide. After learning that Kim Seung-cheol died in a car accident, Kim Seo-hui can’t get a hold of Jeong Sang-hun.

episodes.name: Target
episodes.overview: Tae-sik and his team look into Sang-hun's disappearance -- and learn he and Seung-cheol were working on something together.

episodes.name: Bait
episodes.overview: When a factory worker he'd been trying to find turns up dead, Tae-sik investigates. Seo-hui forces herself through a tough campaign trail.

episodes.name: Restart
episodes.overview: Another grisly package surfaces. Tae-sik and his team suspect In Dong-gu is involved. Seo-hui tries to understand a bill that her party wants passed.

episodes.name: The Other Side
episodes.overview: Suspecting something is amiss at the mental hospital, the cops send Jeon Ho-gyu undercover. Seo-hui eavesdrops on Hong Min-guk and Dong-gu.

episodes.name: Disappear
episodes.overview: Tae-sik untangles the mystery of the mental hospital -- but Sang-hun remains missing. Seo-hui confronts Jeong Yeong-mun about what he knew.

episodes.name: Jealousy
episodes.overview: The search for answers continues as the police turn their attention to Jin Yeong-min, who turns out to have a long history with Sang-hun.

episodes.name: Eye
