episodes.overview: Seo-hui comes clean to Tae-sik about the mysterious messages she's been hiding, and probes into a funeral Sang-hun attended before he vanished.

episodes.name: KEY
episodes.overview: While Tae-sik's reinvestigation into Choe Su-hyeon's death ruffles feathers left and right, Seo-hui asks around about her connection to Sang-hun.

episodes.name: Bottomless Pit
episodes.overview: Ignoring his suspension, Tae-sik chases leads from the list in the USB drive with Seo-hui. Kang Jin-gyeong brings Ho-gyu the dead laptop.

episodes.name: Framed
episodes.overview: Tae-sik recovers the list while on the run from authorities. Meanwhile, Jin-gyeong gets to the bottom of who framed him.

episodes.name: Disclosure
episodes.overview: Tae-sik and Jin-gyeong channel their grief into helping Seo-hui, who discovers a startling truth about what connects the people on the list.

episodes.name: Real Intention
episodes.overview: Getting their hands on damning evidence allows Tae-sik and Jin-gyeong to set a trap. Seo-hui receives another message.

episodes.name: Survivor
episodes.overview: Trying to turn votes against the bill, Seo-hui holds a press conference. Tae-sik tails Yeong-min, who has his own plans for the future of JQ Group.

episodes.name: Original Sin
episodes.overview: If Seo-hui wants to save Sang-hun, she must find one last crucial piece of evidence among her father's things. Yeong-min delivers an ultimatum.

episodes.name: Those Who Were Silent, Those Who Were Not
episodes.overview: Yeong-min and Dong-gu have a final face-to-face. A heartbreaking letter from Sang-hun is difficult to swallow for Seo-hui, but doubly so for Yeong-mun.

episodes.name: It's Diwali
episodes.overview: Bheem wants to help prepare for the festivities, but will he and his animal pals create a decor disaster?

episodes.name: Temple Trouble
episodes.overview: A visit to the temple is anything but peaceful when Bheem rings the bells - and danger answers!

episodes.name: Fireworks
episodes.overview: While at the palace for the fireworks, Bheem's busy chasing laddoos... and crawls right into a crime scene!

episodes.name: Little Bo Peep
episodes.overview: While working as security for a merchant, exterminator Kidow intervenes when insects attack, then promises to convey young Ilie to her mother.

episodes.name: Anchovy and Black Lizard
episodes.overview: As gruesome murders come to light, Kidow suspects they're not the work of insects. When Ilie goes to the market, someone steals her bag.

episodes.name: From the Abyss
episodes.overview: Ilie befriends the leader of the Red Rats. At Mario Garden, Kidow receives a letter and a map marked with the locations of the murders.

episodes.name: As a Heartless Sword
episodes.overview: The army prepares to exterminate an insect lurking in the sand beneath E-05. Still regretting his actions five years ago, Qasim volunteers as bait.

episodes.name: From the Far East
episodes.overview: Ilie learns from Mario how Kidow's adoptive father, Lazarus, taught him the harsh lessons of survival in the Cagaster-infested Far East.

episodes.name: Awakening
episodes.overview: A man claiming to be Ilie's father arrives to take her away. She and Kidow try to flee, but are ambushed by Acht before they can make their escape.

episodes.name: Iliaster
episodes.overview: Searching for clues to Ilie's past, Jin and Kidow discover a message that Griffith recorded for Franz, explaining his actions and Ilie's origins.

episodes.name: Princess in the Insect Cage
episodes.overview: Adham's forces plot to overthrow the Bazaar Overseer and turn E-05 into an insect cage. Kidow escapes to E-07, where Ilie is now held prisoner.

episodes.name: Insects' Feast
episodes.overview: Kidow infiltrates E-07's main tower in search of Ilie. After learning the truth of her origins, Ilie proclaims herself the next queen of the cage.

episodes.name: Up
episodes.overview: Reunited, Ilie and Kidow make their way up to the throne room, but Adham's security detail and numerous Cagasters stand in their way.

episodes.name: To You…
episodes.overview: Gravely injured, Franz guides Ilie to the queen's chamber and gives her control over Tania's fate. Acht and Kidow face off for the final time.

episodes.name: Finally, For You
episodes.overview: As the battle between Salif’s forces and the defenders of E-05 come to an end, the survivors inside E-07's main tower confront their futures.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Knocked out by fierce winds while paragliding through the air, Yun Se-ri wakes up on the north side of the Korean DMZ, where Ri Jeong Hyeok finds her.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: After talking Jeong Hyeok and his comrades into hiding her in his home, Se-ri gets a taste of his way of life. Gu Seung-jun buys refuge in Pyongyang.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Jeong Hyeok invents a bold background story for Se-ri, but Cho Cheol Gang isn't so easy to fool. Seo Dan returns to North Korea.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: When her escape plan falls through, Se-ri turns to another idea for a way out. Dan heads to the village to see Jeong Hyeok.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Jeong Hyeok agrees to marry Dan sooner, as his parents wish, but they must do him a favor first. Seung-jun catches a glimpse of Se-ri.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Dan is less than happy when she hears Jeong Hyeok and Se-ri are at a hotel together. Meanwhile, Seung-jun plays what cards he has to save himself.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: A flight out of North Korea awaits Se-ri at the airport. But unwilling to leave Jeong Hyeok while he's injured, she brings him to the hospital instead.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Keeping Jeong Hyeok away from Se-ri turns out to be much more difficult than Seung-jun anticipated. Cheol Gang stays on their tail.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Se-ri faces her kidnapper. Elsewhere, Jeong Hyeok is forced to spread a formidable rumor about himself in order to escape Cheol Gang's clutches.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Back to her cushy life in the spotlight, Se-ri takes care of business — though nothing feels quite the same. Jeong Hyeok goes after Cheol Gang.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: It's Jeong Hyeok's turn to adjust to a new world. Back in North Korea, Dan gives Seung-jun a place to stay after he loses his protection.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Hoping to meet Jeong Hyeok, his comrades attend an event hosted by Se-ri's company. Seung-jun opens up to Dan over a bowl of rice porridge.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Se-ri sends the comrades on a shopping spree, and plays hooky from work with Jeong Hyeok. Jung Man Bok encounters a dilemma.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: While Jeong Hyeok keeps watch over Se-ri, his comrades make themselves useful. Seung-jun can't stop worrying about Dan.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: South Korean officials try to figure out what's going on, but they're given conflicting stories. Seung-jun flees from his captors.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Before departing, Jeong Hyeok leaves behind a surprise that keeps on giving. Dan delivers bittersweet justice.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: When a ghost turns up dead and train passengers go missing, Trese's investigation leads her to an aswang clan by the pier and a corrupt city official.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: In a flashback, Trese's father searches for a heart-stealing killer. Trese pursues the sons of two clan leaders who may be behind recent transgressions.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Ramona attempts a blood ritual to exact revenge. Trese, the "boys" and Hank protect an actress as Trese receives a warning of "liars amongst allies."

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: While Trese fights to undo a spell that sent zombies to attack the police station, Hank tries to uncover details about the coming turmoil.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: After a rash of bombings, the Council makes a surprising decision. Trese discovers who’s been responsible for manipulating recent events all along.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: With humanity and the supernatural world both in danger, Trese confronts Talagbusao to fight her own destiny — and learns the truth about her father.

episodes.name: Welcome to Jinyeong Branch
episodes.overview: Sun Woong, a prosecutor at the Jinyeong Branch in the southernmost of Korea introduces his workplace. The case he’s working on now is a dispute between a shaman and his customer. They believe he didn’t perform exorcism after being paid, but the shaman himself…

episodes.name: Myung Ju Comes to Jinyeong Branch
episodes.overview: Sun Woong is surprised to see Myung Ju, an old acquaintance he’s known since in college years. She’s pretty, smart, and one of the most competent prosecutors in Korea. Everyone at the Jinyeong Branch start to wonder what must’ve caused her to come all the way…

episodes.name: Don’t Fall for Her Act
episodes.overview: Jung Woo gets to work with Myung Ju. On his first day in Myung Ju’s office, an old lady wearing shabby clothes comes to the office. He falls for the old lady’s act, and that’s when Myung Ju shows up to set things right. Meanwhile, Jong Hak is heavily stressed…

episodes.name: Sun Woong and Myung Ju Working Together on the Same Cases
episodes.overview: A middle-aged man named Kim Young Choon is arrested after he assaulted his boss in the middle of the night. He is also known to have committed the obstruction of business against his boss. Two charges are filed against Kim Young Choon. Sun Woong and Myung Ju…

episodes.name: Myung Ju Goes Undercover
episodes.overview: Criminal Department 2 comes across an unexpected tip about a hidden gambling den in the mountains. They decide to send someone to the gambling den undercover, but the only person whose face is unfamiliar to the target is Myung Ju. However, she does not know a…

episodes.name: Myung Ju’s Past
episodes.overview: The crackdown on the hidden gambling den is a success and hordes of people are arrested and interrogated by the prosecutors of Jinyeong. Among the people who were brought in from the gambling site is a man who seems to know Myung Ju quite well. Myung Ju decid…

episodes.name: School Violence
episodes.overview: Sun Woong gets a surprise visit from his son Jae Hoon. It turns out that Jae Hoon is in trouble for bullying a classmate. Meanwhile, Myung Ju works on a school violence case in which a middle-school girl jumped from her school building after being bullied. Su…

episodes.name: Yoon Jin Disappears
episodes.overview: Yoon Jin has a tough few days trying to juggle work and her sick twins. With her mother-in-law and husband to consider on top of it all, she passes out from exhaustion and wakes up in the emergency room. Sun Woong and the others go home after her family arriv…

episodes.name: King Camulos and the Ax
episodes.overview: Promotion season is officially here, and the prosecutors of the Jinyeong Branch are being extra cautious not to stir things up. However, Jung Woo breaks the peace, making Min Ho anxious. To make things worse, the notorious Mr. Hwang, also known as the Ax, is…

episodes.name: The Carpenter’s Ruler Club
episodes.overview: Branch Chief Kim In Ju is on the brink of his big promotion to Chief Prosecutor when he comes across the biggest crisis of his career. Meanwhile, Myung Ju and Sun Woong continue to bicker over everything, including a fraud case that involves a local assemblym…

episodes.name: Branch Chief Kim’s Retirement
episodes.overview: As Branch Chief Kim In Ju prepares for his retirement, the people of Jinyeong Branch get busy preparing for a big farewell. Chief Kim wonders what he will do after he retires and meets other former prosecutors who are now working elsewhere. He also remembers…

episodes.name: The New Branch Chief
episodes.overview: Choi Jong Hoon, the new branch chief, arrives at the Jinyeong Branch and he a harsher boss than anyone could have possibly imagined. He seems determined to grill Criminal Department 2, despite Min Ho's efforts to get on his good side. Meanwhile, Jung Woo gets…

episodes.name: Fraud Nation
episodes.overview: In a nation that boasts two fraud cases every minute, all sorts of swindlers and their victims show up at Jinyeong Branch. Meanwhile, a familiar face reappears in a trial that Sun Woong attends, requesting to be released on bail. As Mi Ran struggles to overco…

episodes.name: Insubordination
episodes.overview: Sun Woong’s negligence brings shame and dishonor on Branch Chief Choi Jong Hoon and apparently the entire Prosecution. The battle between Sun Woong and Chief Choi begins with both their pride on the line. As Min Ho continues to take the flack for Sun Woong’s…

episodes.name: The Inspection
episodes.overview: Inspectors from the Supreme Prosecutors’ Office come to Jinyeong and a dangerous game of Russian Roulette begins. The inspection team seems determined to dig up every error made by the Jinyeong prosecutors in both their work and personal lives. Meanwhile, Jun…

episodes.name: The Special Investigation Team
episodes.overview: The former branch chief of Jinyeong, Mr. Kim In Ju, makes a brilliant comeback as the head of the special investigation team. Mr. Kim requests to have either Sun Woong or Myung Ju join his team in Seoul and they make a bet to decide who gets to go. To settle…

episodes.name: McLaren
episodes.overview: Host Chris Harris drives the stunning, cutting-edge McLaren P1, one of the most advanced sports cars in the world, and /DRIVE visits the home of McLaren, Formula One's technology leader, at its headquarters in Wolking, UK, to see how its latest supercars are…

episodes.name: Against All Odds
episodes.overview: Host Matt Farah takes on the wickedly fast, 1,200-horsepower Hennessey Venom GT, and Mike Musto treks to a California desert for the toughest one-day off-road race in the U.S.

episodes.name: Questionable Road Usage
episodes.overview: Host Chris Harris leaves the world of supercars to stop traffic in his 1957 Citroen, and Mike Musto braves the highways in a burnout machine built from junkyard parts.

episodes.name: Ferrari, Ferrari, Ferrari
episodes.overview: Host Chris Harris tests the $1 million Ferrari LaFerrari on a famous Italian racetrack, and Mike Spinelli solves the mystery of a Ferrari stolen in the 1970s and found buried in Los Angeles.

episodes.name: Best Made Cars in the World
episodes.overview: /DRIVE uncovers the high-performance secrets behind a multimillion-dollar supercar, and Chris Harris travels to southern California in search of the perfect Porsche 911.

episodes.name: Opposites Attract
episodes.overview: Chris Harris travels to Spain to test the stunning Jaguar F-Type Coupe R, and find out how a pizza delivery guy built a "junk heap" Mazda that became an internet sensation.

episodes.name: Back to the Future
episodes.overview: Matt Farah goes "back to the future" in an all-electric Delorean sports car, and /DRIVE hosts find the high speed, high-tech secrets behind the Porsche 918 supercar.

episodes.name: Foreign Car Culture
episodes.overview: /DRIVE hosts take a death-defying ride on Panama's infamous "red devil" racing buses, and travel to South Africa's Western Cape in search of the world's best driving roads.

episodes.name: The Ultimate /DRIVE
episodes.overview: Chris Harris meets a pair of classic Ferrari poster cars from the 1980s, and gives them a racetrack workout, and Mike Musto does massive burnouts in a Cadillac hot rod.

episodes.name: Middle East Special
episodes.overview: /DRIVE on NBC Sports hosts Chris Harris, Matt Farah and Mike Spinelli embark on an epic road trip in three modern supercars, to seek out and explore car cultures of the middle east, from the home of the Bahrain Grand Prix to the mythical "road to nowhere" on…

episodes.name: German Special
episodes.overview: /DRIVE hosts Chris Harris, Matt Farah and Mike Spinelli find the stories behind Germany's national obsession with speed and technology, track-test three amazing German cars, and discover the "Area 51" where sports cars of the future are tested.

episodes.name: American Speed
episodes.overview: Matt Farah, Mike Musto and Mike Spinelli test two all-American performance cars, the Corvette Z06 and Tesla P85D, and experience NASCAR history, from its humble beginnings on dirt tracks, to the science of the super speedway at Daytona.

episodes.name: American Road Trip
episodes.overview: Hosts Chris Harris, Matt Farah and Mike Spinelli take three great American sports cars on a tire-smoking road trip, from drag racing in downtown Detroit to setting lap times at Watkins Glen, one of the most iconic racetracks in US racing history.

episodes.name: Japan Special
episodes.overview: /DRIVE hosts explore the Japanese auto industry and car culture. They drive three quintessential Japanese sports cars on Hakone Turnpike, an epic mountain road that inspires video games.

episodes.name: Texas Special
episodes.overview: /DRIVE hosts Chris Harris, Matt Farah and Mike Spinelli explore Texas car culture, from the fastest highway in the U.S. to the spectacular driving roads of the Hill Country, and meet the larger-than-life characters that make The Lone Star State a best kept se…

episodes.name: The Turbocharged Future
episodes.overview: Matt and Mike argue over whether today's turbo-charged engines are any good by comparing sports car icons on a mountain road and at the drag strip. Chris experiences just how good a turbo car can be in a Ferrari 458 on a wet track.

episodes.name: BMW M
episodes.overview: Many marques offer fast and comfortable high-end cars, but it started with BMW's M division. Matt drives a couple legendary M's in South Carolina. Mike views some top secret M prototypes in Munich. Chris drives the new M2 at Nürburgring.

episodes.name: The Best Cars with the Letter "R"
episodes.overview: Chris, Matt, and Mike turn a shaky premise for an episode into an excuse to charge across Britain in some of the most hard-core street cars available today, to see which is the loudest, the fastest, and the best, on the road and the track.

episodes.name: The Autonomous Car
episodes.overview: Alex Roy and Mike Spinelli look at cars that drive themselves including the first ever autonomous track day, putting partly self-driving cars from Mercedes and Tesla to a real-world test, and how close Ford is to a fully driverless car.

episodes.name: Colorado Special
episodes.overview: Chris, Matt and Mike set out across Colorado on an epic trip in three very different vehicles, crossing some of America's most beautiful terrain to determine who has chosen the best vehicle for experiencing nature.

episodes.name: What Makes Fast
episodes.overview: Matt Farah takes a powerful Camaro 1LE to a NASCAR wind tunnel. Mike Spinelli drives a lightweight Ariel Atom 3S and gets car control tips from factory Porsche driver Patrick Long. Chris Harris goes flat out in a second generation Ford GT.

episodes.name: Miami Vices
episodes.overview: A hilarious look at the best (and worst) of Miami's car scene, with a new Lamborghini; an old Ferrari; a speedboat; and a donk limousine.

episodes.name: Cheap Racing
episodes.overview: Chris Harris, Matt Farah and Mike Spinelli try to match lap times with a pro driver as they test the limits of a beater BMW in a grueling 24-hour endurance race.

episodes.name: Electrification
episodes.overview: The hosts explore the high-speed, high-performance future of electric and hybrid cars.

episodes.name: Italy Returns
episodes.overview: The team travels to Italy to drive the country's best cars, roads and race tracks.

episodes.name: National Parks Tribute
episodes.overview: The hosts embark on an epic burn through the great national parks of the American west, from Zion to Death Valley to Yosemite.

episodes.name: Iceland Adventure
episodes.overview: The beauty of Iceland in summer is the backdrop for a race between Matt Farah in a McLaren 570GT and Mike Spinelli and Chris Harris who rough it across the country's volcanic center in a Ford F-150 Raptor.

episodes.name: A Car of the Year
episodes.overview: Hosts Mike Spinelli, Chris Harris, and Alex Roy challenge one another to find the best car in a send-up of automotive magazine car-of-the-year awards. It's McLaren 720S versus Jeep Grand Cherokee Trackhawk versus Audi RS3.

episodes.name: L.A. Car Culture
episodes.overview: The car culture of Los Angeles explored with a visit to Singer Vehicle Design's amazing shop by Mike Spinelli, a look at the underground racing scene with Alex Roy, and a visit to ArtCenter College of Design in Pasadena with Kristen Lee.

episodes.name: How Far We've Come
episodes.overview: Chris Harris drives a succession of Porsches representing the pinnacle of performance in their eras, including the Porsche 930 Turbo, 959 and 918 Spyder. It ends with a drive in the amazing Porsche 919 Evo race car.

episodes.name: Grassroots Racing
episodes.overview: What's the best grassroots motorsport? Zack Klapman goes drifting, Alex Roy tries the Power Racing Series, and Mike Spinelli goes to the top of Pikes Peak to find out.

episodes.name: Oregon Trail Road Trip
episodes.overview: Overlanding the original Oregon Trail, Alex Roy brings a six-figure off-road Mercedes while Mike Spinelli goes traditional in a Jeep Wrangler and Zack Klapman goes simple in an Arial Nomad.

episodes.name: French Cars
episodes.overview: The hosts learn about the global renaissance for French cars and a plan for coming back to the United States.

episodes.name: Le Mans Pilgrimage
episodes.overview: The one-hour season finale is a scenic road trip to Le Mans through Europe in a trio of extreme sports cars. Chris Harris picks up a Ferrari 488 GTB in Italy to meet Mike Spinelli in a Porsche 911 GT3 and Zack Klapman in an Aston Martin.

episodes.name: NYC
episodes.overview: A tribute to New York City. Kristen and Mike tell the story of Max Hoffman in a Porsche 718 Boxster GTS and a BMW Z4. Alex meets the NYPD Auto Crimes Division. Kristen goes for a trip in a garbage truck. Mike visits the Classic Car Club.

episodes.name: Dirty Motorsports
episodes.overview: Mike learns how to drive a monster truck and host Zack Klapman discovers the joy of rallying then tries to do it in an Infiniti Q60. Alex and Mike attempt to drive a stage of the Baja. Alex tells Mike a secret.

episodes.name: IMSA
episodes.overview: A tribute to 50 years of IMSA. Chris Harris tries his hand at the Porsche 911 GT3 RS and Ferrari 488 Pista and related race cars. Mike becomes a strategist for the Magnus Racing Lamborghini team - it could have gone worse.

episodes.name: Electric Mayhem
episodes.overview: Electric cars aren't just good for the environment, they can also be a great time. Zack drives a Tesla Model S powered sand buggy and an electric 1995 BMW M3 Pikes Peak racer. Mike and Chris review Tesla's history and test the new Model 3.

episodes.name: AMG
episodes.overview: Inside the famous Mercedes performance brand. Mike tries the original Hammer, Chris drives the wheels off a vintage Mercedes DTM race car, a GT4 race car, and the wonderful GT-R Pro. Kristen compares the new AMG C63 S to her classic AMG.

episodes.name: Morocco
episodes.overview: Our hosts take a weekend road trip to Africa in a trio of fitting vehicles: Chris in a new Ford Ranger Raptor, Spinelli in the Maserati GranCabrio MC, and Alex Roy in a Renault Kangoo Extrem. Alex buys many scarves.

episodes.name: Ryomen Sukuna
episodes.overview: After visiting his beloved grandfather in the hospital, Yuji Itadori encounters an apprentice sorcerer who demands that Yuji hand over a cursed relic.

episodes.name: For Myself
episodes.overview: Yuji manages to control the curse of Ryomen Sukuna. Later, he awakens in a room with Jujutsu High teacher Satoru Gojo, who offers him a deadly choice.

episodes.name: Girl of Steel
episodes.overview: Nobara Kugisaki joins the class on a trip to Roppongi where Gojo gives her and Yuji their first test: dispel a curse from an abandoned building.

episodes.name: Curse Womb Must Die
episodes.overview: When a curse womb attacks a juvenile detention center, Yuji's group is called upon to rescue any remaining survivors — but combat isn’t an option.

episodes.name: Curse Womb Must Die -II-
episodes.overview: As Sukuna gruesomely holds Yuji's body hostage, Fushiguro struggles against the sheer strength of Sukuna's curse to buy time until Yuji can awaken.

episodes.name: After Rain
episodes.overview: Sukuna tells Yuji that he will bring him back to life on two conditions. Meanwhile, Suguru Geto and a cursed spirit discuss their plans for Gojo.

episodes.name: Assault
episodes.overview: The cursed spirit Jogo attacks Gojo, who has such little trouble fighting back that he leaves and brings back a student to observe the battle.

episodes.name: Boredom
episodes.overview: As Kugisaki and Fushiguro train for the exchange event, two older students from the Kyoto Jujutsu school arrive in Tokyo and pick a fight with them.

episodes.name: Small Fry and Reverse Retribution
episodes.overview: High schooler Junpei Yoshino finds his bullies horrifically killed in a movie theater. Sorcerer Kento Nanami and Yuji investigate the crime scene.

episodes.name: Idle Transfiguration
episodes.overview: Junpei gets some startling advice from Mahito. Later, Ijichi and Yuji track down Junpei and formulate a plan to set up a chance encounter with him.

episodes.name: Narrow-minded
episodes.overview: Annoyed at having to work off the clock, Nanami shows Mahito the true potential of his sorcery. Meanwhile, Yuji and Junpei bond over movies.

episodes.name: To You, Someday
episodes.overview: Ignoring Nanami's warning, Yuji dashes into the school and tries to reason with Junpei, but Mahito soon interrupts. Yuji appeals to Sukuna for help.

episodes.name: Tomorrow
episodes.overview: Yuji and Nanami coordinate their attacks on Mahito, wearing him down. But as the cursed spirit approaches death, he finds a new power within himself.

episodes.name: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 0 -
episodes.overview: With the exchange event between the Tokyo and Kyoto Jujutsu schools set to begin, Gojo arranges for Yuji to make a surprise appearance.

episodes.name: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 1 -
episodes.overview: Shortly after the exchange event team battle begins, Todo ambushes the Tokyo students. Yuji moves to stop him but soon finds himself surrounded.

episodes.name: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 2 -
episodes.overview: Todo gives Yuji advice on how to better tap into his curse powers. After Kugisaki taunts Nishimiya, Panda fights the remote-controlled Mechamaru.

episodes.name: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event - Group Battle 3 -
episodes.overview: While Miwa struggles to stand her ground against Maki's attacks, Kugisaki chases down a flying Nishimiya, who lectures her about Mai's hardships.

episodes.name: Sage
episodes.overview: Fushiguro dodges Kamo's barrage of arrows but his opponent proves just as formidable in close combat. Meanwhile, Inumaki senses a foreboding presence.

episodes.name: Black Flash
episodes.overview: Inumaki, Fushiguro and Kamo struggle to hold their own against special grade cursed spirit Hanami, but Maki arrives to provide much-needed backup.

episodes.name: Nonstandard
episodes.overview: After analyzing Hanami's assortment of skills with his self-proclaimed intellect, Todo uses his disorienting technique to attack in tandem with Yuji.

episodes.name: Jujutsu Koshien
episodes.overview: After the event's interruption, the school tournament continues with a baseball match.

episodes.name: The Origin of Blind Obedience
episodes.overview: An investigation into a string of curse-related killings leads Yuji, Fushiguro and Kugisaki to the victims' – and Fushiguro's – former middle school.

episodes.name: The Origin of Blind Obedience -II-
episodes.overview: Fushiguro, Kugisaki and Itadori fight the cursed spirits on two fronts. When Fushiguro faces his enemy alone, he recalls his recent training with Gojo. He knows that he has to be able to surpass himself...

episodes.name: Accomplices
episodes.overview: Yuji and Nobara's battle against the Death Painting Wombs Kechizu and Eso reaches its conclusion! However, even in victory there is a cost in killing, something the Jujutsu High students had never considered before. Meanwhile, Choso, Geto and Mahito gain wind…

episodes.name: Hidden Inventory
episodes.overview: The jujutsu sorcerers Iori Utahime and Mei Mei are dispatched to an ominous manor where several people have gone missing. They infiltrate the manor and attempt to destroy the cursed spirit's barrier, but suddenly the building starts to crumble.

episodes.name: Hidden Inventory 2
episodes.overview: Gojo and Geto are assigned to the mission of escorting and erasing the young girl compatible with the Tengen - the Star Plasma Vessel. Amanai Riko is being targeted by the Curse User Group Q, and the religious cult the Star Religious Group.

episodes.name: Hidden Inventory 3
episodes.overview: Gojo and Geto beat back the curse users after the bounty placed on Amanai's head when her cell phone rings. A captured Kuroi is displayed on her phone. Gojo tries to bring Amanai back to Jujutsu High, but she insists on going to the negotiations herself.

episodes.name: Hidden Inventory 4
episodes.overview: "Let's go home, Riko-chan." The moment Geto extends a hand to Amanai, the worst that could possibly happen does. Geto is left dumbstruck as Toji Fushiguro makes his appearance. Toji then declares that he killed Satoru Gojo.

episodes.name: Premature Death
episodes.overview: August 2007. Gojo starts to handle missions on his own, causing Geto to, as well. One day a certain individual appears before Geto. What's the conclusion that led to Gojo becoming the strongest jujutsu sorcerer, and Geto becoming the most evil curse user?

episodes.name: It's Like That
episodes.overview: 2018. After finishing a mission one day, Itadori decides to go to the movies, Kugisaki decides to go shopping, and Fushiguro tells them he's going home. After parting ways Kugisaki is approached by a woman who suddenly asks if she was with Itadori-kun.

episodes.name: Evening Festival
episodes.overview: The battle between Muta and Mahito continues and reaches its conclusion. Later, on October 31st, a veil is lowered over Shibuya and various jujutsu sorcerer teams assemble around the area.

episodes.name: Shibuya Incident
episodes.overview: Team Mei Mei are reassigned to a veil that has been lowered over Meiji Shrine Station. The team splits up and Yuji encounters a grasshopper curse assigned to protecting the veil. Elsewhere Satoru Gojo encounters Jogo, Hanami, and Choso.

episodes.name: Shibuya Incident - Gate, Open
episodes.overview: The battle between Satoru Gojo, Jogo, Hanami and Choso begins. Gojo informs Hanami that they will die first. Yuji encounters a woman who tells him that everyone was turned into monsters and boarded a train. As Gojo's battle continues, the train arrives.

episodes.name: Pandemonium
episodes.overview: Now that Satoru Gojo has been sealed, Mechamaru works with Team Mei Mei to inform them about what is going on and has them work on enacting his plan on what to do now.

episodes.name: Seance
episodes.overview: Nanami, Fushiguro, and Ino meet up with Itadori, then Nanami issues new orders for the others to work together to lift the veil keeping sorcerers out.

episodes.name: Dull Knife
episodes.overview: Yuji and Megumi lift the veil that was keeping sorcerers from entering Shibuya. Nobara and Nitta encounter Shigemo and a battle ensues. Shigemo has the upperhand, but then Nanami arrives with the deaths of the assistant supervisors in mind.

episodes.name: Red Scale
episodes.overview: Yuji makes his way to Shibuya Station where he's confronted by Choso. Choso unleashes his Convergence and the battle between him and Yuji commences.

episodes.name: Fluctuations
episodes.overview: Mei Mei and Ui Ui fight the Special-Grade Disease Curse summoned by whatever is pretending to be Suguru Geto. Meanwhile, Nanami joins up with Maki and Naobito, but they encounter a cursed spirit with unknown powers.

episodes.name: Fluctuations (2)
episodes.overview: Nanami, Maki, and Naobito are driven to the edge after the Special-Grade Cursed Spirit, Dagon, activates his Domain Expansion, Horizon of the Captivating Skandha. Fushiguro gives them a glimpse of a way to escape death, then Toji intrudes upon the fight.

episodes.name: Thunderclap
episodes.overview: Sukuna refuses to heed Jogo's advice after waking up, instead displaying his overwhelming strength against the Special-Grade Cursed Spirit, Jogo. Meanwhile, Fushiguro faces off against the rampant Toji with neither being aware of the other's identity.

episodes.name: Thunderclap (2)
episodes.overview: After being severely injured in his fight against Toji, Fushiguro suffers a surprise attack from Shigemo. On the verge of death, Fushiguro desperately heads toward Dougenzaka crossing and summons a certain Shikigami with his Ten Shadows Technique.

episodes.name: Right and Wrong
episodes.overview: Itadori reawakens with grievous resolve as he bears witness to the aftermath Sukuna has wrought upon Shibuya. Meanwhile, Nanami continues to fight through packs of transfigured humans in an exhausted haze until Mahito appears before him.

episodes.name: Right and Wrong (2)
episodes.overview: Itadori launches into a back-and-forth battle against Mahito, but he struggles against Mahito's ploy of using average people against him. Meanwhile, Kugisaki encounters one of Mahito's separated bodies as she returns to the battlefield.

episodes.name: Right and Wrong (3)
episodes.overview: Itadori stands in a daze at the disaster before his eyes, his mind already well past its limit. As a curse, Mahito is elated at seeing his ideal sequence of events play out before him, and he prepares to further finish off Itadori.

episodes.name: Metamorphosis
episodes.overview: After rescuing Itadori from his predicament, Todo bolsters his morale and encourages him to stand back up. As Mahito kicks things into higher gear, he begins using Soul Multiplicity and Body Repel to unleash omnidirectional attacks.

episodes.name: Metamorphosis (2)
episodes.overview: The moment it appeared Itadori and Mahito's battle to the death was resolved, the being wearing Geto's body asked, "Shall I save you, Mahito?" Itadori immediately recognizes the man before him as the very same one who sealed away Gojo and leaps to attack.

episodes.name: Shibuya Incident - Gate, Close
episodes.overview: Choso begins to realize the identity of the mastermind parasitizing Geto's corpse as sorcerers gather for the final moments of the Shibuya Incident. The special-grade sorcerer, Yuki Tsukumo, comes to the rescue when they're on the verge of death.

episodes.name: Execution
episodes.overview: While Yuji grapples with the weight of his sins, Naoya Zen'in and Yuta Okkotsu set out to execute him.

episodes.name: One More Time
episodes.overview: After fighting Yuta, Yuji learns his real objective. Megumi asks for Yuji's help to save his sister.

episodes.name: About the Culling Game
episodes.overview: Itadori and his friends speak with Tengen about Kenjaku's objectives and their plans for the Culling Game.

episodes.name: Perfect Preparation
episodes.overview: After going to collect their Cursed Tools, Maki awakens her true potential & slaughters the whole Zen'in Clan.

episodes.name: Passion
episodes.overview: Yaga is executed. Yuji and Fushiguro go to Hakari's fight club hoping to meet him and recruit him.

episodes.name: Cog
episodes.overview: Fushiguro and Panda fight Kirara to try and persuade them while Yuji attempts to convince Hakari.

episodes.name: Tokyo Colony No. 1
episodes.overview: Yuji's group enters two of the colonies and fight the Culling Game's newbie hunters.

episodes.name: Tokyo Colony No. 1 (2)
episodes.overview: Yuji meets Higuruma and tries to persuade him, while Fushiguro is falsely led to Reggie.

episodes.name: Tokyo Colony No. 1 (3)
episodes.overview: Yuji Itadori fights Hiromi Higuruma.

episodes.name: Tokyo Colony No. 1 (4)
episodes.overview: Takaba handles the minions while Fushiguro has his showdown with Reggie.

episodes.name: Tokyo Colony No. 1 (5)
episodes.overview: Fushiguro deploys his Domain Expansion in his climatic fight against Reggie.

episodes.name: Sendai Colony
episodes.overview: Okkotsu fights three powerful sorcerers in Sendai Colony.

episodes.name: I am General Manager Baek Seung Soo
episodes.overview: The Dreams is a frail baseball team continuously landing the last place. In order to have better results the following season, the team finds a new general manager, Baek Seung Su, who despite having little experience with baseball, has a track record of winni…

episodes.name: I will trade Lim Dong Gyu
episodes.overview: Rumors spread that the Dreams' new general manager, Baek Seung Su, is planning to trade the team's most famed player, Lim Dong Gyu, for reasons unbeknownst to the employees. Despite backlash and opposition, Baek Seung Su manages to explain his reasons to the…

episodes.name: The Worst Baseball Team
episodes.overview: Baek Seung Su finds something suspicious about a disagreement between Ko Se Hyeok, the scouting division head, and a scouting division member, Yang Won Seop, at the first-year player draft, regarding the team's selection of player Yu Min Ho over Lee Chang Kwo…

episodes.name: Professional Scout Team
episodes.overview: Baek Seung Su and Lee Se Young call everyone to identify irregularity of the scouting division. Meanwhile, an unexpected guest visits the office and their meeting takes a new turn.

episodes.name: The one who smiling back home
episodes.overview: Baek Seung Su and his team leave to California to recruit Miles, but they get bewildered by the unexpectedly high cost. In the meantime, Kyung Min offers Seung Su a new amount of money for the down payment of foreign players, and their target changes into som…

episodes.name: Problem from America
episodes.overview: The Dreams has an open recruitment process to fill an opening in the strategy and performance analysis division. Despite Seung Su being unaware, his brother Yeong Su applies for the position, displaying a high level of understanding in statistics and receivin…

episodes.name: The art of negotiation
episodes.overview: After hearing that total funds for the Dreams will be cut by 30 percent in comparison to the previous year, Seung Su and the management team go into salary negotiations with a determined attitude. They change their way of calculating the salary of each player…

episodes.name: How much I should get?
episodes.overview: Despite initial roadblocks in salary negotiations, the Dreams and various players work out their differences and negotiate their contracts. Meanwhile, controversy surrounding Gil Chang Ju's interview on TV and Baek Yeong Su's employment leads to Seung Su rece…

episodes.name: Thank you for the dream General Manager Baek Seung Soo
episodes.overview: General Manager Baek Seung Su agrees to resign from his post and Lee Se Young becomes interim general manager. The Dreams manages to bring good results at the 2019 KPB Rule 5 Draft and a sudden interview held with Gil Chang Ju surprises many people and leads…

episodes.name: Good Cop, Bad Cop
episodes.overview: The players' association goes against the Dreams hosting practice sessions with their coaches during off-season. General Manager Baek Seung Su argues that it's only right that even players with lower salaries are allowed to practice and not pressured to rest…

episodes.name: Changes for better
episodes.overview: Kwon Kyeong Min orders Baek Seung Su to cancel plans for the players of the Dreams to go abroad for off-season training. Baek Seung Su convinces three special instructors with a not-so-pleasant history with the team to train the players during the off-season.

episodes.name: Lim Dong Gyu vs Kang Doo Ki
episodes.overview: The Dreams have begun off-season training and they face the Vikings in a practice game. Yu Min Ho is unable to produce the same quality in his pitches as before and the heads and coaches try to find a way for him to improve. Meanwhile, changes in personnel ca…

episodes.name: Doubt
episodes.overview: The entire national baseball league is in a panic due to a drug scandal. Seung Su and General Manager Kim try to protect the Dreams and the Vikings respectively. However, the rumors about the drug-using players are widespread, and the baseball fans start susp…

episodes.name: Lim Dong Gyu return home
episodes.overview: In order to bring back Lim Dong Gyu back to the Dreams, the general manager persuades the general manager of the Vikings with a deal emphasizing a bright future.

episodes.name: Somehow I want to protect Dreams
episodes.overview: News spreads of a trade between Kang Doo Ki and two second-string players, handled by President Kwon Kyeong Min. While the general manager is shocked by the decision, the management team rallies behind him to try to work even harder to offset the loss that th…

episodes.name: Sale!
episodes.overview: As Jaesong Group aims to switch its main industry, President Kwon makes the announcement to disband the Dreams. In order to salvage the team, Baek Seung Su urges him to give him a period of one week, in which he makes a bid to an IT company to persuade it to…

episodes.name: Nice to Meet You. I'm Gauko
Imposter Gauko
episodes.overview: Everyone keeps thanking Nauko for things she didn't do. Eventually she realizes the truth: There's an imposter Gauko on the loose!

episodes.name: Mom’s Birthday
episodes.overview: Naoko and her dad both forget her mom's birthday. They come up with a plan to celebrate at the last minute, but complications arise.

episodes.name: Alien Chase
episodes.overview: Things are going missing around town. Naoko learns that the thefts are part of Bibilian's invasion plan, and she's not happy about it.

episodes.name: Community Center
episodes.overview: Naoko goes to a community meeting in her parents' place. But when a discussion about a new community center turns into an argument, Gauko intervenes.

episodes.name: Running away
episodes.overview: When Naoko's mom spoils the ending of her favorite TV show, Naoko gets upset and runs away – to Bibilian's house! But the alien isn't a very good host.

episodes.name: KinPika’s Troubles
episodes.overview: KinPika the penguin is late to school one day. Naoko asks him about what's bothering him, and he invites her over to his very fancy house.

episodes.name: Copy Machine
episodes.overview: Bibilian orders a copy machine and decides to make clones of Naoko until one of them agrees to date him. When Naoko finds out, she gets angry!

episodes.name: Never Give up
episodes.overview: After Naoko gets another bad grade on a math test, her father decides to take up boxing to encourage her to never give up.

episodes.name: Teacher R3 explodes
episodes.overview: When Mr. R3 suddenly explodes one day, the class launches an investigation into the incident. They quickly realize that everyone's a suspect.

episodes.name: Masked Singer
episodes.overview: Everyone is uploading videos of themselves singing to social media. Saito criticizes them at first, but soon enough he wants in on the action.

episodes.name: Candy strategy
episodes.overview: Naoko's mom suddenly doesn't remember her, and no one else in town does either! It turns out Bibilian and his family are giving out brainwashing candy.

episodes.name: My Cousin and the Snake
episodes.overview: Naoko's cousin Ichiro comes to visit, along with his snake puppet, Elizabeth. When Elizabeth says one too many mean things, he throws her in the river!

episodes.name: My Cousin and the Snake return
episodes.overview: Ichiro and Elizabeth come to visit again just as Naoko and her mom are about to go shopping, so they hang out with Leonard and the Moles.

episodes.name: World domination kit
episodes.overview: Under pressure to deliver results, Bibilian orders a world domination machine, only to learn that he has to wait two years for a missing part.

episodes.name: Big Sister
episodes.overview: Naoko enjoys being a big sister to Leonard, but she gets jealous when his soccer ambitions lead him to start hanging out with Takashi.

episodes.name: Ultimate Paella
episodes.overview: To drum up business, the cat cafe offers a cooking class. Naoko, Mrs. Mole and KinPika sign up, but the proprietors aren't being totally honest.

episodes.name: Alien President
episodes.overview: To speed up his conquest of Earth, Bibilian runs for president. But he faces a tough opponent: KinPika's father, who bribes people to vote for him!

episodes.name: Get angry Gauko
episodes.overview: Naoko and her friends visit Toshio at the shop, but they get locked in the walk-in freezer. To escape, everyone tries to get Gauko to appear.

episodes.name: Samba Competition
episodes.overview: The samba competition approaches. Naoko unhappily agrees to join Toshio's samba team, whose big rival is the team led by Naoko's mother!

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Five friends whose friendship goes back to their days in med school are brought back together when a phone call interrupts each of their busy lives.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: For the first time in 20 years, everyone's finally working under the same roof. A patient with a familiar name finds Chae Song-hwa.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The hospital's med students are inspired by the doctors, who each look after their patients in their own ways. Lee Ik-jun gets a welcome visitor.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Yang Seok-hyeong's aloofness frustrates someone on his team. Jang Yun-bok and Jang Hong-do witness a surprising side of Song-hwa outside the hospital.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Jang Gyeo-ul can't get one kind word out of Ahn Jeong-won, who seems especially cold to her. A difficult professor joins the cardiothoracic department.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Kim Jun-wan waits for a response from Lee Ik-sun, who says she needs some time. Jeong-won breaks painful news to the family of his longtime patient.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: An unforeseen problem just before a surgery forces Jeong-won to make a tough decision. Meanwhile, Jun-wan is put on edge in the operating room.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Distracted by a problem in his personal life, Do Jae-hak struggles to get through the day. Meanwhile, Chu Min-ha finds herself drowning in work.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: An urgent call sends Song-hwa rushing to the hospital to tend to a young patient. Ik-jun receives a plea from a desperate father.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Put in a stressful situation, Jae-hak looks to Jun-wan for advice on the right thing to do. Ik-jun accidentally uncovers an extraordinary secret.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Ik-jun handles a sensitive request from the troubled wife of a patient. A sudden piece of news threatens Seok-hyeong's peace.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: As doctors and as humans, the five friends each face a maze of life's questions and decisions as they figure out their next steps.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: As life at the hospital goes on, the five friends' growing pains continue. Gyeo-ul is disquieted by frequent visits from a patient's mother.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Traveling to and from Seoul, Song-hwa takes on a VIP client in need of surgery. A woman with pregnancy complications fights to keep her baby alive.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: An urgent case involving a liver transplant between a father and son is brought to Ik-jun's attention. Jun-wan has big news for one of his patients.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Worries about Ik-sun plague Jun-wan's ever-busy days. While watching over a patient post-surgery, Heo Seon-bin experiences a critical lesson.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Gyeo-ul receives a disturbing noise complaint about one of Ik-jun's patients. Seok-hyeong opens up to Song-hwa, who gives him a piece of advice.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: From student to intern for Yun-bok and Hong-do, and resident to fellow for Gyeo-ul, every step forward comes with plenty of hiccups — and new learnings.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Ik-jun’s team deals with a patient’s anxious brother — and his overbearing attitude. Chu Min-ha leaves a bad impression on a visitor in the cafeteria.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Jeong Rosa fears the worst when her memory continues to decline. Song-hwa grapples with the unforeseen diagnosis of a loved one.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: A hospital ping pong tournament brings out each department's competitive streak. Ik-sun and Jun-wan make plans to meet for a proper chat.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: The five friends leave for vacation together, but not all of them make it to the destination. Jae-hak and his wife navigate one surprise after another.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: One of the hospital's doctors is rushed into the emergency room. A patient with an unanticipated condition poses a challenge for Song-hwa and her team.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: A series of tough choices and sudden crises keeps life at the hospital as busy as ever. Through it all, the five friends continue to follow their hearts.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: On his first day at a new high school, Park Saeroyi stands by his principles in front of powerful bullies. Oh Soo-ah works on getting into college.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: While serving his time, Saeroyi develops a bold game plan for his future. Soo-ah can't ignore a generous offer from Jang Dae-hee.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Saeroyi crosses paths with Jo Yi-seo, who seems to have a knack for bringing him trouble. Meanwhile, DanBam struggles to attract customers.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Choi Seung-kwon regrets reverting back to his old ways. When Yi-seo's night out takes an ugly turn, Saeroyi is there to help.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Before its reopening, DanBam gets a few upgrades. Yi-seo, Seung-kwon and Jang Geun-soo have a surprise encounter at a nightclub.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Dae-hee keeps tabs on DanBam's progress. Saeroyi runs into Jang Geun-won at the TV station. Yi-seo faces her mother's disappointment.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: DanBam gets an unwelcome visitor. Saeroyi approaches Kang Min-jung with a weighty proposition, and shares his entire story with Yi-seo.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Bad news strikes DanBam, but Saeroyi isn't one to bow under pressure. Geun-soo learns a horrible truth. Kim Toni deals with discrimination.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: The bar's move to a quieter street poses fresh problems for the crew. Dae-hee takes an interest in Saeroyi's people.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Jangga finds itself in hot water with the public. With the future of the company hanging in the balance, Dae-hee must make his choice.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: After Ma Hyun-yi makes a buzzy TV appearance, a big opportunity comes knocking for DanBam. Geun-soo goes after what he wants.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: While navigating their latest crisis, Saeroyi and Yi-seo come across a potential investor. Hyun-yi preps for the competition's final round.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Geun-soo moves closer to his goal. With their sights set high, Saeroyi and his team take the business to the next level.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Yi-seo overworks herself as she steps into a critical role for the team's new strategy against Jangga, worrying Saeroyi.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Searching for Yi-seo, Seung-kwon pays his old boss a visit. Dae-hee receives a warning from Soo-ah, and a disturbing call from Geun-won.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Yi-seo runs from Geun-won, who's out to put an end to everything. Desperate to salvage his crumbling legacy, Dae-hee heads to DanBam.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: As humans turn into savage monsters and the world plunges into terror, a handful of survivors fight for their lives — and to hold on to their humanity.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Cha Hyun-su moves into the run-down Green Home by himself. Not long after, he witnesses a disturbing sight in his neighbor's apartment.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: As a state of emergency is declared, the residents tie up Pyeon Sang-wook for being bitten. Hyun-su is unable to ignore a family in distress.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: An unexpected savior protects the children from harm as Hyun-su, together with Yoon Ji-su and Jung Jae-heon, tries to bring them to safety.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Critical information about the monsters is made public. When residents are split on what to do with Hyun-su, Lee Eun-hyeok suggests they hold a vote.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Tasked to carry out dangerous missions, Hyun-su heads back to retrieve Han Du-sik. Sang-wook stops at nothing to finish what he started.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: An Seon-yeong confronts the greatest monster in her life. Leaving the building, Seo Yi-kyung heads to her fiancé's office in search of answers.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Hyun-su saves the others from a deadly attack. Running out of necessities, Eun-hyeok announces a plan to venture outside for resources.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Having little options in her state of being, Ji-su agrees to take a big risk. Yi-kyung returns to Green Home just in time.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: When a team of outlaws take over the building, the residents are shown how humans can be even more barbaric than the monsters.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: A military leaflet promises a route to safety, but the group is reluctant to trust it. Hyun-su is exposed to a new perspective on his condition.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The stakes are higher than ever as the line between monster and human begins to blur. Can Hyun-su and the other survivors fight to stay alive?

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Hyun-su wakes up to find Sang-wook, who has a new goal for them. Lee Eun-yu and Ji-su escape a violent evacuation and commandeer their next destination.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Eun-yu finds a hint of Eun-hyeok’s fate at a stop in her journey. During an experiment, Hyun-su finds that he has a special effect on another monster.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: On a mission to find her husband, Yi-kyung makes a shocking discovery. The battered Ji-su and Eun-yu arrive at a new shelter, but catastrophe awaits them.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The survivors take shelter underground, where supplies run low. In her continued search for Eun-hyeok, Eun-yu encounters a young girl.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Sergeant Kim and Master Sergeant Tak clash on how to protect their men. The mysterious girl approaches Eun-yu with an enticing offer.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Eun-yu chases Yi-kyung and the girl, with Park Chan-yeong right behind her. The death of survivors and a missing soldier throws the stadium into unrest.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Eun-yu shares a terse reunion with Hyun-su. While the platoon embarks on their search for a missing soldier, the stadium experiences a monster threat.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: As Yi-kyung faces death, the young girl tries to save her. In the ruins of the lab, the soldiers discover other survivors who aren't what they seem.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The world teeters on the boundary between monsters and humans, leaving humanity with a difficult choice. As desires clash, a desperate fight ensues.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Hyun-su gives it his all to bring Yi-kyung’s humanity back. Sergeant Kim faces countless monsters in an effort to make it out alive with his men.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Resolved to find his child, Jung Ui-myeong heads to the stadium. Despite Hyun-su's unpredictability, Eun-yu tries to wake him up during a sudden crisis.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Yi-kyung discovers Ui-myeong's true motive for him and their daughter. Eun-yu accepts a challenge from Hyun-su's alter ego and heads to the stadium.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The girl contemplates her future with Yi-kyung — and a life away from Ui-myeong. Sergeant Kim encounters Eun-hyeok, who reveals a new kind of being.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Eun-hyeok's reunion with Hyun-su and Eun-yu turns into chaos. Ui-myeong prepares for his body transfer, while Sergeant Tak carries out his own plan.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: In her trek to the stadium, Eun-yu begins to feel a personal worry. While Ui-myeong searches for the girl, she plans a counterattack in the background.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Hyun-su and Eun-hyeok arrive at the stadium, splitting up to find Ui-myeong. During the great escape, Sergeant Tak commits the ultimate sacrifice.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: In the final battle, Hyun-su and Eun-hyeok confront the girl head-on — getting an assist from an old friend. Will they finally succeed?

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A group of small-town young men run a lucrative phishing operation, until a corrupt politician wants in on their scheme -- and a cop wants to fight it.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: The successful phishing scams of Rocky, Sunny and their friends pique a corrupt local politician’s interest. Tension brews between Rocky and Sunny.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: An attempt to arrest the young men is thwarted, to the dismay of the ambitious new police superintendent. Sunny brings a proposal to Gudiya’s mother.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Dolly seeks a cybercrime officer’s help in her case. As some of the guys side with Sunny, Rocky plans revenge. An intrusion disrupts Sunny’s wedding.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Sunny's father comes to his aid. Brajesh wields his power. As Saurav educates the police on phishing, Sunny and Gudiya conduct a training of their own.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: When Gudiya’s coaching classroom is burned down, Sunny considers drastic retaliation. A slipped note leads Dolly and Saurav to a deserted warehouse.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The boys adopt Sunny’s get-rich-quick strategy. Anas looks to break a story in the paper. As Sunny’s confidence grows, Brajesh visits him and Gudiya.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Dolly, Biswa and Saurav carry out a sting operation that goes awry. Sunny arrives at Brajesh's party, vowing payback for his treatment of Gudiya.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: A tragedy sends Sunny on the run, with the police and Brajesh’s men on his trail. Dolly and Saurav hatch a plan to prove Brajesh’s link to the incident.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: An enemy intercepts Sunny’s escape. While tracking the phishing calls, Saurav makes a breakthrough. As some scammers are arrested, Sunny’s fate worsens.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Sunny acquiesces to a dubious deal to save his father. A shattered Gudiya partners with Dolly to set a honey trap in hopes of finally capturing Brajesh.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: New scams, higher stakes, same old town. In Jamtara, no one is spared from the web of corruption and treachery.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: As elections approach in Jamtara, Gudiya takes a stand against Brajesh. Rocky looks to start fresh, and Sunny concocts a new scam.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Before arriving in Jamtara, a dating app scam lands Rinku in trouble, while the beginnings of Gudiya's political career are revealed.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Dolly and Saurav return to Jamtara to investigate a major phishing case. A group of schoolchildren are assembled to carry out Sunny’s new scam.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: While speaking at a rally, Gudiya encounters a masked gunman. Dolly faces pressure to crack the case, while a crooked journalist is handed a scoop.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Rinku is devastated after a loss. A raid on Brajesh’s property uncovers incriminating evidence. Biswa witnesses a shocking event.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: A sudden police press conference blindsides Dolly, Saurav and Biswa. Brajesh pays a visit to the chief minister, while Rocky opens a new shop.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: The scammers’ wives join Gudiya’s operation, while a mob attack leads to a brutal assault. Saurav makes a big discovery in Noida.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Ahead of election day, Sunny, Gudiya and Rocky devise a scheme to woo voters. Brajesh learns the abductor’s identity, while Rinku is caught in a web.

episodes.name: Dai, The Tiny Hero
episodes.overview: Young Dai lives on Dermline Island, where he dreams of being a Hero. One day, a Hero and his companions come to the island. Dai is excited at first, but their true intent is to steal his best friend, Gomechan, the mythical Golden Metal Slime.

episodes.name: Dai and Princess Leona
episodes.overview: Dai must take Leona to the Earth Cave for a ritual. At first, Dai dislikes Leona, but they slowly come to understand each other. Suddenly, a giant Evil Scorpion attacks. Dai defeats it, but Leona is poisoned. As Dai’s wishes to save her...

episodes.name: The Hero's Tutor
episodes.overview: A dark power affects Dai’s monster friends, driving them berserk. Brass tries to get Dai to leave. As they argue, a Hero trainer arrives to inform Dai that the Dark Lord has returned. To save those he cares about, Dai undergoes Hero training.

episodes.name: The Dark Lord Hadlar's Return
episodes.overview: Avan turned into a dragon and attacks Dai. Dai fights back to no avail. To defeat Avan’s flames requires Wave Slash. As Dai clears his objective, someone enters the island. Who should appear before Avan but the worst possible being...!

episodes.name: The Insignia of Avan
episodes.overview: Avan is overpowered by Hadlar, who is now stronger than ever. To protect his students and the world, Avan gathers the last of his strength and faces Hadlar. Dai can do nothing but watch. Finally, the showdown between Avan and Hadlar is concluded.

episodes.name: Maam's Turmoil
episodes.overview: Thanks to Maam’s help, Dai goes on the offensive against Crocodine. Popp joins in and the battle intensifies. Seeing Dai and Popp fight, Maam remembers Avan’s words to her when she was young and comes to a decision.

episodes.name: Furfang Full Assault
episodes.overview: Dai and company arrive late at night to the castle town of Romos. The next morning, Crocodine attacks with the Furfang Legion. In Romos Castle, Dai faces Crocodine. Crocodine decides to use the weapon that Zaboera gave him.

episodes.name: A Single Shard of Courage
episodes.overview: Dai is heavily wounded by Crocodine’s Beast King Anguish Blast. Maam tries to save Dai, but is bound by a Heyedra. Masopho, the Mage from the fake Hero’s party shows this to Popp, who remains paralyzed by fear. Masopho then speaks of his past...

episodes.name: Onto Papnica Kingdom
episodes.overview: Having won the battle with Crocodine, Dai and company head to Papnica Kingdom, which is under attack by the Undead Legion of the Dark Army. Upon arrival, Dai sees an unbelievable sight. Meanwhile, Hadlar summons all Legion Commanders, but...

episodes.name: Hyunckel, the Dark Swordsman
episodes.overview: Dai’s Avan Strash had no effect on Hyunckel. Hyunckel dons his “Dark Armour Blade” to face Dai and his companions. Just why does Hyunckel hate Avan so much? Hyunckel reveals his past with Avan to answer Maam’s question.

episodes.name: The Collaborative Raidein
episodes.overview: Thanks to Crocodine, Dai and Popp managed to escape. Popp says to Dai that if they don’t defeat Hyunckel, they won’t be able save Maam or Leona. Morning comes. Popp has come up with a plan to defeat Hyunckel and suggests the use of a certain spell.

episodes.name: The Deciding Moment
episodes.overview: Hyunckel withstands the Zapple spell. His spell thwarted, Dai falls prey to Hyunckel’s Bloody Scryde. At that moment, Maam appears and hands a Soul Shell found in a hidden room to Hyunckel. It contains a shocking truth about Hyunckel’s past.

episodes.name: Blizzblaze General Flazzard
episodes.overview: After their fierce battle against Hyunckel, Dai and friends set out to find Leona. They launch signal flares and are met by Amy of the Papnica Troika, who takes them to where Leona is hiding, but Blizzblaze General Flazzard reaches her first...!

episodes.name: The Terrifying Curse Field
episodes.overview: Dai faces off with Flazzard. His Magic Sword is effective, but Flazzard fires off the rocks in his body in both an attack and a signal to activate the Blizzblaze Curse Field. The surrounding area is encased in a field, and Dai’s group is weakened.

episodes.name: The Grand Sorcerer Matoriv
episodes.overview: Matoriv is a Grand Sorcerer living in a cave. At first, he’s resistant to helping, but upon learning that Dai is Avan’s last student, he agrees to help save Leona. Meanwhile, Hadlar’s Dark Army prepares a scheme.

episodes.name: The Death-Defying Savior
episodes.overview: Dai and Baduck reach the Dark Flame Spire to find Zaboera, Mystvearn, and their Legion monsters waiting for them. Waiting for Popp and Maam at the Dark Ice Spire is Hadlar. Dai and his friends are in danger. Just then, an unlikely savior appears.

episodes.name: Hyunckel Versus Hadlar
episodes.overview: Popp and Maam are shocked by the appearance of Hyunckel. It turns out he was saved by Crocodine. Having come to help the Disciples of Avan, Hyunckel sends Popp and Maam off to Valge Tower and faces off with Hadlar.

episodes.name: The Final Avan Style Technique
episodes.overview: Dai, Popp, and Maam reach Valge Tower where they are stopped by Flazzard. Realizing he is at a disadvantage, Flazzard shatters himself into bullets of rocks and launches himself as projectiles. Just then, the words of Avan flash through Dai’s mind!

episodes.name: Now I Slice Everything
episodes.overview: With his core destroyed by Dai’s Air Slash, Flazzard splits his body. Mystvearn appears and gives Flazzard the Shadow Legion’s ultimate armour. Flazzard attacks Dai. But having completed his Avan Style Sword Technique, Dai remains unfazed...!

episodes.name: Maam's Decision
episodes.overview: Dai and his friends prepare for their next battle as Papnica rebuilds. Maam hears the words of Matoriv and comes to a decision. Meanwhile, Vearn’s personal assassin, Killvearn and his companion Piroro appear before Hadlar. What will they say to him?

episodes.name: Off To the Department Store
episodes.overview: Dai and Leona head to Bengarna Kingdom to get Dai a new weapon. Freed from her duties as princess, Leona enjoys her shopping. Dai and Popp spend their time amazed by all the new sights. New encounters and new threats await them.

episodes.name: The Dragon Knight
episodes.overview: Dai faces the Dragons attacking Bengarna. His sword shatters. Dragons that Popp failed to defeat join in. All prepare for defeat, but Dai unleashes the power of the Dragon Crest. Nabara and Merle realize a truth that Dai himself doesn’t yet know.

episodes.name: Dragon Master General Baran
episodes.overview: Baran reveals the duty of a Dragon Knight: to wipe out the humans. Baran explains why Dragon Knights were born. Dai rejects Baran’s words. Growing impatient, Baran blows Dai away with a powerful attack. Baran then reveals a shocking truth…!

episodes.name: The Terrifying Draconic Aura
episodes.overview: With the secret to the Dragon Knights’ supremacy, the “Draconic Aura” deployed, Baran is invulnerable to Crocodine’s attacks. Crocodine continues to stand up to Baran. And Dai, as well. They attack Baran together, but Baran forms a plan.

episodes.name: The Dragon Masters Approach
episodes.overview: Baran summons the Dragon Masters, three powerful Dragon Riders, and heads to Teran Kingdom to reclaim Dai. Leona and the others shelter Dai in a prison cell. Detecting Baran and the Dragon Masters, the group is at a loss. Just then, Popp acts.

episodes.name: Land Rider Larhart
episodes.overview: Popp faces the Dragon Masters alone and falls into peril. Hyunckel arrives to save him. Popp and Hyunckel defeat Galdandy and Borahorn. Popp loses consciousness and Hyunckel faces Larhart. But Larhart is far more powerful than Galdandy or Borahorn.

episodes.name: Dai's Secret
episodes.overview: Baran approaches Teran Castle where Dai is kept. Leona gives Dai his knife and encourages him to fight before heading off to face Baran with Crocodine. Meanwhile, Hyunckel lies beaten by Larhart. Larhart tells him Baran’s tumultuous past...

episodes.name: Baran's Rage
episodes.overview: With Popp as his hostage, Borahorn threatens Hyunckel. Larhart takes unexpected action. Larhart reveals his past. Meanwhile, Baran appears at Teran Castle. Hearing of Popp’s actions, Crocodine employs a desperate strategy against Baran!

episodes.name: Popp's Resolve
episodes.overview: As a Dragonoid, Baran’s power is beyond imagination. Just as everyone prepares to die, Dai appears. When the meeting between father and son that they had hoped to prevent happens, Popp remembers the final moments of his master, Avan.

episodes.name: A Father and Son Clash
episodes.overview: The Dragon Crest appears on Dai’s right hand. Is it a miracle brought on by his mother, Soala...? By focusing his power, Dai gains power beyond Baran’s. Baran wields his Draconic Aura and fights back. The two Dragon Knights clash in an epic battle.

episodes.name: Farewell To the Father
episodes.overview: With his weapon lost, Dai must defend himself. Baran lacks the Magic Power for his full Gigabreak. Dai is given Hyunckel’s Dark Armour Blade and faces off with Baran one last time. Meanwhile, Popp remains unresponsive to Leona’s Zing spell...

episodes.name: Zaboera's Scheme
episodes.overview: With one final chance from Vearn, Hadlar himself heads out with Zaboera to kill Dai. Dai and his friends rest their wounds in Merle’s cottage. As Popp stands guard outside, someone makes an unexpected appearance.

episodes.name: The Romos Martial Arts Tournament
episodes.overview: Dai and his friends return to Papnica. They learn of a Martial Arts Tournament in Romos where the winner will receive a legendary weapon. Dai and Popp head to the tournament where a certain contestant’s fighting catches their eyes.

episodes.name: The Incident At the Finals
episodes.overview: Dai and Popp were reunited with Maam. Maam promises to win the Sword of Champions. Maam wins her way through the preliminary fights. But an evil plot unfurls behind the scenes... As the finals are about to begin, one man springs into action.

episodes.name: The Superior Being Versus Chiu
episodes.overview: A giant body, unbelievable speed, unparalleled strength, and rapid regeneration... The Superior Being, Zamza, is a terrifying threat. Dai faces him but loses stamina too quickly. Dai falls. All hope seems lost. But only Chiu refuses to give up...!

episodes.name: All In An Instant
episodes.overview: The Refractor Fist is effective against the seemingly invincible Superior Being. Using her nimble skills and the Refractor Fist, Maam succeeds in freeing Dai. Dai sees her fight and discovers a clue. Dai prepares a final counterattack.

episodes.name: The World Summit
episodes.overview: To fight the Dark Army, Leona gathers world leaders for a summit. Dai hopes to learn of a new legendary weapon. In Zaboera’s hideout, Hadlar is hooked up inside a large bio-chamber. Hadlar is letting Zaboera perform a certain experiment on him...

episodes.name: The Landing of Sovereign Rock Castle
episodes.overview: Lon Beruk, begins forging the greatest sword in the world for Dai. Meanwhile, in Papnica, the world summit of the world’s leaders begins. But the talks drag on without progress, troubling Leona. Just then a giant enemy appears...

episodes.name: Master of Darkness Against His Pupil
episodes.overview: With Mystvearn’s declaration of war, the battle begins. The companions fight, but against an endless enemy, they’re slowly forced back. Help arrives, reigniting the weakened flame in everyone’s hearts. At last, Mystvearn himself appears...!

episodes.name: The Strongest Sword
episodes.overview: Hyunckel unleashes a strike with the Aura of Justice. Enraged, Mystbearn unleashes his Dark Aura to tear Popp and the others apart. Sovereign Rock Castle heads for the Grand Chapel. Meanwhile, Lon Beruk finally completes the sword for Dai.

episodes.name: The Field of Death
episodes.overview: The Sword of Dai cuts Sovereign Rock Castle in half. Mystvearn tries to reveal his true power, but Killvearn appears. With Mystvearn’s anger quelled, and the two retreat. Popp gives chase. Popp reaches the dark island known as the Field of Death.

episodes.name: The Clash of Powerful Swords
episodes.overview: Hadlar was more powerful than ever. Along with an indomitable Superior Being body and an unbreakable will, he also has the ability to cast spells. Dai could only defend himself. Cornered, Dai unleashes an Avan Strash with the Sword of Dai.

episodes.name: The Hero Lost in the Glacier
episodes.overview: Dai and Hadlar’s battle ended in a draw, with Dai lost in the ocean. Killvearn attacks the despondent Popp. Popp remembers the words of Matoriv and retreats, but Killvearn pursues. Can Popp escape? And what happened to Dai...?

episodes.name: The Orichalcum Warrior
episodes.overview: Popp, Crocodine, and Chiu search for Dai. Zaboera also leads his servants to find Dai, causing the parties to clash. Popp rescues Dai, but Zaboera unleashes his Super Spell. Just then, a mysterious shining warrior appears between them and...?

episodes.name: The Extreme Annihilation Spell, Medoroa
episodes.overview: The showdown with Vearn is in five days. Dai and his friends head out to spend the remaining time training. Popp visits Matoriv to find a way to counter the Hadlar Royal Guard. Matoriv decides to teach Popp a spell that he himself fears to use.

episodes.name: To the Final Battleground
episodes.overview: The members return, having completed their training. Dai and his friends head to Carl Kingdom. There’s a change in the Field of Death and they land with a heightened sense of tension. Meanwhile, in a remote cave, Baran and Killvearn face off...

episodes.name: The Hadlar Royal Guard
episodes.overview: Nova is General Bowson’s son. Refusing to fight together with Dai, he heads off to fight the Dark Army. Dai and Popp hurry after him, but Nova arrives first. Nova fights valiantly, but the Orichalcum warriors reveal their true terror...!

episodes.name: The Team Battle Begins
episodes.overview: Zababa becomes the stage for the battle between Dai, with his friends, and the Hadlar Royal Guard. Our heroes fight using their individual strengths, but the Orichalcum warriors are powerful enemies. Just who will prevail in this fierce battle...?

episodes.name: We're The Beast King Commandos
episodes.overview: Popp’s Medroa was strong enough to carve out the ground. Dai and his friends celebrate their victory. Meanwhile, Chiu forms the Beast King Commandos and works to uncover the secret of the enemy stronghold. But the evil hand of the enemy closes in.

episodes.name: The Avan Style Ultimate Technique
episodes.overview: Popp, Hyunckel, and Crocodine find the wounded Chiu. Hyunckel deduces it was Fenbren who fought him, and Baran who saved him. Hyunckel sends Popp home and calls out to Baran. Sensing a change in Baran’s demeanor, Hyunckel attempts to stop him...!

episodes.name: Father and Son Dragons Set Out
episodes.overview: Though shocked by Baran’s sudden appearance, Leona decides to accept his assistance. The Hadlar Royal Guard is lured to the surface while Dai and Baran head to destroy the Dark Citadel Gate. But someone awaits them at the Dark Citadel Gate.

episodes.name: Hadlar's Challenge
episodes.overview: Popp and his friends face the Hadlar Royal Guard. Meanwhile, Dai and Baran battle Fenbren, and Dai instinctively saves his ally, Baran. The battle with Fenbren ends. Beyond the Dark Citadel Gate, they find Hadlar ready to battle the Dragon Knights.

episodes.name: Hadlar Verus Baran
episodes.overview: Hadlar’s Black Core could explode at any moment, leaving Dai and Baran unable to attack. Unaware of his own situation, Hadlar unleashes an even more intense barrage of attacks at the two. To resolve the situation, Baran attempts a risky maneuver.

episodes.name: The Black Core
episodes.overview: After putting Dai to sleep, Baran turns into the Dragonoid for the final fight with Hadlar. Hadlar focuses all his strength to combat Baran. Meanwhile, from his throne, Dark King Vearn watches their battle with a cool gaze.

episodes.name: The Inherited Heart
episodes.overview: Popp and the others have managed to survive the Black Core’s explosion. Realizing that the explosion happened while Dai and Baran were fighting, the group rushes to find Dai and Baran. There, they see a shocking sight.

episodes.name: The God of the Underworld
episodes.overview: Dai and his friends finally face off against Vearn, who uses his Dark Aura to blast Dai away and casts powerful spells with his overwhelming Magic Power. Vearn is in control even against five opponents. Do Dai and his friends stand a chance...?

episodes.name: The Unlikely Savior
episodes.overview: Dai’s Avan Strash hit Vearn, but it’s not enough to defeat him. Vearn rises again and summons the Staff of Edacity, which converts Magic Power into raw attack power. With Vearn’s Magic Power, its attack is strong enough to shake the heavens and...?

episodes.name: The Survivors
episodes.overview: Dai and his friends faced absolute defeat. Dai is taken away by the Holy Mother Dragon and Hyunckel and Crocodine are missing. Popp and Maam wash up on a beach in Carl Kingdom. The two learn that Vearn has begun his attack on the Surface World.

episodes.name: Dai and Popp
episodes.overview: The missing Hyunckel and Crocodine are prisoners of the Dark Army. A meeting is held in which it’s decided that Dai should rally the forces. Meanwhile, Dai awakens, but is unable to bear the weight of being a Hero and runs. He ends up in...?

episodes.name: Avan, The Hero
