episodes.overview: A story of Avan when Hadlar was still the Dark Lord. The Order of Carl faces the Dark Army with its princess, Flora. A young Avan protects the princess. Hadlar attacks Carl Castle to capture Flora and...? How Avan and Hadlar’s rivalry began...

episodes.name: The Cave of Trials
episodes.overview: Seeking the legendary spell Kaglimmer, Leona, Maam, Merle, and Flora brave the Cave of Trials. Dai sets out to train until Leona returns. As they prepare, Flora tells Maam a secret of the Insignias of Avan. When Popp overhears them...?

episodes.name: The Sacred Inheritance
episodes.overview: Dai trains with Nova and masters both types of Avan Strash, leading him to create a new attack. Leona and the others search the Cave of Trials to attain Kaglimmer. Popp grows desperate that his Isignia of Avan is the only one which will not glow...?

episodes.name: The Night Before the Battle
episodes.overview: Lon Beruk brings the restored Sword of Dai and new weapons. The group renews their resolve. Maam is shaken by Amy’s feelings for Hyunckel and Popp is frustrated his Insignia of Avan won’t shine. As the final battle approaches, things grow shaky...

episodes.name: The Dark Hyunckel
episodes.overview: The execution day has arrived. As noon approaches and Vearn Palace arrives in the sky above, Mystvearn appears before Hyunckel and Crocodine. Mystvearn makes Hyunckel an offer: accept his Dark Aura or die. Hyunckel makes an unexpected choice.

episodes.name: The Five Colors of Light
episodes.overview: The five Disciples of Avan have gathered. Mystvearn attempts to intervene, but Lon Beruk stops him. Crocodine and the others fight the army of monsters. The Disciples of Avan prepare the ritual to cast Kaglimmer. But Popp remains uncertain...

episodes.name: The Peril of the Great Purification Spell
episodes.overview: The Disciples of Avan try to cast Kaglimmer. But Popp’s Insignia won’t glow. Maam tries to encourage Popp, but only increases his pain. Powerful monsters enter the fray. As Dai and friends begin to panic, Zaboera schemes.

episodes.name: The Last Challenge
episodes.overview: Popp’s soul is awakened. He realizes his abilities as a Sage and heals Merle. Dai and friends continue the ritual to cast Kaglimmer and nullify Vearn’s magic field to enter Vearn Palace, where some unexpected individuals appear before them.

episodes.name: The Clash of Love
episodes.overview: Maam’s plea for a truce goes unheard and she is attacked relentlessly by Albinass’s true form. Maam sees Albinass’s strong devotion to Hadlar, but soon remembers Avan’s words, which motivate her to fight back...!

episodes.name: Victory Or Annihilation
episodes.overview: The Disciples of Avan continue to fight the Hadlar Royal Guard. Maam defeats Albinass and Hyunckel defeats Hym. But Popp struggles against Sigma. The two battle over the only spell that has any effect on Sigma, Medroa.

episodes.name: Battle of True Dragons
episodes.overview: Popp and the others return to Dai. There, they witness an unbelievable clash between Dai and Haldar. The sight is a recreation of the legendary “Battle of True Dragons.” The others can only stand back and observe. The moment of truth arrives...!

episodes.name: The Last Attack
episodes.overview: Hadlar rises again out of sheer force of will to face his true final battle. Dai accepts this challenge and chooses his Magic Sword. Though weaker than his Avan Strash Cross, Dai still has one ace up his sleeve...!? Their final attacks clash...!

episodes.name: The Hope in the Flames
episodes.overview: Killvearn’s trap imprisoned Dai, Popp, and Hadlar. Powerful flames gradually eat away at their stamina and spirits. Dai and Popp begin to lose hope. Just then, a single ray of light shines through. Can they escape this hopeless situation...?!

episodes.name: Return of the Great Hero
episodes.overview: It was Avan, returned from the dead, who saved Popp and Hadlar! Dai, Popp, and Maam embrace their Master in tears. But Hyunckel, caught between conflicting emotions, is unable to face Avan. The party welcomes their new ally and heads towards Vearn’s palace!

episodes.name: The Secret Way of Purification
episodes.overview: Hyunckel refuses to proceed with Avan and stays behind. Dai and the others are bewildered but advance without him. The party reaches the doors to Vearn Palace. At a loss as to how to breach the doors, Avan steps forward…

episodes.name: The Steady Advance of Justice
episodes.overview: Leaving Hyunckel to guard the rear, Dai and his friends enter Vearn Palace. Avan scouts ahead and asks a favor of Leona. Back on the surface, the humans overcome Zaboera’s monster horde. The tide of battle is turning, then Zaboera executes a plan.

episodes.name: The Other Hero
episodes.overview: Zaboera reveals his ace, the Superior Being Zombie. Crocodine and the humans are out of options. As morale fades, Nova, Hero of the North, risks his life to face the enemy.

episodes.name: The Survivor From Hell
episodes.overview: After the battle of Loroi Valley, Crocodine finds Zaboera who managed to survive. Meanwhile, Hyunckel battles the monster horde. Then an unexpected individual appears...!

episodes.name: The Silver-Haired Hym
episodes.overview: Hym returns from hell stronger than ever. Hyunckel faces Hym using only his fists and Aura. Who will be the victor in the clash between fists of fortitude and implacability?

episodes.name: Checkmate
episodes.overview: A new enemy, the king Maximum appears with an Orichalcum Army. Hyunckel and Hym are in peril. Hyunckel stands his wounded body up and burns his fortitude to face their enemy!

episodes.name: The Battle in the White Garden
episodes.overview: Larhart appears before Hyunckel and Hym, and takes the Dark Armour Spear before leaving to protect Dai. Meanwhile, Dai, Popp, and Maam face off against Mystvearn.

episodes.name: The Successor of Justice
episodes.overview: Avan is taken by Killvearn and challenged to a duel. Meanwhile, Dai and his friends challenge Mystvearn in hopes of finding out how to save their Master, but...?

episodes.name: Baran's Last Will
episodes.overview: Mystvearn captures Popp and Maam and all seems lost. But Land Rider Larhart appears and rescues them before kneeling before Dai and relaying Baran’s last wish to him...

episodes.name: Rise, Knight of Destiny
episodes.overview: Leona is captured. Dai chases after her and arrives at a “living engine", the Dark Force Reactor. Dai attempts to rescue Leona, but is stopped. What will happen to her...?

episodes.name: Vearn, The Dark King
episodes.overview: Dai and Leona reach the top of the Tower of Supremacy. Facing Vearn, Dai recalls his past loss against him and is struck with fear. Vearn is wary of Dai’s Twin Dragon Crests.

episodes.name: Killvearn's Trap
episodes.overview: Dai’s power could match or exceed Vearn’s. Vearn invites Dai to serve him. Meanwhile, Avan and Killvearn continue to fight. Can Avan win against the Reaper?

episodes.name: The Deciding Attack
episodes.overview: Hym unleashes attacks against the heretofore invulnerable Mystvearn. Dai holds the upper hand against Vearn, but feels overwhelmed by his confidence. How will each fight end?

episodes.name: The Shadow Raiment
episodes.overview: The consecutive Doruoras swallowed Dark King Vearn. Popp and the others decide to regroup with Dai. The fallen Mystvearn stands again and removes his Shadow Raiment.

episodes.name: The Secret Spell of Frozen Time
Myst and Kill
episodes.overview: With Popp and Brokeena gone, the others lose their will to fight. Then, Killvearn appears, announcing Avan’s death. But something about Killvearn is different...?

episodes.name: Vearn's Truth
episodes.overview: Avan reveals Mystvearn’s true identity and Dark King Vearn’s greatest secret. Meanwhile, in the Tower of Supremacy, dark clouds gather above Dai and Leona...

episodes.name: The Demonic Guard of Heaven and Earth
episodes.overview: Myst tries to make Hyunckel’s body his own. Meanwhile, Dai faces off with Vearn, the True Dark King. Dai’s strongest attack, Giga Strash, is met with an unknown stance...

episodes.name: The Eye Jewel
episodes.overview: The Demonic Guard of Heaven and Earth beats Dai’s Gigastrash. When Leona refuses to become Vearn’s servant, he takes away her freedom. Just then, Popp and the others arrive!

episodes.name: On This Bond
episodes.overview: Popp tries to uncover the secret of the Dark King’s ultimate skill. He stands strong despite being battered by Vearn’s offensive, bolstering the morale of Hym and Larhart.

episodes.name: Like a Bright Flash
episodes.overview: The Black Cores in the Pillars of Vearn begin counting down to the world’s end. Dai is broken, and Popp loses the will to fight... Suddenly, a voice rings in Popp’s ears!

episodes.name: The Tear of the Gods
episodes.overview: To Vearn’s confusion, Dai and Popp rise up again and again. The Dark King tries to detonate the Black Core below, but suddenly the unbelievable happens!

episodes.name: Dai's Decision
episodes.overview: With Gomechan’s miracle, the hearts of all the people of the world have been united. They all work together to stop the Black Cores... What will happen to the Surface World?!

episodes.name: Victory By These Hands
episodes.overview: Having become the Dragonoid, Dai pummels Vearn. Meanwhile, Popp and the other heroes have been dropped into the heart of Vearn Palace, where they face a new threat...!

episodes.name: Farewell, This World That I Love
episodes.overview: In the conclusion to the epic battle between the Hero and the Dark King, Dai fights with his father’s Demon Dragon Blade, and Vearn counters with beams and his rigid body.

episodes.name: Three Men, a Little Girl, a Police Officer and a Dog
episodes.overview: Kusuo and his "friends" search for a missing dog. Kusuo discovers the intricacies of online gaming, then the world of adults as his father's stand-in.

episodes.name: Build the Most Powerful Deck!
episodes.overview: Broken headgear spells trouble for Kusuo's home life. Kaido ropes his friends into a children's card game and loses in more ways than one.

episodes.name: New Teacher with an Outstanding Feature
episodes.overview: A sincere new teacher's creepy-looking face leads to mishaps and misunderstandings when the class sets out to find a peeping tom.

episodes.name: Terrifying! A Disastrous Transfer Student
episodes.overview: Toritsuka ropes Kusuo into helping him after a cute transfer student bumbles into their lives. She might be more than Kusuo can handle.

episodes.name: Bully Rescue! Mr. Iguchi
episodes.overview: Nendo's friends get mistaken for bullies. Kusuo escapes his friends before their plans to have an escape room adventure become reality.

episodes.name: Reawakening Saiki Kusuo
episodes.overview: Kusuo is now a third-year student living as a normal teenager with no psychic powers. Sort of. But being normal is harder than he thought.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: This is the story of a mother who died and begins a 49-day long project of reincarnation, and a husband who has barely begun to live a new life after overcoming the pain of losing his wife. Jo Kang Hwa is a skilled thoracic surgeon. After losing his wife four…

episodes.name: Life is Full of Unpredictable Surprises
episodes.overview: Cha Yu-ri, a ghost for five years, realizes her daughter can see her. Just as she decides it's time to move on, she is returned to her human form.

episodes.name: Forgotten Season
episodes.overview: Cho Gang-hwa is shaken by the sight of Yu-ri, who's got 49 days to find her rightful place. What's more, Cho Seo-woo has gone missing.

episodes.name: Realizing the Beauty of Life is Only Possible After Death
episodes.overview: Gang-hwa isn't sure how to reveal that he got remarried. Wanting to protect Seo-woo from lurking ghosts, Yu-ri eyes an opening at the preschool.

episodes.name: There is Nothing that Won't Happen to Me
episodes.overview: Gang-hwa worries when Oh Min-jeong notices that Yu-ri looks familiar. At her new job at the preschool, Yu-ri learns the child ghost's secret.

episodes.name: Every Moment When Chance Turns into Fate
episodes.overview: Yu-ri's human form causes a stir with the ghosts at the columbarium. Yu-ri slips up in front of Gang-hwa and Min-jeong at the preschool.

episodes.name: Even in the Face of Death, Family is Still My Number One
episodes.overview: Min-jeong wakes up with a mysterious face wound, and contemplates a big decision. Meanwhile, Gang-hwa faces disciplinary action at the hospital.

episodes.name: Where Flowers Bloom and Fall
episodes.overview: Yu-ri meets Min-jeong about an opportunity. While fulfilling a wish from Jang Pil-seung's family, Yu-ri finds herself in an awkward position.

episodes.name: People Who Can't Say Goodbye
episodes.overview: Yu-ri can't help but notice a ghost and his daughter's unfortunate circumstances, and crosses paths with someone who shouldn't see her.

episodes.name: Goodbye and Hello to Your Light
episodes.overview: Determined to kick out an unwanted ghost from Seo-woo's home, Yu-ri starts babysitting her. Gang-hwa makes an upsetting blunder.

episodes.name: Your Place Where I Cannot Reach
episodes.overview: With half her allotted days already gone, Yu-ri focuses on taking care of Seo-woo — and Min-jeong. Elsewhere, Gang-hwa and Jeon Eun-suk meet again.

episodes.name: The Share Of Life Given To Me
episodes.overview: The arrival of an unwelcome guest sets Ms. Mi-dong on edge. Yu-ri, Min-jeong and Go Hyeon-jeong have had enough of the preschool's bullying moms.

episodes.name: The Days I Was Forgotten
episodes.overview: Gang-hwa is shocked to hear Seo-woo say Yu-ri's name. Yu-ri grapples with the implications, as well as a threat from the exorcist.

episodes.name: A Story I Could Not See
episodes.overview: After learning that Yu-ri was by his side all along, Gang-hwa prepares to be honest with Min-jeong. The neighbors gossip about the trio.

episodes.name: It’s Not Your Fault
episodes.overview: Returning to the operating room isn't easy for Gang-hwa. After a day spent with Hyeon-jeong and her family, Yu-ri comes to a tearful realization.

episodes.name: My Life's Tomorrow
episodes.overview: If Yu-ri wants to stay and live, she must go back to her rightful place. As Gang-hwa resolves to make this happen, Min-jeong tells him she's leaving.

episodes.name: Petals Fall, But the Flower Endures
episodes.overview: The reason why Yu-ri was brought back to life comes to light. With the end of her 49 days imminent, all that remains is for her to make her choice.

seasons.name: Limited Series
seasons.overview: To secure a better future, Kang Ingu goes to Suriname to run a fishery with a friend. It’s all smooth sailing until he falls into a trap and ends up in jail. A government agent comes to Ingu's aid — but in return, he must help reel in a drug lord.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Kang Ingu goes to scope out the factory for his potential new business venture, but finds himself caught in a turf war. A local pastor offers his help.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Reluctant to hire a lawyer, Ingu considers a deal proposed by a secret agent. He expands his influence in prison, hoping to trick an ex-bodyguard.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Ingu mediates a partnership between Jeon Yohan and Goo Sangman. Yohan does his due diligence before committing to the trade.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: A conflict at the border shifts the dynamics within Yohan’s inner circle. Sangman proposes a different route to Korea.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Unable to convince Yohan to take the new route, Ingu improvises by coming up with a solution of his own. David Julio Park prepares a handoff.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Yohan throws a last-minute curveball in a plan that ensured Ingu’s safety. Lee Sangjun arrives at the airport as the crackdown on Yohan’s empire begins.

episodes.name: The "What the Love!" Singles Party
episodes.overview: A rocking party, cheeky games and a few special guests help Karan select six people he wants to help find love from a roomful of hopeful candidates.

episodes.name: The Unsuitable Bride
episodes.overview: Rejected by 11 suitors, pathologist Aashi dreams of Bollywood-style love. But first, Karan must help her through the pain behind her bubbly exterior.

episodes.name: The Eager Beaver
episodes.overview: Rabanne hungers for a monogamous relationship as a gay man in Mumbai, yet he must learn that finding real love means being true to himself first.

episodes.name: Mr. No Time for Love
episodes.overview: Workaholic Vaibhav lacks the time and swagger to make dating work, but Karan’s got strategies — and a surprise guest — to take him from shy to suave.

episodes.name: Ms. Date Me Not
episodes.overview: Lingering physical and emotional scars have fashion designer Geetika running from romance. Karan urges her to lower her defenses to let love in.

episodes.name: Ms. Heartbroken
episodes.overview: Low self-esteem plagues Reena after being dumped. Karan's squad and a Bollywood gent give her a mental makeover before she gives dating another try.

episodes.name: The Planner
episodes.overview: Jet-setter Rameez has high expectations for a life partner. Karan challenges this man with a plan to see that love isn’t about checking off boxes.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Two actors and a makeup artist fight to make their own way in a world that weighs the backgrounds they were born into more than their dreams.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Despite opposition from his family, Sa Hye-jun hustles to make ends meet while pursuing an acting career. At a fashion show, he meets An Jeong-ha.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Nothing is easy for Hye-jun as he faces an insulting proposition, upsetting clashes with his father and disappointing news from Won Hae-hyo.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Down about work and life, Hye-jun and Jeong-ha cheer each other up. Kim I-yeong and Han Ae-suk disagree on what a parent's duty is to their children

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Hye-jun decides to give his acting career one last chance. Over dinner and drinks, Jeong-ha spills her heart out to him about trouble at work.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: When Sa Gyeong-jun says he wants to move out, Ae-suk calls a family meeting. On the set of the film, Hye-jun puts forth his best effort.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Just when everything seems to be working out, Lee Min-jae runs into a roadblock. Hye-jun and his friends help Sa Min-gi create a modeling portfolio.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Min-jae secures Hye-jun a new audition for a TV drama role. Gyeong-jun is stunned when his move doesn't go according to plan.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: As Hye-jun's drama debuts to great success, some in his family are happier than others. Meanwhile, Jeong-ha's conflict with her co-worker escalates.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Jeong-ha prepares to sell her place. Hye-jun's continued rapid rise to stardom draws the envy of many, most of all from I-yeong.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Hae-hyo grows sick of constantly being compared to Hye-jun, who learns he's up for an acting award. Jeong-ha hands in her resignation letter.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: A piece of shocking news evolves into gossip that threatens Hye-jun's career and sets Min-jae on edge. The family convenes for another meeting.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Hae-hyo and Hye-jun have a frustrating conversation. When his ex-girlfriend gives an interview to a reporter, Hye-jun apologizes to Jeong-ha.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Lee Tae-su tries to get back into Hye-jun's good graces. Grappling with a hard-to-swallow truth, Hae-hyo turns to Jeong-ha for consolation.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Another false news story involving Hye-jun scandalizes the public. In a conflict with an internet troll, Gyeong-jun refuses to admit wrongdoing.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Jeong-ha's mother shows up to stay with her for a few days. Wanting to put an end to rumors about Hye-jun, Min-jae takes matters into her own hands.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Hye-jun defies everyone's expectations for his next steps with a surprise announcement. At the same time, Hae-hyo comes to his own resolve.

seasons.name: Start-Up
seasons.overview: Young entrepreneurs aspiring to launch virtual dreams into reality compete for success and love in the cutthroat world of Korea's high-tech industry.

episodes.name: START-UP
episodes.overview: The spring Seo Dal-mi lost everything, Nam Do-san's letters kept her company. Fifteen years later, she needs him by her side to prove Won In-jae wrong.

episodes.name: FFF (FAMILY, FRIENDS, FOOLS)
episodes.overview: To preserve Dal-mi's past and to support her future, Choi Won-deok asks Han Ji-pyeong to pull off an impossible task.

episodes.name: Angel
episodes.overview: Ji-pyeong scrambles to transform Do-san into the man of Dal-mi's dreams. A rude awakening prompts In-jae to close one door and open another.

episodes.name: Sandbox
episodes.overview: Despite differing pasts, Dal-mi and In-jae fight for their dreams at the same starting line. Ji-pyeong sets out to protect Dal-mi and help Do-san.

episodes.name: Hackathon
episodes.overview: Dal-mi and In-jae present their teams' ideas on the hackathon stage. A story about Dal-mi's upbringing moves Ji-pyeong to fight for her success.

episodes.name: Key Man
episodes.overview: In-jae uses lessons from her father and stepfather to her advantage. A clash over company shares tests Dal-mi, who turns to Ji-pyeong for advice.

episodes.name: Burn Rate
episodes.overview: Grappling with his feelings for Dal-mi, Ji-pyeong avoids her. Do-san's knowledge of Won-deok's condition inspires a business idea for Samsan Tech.

episodes.name: Backup
episodes.overview: Devastating news gives Dal-mi another reason to make the app a success. Won Du-jeong's plan to teach Do-san and Dal-mi a lesson backfires.

episodes.name: Risk
episodes.overview: Do-san and Ji-pyeong struggle to bear the weight of their untold truths. Doubts and a mix-up lead Dal-mi to the place where it all started.

episodes.name: Demo Day
episodes.overview: Ji-pyeong gives Dal-mi long-awaited answers and a confession. Seeking success on his own terms, Do-san considers a golden opportunity.

episodes.name: Exit
episodes.overview: Kim Yong-san forces Ji-pyeong to reflect on his past remarks. In-jae and Dal-mi's companies showcase rivaling programs using the same technology.

episodes.name: Acqhire
episodes.overview: Alex Kwon shows his true colors, proving Ji-pyeong right and fulfilling Samsan Tech's worst fears. Do-san tells Ji-pyeong about Won-deok's health.

episodes.name: Comfort Zone
episodes.overview: Dal-mi and In-jae's self-driving car is hit by a ransomware attack. Samsan Tech founders return after a successful three-year stint in San Francisco.

episodes.name: Elevator Speech
episodes.overview: Tasked with recruiting top developers into her company, Dal-mi pitches her idea at Samsan Tech. Do-san gets away to clear his head.

episodes.name: MVP (Minimum Viable Product)
episodes.overview: Jung Sa-ha and Lee Chul-san begin dating in secret. A boozy, heartfelt conversation with Do-san helps Ji-pyeong make a decision about Dal-mi.

episodes.name: Scale Up
episodes.overview: Do-san and Dal-mi envision new goals for their future. Ji-pyeong finds a way to pay forward his gratitude for Won-deok. In-jae returns to her roots.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When doubts arise about a five-year-old murder conviction, a veteran detective partners with a young hotshot to hunt down the case's hidden truths.

episodes.name: The Murder Case From Five Years Ago
episodes.overview: On their first day as partners, detectives Kang Do-chang and Oh Ji-hyeok pick up a series of calls with perplexing connections to a closed murder case.

episodes.name: No Sinner Shall Sleep Peacefully At Night
episodes.overview: Words get out of Incheon Seobu Police Station revealing that Lee Eun Hye, the daughter of a murderer Lee Dae Chul, has been kidnapped, murdered, and buried by a man who claims to be the culprit. As the news goes viral, people who were related to the murder ca…

episodes.name: The Execution
episodes.overview: The execution of death-row convict Lee Dae Chul nears as well as the evaluation for Do Chang’s promotion. Knowing that Lee Dae Chul has an alibi at the time of the murder, Do Chang needs to decide whether to save an innocent man or to submit to the authority.…

episodes.name: We Are Only Humans
episodes.overview: A big body of corruption sweeps over Violent Crimes Unit Two with the higher-ups continuously pressuring them to turn a blind eye to Lee Dae Chul’s case. Meanwhile, Ji Hyuk saves Seo Gyeong from Jo Seong Dae who is suspected of killing Park Gun Ho. Eventually…

episodes.name: We Are Trying To Save A Person’s Life
episodes.overview: While clues proving a corruptive body’s close relation to Lee Dae Chul’s case pile up, Do Chang figures out a work-around to carry out a secret investigation on Jo Seong Dae. On top of that, Ji Hyuk hints to him how his very cousin, Oh Jong Tae, may be partia…

episodes.name: Not Everyone Is Self-Centered
episodes.overview: Do Chang confesses to Eun Hye that he wants to save her father, Lee Dae Chul. Unfortunately, Eun Hye can’t trust Do Chang who literally handcuffed and arrested her father for a murder he didn’t commit. However, Do Chang shows a sign of hope for Eun Hye by get…

episodes.name: Every Truth Has Two Opposing Stories
episodes.overview: Although Do Chang and Mr. So prepare for the retrial of Lee Dae Chul’s case, Do Chang still needs to persuade Dae Chul to follow his lead because he is reluctant to take part in it due to the possibility of harm that it may cause his daughter. Meanwhile, Do C…

episodes.name: Do Chang on a Witness Stand
episodes.overview: It was already difficult enough for Do Chang and others to get a retrial approved. However, feeling desperate during the trial, Dae Chul falsely admits to his killing of Detective Jang Jin Soo. Meanwhile, Seo Gyeong receives a recording from an unknown sender…

episodes.name: A Voice Recording of Superintendent Moon
episodes.overview: After losing at the retrial, Do Chang gets demoted. With Do Chang out of the picture, Violent Crimes Unit Two also feels pointless to even fight for a comeback. Meanwhile, Ji Hyuk meets Seo Gyeong and finds out about a voice recording that she’s been keeping…

episodes.name: The One Behind Jo Seong Dae
episodes.overview: Do Chang gets reinstated and returns to Violent Crimes Unit Two after coming to an agreement with Superintendent Moon. The team then focuses on Park Gun Ho’s case and stumbles upon Jo Seong Dae’s bloodstain at the murder site. This leads to the revelation of…

episodes.name: Do Chang Goes After Oh Jong Tae
episodes.overview: With the help of a little stunt pulled off by Jae Hong, Do Chang gets one step closer to proving Oh Jong Tae’s crime. Meanwhile, Ji Hyuk barges into Yoo Jeong Seok’s office, asking if he is closely acquainted with his cousin, Oh Jong Tae. Even with all eviden…

episodes.name: You Can't Die Just Yet
episodes.overview: While Ji Hyuk manages to survive the ambush by Oh Jong Tae, the prosecution adds more pressure to Do Chang and his colleagues, invalidating their efforts to bring Oh Jong Tae down. Do Chang however continues to put pieces together and stumbles upon a crucial…

episodes.name: The Remains Of A Dead Body Near Gawol Church
episodes.overview: Jin Seo Gyeong hosts a secret meeting with Yoo Jeong Seok and Kim Gi Tae at Gawol Church, demanding them the truth regarding a missing person named Jo Seong Gi. In the meantime, Do Chang and Ji Hyuk successfully locate the missing dead body from five years ag…

episodes.name: Those Who Deserve To Die
episodes.overview: Even after the arrest, Oh Jong Tae still has the audacity to claim his innocence and goes on to emphasize the incompetence and corruption of the police organization. Meanwhile, Seo Gyeong and Sang Mi sidestep to approach the matter in their own way. Eventuall…

episodes.name: Something Worth Dying For
episodes.overview: Yoo Jeong Seok admits to his doings before his junior reporters and leaves the office, ordering them to stay put until his next instruction. While being threatened by Oh Jong Tae, Nam Guk Hyun offers video footage of Jeong Seok’s murders. On the verge of bein…

episodes.name: The Last Target
episodes.overview: The shocking death of Yoo Jeong Seok stirs up the public, and the case is now under a spotlight. As the prosecutor makes a confession to his previous wrongdoing out of conscience, Oh Jong Tae gets sentenced to a lifetime in prison. However, Ji Hyuk’s gut feel…

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The tenacious detective duo returns to chase after killers and get to the bottom of a dark conspiracy involving an influential corporation.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: A serial killer is on the loose. As Do-chang battles past trauma, the investigation grows murkier, only taking him further from the truth.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Do-chang’s guilt grows after another unexpected death takes place. Others want to wrap up the case, but Do-chang and Ji-hyeok refuse to give up.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The detectives find some strong evidence and start going over CCTV footage. A man burns mysterious objects, and makes a suspicious approach.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Do-chang and Ji-hyeok are hot on the killer’s heels, but elsewhere another murder is underway. Cheon Sang-u keeps an eye on Cheon Na-na.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Do-chang finds out about the killer’s tragic past and realizes that one piece of his pattern of murders doesn’t line up. He induces a confession.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Na-na follows Sang-u and finds some evidence. The team is threatened with being broken up. The detectives investigate Jung Hui-ju’s acquaintances.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Kim Min-ji’s background is revealed. The detectives get proof that incriminates TJ Group executives. Ji-hyeok is curious about Na-na’s intentions.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Na-na’s press conference throws Woo Tae-ho into disarray. A suspect in the Hui-ju case is caught and some clarity is brought to the case.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: The detectives question Na-na about the car accident. They investigate Tae-ho's previous whereabouts, but Choi Yong-geun is looking into this too.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Na-na preys on Sang-u’s weaknesses. A mysterious man follows Moon Bo-kyeong, while Yong-geun plans to use her connections to his advantage.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Yong-geun is arrested, but uses his experience to make the interrogation difficult. The detectives search for a motive for Sang-u’s murder.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Sang-u is furious after realizing that Na-na came close to turning him in. Ji-hyeok provokes Yong-geun in an attempt to make Sang-u culpable.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: The detectives ask to reopen Tae-ho’s case and look for further evidence regarding his death. Na-na asks Ji-hyeok to make an allegiance with her.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: The detectives question the gang who tried to kill Hui-ju’s grandfather. As they get closer to the truth, Na-na and Jang Ki-jin get into trouble.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Na-na passes evidence of her father threatening her to Ji-hyeok, but he uses it against her. Ki-jin files a false charge against Do-chang’s team.

episodes.name: Episode 16

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Weol-ju is intrigued when a tight-lipped customer who refuses to open up about her problems suddenly starts pouring out her heart to Han Kang-bae.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Kang-bae isn't sure he wants to work for Weol-ju. But he does want to help his neighbor, a woman who is plagued by guilt from her past.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Weol-ju attacks a rotten system that's thrown her latest customer into despair. Kang-bae makes contact with an unusual woman.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: At an event held in the afterlife, Kang-bae meets a man who's determined to win the prize: lottery ticket numbers for his living descendant.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Weol-ju and Guibanjang chase after a wayward spirit who has a problem moving on. Kang-bae asks Kang Yeo-rin to be his partner for a dance contest.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Kang-bae and Yeo-rin start taking dance lessons. When their instructor reveals a heartbreaking personal struggle, Weol-ju has an idea for a solution.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Tasked by Yeomradaewang with fixing an afterlife slip-up, Weol-ju, Guibanjang and Kang-bae devise a plan that hinges on victory at the dance contest.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: A haunted apartment turns out to be occupied by a dead web novelist with a sad real-life love story. Kang-bae mopes over romantic woes of his own.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: While seeking a way to keep her end of the deal with Kang-bae, Weol-ju comes up against a hellish decision. Yeombujang stirs up trouble.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: The appearance of a face from the past dredges up cruel memories for Guibanjang and Weol-ju. Kang-bae saves Yeo-rin from a hurtful situation.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Yeo-rin is mystified when a strange voice begins to prevent her from touching Kang-bae. Weol-ju confronts new truths about Guibanjang.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Following a huge revelation, Weol-ju and Guibanjang take on a final case to resolve, and do everything they can to protect Kang-bae.

episodes.name: Gluttony

episodes.name: Sloth
episodes.overview: The pair make their way through a cavern that once housed a bustling narcotics operation. Deeper inside, a towering hydra stalks the depths.

episodes.name: Greed
episodes.overview: Ethan and Hannah reunite with royal guards Simon and Balthazar, agreeing to help them destroy a greedy lich who commands an army of undead.

episodes.name: Lust
episodes.overview: Hannah convinces Ethan to rest at an inn before marching on to the dragon's lair. In his room, a vision of his wife brings back Ethan's past.

episodes.name: Pride
episodes.overview: Ethan makes his way to the Tainted Mountain to face the dragon and reclaim his stolen heart, or die trying.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Though mortal enemies, a human girl and a vampire queen set out in search of the paradise where humans and vampires once coexisted in peace.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: On a mission to annihilate vampires, Momo discovers a music box. The mysterious melody leads to an unlikely encounter with Fine, the vampire queen.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Fine brings Momo to her secluded villa, where they bond over music. Meanwhile, Kubo and Allegro are on a mission to retrieve the two runaways.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Fine and Momo hit the road, making a pit stop at a hotel in a desolate city. All is well, until there is a gradual change in Fine.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Momo wakes up to find herself in a seemingly utopian village where vampires and humans peacefully coexist. She meets Elisha, a vampire her age.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Both the human troops and vampires under Allegro's lead reach the village, forcing Fine and Momo to fight for their lives.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Inside Lee Byeong-chan's science lab, a student incurs a seemingly harmless bite. Shortly after, a fast-spreading outbreak soaks the school in blood.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: The infected multiply in droves. Scrambling for their lives, Nam On-jo and Lee Cheong-san find safety with others inside a classroom — but not for long.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: When one of the group is scratched while fighting a zombie, Lee Na-yeon demands they kick him out. Outside, the virus swallows up the city.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: In need of a cellphone, two students take a risky journey to the teachers' office. Byeong-chan passes on critical information to Detective Song Jae-ik.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Martial law is imposed on the city. When Cheong-san is separated from the rest of the group, On-jo leads a mission to use a drone to locate him.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The group clears a path to Cheong-san using sound to draw away zombies, but a new type of threat surfaces. Nam So-ju breaks out of the quarantine camp.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: To make it out of the music room and onto the roof, the students put into action their most perilous plan yet. Elsewhere, Jae-ik comes across a setback.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Jae-ik and his crew run into a student from the school. Na-yeon works up the courage to face her peers. The group shares confessions around a fire.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: A disturbance at the camp shifts the military's understanding of the virus. A thunderstorm provides cover as the group agrees to keep on moving.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: The auditorium quickly becomes a trap for the two newly united teams of survivors. Byeong-chan's video logs reveal a drastic solution to the crisis.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Though a surprise protector provides the group safe passage to their next stop, Yoon Gwi-nam is not far behind. The military makes a grave decision.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: The students make it to the quarantine camp, each of them weighed down by tragic loss. Months later, they hang on to hope for a survivor.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Megatron urges Optimus Prime to accept a treaty, while Starscream questions Jetfire’s leadership. The Autobots try to recruit Bumblebee to their side.

episodes.name: Episode 2

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Optimus has a plan but needs Ratchet’s help. Ultra Magnus is tortured for information while Starscream continues to foster dissent among the Seekers.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Elita casts doubt on Optimus’ plan, which includes fixing a Spacebridge. Optimus appeals to the Guardians for help and Bumblebee receives a high honor.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Jetfire offers to help Optimus retrieve the Allspark. Bumblebee, Cog and Arcee go on a mission for energon; Wheeljack tries to get the Ark to fly.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Optimus struggles to obtain the Allspark. Megatron figures out Optimus’ plan and orders an attack on the Autobots, who receive an unexpected assist.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A timid, small-town comedian's long-awaited big break takes a dark turn when he realizes committing murder is the only way to keep his onstage mojo.

episodes.overview: A betrayal against Hasmukh is thwarted. At a party, Jimmy spots their potential next victim. Ahead of his performance, Hasmukh faces an unexpected snag.

episodes.name: Ek Writer Ki Maut
episodes.overview: Low on morale, Jimmy shuts Rhea out. Naik makes a discovery about Hasmukh’s ex-mentor. Ajinkya tries to prove his loyalty to KK, with tragic results.

episodes.name: Sab Samay Ka Khel Hai
episodes.overview: Hours before the show, Jimmy and Hasmukh catch up to Ajinkya, and Hasmukh’s past catches up to him. Hasmukh and KK go head-to-head in a shocking finale.

episodes.overview: Anna tells Yoh about the new tournament to crown the next Shaman King. Ren's sister Jun challenges Yoh to a battle, with Amidamaru as the prize.

episodes.name: Happy Place
episodes.overview: After possessing Ryu, Tokageroh takes Manta hostage. Yoh and Amidamaru fight him, but Tokageroh wields Harusame and they're at a disadvantage.

episodes.name: Yoh vs. Horohoro!

episodes.name: A Form of Courage
episodes.overview: Faust VIII, a necromancer who can manipulate corpses, enrages Yoh when he targets Manta for sadistic experimentation before their match.

episodes.name: Progress
episodes.overview: With Ren as his next opponent, Yoh distances himself from Manta to ensure his friend's safety. Later, Yoh returns to Izumo to continue his training.

episodes.name: Yoh vs. Ren: Again!
episodes.overview: The last battle in the preliminary round begins. Fated rivals Yoh and Ren fight to the limit, but who will punch their ticket to the main tournament?

episodes.name: Night in the Flame
episodes.overview: Ren returns to China to take care of unfinished business. The BōZ Brothers ambush Yoh and Tamao, but a familiar face comes to their rescue.

episodes.name: A Tale of Two Men
episodes.overview: Back home, an imprisoned Ren vows to defeat his father after losing to him in a fight. Meanwhile, Yoh and the others set out for China to rescue Ren.

episodes.name: Ren vs. En: The End of the Tao
episodes.overview: Ren and his allies make their way toward En. The head of the Tao family may be a formidable foe, but Yoh and company aren't ones to back down.

episodes.name: And Hao!
episodes.overview: Yoh's group meets the self-proclaimed future king. Those in the main tournament board a flight, not knowing their first trial is about to begin.

episodes.name: Lyserg the Avenger
episodes.overview: As Yoh and the others prepare to travel to a town where a Patch Tribe village once stood, the dowser Lyserg appears and asks to join their group.

episodes.name: When the Pieces Come Together
episodes.overview: Yohmei tasks Anna with delivering an ancient book belonging to the Asakura family to Yoh in the United States. Horohoro's guardian Kororo goes missing.

episodes.name: Enter the Ultra-Pompandour
episodes.overview: Searching for answers, Yoh and company arrive at the ancestral village of the Patch Tribe, where they find themselves beset by Hao's followers.

episodes.name: Guns of the Angels
episodes.overview: Facing Boris, Ryu unleashes a new power acquired from his training with Yoh's grandfather Yohmei. An unexpected person appears before Manta and Anna.

episodes.name: Great Spirits and My Team
episodes.overview: Yoh's group reaches the Patch Tribe Village as they find the Great Spirits and learn the purpose of the Shaman Fight. A cheery shaman joins the team.

episodes.name: Jaguar
episodes.overview: While looking for Lyserg, Yoh and friends are confronted by Faust, who makes a startling offer. Finally the stage is set, and the Shaman Fight begins.

episodes.name: Joco's Christmas
episodes.overview: Team Ren faces off against Hao's lackeys, Team Tsuchi-gumi. Joco recalls his past with a certain person after being cornered in a desperate situation.

episodes.name: Iron Maiden Jeanne
episodes.overview: The second Shaman Fight begins as Team X-I of the X-Laws take on Egypt's Team Niles. But X-I's newest member is someone Yoh's group knows all too well.

episodes.name: I'll Go Anywhere with You
episodes.overview: Team Funbari Hot Springs begins their first match versus the Icemen. But Yoh vows to defeat them with one attack thanks to the ultra senji ryakketsu.

episodes.name: The Power of Yoh
episodes.overview: Overwhelmed by Faust's new Over Soul, the Icemen crumble under the pressure — then launch a sub-zero counterattack as the end of the match approaches.

episodes.name: Trust No One
episodes.overview: Yoh meets with Lyserg for a long-awaited conversation, but others lurking nearby intervene. Finally, X-Laws' team X-III takes on Hao's Hoshi-gumi team.

episodes.name: The Great Onmyoji, Hao Asakura
episodes.overview: Yoh watches helplessly as Team X-III desperately fights Hao, who reveals the secret of his birth and his thousand-year history with the Asakura clan.

episodes.name: Mikihisa Typhoon
episodes.overview: Yoh's friends are stunned by the revelation about Hao. Later, a mysterious masked man appears before Team Ren with an offer to make them stronger.

episodes.name: Farewell Forever
episodes.overview: Ren gains new power after taking on his powerful opponent. As the Shaman Fight continues, Hao's followers begin targeting teams outside the ring.

episodes.name: Yoh's Decision
episodes.overview: Horohoro and Joco try to escape Hao's follower Peyote Díaz with an injured Ren, but Yoh makes a surprising entrance. Elsewhere, Anna makes her move.

episodes.name: Emeth
episodes.overview: As Anna helps Mikihisa's teammates escape to their Shaman Fight, Tamao and Jun's battle against Hao's Hana-gumi heats up.

episodes.name: Mt. Osore Le Voile
episodes.overview: Yoh accepts Jeanne's conditions as payment for healing Ren, leaving their friends in shock. Anna recalls the first time she met Yoh five years ago.

episodes.name: Mt. Osore Le Voile ||
episodes.overview: Yoh tries to understand his fiancée, who continues to reject him and her connection to the demon attacking the town. Matamune's past is revealed.

episodes.name: Mt. Osore Le Voile |||
episodes.overview: Bit by bit, Anna and Yoh get closer when they visit the shrine together for New Year's. But Anna's powers bring on a dangerous situation.

episodes.name: Mt. Osore Le Voile IV
episodes.overview: Yoh and Matamune arrive at Mt. Osorezan to rescue Anna from the giant demon born from people's hearts, but Yoh only has one shot to save her.

episodes.name: To Be King
episodes.overview: Yoh's path to being Shaman King is over. Ryu and Manta spy on Jeanne's successful resurrection of Ren, which has an unexpectedly powerful side effect.

episodes.name: Reunion
episodes.overview: Horohoro finishes the fight with Brocken's team. Lyserg brings an injured Horohoro to Yoh's team when Peyote attacks with the intent to kill.

episodes.name: Redseb and Seyrarm
episodes.overview: Mikihisa's teammates, siblings Ludsev and Seyram, seek revenge against the person who killed their father. But Yoh steps in before it's too late.

episodes.name: Winds of Laughter
episodes.overview: Golem's new user goes on a rampage while Ren, Ludsev and the others come up with a plan to bring them back to their senses. Hao gives Opacho a task.

episodes.name: Graduation
episodes.overview: Opacho appears in front of Yoh with a message: Yoh must return to the Shaman Fight or Hao will destroy Golem and the children. What will he decide?

episodes.name: The Summit
episodes.overview: Yoh's battle with X-Laws to re-enter the Shaman Fight comes to an end as Luchist Lasso and Jeanne enter the fray. Later, Yoh reveals a plan to beat Hao.

episodes.name: Humility
episodes.overview: As the Shaman Fight matches enter the final stages, Team Ren faces a fierce battle against The Wisdom Kings, who can nullify a person's Over Soul.

episodes.name: Encounters in Hell
episodes.overview: Horohoro clinches the win for Team Ren, meaning their next opponent is Team Funbari Hot Springs. Meanwhile, a dubious group approaches Yoh and others.

episodes.name: A Great Trial
episodes.overview: Yoh continues to fight his way through hell with his new ability. As the Shaman Fight gets more complicated, an unprecedented trial awaits Yoh's team.

episodes.name: The End of a Dream
episodes.overview: Marco and the others desperately resist Hao's attack to keep Jeanne safe. Hao's clash with the X-Laws causes an unexpected crisis.

episodes.name: A Leisurely Chat
episodes.overview: Hao's lackeys begin to doubt his intentions. Anna confronts Hao, who reveals his ultimate oversoul. Yoh's group steps into the Shaman Fight ring.

episodes.name: The First and the Last
episodes.overview: The Shaman Fight between Team Funbari Hot Springs and Team Ren begins! But before Yoh can launch his counterattack, the match takes an unexpected turn.

episodes.name: True Justice
episodes.overview: Yoh and the others enter the area for the second tournament, but before it can begin, Yoh makes a surprising declaration.

episodes.name: Plants
episodes.overview: The winner of the Shaman Fight will finally be revealed. Yoh and the others try to stop Hao from joining with the Great Spirit.

episodes.name: All the Way
episodes.overview: Yoh and the others are giving it their all, but despite their best efforts and sacrifices, Hao manages to reach the King's shrine.

episodes.name: Good Night
episodes.overview: Yoh and the others arrive at Patch Officiant Kalim's residence, where they decide to take a well-earned rest. But soon, a surprise arrives.

episodes.name: Falling Damko
episodes.overview: During the battle against Kalim, the darkness that has been burdening Horohoro finally comes to light.

episodes.name: Last Test: Shaman Fight
episodes.overview: The group finally makes it to the final plant where they face Rutherfor, their most formidable opponent yet.

episodes.name: Shaman King: God End
episodes.overview: Hao releases the might of his newly acquired powers against Yoh and the others, but the scrappy crew refuses to give up hope.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Shiki is a boy who's always dreamed of making new friends from outside the Granbell Kingdom, his amusement park home filled with robots. He gets his wish when two young adventurers—Rebecca and her talking blue cat, Happy—come looking for interesting things to…

episodes.name: Into the Sky Where Cherry Blossoms Flutter
episodes.overview: Rebecca Bluegarden visits the nearly deserted Granbell Kingdom. There she meets the sole human inhabitant, Shiki, who wants to be her friend.

episodes.name: A Girl and Her Blue Cat
episodes.overview: On their way to Blue Garden, Rebecca encourages Shiki to get his adventure license. She also asks him to be a bodyguard for her and Happy.

episodes.name: Adventurers
episodes.overview: Shiki loses his cool when famous B-Cuber Labilia makes fun of Rebecca’s inferior B-Cube channel. Then, Shiki gets his official adventure license.

episodes.name: A Man Named Weisz
episodes.overview: On the planet Norma, where time is 50 years in the past, Happy and Rebecca meet a young Professor Weisz, who long ago saved Happy’s life.

episodes.name: Clash!! The Sibir Family
episodes.overview: Shiki and the gang break into Sibir’s hideout to get Pino back, but Weisz takes advantage of the chaos to try and take Pino for himself.

episodes.name: The Skull Fairy
episodes.overview: While Shiki and the gang struggle to fly Aqua Wing off of Norma, Weisz suddenly appears and offers to help — but he wants something in return.

episodes.name: Warship of the Demon King
episodes.overview: After boarding the pirate ship Skull Fairy, Shiki makes his way to the bridge to confront Elsie Crimson and fight her for the vessel.

episodes.name: Wind Howls on the Highway
episodes.overview: Witch informs Shiki that he is now the master of the Edens Zero. She further explains that the ship has not yet returned to its full power.

episodes.name: Planet Guilst
episodes.overview: While Shiki and the others rush to rescue Rebecca, Weisz returns to Edens Zero along with a woman named Homura.

episodes.name: The Great Naked Escape
episodes.overview: Homura uses her Soul Blade powers to fight off Sister's men. Meanwhile, Rebecca plans her escape from Illega Tower.

episodes.name: Sister Ivry
episodes.overview: As the chronophage moves ever closer to Planet Guilst, Shiki is disgusted to see Sister use Jinn as a shield. Then, another Sister appears!

episodes.name: New Friends
episodes.overview: Witch and Sister Ivry finally reunite, and Homura reveals her true motivations for coming aboard Edens Zero.

episodes.name: The Super Virtual Planet
episodes.overview: After finding Hermit on Iron Hill, the crew deduces that she’s in an abnormal sleep mode as a result of her heart being broken.

episodes.name: The Girl on the Hill
episodes.overview: The crew enters the virtual planet of Digitalis to search for Hermit, but when they find her, she stubbornly refuses to return to Edens Zero.

episodes.name: Great Kaiju Shiki
episodes.overview: After Homura declares that she’s joining Drakken Joe, Shiki and the crew are shocked when another Homura suddenly appears.

episodes.name: Fireworks
episodes.overview: Spider hacks into Edens Zero’s system and starts to destroy the ship from the inside. The only one who can stop him is Hermit.

episodes.name: The Temple of Knowledge
episodes.overview: To find the fourth member of the Demon King’s Four Shining Stars, Shiki and the crew head for the Planet of Time, Mildian.

episodes.name: Words Will Give You Strength
episodes.overview: At Battle Coliseum, Xiaomei tells Shiki and the crew that she’ll give them the information they want — but only if they can defeat their opponents.

episodes.name: From the Planet of Eternity
episodes.overview: After obtaining the information they needed from Xiaomei, Edens Zero sets course for the planet of Sun Jewel to reunite Homura with her mentor.

episodes.name: Stones
episodes.overview: Shiki and Homura find themselves in a labor zone where they’re forced to gather valuable metal for a figure known as Madame Kurenai.

episodes.name: Reset
episodes.overview: Nino leads Rebecca, Pino and Happy to the labor zone where they meet a man named Paul, who tells them he’s Valkyrie’s disciple.

episodes.name: My Mother, the Machine
episodes.overview: When Homura was a child on a war-torn planet, Valkyrie took her under her wing and raised her like her own.

episodes.name: Until the Day It Turns to Strength
episodes.overview: Shiki and the others confront Madame Kurenai. Homura is overwhelmed with sadness when she sees Valkyrie, while Drakken Joe hacks into Oculus Kurenai.

episodes.name: Taking Up the Torch
episodes.overview: Baku is easily defeated, thanks to Weisz’s Arsenal suit. While Shiki battles the Knight Gear controlled by Madame Kurenai, Rebecca fights Nino.

episodes.name: Someone to Love
episodes.overview: After the battle between the Kurenai Dragoon and Shiki comes to an end, Shiki and the others return to the Edens Zero and have to share some bad news.

episodes.name: BELIAL GORE
episodes.overview: After defeating Madame Kurenai and leaving the planet Sun Jewel, Shiki and his comrades continue their journey and attempt to infiltrate Belial Gore, the enormous urban-type battleship of Drakken Joe, who has been targeting Edens Zero.

episodes.name: ELEMENT 4
episodes.overview: Shiki and his gang believe they have successfully infiltrated Belial Gore, but Drakken Joe had been aware of their every move and sends out his elite military force, the Element 4, to take down Shiki's group.

episodes.name: A WIND BLOWS THROUGH THE SAKURA COSMOS
episodes.overview: Within the Belial Gore, Weisz dons an Arsenal suit in his fight against the Element 4 Spirit of Water, Laguna. However, he finds it difficult to gain the upper hand due to Laguna's various water attacks.

episodes.name: NO. 29
episodes.overview: Although Rebecca and Happy go into Belial Gore to deliver medicine to the injured Weisz, they are found by the Sylph of the Wind and captured. Shiki, Homura, and Pino receive Rebecca's communications and go to the loading docks, only to find that Rebecca is n…

episodes.name: INTERCESSION
episodes.overview: Although Shiki and Homura want to deliver medicine to Weisz as soon as possible, they struggle with the attacks from Sylph of the Wind and his assistant, Jinn.

episodes.name: OUR FUTURE
episodes.overview: Rebecca is devastated by Shiki's death and Drakken Joe finally explains to her in detail what it is he wants to extract from her. Apparently, she has a very particular Ether Gear.

episodes.name: 4 VS 4
episodes.overview: As her Ether Gear powers are activated, Rebecca goes back in time to before the Belial Gore infiltration and offers information to Shiki. Master Noah appears in front of Shiki and the gang, as they arrive at Drakken's hideout and says that he has a message fo…

episodes.name: The Sword of Edens
episodes.overview: Changing into her Battle Dress, Hermit fights off the Element 4 sniper, Fie. Sister fights Daichi of Earth, Homura battles Sylph of Wind, and Witch stands against Laguna of Water. Meanwhile, Shiki and his gang push forward toward Drakken's hideout.

episodes.name: SHIKI VS. DRAKKEN
episodes.overview: Shiki and the gang grasp a secret clue about Drakken Joe. As they discuss strategies for their next course of action, they notice that something is wrong with Labilia… Suddenly, Drakken Joe appears, sensing an Ether reaction. A head-to-head battle between Shi…

episodes.name: Advent of the Demon King
episodes.overview: The fierce battle between Shiki and Drakken continues. Drakken activates his Overdrive to overwhelm Shiki, but suddenly Arsenal appears!

episodes.name: Edens One
episodes.overview: "You've lived enough, time to sleep," says Shiki, who has reached Overdrive and defeated Drakken Joe. However, Weisz's anger does not subside, and he stands over and points his gun at the barely alive Drakken Joe.

episodes.name: Clash of the Cosmos
episodes.overview: Before they venture beyond the cosmos in search of Mother, the Goddess of the Cosmos, Edens Zero visits Granbell at the request of Shiki, where he has an unexpected reunion.

episodes.name: The Woman They Called Pirate
episodes.overview: Edens Zero is cornered by Edens One and Shiki and the crew are saved at the nick of time by the space pirate Elsie Crimson. After the battle, Elsie boards Edens Zero and talks to Shiki about something Ziggy had asked her to do a long time ago.

episodes.name: Nadia, Love of My Life
episodes.overview: Shiki and the gang get through Dragonfall and arrive at the Aoi Cosmos, which is ruled by Poseidon Nero of the Oración Seis Galáctica, and land on a fire planet, Red Cave, at the suggestion of Witch. The planet is overflowing with Water Ether, and is an envir…

episodes.name: A Robot in Love
episodes.overview: Within a temple adorned by reliefs of Mother, Shiki and the group meet Nadia, the temple's guardian. They hear from Nadia that the far end of the temple contains hints to finding Mother, but as they venture deep into the temple, they find a scorching cave…

episodes.name: IN THE DOGHOUSE
episodes.overview: With Laguna's help, Shiki and the gang obtain a hint for finding Mother and leave Red Cave towards the Verdant Planet Foresta. Meanwhile, Elsie's pirate gang, cruising through the Aoi Cosmos on the Skull Fairy, are being pursued by Justice of the Cosmic Gover…

episodes.name: THE BATTLE OF FORESTA
episodes.overview: The robots attack the ship and Jin, Kleene and Laguna have to defend their new allies. Meanwhile, on the planet, Shiki and the others are confronted by Poseidon Nero, who has been ordered to eliminate all robots.

episodes.name: Star Drain
episodes.overview: Shiki confronts Orc from Poseidon Nero's Commando Team "Beast". Orc tells Shiki that they were ordered by Nero and are on a mission to cleanse this planet, which was under the control of Ziggy.

episodes.name: DARLING LITTLE PIECE OF JUNK
episodes.overview: The battle in Foresta continues its course. Rebecca tries to experiment a little more with the use of Cat Leaper, but Hermit meets someone from her past that causes her to relive certain traumas.

episodes.name: Kiss & Die
episodes.overview: The battle in Foresta rages on and Elsie springs into action to help Shiki when Justice cuts his way.

episodes.name: THE DOOMSDAY SYSTEM
episodes.overview: The Doomsday System is activated and all of Foresta is in danger.

episodes.name: OCEANS 6
episodes.overview: Now that everyone's back on the ship, Shiki introduces Xenolith, who has some disturbing statements that affect Shiki and his companions. Meanwhile, Oceans 6, Poseidon Nero's group, assembles and prepares for their next move.

episodes.name: Judgment Day
episodes.overview: Under Xenolith's guidance, Shiki and his friends receive VR "bondage training" to overcome decline of Ether levels when they are constrained. During this training, Ziggy suddenly appears and hurts Rebecca with gravity, infuriating Shiki and causing him to bre…

episodes.name: DESERT OASIS
episodes.overview: After Poseidon Shura's "Judgment Day" declaration, Shiki and his friends decide to think of a way to counterattack. Laguna suggests an idea that will take Edens Zero to the desert of Planet Sandra.

episodes.name: PRELUDE TO THE AOI WAR
episodes.overview: Shiki and Laguna's former companions prepare to launch an attack on Nero and try to stop Orc from placing the bombs on the planet.

seasons.name: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
seasons.overview: In a dystopia riddled with corruption and cybernetic implants, a talented but reckless street kid strives to become a mercenary outlaw — an edgerunner.

episodes.name: Let You Down
episodes.overview: After a night of streaming illegal braindance, David wakes up to reality: a rundown apartment with a broken washing machine and an overworked mother.

episodes.name: Like a Boy
episodes.overview: With his newly enhanced body, David heads to the Academy seeking revenge on his bully. Later, he meets a mysterious woman who wants to recruit him.

episodes.name: Smooth Criminal
episodes.overview: Surrounded by a group of rowdy edgerunners, David makes a plea to join their team. Meanwhile, sinister forces plot to lure him back to Arasaka Academy.

episodes.name: Lucky You
episodes.overview: Eager to learn the edgerunner ropes, David pesters Maine for another mission. Instead, Maine tasks Lucy with training him.

episodes.name: All Eyez on Me
episodes.overview: David makes a clever suggestion when the team strategizes for their next mission. However, he soon learns that their target can't be underestimated.

episodes.name: Girl on Fire
episodes.overview: Maine doesn't seem to be himself. But the team has bigger fish to fry: They must race against time to extract vital information from their prisoner.

episodes.name: Stronger
episodes.overview: Now an all-star edgerunner enhanced with more cybernetics, David leads his team into a new mission. An old contact reaches out to him for a big job.

episodes.name: Stay
episodes.overview: Faraday finds himself stuck between Arasaka and Militech. Lucy and Rebecca confront David about his change in behavior, but he refuses to listen.

episodes.name: Humanity
episodes.overview: Lucy's captors learn about her secret mission and dark past. David and his team head out to complete Faraday's job but realize that something is off.

episodes.name: My Moon My Man
episodes.overview: On the edge of cyberpsychosis but determined to save Lucy, David storms into Night City as Arasaka plots to deploy their ultimate lethal weapon.

seasons.name: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2
seasons.overview: Weak, a washed-up cyberpunk legend, is now forced to live without chrome as he searches for a sense of purpose in a world that’s passed him by. Meanwhile, the deadly nomad D sets out on a path to revenge that brings him close to corpo secrets never meant to b…

episodes.name: Last Chance for a Slow Dance
episodes.overview: A former edgerunner slipping into cyberpsychosis and a lonely survivor with a fractured past start their stories at opposite ends of Night City.

episodes.name: Give Me Another Day
episodes.overview: A desperate call drags Weak back into danger to save a rebellious teen. As D bonds with a young cinephile, painful flashbacks fuel his thirst for revenge.
Weak tries to rescue Talia from a dangerous surgery, but the confrontation ends in disaster. D and Roman discover a chaotic chip that sparks mayhem.

episodes.name: Someone That I Used to Know
episodes.overview: Armed with abilities he doesn't fully understand, D uses Capri's power to infiltrate an Arasaka research facility. Talia and Weak find common ground.

episodes.name: Fades (Pass the Distance)
episodes.overview: An impulsive act sends Talia into a terrifying spiral. D's obsession with revenge reaches an unsettling new level of violence.

episodes.name: Everything Hate
episodes.overview: D becomes an anti-corporate vigilante and asks Roman to film his every move. Weak looks into rumors of tech that can transfer digitized consciousness.

episodes.name: To the Depths with You
episodes.overview: Talia's condition takes a startling turn under Capri's watch. D reconnects with an old friend. Weak and Avida chase a miracle cure.

episodes.name: Serce
episodes.overview: A riot ignites on the streets as D digs deeper into Project Capricorn's dark past. With time running out, Avida and Weak fight for Talia's future.

episodes.name: Strictly Reserved for You
episodes.overview: Omi and D go off the grid, and Kiril takes Talia into custody. Kyoko pushes Project Capricorn forward with frightening results.

episodes.name: Then Everyone Went Home
episodes.overview: A chilling transformation turns the city into a war zone, erupting in an explosive confrontation.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Hellbound takes place in 2022–27 in South Korea. An otherworldly face called an angel suddenly starts to materialize to deliver prophecies called decrees that condemn certain individuals to Hell at a specific future time, either seconds or years away. Three m…

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Horrified bystanders watch as otherworldly beasts chase down and kill a man in broad daylight. Jung Jinsu declares that only sinners are sent to hell.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: The New Truth offers a sizable payment to Park Jungja, a condemned woman, in exchange for the right to live-broadcast the moment her fate is decided.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Addressing a stunned world, Jinsu preaches righteousness. Detective Jin Kyunghun searches for his missing daughter. The Arrowhead targets Min Hyejin.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Bae Youngjae follows his co-worker to a fishing dock, where he witnesses a terrifying sight. The Prophet Angel appears in an unthinkable place.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: A despairing Youngjae tracks down a man who he thinks might have answers. The New Truth catches wind of a mysterious organization with its own agenda.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: With detrimental information hanging over its head, The New Truth scrambles to protect its power by preventing the public from learning the truth.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In a chaotic world exacerbated by the continuous hellbound decrees, lawyer Min Hye Jin of Sodo, The New Truth Society, and the Arrowheads get entangled anew amidst the sudden resurrections of the formerly condemned; The New Truth’s Chairman Jung Jin Su, and P…

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After a series of visions, Jinsu finds himself mysteriously resurrected. Realizing he's losing power, Kim Jeongchil agrees to work with the government.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: While in hiding, Kyunghun and his daughter suddenly come under attack. Meanwhile, the New Truth accelerates their announcement plan.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Jeongchil manipulates Jungja to carry out the New Will. As Jinsu learns more about Cheon Sehyeong, he begins to form his escape plan.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Jinsu puts forward his plot to come face to face with Jungja. However, Hyejin decides to carry out her own rescue plan to retrieve Jungja for Sodo.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: As Hyejin, Jinsu and Jeongchil all try to grab ahold of Jungja, Senior Secretary Lee plays her own game on the sidelines — but chaos arises everywhere.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Jinsu confronts Jungja, desperately searching for answers. But as disorder unfolds, will Hyejin be able to get Jungja to safety before it's too late?

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A con artist encounters a supernatural village where spirits of missing persons are stranded until the mystery behind their disappearance is solved.

episodes.name: Duon Village
episodes.overview: A village holds spirits of missing, deceased people. A search to find the missing bodies and discover the truth behind their disappearance occurs.

episodes.name: Finding Ha Neul
episodes.overview: Once Wook realizes what Duon Village actually is, he receives a big shock. None of the police takes him seriously when he tells them about the village, and they seem to think he is Ha Neul’s kidnapper. Meanwhile, the gangsters who abducted him keep showing up…

episodes.name: A Disturbance In Duon Village
episodes.overview: Wook continues to stay with Pan Seok, the man who lives in Duon Village and finds the villagers’ missing bodies. When Wook meets Yeo Na in the village, he realizes that she was the girl he witnessed being abducted. Meanwhile, Jun Ho finds Yeo Na and Nam Guk’s…

episodes.name: Investigating Nam Guk’s Death
episodes.overview: Wook is despondent over Nam Guk’s death, but he soon begins to track down the mysterious thugs who kept following him. Jun Ho also continues his investigation on the deaths of Nam Guk and Jang Myung Gyu, as well as Yeo Na’s disappearance. Meanwhile, the sex o…

episodes.name: Wook’s Meets His Mom Again
episodes.overview: Wook discovers that one of the villagers of Duon Village, Kim Hyun Mi, is his mom. Seeing her after all these years makes him feel quite flustered. In the meantime, Wook and Pan Seok must find Woo Il Suk’s body to make sure Duon Village is safe again. Meanwhi…

episodes.name: Memory Day
episodes.overview: Wook finds out that his mom worked as a housekeeper for Chairwoman Han of Choiseung Construction. He goes to speak to the chairwoman and runs into Jun Ho. Wook finally tells Jun Ho that he witnessed Yeo Na’s abduction. Meanwhile, Duon Village prepares for the…

episodes.name: Meeting The Chairwoman
episodes.overview: Pan Seok finds out that Hyun Mi is Wook’s mom. Knowing how painful it is to lose a family member, Pan Seok decides to help solve the mystery of Hyun Mi’s death. Wook, Pan Seok, and Jong Ah plan to sneak into Choiseung Construction to get some answers. Meanwhi…

episodes.name: Thomas’ Secret
episodes.overview: Hwang Du Cheol, the man in the derelict building, claims that Thomas had him locked up for years. The village is in an uproar when they find out Thomas’ secret. Meanwhile, Jun Ho gets a phone call from a witness who says he saw Yeo Na. As Wook, Jong Ah, and P…

episodes.name: A Recovered Memory
episodes.overview: Wook goes to save Jong Ah from Manager Wang’s men and ends up recovering a deeply buried memory from his childhood. Jun Ho and the Missing Persons Squad go to meet the mysterious man who says he knows Yeo Na’s whereabouts. Meanwhile, Pan Seok hands Il Du Hyun…
