seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The mythical nine-tailed fox, or gumiho, Lee Yeon had to settle in the city many centuries ago. Able to transform into human form, he eradicates supernatural beings that threaten the mortal world. His real aim is to find the reincarnation of his lost first lo…

episodes.name: The Incident That Occurred on Yeou Gogae
episodes.overview: Ji-ah who lost her parents in a freakish car accident on Yeougogae when she was 9 years old, becomes a producer of the investigative program called "Finding Local Myths". One day, she receives a report on a suspicious "monster".

episodes.name: I've Been Waiting for You
episodes.overview: Ji-ah finally meets a mysterious creature she had been looking for and she thinks Lee Yeon is the last evidence to find her long-lost parents. However, Lee Yeon draws a line to Ji-ah. Then, they both get caught up in a shocking incident.

episodes.name: The Secret of the Dragon King
episodes.overview: On the suspicious Eohwa Island, Ji-ah finds the evidence of head incident along with her parents' story. However, while investigating on the incident, she falls into danger with Lee Rang's appearance.

episodes.name: Verge of Death
episodes.overview: After returning from the island, Lee Yeon falls into Ji-ah when he knows she's not the one he has been looking for. Even Ji-ah also is attracted to Yeon gradually. After a short date, Lee Yeon is given a serious trial.

episodes.name: I Also Waited for You
episodes.overview: Lee Yeon finally has assured that A-eum reincarnated as Ji-ah. However, he hides it from Ji-ah as he wants her to live a normal life. Then, he begins to search Ji-ah's parents and goes to 'Satto' who has the information on Ji-ah's parents.

episodes.name: Four Pillars of Destiny
episodes.overview: Ji-ah and Yeon finally meet "Satto", but he refuses to give information. Meanwhile, Rang also visits Korean Folk Village to find an item. Then, he makes a risky deal on Yeon.

episodes.name: The Trap of Samsara
episodes.overview: The incarnated Imoogi moves towards Ji-ah and Yeon. Yeon barges into Ji-ah's house to protect her. Then, Yeon's brutal truth behind his past gets revealed.

episodes.name: Reincarnation
episodes.overview: Ji-ah is shocked that Yeon is the one who killed her in the past. Then, they move away from one another for each other. However, she decides to find out about the truth. Then, they fall into the Imoogi's trap.

episodes.name: Spirit of Darkness
episodes.overview: Yeon and Rang trapped in the Forest of evil. They fight against those evil sprits endlessly. After reuniting her long missed parents, she refueses to go back to her life.

episodes.name: Déjà Vu
episodes.overview: Ji-ah and Yeon finally face the truth of the past. They promise to look only at each other's present and stay together no matter what happens. Then, Yeon goes to save Rang who is in danger.

episodes.name: Ground Cherries
episodes.overview: The Butler uses Ji-ah's parents as a bait to threaten Ji-ah for Yeon's body. Then, the Imoogi declares to Yeon that he will own Ji-ah. Rang is threatened with his life at stake.

episodes.name: Catch the Tail
episodes.overview: Ji-ah finally meets her parents after 21 years. However, Rang faces a new challenge as soon as released from the contract and goes out to find Imoogi and Yeon to protect his precious people.

episodes.name: The Other Imoogi
episodes.overview: Another Imoogi within Ji-ah came out. Ji-ah and Yeon spend a mournful night before the sad fate ahead of them. The pandemic Imoogi caused puts the human world in chaos. Yeon and reborn Rang carry out a plan to bring an end to the endless fight.

episodes.name: Dead End
episodes.overview: Taluipa sentence Ji-ah to death and turns down Yeon, who wants to catch Imoogi after figuring out how Imoogi switches to another body. Yeon now makes his final choice in the face of ever-changing fate.

episodes.name: Without Knowing Imoogi's Plan
episodes.overview: Ji-ah and Yeon have their final date, hiding their feelings for each other. A faint hope appears before them, but it shatters because of an evil scheme Imoogi plots.

episodes.name: The Rewritten Tale of the Nine Tailed
episodes.overview: Left behind in the world without Yeon, Ji-ah visits the Afterlife Immigration Office and begs for Yeon's return. However, there seems no way. In April, when the snow falls, an especial person appears.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: On her birthday, Yoon Ji-woo witnesses the horrific death of her father. Hell-bent on taking revenge at any cost, she sets out to find his killer.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Choi Mu-jin imposes punishment on Do Gang-jae. Instructed to join the police force undercover, Ji-woo takes on a brand-new identity.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: When her team goes after an unforeseen target in a sudden raid, Ji-woo must act fast. A new drug ring and its malevolent leader threaten Mu-jin's empire.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Cha Gi-ho sees Gang-jae's declaration of war on Mu-jin as an opportunity. Suspecting Ji-woo is up to something, Jeon Pil-do tails her.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Ji-woo and Pil-do's narrow escape from peril shifts the police's focus onto Gang-jae. A run-in with a familiar face at the precinct places Ji-woo on edge.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: A photo in the mail revealing obscured truths casts everything Ji-woo thought she believed into doubt. Mu-jin moves to protect his interests.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Ji-woo fights off an ambush. Mu-jin submits himself to a police interrogation. Pil-do gets his hands on incriminating phone call records.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Intent on changing Ji-woo's mind about carrying out her vengeance, Pil-do handcuffs himself to her. Mu-jin reacts to another act of betrayal.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The story of Jun-ho and Ho-yeol, a group of military escape arrest groups (D.P.), who catch deserters, chasing those with various stories and facing reality that they did not know

episodes.name: A Man Holding Flowers
episodes.overview: An Jun-ho's keen eye earns him a position in the Deserter Pursuit unit. On his first mission with Park Sung-woo, things don't go quite as planned.

episodes.name: Daydream
episodes.overview: Discharged from the hospital, Han Ho-yeol returns to the base and partners up with Jun-ho to search for a soldier last spotted at a subway station.

episodes.name: That Woman
episodes.overview: Jun-ho and Ho-yeol assist with a mission while on break. In an attempt to gain intel, the two go undercover to befriend a deserter's girlfriend.

episodes.name: The Monty Hall Problem
episodes.overview: Relentless hazing shifts Cho Suk-bong's once-warm personality. Riddled with responsibilities, an enlistee jumps the fence at the dead of night.

episodes.name: Military Dog
episodes.overview: Suk-bong is pushed over the edge. During their investigation, the D.P. duo learns of events that unfolded at Hwang Jang-soo's discharge.

episodes.name: Onlookers
episodes.overview: When a chase after a deserter turns into a manhunt for a criminal at large, Jun-ho and Ho-yeol rush to find him before armed men bring him down.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: After a shocking tragedy turns their lives upside down, Jun-ho and Ho-yeol return to capture more military deserters — only to face unexpected danger.

episodes.name: The Rains
episodes.overview: Jun-ho navigates his life post-tragedy. Park Beom-gu feels pressure to cover up recent events. A sudden attack shocks the military.

episodes.name: Dirty Play
episodes.overview: While Kim Ru-ri goes public with his motive, Seo Eun sets up a lure to catch him. Jun-ho and Ho-yeol attempt to stop the growing escalation.

episodes.name: Curtain Call
episodes.overview: Jun-ho and Ho-yeol receive unexpected praise from the military. They later set off to catch a deserter who was bullied relentlessly for being different.

episodes.name: The Charred Remains
episodes.overview: Lim Ji-seop and Beom-gu realize that an investigation into a military death isn't as it seems. The government faces a damning accusation.

episodes.name: An Jun-ho
episodes.overview: Jun-ho discovers the extent of the military's secrets — making a critical decision. Oh Min-u pursues crucial evidence to stop it from being released.

episodes.name: The Day
episodes.overview: Ho-yeol makes a deal to help Jun-ho, who faces harsh consequences. In a fight for justice, the trial against the government takes a surprising turn.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Now at an NGO in Penamstan, Claire discovers signs reminiscent of Raccoon City. Leon makes his way to the White House, unaware that it's under attack.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Leon, along with agents Jason and Shen May, embarks on a covert mission to infiltrate a research facility in Shanghai aboard a nuclear submarine.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Claire discovers a grim scene at the home of one of the last surviving members of the Mad Dogs Unit. Shen May warns Leon about an ominous conspiracy.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Secretary Wilson threatens Claire's life, demanding that she drop her investigation. Leon and Shen May rush to the vast subterranean bioweapons lab.

episodes.name: ROMANCE DAWN
episodes.overview: Stranded on a sinking boat, carefree Luffy begins his journey in search of a pirate king's lost treasure. But first, he'll need a crew, a ship and a map.

episodes.name: THE MAN IN THE STRAW HAT

episodes.overview: In need of a proper ship, the gang reaches Syrup Village and meets the cheerful Usopp and his best friend Kaya. A sinister threat disrupts their plans.

episodes.overview: With his friends in danger and Klahadore's plan in motion, Usopp seeks help from the Marines. Blades clash when a fierce battle erupts at Kaya's mansion.

episodes.name: EAT AT BARATIE!
episodes.overview: The Straw Hat Pirates face their first adversary as a group. At a floating fish house, Luffy befriends a cook, and Zoro enters a duel with a warlord.

episodes.name: THE CHEF AND THE CHORE BOY
episodes.overview: Sanji and head chef Zeff put their differences aside to save a severely wounded Zoro. A ruthless Fishman on a mission stirs up trouble for the crew.

episodes.name: THE GIRL WITH THE SAWFISH TATTOO
episodes.overview: After striking a deal with a familiar foe to find Arlong, Luffy and his friends set sail for Coco Village and learn about Nami's mysterious past.

episodes.name: WORST IN THE EAST
episodes.overview: The Straw Hat crew strives to take down Arlong and the Fishmen once and for all. After a tense family reunion, Luffy inches closer to his dreams.

seasons.name: Into the Grand Line

episodes.name: THE BEGINNING AND THE END
episodes.overview: To prepare for the Grand Line, the Straw Hats visit Loguetown, birthplace of the Great Pirate Era — where rivals both old and new await.

episodes.name: GOOD WHALE HUNTING
episodes.overview: When the Merry lands in the belly of a giant whale, Luffy must win over a gruff lighthouse keeper to save his friends and his ship.

episodes.name: WHISKY BUSINESS
episodes.overview: The crew receives a warm welcome to the pirate-loving town of Whisky Peak. But with a pair of assassins on the loose, trouble isn't far behind.

episodes.name: BIG TROUBLE IN LITTLE GARDEN
episodes.overview: A new addition to the ship raises the stakes. On the lush isle of Little Garden, the crew encounters an adventure of giant proportions.

episodes.name: WAX ON, WAX OFF
episodes.overview: The Straw Hats are held captive by two artists: one who colors emotions, and one intent on making them part of his latest — and deadliest — masterwork.

episodes.name: NAMI DEEREST
episodes.overview: When Nami is stricken by a mysterious illness, Luffy and Sanji embark on a perilous mission to save her. Smoker and Tashigi investigate a Marine outpost.

episodes.name: REINDEER SHAMES
episodes.overview: Dr. Kureha tells the heartwrenching story of Chopper's origins, including how he met his mentor Dr. Hiriluk and their quest to cure all disease.

episodes.name: DEER AND LOATHING IN DRUM KINGDOM
episodes.overview: The Straw Hats lend themselves to Drum Island's cause when King Wapol and his army of monsters return to reclaim the throne.

seasons.name: The Battle of Alabasta
seasons.overview: In ONE PIECE: The Battle of Alabasta, war is coming for Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat crew in the desert kingdom of Alabasta, Princess Vivi's homeland. A rebellion threatens to tear the nation apart, fueled in secret by one of the Seven Warlords of the Se…

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A commoner living in ancient Greece, Heron discovers his true heritage as a son of Zeus, and his purpose: to save the world from a demonic army.

episodes.name: A Call to Arms
episodes.overview: Demons attack the polis near the home of the outcast Heron, who finds allies in the wise elder Elias and the fierce Amazonian warrior Alexia.

episodes.name: Past Is Prologue
episodes.overview: After he completes a quest for adamantine ore, Heron learns the truth about his birth from his mother Electra, as well as the identity of his father.

episodes.name: The Raid
episodes.overview: The goddess Hera discovers the existence of Zeus's bastard son Heron and vows revenge. The polis falls to the forces of the malevolent Seraphim.

episodes.name: A Monster Is Born
episodes.overview: Heron is taken captive by the army of Seraphim, who chases Alexia but instead encounters Hera. The goddess informs the demon leader of his true past.

episodes.name: Escape or Die
episodes.overview: Hera directs Seraphim to the powerful sword Zeus once forged for Heron, who is enslaved aboard a galley. Alexia seeks counsel from her mentor, Chiron.

episodes.name: Back to Olympus
episodes.overview: Zeus brings Heron to Olympus for training, angering the other gods. Alexia embarks on a mission to Melidoni with Heron's companions, Evios and Kofi.

episodes.name: The Fields of the Dead
episodes.overview: Seraphim's loyalties are tested when Zeus reveals Hera's deceptions. Alexia's company crosses the Fields of the Dead. War breaks out between the gods.

episodes.name: War for Olympus
episodes.overview: Hera resurrects the giants of the sea and assails Olympus, leading to an earth-shattering battle for the ages and the rise of a new demigod: Heron.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: To escape the Underworld forever, Hades crafts a plan to claim Zeus's crown for himself and reunite with his beloved Persephone as ruler of Olympus.

episodes.name: A Shadow Emerges
episodes.overview: Hades plots to steal a powerful stone from Zeus's temple while the battle for Olympus rages. Gaia sets Heron on a quest to save a former adversary.

episodes.name: Weights & Measures
episodes.overview: Seraphim faces harsh judgment in the Underworld and receives an unexpected offer from Hades, who reveals the true origin of the Eleusinian Stone.

episodes.name: Winter Is Born
episodes.overview: Heron seeks guidance from the smithing god Hephaestus. To win Seraphim's allegiance, Hades tempts him with a promise to bring peace to a lost love.

episodes.name: Funeral Games
episodes.overview: While mourning their fallen king, the immortals honor Zeus with celebratory games. But the competition between Ares and Heron grows brutally violent.

episodes.name: Judgement Day
episodes.overview: Zeus is sentenced to his fate in the Underworld while Heron visits the land of his birth. Fueled by vengeance, Seraphim unleashes wrath upon an enemy.

episodes.name: Crossing Paths
episodes.overview: Heron and his companions fight a vicious swarm of Keres and encounter a surprising traveler along their journey. Demeter makes a bold play for power.

episodes.name: The Hidden Realm
episodes.overview: Aided by an Amazon fleet, Heron, Alexia and Kofi face the giant automaton Talos. To enter the Hidden Realm, Seraphim must first outsmart the Curetes.

episodes.name: The Three Trials
episodes.overview: With the crown of Olympus at stake, the gods clash swords in an epic battle for the Eleusinian Stone and the power it grants to whomever possesses it.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Set loose from captivity and burning for revenge, the king of the Titans swears to crush the Olympian gods and reclaim the power they stole from him.

episodes.name: A Breath Before Dying
episodes.overview: Heron and Seraphim set forth on a mission of mercy while the heavens tremble with the rage of Typhon, who rains destruction down on the gods of Olympus.

episodes.name: Hades' Choice
episodes.overview: To protect those she holds dear, a selfless immortal confronts a towering terror. Freed from bondage, Cronos vows to teach the gods the meaning of fear.

episodes.name: Hellebore
episodes.overview: In the Underworld, the vengeful king of the Titans puts Hades' love to the ultimate test. Seraphim reveals his perilous plan to save Gorgo from torment.

episodes.name: Brothers' Journey
episodes.overview: Cronos schemes to weaken Zeus as the Olympians bid farewell to their fallen brethren. Old allies lend their swords in a clash against a colossal foe.

episodes.name: The Head of the Maenads
episodes.overview: While seeking an oracle to help guide them on their quest, Heron and his companions intrude upon a mysterious cult and their gruesome blood sacrifice.

episodes.name: The Tower of the Winds
episodes.overview: A humbled Hera pleads for aid on Zeus' behalf. In the home of the wind gods, Heron's search party fights a dark force that pits friend against friend.

episodes.name: Land of the Dead
episodes.overview: Two star-crossed soulmates reunite on the bank of the River Styx. Facing insurmountable odds, the last remaining Olympians square off against Cronos.

episodes.name: A Champion's Challenge
episodes.overview: With the fate of the gods at stake, the immortals and the Titans invoke the ways of old and settle their dispute through an epic battle of champions.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Miku rushes off to work but forgets her bento. Tatsu tracks down a Policure Blu-ray for Miku’s birthday. Gin takes a walk around the neighborhood.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Masa realizes that housewives — and househusbands — have a lot in common with the yakuza. Tatsu takes a yoga class and thoroughly enjoys himself.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Tatsu and Masa bump into Torajiro, a fellow ex-gangster now running a crepe truck. The cops grow suspicious of Tatsu’s balcony herb garden.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Miku’s dad tries to bond with Tatsu over a game of catch. A cockroach infiltrates the apartment. The Immortal Claus stops by a kids’ Christmas party.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Tatsu takes a part-time job at a cafe. Then he bumps into a deceased yakuza boss’s wife, who’s now working at the supermarket. It’s Tatsu’s birthday!

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: While at the mall, Tatsu catches a live Policure show. Later, he goes on a date with Miku to an amusement park, then takes a trip to the beach.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Torajiro hits up Tatsu for some street-level information on the latest craze: bubble tea. Tatsu takes Masa on a confusing trip to the 100-yen shop.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Tatsu gets pulled into a rap battle, then enters a Halloween costume contest with Miku. Things get intense during a trip to a buffet restaurant.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: A battle ensues inside Tatsu's body when he catches a fever. Masa stops by for New Year's. In a baking class, Tatsu drives home the value of heart.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: To buy Miku a limited edition Policure DVD, Tatsu has to memorize a confusing discount code catchphrase. Tatsu and Miku dogsit; Gin takes another walk.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Everyone's favorite ex-yakuza is back! He's clipping coupons, planning penny-saving meals — and taking his job as a househusband very, very seriously.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Miku needs to eat her way through a huge pile of pastries. Tatsu's no match for the typhoon. Then, Tatsu, Miku and Masa go camping.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Tatsu gets intimidated at a meeting of women's group leaders. Gokudon visits a little girl in the hospital. Miku finds Tatsu collapsed on the floor!

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Torajiro gets a formidable rival — his sister. It's snowing! The popcorn is popped, but Tatsu, Miku and Masa can't decide on what DVD to watch.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Tatsu gives Miku pointers on how to play golf. A group of scary looking guys walk into the woods. Tatsu, Miku and Masa can’t take the heat.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Little Suzu refuses to eat her veggies. To really get rid of weeds, you've got to pull them up by the roots. Tatsu and Torajiro have a bug fight.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: After Kaiju ravage Australia, two siblings pilot a Jaeger to search for their parents, encountering new creatures, seedy characters and chance allies.

episodes.name: From the Shadows
episodes.overview: Five years after their parents left to find help, siblings Taylor and Hayley find a training Jaeger - but it quickly attracts a Kaiju to their village.

episodes.name: Into the Black
episodes.overview: When Atlas Destroyer runs out of energy, Taylor and Hayley search a nearby destroyed city for power cells and make some startling discoveries.

episodes.name: Bogan
episodes.overview: While on foot, Taylor, Hayley and Boy encounter a mobile settlement that traffics in Kaiju body parts. Its shady leader seeks to uncover their secret.

episodes.name: Up and Running
episodes.overview: When a Kaiju fast approaches, Shane forces Taylor to copilot Atlas Destroyer with Mei to get it out of harm's way, but Taylor wants to fight.

episodes.name: Escaping Bogan
episodes.overview: To take back Atlas Destroyer and save Hayley and Boy, Taylor attempts a risky maneuverer known as "ghost piloting." Joel and Mei make a deadly choice.

episodes.name: Boneyard
episodes.overview: The mystery behind Boy's past deepens when Taylor and Hayley find him among dead Kaiju and destroyed Jaegers - along with the creature responsible.

episodes.name: Showdown
episodes.overview: While responding to a distress signal, Taylor and Hayley find their parents' abandoned Jaeger and confront the Kaiju that attacked their village.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Piloting Atlas Destroyer with Mei and Boy in tow, Hayley and Taylor continue their journey to Sydney, but first, they must get past a bloodthirsty cult.

episodes.name: bOy
episodes.overview: Boy's transformation into a Kaiju alarms Taylor and Mei, but Hayley wants to keep caring for him. A group of mysterious women attempts to kidnap Boy.

episodes.name: The Never Never
episodes.overview: With Boy gravely injured, Hayley, Taylor and Mei pilot the Jaeger toward a valley full of Kaiju, where a supposed Kaiju whisperer might be able to help.

episodes.name: Divide
episodes.overview: The Atlas Destroyer gets chased into the territory of the Sisters of the Kaiju, where Hayley, Taylor and Mei argue about what should be done with Boy.

episodes.name: Sisters of the Kaiju
episodes.overview: After successfully catching up with the Atlas Destroyer, Shane offers Hayley and Taylor a trade: the Jaeger for something they desperately want.

episodes.name: Mind, Body, Soul
episodes.overview: As Hayley and Taylor's mother tries to resist the High Priestess, the group plots to rescue Boy before his mind is permanently turned against them.

episodes.name: The Twilight Run
episodes.overview: When Boy falls under the spell of the Sisters and transforms into a Kaiju bent on destroying the Atlas Destroyer, a surprising ally comes to its aid.

episodes.name: Final Approach
episodes.overview: With creatures close behind, Hayley, Taylor, Mei and Boy race to the safety of Sydney Base, but the Sisters call upon a Category VI Kaiju to stop them.

episodes.name: I Just Don't Get This World
episodes.overview: Transported to the top of a skyscraper, Yuri desperately tries to evade a masked killer, but her escape routes are few.

episodes.name: I've Found a New Goal
episodes.overview: Mayuko kills others without any hesitation, desperate to escape. An encounter with Yuri brings back her sense of humanity.

episodes.name: I'm Sorry, Mayuko Nise
episodes.overview: Rika confirms that his sister Yuri is still alive when she calls him. Soon after, he faces the wrath of a masked baseball pitcher.

episodes.name: I Won't Give in to This World
episodes.overview: Sniper Mask looks to help a scared Kuon. Yuri and Mayuko head toward Rika, but the saw-wielding Chef Mask has other plans for them.

episodes.name: That's an Incredible Ultimate Weapon
episodes.overview: Seeking revenge for his annihilated crew, Tanabe pleads for Yuri and Mayuko's help taking down "God Candidate" Aohara and his masked killer, Ein.

episodes.name: If I Become a Perfect God
episodes.overview: Mayuko vows to keep fighting until Yuri reunites with her brother, but she realizes it may only be a matter of time before she loses her mind.

episodes.name: I Will End This Realm
episodes.overview: Yuri acquires new powers. Rika and his allies reach Yoshida, but they face fierce opposition from Police Mask and her killer army.

episodes.name: I've Cast Off My Humanity, But That’s Fine
episodes.overview: Mayuko and Yuri reunite on top of a skyscraper amidst a grenade attack. Now held hostage, Rika is summoned before a God Candidate.

episodes.name: Which of Us Will Live a Cool Live?
episodes.overview: Aikawa deploys a sniper to Yuri's location in a move to eliminate other God Candidates. It's a battle of equals as Sniper Mask takes on the threat.

episodes.name: Our Enemy Is One Who Desires Chaos
episodes.overview: Aohara, Tanabe and the others approach Yuri to form an alliance. Mayuko and Kuon come to Sniper Mask's aid when he starts to lose his mind.

episodes.name: I AM Justice!
episodes.overview: With Yuri and her allies' location exposed, Aikawa dispatches an elite team led by Police Mask to purge those who disagree with his ideology.

episodes.name: This Is a High-Rise Invasion
episodes.overview: Archangel destroys everything in his path in the name of justice. Mayuko and the others stand in his way, but who will die, and who will prevail?

episodes.name: Ronin
episodes.overview: When her young daughter is stricken by a mysterious malady, Ichika asks Yasuke to bring them upriver to a special doctor, but Yasuke refuses.

episodes.name: The Old Way
episodes.overview: Back in 1581, Yasuke and Natsumaru have become trusted warriors serving Nobunaga. In the present day, the mercenaries catch up to Yasuke and attack.

episodes.name: Mortal Sins
episodes.overview: Abraham sends Haruto and Nikita out to find Saki, who uses her growing powers to fight back. Under torture, Yasuke has a flashback to a betrayal.

episodes.name: A Long Road
episodes.overview: Back in the village, Saki asks Yasuke to bring her to Doctor Morisuke — and she won’t take no for an answer. But there are new enemies in pursuit.

episodes.name: Pain & Blood
episodes.overview: While Morisuke protects Saki from the Daimyo’s attack on the Astral Plane, Yasuke confronts the masked Dark General, who reveals their true identity.

episodes.name: Balance
episodes.overview: While Morisuke and his men create a protective shield around the temple, Yasuke and Saki face off with the Daimyo in Azuchi Castle.

episodes.name: All Baths Lead to Rome
episodes.overview: While bathing in the public bathhouse his grandfather designed and built, a boy in ancient Rome is momentarily transported to a very strange place.

episodes.name: The Thermae Architect Who Leapt Through Time
episodes.overview: Rome, 128 A.D. In a golden age of bathhouse innovation, bathhouse architect Lucius tries to come up with fresh ideas that will set his designs apart.

episodes.name: Lucius Builds an Outdoor Bath
episodes.overview: After Consul Lepidus asks him to build an outdoor bath with a view of Mt. Vesuvius, Lucius suddenly finds himself bathing among strange-looking monkeys.

episodes.name: Lucius Builds an Indoor Bath
episodes.overview: Lucius ends up in a small bathroom in a modern Japanese house and is completely fascinated by everything he finds.

episodes.name: Lucius Builds a Bath in Emperor Hadrian's Villa
episodes.overview: Impressed by his creativity, Emperor Hadrian invites Lucius to his opulent villa and asks him to build a private bath.

episodes.name: Lucius Builds a Hot Stone Spa
episodes.overview: Lucius works to complete a bathing area for soldiers fighting on the front lines — and not a minute too soon, as the men are in dire need of healing.

episodes.name: Lucius Appears on the Tokaido Road in the Edo Period
episodes.overview: While stopping in an unwelcoming tavern during his long journey home, Lucius surfaces in a comfortable Edo-era rest stop along the Tokaido road.

episodes.name: Lucius Learns Bathing Etiquette in Japan
episodes.overview: Lucius encounters a set of very rude bathers who don't seem to know the first thing about proper bathhouse etiquette.

episodes.name: Lucius Meets a Fellow Architect in Japan
episodes.overview: On a construction site for a Roman-style spa in modern day Japan, Lucius meets a fellow bathhouse architect.

episodes.name: Lucius Builds a Theme Bath
episodes.overview: Emperor Hadrian asks Lucius to devote himself to building a large public bathhouse in the name of his son and heir to the Empire.

episodes.name: Lucius Builds a Spa Town
episodes.overview: To undermine public support for the Emperor, some members of the Senate scheme to get rid of the man behind the popular bathhouses: Lucius.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Shim Eun-seok, an elite judge with a cold and distant personality who is known for her dislike of juveniles, is appointed judge of a juvenile court in the Yeonhwa District. There, she breaks customs and administers her own ways of punishing the young offender…

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Arriving at juvenile court, Sim Eun-seok meets the compassionate Cha Tae-ju. The details of a murder case involving an underage killer don't add up.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Eun-seok's unorthodox methods in dealing with the suspected accomplice ruffle feathers. Contradictory accusations fly in a heated trial.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The search for the truth behind a teenager's injuries leads to painful and hidden revelations. Meanwhile, the case is personal for Tae-ju.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: A troubling call puts a youth counseling instructor under the judges' microscope. The girls inside her recovery home back up the claims.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Eun-seok and Tae-ju set out to locate the missing girls before harm comes to them. The whistleblower's surprising identity is revealed.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Students from privileged backgrounds are caught in a scandal that attracts national attention. Kang Won-jung hides a career-sabotaging secret.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Eun-seok expects Won-jung to do the right thing, and pushes back against his actions in court. When he demands hard evidence, she digs in deeper.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Investigating an underage traffic accident case despite Eun-seok's reservations, Tae-ju discovers a key missing piece. They clash with Na Geun-hee.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Eun-seok fixates on one of the accused perpetrators in a brutal sexual assault case. Tae-ju gains insight into her personal history.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Efforts to locate the ringleader of the runaway gang places Eun-seok in grave danger. Geun-hee faces a confrontation about her principles.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Thieves overtake the mint of a unified Korea. With hostages trapped inside, the police must stop them — as well as the shadowy mastermind behind it all.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Recruited by the Professor for a job of unprecedented proportions, eight thieves storm the Unified Korea Mint. Police pull together a task force.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Seon Woojin waits for a crack in the thieves' operation. An escape plan centered around the retrieval of a hidden smartwatch puts Yun Misun in danger.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The sound of a gunshot shakes up the Mint. Dissent among the thieves reaches new heights as some believe a line has been crossed.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Looking to turn a potential disaster into an opportunity, Woojin presses the Professor to allow medical personnel to enter the Mint.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Cha Moohyuk hurries a plot of his own into action. A key revelation on Woojin's end threatens to unravel the Professor's strategy.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: As those outside the Mint panic, Woojin proposes she go inside with a cameraman so the thieves can show the public that the hostages are unharmed.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Woojin shifts her tactics after figuring out the real reason for the heist. Kim Sangman appeals to the thieves with a bold promise.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: The hostages set their escape plan into motion while Park Chulwoo calls for backup. Cho Youngmin’s attempt to be the first to leave the mint backfires.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: The police interrogate a thief. Sangman steps in to take control of the hostage negotiation. A rescue mission takes place to bring a child to safety.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: The thieves offer the hostages a choice between money and freedom. After finding out about his son's love affair, Moscow reveals his past.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: A medical emergency puts the thieves on edge, while the deadline to carry out their plan is cut short. Woojin lures the Professor to a nearby hospital.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: The police close in on the thieves as they prepare to transport the money out of the Mint. Fierce protests force Sangman to put his foot down.

episodes.name: The Errand Girl
episodes.overview: Kids hate her just because she’s ugly. And for the same reason, her crush cruelly rejects her confession. Thinking of ending her life, Ju Kyung stands at the edge of a rooftop. That’s when Su Ho jumps in to save her. Days later, Ju Kyung comes across some mak…

episodes.name: With or Without Make-Up
episodes.overview: As soon as Su Ho sees Ju Kyung at the comic book store, he recognizes that it’s the same girl he saw on the rooftop. He’s kind of disappointed that she doesn’t seem to remember him. Ju Kyung is anxious to see how Su Ho will react at school the next day, but s…

episodes.name: Revenge Is a Dish Best Served Cold
episodes.overview: It seems Su Ho knows that the no makeup Ju Kyung at the comic store is the same person as the made up Ju Kyung at school. Ju Kyung feels anxious that he might tell everyone about how ugly she actually is. She promises him that she’ll do anything he asks, but…

episodes.name: Ju Kyung Goes on a Blind Date
episodes.overview: Ju Kyung prepares to go on a blind date. She asks her mother for help at her hair salon, but then Seo Jun steps into the salon when Ju Kyung’s not wearing makeup on her face. She tries to avoid meeting him. Meanwhile, Su Ho participates in a maths competition…

episodes.name: If He Has Feelings for Me
episodes.overview: Su Ho goes all the way to meet Ju Kyung late at night with a lame excuse. Ju Kyung starts to wonder if Su Ho has feelings for her. She asks him out. Meanwhile, a first-year student is bullied by her classmates for her ugly looks. This reminds Ju Kyung of her…

episodes.name: Ju Kyung Runs into Bullies
episodes.overview: Su Ho’s father visits Saebom High School to meet Su Ho’s teacher. Everyone at school gets surprised by the fact that Su Ho’s father is actor Lee Joo Hun. Meanwhile, Ju Kyung runs into the bullies who used to harass her before transferring to Saebom High Schoo…

episodes.name: Mutual Feelings of Love
episodes.overview: Ju Kyung’s heart doesn’t seem to calm down whenever she sees Su Ho. Unfortunately, she finds out that there is already someone whom Su Ho likes. Devastated and disappointed, Ju Kyung begins to naturally avoid him. Meanwhile, Hyung Jin, the ace baseball player…

episodes.name: Misunderstanding
episodes.overview: The students of Saebom High School go on a school trip. Su Ho makes up his mind to tell Ju Kyung that he has feelings for her and even buys jewellery for her. However, Ju Kyung gets heartbroken, thinking that Su Ho likes Soo Jin. Meanwhile, Hee Kyung gets tra…

episodes.name: Secret Boyfriend
episodes.overview: Not long after reassuring each other’s feelings, Ju Kyung and Su Ho initiate a movie-like plan to keep their relationship secret at school. However, doing so makes it difficult for them to enjoy a typical ordinary date. Su Ho even puts up with embarrassing mo…

episodes.name: Between Love and Friendship
episodes.overview: Ju Kyung still doesn’t want to let her friends know that her boyfriend is Su Ho. Soo Jin tells Ju Kyung that she plans to tell Su Ho that she has feelings for him. Ju Kyung gets torn between love and friendship. Meanwhile, Su Ho and Seo Jun happen to meet at…

episodes.name: The Truth About Se Yeon
episodes.overview: After stumbling upon the truth behind Se Yeon’s death, Su Ho gets into an accident as he runs out of his dad’s office, and Seo Jun also gets involved while trying to save Su Ho. Hospitalized in the same room, Soo Ho and Seo Jun get to know each other a little…

episodes.name: Transfer Student
episodes.overview: At school, Su Ho comes back to his class, and Ju Kyung runs into Hye Min who just transferred. Hye Min asks Ju Kyung if they know each other, but Ju Kyung denies and keeps avoiding her at school. Meanwhile, Soo Jin and Se Mi make a deal, and Se Mi shares with…

episodes.name: Only Fools Judge Others
episodes.overview: A video of Ju Kyung sends the whole school in turmoil. When Ju Kyung finds out that her past from the old school has been exposed, she runs away. However, it doesn’t bother Su Ho a bit what others are saying. The only thing that worries him is whether Ju Kyun…

episodes.name: Trip to the Sea
episodes.overview: Ju Kyung comes back to school and makes up with Soo Ah. Everyone at school finally finds out that Soo Jin was the one who uploaded the photos and videos of Ju Kyung being bullied. Meanwhile, Soo Ho and Ju Kyung go on a trip to the sea, but Su Ho forgets to br…

episodes.name: Unexpected Encounter
episodes.overview: Ju Kyung and Su Ho have no other option but to accept the breakup. After, Ju Kyung stumbles upon the fact that Su Ho is the very boy she met at the Prince Comics when she was young and struggles even more. Meanwhile, Seo Jun finds it difficult to hide feeling…

episodes.name: Happy Ending
episodes.overview: Ju Kyung and Su Ho finally confirm that their feelings for one another haven't changed after all these years. After shedding tears from their reunion, they start their happy relationship, which is more grown-up from their high school days. Meanwhile, Seo Jun,…

episodes.name: Do you believe in destiny? I believe in it if I'm handsome
episodes.overview: Ki Seon-gyeom notices bruises on Kim Woo-sik's body. Trying to get back into her professor's good graces, Oh Mi-joo takes on an interpreting gig.

episodes.name: Why are you excited? If I get more excited, I think I'll make a mistake.
episodes.overview: Seon-gyeom gets revenge on Woo-sik's behalf, but is disheartened by the coaches' inaction. Mi-joo and Seon-gyeom bond over a movie and drink

episodes.name: Do you like me by any chance?
episodes.overview: Handing her a handsome reward, Ki Jeong-do asks Mi-joo for a favor. Seon-gyeom's rage over Woo-sik's unjust injury boils over in Jeju Island.

episodes.name: Everything you said to me earlier sounds like a confession
episodes.overview: Seo Dan-ah gives Woo-sik a chance to set the record straight. Seon-gyeom bids farewell to track and confronts Mi-joo about the payoff from his father.

episodes.name: Let's just pretend that everything else that's left between us never happened.
episodes.overview: Lee Yeong-hwa tries to compensate Dan-ah for her broken bracelet. Mi-joo translates and shares Woo-sik's interview online to clear Seon-gyeom's name.

episodes.name: You came here because you wanted to go to my house? Let's go.
episodes.overview: Retired and unemployed, Seon-gyeom accepts Mi-joo's offer to stay at her home. Dan-ah convinces Yeong-hwa to submit a new painting for the gallery.

episodes.name: I'm going to get Director Seo married to Seon-gyeom.
episodes.overview: Mi-joo becomes concerned, then angry, when Seon-gyeom stays out all night. Yeong-hwa's persistence pays off with a surprise visit from Dan-ah.

episodes.name: I didn't say I don't like Ki Seon-gyeom, don't hate me.
episodes.overview: At a movie premiere, Yeong-hwa clears up Mi-joo's misunderstanding about Seon-gyeom's night. She goes on a business trip, leaving Seon-gyeom home alone.

episodes.name: I keep doing that. I beg you to like it...
episodes.overview: Mi-joo and Seon-gyeom grow close, then apart, during their work trip. Yeong-hwa puts his foot down during a heated argument with Dan-ah.

episodes.name: Are Ms. Oh Mi-joo's feelings really romantic? I think so.
episodes.overview: Mi-joo and Seon-gyeom start dating. Seeking perspective on her situation with Yeong-hwa, Dan-ah invites herself into Mi-joo's home for a drink.

episodes.name: I won't disappear, I'll stay
episodes.overview: Seon-gyeom takes the lead in helping Woo-sik get back on track. Dan-ah realizes the reason behind her admiration for Yeong-hwa's artwork.

episodes.name: That person is not my weakness, but my strength.
episodes.overview: Unhappy with Seon-gyeom's disobedience, Jeong-do takes out his anger on Mi-joo. Dan-ah allows herself to smile in Yeong-hwa's embrace.

episodes.name: I just wish there was Ms. Oh Mi-joo
episodes.overview: Mi-joo and Seon-gyeom tearfully agree to take some time apart. Yeong-hwa's planned birthday party for Dan-ah starts and ends in chaos.

episodes.name: Do you want to eat ramen at my house before you go?
episodes.overview: Missing Yeong-hwa, Dan-ah spends a night with him in his seaside hometown. Mi-joo runs her first marathon. Seon-gyeom is peeved by his father's plans.

episodes.name: You're shouting so passionately that you love me
episodes.overview: Goh Ye-jun comes out to his family. Ki Eun-bi finds solace in Mi-joo's home. Yeong-hwa unveils his masterpiece and love for Dan-ah.

episodes.name: Are you comforting me? I'm being comforted right now.
episodes.overview: Mi-joo’s work gets a director noticed overseas. Yeong-hwa and Dan-ah achieve their own goals. Seon-gyeom officially becomes a sports agent.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Noodle shop employees by day and demon hunters by night, the Counters use special abilities to chase down malevolent spirits that prey on humans.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: On his birthday, So Mun's struck by a strange burst of light that leaves puzzling changes to his body. He finds answers inside the local noodle shop.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: The Counters give Mun an extraordinary surprise. While contemplating whether he wants to join them, he's given a taste of the action.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Lim Ju-yeon and Kim Ung-min notice something is different about Mun. Ga Mo-tak heads to the police station for answers about his forgotten past.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: In a confrontation with violent bullies, Mun loses control over his rage — and must face the consequences. Mo-tak is reunited with his old cellphone.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Do Ha-na saves Mun from the attacks of a powerful demon with a malicious tongue. Kim Jeong-yeong helps Mo-tak look into his last detective case.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: While the Counters attempt to keep the truth behind his painful past from Mun, he discovers a mysterious memory card among his parents' belongings.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: During a trip into his most traumatic memory, Mun has his first encounter with Ji Cheong-sin. Later, he leads the Counters to a car junkyard.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Things get personal for Ha-na as she takes down a familiar demon. The team tries to locate a reservoir tied to a case Mun's father had worked.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Cheong-sin leaves Mun in a bad state, but Chu Mae-ok is determined to save his life. The Counters set out to make the mayor's corruption public.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Wi-gen calls for an action that could take everything away from Mun. When stunning news about Cheong-sin is reported, the Counters can't believe it.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: The Counters struggle in a mismatched fight against an increasingly dangerous Cheong-sin and the other demons. Mo-tak's memories resurface.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: A heartbroken Mo-tak and the team plot revenge against Shin Myeong-hwi and his collaborators. While carrying out their scheme, a human corpse turns up.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: As Cheong-sin becomes nearly unstoppable, the Counters learn there may be a way to defeat him for good. Mo-tak gets justice for Jeong-yeong.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Myeong-hwi's son notices something about his father isn't quite right. When Baek Hyang-hui kidnaps a young girl, the Counters rush after her.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: The team welcomes back a Counter who's been overseas. After confirming his suspicions about his father, Shin Hyeok-u goes to Mun.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: The final face-off against Myeong-hwi tests Mun and the other Counters' limits. In Yung, long-awaited reunions take place.

seasons.name: Season 2: Counter Punch
seasons.overview: Armed with new powers and fresh recruits, the Counters continue their battle against evil demons who feed on humans.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: It's business as usual for the Counters as they work together to defeat malicious demons. Meanwhile, trouble starts brewing in a remote mansion in China.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Ga Mo-tak discovers the perfect recruit when he witnesses a car accident. Hwang Pil-gwang, Gelly, and Wong arrive in Korea and begin wreaking havoc.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The Counters are confronted with an unwelcome visitor at the noodle shop. Amidst a training session with his new protégé, Mo-tak hears alarming news.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: So Mun goes head to head with Pil-gwang, while his teammates battle the demon's cronies. Meanwhile, Ma Ju-seok experiences a terrifying nightmare.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Ju-seok's impassioned statement shocks the Counters — but the demons watch on with glee. Do Ha-na reunites with an important figure from her past.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The Counters face a new, formidable demon and gather to devise a plan of action. Pil-gwang and Gelly head to the hospital with a sinister motive.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: So Mun experiences a moment of weakness during a crucial battle. Gelly faces a betrayal. The Counters later attempt to put a stop to a fraud scheme.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Ha-na decides to follow through with a devastating decision. Meanwhile, Chu Mae-ok lends a helping hand to a troublemaking young man.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: The Counters go neck to neck with Pil-gwang's gang. So Mun is trapped in a life-threatening predicament, and his teammates struggle to find a solution.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Ju-seok and Pil-gwang face a change in their relationship. The Counters celebrate some good news.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Pil-gwang grows more powerful by the day. Although hesitant at first, Ha-na assists So Mun in a dangerous endeavor.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: The Counters give it their all to fight the mighty Pil-gwang. Will Ju-seok be able to overcome his demons and put an end to this life-or-death battle?

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Aboard a falling plane as the clock ticks toward doom, Han Tae-sul puts his famous mind to work for a solution. Gang Seo-hae arrives in the year 2020.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: The contents of a mysterious suitcase give Tae-sul more questions than answers. In exchange for lottery numbers, Sun agrees to help Seo-hae.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Tae-sul's presentation at a conference gets a violent interruption. He and Seo-hae make a narrow escape, but more trouble soon follows.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: On the run from the enforcement agency, Tae-sul and Seo-hae give in to the time traveler's request that they make a stop at his mother's house.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Caught by Kim Seo-jin trespassing in her clinic, Tae-sul tries to explain what's going on. Seo-hae reveals disturbing details about the future.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Seo-hae infiltrates Eddy Kim's party with a mission. After a series of distressing events, Tae-sul realizes he cannot trust everyone around him.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Seo-hae urges Sun to flee the country, and asks Mr. Park to do her a favor in exchange for an item he's eager to get his hands on.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Despite Seo-hae's insistence that he lie low, Tae-sul focuses on tracking down an enigmatic figure who seems to be tied to everything.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: At the amusement park with Tae-sul for her birthday, Seo-hae encounters someone unexpected. A familiar threat strikes again.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Tae-sul enters enemy quarters to retrieve Seo-hae. Learning she's been put in a dire condition, he turns to a grudging Mr. Park for assistance.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Tae-sul and Sigma come face-to-face. In order to rescue Seo-hae, Tae-sul must endure an emotional trip through his past.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: When Seo-hae wakes up, a person she missed is waiting to meet her. A long-forgotten childhood memory returns to Tae-sul.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Tae-sul is reunited with a trusty friend, who comes to him with a warning. A suitcase containing disturbing contents arrives at Asia Mart.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: With the war looming on the horizon, everyone must make their choices. When Seo-hae heads to the only place she knows, Tae-sul finds her.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: As Tae-sul tries to locate him, Sigma reveals more details about himself. Sun frees Seo-hae from the bunker.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Tae-sul asks Seo-hae to trust him no matter what happens — and demonstrates that nothing is fixed when it comes to matters of the future.

episodes.name: Of Waltzes and Water Bras
episodes.overview: Maheep and Sanjay travel to Paris ahead of Shanaya's debutante ball. Former actress Neelam considers a comeback. Bhavana and Seema enjoy family time.

episodes.name: Werk it!
episodes.overview: Maheep and her family enjoy a lavish night at le Bal. Bhavana, Neelam and Seema grapple with balancing work and life.

episodes.name: Crabs, Claws and a Catfight
episodes.overview: A lunch date with Karan Johar gets tense as Bhavana and Seema butt heads. Neelam discusses acting opportunities with producer friend Ekta Kapoor.

episodes.name: Feelings and Fillers
episodes.overview: A group lunch smooths ruffled feathers. Neelam has her first face-lift. A dinner with the husbands turns awkward as Maheep raises an unusual question.

episodes.name: Fasten Your Seat Belts
episodes.overview: Ahead of a girls trip to Doha, the women meet for a beach cleanup. Actors Raveena Tandon and Jacqueline Fernandez give Neelam and Seema career tips.

episodes.name: “Aap Qatar mein hain…”
episodes.overview: As the ladies enjoy opulent indulgences in Doha, Seema explores her adventurous side, while a persistent admirer rattles Neelam.

episodes.name: There's Something About Neelam
episodes.overview: As the fun in Doha continues with a yacht ride and a trip down memory lane, an unseen side of Neelam emerges. Karan Johar catches up with the group.

episodes.name: The Shah Rukh-Gauri Big Bash!
episodes.overview: The women go glam for ultimate star wife and pal Gauri Khan’s celebrity-studded bash, where Shah Rukh Khan himself joins in to recall the good times.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In a season of fresh starts, the wives redefine relationships, careers and personal goals — all with their signature mix of cheeky quips and camaraderie.

episodes.name: Love, Life and Menopause
episodes.overview: Maheep brings an offer that splits the wives’ opinions. Bhavana has a romantic idea. Neelam is daunted by a new film role. Seema begins a new chapter.

episodes.name: Bollywood Friends Forever
episodes.overview: Maheep mingles with famous friends, then has a heartfelt chat with Seema. A clash with Samir perturbs Neelam. Bhavana finally tells the wives her news.

episodes.name: Heard it on the Grapevine!
episodes.overview: As tensions brew between the ladies, Bhavana makes plans with other friends. Karan arranges a surprise for Seema. Neelam spills on her upcoming project.

episodes.name: Men are from Mars...
episodes.overview: Neelam and Seema's spat divides the ladies. As Samir surprises the group at brunch, Sanjay irks Maheep. The women go glam for a shoot with Gauri Khan.

episodes.name: Friends, Family and Other Animals
episodes.overview: For some, anxieties run high ahead of a trip organized by Seema. The unexpected destination proves beautiful — but the ladies are in for a wild ride.

episodes.name: Wild Things
episodes.overview: The wives settle into holiday mode. Amid safaris and poolside lounging, there's plenty of time for some to butt heads — and others to bury the hatchet.

episodes.name: Face Lifts & FacePalms
episodes.overview: Vow renewal prep is in full swing, from fashion decisions to anti-aging procedures. Meanwhile, Seema and a familiar matchmaker discuss arranged marriage.

episodes.name: Objects of Desire are Closer Than They Appear
episodes.overview: The vow renewal is an evening of warmth, friendship and affection. But the real climax comes a few days later, when the wives visit a superstar's set.

seasons.name: Fabulous Lives vs Bollywood Wives
seasons.overview: This season - brace yourselves as the OG Bombay Wives collide with the new, blazing Delhi wives.

episodes.name: The Delhi Cats
episodes.overview: Donning artsy looks, Neelam, Maheep, Bhavana and Seema meet Delhi’s glitterati — Riddhima, Shalini and Kalyani — for a fabulously opulent ball.

episodes.name: Fasting & Furious
episodes.overview: Shalini plans a musical welcome for the Bombay ladies. While the gang celebrates Karva Chauth at Riddhima’s home, Maheep makes a startling discovery.

episodes.name: BYOB - Bring Your Own Baggage
episodes.overview: Bhavana visits her alma mater. Maheep opens up about her health struggles and Seema meets internet sensation Orry. Karan Johar comes in to stir the pot.

episodes.name: Let The Chaos Begin
episodes.overview: A rogue Instagram post puts Kalyani and Shalini in the spotlight. The ladies touch down in Mauritius — but all’s not well with Shalini.

episodes.name: Wine & Whine
episodes.overview: A growing rivalry sours the mood as the Delhi ladies criticize their Bombay counterparts. Seema and Maheep try to mend their friendship.

episodes.name: Drunk Skunks
episodes.overview: A day of adventure sports ends with the ladies admitting their secret desires aboard a luxury yacht — until a storm begins to roll in.

episodes.name: Home Hits Different
episodes.overview: An emotional Neelam comes clean, while Seema has secrets of her own. The gang prepares to meet the most fabulous of wives — Gauri Khan.

episodes.name: A Tale Of Two Cities
episodes.overview: The women engage in a smashing activity and later rendezvous with Saif Ali Khan. Karan stages an intervention for Maheep and Seema.

episodes.name: Love Letter
episodes.overview: Shin Sol-i isn't shy about her unrequited crush on Cha Heon, her next-door neighbor. One day, she gets an idea to write him the perfect love letter.

episodes.name: At the Karaoke
episodes.overview: Woo Dae-sung ditches swim practice before a competition for a fun night out at karaoke. When Heon is down, Sol-i wants to be by his side.

episodes.name: Pick Me Up!
episodes.overview: Sol-i declares she's running for class representative, surprising her friends. While Dae-sung shows his support, Heon disappoints her.

episodes.name: Field Day
episodes.overview: Desperate for prize money so she can buy Heon a birthday present, Sol-i pours all her energy into winning at the school's sports competition.

episodes.name: Drama Festival (feat. Let's Go, Baby)
episodes.overview: The class prepares to audition for the school play. Sol-i wants to act out a romantic story with Heon, but he's not easy to convince.

episodes.name: Don't Go
episodes.overview: After the incident at the play, Sol-i begins to avoid Heon and considers a big decision. To cheer her up, Dae-sung puts together something special.

episodes.name: Game of Truth
episodes.overview: Excited to try out for a TV singing competition, Jeong Jin-hwan asks the friends to come and support him. Sol-i worries when her parents fight.

episodes.name: Happy Birthday
episodes.overview: Heon agrees to spend a Saturday with Sol-i, who wants to take him to see his favorite soccer team. But his mood soon sours.

episodes.name: We Need to Talk
episodes.overview: When a confession note makes Sol-i awkward around him, Dae-sung assures her it was a joke. Jin-hwan gets help facing his bullies.

episodes.name: Don't Worry.mp3
episodes.overview: With the flu going around, Sol-i frets when she has a cough and is sent to the school nurse's office. Heon looks out for her in his own way.

episodes.name: White Christmas
episodes.overview: It's almost Christmas! While Sol-i racks her brains on what to get Heon, her parents wonder whether their daughter has a crush on someone.

episodes.name: Declaration of Love
episodes.overview: When the class goes on a trip outdoors, Sol-i plans a surprise event for Heon. Jin-hwan ruins Kang Ha-young's night at the movies.

episodes.name: Raindrop
episodes.overview: Knowing he's hurt Sol-i's feelings, Heon attempts to apologize. A visibly troubled Oh Hui-ji acts out of character.

episodes.name: Four-Leaf Clover
episodes.overview: Hui-ji steals from the school nurse's office. Jin-hwan stops coming to school when he finds out about Ha-young's crush on someone else.

episodes.name: University, University, University!
episodes.overview: Sol-i learns that Heon wants to attend a prestigious university. Dae-sung's worsening arm injury threatens his swimming career.

episodes.name: Collect Our Dreams
episodes.overview: Heon's plans for his future don't align with what his mother wants. When Dae-sung's grandmother goes missing, Heon and Sol-i also look for her.

episodes.name: First Kiss
episodes.overview: As all her friends get accepted into college, Sol-i feels down about herself. Heon encourages her to keep trying, and promises he'll help.

episodes.name: Love Generation
episodes.overview: Sol-i is elated when Heon makes their relationship official. Not wanting to worry Ha-young, Jin-hwan keeps a secret from her.

episodes.name: Farewell Formula
episodes.overview: Struggling in her job search and with putting up with Heon's demanding work schedule, Sol-i snaps when she finds out he may be leaving for America.

episodes.name: It's Been A While
episodes.overview: Hearing her dad's been hospitalized, Sol-i hurries over — and bumps into Heon, who's back in Korea. All the friends gather for drinks.

episodes.name: Your Wedding
episodes.overview: Sol-i calls Heon about his actions the night before. Everyone comes together for Ha-young and Jin-hwan's wedding.

episodes.name: Begin Again
episodes.overview: Heon shows up to a gathering in his old school uniform, and gets honest about his feelings. Dae-sung decides it's time to bare his heart to Sol-i.

episodes.name: Dear My Honey
episodes.overview: A lovely surprise awaits Sol-i outside of Heon's hospital. The next day, Sol-i's parents come to visit her without notice.

episodes.name: From, Honey
episodes.overview: Looking back on all they've endured together, Heon recounts for Sol-i how he came to fall in love with her.

episodes.name: Ragnarok
episodes.overview: At the Council of Valhalla, the gods vote unanimously for humankind's extinction. But Brunhilde, eldest of the Valkyrie sisters, raises her objection.

episodes.name: Worthy Opponent
episodes.overview: In the first round of the Ragnarok battle, Han dynasty warlord Lü Bu puts up a good fight against Norse god Thor, surprising the gods in attendance.

episodes.name: Killer Move
episodes.overview: To give Lü Bu the upper hand against Thor, Brünnhilde summons her sister Randgriz and asks her to transform into a sacred weapon — the Shield Breaker.

episodes.name: Joy
episodes.overview: Lü Bu's legs are crushed by the mighty Geirröd Thor's Hammer attack, but just when all hope seems lost, the warlord's trusty horse Red Hare rides in.

episodes.name: FILE No.00000000001
episodes.overview: Chosen for the next round is the father of humankind and the man bearing more hatred towards the gods than anyone else: Adam himself.

episodes.name: Great Emulation
episodes.overview: Zeus insists on going up against Adam, who joins forces with Valkyrie Reginleif to obtain a most peculiar weapon: a knuckleduster.

episodes.name: Expelled from Paradise
episodes.overview: Just when it looks like Adam will earn humankind the victory they long for, Zeus gathers his strength to ask Adam why he's really fighting.

episodes.name: Grace Abounding
episodes.overview: Zeus has transformed into his final most powerful form, but after the beating he's suffered, he may not last much longer in the fight.

episodes.name: Tyrant of the Ocean
episodes.overview: Humankind is desperate to win the next bout, but the god they're going up against is one of the mightiest of them all: Poseidon.

episodes.name: Greatest Loser
episodes.overview: Kojiro Sasaki uses his mighty Tsubame Gaeshi move to finish off Poseidon, but the god of the sea won't be sunk so easily.

episodes.name: The Swallow Gazes into the Abyss
episodes.overview: Through the power of Valkyrie Hrist, Kojiro's broken blade is transformed into dual swords, allowing him to tap into the depths of his inner strength.

episodes.name: And Ragnarok Goes On
episodes.overview: Despite Kojiro's Niten Ganryu duel blade method, Poseidon's powerful attacks continue to wear him down. But the battle isn't over yet.

seasons.name: Record of Ragnarok II
seasons.overview: Humanity may be down, but their fight for survival is far from over. For the pivotal next round, a truly evil human emerges to face the next mighty god.

episodes.name: Good vs. Evil
episodes.overview: The gods have no intention of letting the humans win the next round; for their next fighter, they present none other than the great hero, Hercules.

episodes.name: The Indomitable War God
episodes.overview: The spectators notice that the tattoos on Hercules have grown significantly — and if they continue to grow, the hero will suffer a painful death.

episodes.name: Birth of a Monster
episodes.overview: In late 19th century London, the young son of a prostitute has a special ability that helps him survive the poverty he was born into.

episodes.name: The Final Labor
episodes.overview: Although he’s lost his left arm, Hercules remains steadfast, easily summoning the strength to unleash his ultimate move: the Twelfth Labor.

episodes.name: Requiem
episodes.overview: The brutal fourth round has pushed both fighters beyond their breaking point; when the winner is finally announced, there is no joy or celebration.

episodes.name: Conflicting Motives
episodes.overview: To capitalize on humanity's momentum, Brünnhilde pays a visit to the colossal Tameemon Raiden, the most powerful sumo wrestler in history.

episodes.name: Hundred Seals
episodes.overview: Stepping into the sumo ring to take on Tameemon Raiden is the God of Destruction, the Destroyer himself: Supreme Lord Shiva.

episodes.name: The Pinnacle of 1116
episodes.overview: Years ago, Shiva spent many happy days with his best friend Rudra. Then one day, Rudra asks Shiva to join him on a journey to the top.

episodes.name: Resonance
episodes.overview: As a child, Raiden had to suppress his full strength so he wouldn’t hurt other people. But now, to win this battle, he’s not holding anything back.

episodes.name: The Brink
episodes.overview: The match comes to a moving end. Even Zeus is impressed by humanity's powerful spirit; but he's going to make sure the gods get the ultimate victory.

episodes.name: Round Six
episodes.overview: With the scoreboard almost neck-and-neck, Buddha declares that he'll fight in the next round — but whose side will he be fighting on?

episodes.name: Zero
episodes.overview: Struck by the amount of suffering humans must endure, Zerofuku decides to absorb all of their unhappiness, but it still isn't enough to end their pain.

episodes.name: The strongest puberty in history
episodes.overview: There was once a prince who was born into great wealth and given the very best of everything. But one day, he decides to leave it all behind.

episodes.name: Legend of the Underworld
episodes.overview: Nobody knows who the strange new creature is, but he's clearly very strong. And most worryingly, Buddha can't foresee his new opponent's next moves.

episodes.name: The Way of Light
episodes.overview: It looks like the match is over. But then Buddha gets up, looking stronger than ever. Will he be able to gain another crucial point for the humans?

seasons.name: Record of Ragnarok III
seasons.overview: The saga continues with 13 one-on-one battles for the survival of humanity, pitting gods against humansfrom across the world. Witness the fateful seventh battle: the final fight to break the 3-3 tie between the gods and humans. Blood flows and fists fly in th…

episodes.name: Prologue: Recollections
episodes.overview: While humanity celebrates, the sixth round's result rattles the gods. Brunhilde and Hermes reflect on the previous battles and humanity's resilience.

episodes.name: King vs. King
episodes.overview: With the gods desperate for a win, Hades steps up to avenge his brother. Humanity sends Qin Shi Huang, setting the stage for a monumental clash of kings.

episodes.name: Chi You
episodes.overview: After uniting China, Qin Shi Huang ascends Mount Tai alone to prove himself before the demon god Chi You. There, he masters the ultimate martial art.

episodes.name: A Promise and an Oath
episodes.overview: As a child, Qin Shi Huang's daily life is filled with hostility. Yet over time, he finds happiness in the close bond he forms with his strict caretaker.

episodes.name: Pride of the King of Helheim
episodes.overview: As the seventh round heats up, Hades gouges his own chest, humming as blood pours out and empowers his divine weapon with new strength.

episodes.name: Return of the King
episodes.overview: On the brink of death, Qin Shi Huang draws strength from Alvitr, unleashing the Force of the Phoenix again. Hades readies his spear for the final blow.

episodes.name: Satan
episodes.overview: For the eighth round, the gods choose Beelzebub, the god cursed by Satan. Though shunned by all, he once had three close friends who shaped his destiny.

episodes.name: Light vs. Shadow
episodes.overview: While struggling with Beelzebub's vibration-based powers, Tesla recognizes them as a form of science and counters with the full force of human ingenuity.

episodes.name: A Curse and a Prayer
episodes.overview: Tesla traps Beelzebub in the Gematria Zone and unleashes the Tesla Step, but Beelzebub learns to nullify the onslaught. The gods expect victory, but...

episodes.name: The Torch Passed On
episodes.overview: Even after Beelzebub unleashes Helheim's forbidden technique, Tesla stands firm. As the battle peaks, he recalls childhood memories of his brother.

episodes.name: Progress
episodes.overview: Though battered, Tesla is relentless, pushing Beelzebub on the defensive and to his limits. The showdown between science versus myth reaches its climax.

episodes.name: The Sun God and the Rebellious Hero
episodes.overview: The gods' next fighter is Apollo, the radiant sun god. Representing humanity is King Leonidas of Sparta. As round nine begins, neither will back down.

episodes.name: Pride vs. Pride
episodes.overview: In the past, King Leonidas of Sparta defies Apollo's prophecies and goes to war. Now, with his pride on the line, he delivers a decisive strike at Apollo.

episodes.name: Know Thyself
episodes.overview: Fueled by unyielding resolve, Leonidas slams Apollo down. As the bloodied god rises, most gods scorn his pride, but Zeus and Ares see the truth.

episodes.name: A Clash of Souls
episodes.overview: Both fighters near death but stand tall, honoring each other's valor. Leonidas transforms his shield and advances as Apollo draws his mythical bow.

episodes.name: Chi Goes To A Nice Place
Chi Takes Cover From The Rain
Chi Goes On An Adventure With Friends Part 1
Chi Goes On A An Adventure With Friends Part 2
Chi, Flutter, And The Thieving Cats
Chi Aims For A Pigeon Again
Adventures In Fluffyland The Final Level

seasons.name: Summer Vacation
seasons.overview: Sweet, energetic kitten Chi travels to Okinawa with her beloved Yohei and his family, where they discover the joys of island life and make new friends.

episodes.name: Homemade 1
episodes.overview: Dad takes the whole family to Okinawa for a work trip during summer vacation. A girl named Aina gives them a warm welcome at her beach house.

episodes.name: Homemade 2
episodes.overview: Chi wants to become friends with the three cats that live near Aina's house, but they say she needs to pass three tests before they accept her.

episodes.name: Homemade 3
episodes.overview: Yohei and his parents find a gecko in the house while Chi is asleep and try to quietly shoo it outside, knowing she will chase it if she wakes up.

episodes.name: Homemade 4
episodes.overview: When Chi loses her favorite cushion, she begins searching the house high and low. Sunny and the other cats offer to help her look for it.

episodes.name: Homemade 5
episodes.overview: Yohei and Aina decide to make Okinawan doughnuts for Dad, who has been busy working hard. The hungry cats try to steal some for themselves.

episodes.name: Homemade 6
episodes.overview: Dad, Yohei and Chi go to a forest to find a big tree. After Chi eats a snack said to be liked by the forest’s spirits, spooky things start to happen.

episodes.name: Homemade 7
episodes.overview: Aina invites Yohei and Mom to try hip-hop dancing. She tries to teach them, but they aren't very good at dancing and struggle to keep up.

episodes.name: Homemade 8
episodes.overview: Aina helps Yohei make a video report for his school project. But when they start filming, she keeps getting distracted by random events.

episodes.name: Homemade 9
episodes.overview: Two lion-like guardian spirits suddenly jump down from the roof and teach Chi and Sunny how to look alert and defend the house from danger.

episodes.name: Homemade 10
episodes.overview: Yohei goes fishing with Aina but is too scared to touch the worm bait. Remembering an Okinawan saying, he finally finds the courage he needs.

episodes.name: Homemade 11
episodes.overview: A typhoon hits Okinawa, forcing everyone to stay indoors and play games. Chi tries to play with the cats but finds them fighting with each other.

episodes.name: Homemade 12
episodes.overview: Dad worries when he finds that the screen he needs for the festival has been broken, but he gets an idea when he sees Aina and Yohei catching fish.

episodes.name: The Mighty Bulls
episodes.overview: When the village’s biggest bulls display their strength, can Bheem help his friend, a calf, impress the crowd, too?

episodes.name: Master Chef Bheem
episodes.overview: The villagers are cooking for the festivities, and Bheem wants to show off his culinary skills, too — but he might need some divine intervention!

episodes.name: The Peacock Kite
episodes.overview: As friends and families fly their kites, Bheem spots an especially beautiful one. Who does it belong to?

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Dong-kyung has been working hard ever since her parents passed away. Her life seems to get stable after working as an web novel editor for 6 years, but one day she gets diagnosed with a brain cancer. She blames her unlucky life and wishes to curse everything…

episodes.name: I'm Really Dying
episodes.overview: After having the worst day of her life, Tak Dong-gyeong wishes for the world to end. A stranger shows up at her door to make that desire a reality.

episodes.name: Hold My Hand
episodes.overview: Dong-gyeong realizes that the hundred-day pact with Myeol-mang comes with heavy consequences if she refuses to fulfill her end of the bargain.

episodes.name: Living Together with Myeol-mang
episodes.overview: As Dong-gyeong deals with a demanding new roommate, she looks for a loophole in her agreement with Myeol-mang to save her loved ones from doom.

episodes.name: How to Love Myeol-mang
episodes.overview: In a desperate attempt to destroy Myeol-mang by winning him over, Dong-gyeong seeks the help of a romance expert.

episodes.name: Why Would She Do That?
episodes.overview: Puzzled by Dong-gyeong's act of self-sacrifice, Myeol-mang decides to keep close tabs on her to figure out her true intentions.

episodes.name: Now What?
episodes.overview: Dong-gyeong looks for another subject to fall in love with. Na Ji-na attends a high school reunion hoping to see an old flame.

episodes.name: And Then He Was Gone
episodes.overview: Myeol-mang comes to a difficult decision after being reminded of the part he played in bringing grief and sadness into Dong-gyeong's life.

episodes.name: I Knew You Would Come
episodes.overview: After a short-lived reunion, Dong-gyeong has her love and trust in Myeol-mang tested while he navigates a world where she never existed.

episodes.name: Soo-ja Finds Out
episodes.overview: Lee Hyeon-gyu shows up at Ji-na’s door to get something off his chest. Dong-gyeong goes on a shopping spree to prepare for a final goodbye.

episodes.name: An Unexpected Answer
episodes.overview: Myeol-mang makes a heartfelt confession. A writer accuses Ji-na of plagiarism. Dong-gyeong makes a painful choice to save her loved ones.

episodes.name: A Date with Myeol-mang
episodes.overview: After spending time with good company, Dong-gyeong returns to her old life while Myeol-mang finds himself transformed. Ji-na works on a new series.

episodes.name: The Forgotten Ones
episodes.overview: Myeol-mang punishes criminals who run free. Dong-gyeong meets a ghost at the hospital. Ji-na and Hyeon-gyu feel a growing distance between them.

episodes.name: Who Are You?
episodes.overview: Myeol-mang keeps an eye on Dong-gyeong hoping to figure out who she is. Ji-na clears the air with Hyeon-gyu but makes up her mind to move on.

episodes.name: Cold Heartless Fate
episodes.overview: After promising a life together, Myeol-mang and Dong-gyeong make the most of the time they have left.

episodes.name: A Butterfly for a Flower
episodes.overview: Upon receiving a second chance, Dong-gyeong moves forward with her life, while holding on tightly to the memories of her past.

episodes.name: I No Longer Bring Doom
episodes.overview: Having found the person to spend the rest of her life with, Dong-gyeong finds hope and meaning for the future.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: As a killing resembling a cold case resurfaces in a small town, the chase for the truth falls on two policemen who each harbor secrets of their own.

episodes.name: Appear
episodes.overview: When young hotshot Han Ju-won arrives in town, he's assigned to partner with Lee Dong-sik, a maverick cop with a gruesome tragedy in his past.

episodes.name: Disappear
episodes.overview: The discovery of an unidentified human skeleton raises unsettling possibilities. Dong-sik drags Kang Min-jeong back to town from a Seoul night club.

episodes.name: Smiled
episodes.overview: Ju-won's suspicions about Dong-sik's involvement in the case intensify. The emergence of a mysterious cellphone places Ju-won in a tight spot.

episodes.name: Cried
episodes.overview: Coming up empty with Dong-sik's interrogation, the police root around Yoo Jae-i's butcher shop. Ju-won makes an explosive statement to the public.

episodes.name: The Deceit
episodes.overview: A fight breaks out as Dong-sik prevents Kang Jin-muk from being taken advantage of. Oh Ji-hun is confronted about the night of the disappearance.

episodes.name: To Deceive
episodes.overview: Ju-won agrees to Jin-muk's request to carry out his own unofficial investigation. Do Hae-won moves to put an end to the case and protect her son.

episodes.name: The Text Messages
episodes.overview: Park Jeong-je does the right thing. The arrival of a second text from Min-jeong points Dong-sik toward someone who's figured out the truth.

episodes.name: The Arrest and Interrogation
episodes.overview: News of the killer's arrest scandalizes the town. The killer refuses to speak to anyone but Dong-sik and Ju-won. Their interrogation hits a nerve.

episodes.name: Bodies Found
episodes.overview: Following a clue from an old video, Dong-sik searches desperately for his sister's remains. Ju-won and Jae-i each return after three months away.

episodes.name: Interrogating the Chief
episodes.overview: Seeing CCTV footage, Dong-sik is convinced he's figured out the real culprit behind the killer's death. Ju-won puts a GPS tracker on Nam Sang-bae.

episodes.name: Who Killed Sang-bae?
episodes.overview: Committed to getting to the bottom of the latest murder, the team pulls together — and considers two of their own as prime suspects.

episodes.name: Jeong-je and the Deer
episodes.overview: The truth behind the events from the night of Lee Yu-yeon's death begins to unravel. Jeong-je struggles to remember what happened.

episodes.name: The Next Commissioner General
episodes.overview: As detectives begin to connect the dots, Han Ki-hwan's ties to the case become clearer. Dong-sik asks Ju-won if he can trust him.

episodes.name: Setting the Trap
episodes.overview: Dong-sik listens in on a conversation that brings to light many long-held secrets. A determined Ju-won sets out to uncover further truths.

episodes.name: Letting Go
