episodes.overview: After obtaining an astonishing audio recording, Ju-won resolves to pursue justice at any cost. Dong-sik and Ju-won question Lee Chang-jin.

episodes.name: Catch
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of another sudden killing, Dong-sik joins hands with Ju-won to bring down the guilty — and deliver necessary punishment.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Vincenzo Cassano's homecoming is met by distrusting tenants and eager fraudsters. Hong Yu-chan relinquishes his parental rights to Hong Cha-young.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Warned about a scheduled demolition of Geumga Plaza, Vincenzo contrives to thwart the attack. Yu-chan receives a call from a whistleblower.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Vincenzo warns an impassioned Yu-chan about the dangers of a new drug and its even more harmful pharmaceutical company. Choi Myung-hee shows her claws.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Fighting fire with fire, Yu-chan's supporters unite their efforts to carry out his vision of justice. Vincenzo employs Myung-hee's tactics against her.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Jang Joon-woo reminds Jang Han-seo who's the boss. The tenants rally around Vincenzo and Cha-young, who team up to take down Babel Group.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Both sides use every trick in the book to cause disturbances in and out of the courtroom. Han Seung-hyuk and Myung-hee are introduced to Babel's CEO.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Stumped by surprise witnesses, Joon-woo and Myung-hee direct their rage toward Cha-young. The tenants gain new appreciation for their building.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Angered by another conglomerate and its generations of unpunished crimes, Vincenzo tries to charm a young bank president out of investing in Babel.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Joon-woo wields his power to force loyalty from his partners. Cha-young finds refuge in Vincenzo's apartment following a break-in.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Seeking revenge instead of liability for the loss of more innocent victims, Vincenzo puts his life on the line to lure Babel's CEO out of hiding.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: The search for Jang Han-seok begins with torturing his lackeys for information. An Gi-seok flashes his work badge to free Vincenzo from prosecution.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Han-seo faces unintended consequences when he takes a shot at Babel's throne. Vincenzo and Cho Ju-yeong finally get Geumga Plaza to themselves.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Ju-yeong reveals his true motive. As incoming CEO, Han-seok is met with admiration, applause and a mafia-styled surprise from Vincenzo.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: To expose Han-seok’s paper company, Vincenzo and Cha-young go undercover as an enamored couple. Seo Mi-ri reveals her high-tech tricks.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: With ample evidence to lock up Han-seok, Jung In-kuk holds a press conference. Vincenzo channels spirits to turn an ill-famed newspaper against Babel.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Maddened by Vincenzo's ability to slip out of another one of his bloody traps, Han-seok goes after what Vincenzo cherishes the most.

episodes.name: Episode 17
episodes.overview: A grieving Vincenzo crashes a party to bleed Babel Group dry of its powerful allies. Seung-hyuk reaches out to a high-level commander for help.

episodes.name: Episode 18
episodes.overview: Fearing for his life, Han-seok goes to jail to bide some time. A visitor from Italy tells Vincenzo his help is urgently needed back home.

episodes.name: Episode 19
episodes.overview: Vincenzo and Cha-young present damning evidence against Babel Tower and its influential cronies. Myung-hee proves her loyalty toward Han-seok.

episodes.name: Episode 20
episodes.overview: Han-seok lets nothing stand in his way of revenge. Seeking justice the mafia way, Vincenzo gives his enemies a slow and painful death.

episodes.name: The Death Row Convict and the Executioner
episodes.overview: Gabimaru, a ninja member of a clan of assassins, is sentenced to death. He claims to have nothing to tie him to life, yet no method of execution manages to end his life. His meeting with Sagiri Yamada Asaemon, who seems to be investigating him, will change ev…

episodes.name: Screening and Choosing
episodes.overview: The condemned criminals are gathered on the beach to prepare for the expedition to Shinsenkyo, but first, they must reduce their numbers.

episodes.name: Weakness and Strength
episodes.overview: Gabimaru, Sagiri, and the others arrive on Shinsenkyo, and their battle for survival begins.

episodes.name: Hell and Paradise
episodes.overview: Gabimaru and Sagiri are in trouble during their first fight against the island's mysterious creatures. Gabimaru is unaware of these monstrosities and this puts him at a disadvantage in battle. The sudden arrival of Yuzuriha, the female ninja, will change the…

episodes.name: The Samurai and the Woman
episodes.overview: Gabimaru and Sagiri's group cross paths with another Yamada Asaemon, Genji, who takes a dim view of Sagiri's involvement in the present matter. Meanwhile, Yamada Asaemon Tenza tries to find a way off the island along with his charge, Nurugai.

episodes.name: Heart and Reason
episodes.overview: Rokurota starts to cause serious problems for Sagiri and Gabimaru, and now they must think of a strategy to defeat him!

episodes.name: Flowers and Offerings
episodes.overview: Chobe and Toma encounter people unlike any they've ever encountered before. Gabimaru and Sagiri's party finally meet people who live on the island.

episodes.name: Student and Master
episodes.overview: Tenza and Nurugai also encounter one of the island's strange denizens with unfathomable power. All seems lost before they encounter another Yamada Asaemon...

episodes.name: Gods and People
episodes.overview: Sagiri's group sets off in search of Horai. Gabimaru goes ahead and encounters the same powerful being that confronted Tenza...

episodes.name: Yin and Yang
episodes.overview: Mei attempts to explain something very important to Sagiri's party in the forest. Shion tries to explain how he interacts with the world to Nurugai. A mysterious servant of the Tensen tries to explain why Aza Chobe and Toma shouldn't escape.

episodes.name: Weak and Strong
episodes.overview: Chobe brings new abilities to bear as he faces the Tensen's servants. A secret of Mei's is revealed to Gabimaru, hardening his resolve to fight and opening him up to a new perception of the world.

episodes.name: Umbrella and Ink
episodes.overview: Mu Dan confronts Sagiri's party and reveals shocking truths about the island's true nature.

episodes.name: Dreams and Reality
episodes.overview: Sagiri's party faces Mu Dan's seemingly unstoppable true form. Shion does his best to rise to the challenge with his mastery of waves.

episodes.name: Dawn and Confusion
episodes.overview: Shugen and Jikka are sent to Shinsenkyo, while Gabimaru and his companions battle Aza Chobe and Toma.

episodes.name: Reality and Fantasy
episodes.overview: Aza Chobe and Gabimaru lose themselves in battle, but Mei stops their fight.

episodes.name: Immutability and Change
episodes.overview: While Aza Chobe battles Rien, Gabimaru regains his memories and begins training in the use of tao.

episodes.name: The Samurai Code and Carnage
episodes.overview: Sagiri believes Shugen will be an ally and eagerly anticipates the expedition's arrival, but Shion is skeptical.

episodes.name: Humans and Sages
episodes.overview: As the expeditioners prepare, Gabimaru asks Mei if she's sure she wants to leave the island with them.

episodes.name: Hindering and Restoration
episodes.overview: Gabimaru's group finally enters the sacred mountain, but the Tensen can see everything they're up to.

episodes.name: Two People and One Person
episodes.overview: Gantetsusai and Fuchi struggle against Tao Fa, but they seem to be enjoying themselves.

episodes.name: Chrysanthemum and Peach
episodes.overview: When Tao Fa asks Ju Fa for help, Ju Fa recalls the time they spent together.

episodes.name: Love and Karma
episodes.overview: The expeditioners work together to take on Tao Fa and Ju Fa, who have undergone Kishikai transformations.

episodes.name: Master and Student
episodes.overview: Shion and Nurugai take on Zhu Jin, but both sides lack the ability to finish the other off.

episodes.name: Ephemeralness and Fire
episodes.overview: Gabimaru recalls the days he spent with Yui. How will his battle against Rien end?

episodes.name: Endings and Beginnings
episodes.overview: As Gabimaru and his companions finish their respective battles, the additional expedition arrives.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Believing the Allspark destroyed, Megatron plans to flee the dying planet — but at great cost. Elita’s plan to free some prisoners hits a snag.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Mercenary Transformers come upon the Ark adrift in space. As unlikely allies arrive to rescue the imprisoned Autobots, Megatron reveals Project Nemesis.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The Autobots locate the Allspark, but a deserted space station and its lone occupant stand in the way. The Decepticons catch up with the Ark.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Megatron faces a life-or-death situation. As the Autobots and Decepticons work together to fight against Scorponok, Starscream tries to seize power.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Optimus encounters an unexpected guide who shows him a possible future. Megatron meets an entity who tells him what he needs to take from Optimus.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Above the planet where the Allspark lies, the Autobots and Decepticons battle while Deseeus closes in to exact revenge upon them all.

episodes.name: What the Thunder Said
episodes.overview: There's no rest for the righteous: Dragon Knight Davion makes an ominous discovery and meets a princess with a plan. A fiery fight burns its hero.

episodes.name: Princess of Nothing
episodes.overview: Mirana and Marci lend a hand to Davion, who remembers little. The Black Market calls; Davion spits out a telltale ring — and unleashes a beast within.

episodes.name: Neverwhere Land
episodes.overview: Dream on: visions drive a haunted Dragon Knight and a gifted lotus thief. Fymryn sets out to find her sorcerer as a treacherous path humbles Mirana.

episodes.name: The Monster at the End of This Book
episodes.overview: Fear summons a goddess; Davion looks to a brooding brother for answers — or a fight. Fymryn's rescuer faces a powerful luminary, ready to declare war.

episodes.name: The Fire Sermon
episodes.overview: The gang copes with a bumpy landing while the Order goes to war. Slyrak rampages, and Davion must reckon with the powerful spirits of ancient dragons.

episodes.name: The Knight, Death and the Devil
episodes.overview: Fymryn and Luna appeal to their goddesses. The Invoker delivers tough truths to Davion and Mirana; later, a bargain is struck.

episodes.name: Speak the Words
episodes.overview: A grieving father invokes a daughter's memory. Up to her old tricks, Fymryn rushes into a dragon's nest, leaving Davion to risk it all.

episodes.name: A Game of Chess
episodes.overview: Old compatriots — and enemies — reemerge. Mirana and Fymryn try to right wrongs, but a goddess has other plans, and cruel oblivion beckons.

seasons.name: Book 2
seasons.overview: Upheaval reigns, order crumbles, and all heroes must now answer the call to fight the daunting forces threatening to plunge the world into darkness.

episodes.name: Nothing with Nothing
episodes.overview: After striking a deal with a demon, the Invoker faces Selemene. Mirana and Luna marshal the troops. Davion makes a discovery with deadly implications.

episodes.name: My Sword, My Life
episodes.overview: A swarm like no other attacks the hold as a squire steps up and a patriarch plays on deep fears. Desperate for help, Mirana finds a refuge — or is it?

episodes.name: The Lady of Situations
episodes.overview: With faith and trust in short supply, chaos descends on siblings. Davion's group shelters with a unique dragon as a princess returns to her origins.

episodes.name: Desolate and Empty the Sea
episodes.overview: The ties that bind: Mirana makes a deal for an army. Bram's match reveals a new side. Davion heads to the Helio Imperium for the Eye of the Worldwyrm.

episodes.name: The Burial of the Dead
episodes.overview: A goddess full of regret, an elf discovered, and a princess on a precipice: Mirana's beginnings come to light as the hunt for an assassin heats up.

episodes.name: The Hyacinth Girl
episodes.overview: Has Davion's song faded? Lina battles Slyrak. A poetry-spinning dragon ushers in the sunlight, and then a shocking power play shakes the Imperium.

episodes.name: The Violet Hour
episodes.overview: A leader rises: Davion confronts a fake. Lina confesses. Fymryn grapples with guilt, a demon and a promise. A power behind the scenes materializes.

episodes.name: Unreal City
episodes.overview: Darkness reveals itself — and demands sacrifices. Davion lays it all on the line, Bram rises to the occasion, and Mirana fights for the power within.

seasons.name: Book 3
seasons.overview: The time has come for brave warriors to conquer an indomitable foe. But can the ultimate sacrifice bring lasting peace — to all possible worlds?

episodes.name: The Wind Under the Door
episodes.overview: Drysi strikes a terrifying bargain. Luna appeals to Mirana, as does an unexpected foe. The tables turn for Fymryn, and Davion takes on a trying test.

episodes.name: Hell of Hells
episodes.overview: A new moon rises. Mirana and her warriors enter Foulfell, an insidious realm where fresh hells — and regrets — await. Can Terrorblade be vanquished?

episodes.name: This Stranger's Life
episodes.overview: Another day dawns — and a world begins. In the hinterlands, a threat spreads, spurring Mirana and Luna to investigate. The Oracle holds the key.

episodes.name: The Hanged Man
episodes.overview: In a quest to find Slyrak, Mirana taps a familiar Dragon Knight. Filomena faces her struggling goddess — and father — as the moon threatens all life.

episodes.name: Summons of the Ideal
episodes.overview: Mirana encounters a surprising opponent while Filomena embarks on a desperate attempt to get answers via Mene's memories. A sleeping giant awakens.

episodes.name: Twelve Thousand, Four Hundred and Three
episodes.overview: In a hard homecoming, Mirana returns to an uncle's maneuvers and a father's wisdom. Filomena uncovers the awful facts. Davion rekindles a partnership.

episodes.name: Lunartropism
episodes.overview: Undeterred, Filomena hunts for hope as a changed Davion reaches out to Mirana. But now a brutal battle promises to shatter everything for the heroes.

episodes.name: Consider Phlebas
episodes.overview: Does creation require destruction — and painful sacrifices? Filomena and Davion square off against the Invoker. The truth remains the final weapon.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When a grim incident occurs at their prestigious school, justice through law is put to a test by a tough law professor and his ambitious students.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: During a mock trial at school, a student makes a shocking discovery. Yang Jong-hoon, a former prosecutor-turned-professor, examines the crime scene.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: As evidence piles up against Jong-hoon, he's interrogated by the police. On an exam, Han Joon-hwi's past trouble with the school is used as a prompt.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: With Joon-hwi now a suspect in the murder case, authorities call for a second autopsy. A sudden attack places Jong-hoon's life in danger.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Back in the classroom, Jong-hoon poses his own ongoing case as an assignment topic. Facing charges from Jong-hoon, Prosecutor Jin Hyeong-u retaliates.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: A student's plagiarism case seems tied to key evidence that could exonerate Jong-hoon. Kang Sol A sympathizes with a client at the legal clinic.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Ahead of his first trial, Jong-hoon finds out Kang Sol B's secret. Joon-hwi watches over Sol A as she deals with her family's unsettling neighbor.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Sol A is stunned when Jong-hoon receives a call from someone she never expected. Back in court on the stand, Seo Ji-ho shares a tragic story.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Prosecutor Jin claims to have a witness who saw Jong-hoon commit the murder. A scared and threatened Jeon Ye-seul grapples with a difficult decision.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Ye-seul struggles to find a lawyer. Kim Eun-suk banks on one of her students to own up to his actions and provide the testimony Jong-hoon needs.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Joon-hwi tracks down important evidence, but it may still not be enough to acquit Jong-hoon. The students help Ye-seul build a case for self-defense.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: As the students get busy with training opportunities, Joon-hwi begins working under Prosecutor Jin. Jurors are selected for Ye-seul's trial.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: After an unexpected court appearance threatens to turn the tide of Ye-seul's trial, Jong-hoon uses classroom methods to help her speak her truth.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: A new arrest is made for the murder of Seo Byung-ju, but Jong-hoon has unanswered questions. The jury reaches a verdict for Ye-seul.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Speculations arise about Lee Man-ho's motives. Jong-hoon and the students suspect Byung-ju wasn't alone in his car during the hit-and-run.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Sol A grapples with financial woes and Kang Dan's sudden appearance. Malicious comments flood the students' video of accusations against Ko Hyeong-su.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: As the case's loose ends tie up, the question becomes whether the law can truly serve justice. Sol A, Sol B and Joon-hwi prepare for a competition.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A spy, an assassin and a telepath come together to pose as a family, each for their own reasons, while hiding their true identities from each other.

episodes.name: OPERATION STRIX
episodes.overview: Twilight is an agent that works for WISE, Westalis's intelligence agency, and he is tasked with investigating Desmond, who is in Ostania and planning to start a war. Twilight disguises himself as the psychiatrist Loid Forger and adopts a girl named Anya so th…

episodes.name: SECURE A WIFE
episodes.overview: Civil servant Yor Briar has a secret identity: an assassin named the Thorn Princess. Lately, single women had been suspected of being spies, which was making Yor nervous. Meanwhile, Loid was searching for someone to play Anya's mother so they could attend the…

episodes.name: PREPARE FOR THE INTERVIEW
episodes.overview: Yor moves in with Loid and Anya. Now that they are a family, they need to prepare for the interview. But Loid realizes with how Anya and Yor currently are, the interview probably won't go well. In order to make sure they all understand how an upper-class fami…

episodes.name: THE PRESTIGIOUS SCHOOL'S INTERVIEW
episodes.overview: The day they had been preparing for has finally arrived! The Forgers are fully prepared and head to the interview. As soon as they enter the school grounds, Loid feels someone watching them. All of the applicants were being observed from the shadows by the in…

episodes.name: WILL THEY PASS OR FAIL?
episodes.overview: The day that Eden College would announce the applicants that successfully got into the school had finally arrived, but Anya's number is not listed. The Forgers fall into the depths of despair but are greeted by Henderson. He praises them for their interview a…

episodes.name: THE FRIENDSHIP SCHEME
episodes.overview: Anya's uniform is finished. Loid has to go to a WISE strategy meeting, so he has Yor pick up the uniform as he heads to the safehouse. At the meeting, he finds out that Anya will have to receive 8 Stellar Stars and become an Imperial Scholar at Eden College i…

episodes.name: THE TARGET'S SECOND SON
episodes.overview: Anya ends up with a Tonitrus Bolt after she hit Damian Desmond. Sadly, this causes her to stand out for the wrong reasons in class which depresses her, but she ends up friends with Becky, and school becomes a little more fun. She also tries to apologize to Da…

episodes.name: THE COUNTER-SECRET POLICE COVER OPERATION
episodes.overview: Ostania's counterintelligence agency and national security bureau conducts spy hunts and keeps surveillance on its citizens to maintain peace within the country. They are also called the Secret Police and are feared. Yor's younger brother Yuri actually belong…

episodes.name: SHOW OFF HOW IN LOVE YOU ARE
episodes.overview: In order to prove to Yuri that they are actually a married couple, Loid and Yor are supposed to kiss. Loid is willing to get this done immediately for the sake of Operation Strix, but Yor can't do this sober, so she ends up downing a bunch of wine and gets dr…

episodes.name: THE GREAT DODGEBALL PLAN
episodes.overview: A rumor spreads amongst the first graders at Eden College saying that if they do well in their next PE class, they will get rewarded with Stella Stars. Anya is determined to get a Stella Star, so she trains with Yor. Thus begins the dodgeball match between Ce…

episodes.name: STELLA
episodes.overview: In order for parents to attend one of the social gatherings at Eden College, their children need to be Imperial Scholars, but Anya hating to study makes this rather difficult. Loid then comes up with a plan to get Anya to get Stella Stars by doing community s…

episodes.name: PENGUIN PARK
episodes.overview: Loid is burdened with one mission after another from WISE and comes home exhausted. He then hears neighbors gossiping that he's neglecting his family. Because he can't let anyone doubt them as a family for the sake of Operation Strix, he decides to take his f…

episodes.name: PROJECT APPLE
episodes.overview: The Forgers go look for a dog for Anya's reward for getting a Stella. In the middle of their outing, Loid ends up having to work a mission to stop a terrorist bombing attack planned against Westalis's foreign minister. Meanwhile, Anya is trying to pick out a…

episodes.name: DISARM THE TIME BOMB
episodes.overview: Anya meets a mysterious dog who can see into the future. They were able to escape from the terrorists with the dog's help, but eventually, they fall back into the hands of the terrorists again. And then Yor shows up and attacks the enemy! Soon after, the dog…

episodes.name: A NEW FAMILY MEMBER
episodes.overview: Loid faces off with one of the enemy's bomb dogs, Anya secretly saves Loid, and Yor finds the leader of the terrorists who had been on the run. The whole family ends up involved in this terrorist bombing incident, but what will be its conclusion?! Also, they…

episodes.name: YOR'S KITCHEN / THE INFORMANT'S GREAT ROMANCE PLAN
episodes.overview: Why has Yor been coming home late every night, her hands covered in cuts? Why has Franky asked Loid to meet him under mysterious and urgent circumstances? These are two tales of misadventure while seeking happiness in Berlint.

episodes.name: CARRY OUT THE GRIFFIN PLAN / FULLMETAL LADY / OMELET RICE♥
episodes.overview: Anya and the rest of her class have an arts and crafts lesson where Anya is put in the same group as Damian. Sylvia goes about an ordinary work day. We learn the secret source of Yuri's strength.

episodes.name: UNCLE THE PRIVATE TUTOR / DAYBREAK
episodes.overview: Next week is Eden College's midterms. That week happens to include the new moon, the one day of the month Anya can't use her powers to cheat. But then, Yor suggests that Yuri should be her tutor... The midterms are over. Loid is nervous about Anya's test scor…

episodes.name: A REVENGE PLOT AGAINST DESMOND / MAMA BECOMES THE WIND
episodes.overview: Damian does well on his midterms, so he earns a Stella. Everyone around him is now praising him, but for some reason, his classmate George seems to be looking at him begrudgingly. The reason being... After seeing Anya off to school, Yor finds Anya's gym cloth…

episodes.name: INVESTIGATE THE GENERAL HOSPITAL / DECIPHER THE PERPLEXING CODE
episodes.overview: Anya has to write a report about an occupation she's interested in, so she ends up going to Loid's place of work, Berlint General Hospital. As soon as Loid was out of sight, Anya starts to explore! Anya becomes very interested in deciphering codes after seein…

episodes.name: NIGHTFALL / FIRST FIT OF JEALOUSY
episodes.overview: Fiona, who works at Loid's hospital, happens to actually be the female WISE agent Nightfall. She is irritated that Operation Strix is facing delays, so she suggests that she becomes Mrs. Forger instead. She also decides to show up at the Forger household unan…

episodes.name: THE UNDERGROUND TENNIS TOURNAMENT: THE CAMPBELLDON
episodes.overview: The secret files called the Zacharis Dossier may cause a war between the East and the West. In order to obtain a painting that is supposed to be the hiding spot for these files, Loid and Fiona enter an underground tennis tournament run by the owner of the pai…

episodes.name: THE UNWAVERING PATH
episodes.overview: The underground tennis tournament is finally heading to the final match. The Campbell siblings that Loid and Fiona are up against are playing dirty, as they have altered tennis rackets as well as the staff helping them out. But the spy pair from WISE overcome…

episodes.name: THE ROLE OF A MOTHER AND WIFE / SHOPPING WITH FRIENDS
episodes.overview: Yor becomes anxious about their pretend marriage after Fiona shows up. Loid notices this and thinks that Yor had started to develop romantic feelings towards him. For the sake of the mission, he flips on his Twilight mode. Becky takes Anya to the department s…

episodes.name: FIRST CONTACT
episodes.overview: A social gathering happens at Eden College once every half term. It is a strictly guarded event where only Imperial Scholars and their parents, the VIPs of Ostania, are allowed to go. Damian tells his brother that he'd like to see their father when he attends…

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Yor and Loid may be keeping their true identities from each other, but telepathic Anya knows everything. Now, as they set sail on a luxury cruise, Yor must stop a group of assassins from reaching their target—while Loid struggles with a different mission alto…

episodes.name: FOLLOW MAMA AND PAPA
episodes.overview: Yor is shot in the butt while on a mission and looks miserable when she gets home. Loid mistakes her very apparent miserable mood as her being unhappy with their marriage of convenience and offers to take her out on a date.

episodes.name: BOND'S STRATEGY TO STAY ALIVE / DAMIAN'S FIELD RESEARCH TRIP
episodes.overview: Bond sees an ominous future and believes that it's Yor's food that's going to cause it. In order to change this fate, Bond leaves the house to search for Loid! Henderson orders Damian, Emil, and Ewen to go on a field research trip with Mr. Green.

episodes.name: MISSION AND FAMILY / THE ELEGANT BONDMAN / THE HEART OF A CHILD / WAKING UP
episodes.overview: Yuri is doing great at his job with the Secret Police. His assignment today is to investigate a former newspaper reporter suspected of selling articles slandering Ostania to Westalis. Anya's favorite cartoon hero Bondman shows off his elegant spy moves!!

episodes.name: THE PASTRY OF KNOWLEDGE / THE INFORMANT'S GREAT ROMANCE PLAN II
episodes.overview: Eden's legendary dessert finally appears! In order to obtain the macaroons that supposedly can make you into an Imperial Scholar if eaten, Anya and her friends race to get to them first.

episodes.name: PLAN TO CROSS THE BORDER
episodes.overview: On a mission as Thorn Princess and using her job as city hall as a cover, Yor is tasked with protecting the only survivors of the Gretcher family, Olka and her son, and helping them escape to a different country by traveling on a cruise ship.

episodes.name: THE FEARSOME LUXURY CRUISE SHIP
episodes.overview: After boarding the cruise ship, Yor began her duty as bodyguard to Olka and her son. Meanwhile, Yor's superior, Matthew, finds an assassin who is after Olka and her son.

episodes.name: WHO IS THIS MISSION FOR?
episodes.overview: Loid tries to pick out souvenirs that will make him look like a fun and happy dad so he can cheer Anya up. Meanwhile, Yor was facing off with Sickle-and-Chain Barnaby.

episodes.name: THE SYMPHONY UPON THE SHIP
episodes.overview: The deck is filled with passengers enjoying the fireworks show. Anya and Loid were also enjoying the fireworks. Meanwhile, Yor's mission finally reaches its climax. She tries to help Olka and the others escape, but they are surrounded by assassins!

episodes.name: THE HAND THAT CONNECTS TO THE FUTURE
episodes.overview: Due to the movements the State Security Service members were making, Loid finds out that there was a bomb on the ship. Loid leaves Anya at the daycare in a hurry then disguises himself as a State Security Service member to take care of the bomb.

episodes.name: ENJOY THE RESORT TO THE FULLEST / BRAGGING ABOUT VACATION
episodes.overview: The morning after the attack from the assassins and the bomb scare, the cruise ship arrives at the resort island. Loid and Anya meet up with Yor and the three enjoy a family vacation!

episodes.name: BERLINT IN LOVE / NIGHTFALL'S DAILY LIFE
episodes.overview: Becky is very excited about a romantic drama on TV, so she heads over to the Forgers' place to see Loid, who she fell in love with instantly after seeing his picture. Becky aggressively pursues Loid.

episodes.name: PART OF THE FAMILY
episodes.overview: As Bond is on a walk with Loid, he has a premonition of an accident, so he tries to stop it, but is scolded by Loid. He then sees a vision of a building going up in flames and a sobbing girl standing in front of it.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The cold war between Ostania and Westalis continues with a terrible strawberry shortage. Fiona Frost, AKA Nightfall, tries to solve the crisis before it becomes too much. Perhaps, the bigger question is whether or not the entire Forger family can thwart an en…

episodes.name: Berlint Panic | The Informant and Nightfall
episodes.overview: The Forgers enjoy a day off while Nightfall hires Franky to help her on a mission.

episodes.name: Avoid Getting Tonitrus Bolts | ■■■■'s Memories I
episodes.overview: Anya's class must avoid getting Tonitrus Bolts and we get a glimpse into someone's past.

episodes.name: ■■■■'s Memories II
episodes.overview: Loid recalls what happened in the past that led him to where he is today.

episodes.name: Behind the Scandal | The Path to an Imperial Scholar
episodes.overview: WISE agents protect an opera singer and Henderson gives Anya tips on becoming an Imperial Scholar.

episodes.name: The Mommy-Friends Scheme
episodes.overview: Yor goes out shopping and happens to save someone quite unexpected.

episodes.name: White Jealousy | The Eden College Busjacking Incident
episodes.overview: A doctor's jealousy gets Loid into some trouble at the hospital and Anya's class goes on a field trip.

episodes.name: The Red Circus
episodes.overview: A bus carrying Anya's class is busjacked by some terrorists.

episodes.name: Take Down the Busjacker
episodes.overview: Henderson gets on the bus to give the children food and water. Billy remembers his purpose in life.

episodes.name: Anya's Era Has Come
episodes.overview: Anya, Becky, Damian, and Bill are given Stella Stars for their quick thinking during the busjacking.

episodes.name: Austin's Troubles | A Normal Mixer | Moon Landing
episodes.overview: Mr. Austin is having nightmares after the busjacking incident and Yor goes out with her coworkers.

episodes.name: Extreme Level 3 Situation
episodes.overview: Twilight and Yuri get an emergency summons from their respective agencies.

episodes.name: Battle to the Death in the Sewers
episodes.overview: The WISE agents and the State Security Service agents clash in the sewers.

episodes.name: A World Where We Cannot Survive
episodes.overview: The battle in the sewers reaches its conclusion and Loid tries to remedy his relationship with Yor.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A boy raised by a demon, Akuma Kun works with his half-human partner Mephisto III as paranormal investigators to solve various murder and mysteries.

episodes.name: Demons
episodes.overview: A university student asks Akuma Kun to investigate the strange deaths of two of her friends, who both died on the same exact date and time.

episodes.name: Gluttony
episodes.overview: Hina looks after Ichika, but danger still lurks nearby. Akuma Kun further investigates the case by making another visit to the Asanagi house.

episodes.name: Greed
episodes.overview: Akuma Kun and Mephisto III get invited to the home of a very wealthy client, who has a disturbing request — to summon Satan for his flesh.

episodes.name: Envy
episodes.overview: A famous movie director in his twilight years asks Akuma Kun and Mephisto III to find a long-lost, cursed film made by his dear friend.

episodes.name: Angel
episodes.overview: At his wit's end, a landlord breaks into the apartment of a tenant who stopped paying rent — and discovers a gruesome, seemingly impossible murder.

episodes.name: Love and Hate
episodes.overview: After arriving in Easter Island to investigate a strange red nail, Akuma Kun and Mephisto III discover the body of a murdered young woman.

episodes.name: Human
episodes.overview: After years of hard work, a long-time legislator is on the verge of becoming a Cabinet minister. But then, a threatening man pays him a visit.

episodes.name: True Intentions
episodes.overview: A little boy goes into the Millenarianism Research Institute saying he wants to become a demon, but Akuma Kun immediately throws him out.

episodes.name: Father
episodes.overview: On a dark and stormy night, a ghastly looking man comes looking for Sanae. He turns out to be her husband, who's been missing for five years.

episodes.name: Celebration
episodes.overview: While trying out the pancakes at a new neighborhood restaurant, Mephisto III and Akuma Kun remember the day they first met.

episodes.name: Play
episodes.overview: When Shingo — aka the first Akuma Kun — is sealed away, the father and son Mephistos set out to rescue him, while Akuma Kun takes a different approach.

episodes.name: Sacrifice
episodes.overview: Akuma Kun, Gremory and Mephisto III enter the barrier to save Shingo. But first, they'll have to confront Strophaia, an old enemy from Ichiro's past.

episodes.name: Do You... Believe in Magic?
episodes.overview: Yoon Ah-yi’s silent scream for help is answered by Ri-eul, who appears before her during a time of need and makes her wonder: is he really a magician?

episodes.name: Don’t Let Me Dream Any Longer
episodes.overview: Set on exposing Ri-eul's secrets, Baek Ha-na enters the theme park with a camera and captures Ah-yi inside. Na Il-deung asks Ah-yi on a study date.

episodes.name: Merry-Go-Round
episodes.overview: Il-deung and Ah-yi make a deal to try to make each other's lives easier. Suspicious about Ri-eul, Il-deung secretly follows Ah-yi to her magic lessons.

episodes.name: Becoming an Adult
episodes.overview: Il-deung begins questioning his path. Ha-na discovers shocking footage in the hidden camera from Ri-eul's room. Ah-yi finds comfort from the future.

episodes.name: Curse of Asphalt
episodes.overview: Ha-na infuriates Ri-eul by snooping for evidence in his room. The police ask Ah-yi questions about a caped person of interest.

episodes.name: The Last Performance
episodes.overview: Through a longtime friend, Ah-yi and Il-deung learn of Ryu Min-hyuk's pained past. The magician disappears from the interrogation room.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Richter Belmont joins forces with Maria and an unlikely crew of characters whose toughened exteriors bely their various tragic backstories. Bringing their formidable shape-shifting powers to bear, they seek to prevent the seemingly imminent reign of the vampi…

episodes.name: A Common Enemy in Evil
episodes.overview: An attack on their camp spurs vampire hunter Richter and young mage Maria to seek the help of the Abbot of Machecoul. Strangers bring news from abroad.

episodes.name: Horror Beyond Nightmares
episodes.overview: As the threat of a Vampire Messiah looms, Tera's past holds dark omens for the future. Annette, Edouard, Richter and Maria head for the château.

episodes.name: Freedom Was Sweeter
episodes.overview: In shock after a loss, Annette shares the story of her escape from slavery and her journey from Saint-Domingue. Chaos erupts at a public gathering.

episodes.name: Horrors Rising from the Earth
episodes.overview: Olrox voices doubts to Mizrak about the Abbot's alliances. Desperate to help a friend, Annette leads a risky mission over Richter's objections.

episodes.name: The Natural Order
episodes.overview: Drolta makes a persuasive pitch to Olrox, and Annette encounters an old enemy. Revelations shed new light on Maria and Richter's family histories.

episodes.name: Guilty Men to Be Judged
episodes.overview: While Richter learns about the Belmont legacy, Annette searches for the wisdom of her own ancestors. Edouard attempts to get through to a comrade.

episodes.name: Blood Is the Only Way
episodes.overview: Emboldened by her victories, the Vampire Messiah steps into the spotlight. Richter flexes new abilities. Olrox makes a surprising proposal.

episodes.name: Devourer of Light
episodes.overview: With the Abbot poised to make an unthinkable sacrifice and Erzsebet's plans already in motion, Richter and his allies hurl themselves into battle.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Aided by the legendary Alucard, Richter and his band of vampire hunters must race to stop powerful Erzsebet from plunging the world into eternal night.

episodes.name: A Living Legend
episodes.overview: Alucard seeks help from Richter and his friends in the wake of a devastating loss. Elsewhere, Erzsebet makes plans to conquer Paris.

episodes.name: Angel of Death
episodes.overview: Drolta's dark past unfolds as Alucard, Annette and Richter set out in search of Sekhmet's missing soul. Maria encounters her mother in her new form.

episodes.name: The Widow's Window
episodes.overview: As Maria's magic intensifies, Mizrak urges the Abbot to repent and reverse his loyalties. Alucard's party arrives in Paris at the height of revolution.

episodes.name: Monstrous Things
episodes.overview: Annette, Richter and Alucard seek Sekhmet's mummy at the Louvre, where spirits seem to be lighting the way. Juste intervenes in a deadly confrontation.

episodes.name: Into the Abyss
episodes.overview: Maria confronts her dark side as Annette and Richter follow orders to find and destroy the city's undead. Olrox considers his fate in the fight ahead.

episodes.name: Ancestors
episodes.overview: Annette embarks on a perilous journey into the spirit world that sparks a shocking transformation — and sets the stage for an epic showdown.

episodes.name: Grenadye Alaso
episodes.overview: Chaos erupts under a blood-red sky as the battle for Paris begins, with Alucard's allies on one side and Erzsebet's army on the other.

episodes.name: A Line of Great Heroes
episodes.overview: With the future at stake, Richter and friends join forces against a terrifying new evil that puts their powers — and the Belmont legacy — to the test.

episodes.name: It's just, I wish I could speak.
episodes.overview: It's Tadano's first day of high school and all he wants to do is blend into the background. He starts to get to know Komi, a quiet girl in his class.

episodes.name: It's just a childhood friend. Plus more.
episodes.overview: To help Komi make more friends, Tadano tries to enlist the help of a talkative classmate who's friends with everyone, but they promptly turn him down.

episodes.name: It's just stage fright. Plus more.
episodes.overview: A nervous girl named Himiko Agari's anxiety levels go through the roof when Komi starts silently staring at her in a very intense way.

episodes.name: It's just a physical. Plus more.
episodes.overview: During the school health checkup, competitive classmate Yadano is determined to clock better results than Komi, whom she sees as her ultimate rival.

episodes.name: It's just my summer uniform. Plus more.
episodes.overview: Komi wonders why everyone starts staring at her when, like the rest of the student body, she switches from her winter to her summer school uniform.

episodes.name: It's just a joke. Plus more.
episodes.overview: When Tadano gets to school, he finds Komi waiting for him in the classroom. She then nervously hands him a letter.

episodes.name: It's just the pool. Plus more.
episodes.overview: Komi spends a lot of time getting ready for her trip to the local pool with Tadano and Najimi. Once they're there, they bump into even more friends.

episodes.name: It's just Obon. Plus more.
episodes.overview: It's the Obon holidays, and Komi is visiting her grandma's house. She can't help but feel a little awkward around her extended family.

episodes.name: It's just a country kid. Plus more.
episodes.overview: It's the first day of the new semester and everyone is happy to see Komi again, but then a student named Inaka starts to follow her around.

episodes.name: It's just sports day. Plus more.
episodes.overview: On the school sports day, Komi isn't sure how to properly cheer for her classmates, but she does her best. Then, it's her turn to run the relay race.

episodes.name: It's just a performance for the culture festival. Plus more.
episodes.overview: The students of class 1-1 have to decide what they're going to do for the culture festival — a task they're all taking way too seriously.

episodes.name: It's just the culture festival.
episodes.overview: At the culture festival, Najimi is up to something. They try to rope Komi and Tadano into their scheme.

episodes.name: It's just the arrival of winter. Plus more.
episodes.overview: On one cold morning, Komi wraps a scarf around her neck to keep warm, but as soon as she gets to school, Najimi plays a trick on her!

episodes.name: It's just a typhoon. Plus more.
episodes.overview: Komi gets all dressed and ready for school, but when she opens the front door, she's greeted by a typhoon. She decides to stay home and wait it out.

episodes.name: It's just a feeling. Plus more.
episodes.overview: Hoping to understand their classmate Komi more so they can be friends with her, Nakanaka and Yamai decide to talk to Tadano.

episodes.name: It's just a merry Christmas.
episodes.overview: It's Christmas Eve, and Komi has nothing planned. But then Najimi informs her that they're going to have a Christmas party — at Komi's house.

episodes.name: It's just a snowman. Plus more.
episodes.overview: Komi wakes up to find that it snowed overnight. With Tadano and Najimi, she goes out into the fresh snow to start building a snowman.

episodes.name: It's just everyone's New Years. Plus more.
episodes.overview: On January 2, Najimi calls up all their friends and hears about all the different ways they welcomed in the new year.

episodes.name: It's just a misunderstanding. Plus more.
episodes.overview: Komi decides to write a letter to Najimi to clear up a misunderstanding, but she might be too nervous to give it to them.

episodes.name: It's just the school field trip.
episodes.overview: Komi's class departs for their school trip. Her classmates Kato and Sasaki are determined to make it as enjoyable as possible for Komi.

episodes.name: It's just day 2 of the field trip.
episodes.overview: On the second day of their school trip, Komi joins Ayami Sasaki and Mikuni Kato on a meticulously planned trip all over the Kansai area.

episodes.name: It's just Valentine's Day.
episodes.overview: Nene Onemine invites Komi over to her house to bake a chocolate cake. Soon enough, Nene's rowdy younger siblings join in.

episodes.name: It's just ripped tights. Plus more.
episodes.overview: During class one day, Ren Yamai notices that Komi's tights have a hole in them. Luckily, Ren has a spare pair to lend her.

episodes.name: It's just White Day. Plus more.
episodes.overview: White Day is coming up, and Tadano wants to give something to Komi in return for the chocolate she gave him on Valentine's Day.

episodes.name: Rainy Days Bring Out The Mad People
episodes.overview: On a rainy day, Lee Min-kyung and Noh Hwi-oh experience a series of increasingly unpleasant encounters, unaware they live next door to each other.

episodes.name: People Who Make You Angry
episodes.overview: At the police station, Min-kyung and Hwi-oh go at each other's throats. Later, Hwi-oh is advised to stay away from people who trigger his anger.

episodes.name: Help Me
episodes.overview: Bumping into an old coworker dredges up painful memories for Min-kyung. With a flasher on the loose, Hwi-oh is roped into patrolling the neighborhood.

episodes.name: There Are No Bad Dogs
episodes.overview: Min-kyung is determined to find her missing dog. Getting wind of drug dealing activity on a chatting app, Hwi-oh sets out on an undercover mission.

episodes.name: A Big Barking Dog That Doesn't Bite Women
episodes.overview: The flasher resurfaces, this time in front of Min-kyung, but thankfully Hwi-oh is close by. The next day, she asks him for a favor.

episodes.name: Run Away
episodes.overview: Hwi-oh trains Min-kyung in the basics of self-defense. But soon, Min-kyung's anxiety returns in full force with the arrival of a sudden piece of mail.

episodes.name: The Bolt Opens
episodes.overview: A sudden incident in the night scares Min-kyung, who feels vulnerable living alone. Hwi-oh's mother discovers a woman in her son's apartment.

episodes.name: Maybe We're The Only Okay Ones
episodes.overview: Min-kyung exchanges harsh words with her mother. She's further shaken by the identity of a prospective tenant who comes by to see her apartment.

episodes.name: To Have An Ally
episodes.overview: Malicious rumors about Min-kyung spread online. While other neighbors turn against her, Hwi-oh promises she can always count on him to take her side.

episodes.name: From Today We Are
episodes.overview: As a show of repentance, the Women's Association sets out to help Min-kyung. After a night of drinking, Min-kyung tells Hwi-oh she wishes to see him.

episodes.name: Clear After Rain
episodes.overview: After receiving good news at the psychiatrist's office, Hwi-oh heads to the police station. At the apartment, Min-kyung panics when her dog gets loose.

episodes.name: Love That Didn't Hurt Too Much
episodes.overview: Hwi-oh's fury takes over when Min-kyung's ex-boyfriend shows up at the apartment. Lee Su-hyeon finds out that a video of her singing has gone viral.

episodes.name: Goodbye & Hello
episodes.overview: Resolving to protect Hwi-oh, Min-kyung meets the one person she wanted to avoid. Concerned for her safety, Hwi-oh chases after her.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A city kid is brought to the countryside by his father's new coaching gig: reviving a ragtag middle school badminton team on the brink of extinction.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Yoon Hae-kang is less than enthused when he's forced to pack up and follow his family to a countryside village, home to a once-esteemed badminton team.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Hearing about a legendary coach nicknamed the "White Wolf" piques Yoon Hyeon-jong's curiosity. Hae-kang stands up for his teammate against a bully.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: In New Zealand for a championship, Han Se-yoon silently grapples with pressure and expectations. Hae-kang confronts his mother about her absence.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Hyeon-jong agrees to an unusual request from a student's father. On the morning of a tournament, plans go awry for Hyeon-jong and the boys.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Before another important match, Se-yoon finds a cure for her headaches. Meanwhile, Hae-kang and Bang Yoon-dam go head-to-head in a battle of egos.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The boys ditch training day, but find themselves in a bind when they lose all their money. Hyeon-jong drops in on an old teammate.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: When Lee Han-sol is harassed during a competition, Yoon-dam loses his cool. Se-yoon enters a singles match as the clear favorite to win.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: With direction from Jeong In-sol, Na Woo-chan identifies his greatest weakness on the court. Hae-kang suffers a sprain at the worst possible moment.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: At national team training, Hae-kang grows anxious over a rival's interest in Se-yoon. The village head calls a meeting for a brainstorming session.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Hyeon-jong is troubled to realize he's never asked Hae-kang about his own goals and dreams. The boys are introduced to a new side of their director.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: As the city couple makes themselves useful around the village, they find new meaning in life. Hyeon-jong investigates rumors about the White Wolf.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: The upcoming national championships give rise to new tensions within the boys' team. The disturbing truth about an abusive coach is finally revealed.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Hae-kang and Se-yoon each receive a coveted proposal to play in Seoul. Director Bae Jeong-hoon announces disappointing news to the boys.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Se-yoon's absence at Nationals places the girls' team on edge. As Han-sol takes her shot at a miracle, Ra Yeong-ja realizes where she went wrong.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: The boys struggle with nerves in their singles matches, the villagers consider an enticing offer and Kang Tae-seon prepares for his comeback.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Down to their final games and with much on the line, Hae-kang, Woo-chan and Se-yoon give it their all despite the odds being stacked against them.

episodes.name: There’s No Such Thing as Fate. Nevertheless,
episodes.overview: Days after a heart-fluttering encounter with a charming man, Yu Na-bi bumps into him again. This time, she's formally introduced to Park Jae-eon.

episodes.name: It's Not Only Me. Nevertheless,
episodes.overview: As Na-bi wonders whether Jae-eon only acts friendly toward her or also to other girls, she has a racy dream about the two of them in bed.

episodes.name: It Has Already Begun. Nevertheless,
episodes.overview: A cold, some jealousy and a slight misunderstanding drive Na-bi and Jae-eon further apart before bringing them closer than ever before.

episodes.name: I Know It Isn't Love. Nevertheless,
episodes.overview: Na-bi's attraction to Jae-eon is enough to momentarily quiet her concerns about their intimate relationship — until a rude awakening sets in.

episodes.name: I Know Nothing Will Change. Nevertheless,
episodes.overview: Sick of Jae-eon's ways, Na-bi ends things with him. Oh Bit-na makes a drunken confession. Yun Seol-a approaches Na-bi on campus.

episodes.name: There's No Such Thing as Love. Nevertheless,
episodes.overview: Na-bi visits her hometown, where she helps out in her aunt's studio and enjoys the outdoors with Yang Do-hyeok. Jae-eon feels Na-bi's absence.

episodes.name: I Know There's No Turning Back. Nevertheless,
episodes.overview: The students arrive at the guesthouse for a group retreat. Na-bi tries to keep a distance from Jae-eon, who keeps his eye on her and Do-hyeok.

episodes.name: I Know It's a Lie. Nevertheless,
episodes.overview: Do-hyeok surprises his childhood crush with a sweet confession. Na-bi visits a gallery with Jae-eon. Yun Sol gets honest about her feelings for Seo Ji-wan.

episodes.name: I Know It's Over. Nevertheless,
episodes.overview: Afraid to lose Na-bi, Do-hyeok shows up in front of her building — only to see Jae-eon by her side. Sol allays Ji-wan's fears about their relationship.

episodes.name: Nevertheless, I Still…
episodes.overview: Na-bi scrambles to recreate her sculpture days before the exhibit. Staying true to his word, Jae-eon bids farewell to his butterflies.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Branded an enemy of the state, a cyborg supersoldier struggles to find a cause worth fighting for in a dystopian society where nothing is what it seems.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Renegade officer Dolph Laserhawk and his partner Alex activate their plan to steal an invaluable gadget and leave the oppression of Eden behind forever.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: On a mission to secure a smuggled high-tech tool, the Warden's crew of Ghosts infiltrates the unsavory underworld ruled by mob boss Pagan Min.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: A new assignment puts Dolph and Alex on a collision course as the Ghosts try to prevent anti-hybrid resentment from boiling over into deadly carnage.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: After a sudden change of scenery, the Warden opens up to Dolph about her history, her family and the dark reality that powers Eden's systems.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Dolph hits the beach while a disillusioned Rayman sets out to learn the truth. Marcus weighs whether to give an old enemy a second chance.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: As the clock ticks down to Bullfrog's execution, Dolph and Marcus race against time and a crippling virus. Rayman makes a plan; Sarah makes an offer.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Two young boxers band together with a benevolent moneylender to take down a ruthless loan shark who preys on the financially desperate.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After a thrilling boxing match, Kim Gun-woo befriends Hong Woo-jin. Kim Myeong-gil's business ambitions come into focus, with dangerous tactics at play.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Gun-woo meets with Choi Tae-ho to remedy his mother's debt. Myeong-gil endures a humiliating meeting with Hong Min-beom and grows revengeful.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Gun-woo and Woo-jin figure out how to take down the scam ring. Myeong-gil gains the upper hand on Min-beom.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: After the group faces a close call, President Choi plans his own operation. But as their plans fall into place, the enemies stand in their way.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: After narrowly escaping a threat, the group trains for what's coming — and President Choi and his men look to extract valuable information.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The group celebrates as they get ready for their next move. More exposed than ever before, Myeong-gil goes after President Choi and his guards.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: After an unthinkable setback, Gun-woo and Woo-jin resolve to come back with a vengeance — later partnering with an unlikely figure.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Galvanized by their duty to their loved ones, Gun-woo and Woo-jin tread forward to take down Myeong-gil — once and for all.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Going up against a formidable champion, Kim Gun-woo prepares for an upcoming fight. But in the shadows, the brutal Im Baek-jeong hunts him.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Gun-woo puts his mother’s safety first. Hong Woo-jin turns to an old friend for help. But Baek-jeong's men soon catch up after tailing their every move.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Gun-woo discovers just how sophisticated IKFC is — and that he could potentially get pulled in. Meanwhile, Baek-jeong finds another target to lure him.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Tension rises after Baek-jeong puts Gun-woo’s close ally at risk. As Baek-jeong’s group comes to light, Min Gang-yong plans a mission to hunt him down.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Backed into a corner, Gun-woo decides to face Baek-jeong himself. But things take a turn — further fueling Baek-jeong’s rage to new heights.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Gun-woo and Woo-jin zero in on what makes Baek-jeong vulnerable. Gang-yong makes a final move to capture Baek-jeong, but the task is full of danger.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Hong Min-beom devises a plan to end the madness for good — pitting Gun-woo and Woo-jin in a final fight against formidable foes for lasting peace.

episodes.name: The Night Before Festival of Colors
episodes.overview: During a stage show on the eve of Holi, Bheem and Kalia give the townspeople a little extra drama as they battle over a flute.

episodes.name: Bheem’s White Shirt
episodes.overview: Bheem loves his clean white kurta. But how will he keep it spotless when his friends arrive to splash him with Holi colors?

episodes.name: A Royal Festival of Colors
episodes.overview: Holi's here! And as the village celebrates, Bheem and Kalia must face the naughty twins, who are armed with a smelly concoction!

episodes.name: Electro Boy
episodes.overview: A regular kid named Johnny Bolt suddenly finds that he can control electricity. Soon enough, he starts testing the limits of his newfound powers.

episodes.name: Kasey
episodes.overview: As soon as he's released from prison, Johnny meets up with his old supervillain friends, who try to pull him into a very intriguing gem heist.

episodes.name: Man Mountain
episodes.overview: Things don't go as planned with the heist, and Johnny and the crew end up getting chased by cops and superheroes through the streets of San Francisco.

episodes.name: The Praetorian
episodes.overview: Johnny and his friends are confronted by Praetorian, a superhero who relishes using his seemingly endless abilities to punish them.

episodes.name: The Heat
episodes.overview: In Chicago, Carmine introduces Johnny and Kasey to the other supervillains. They've all been chosen for their specific powers and their nameless status.

episodes.name: The Gladiator
episodes.overview: Carmine and his crew steal a plane and fly off to rescue TK, who's on a heavily guarded aircraft protected by Gladiator.

episodes.name: The Supermax
episodes.overview: While waiting for the final member of their crew to show up, Carmine shares his plan with everyone else and gives them one last chance to drop out.

episodes.name: The Union of Justice
episodes.overview: The night before hitting the Union of Justice headquarters, Johnny and Kasey have an early celebration and vow to walk away from crime after this heist.

episodes.name: Count Orlok
episodes.overview: While confronting their old friend Praetorian, Carmine and the crew realize they've made a major miscalculation and have to think on their feet.

episodes.name: Carmine
episodes.overview: Johnny's old supervillain buddies take him out for a celebration and as usual, try to pull him into one last harebrained job.

episodes.name: Casino Grand Granite
episodes.overview: To save Carmine, Johnny tries to get the crew back together for another heist he's planned using information he gathered while serving time in supermax.

episodes.name: The Bastard
episodes.overview: Kasey and Roddy disguise themselves as professors for a meeting with Christopher Matts while Carmine, Johnny, TK and Josh case the casino.

episodes.name: SUPER CROOKS
episodes.overview: Christopher Matts sends Praetorian to stop Johnny and his crew — but this time, the supervillains have Gladiator on their side.

episodes.name: I'm Finally Back From the Fantasy World of Granbahamal After 17 Long Years!
episodes.overview: Takafumi’s uncle wakes up from a 17-year coma, claiming he was in another dimension, and he tries to prove it by showing off his magical powers.

episodes.name: "Guardian Heroes" Shoulda Been Number One!
episodes.overview: Takafumi surprises his uncle with an early birthday present. As the new year begins, Takafumi bumps into a childhood friend.

episodes.name: I'm Your Un—...Aunt, Dear
episodes.overview: While Takafumi and his uncle strategize on how to increase their YouTube subscriber count, Fujimiya is worried about the well-being of her crush.

episodes.name: You Helped Me Through Tough Times
episodes.overview: Fujimiya tries to catch Takafumi’s attention. Takafumi’s uncle shares a seemingly romantic memory he experienced during his time in the other dimension.

episodes.name: That Reminds Me, I Almost Got Assassinated Once
episodes.overview: Takafumi’s uncle has a flashback to the time he narrowly escaped an assassination attempt — and his story keeps getting grimmer.

episodes.name: So They Threw Me Into the Basement of a Freak Show...
episodes.overview: Even Takafumi’s uncle has memories he’d rather forget. But he also remembers a rare heroic moment he experienced in the other dimension.

episodes.name: As You Can See, Sega Games Are Very Helpful in Life!
episodes.overview: Takafumi’s uncle recalls the time he almost made friends in the other dimension. Meanwhile, Fujimiya heads to her college campus to meet someone.

episodes.name: I Got Through It by Transforming Into the Most Powerful Being I Know
episodes.overview: Takafumi’s uncle continues his story about his search to find the Shining Crusader, revealing a thoughtful side to him — almost like a real hero.

episodes.name: The Ice Spirit Demands a Price for Its Cooler Magic
episodes.overview: Stuck in an apartment without air conditioning in record breaking heat, Takafumi’s uncle negotiates with the Ice Spirits for help.

episodes.name: Civility Only Comes After You're Seen as a Person
episodes.overview: Worried that Fujimiya is hanging out with the wrong crowd, her friend from college comes to visit her at Takafumi’s apartment.

episodes.name: N-no, I Wasn't Looking at Anything Dirty...
episodes.overview: Unable to wield his powers, Takafumi’s uncle finds himself helpless against magic-sealing birds. Later, he has a heart to heart with Alicia.

episodes.name: Names Are Important, That's What (He/She) Said
episodes.overview: Takafumi’s uncle reminisces about the time he was tasked with hunting down a mysterious singing demon. Meanwhile, he longs to find his way home.

episodes.name: It's Thanks to All of You
episodes.overview: Up against the legendary venom dragon, Takafumi’s uncle and his cohorts feel hopeless — until Elf comes up with an ingenious plan. Let the battle begin!

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After crash-landing at different locations, the Autobots and the Decepticons encounter the planet's denizens and are shocked to learn who they are.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Megatron acquires an advantage in locating the Allspark. The Maximals mount a rescue attempt when the Predacons capture one of their teammates.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: As the Autobots and the Decepticons close in on it, the Allspark launches a defense system that alters perception and disrupts all functionality.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Megatron's continued use of the Golden Disk to guide his actions threatens to derail Optimus Prime's attempt to obtain the Allspark.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: The Autobots and the Maximals attempt to launch the Ark to return to Cybertron. They meet heavy resistance — until something extraordinary occurs.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The past, present and future collide on Cybertron as the final showdown for the Allspark begins with some unexpected participants.

episodes.name: The Moment I Met You Everywhere
episodes.overview: Things look bleak for Yoon Hye-jin after she quits her job. On a trip to Gongjin, she runs into a series of unfortunate events — and one unusual local.

episodes.name: The Moment Your Sincerity Took a Step Forward
episodes.overview: Hye-jin gets ready to welcome patients. But when a mishap at a party lands her in the town's bad graces, she needs guidance from Hong Du-sik.

episodes.name: The Moment Your Heart Smiled at Me
episodes.overview: A long drive to Seoul with Du-sik and other uninvited passengers tests Hye-jin's patience. Despite pain in her teeth, Kim Gam-ri refuses treatment.

episodes.name: The Moment Your Temperature Melted My Heart
episodes.overview: When a patient causes a disturbance at the office, Du-sik comes to the rescue. Elsewhere, Chang Yeong-guk learns that his first love is back in town.

episodes.name: The Moment Your Feelings Floated on the Waves
episodes.overview: Hye-jin is seen leaving Du-sik's home one morning. While she tries to recall what happened the night before, the town's gossip mill goes into overdrive.

episodes.name: The Moment Your Gaze Goes Beyond Friendship
episodes.overview: Hye-jin resolves to stop getting involved with Du-sik. Oh Ju-ri enters a singing competition in an attempt to win money to fix her snaggletooth.

episodes.name: The Moment Your Loneliness Leaned on Me
episodes.overview: Preparing to film his TV show in Gongjin, Ji Seong-hyeon has the perfect guide and house in mind — but getting them takes extra convincing.

episodes.name: The Moment Your Existence Erases the Darkness
episodes.overview: Du-sik catches a nasty cold. Hye-jin notices a troubling trend among her patients. A kidnapper on the loose puts the town on high alert.

episodes.name: Your Seat, the Moment You Draw Your Daily Life
episodes.overview: Du-sik puts on a show pretending to be Hye-jin's boyfriend in front of her visiting parents. Seong-hyeon makes a good impression on her father.

episodes.name: The Moment Your Love Reaches 'Us'
episodes.overview: Following an intruder attack in her home, a shaken Hye-jin leans on Du-sik. She's left more conflicted than ever after Seong-hyeon asks to talk.

episodes.name: The Moment When Your Excitement Becomes My Happiness
episodes.overview: Before Hye-jin makes things official with Du-sik, there's something she needs to do first. Attempts to keep their relationship a secret backfire on them.

episodes.name: The Moment Your Wish Dreams of 'Together'
episodes.overview: Hye-jin compiles a long bucket list of activities she wants to experience with Du-sik. Pyo Mi-seon and Choi Eun-cheol finally arrive on the same page.

episodes.name: Your Today Is the Moment You Wish for Tomorrow
episodes.overview: As Du-sik continues to keep his past shrouded in mystery, Hye-jin grows frustrated. Ham Yun-gyeong is struck by an emergency during a typhoon.

episodes.name: The Moment Your Promise Bring Up Courage
episodes.overview: Hye-jin and Du-sik take some time apart. Yu Cho-hui urges Yeong-guk to have courage about his feelings. Seong-hyeon and his team wrap up filming.

episodes.name: The Moment Your Sadness Greets Spring
episodes.overview: With his secrets out in the open, Du-sik must find a way to move on from the tragedies of his past. Hye-jin considers an enticing job offer.

episodes.name: The Moment Our Lives Dance With Everyone
episodes.overview: The town gathers to bid goodbye to a loved one. Hye-jin plans an unforgettable event for Du-sik, but it turns out he had the same idea.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Set in the Joseon Dynasty, at that time, twins were considered an omninous sign for the royals. As a result, when the crown princess gives birth to twins, an order is sent to kill the daughter among twins. To save that daugther's life, crown princess secretly…

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Years after the crown princess delivers forbidden twins, Yi Hwi meets a court maid who looks exactly like him, to his amazement and his mother’s horror.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Dam-i tearfully bears the weight of the crown in guise of her brother. Jung Ji-un races against time to find a herbal remedy for a peeved patient.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Hwi spares Ji-un his life thinking they won't ever cross paths again. Later, she's startled to see him lurking inside the palace walls.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Ji-un proves to be a formidable opponent for Hwi, who's determined to make her newest royal tutor resign. Yi Hyun takes Hwi out on the town.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Ji-un's good-hearted attempt to make his pupil warm up to people in the palace goes awry. Prince Changun tests Hwi with an intoxicating surprise.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: A familiar book on the crown prince's desk baffles Ji-un. Running out of time and the means to save his friends, he asks Hwi for help.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Hwi earns a chance to gain the king's trust during the Ming envoys' visit, but an ill-tempered guest tests the limits of her patience.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Ji-un comforts a tearful Hwi in his arms. Hyun and Ji-un team up to figure out the envoy's secret after a suspicious man visits his quarters.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: The queen dowager tells the crown prince to wed. As Ji-un recalls previous night's events, he realizes the reason behind his rollercoaster of emotions.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: After a joyous day together, Hwi gives Ji-un her answer. Shin So-eun and No Ha-gyeong visit the palace as candidates to become the next crown princess.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Hyun visits Ji-un at his new clinic. A furious Hwi holds Prince Changun accountable for his wrongdoing, and faces staggering backlash as a result.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: The king is asked to answer to overwhelming appeals for the crown prince's removal. Reentering the palace, Ji-un promises to protect Hwi no matter what.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Hwi carefully reveals her secret to Ji-un. Lord Sangheon unleashes his royal ambitions and makes way for the future king.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Hwi and Ha-gyeong spend their first night together. Reinstated into a palace operating around Lord Sangheon, Ji-un lies low to serve the wounded king.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Moving in silence, Hwi strategizes retaliation against her grandfather. Kim Ga-on reappears in front of the king with a startling confession.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Yoon Hyeong-seol sets out to find the damning ledger and keep his promise to the king. Prince Wonsan puts two and two together about Hwi's identity.

episodes.name: Episode 17
episodes.overview: Rumors about Hwi and Ji-un's close relationship circulate amongst the palace staff. To protect his son, Jung Seok-jo takes matters into his own hands.

episodes.name: Episode 18
episodes.overview: Hyun and Lord Sangheon learn of Prince Wonsan's secret ploy to dethrone the king. Hwi prepares to take down her grandfather — alone.

episodes.name: Episode 19
episodes.overview: Prince Wonsan ruthlessly proves his ambitions — and worthiness — for kingship to Lord Sangheon. Hwi prepares to abdicate the throne.

episodes.name: Episode 20
episodes.overview: Returning to the palace with a vengeance and an army, Lord Sangheon and Prince Wonsan spare no one in their bloody path to the crown.

episodes.name: The World's Strongest Senior
episodes.overview: The world is shaken by news of a man taking down a monstrous elephant with his bare hands. Back in Japan, Baki is confronted by a knife-wielding child.

episodes.name: Mixed species' martial arts
episodes.overview: To train for his eventual battle against his father, Baki spars against an imaginary giant praying mantis he’s created in his mind.

episodes.name: Prison and Hell
episodes.overview: In the middle of a heavily guarded parade, the President of the United States is kidnapped in plain sight by an unknown young man.

episodes.name: The Second
episodes.overview: Baki comes across a man known as “Mr. Second,” a powerful inmate who seems to enjoy special privileges within the prison.

episodes.name: Terrible Triplets
episodes.overview: With just a few weeks left on his sentence, Iron Michael is attacked by triplet hit men hired to make sure the ex-boxing champ never fights again.

episodes.name: Man of the Sea
episodes.overview: Just as the Mouth triplets are about to finish their attack on Iron Michael, Guevaru rolls in and instigates a fight.

episodes.name: Hyper male and Hyper male
episodes.overview: Guevaru refuses to believe that Biscuit Oliva, the most notorious inmate in the prison, is comfortably serving his sentence in the company of his lover.

episodes.name: Gilberto Style
episodes.overview: The match between Guevaru and Oliva begins, and the rules are simple: They both hold onto the same piece of cloth and the first one to let go loses.

episodes.name: Decision Time
episodes.overview: Guevaru is fighting for the people of his impoverished homeland, and he won’t go down so easily. Later, Oliva makes a discovery.

episodes.name: Can't you laugh?
episodes.overview: Baki is surrounded by guards with their guns pointed right at him, but he doesn’t seem worried at all — he seems to be planning something.

episodes.name: The Prison Guard talks about it
episodes.overview: Oliva inadvertently kicks off a major incident when he enters Baki’s solitary confinement cell to challenge him to a fight in two weeks' time.

episodes.name: Beyond the Brawn
episodes.overview: Baki learns the hard way that he might not be ready to fight the man known as “Mr. Unchained” — Oliva’s power and technique are on another level.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Scientists discover a perfectly preserved prehistoric man so powerful, he once preyed on Jurassic dinosaurs — and Baki can’t wait to fight him.

episodes.name: New History of Mankind
episodes.overview: Captain Strydum pays Baki a visit and gives him some shocking news; scientists have discovered a human preserved in a salt slab from the Jurassic era.

episodes.name: Completely Surrounded
episodes.overview: Soon after the prehistoric human arrives in Tokyo, the fiercest underground fighters in the country attempt to take him on.

episodes.name: Nature Power VS Battle Power
episodes.overview: Pickle, who's used to devouring dinosaurs, struggles to find anything to eat in modern day Japan. Hoping to fight him, Retsu offers himself up as prey.

episodes.name: Pickle's Tears
episodes.overview: After Retsu gives him a taste of highly evolved martial arts moves that have been passed on for thousands of years, Pickle suddenly begins to weep.

episodes.name: Just Want to See You
episodes.overview: On the streets of Shinjuku, Pickle tussles with the legendary street-fighter Kaoru Hanayama, a modern day human with the power of a Jurassic dinosaur.

episodes.name: Beyond the Sound Barrier
episodes.overview: Katsumi Orochi has never been able to gain the respect of his peers, but the time may have finally come for him to bring his skills to the next level.

episodes.name: Moment of the Heat
episodes.overview: The moment comes when Pickle recognizes Katsumi as his prey; Katsumi responds by quickly unleashing his new and improved Mach Fist move.

episodes.name: Praying Savage
episodes.overview: As riveted spectators look on, Katsumi Orochi sacrifices everything to his supersonic attacks, and yet Pickle continues to get back on his feet.

episodes.name: Devouring Each Other
episodes.overview: It's a past-versus-present battle when Pickle, a powerful prehistoric human, fights a man who has ingested the most advanced performance enhancing drugs.

episodes.name: Food Reserve
episodes.overview: Baki enters Pickle’s enclosure and settles in; breathing the same air, eating the same flesh and living as the prehistoric man does.

episodes.name: The Weak Eats the Mighty
episodes.overview: The full effects of the 30 foot fall continue to crush Baki. Even Pickle looks disturbed by the sight of his opponent.

episodes.name: Final Form
episodes.overview: Baki goes on the offensive, visualizing three different dinosaurs at once as he clobbers Pickle, who responds with an unexpected move of his own.

episodes.name: Unwritten Rule of the Fight
episodes.overview: Having recognized that the man he's now facing is stronger than any opponent he's ever faced, Pickle morphs into his true, all-powerful form.

episodes.name: Dying for Love
episodes.overview: Life returns to normal for Baki — but not for long. After bumping into his mother's old colleague, Baki recalls his parents' tumultuous relationship.

episodes.name: Feeling the Beginning
episodes.overview: Strydum readies himself to fight Yujiro Hanma. Then Mitsunari Tokunaga talks to the Prime Minister about the upcoming battle between Yujiro and Baki.

episodes.name: New Horizon
episodes.overview: Though training as a boxer, Retsu has no intention of changing his Kenpo fighting style. Then, boxing champ Akio Mani challenges him to a sparring match.

episodes.name: Legendary Promoter
episodes.overview: Legendary boxing promoter Kaiser arrives in Japan and walks into the gym where Retsu is training. Impressed, Kaiser makes him an offer.

episodes.name: Turning the Table
episodes.overview: Retsu's first boxing match in America is announced, and it's against former world champion Andrei Valev. Meanwhile, Baki gets a premonition.

episodes.name: God of Boxing
episodes.overview: For some reason, Chiharu Shiba keeps trying to fight Baki. Meanwhile, Retsu gets ready to face the battle-hardened boxer, Smoking Joe.

episodes.name: Their Own Way
episodes.overview: Despite getting clobbered, Chiharu Shiba never gives up — and Baki wants to copy his relentless style. A series of hard knocks leaves Retsu reeling.

episodes.name: Father & Son Dining
episodes.overview: Baki cooks some food and sets his table; and sure enough, his father arrives and sits down. But this isn’t going to be a normal family meal.

episodes.name: The Biggest Father-Son Fight in History
episodes.overview: Their nice meal at a fancy hotel turns violent when Baki asks Yujiro a personal question, setting off a sky high scuffle for the ages.

episodes.name: Urban Legend
episodes.overview: Baki counters his father's attacks by visualizing a cockroach. Meanwhile, word of the epic battle starts to spread and a huge crowd begins to gather.

episodes.name: Tears Swelling
episodes.overview: As a growing crowd looks on, the father-son battle continues. Baki puts his father on the offensive with a triceratops attack.

episodes.name: Son, Father and…
episodes.overview: Using an ancient battlefield move, Baki is finally able to subdue Yujiro in what should be an inescapable move. But then, Baki notices his father's hand.

episodes.name: Dress
episodes.overview: Yujiro uses his secret, highly effective "dress" move, grabbing Baki and spinning him around with such speed, his son begins to lose consciousness.

episodes.name: Taste of Dad
episodes.overview: Their battle has exceeded all expectations; and now, the family feud between the most powerful being in the world and his son reaches its conclusion.

episodes.name: Revelations Part 1
