episodes.overview: In this in-depth look at part one of “Revelation,” the star-studded voice cast shares experiences recording for their iconic characters.

episodes.name: Revelations Part 2
episodes.overview: Tiffany Smith hosts as executive producer Rob David and showrunner Kevin Smith discuss thoughts, reactions and insider details with the cast.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The dreams of two young people are crushed by an overwhelming financial crisis in the 1990s. But when they reunite at the ages of 25 and 21, the spirited pair finds friendship and affection in times of adversity as they venture into adulthood together.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: When the IMF financial crisis threatens to slash Na Hee-do's dreams, she sets out to get herself transferred to another school with a fencing program.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Though taken aback by Ko Yu-rim's cold attitude, Hee-do gives it her best in their first face-off. More of Back Yi-jin's situation comes into focus.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: When a fortuitous opportunity presents itself, Hee-do begs her coach for extra training. An unanticipated visitor comes around hoping to see Yi-jin.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: In exchange for a favor, Hee-do carries out a daily errand for Moon Ji-woong. She happens across a drunk Yi-jin after he fails another job interview.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Hee-do takes one giant leap closer to her dream. She's eager to tell Yi-jin the good news — but realizes he's disappeared without a trace.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Tensions run high between Hee-do and Yu-rim before an important event. Yi-jin takes on a new assignment, and spots a familiar face in the crowd.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: A frustrating media narrative dampens a monumental moment for Hee-do. Yi-jin chases down the only person who may be able to set things right.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Hee-do perceives a growing distance between herself and Yi-jin, even as he moves back into the neighborhood. Trouble at home adds to Yu-rim's stress.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: As Yu-rim's perspective on Hee-do shifts, so does her behavior. While Hee-do avoids seeing Yi-jin, he volunteers for a special documentary project.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Under the guise of work, Yi-jin takes Hee-do and Yu-rim on a weekend getaway to the ocean — and agrees to let Ji Seung-wan and Ji-woong tag along.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Hee-do grows upset when her career-obsessed mother fails to keep a promise. Yi-jin helps out Ji-woong's plans for a grand gesture at a music festival.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Unable to hold back from putting an end to a teacher's abusive behavior, Seung-wan stands her ground. Hee-do and Yu-rim support a distraught teammate.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Warnings about allowing his personal ties to affect his work weigh heavily on Yi-jin. The school fencing team enters their last competition together.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Shouldering the burdens of a sudden misfortune in her family, Yu-rim arrives at a decision that places her in hot water with the public.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Hee-do once again finds herself opposite her most formidable opponent. Yi-jin is busier than ever after transferring to another department.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: In an emotionally charged exchange, Hee-do and Yi-jin confront the state of their relationship. Hee-do accidentally leaves her diary on a bus.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After losing hope of gaining tenure, a desperate Park Dong-ha acts quickly when he comes across a van containing two dead bodies and a bag of cash.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Ma Kwang-chul moves into the neighborhood, with Kwang Joo-hyun soon following suit. Dong-ha searches online for tips on how to launder money.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Kwang-chul uncovers useful information on what went down with the money launderer. Dong-ha calls the police with an anonymous tip about his neighbor.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Dong-ha sets out for Busan to make his first delivery. Kang Eun-ju searches the streets for her daughter, who refuses to come home.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Park Yeon-woo stirs up trouble for herself and her father after he discovers the hidden bag and takes off with a chunk of the loot.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Eun-ju trails after Dong-ha as he heads to a spa. Striking out on his own, Kwang-chul fights for a chance to work for the head cartel.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Kwang-chul drops by to give Tonh-soo a promised heads-up. Park Deuk-soo makes himself at home while stealthily looking for clues.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Dong-ha and a partner are tasked with transporting the cash. Choi-Kang-jun offers to free Dong-ha from the money and Kwang-chul in one fell swoop.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Fearing for his life, Yong-soo goes into hiding. Joo-hyn makes Kang-jun an offer in exchange for the identity of the mole.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Dong-ha returns home to find the police digging around. Kwang-chul sends the head cartel a bloody message. Joo-hyun takes matters into her own hands.

episodes.name: A Murdered Mother
episodes.overview: When a stabbing incident kills a mother and leaves her son gravely injured, Bengaluru police trace the steps and the motives of their unusual suspect.

episodes.name: Body In a Bag
episodes.overview: A murdered body is found in a sack, but without clear evidence implicating the initial suspects, police seek smaller clues in hopes for a breakthrough.

episodes.name: Dying For Protection
episodes.overview: As sub-inspector Latha Mahesh handles her first murder investigation, findings lead her to reexamine attitudes towards sex workers and their safety.

episodes.name: The Stolen Baby
episodes.overview: Four teams are sent to track down a man alleged to have taken a baby girl from her family, but the suspect may have an unexpected accomplice.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Suicide, murder... or something else? This docuseries examines chilling truths and theories around the deaths of 11 members of a Delhi family.

episodes.name: 11 Bodies
episodes.overview: News of 11 family members found dead in their home sparks a local and national frenzy. Perplexed investigators grapple with more questions than answers.

episodes.name: 11 Diaries
episodes.overview: Media pressure and rumors swirl around the incident. Inside the house, 11 diaries are discovered that reveal harrowing but crucial information.

episodes.name: Beyond 11
episodes.overview: A deeper dive into the family’s history unearths telling details and dark secrets. In the incident's aftermath, larger sociological concerns emerge.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Han Ji-yul’s stay in Huidong starts off on the wrong foot when he gets mistaken for a thief while trying to enter his grandfather’s home.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: The townsfolk meet Ji-yul with much enthusiasm and interest, including An Ja-yeong — who seems to be present wherever he goes.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: After a frustrating incident at the police station, Ji-yul coldly distances himself from Ja-yeong — a choice he will soon regret.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Ji-yul warms up to Ja-yeong and helps her care for a rescue dog. Meanwhile, the growing closeness between the two makes Lee Sang-hyeon uneasy.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Sang-hyeon clears the air with Ja-yeong after the awkward encounter the night before. He then warns Ji-yul to back off.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Ja-yeong attends a town meeting and gets caught in the cross hairs of an ongoing feud. Ji-yul looks for a solution to an old man’s heartbreaking request.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Ji-yul tiptoes around Ja-yeong, not knowing how to break the ice after the shocking revelation. Meanwhile, a heartbroken boy comes to him for advice.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: After getting a chance to hang out and unwind on a spontaneous work trip, Ji-yul and Ja-yeong come home to find unexpected visitors from Seoul.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Ja-yeong drifts further away from Ji-yul after her new housemate asks for her help to win back an ex-boyfriend.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Ji-yul finds that he's running out of time as he grows more certain of his feelings for Ja-yeoung. Sang-hyeon gets his long-awaited response.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Ji-yul gives Ja-yeong a tour of his clinic in Seoul as they continue to sneak around town on secret dates.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: When work delays the much-anticipated night out with Ji-yul, Ja-yeong plucks up the courage to make a special announcement to the entire neighborhood.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: A strange four-year-old boy named Kotaro moves into Shimizu Apartment all on his own. He doesn't seem to have any parents or family around.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Karino figures out why Kotaro talks the way he does: he's copying Tonosaman, his favorite cartoon character from a show that's about to end.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: When he sees someone handing out free balloons, Kotaro tries to collect as many as he can. But there's a reason he wants so many balloons.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Kotaro's friend Kakeru has a maid who takes care of everything for him, so Kotaro decides to show Kakeru how to do things for himself.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: For some reason, Kotaro is very particular about his tissues. He wants expensive, soft ones because they're "sweet." Later, Karino figures out why.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: A man named Aota moves into the building for a month. When he asks Kotaro to be his friend, Karino gets suspicious — and a little jealous.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: A girl named Kana starts coming over to Kotaro's house to play everyday after kindergarten, but she never seems to have fun.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Karino brings Kotaro and all his friends to the movies. Kotaro wants to see the new Tonosaman film, but the other kids want to watch something else.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Whenever Kotaro goes to see the neighborhood dentist, Dr. Ohba always takes the time to talk to him and ask him lots of questions.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: One day, a woman Kotaro doesn't recognize comes to pick him up from kindergarten. She says she's Karino's ex-girlfriend.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Oh In-joo turns to a work friend for help when an incident with her mother leaves her cash-strapped. Oh In-kyung digs into a four-year-old case.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: After discovering Jin Hwa-young’s surprising secret, In-joo comes to suspect a finance director to be the culprit of the murderous scheme.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: In-kyung causes a scene at a party celebrating Park Hyo-rin’s win in a contest. In-joo heads to a mental hospital to deliver an orchid and seek advice.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: In a secret garden, Won Sang-a commissions Oh In-hye to draw a portrait of her. In-joo and In-kyung debate over the fate of the found money.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: In-joo and In-kyung start new jobs and dig deeper into unanswered questions. Sang-a takes a sudden trip, inciting a surprising reaction.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: In-joo and In-hye debate what to do with a shocking piece of evidence. In-kyung contends with fallout from a media firestorm.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Reeling from recent events, the sisters must look further into the past in hopes of finding the truth. In-kyung unlocks a secret. In-joo hatches a plan.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: In-joo travels abroad and receives an unexpected welcome, leading to more questions. In-hye and Hyo-rin attempt to help Sang-a, who's in isolation.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: In-joo is in grave danger following an encounter with a mysterious visitor abroad. In-kyung offers to make a deal to save her older sister.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Park Jae-sang faces a threat. With some help, In-hye and Hyo-rin set out to start fresh. In-kyung finds her own way of shining light on the truth.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Jae-sang makes a drastic move. In the aftermath, the sisters face the wrath of familiar adversaries, newly emboldened with great power.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: During one sister's hearing, a bombshell courtroom appearance causes a stir. Emotions run high as lingering questions are finally answered.

seasons.name: Part 1
seasons.overview: A powerful sorceress in a blind woman's body encounters a man from a prestigious family, who wants her help to change his destiny.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Naksu casts one last spell to save her soul. Jang Uk looks for the only sorcerer who would dare to help him. Mu-deok gets taken under a new master.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: When Mu-deok refuses Uk's proposal to form an alliance, he convinces her in other ways. Park Jin barricades Songrim to catch a spy.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Mu-deok sets the terms before beginning proper training. Uk discovers that Heo Yeom left him with a gift he must learn to claim as his own.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Uk suffers a fever and chills, much to Mu-deok's delight. The Crown Prince visits the Jang household, demanding a family heirloom and a show of respect.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Mu-deok and Uk arrive at a secluded, empty cabin. Jin Mu orders a body dump. Jin Ho-gyeong offers protection for Uk... at a cost.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Seo Yul and Park Dang-gu visit Uk at his training ground. Mu-deok pushes her student to the extreme. Jin Cho-yeon prepares a wedding gift.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: The Prince encounters an illusion. Uk demands entry into Jinyowon. Gil-ju goes after Naksu to acquire a body.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Gil-ju stumbles into town to satisfy his hunger. Uk follows closely behind him. Rumors surface of Naksu’s comeback.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Jin Ho-gyeong looks for her long-lost child. Jin Mu devises a plan to help end that search. Uk and Mu-deok are driven apart.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Uk is given a book to read. Yul saves a girl at the market. Mu-deok goes through an intensive selection process to become a servant at Songrim.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Uk loses the will to train. Mu-deok makes a bet with the Prince. At Cheonbugwan, a line of blind girls await judgment.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: An unusual death draws Park Jin’s attention. Uk learns of Naksu’s tragic past. Maid Kim sends Mu-deok on an errand to Cheonbugwan.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: A sudden lightning strike causes damage to Cheonbugwan. Park Jin and Jin Mu dispute who's to blame. Master Lee takes Uk on a special fishing trip.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Uk faces his tenth and final opponent with a trick or two up his sleeve. Seo Yul keeps Mu-deok close. Jin U-tak plays a trick on his daughter.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Mu-deok is caught at the site of a bloody murder. Master Lee presents the royal family with a gift and a prophecy. So-i tracks down a blind friend.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Park Jin and Jin Ho-gyeong get into a heated dispute as they both lay claim to an artifact. Uk runs into the Prince while on the search for a shaman.

episodes.name: Episode 17
episodes.overview: Mu-deok investigates Jin Bu-yeon’s true identity. Jin Mu convinces Jin Ho-gyeong to make a special announcement at an important assembly.

episodes.name: Episode 18
episodes.overview: Trapped inside an enchanted force field, Mu-deok explores her newfound powers but soon learns of its drawbacks. So-i makes a deal with a soul shifter.

episodes.name: Episode 19
episodes.overview: Uk comes up with a solution to break the force field that would require him to risk it all. Dang-gu and Cho-yeon make a startling discovery.

episodes.name: Episode 20
episodes.overview: Love is in the air with a wedding on the way and Uk playing matchmaker. Jin Mu appoints an assassin to do his dirty work and become his scapegoat.

seasons.name: Part 2
seasons.overview: Jang Uk, now a fierce but troubled hunter of the soul shifters, meets an imprisoned young woman who seeks his help to reclaim her freedom.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: A search leads Uk into Jinyowon, where he runs into a mysterious woman who is planning an escape. Meanwhile, haunting visions of the dead trouble him.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Jin Ho-gyeong makes a family secret public. Jin Bu-yeon finds new shelter but realizes that her freedom is limited and time is running out.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: A debate surrounding a secret wedding ends with a shocking announcement. Jin Ho-gyeong tries to summon Bu-yeon back by causing her excruciating pain.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Flashes of another's memory leads Bu-yeon to find out more about Uk's past heartbreak. News of a feared assassin's return shakes the whole kingdom.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Yul uncovers the mystery of his ill health as So-i becomes desperate to save him. Uk and Bu-yeon continue to hit barriers in their relationship.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: While Yul bears the burden of a heavy secret, Uk investigates a conspiracy involving a mysterious animal that could cause a devastating drought.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: To save a fatally injured mage, Uk gives Jin Mu a firm warning and asks Jin Ho-gyeong for help, who agrees to cooperate under one condition.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Go Won presents Uk with a choice. Jin Mu sets the next step of his plan in motion. Heo Yun-ok requests to meet Bu-yeon in private.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: As the search for the ice stone continues, Uk reaffirms his alliances while Jin Mu prepares for battle with an army of loyal soul shifters.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Jin Ho-gyeong takes a risk to protect Jinyowon and its treasures from attack. Having had a glimpse into the future, Uk braces for the inevitable.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: 1945, Gyeongseong South Korea. Jang Tae-sang is a rich man. He is known as the most attractive man around Bukchon in Gyeongseong. He is also a reliable source for information in the area. His talents, including the ability to respond quickly to situations, ke…

episodes.name: Najin
episodes.overview: Facing financial ruin, Jang Tae-sang agrees to track down a missing person — but two figures trail him. Meanwhile, sinister operations occur underground.

episodes.name: Mother
episodes.overview: Yoon Chae-ok and Yoon Jung-won find a lead on Myeong-ja, leading them to a hospital. Soon, a calamity traps the two inside, leaving Tae-sang concerned.

episodes.name: Signal
episodes.overview: Tae-sang decides to reenter the hospital, but discovers that Ryu Sachimoto is nearby. At the hospital, Chae-ok and Jung-won devise a risky rescue plan.

episodes.name: Imprinting
episodes.overview: Reunited in their search for Myeong-ja, Tae-sang and Chae-ok attempt to also save other survivors. But soon, the monster makes itself known.

episodes.name: Desperation
episodes.overview: After coming face to face with the creature, Tae-sang and Chae-ok get captured. But as one plans his escape, the other stays to find a person dear to her.

episodes.name: Chaos
episodes.overview: Tae-sang steadfastly remains to save Chae-ok and the captives. On a mission to find her mother, Chae-ok learns the grisly truth — and confronts the beast.

episodes.name: Chase
episodes.overview: With only 10 minutes to act, Tae-sang and Chae-ok risk it all to get everyone to safety. But just as all goes to plan, one of them may not get out alive.

episodes.name: Awakening
episodes.overview: An unlikely acquaintance becomes Tae-sang's ticket out of the hospital. After a touching reunion, Tae-sang and Chae-ok encounter a transformed Myeong-ja.

episodes.name: Atrocity
episodes.overview: After a series of grisly deaths, Ishikawa finds Myeong-ja in her new state. Tae-sang shares a tender moment with Chae-ok, unaware of her hidden plan.

episodes.name: Tear
episodes.overview: In order to rescue Chae-ok and stop the atrocity, Tae-sang and Jung-won forge a plan. But just as the coast seems clear, Yukiko Maeda stands in the way.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In 2024 Seoul, fate-bound ties to Gyeongseong unravel when Chae-ok meets Ho-jae, a man with an uncanny resemblance to Tae-sang. What will destiny reveal?

episodes.name: Ho-jae
episodes.overview: On a mission to clear his name, Jang Ho-jae searches for a mysterious woman. On the job, Chae-ok encounters a familiar person from decades ago.

episodes.name: Sign
episodes.overview: While looking for the same person, Ho-jae ends up saving Chae-ok, who's being chased by a mysterious being. Ho-jae begins to wonder more about his past.

episodes.name: Pieces of Memories
episodes.overview: Chae-ok agrees to work with Ho-jae to find Seung-jo, but they soon find themselves in peril. Meanwhile, Chae-ok's monstrous instincts begin to surface.

episodes.name: The Other Side
episodes.overview: Ho-jae tries to piece together everything that has been hidden from him. Chae-ok discovers that the atrocities of the past continue to the present day.

episodes.name: The Creature
episodes.overview: In his effort to save Chae-ok, Ho-jae makes a momentous decision. Having sustained severe injuries, they must battle through a treacherous escape.

episodes.name: Bait
episodes.overview: After a test subject wreaks havoc in public, Jeonseung Biotech goes into damage control. Fate drives Ho-jae and Chae-ok to confront the company head-on.

episodes.name: Marginal Man
episodes.overview: As Ho-jae's enemy threatens to hurt those closest to him, he risks everything to protect them. Will he survive the ferocious beasts and save Chae-ok?

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After being rejected from every law firm he applied to, Do Bae-man receives an offer he can't refuse. Cha Wu-in starts work at a new job.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: A celebrity goes missing. No Tae-nam puts Bae-man's abilities to the test. Wu-in hands over key evidence to Han Se-na.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: No Hwa-yeong gets promoted. Bae-man assigns himself a final case before departing from active duty. Wu-in meets an old friend.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Bae-man recovers a repressed memory. Tae-nam gets taken into custody. Yong Mun-gu gives him a way out.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Wu-in proposes an alliance. Bae-man meets his first client as a big-firm lawyer. Tae-nam's case goes to court.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Tae-nam suffers the aftermath of the trial. Hwa-yeong gets Bae-man to prove his worth, while Wu-in questions his loyalty.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Wu-in drives a wedge between Hwa-yeong and Lee Jae-shik. Bae-man has a word with Ahn Su-ho. There is an attack at a book-signing event.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Wu-in reassesses Won Gi-chun's case. Bae-man goes after a medical officer. Kim Han-yong speaks out. Su-ho keeps his enemy close.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Mun-gu tells Hwa-yeong to watch out for Wu-in. Bae-man calls a press conference. Won Gi-chun threatens a witness.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Bae-man and Wu-in get a hold of Gi-chun's journals and set their next target. A scandal shakes up Kang's Solution.

episodes.name: Epsiode 11
episodes.overview: Bae-man and Wu-in learn of the secrets that were buried when their parents were killed. Abuse allegations are raised against Hong Mu-seop.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Sergeant Shin bares all about the treatment he's endured. Bae-man goes to court expecting a bumpy ride ahead. Tae-nam finds out that he's been played.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Mun-gu looks for Ha-jun's hard drive. Hwa-yeong rewrites the narrative of Mu-seop's case. Bae-man receives a tip about the secret society's X-files.

episodes.name: Epsiode 14
episodes.overview: Hwa-yeong silences her son. Wu-in tries to get Pyeon Sang-ho to talk. Mun-gu secures a deal with the Department of Defense.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Tae-nam learns of the lengths his mother will go to protect herself. Wu-in tries to get Yang Jong-suk to turn. Hwa-yeong orders a hit.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Mun-gu goes on the lam. Bae-man gets his hands on incriminating evidence. Hwa-yeong and the Patriotic Society face judgment.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Romance is sweet and bitter — and life riddled with ups and downs — in multiple stories about people who live and work on bustling Jeju Island.

episodes.name: Han-su and Eun-hui 1
episodes.overview: Choi Han-su, who's fallen on hard times, decides to leave the city and return to his hometown. Soon, he bumps into his old classmate Jung Eun-hui.

episodes.name: Han-su and Eun-hui 2
episodes.overview: The class reunion ends with a tiff. Eun-hui considers a startling suggestion from Han-su, unaware that not everything with him is all it seems.

episodes.name: Han-su and Eun-hui 3
episodes.overview: When Eun-hui leaves on an overnight getaway with Han-su, her concerned friends discover the secrets he's been keeping from them all.

episodes.name: Yeong-ok and Jeong-jun 1
episodes.overview: When Park Jeong-jun chases off her annoying admirer, Lee Yeong-ok asks him to go for a walk. At work, the other divers disapprove of her methods.

episodes.name: Yeong-ju and Hyeon
episodes.overview: Bang Yeong-ju plans to graduate high school and leave the island behind, but an unwanted roadblock threatens everything. Jung Hyeon worries about her.

episodes.name: Dong-seok and Seon-a 1
episodes.overview: At a low place in her life, Min Seon-a finds herself heading to Jeju. Seeing her again brings back aggravating memories for Lee Dong-seok.

episodes.name: In-gwon and Ho-sik 1
episodes.overview: Committed to their decision, Yeong-ju and Hyeon agree to stop hiding their situation. Coming clean to their fathers is the toughest ordeal.

episodes.name: In-gwon and Ho-sik 2
episodes.overview: Bang Ho-sik and Jung In-gwon each vehemently disagree with their children's wishes. An unbudging Yeong-ju leaves home for a motel.

episodes.name: Dong-seok and Seon-a 2
episodes.overview: When Seon-a is nowhere to be seen, Dong-seok leaves to find her. When he does, she offers answers to the questions he always had, but never asked.

episodes.name: Dong-seok and Seon-a 3
episodes.overview: Ahead of an all-important decision that is out of her hands, Seon-a heads back up to Seoul for her son's birthday. Dong-seok accompanies her.

episodes.name: Dong-seok and Seon-a, Yeong-ok and Jeong-jun
episodes.overview: Seon-a shares her next steps with a supportive Dong-seok. Yeong-ok ignores being cast out by the other divers, and enjoys a date with Jeong-jun.

episodes.name: Mi-ran and Eun-hui 1
episodes.overview: Yeong-ok has a close call in the water. Everyone in the village eagerly welcomes back Ko Mi-ran, but Eun-hui seems noticeably on edge.

episodes.name: Mi-ran and Eun-hui 2
episodes.overview: Left alone in Eun-hui's house, Mi-ran cannot resist the urge to read her friend's diaries. Hurtful revelations follow.

episodes.name: Yeong-ok, Jeong-jun, and… 1
episodes.overview: Yeong-ok abruptly pushes Jeong-jun away when her closely guarded secret threatens to make an appearance on the island.

episodes.name: Yeong-ok, Jeong-jun, and… 2
episodes.overview: Jeong-jun sticks by Yeong-ok's side and gets to know her visitor, who has yet to show anyone the drawings in her sketchbooks.

episodes.name: Chun-hui and Eun-gi 1
episodes.overview: Hyeon Chun-hui finds her hands full when her granddaughter is dropped off at her house for two weeks, and wonders if something might be amiss.

episodes.name: Chun-hui and Eun-gi 2
episodes.overview: An overheard conversation leads to heartbreak for Chun-hui. Son Eun-gi tells the villagers about all the wishes she wants to make.

episodes.name: Ok-dong and Dong-seok 1
episodes.overview: Upon hearing major news about his mother, Dong-seok does not know exactly how to feel. He deliberates over a request she's asked of him.

episodes.name: Ok-dong and Dong-seok 2
episodes.overview: Yeong-ok hesitates before meeting Jeong-jun's parents. Dong-seok tells Kang Ok-dong that he will do anything she wants during their trip to Mokpo.

episodes.name: Ok-dong and Dong-seok 3
episodes.overview: Dong-seok and Ok-dong make a series of impromptu detours on their way back home. Their time together allows old wounds to heal.

episodes.name: I Know What You Did Last Summer
episodes.overview: As high schoolers, Kook Yeon-su and Choi Ung give a documentary crew a peek into their lives. Ten years later, they've gone their separate ways.

episodes.name: 1792 Days of Summer
episodes.overview: Yeon-su and Ung reunite for the first time in five years when she shows up at his door with a proposal to work together on an art project.

episodes.name: 10 Things I Hate About You
episodes.overview: Eager to film a follow-up documentary, Kim Ji-ung sets out to persuade Yeon-su and Ung. But getting them to agree proves to be a challenge.

episodes.name: The Boy, or the Girl, We Liked Then
episodes.overview: Yeon-su and Ung's squabbles begin even before the cameras start rolling. Ung refuses to dignify an infuriating plagiarism accusation with a response.

episodes.name: A Secret That Can’t Be Told
episodes.overview: Ji-ung recounts how he and Ung became friends in their childhood. Yeon-su wants to apologize to Ung, but can't quite bring herself to do it.

episodes.name: Pride and Prejudice
episodes.overview: Ung wakes up on the morning of the live drawing show with a few gaps in his memory. Watching him at work, Yeon-su sees an unfamiliar side of him.

episodes.name: Catch Me If You Can
episodes.overview: Ung and Yeon-su attempt to run away from having to see each other, but wind up in the same place anyway. NJ stands up to her cyberbullies.

episodes.name: Before Sunset
episodes.overview: A forced vacation commences for Yeon-su and Ung when the documentary crew traps them at a mountain retreat. Awkward tensions run high between the pair.

episodes.name: Just Friends
episodes.overview: When she doesn't hear from Ung after their return from the retreat, Yeon-su decides to confront him. He has a disorienting response for her.

episodes.name: Hello, My Soul Mate
episodes.overview: With his mother back in town, Ji-ung stops going home so he can avoid seeing her. Watching NJ and Ung go on a date vexes Yeon-su to no end.

episodes.name: Our Nights Are More Beautiful Than Your Days
episodes.overview: Ahead of the final day of filming, gossip about Ung and NJ causes a stir. Ji-ung receives pointed advice about his documentary edit.

episodes.name: Begin Again
episodes.overview: For Ung and Yeon-su, a new beginning is equal parts sweet and clumsy. When NJ bumps into Ji-ung, she invites him out for a drink.

episodes.name: Love Actually
episodes.overview: After soliciting dating advice from a co-worker, Yeon-su acts out of character in front of Ung. Meanwhile, Ji-ung takes some time to himself.

episodes.name: Life Is Beautiful
episodes.overview: Ung asks Yeon-su a question that's difficult for her to answer. As Lee Sol-i deals with an unwanted surprise in her bar, Gu Eun-ho happens to swing by.

episodes.name: Three Idiots
episodes.overview: A noticeably down Ji-ung pours himself into his work instead of going home. Ung waits for Yeon-su to come and see the final night of his art exhibit.

episodes.name: Our Beloved Summer
episodes.overview: Ready to pursue his next dream, Ung sets his sights on studying overseas. When he asks Yeon-su to join him, she has a tough decision to make.

episodes.name: Ticket to Hollywood
episodes.overview: Talent agent Mehershad panics over telling celebrity client Dia Mirza the truth about a coveted film deal. An office visitor catches Monty off guard.

episodes.name: In Loving Memory
episodes.overview: Mehershad and Amal clash as they put nemeses Lillete Dubey and Ila Arun up for the same role. A tragedy puts the agency’s future in question.

episodes.name: Casting Coup
episodes.overview: Mehershad and Monty offer feuding mom and daughter Sarika and Akshara Haasan the same script. Amal makes a bold attempt to distract a tax auditor.

episodes.name: Tax Notice
episodes.overview: Monty pulls strings to get cash-strapped actress Lara Dutta a role, and faces heat from the team when they learn what he’s been keeping from them

episodes.name: Break Up and Make Up
episodes.overview: On location with bickering couple Richa Chadda and Ali Fazal, Amal and Mehershad are in for surprises. Business becomes increasingly personal for Monty.

episodes.name: In the Dog House
episodes.overview: Amal's love life nosedives as she mediates a fallout between director Nandita Das and actor Jackie Shroff. Monty’s past catches up to the firm’s future.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A high school student dreams of becoming an architect. However, she had to drop out of school after suffering from brutal school violence. Years later, the perpetrator gets married and has a kid. Once the kid is in elementary school, the former victim becomes…

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Tormented by her high school classmates and with nowhere to turn for help, Moon Dong-eun sinks into despair before deciding on a new mission in life.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: With Park Yeon-jin's wedding on the way, Dong-eun's revenge rolls out according to plan. Meanwhile, a fateful encounter at a hospital takes place.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: After securing the services of an amateur sleuth, Dong-eun uncovers scandalous secrets that she leverages for the next phase of her scheme.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Already on edge over the past resurfacing, Yeon-jin grows more anxious when she learns about her daughter's new homeroom teacher — and of a sudden death.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: While Ha Do-yeong comes across an intriguing game opponent, Yeon-jin realizes her deepest secrets are at stake when she tries to intimidate Dong-eun.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Son Myeong-o's sudden absence causes tension in the friend group. Dong-eun finds her trust in Kang Hyeon-nam tested.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Dong-eun shares her traumatic past with Joo Yeo-jeong, who has unfinished business of his own. A new plan is put in place for Hyeon-nam's daughter.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Do-yeong meets with Choi Hye-jeong to find out more about his wife — and her past. Yeon-jin digs into Dong-eun's private life.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Questions arise over Myeong-o, Dong-eun gives Yeon-jin a chance to come clean about her past, and the circumstances of Yoon So-hee's death are revealed.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Yeon-jin threatens Hyeon-nam after discovering her involvement with Dong-eun. Yeo-jeong devises a way to get the truth out of Yeon-jin.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Hye-jeong finds an incriminating recording on Myeong-o's tablet, and Hyeon-nam receives an unwelcome visitor as she prepares to send her daughter abroad.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Dong-eun's end game comes into focus as she sends Jae-jun a troubling package and orchestrates a plan to take down Yeon-jin and Lee Sa-ra.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: As Sa-ra and Yeon-jin deal with the aftermath of their crumbling reputations, Dong-eun learns the details behind Yeo-jeong's private struggles.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Yeon-jin and Shin Yeong-jun panic over Myeong-o. Dong-eun takes care of a lingering problem. Yeon-jin's mother schemes to remove a threat.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Do-yeong issues an ultimatum. Dong-eun demands a piece of evidence be handed over. Yeon-jin attempts to do damage control after old videos appear online.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: As the final pieces of Dong-eun's revenge plot slot into place, she considers what comes next — and what it will mean for Yeo-jeong.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Defying his master, Lee Yoon heads to North Gando to search for a man from his past — but danger from all sides proves to test his strength and vigilance.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Nam Hee-shin leaves for the railroad ceremony to take part in a secret plan, but she faces several obstacles as hiccups occur and rivals take notice.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Lee Gwang-il brutally attempts to extract information from an independence fighter. As Yoon approaches Hee-shin, Eon-nyeoni provokes him.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: As news of the railroad funds make the rounds, Yoon and his bandits come up against the Mounted Bandits. Hee-shin plans tricks of her own.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Yoon tracks down the railroad funds and encounters a frenzy. He later accompanies Hee-shin to complete her mission but comes upon another complication.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Choi Choong-soo questions Yoon's motives — realizing the truth may hurt their relationship. Eon-nyeoni gives Choong-soo a stern warning.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Eon-nyeoni hesitates in her mission, getting caught in the process. As forces come together to fight against Gwang-il, Hee-shin and Yoon part ways.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Yoon comes face to face with Gwang-il for a tense duel. Choong-soo and his bandits fight Jang Ki-ryong and his men — all for the safety of their town.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Choong-soo and his bandits face off against the town authorities. Gwang-il, Hee-shin and Yoon all discover the Japanese Army's true plans with Gando.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Choi Jun-woong seeks a job, but it's hard for him to get hired. One night, he witnesses a man trying to end his life and decides to stop him. He gets acquainted with grim reapers Koo Ryeon and Lim Ryung-gu, who belong to a crisis management team. Their purpos…

episodes.name: Fallen Flower 1
episodes.overview: A dizzying world of hard-at-work grim reapers and an extraordinary offer await Choi Jun-woong after a freak accident lands his body in a coma.

episodes.name: Fallen Flower 2
episodes.overview: While trying to help a TV writer tormented by the return of her high school bully, Jun-woong fails to follow Koo Ryeon's orders to rein in his emotions.

episodes.name: Forest of Time 1
episodes.overview: Jun-woong officially joins Ryeon's team. When his best friend needs saving, he travels back in time and gets a glimpse into a tough childhood.

episodes.name: Forest of Time 2 & Tree 1
episodes.overview: The team sets out to convince both father and son, in the past and present, to rethink their decisions. A runaway soul tells Jun-woong her story.

episodes.name: Tree 2
episodes.overview: The runaway soul refuses to move on until her husband stops blaming himself for her death. As other reapers come after her, Ryeon's team holds them off.

episodes.name: A Soul Becomes a Star
episodes.overview: One day before his death, a war veteran rediscovers the meaning of life as he recounts his journey to Ryeon, Jun-woong and Ryung-gu.

episodes.name: A Prison Without Bars
episodes.overview: The next case surfaces at a cosmetics company. When their tech breaks down, the team uses their observation skills to narrow down the at-risk human.

episodes.name: Broker
episodes.overview: Unable to ignore the discovery of an online scammer who is enabling people to end their lives, Jun-woong takes matters into his own hands.

episodes.name: Someday, Because of You
episodes.overview: An urgent alert leads the grim reapers to an atypical case involving a dog that's been separated from his longtime owner.

episodes.name: Breath
episodes.overview: A woman who was sexually assaulted grapples with trauma, while her twin brother seeks justice. The case proves personal for Ryung-gu.

episodes.name: West Sky 1
episodes.overview: After hearing an awful rumor about Ryung-gu, Jun-woong learns the tragic truth behind his colleague's past, and how he came to be a grim reaper.

episodes.name: West Sky 2
episodes.overview: A familiar face comes up on the team's radar, but her negative energy levels seem to fluctuate irregularly. When Ryung-gu finds out, he steps in.

episodes.name: Spring
episodes.overview: Mutual grief over the pain suffered by a long-lost friend brings two women together. The story of the comfort women and the horrors they endured is told.

episodes.name: Wind Flower
episodes.overview: The sorrows of Ryeon's past come to light. Centuries ago, she was a highborn lady who was left with deep scars after surviving a harrowing event.

episodes.name: Circus
episodes.overview: Helping a tormented top star is an especially important case for Ryeon. Meanwhile, Park Joong-gil demands answers about the secrets being kept from him.

episodes.name: Threads of Fate
episodes.overview: Jun-woong seeks out the one person who might be able to prevent Ryeon from being dragged to hell. The team still has a job to finish.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Hong Jihyo tries her best to dismiss the return of the strange creature in her life, until its signal for attention becomes impossible to ignore.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Unable to find any sure leads to locate Lee Siguk, Jihyo turns to a community of UFO buffs where she's given a hostile welcome.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Huh Bora offers to help Jihyo as long as she's able to document the investigation for her video series. The two make their way to Siguk's apartment.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: After getting into a tiff, the two friends go their separate ways. Jihyo turns to the police while Bora tails a suspicious real estate agent.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: After a surprising find in a stolen hard drive, Jihyo and Bora sneak into the back of a car and end up near a secluded home.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Jihyo and Bora face a series of delays on the way to a psychiatric hospital. Kim Byungjo and Oh Sehee ask a former detective about a mass suicide case.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Moon Hyungtae tries to get information out of Jihyo by strapping her to a device that distorts the subconscious. Seo Hwajung attempts to meet her savior.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Jihyo revisits the site of the close encounter and turns to her family for more clues. Kim Chanwoo brings a hostage into Cafe Universe.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Preparations for the funeral are well underway until the Hosanna makes a surprise appearance. An old colleague reveals the details of Hyungtae's past.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Hyungtae’s unsettling confession catches Jihyo unawares, putting her in great danger. Bora chases after a mysterious flying object.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: 5-8 investigates the construction of a new district in post-apocalyptic Korea. Sa-wol and Seul-ah experience an unexpected attack.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Seol-ah begins to investigate the recent tragedy. Sa-wol grapples with guilt. 5-8 discovers a dark scheme taking place in the shadows.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: 5-8 warns Seol-ah about the chilling facts surrounding her investigation. Sa-wol partakes in an intense tournament in the hopes of becoming a deliveryman.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Sa-wol advances to the final round. Ryu Seok reveals his disturbing plans for the upcoming migration, despite his father's opposition.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of Ryu Seok's ploy, 5-8 plans to take him — and Cheonmyeong — down. Having finally achieved his dream, Sa-wol takes up his first mission.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Confronted with a crisis, Seok executes his endgame. 5-8 and Seol-ah team up to stop Cheonmyeong once and for all.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: For an attorney who despises losing to men and an A-list actor who distrusts women, love means nothing — until they're forced to date each other.

episodes.name: Bad Girl
episodes.overview: Yeo Mi-ran’s distaste for petty, philandering men grows even stronger. Nam Kang-ho offends his finicky co-star on the set of their drama.

episodes.name: Bad Boy
episodes.overview: Mi-ran starts a new job at a previously all-male law firm where she navigates awkward encounters with a top client, an ex-boyfriend and a familiar foe.

episodes.name: Nice Guys Get a Pass Bad Boys Have It Coming
episodes.overview: After catching Kang-ho in what seems like a compromising position, Mi-ran becomes determined to get close to him so she could bring him to justice.

episodes.name: You Are Not What I Expected
episodes.overview: While prepping for the role of his dreams, Kang-ho turns to martial arts enthusiast Mi-ran for help. Oh Se-na, an old flame, re-enters the picture.

episodes.name: Love is Just an Experiment, Life is the Real Thing
episodes.overview: Mi-ran bats away unwanted advances — including a tricky birthday surprise. Kang-ho's reputation is threatened when false dating rumors go public.

episodes.name: Femme Fatale vs Homme Fatale
episodes.overview: Mi-ran and Kang-ho begin a whirlwind — but fake — romance to combat questions surrounding the actor's sexuality. Do Won-jun meets Mi-ran's roommate.

episodes.name: Trigonometry: The Love Triangle Edition
episodes.overview: Feelings start to get a bit too real between Mi-ran and Kang-ho. Despite knowing Kang-ho's apparent relationship status, Oh Se-na tries to win him back.

episodes.name: The Way You Change Me
episodes.overview: When Mi-ran gets hurt, Kang-ho realizes his feelings for her are deeper than he imagined. Won-jun and Shin Na-eun flirt with teaming up — and each other.

episodes.name: You Made Me Who I Am
episodes.overview: Mi-ran and Kang-ho get serious and vulnerable with each other. To get over her crush on Won-jun, Na-eun tells him about her most embarrassing habits.

episodes.name: A Passionate Goodbye
episodes.overview: News of Mi-ran's dating history gets out, making her a social pariah. Will she and Kang-ho give in to pressure and break up, or will love prevail?

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: The birth of a boy born with a curse brings death to the village. Years later, Dan Hwal reencounters a mystifying woman while hunting down monsters.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Upon burying loved ones, Hwal embarks on a centuries-spanning chase for revenge. Min Sang-yeon's worst fears come true when Min Sang-un is followed home.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: A hair tie left behind at a crime scene leads Hwal closer to his target. Sang-un's past catches up to her during a night shift at the cleaners.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Sang-un finally remembers her sister's last words — and how to kill Bulgasal. Ok Eul-tae emerges out of the shadows to destroy an ill-fated soul.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Sang-un asks Hwal for help in avenging her family's death. Eul-tae tries to persuade the other Bulgasal into joining hands against a common enemy.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: To defeat a greater evil, Sang-un and Hwal agree to keep each other alive for now. Kwon Ho-yeol steps into a hairy case of déjà vu.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Hwal takes Sang-un to a village to help retrieve memories from her past life. There, a monster tells of Eul-tae's secret in her final gasps of breath.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Lee Hye-seok's prediction spooks Sang-un into searching for answers about her past. Despite Hwal's warning, Ho-yeol continues to look into Eul-tae.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Seeing Hwal and Ho-yeol together stirs up a bitter memory for Eul-tae. Nam Do-yun faces a dilemma when a Bulgasal asks him to return the favor.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Eul-tae invites himself into Hwal's home to look for Sang-un. Do-yun is kidnapped by a reincarnated monster seeking revenge on both Bulgasals.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Hwal sets out to lock up Eul-tae for good. Trying to protect Sang-un from danger, Si-ho searches for a solution from her sister's past life.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Rattled by Eul-tae's remarks, Hwal seeks clarity on events that transpired a thousand years ago and how the bad blood started between him and Sang-un.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Hwal and Sang-un share conflicting memories of the past. Eul-tae channels his anger into a plan to take away everything Hwal cherishes.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: As Hwal vows to do everything in his power to capture Eul-tae, Sang-un reminds him not to lose sight of who he is on his path to revenge.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: To settle the score for good, Hwal, Sang-un and Ho-yeol meet Eul-tae at the well. But one individual has a different plan for revenge in mind.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: A backstory from a thousand years ago reveals the origin of the Bulgasals’ ill-fated connection. Sacrifice puts an end to the immortal curse.

episodes.name: A Girl Named Mary Saotome
episodes.overview: Lacking in gambling skills, Tsuzura Hanatemari finds herself at the bottom of the food chain — until one day, an old friend transfers to the academy.

episodes.name: A Targeted Girl
episodes.overview: Student Council member Sakura Miharutaki faces off against a gamble crazed, unruly student. Mary's scheme backfires when an unexpected guest shows up.

episodes.name: A Traitorous Girl
episodes.overview: On the brink of becoming a house pet, Mary must find a way to earn money. Trust is on the line when she and her friends attend a "coupling party."

episodes.name: Confessing Girls
episodes.overview: With a traitor in their midst, Mary struggles with trusting her friends. Meanwhile, the opposing boys' team argues over whether to rejoin the game.

episodes.name: An Honest Girl
episodes.overview: Aoi attempts to lure Mary into his Full-Bloom society. Joining forces with Mikura, Sakura plots to undermine Mary through a gambling match.

episodes.name: A Resisting Girl
episodes.overview: Sakura and Mary brace themselves for the final game. In desperation, Mary asks her friends for help, using whatever means necessary to win.

episodes.name: Extraterrestrial Emissaries
episodes.overview: Born on the moon, Toya half-heartedly welcomes three kids from Earth to his home in space. But during the welcome party a terrifying accident occurs.

episodes.name: Mist and Darkness
episodes.overview: Toya and Taiyo make their way through the station to find their friends after the shockwave from the passing comet knocks out oxygen and the internet.

episodes.name: Lunatic Seven
episodes.overview: The rabbit mascot comes to aid the children, who are trapped in a room leaking air. But to escape, the kids must walk outside in space to reach a ship.

episodes.name: Seven's Pattern
episodes.overview: Toya makes contact with his uncle, the Captain, but further disaster threatens the kids and humanity as a whole when someone takes over the station.

episodes.name: A Story Ends
episodes.overview: The kids learn the truth about the harrowing prophecy of Seven and the extremists who support him as comets continue to hurdle toward Earth.

episodes.name: A Story Begins
episodes.overview: Mina, Doc, Taiyo, and the crew try to evacuate everyone from the space station. Meanwhile, Toya makes one last stand to save them all.

episodes.name: Liyan’s New Beginning
episodes.overview: A new year starts for Liyan Kindergarten, the global leader in the field of early education. Parents from prestigious backgrounds gather for a fundraiser at Liyan. Kang Youn-kyum, the representative of LY Group, also attends with his wife for her daughter. Ho…

episodes.name: Ra-el's Secret Identity
episodes.overview: Eun-pyeong climbs higher in politics. Despite his success and popularity, he still remembers everything about Ra-el and her real mother even after all these years. Knowing in his gut that Ra-el is still alive, he continues the search. Meanwhile, Youn-kyum fee…

episodes.name: Night at Sewoonjung
episodes.overview: While satisfying Dam-ri and Ji-hee, Sun-bin approaches So-ra at the same time. With her charms and wit, she manages to obtain So-ra’s trust. Sun-bin and Jin-wook get invited to Sewoonjung, Youn-kyum’s personal party where not anyone can join. By using this bi…

episodes.name: The Truth of Kang Youn-kyum
episodes.overview: Sun-bin is on a clear path to gaining So-ra’s total trust. With the trust she gains, she must investigate the ledgers of LY Group that might be in Youn-kyum’s study. However, Eun-pyeong finds shocking information about Kang Youn-kyum. Something that Ra-el has…

episodes.name: Love and Lust
episodes.overview: Youn-kyum does not fall for Ra-el easily. Just when things seem to be in a tight spot, Ra-el comes up with a plan by using So-ra’s birthday. Meanwhile, although Eun-pyeong is well-known for not taking any politician or conglomerate’s side, he is willing to do…

episodes.name: The Evil Witch
episodes.overview: So-ra is enraged with Youn-kyum’s disappearance. Despite the presence of her daughter, she does not control her emotions. Meanwhile, Youn-kyum confesses his true feelings to Ra-el. With true love as his source of energy, he determines to break free from being…

episodes.name: Ra-el Gets Close to Youn-kyum
episodes.overview: Now that Ra-el knows about her mother Jin-sook's death, she seeks revenge by getting close to Youn-kyum. Ra-el sees his scars. She knows it isn't right, but she can't resist and slowly falls for Youn-kyum. Eun-pyeong teams up with Pan-ro to help Ra-el. Meanwh…

episodes.name: Ra-el Disappears
episodes.overview: So-ra uses the hit-and-run accident to her advantage and begins to search for Youn-kyum's mistress. Ra-el keeps her distance, hitting Youn-kyum and So-ra mentally. And as soon as she disappears, Youn-kyum yearns for her even more. Meanwhile, So-ra kidnaps Ra-…

episodes.name: Ra-el Becomes Anxious
episodes.overview: Youn-kyum and So-ra don't react as Ra-el expected. So-ra starts to ostracize Ra-el at the kindergarten now that she knows Ra-el is Youn-kyum's mistress. Ra-el starts to become anxious, seeing no difference in Youn-kyum and So-ra's relationship. Meanwhile, Eun…

episodes.name: Ra-el’s Impatience
episodes.overview: Ra-el falls deeper into the darkness after Moon-hee's betrayal and Youn-kyum's indifference. To get Youn-kyum to move, Ra-el deals with him coldly, grabbing and letting go of his heart. Later, at LY Shopping Mall's formal gathering, So-ra falls into Ra-el's p…

episodes.name: Youn-kyum Demands Divorce
episodes.overview: Youn-kyum goes to the house of roses after he tells So-ra he wants a divorce. His love deepens while enjoying his time there. He tells Ra-el he loves her. She tries to turn a blind eye to his endearment, but she can't help herself and falls deeper into love.…

episodes.name: Ra-el Comes Out Of Hiding
episodes.overview: Ra-el sees Youn-kyum's sincerity and gets torn by her love for him and her revenge. Meanwhile, news about Youn-kyum's private life begins to circulate that enrages So-ra. So-ra orders one of her men to capture Ra-el at all costs. Eun-pyeong saves her but sust…

episodes.name: A Drop Of Doubt
episodes.overview: So-ra gives Youn-kyum clues about Ra-el's identity. Ra-el and Youn-kyum's relationship becomes compromised with So-ra's drop of doubt. Realizing there isn't much time left, Ra-el thinks only of her revenge. Youn-kyum senses Ra-el's secret, but it doesn't clou…

episodes.name: Ra-el Take Charge
episodes.overview: Youn-kyum is utterly shocked when he learns about Ra-el's secrets. Ra-el and Eun-pyeong believe Pan-ro has Moon-hee. Eun-pyeong storms Pan-ro's residence with the police to search for Moon-hee, but they come up empty-handed. Ra-el learns more about her mother…

episodes.name: Love for One’s Enemy
episodes.overview: The trial proceeds as scheduled, and Youn-kyum himself shows up in the courtroom. At the same time, with the evidence left behind by Moon-hee, Ra-el turns So-ra and Pan-ro against each other. Cornered and pressured, So-ra finds herself turning into the weakes…

episodes.name: The True Love
episodes.overview: Jung-chul heads to the villa where Ra-el and Youn-kyum are. He is determined to hurt Ra-el as much as she had hurt him. Youn-kyum ends up killing Jung-chul, and he decides to turn himself in. Ra-el receives the gift Youn-kyum left him, and she decides to leav…

episodes.name: An uneasy feeling
episodes.overview: Jackpot! Rilakkuma wins free tickets to Nakasugi Land, the local amusement park that will soon be closing its doors forever.

episodes.name: Game battle with Emiri
episodes.overview: Rilakkuma has lots of fun playing video games with a new friend, but the big fuzzy bear gets a little dizzy after playing too much. Next stop: teacups!

episodes.name: Eiji and the jungle tour
episodes.overview: Kiiroitori ends up getting stuck in a tree. Can Rilakkuma and friends rescue the little bird? Kaoru and Korilakkuma finally make it into the park.

episodes.name: Clown in love
episodes.overview: It's way past lunchtime and everyone's getting hungry. Kaoru and Korilakkuma need to get their bentos back from the clown who ran off with them quick!

episodes.name: Suzune’s an idol
episodes.overview: Rilakkuma, Tokio and Kiiroitori are all really hungry; luckily, the park employee that's been helping them notices and kindly buys them lunch.

episodes.name: The secret of the theme park
episodes.overview: The park secret is out!? As the sun starts to set, Suzune remembers how much she used to love this job. At long last, it's time for her final concert.

episodes.name: Strategy meeting in the dark
episodes.overview: The power's out throughout the park and it's getting dark, but Kaoru starts beaming when she finally meets up with Hayate — and the rest of the crew.

episodes.name: The last parade
episodes.overview: There's only one way to get the power back on in time for the parade; Korilakkuma has to send her remote controlled ducky into the underground maze.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Nam Han-jun keeps his wealthy clients wrapped around his finger. A detective with a fearsome reputation joins the violent crimes unit.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Han Jae-hui pursues Shin Gyeong-ho for the hit-and-run, while Han-jun guarantees that he'll let the man walk scot-free.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Han-jun sets his next target. Jae-hui visits the café with questions about an old case. Minamdang’s origin story is revealed.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Han-jun presses Jung Cheong-gi to give up a name. A witness comes to Jae-hui to confess. Minamdang receives an urgent call about a ghost.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Han-jun and Jae-hui butt heads as they keep getting in the way of each other’s investigations. A familiar face shows up at the crime scene.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Han Jae-jeong’s discovery remains in the dark. Jae-hui seeks to verify Choi Yeong-seop’s alibi. Han-jun goes undercover.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Han-jun acquires a DNA sample. A person haunted by an ex’s ghost visits Minamdang. Jae-hui follows a lead into Joyce Entertainment.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Lee Ji-eun opens up about a horrifying scene she witnessed. Han-jun and Jae-hui compete for a phone. A man with a distinct feature catches Han-jun’s eye.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: The police interrogation faces an uphill climb. Bad luck follows Jeon Gyeong-cheol. Gu Tae-su seeks a shaman for advice.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Tae-su agrees to a DNA test. Han-jun unravels a mystery while in a holding cell. The Minamdang crew try their luck at an underground gambling arena.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Han-jun provokes Park Jin-sang into giving up a name. Jae-hui accompanies Cha Do-won to an exclusive event as his plus-one. Aunt Im expects a visitor.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Jae-hui chases after Han-jun's kidnapper; the near-death experience sparks a romance. Jang Du-jin salvages a photo from the debris of a scorched home.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: The Minamdang crew examines the evidence Jae-hui had acquired from Tae-su’s trailer and sneaks into a popular nightclub for more answers.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: The interrogation proves difficult as Tae-su takes the fall and refuses to give up any names. Han-jun heads to a campsite to take a break from it all.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Han-jun and Jae-hui go after the two key players in the scheme who got away. A murder investigation triggers Cha Do-won’s past trauma.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Han-jun closes in on Cha Seung-won and finds out that Aunt Im possesses an important document. But his unorthodox methods shake Jae-hui's trust in him.

episodes.name: Episode 17
episodes.overview: After being caught red-handed, Han-jun retraces his steps to come to a shocking realization. A phone call stirs suspicion within Jae-hui’s team.

episodes.name: Episode 18
episodes.overview: Han-jun and Jae-hui search the killer’s belongings for more clues. When they come across a hit list, they realize that the murder spree is still ongoing.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Hwang Do-hee attempts to quell Oh Kyung-sook's persistent protest against Eunsung Group. Baek Jae-min confides in Do-hee regarding a potential crisis.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Do-hee grapples with the guilt of having caused a tragedy in the name of her job. Jae-min proposes a scheme to jumpstart his career ambitions.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: After refusing Son Young-sim’s orders, Do-hee risks losing everything she has worked towards. Later, she approaches Kyung-sook with a huge proposal.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: A violent incident cements Kyung-sook's decision to run for mayor. Later, Do-hee helps Kyung-sook prepare for her first television debate.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Kyung-sook pushes Seo Min-jung to an uncomfortable position during their debate. Do-hee throws a wrench into Eunsung Group's development plans.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: After a tip from an unlikely figure, Min-jung goes all in to take down Kyung-sook. In an attempt to rattle Do-hee, Carl Yoon does the unthinkable.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Kyung-sook begins to question the election as it begins to affect her loved ones — forcing Do-hee to reconsider whether the race is really worth it.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Jae-min is attacked on the campaign trail — but Kyung-sook remains skeptical. Do-hee attempts to regain the upper hand on her opponent.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Carl goes after Kyung-sook's family — forcing her camp to seek out the truth. Running out of options, Do-hee teams up an unlikely partner.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Shocking news about Jae-min creates a problem for his campaign. As the final debate nears, Do-hee reveals her silver bullet to Kyung-sook.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: As election day looms, Do-hee becomes entangled in a dangerous endgame. She later makes a surprising final move — shocking Kyung-sook.

episodes.name: The Finest Cardiothoracic Surgeon
episodes.overview: Sensing that Ko Seung-tak, a resident at Eunsang University Medical Center, will not get along with him, Cha Young-min, the top cardiothoracic surgeon, plans to get rid of him.

episodes.name: A Coma Ghost
episodes.overview: Young-min finds his body in a critical condition and gets confused about if he is alive or dead; Young-min discovers that he can possess Seung-tak only; a mysterious man calls Young-min a coma ghost.

episodes.name: A Well-Planned Coincidence
episodes.overview: Young-min suspects Seung-tak for the car accident but reconsiders his opinions when Seung-tak makes a sacrifice for him; a VIP patient suffers side effects after the surgery.

episodes.name: You Want In Or Out?
episodes.overview: With an emergency patient in front of him, Seung-tak struggles. At the same time, Young-min faces the risk of disappearing for good. The two become physically and mentally inseparable, but neither one seems to accept the situation. Meanwhile, Young-min finds…

episodes.name: Help Me Out Here!
episodes.overview: Seung-tak has no other option but to ask Young-min for help in saving an emergency patient. While Young-min is impressed with his good faith, he is also shocked and realizes that there is a possibility that Seung-tak might be seeing him. But first things firs…

episodes.name: The Ghost Patient
episodes.overview: Young-min finds out from the ghost patient that the accident he was involved in was also planned out by someone. Meanwhile, Seung-jo begs Seung-tak to do whatever it takes to save him. However, the only doctor who can save Seung-jo is Young-min, and the only…

episodes.name: What It Means to Save Someone’s Life
episodes.overview: Young-min is excited that he can save someone’s life again. At the same time, Seung-tak asks Young-min what it’s like to save a life all on your own. Meanwhile, someone special to Young-min visits the hospital, not as a guest but as a patient.

episodes.name: Sharing Secrets
episodes.overview: Young-min reveals the truth about what happened to Seung-tak 12 years ago; Young-min's assailant regains consciousness but cannot remember anything.

episodes.name: Ghost Doctor
episodes.overview: Se-jin feels Young-min's presence when interacting with Seung-tak; Seung-won finds Seung-tak's behaviour suspicious.

episodes.name: No Reason to Hide
episodes.overview: Young-min, still in Seung-tak's body, decides to reveal himself to Seung-won; Seung-tak helps Young-min spend some time with Se-jin; something unexpected happens at the hospital.

episodes.name: The Weak Spot
episodes.overview: Young-min feels helpless when the coordination with Seung-jo goes wrong during surgery. Knowing how frustrated Young-min is, Seung-tak looks for other ways to save him. Meanwhile, Se-jin tries to keep a distance from Seung-tak, and Seung-tak is bothered by he…

episodes.name: The Conflict
episodes.overview: Se-jin collapses due to overwork and takes a few days off; Se-jin warns Seung-tak to stay away from Young-min; Seung-won and Tae-hyun hatch another plot.

episodes.name: Anything but This
episodes.overview: Seung-tak loses control during his surgery and disappears, leaving everyone at the hospital worried. Young-min learns about Seung-tak's history, and Se-jin's suspicion about Seung-tak grows.

episodes.name: Thank You Tes
episodes.overview: The connection between Young-min, Seung-tak, and Tes is revealed; Seung-tak returns to the hospital, and Se-jin is surprised to see the new Seung-tak.

episodes.name: A Difficult Decision
episodes.overview: Se-jin discovers Seung-tak's secret; Seung-tak learns that the surgery has a major side effect; Young-min intends to treat as many patients; Young-min must make a tough choice.

episodes.name: Life and Death
episodes.overview: Seung-tak and Young-min get ready for Young-min’s surgery, but Young-min looks like he has a lot on his mind. Either way, this is going to be their last surgery together as one. After the surgery, everyone waits to see if Young-min recovers. However, not ever…

episodes.name: Signal
episodes.overview: While preparing for her wedding, Jin Ha-kyung deals with work headaches as Lee Si-woo refuses to give up on signals that point to an oncoming storm.

episodes.name: Sensible Temperature
episodes.overview: Han Ki-jun's shameless requests infuriate Ha-kyung, who considers an overseas job opportunity. Si-woo shows up at the office on a two-week assignment.

episodes.name: In Between Seasons
episodes.overview: A drunken encounter with Si-woo leaves Ha-kyung uncharacteristically disoriented. At work, her public clashes with Ki-jun continue.

episodes.name: Visibility
episodes.overview: Si-woo's co-workers notice that he seems to have gotten on Ha-kyung's bad side. Chae Yu-jin writes a newspaper article criticizing the weather service.

episodes.name: Localized Heavy Rain
episodes.overview: Ki-jun finds it difficult to let go of Yu-jin's lie. Unrest grows within Ha-kyung's team, and Um Dong-han struggles to focus at work.

episodes.name: Heat Island Phenomenon
episodes.overview: Ha-kyung grows wary of Si-woo's secrets after running into him at a motel. News about her mother sends her hurrying to the hospital.

episodes.name: Ozone Warning
episodes.overview: After an uneasy conversation with Yu-jin, Ki-jun seeks sage advice. While looking for a place to crash, Si-woo finds someone else in need of a home.

episodes.name: Discomfort Index
episodes.overview: As temperatures boil over outside, so do emotions as another uncovered truth pushes the animosity between Si-woo and Ki-jun to new heights.

episodes.name: Dry Changma (Rainy Season)
episodes.overview: Bothered to no end by the sight of Ha-kyung and Si-woo together, Ki-jun tails them on their day off. Meanwhile, Yu-jin's frustration balloons.

episodes.name: Tropical Night
episodes.overview: Ha-kyung faces intensifying pressure from her mother to get married. A pesky reporter lurks around the office in search of a good story.
When Ha-kyung chooses to send Si-woo far away on assignment, he doesn't hide his displeasure. Dong-han is elated when his daughter returns to see him.

episodes.name: Variation Area
episodes.overview: Upon learning Si-woo's sustained an injury while working, his father causes a scene at the office. Ki-jun can't get a hold of Yu-jin.

episodes.name: Scenario 1, 2, 3
episodes.overview: Relationship troubles abound as Ha-kyung tries to process what Si-woo wants, and Ki-jun and Dong-han set out to save their respective marriages.

episodes.name: Migratory Anticyclone
episodes.overview: Gossip about Ha-kyung and Si-woo dating sets the office abuzz, much to their chagrin. Yu-jin is unable to celebrate being handed a coveted assignment

episodes.name: Ensemble
episodes.overview: Ha-kyung is asked to keep a secret, Yu-jin grapples with a life-altering decision and Dong-han tries to make it to his daughter's birthday dinner.

episodes.name: Tomorrow's Answers
episodes.overview: While a second wave of rumors about Ha-kyung and Si-woo spreads around work, those around them urge them to reconsider the status of their relationship.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In an alternate 20th century Kyoto, two brothers dream of bringing about the Age of Electricity with their 20th Century Electrical Catalog. However, when Seiroku Sakamoto brings the catalog with him to war and never returns, his younger brother Kihachi Sakamo…

episodes.name: The Electric Boy
episodes.overview: Early 20th-century Kyoto. Kihachi witnesses the wonders of electricity with Seiroku. Four years later, alone and cynical, he meets a girl deep in prayer.

episodes.name: The Mysteries of the Catalog
episodes.overview: In a haze of incense, Yosuke storms into Kihachi's workshop and demands the Catalog — and his fiancée. But why does Inako have it in the first place?

episodes.name: Their Dream
episodes.overview: Full of denial, Yosuke clashes with Kihachi. Later, Inako's sharp senses reveal a secret and her belief inspires Kihachi to recreate an invention.

episodes.name: The Steadfast Girl
episodes.overview: Inako meets a grieving shop owner whose loss echoes her own. Fully believing in Kihachi's skills, she asks him to build an electric machine to help.

episodes.name: Proof of Love
episodes.overview: Kihachi's latest experiment catches the eye of a strange university graduate, who's convinced that it can help him prove his passion to his crush.

episodes.name: The Sound of Innovation
episodes.overview: Yosuke challenges Kihachi and the gang to a music battle. With only Inako having musical experience, can they master electric instruments in a week?

episodes.name: Elopement
episodes.overview: On the day of Inako's engagement ceremony, Kihachi urges her to chase her dreams and helps her escape. Guided by Stuart's letter, they head for Shiga.

episodes.name: His Brother's Footsteps
episodes.overview: Before Kihachi can figure out how to fix the electric key, Kengo breaks down and confesses the secret he's been carrying for the past three years.

episodes.name: Time to Part
episodes.overview: Kihachi makes a shocking decision to protect Inako, but she takes matters into her own hands. Yosuke reminisces about his first meeting with Seiroku.

episodes.name: Engagement Trouble
episodes.overview: Yosuke makes a critical discovery. After Inako and Kihachi clear up their misunderstanding, they help Kengo reconcile with Noriko using a shocking plan.

episodes.name: The Enticing Circuit
episodes.overview: After Inako and Saki sneak into Yosuke's office to find clues about the Electric Brocade, Kihachi vanishes. Inako realizes that her father holds the key.

episodes.name: Electric Brain
episodes.overview: Inako and Kihachi throw themselves into pursuing their dreams. Determined to fulfill Seiroku's vision, Yosuke ropes Kihachi into a colossal project.

episodes.name: To the Future We Desire
episodes.overview: As the Electric Brain goes berserk, Kihachi, Inako and Yosuke confront their destinies. Who will stay stuck in the past or look towards the future?

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Relentlessly pursued by a powerful politician’s daughter who will do anything to make him hers, a man slips down a dark, risky path to reclaim his life.

episodes.name: Teri Baari Hai
episodes.overview: College graduate Vikrant’s plans for his future are upended when an infamous politician offers him a job at the behest of his infatuated daughter, Purva.

episodes.name: Band Toh Bajega
episodes.overview: Reeling from what he witnessed in Akheraj’s office, Vikrant tells Purva his truth, but ensuing events make it clear he can’t get away so easily.

episodes.name: Bandook Aur Hawaii Chappal
episodes.overview: An increasingly desperate Vikrant makes several attempts to call off the engagement. An honest conversation with Akheraj has a disastrous outcome.

episodes.name: 4 Goliyaan
episodes.overview: A shocking discovery leaves Vikrant heartbroken. Now just days before the wedding, fear for his family’s life compels him to make a decision.

episodes.name: Do You Love Me?
episodes.overview: On the wedding night, Vikrant learns of an unexpected return. As his hunger for revenge deepens, a daring side of him begins to emerge.

episodes.name: Jack and Jill
episodes.overview: As Purva's suspicions grow, Akheraj’s men are sent to track down Vikrant’s secret. Vikrant considers putting a dangerous plot into action.

episodes.name: Seedha Sa Plan
episodes.overview: As Purva lets down her guard, Vikrant suggests a honeymoon — but has ulterior motives. However, he's not the only one making life-changing arrangements.

episodes.name: The Crying Game
episodes.overview: When a crucial plot falters, Vikrant intensifies his ruse with Purva ahead of her show. But even careful planning can't prepare him for what’s coming.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: An abduction forces Vikrant to wrestle with warring feelings of love and vengeance while leaving a bloody trail in his wake.

episodes.name: Lag Gaye Kismat Ke Ghode
episodes.overview: Amidst the search for Purva, Vikrant finds himself falling into deeper trouble. A figure from Purva’s past looms large and a ransom war triggers chaos.

episodes.name: Aasmaan Se Gira Khajur Pe Atka
episodes.overview: With Dharmesh as a threat, Vikrant is forced to take a violent step. Guru takes matters into his own hands when he learns of Purva’s disappearance.

episodes.name: Aage Kuan Peeche Khaai
episodes.overview: As doubts pervade his mind, Guru begins to question Vikrant and his family. Purva finds a way to send out a secret message.

episodes.name: Saajan Niklu Bekaar
episodes.overview: Guru successfully decodes Purva’s message. Akheraj reveals a connection to Sherpa. The ransom exchange triggers a tense shootout.

episodes.name: Nehle Pe Dehla
episodes.overview: A despondent Vikrant receives unexpected news. Purva’s rage takes aim at Shikha. Vikrant’s past catches up to him when an inspector arrives.

episodes.name: Maar Hi Daaloge
episodes.overview: At the funeral, plots for vengeance begin to unfurl. Vikrant implores his family and Shikha to flee. Sherpa’s true motives emerge.

episodes.name: Happiness, Sadness, Pity, and Joy
episodes.overview: Memories of her past lives — and one true love — come rushing back to 9-year-old Ban Ji-eum. But reuniting with him proves trickier than expected.

episodes.name: The Will to Finish What You've Started
episodes.overview: Thanks to a new job, Ji-eum is finally back in Mun Seo-ha's life — but will he recognize her? Another familiar face shows up, much to Ji-eum's delight.

episodes.name: The Agony of Parting With the One You Love
episodes.overview: Ji-eum asks Yoon Cho-won out to dinner and uncovers relieving news. A mysterious figure drops by the hotel.

episodes.name: The Inability to Forget About the One You Long For
episodes.overview: Ji-eum and Seo-ha share more heartfelt moments. Cho-won summons up the courage to make a daring move.

episodes.name: Am I the Butterfly or Is the Butterfly Me?
episodes.overview: Seo-ha butts heads with the CEO of MI Grand Hotel. Kim Ae-gyeong welcomes a new worker at her restaurant — but Ji-eum is wary.

episodes.name: The Spot In One's Heart From Longing
episodes.overview: When Ban Dong-u gets entangled with loan sharks, Ji-eum takes matters into her own hands. Meanwhile, Dong-u happens upon a shocking revelation.
