episodes.name: The Ones Who Share Each Others' Joy and Sorrow
episodes.overview: Seo-ha's world comes tumbling down when a mysterious phone call reveals an uncomfortable truth. He later shares an intimate moment with Ji-eum.

episodes.name: Casting One's Fate Unto the Dice
episodes.overview: Ji-eum continues to deal with her troublesome family. Jang Yeon-ok receives a bouquet of flowers — but finds an ominous note tucked inside.

episodes.name: You're Bound to Meet Someone You've Parted With
episodes.overview: Seo-ha reckons with Ji-eum's confession. Han-na and Ji-eum join forces. During a confrontation with Seo-ha, Lee Sang-hyuck reveals his motives.

episodes.name: Everything Has a Beginning and an End
episodes.overview: Ji-eum receives alarming news about Ae-gyeong. Cho-won continues to pursue Ha Do-yun. Seo-ha receives a curious gift that leaves him puzzled.

episodes.name: No Such Thing as Retreat
episodes.overview: Ji-eum gets more glimpses into her very first life, which leaves her completely devastated. Kang Min-gi meets with Seo-ha and offers him advice.

episodes.name: The One Who Tied the Knot Must Untie It
episodes.overview: After coming to a shocking realization about her unique abilities, Ji-eum is faced with a critical dilemma — what path will she choose for herself?

episodes.name: Let's do it together, get married
episodes.overview: To appease his grandfather's wishes, Kang Tae-moo agrees to a blind date. Jin Young-seo enlists Shin Ha-ri's help to scare away her latest prospect.

episodes.name: Fall in love with me
episodes.overview: Tae-moo lies about having a girlfriend to stop the endless barrage of blind dates, with the perfect person in mind to play the part.

episodes.name: Don't try this fake relationship, try a real relationship
episodes.overview: Ha-ri has a long list of facts about Tae-moo to memorize — as well as someone important to meet. Young-seo declares her independence.

episodes.name: It's pretty
episodes.overview: In and outside of work, Ha-ri scrambles to hide her true identity from Tae-moo and his grandfather. A fake one-year anniversary comes up.

episodes.name: I am Shin Ha-ri
episodes.overview: As payback for being fooled, Tae-moo sets a trap for Ha-ri at a company event. But when she drunkenly apologizes, he has a change of heart.

episodes.name: My name is Hari's boyfriend Kang Tae-moo
episodes.overview: When plans for a confession go awry, Tae-moo takes Ha-ri on a date by the sea disguised as a work trip. Cha Sung-hoon confronts a red-faced Young-seo.

episodes.name: I like Shin Ha-ri
episodes.overview: Tae-moo plays the part of Ha-ri's smitten boyfriend in front of her friends, much to the chagrin of a wary Lee Min-woo and a jealous Go Yoo-ra.

episodes.name: I want to think about just the two of us
episodes.overview: Calling their kiss a mistake, Ha-ri continues to reject Tae-moo's advances. But an unreturned text and word of his blind date stir up her emotions.

episodes.name: What are you doing there?
episodes.overview: Jo Yoo-jung falls for Sung-hoon, landing him in hot water with Young-seo. Tae-moo and Ha-ri try to keep their relationship a secret at work.

episodes.name: Thank you for taking me in like this
episodes.overview: Kang Da-goo's suspicions about his grandson's love life are proven true. On a rainy night after work, Ha-ri takes Tae-moo out on a date.

episodes.name: Don't disappear from my sight
episodes.overview: When Ha-ri's personal life becomes the talk of the town, Tae-moo's grandfather gives her an ultimatum. Young-seo's dad suggests dinner with Sung-hoon.

episodes.name: We're getting married
episodes.overview: Ha-ri tries to win Da-goo over by keeping him company at his hospital bedside. A worried Tae-moo asks Ha-ri to go to the U.S. with him.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After an eventful evening in the city, Yeom Gi-jeong, Yeom Mi-jeong and Yeom Chang-hee leave the day behind and take a long taxi ride back home.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Trying to keep bad news to herself, Mi-jeong forwards a letter to Mr. Gu's address. Mr. Gu, who’d been drinking his life away, finds something to do.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Mi-jeong takes a break from her usual routine to avoid Mr. Gu. Gi-jeong confronts the male colleague who has hit on everyone else but her.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: A talkative co-worker drives Chang-hee to his wits' end. Mi-jeong's new club attracts attention. Gi-jeong encounters someone who keeps her up at night.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Mr. Gu's hidden talent gains Chang-hee's respect and attention. To prove the club's legitimacy, Mi-jeong keeps a record of her thoughts of liberation.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Chang-hee is offered an opportunity he cannot afford. Mi-jeong and Mr. Gu's unusual friendship blossoms, while making Gi-jeong uneasy.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Mi-jeong hides the whole truth from the family as they come close to finding out about her debt. A couple of guests tune in to the club meeting.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Mr. Gu learns that he's been spotted by people he's been avoiding. Cho Tae-hun reaches out to Gi-jeong with a request.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Gi-jeong reflects back on her time with Tae-hun. Interestingly, shame is not the first thing she feels. The past comes to find Mr. Gu.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Mr. Gu brushes Mi-jeong aside, but she sees straight through him — his guilt, his fears, and his habit of deserting happiness when it's within reach.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: On a particularly awful day for Mi-jeong, Mr. Gu provides her with the remedy she needs the most. Gi-jeong's friendly meal with Tae-hun takes a turn.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Mr. Gu gets a visitor from his past life. A sobering experience jolts Chang-hee back to reality from a short-lived dream car fantasy.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Mr. Gu is back in his element: keeping busy, making bank and at the top of his game. But every so often, he feels homesick for the life he once led.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: The family tries to cope with a tragedy. Chang-hee stays with his father. Mi-jeong deals with conflict at work. Gi-jeong makes a momentous decision.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: When Mr. Gu's alcohol dependence becomes a growing problem, he seeks therapy of his own. Tensions rise between Tae-hun and his family.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Mi-jeong meets her old club members to share stories of progress. Mr. Gu finds spurts of joy sprinkled throughout the day that make life worth living.

episodes.name: Scott Pilgrim's Precious Little Life
episodes.overview: Slacker Scott Pilgrim leads a sweet and simple life. Until sparks fly — and ignite total chaos — when he meets the rainbow-haired girl of his dreams.

episodes.name: A League of Their Own
episodes.overview: An eclectic crowd of familiar faces gathers under unusual circumstances. Elsewhere, the League of Evil Exes meets up at a secret lair.

episodes.name: Ramona Rents a Video
episodes.overview: Motivated by a dream, Ramona follows a hunch and confides in a receptive Julie. At a video rental store, a tense run-in with Roxie fuels big feelings.

episodes.name: Whatever
episodes.overview: Ramona heads to a film set to see Lucas, her movie star ex, whose role in a major Canadian motion picture attracts media attention — and the paparazzi.

episodes.name: Lights. Camera. Sparks?!
episodes.overview: A documentary about the Toronto production reveals drama — and steamy romance — behind the scenes. Ramona takes on a daring but demanding gig.

episodes.name: WHODIDIT
episodes.overview: Ramona arrives at Julie's doorstep with more questions and curiosity. A surprise visitor seeks forgiveness from Gideon. Knives taps into new talents.

episodes.name: 2 Scott 2 Pilgrim
episodes.overview: Unfinished business, mind-blowing revelations — and a mix of lovers, friends and exes. What could go wrong?

episodes.name: The World vs Scott Pilgrim
episodes.overview: Scott, Ramona and their friends face their toughest challenge yet in a knockdown epic showdown that could change everything.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Unlike the crown prince, who thrives in his studies, Im Hwa-ryeong’s other sons arrive late to class – stoking the queen dowager’s disapproval.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Hwa-ryeong urges her sons to join the race to become the cohort of the crown prince. She gets a volunteer, but soon learns of his scandalous secret.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: At the selection exam, the king challenges the candidates by posing an unexpected question. The queen dowager closes in on Grand Prince Gye-seong.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The three finalists debate over a topic that’s plaguing the nation. Grand Prince Seong-nam risks his life to meet a doctor who could heal his brother.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: When the news of the crown prince's ill-health spreads through the palace, members of the royal council pressure the king appoint a new successor.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Hwang Won-hyeong spearheads an official investigation of the disturbing rumors. The crown princess comes to Hwa-ryeong in distress.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Seong-nam seeks to take responsibility for the tragedy, hoping to shake his guilt. The royal physician makes a surprising confession before the king.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: When other princes and concubines lie, cheat and scheme to get ahead in the competition, Hwa-ryeong finds a way to slow them down.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: The queen dowager shifts her support to another prince, which makes her former allies nervous. Prince Sim-so returns home to a hostile welcome.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Gye-seong tries to stop a criminal from entering the palace. Two princes investigate a suspicious blind man. Seong-nam’s royal roots are questioned.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: The queen dowager urges a prince to withdraw from the race. Hwa-ryeong puts an end to the foul play by giving the young scholars a chance to come clean.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: As the new crown prince assumes his royal duties, Hwa-ryeong and the queen dowager now shift their attention to appointing a new crown princess.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: The crown princess visits Hwa-ryeong with an inquiry. Grand Prince Mu-an takes on a new responsibility. A missing page in a medical record is found.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Hwa-ryeong investigates two similar deaths and takes action to put the humiliating rumors about the newlywed crown prince to rest.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Physician Kwon forms an alliance to protect himself. The queen dowager tries to obtain critical evidence. The crown princess’ health causes a stir.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: The king faces a dilemma concerning a long-held secret, as revealing it could undo his life's work. The queen gently offers him words of wisdom.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Badly in debt, a man hesitantly joins a mysterious show and meets seven other eclectic strangers. Their first goal? Figure out the rules.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Realizing that an activity rewards them with time, the eight coordinate a plan. But soon, chaos erupts as their strategy doesn't last.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: A participant approaches 3rd Floor with a proposal to steer the next activity selection. After, a strategic vote takes place to pick the bathroom location.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: One participant establishes rank on the others, making them desperate. Soon, a new game of dares begins — and a savage hand-to-hand fight ensues.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: A few floors strategically band together to get an upper hand on the others. But the victims see their salvation in a potential uprising.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Now with the tables turned to their favor, the lower floors plan their endgame. However, the clock keeps winding up as strange, brutal events unfold.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: An act of altruism backfires, putting some participants in danger. But a shocking move changes everything — switching the dynamic up once again.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: One participant suggests an idea to turn the tides back in their favor. But the show falls into disarray when the result turns out duplicitous.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In the cartel-run town of Gulaabgunj, an unprecedented opium deal pulls a big-city cop and a lovesick mechanic into its chaotic clutches.

episodes.name: Chapter 1: Har Insaan Mein Hai Shaitaan
episodes.overview: After his father’s death, lovelorn mechanic Tipu takes a drastic step. The arrival of cop Arjun Varma causes a stir. A high-stakes deal is afoot.

episodes.name: Chapter 2: Everything I Do ... I Do It For You
episodes.overview: When his family is threatened, Arjun's faced with a messy problem. Ganchi's gang suffers a sudden blow while the assassin Atmaram takes aim at Tipu.

episodes.name: Chapter 3: Kasam Paida Karnewale Ki
episodes.overview: A devastated Tipu vows to avenge an emotional loss. Seeking to grab power, a rival cartel makes its move, even as Jugnu steps into his father's shoes.

episodes.name: Chapter 4: Deal Ya No Deal
episodes.overview: As the two gangs vie for control, Arjun targets opium farms in both regions. Nannu and Jo grow closer, while Tipu and Bunty search for Atmaram.

episodes.name: Chapter 5: Do Dil Mil Rahe Hain
episodes.overview: A desperate Jugnu throws caution to the wind, while Lekha's family struggles to cope. An attack on the hospital exposes Tipu to Atmaram's wrath.

episodes.name: Chapter 6: Pyaar Chutiyapa Hai
episodes.overview: Arjun attempts to find his own allies. Nannu's friendship with Jo drives a wedge between he and Gangu. Tipu plots a daring deed to help Lekha.

episodes.name: Chapter 7+8: Raat Baaki...
episodes.overview: As cops and cartels collide, one truck stands between chaos and control. When Lekha and the kids are pulled into danger, Arjun and Tipu take action.

seasons.name: Limited Series
seasons.overview: An office worker who is insecure about her looks becomes a masked internet personality by night — until a chain of ill-fated events overtakes her life.

episodes.name: Kim Mo-mi
episodes.overview: All Kim Mo-mi wanted in life was to be in the spotlight. Her double life as Mask Girl allowed her to do just that. How long until the secrets unravel?

episodes.name: Ju Oh-nam
episodes.overview: True love, or plain infatuation? Lonely recluse Ju Oh-nam is Mask Girl's number one fan. Then one day, an astonishing discovery brings him closer to her.

episodes.name: Kim Kyung-ja
episodes.overview: Poverty. Betrayal. Divorce. Life wasn't always easy for Kim Kyung-ja. When tragedy befalls a loved one, she decides to take matters into her own hands.

episodes.name: Kim Chun-ae
episodes.overview: Kim Chun-ae finds herself trapped in a bad romance with a parasitic, would-be K-pop idol. Will she be able to find her way out?

episodes.name: Kim Mi-mo
episodes.overview: Mo-mi pays a surprise visit to an estranged family member. Some years later, an innocent child suffers the repercussions of Mo-mi's crimes.

episodes.name: Kim Mo-mi
episodes.overview: Life behind bars is no picnic, but Mo-mi slowly finds her feet. When a suspicious letter —and visitor — arrive, she confronts a shocking truth.

episodes.name: Mo-mi and Mi-mo
episodes.overview: Mo-mi puts her plan in motion. Kyung-ja sets out to settle the score. Will the two foes find justice, once and for all?

episodes.name: The Arrival
episodes.overview: As the Dark Rebel Army closes in, the Kingdom of Meta-llicana falls to its knees. Its only hope lies in awakening a powerful but evil sorcerer.

episodes.name: Rampage
episodes.overview: Left with no other option, Yoko revives Dark Schneider once again when a terrifying multiheaded monster attacks the Kingdom of Meta-llicana.

episodes.name: Abduction
episodes.overview: The first of four seals that contain the God of Destruction breaks. As a crisis looms in sight, Yoko grapples with conflicting emotions.

episodes.name: Invasion
episodes.overview: Sheila and Dark Schneider set out to free Yoko, whose captor threatens to torment her unless she discloses how she unseals the powerful wizard.

episodes.name: Showdown
episodes.overview: The demon god Efreet unleashes deadly flames, and Dark Schneider must find a way out in order to save Yoko.

episodes.name: Destiny
episodes.overview: Outraged by Dark Schneider's success, Kall-Su orders Arshes Nei, a half-dark elf, to put an end to the reincarnated wizard before he grows too strong.

episodes.name: The Demon Beast
episodes.overview: Arshes Nei sends sorcerer Kai Harn to defeat Dark Schneider, who uses High Ancient Magic to try to turn him into a stone statue.

episodes.name: The Progenitor
episodes.overview: Lucien reunites with Yoko in the forest, but they are soon attacked by a Werewolf soldier working for Count Di-amon, a powerful vampire.

episodes.name: Blue Nail
episodes.overview: While Dark Schneider struggles to break free from captivity, Yoko, Kai Harn and Sean Ari fend for themselves against Di-amon.

episodes.name: The Goddess of Thunder
episodes.overview: The remaining members of the Divine Kings gather and vow to eliminate Dark Schneider. Abigail tests Arshes Nei's loyalty to their mission.

episodes.name: Prophecy
episodes.overview: Dark Schneider and Arshes Nei reunite for the first time since his reincarnation. Baba, an old woman with prophetic powers, has an alarming vision.

episodes.name: Life or Death
episodes.overview: Arshes Nei unleashes a surprise attack on the castle, getting the upper hand in her battle against a disarmed adversary.

episodes.name: Wavering
episodes.overview: Nearly equal in strength, two opponents ratchet up the rapidly escalating fight. Meanwhile, the warriors struggle with their emotions.

episodes.name: Moved to Tears
episodes.overview: After Dark Schneider's sacrifice, his allies grieve a major loss. Meanwhile, Kall-Su and Abigail’s Army of Decay continue to wreak havoc.

episodes.name: Triumphant Return
episodes.overview: Arshes and Gara face-off against Lynch but realize they are no match against the ruthless creature. Abigail receives word of Dark Schneider’s return.

episodes.name: Incantation
episodes.overview: With his newfound strength, Dark Schneider attempts to face Vivian — a Devil Mace-wielding cyclops fueled by Anthrasax’s immense power — all on his own.

episodes.name: Ring
episodes.overview: Lich reaches Meta-llicana, seeking vengeance against Dark Schneider. The two face off but Arshes notices that something is off.

episodes.name: Secrets of the Sword
episodes.overview: Yoko fearlessly stands up against Abigail. Facing Lich alone, Gara’s only chance of survival is to use the full potential of the Murasame Blade.

episodes.name: Empress of Thunder
episodes.overview: Sensing danger, Arshes heads to Meta-llicana Castle and stops Abigail in his tracks when he sets out to collect the last seal.

episodes.name: Tyranny
episodes.overview: After learning the secret of the final seal, Dark Schneider agrees to protect Sheila. Abigail reveals his true self and turns the tables on Arshes Nei.

episodes.name: Fierce Battle
episodes.overview: Dark Schneider puts up a good fight against the evolved Abigail, but things take a turn for the worst when the dark wizard’s plan backfires.

episodes.name: Conclusion
episodes.overview: The castle walls crumble with the full force of Dark Schneider’s Helloween spell, but Abigail seems unaffected. Arshes swoops in to assist her lover.

episodes.name: Annihilation
episodes.overview: Arshes and Gara stand up to Abigail but are in no condition to fight. Abigail preys on Dark Schneider’s ultimate weakness.

episodes.name: End
episodes.overview: As Abigail taunts Dark Schneider for possessing a human heart, fire spirits come to the rescue and assist the wizard in one final battle.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: With the fall of Meta-llicana Castle and Dark Schneider, Kall-Su continues to terrorize Central Metallion Continent with the help of his Sorcerer Shogun.

episodes.name: Rebellion
episodes.overview: A leading member of the Sorcerer Shogun, Yngwie von Mattström conquers one city after another. Meanwhile, samurai masters try to secure food supplies.

episodes.name: Fate
episodes.overview: Samurai centurion Jorg Fishes faces off against Sorcerer Shogun Macapine Toni Strauss. Kall-Su reveals his sinister plans to rule the world.

episodes.name: Blue Storm
episodes.overview: The samurai corps brace themselves for the upcoming invasion. With no hope in sight, Yoko attempts a spell that comes at a heavy price.

episodes.name: Dawn
episodes.overview: The tables turn when a powerful ally makes a sudden appearance. Later, a defeated Macapine Toni Strauss lands in front of an unlikely survivor.

episodes.name: Ice and Snow
episodes.overview: Di-amon barges into Kall-Su's castle and stirs chaos. As Kall-Su's powers grow uncannily strong, Shella E,Lee notices that something is off.

episodes.name: Departure
episodes.overview: Kall-Su tasks demi-humans to deal with rioters, while he has grander plans for his Sorcerer Shoguns. Yoko deals with an untamed Dark Schneider.

episodes.name: Teleportation
episodes.overview: Yoko and crew learn about Kall-Su's sinister plans. Later, they are called to the basement of the castle and discover an ancient artifact.

episodes.name: Magic Land
episodes.overview: Left in the castle, Shella E, Lee learns the shocking truth. The Sorcerer Shogun experience unexpected turbulence on their way to King Crimson Glory.

episodes.name: Legend
episodes.overview: A young village boy listens to a bedtime story about the civilization that created Anthrasax. Meanwhile, Yoko and crew land in King Crimson Glory.

episodes.name: Distant Thunder
episodes.overview: Bol Gil Bol faces off against Dark Schneider. Gara and Macapine Toni Strauss face a threat. Arshes Nei dreams of her past.

episodes.name: Holy War I
episodes.overview: When a formidable opponent makes a sudden appearance, the samurai corps have a change of heart about Dark Schneider. Sheila finds herself in danger.

episodes.name: Holy War II
episodes.overview: A fierce showdown between the samurai corps and Sorcerer Shogun takes place. Kall-Su gets dangerously close to unlocking the final seal.

episodes.name: Holy War III
episodes.overview: Sheila experiences a sudden change in condition. Kall-Su and Dark Schneider unleash an epic battle of ice versus fire.

episodes.name: Holy War IV
episodes.overview: United over a common enemy, the samurai corps inspire the grieving Sorcerer Shogun with their unwavering spirit.

episodes.name: Gathering
episodes.overview: Unconscious within the beast, Kall-Su has flashbacks to his past. Determined to save his friend, Dark Schneider wields majestic powers like no other.

episodes.overview: Five inmates face Judgement Day as Uorfi Javed and Hina Khan interrogate secrets and deception, trying to uncover the truth behind their words.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Fifteen celebrity inmates face judgement day in a new-age prison, where a game of power and redemption determines who stays or goes.

episodes.name: Famous, Accused, Locked.
episodes.overview: Fifteen inmates enter a new-age jail where they must confront unflattering labels, shocking secrets and harsh criticism from each other.

episodes.name: Tagged and Targeted
episodes.overview: A new status system forces inmates to deal with harsh labels, manage shared resources and compete in a group challenge that sparks emotional meltdowns.

episodes.name: The Jailor’s Bargain
episodes.overview: Akanksha and Harshad's strategy sparks a heated debate. Five inmates have a chance to reveal another's secret for safety, leaving some in fear.

episodes.name: The First Chargesheet
episodes.overview: Jailer Farah's first chargesheet puts five inmates at risk while tensions rise between Ram and Akanksha. Sufi has a vulnerable moment.

episodes.name: Survive the Crackdown
episodes.overview: Crackdown brings a high-stakes task, giving the inmates one last chance to secure themselves. Shreya clashes with Dheeraj and Pamela.

episodes.name: Judgement Day
episodes.overview: The inmates face hard truths as Kangana Ranaut voices public critiques. An overheard secret leads to betrayal, while the journey ends for one inmate.

episodes.name: Hungry for More
episodes.overview: Hunger grips the inmates as their funds run dry. Sunita and Ram revolt against the game's tactics. A diamond hunt offers a way to secure more food.

episodes.name: The Bid and The Bomb
episodes.overview: Save their friends — or funds for food? As the inmates bid for safety, a new arrival stirs things up, threatening to split the prison wide open.

episodes.name: Greed v/s Need
episodes.overview: Shreya's behavior leaves Shivangi shaken, sparking an unexpected reaction from Harshad. Dynamics shift as inmates scramble to win special advantages.

episodes.name: Love and War
episodes.overview: A stark split in the jail creates two warring factions with no middle ground. A heated clash between Akanksha Chaudhary and Shreya rattles everyone.

episodes.name: The Visitor
episodes.overview: A special guest's visit stirs an emotional reckoning for Akanksha Chamola. The inmates pick sides as the jail's divisions grow deeper.

episodes.name: The Storm Arrives
episodes.overview: It's Judgement Day, and the jailers aren't holding back in their critiques. As inmates fight to stay, a shocking secret is revealed and two go home.

episodes.name: Control or Chaos
episodes.overview: A reshuffling forces new cellmates — a controller and a dependent — to work together, but the challenge soon throws the prison into chaos.

episodes.name: The Price of Control
episodes.overview: Friends become rivals as a new dynamic tears bonds apart, and the stakes rise when a task puts the dependent's darkest secret in the controller's hands.

episodes.name: Powers, Secrets, Termination
episodes.overview: Friendship erodes in the jail and a new secret is revealed. A shocking midweek Judgement Day decision sends two inmates home.

episodes.name: Nothing stays fun
episodes.overview: Varun makes a surprising discovery in the secret room. Pamala's talk show brings out hidden talents and new tension among the inmates.

episodes.name: Messy Business
episodes.overview: Chaos reigns in the crackdown as controllers attempt to stack tile towers, but frustrations and sabotage take over. Who will crack under the pressure?

episodes.name: Shock and Terminate
episodes.overview: A stunning Judgement Day sees one inmate returning and another leaving. Five controllers fight for the power to eliminate.

episodes.name: Gang Up
episodes.overview: Under new leaders, two gangs battle for the upper hand in high-stakes challenges, where the losers face a test of their survival skills.

episodes.name: The Struggle Is Real
episodes.overview: The inmates compete for powers that decide if they live in comfort or scramble for resources. Dheeraj gets a warning and Shilpa's antics stir trouble.

episodes.name: Discarded
episodes.overview: Conflict between teams intensifies as rebellion grows in the jail. Three inmates are left without a gang, but a new leader may soon change that.

episodes.name: The New Force
episodes.overview: An agent of disruption arrives — as Apoorva separates the sincere from the pretenders, a new gang holds the power to change the rules.

episodes.name: The Temperature Rises
episodes.overview: Emotions run high as Shivangi stands her ground and Apoorva holds a hard line. Shilpa's helping hand leads to tears and turmoil.

episodes.name: Game Over
episodes.overview: Five inmates face Judgement Day as Uorfi Javed and Hina Khan interrogate secrets and deception, trying to uncover the truth behind their words.

episodes.name: Secrets for Sale
episodes.overview: The final leg begins and Lock Upp raises the stakes. Apoorva secretly controls a lie detector test. A surprise reveal puts two inmates back in action.

episodes.name: Truth Hits Different
episodes.overview: Yogesh's comments draw Riteish's ire. After a secret-revealing task begins, two emotional confessions leave the jail shaken.

episodes.name: The Weight of Redemption
episodes.overview: A redemption task compels some inmates to reveal long-held secrets, revisiting painful chapters from their past. Farah unveils a path to the finale.

episodes.name: More Than a Visit
episodes.overview: Shreya and Shilpa clash as visitors bluff to protect their loved ones, with four inmates securing spots in the finale week.

episodes.name: Not Your Fight
episodes.overview: The final crackdown gives visitors the power to save or sabotage the at-risk inmates as Pamala realizes she's being targeted.

episodes.name: Ep. 30 - Shaken and Stirred
episodes.overview: Pamala lashes out at Ram and Varun in the aftermath of the crackdown. Varun makes a candid admission about his past.

episodes.name: Ep. 31 - Heavy Verdict
episodes.overview: Tensions run high as the final Judgement Day brings emotional closures. A task lays out minefields for more than one inmate.

episodes.name: Ep. 32 - The Feast
episodes.overview: The inmates share a lavish meal that becomes a turning point. Two friends face an emotional standoff with one hour to crown the first finalist.

episodes.name: Ep. 33 - The Worthy and the Not
episodes.overview: The prison reels from Harshad's shocking decision. Later, the jailers introduce a twist that puts power in unexpected hands.

episodes.name: Ep. 34 - The Power of Two
episodes.overview: Shreya and Shivangi call the shots as Ram's shifting loyalties surprise the house, with more than one inmate missing out on the finale.

episodes.name: Ep. 35 - Redemption Day
episodes.overview: Five inmates face the final stretch of their redemption journeys, taking on intense challenges and the jury's scrutiny before the winner is crowned.

episodes.name: The Deal
episodes.overview: After his brother is arrested in a drug bust, a desperate Gurnaam Singh agrees to work with police. As elections approach, a deadly plot is hatched.

episodes.name: The Invasion
episodes.overview: Past tragedies continue to haunt Gurnaam. After infiltrating Madam Aulakh's inner circle, he goes after Mukhtiyaar Singh, a major drug supplier.

episodes.name: The Imposter
episodes.overview: Leading a double life, Gurnaam leaks information to police while staying close to Laadi. A police raid threatens to jeopardize his cover.

episodes.name: The Takeover
episodes.overview: A deadly fight ensues when Gurnaam's identity is compromised. Kimi's interest in singer Rocky grows while drawing Madam Aulakh's ire.

episodes.name: The Crossroad
episodes.overview: Madam Aulakh's horrifying past — and rise to power — is revealed. As the gang hunts for the source of a new drug, Gurnaam makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.name: The Escape
episodes.overview: As a despondent Sunny struggles to cope, Gurnaam anxiously attempts to get his brother out of the country and turns to Sehtab Singh for help.

episodes.name: The Deceit
episodes.overview: An unlikely family connection emerges, while a figure from Sehtab's past returns. Later, Madam Aulakh makes a proposal to Gurnaam.

episodes.name: The Masterplan
episodes.overview: Fueled by rage, Gurnaam seeks to avenge his parents' death. But as a deceptive truth surfaces, new dangers threaten to upend his life.

episodes.name: TIME.1
episodes.overview: As Toru Amuro, Rei Furuya starts his day bright and early to open up Café Poirot, the bustling coffee shop located under the Mouri detective agency.

episodes.name: TIME.2
episodes.overview: While working at Poirot, Rei has to duck out to chase down a fugitive. During his intense daily workout, Rei comes across an adorable little dog.

episodes.name: TIME.3
episodes.overview: After an eventful night, Rei goes undercover to a popular curry shop and meets up with Kazami, who bravely orders the spiciest curry on the menu.

episodes.name: TIME.4
episodes.overview: While chasing a thief, Rei unknowingly participates in an obstacle course game show. Later, as he teaches a boy to ride a bike, a memory surfaces.

episodes.name: TIME.5
episodes.overview: After a brief encounter with an FBI agent, Rei washes his beloved car and discovers an adorable little dog that's determined to win his heart.

episodes.name: TIME.6
episodes.overview: Rei doesn’t know what to call his furry friend yet — but discovers that the dog loves his guitar playing, which inspires the perfect name.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Fighter-in-training Jin lives with his mother in their secluded home — until an abrupt encounter forces Jin to seek out his mysterious grandfather.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Jin begins his grueling tutelage under his grandfather, Heihachi. Missing fighters and a strange artifact raise Heihachi’s curiosity.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: After years of preparation, Jin and a roster of fighters assemble for the King of Iron Fist Tournament. Jin learns about his family’s dark history.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Jin struggles to control his rage while in the ring. Ling Xiaoyu goes toe-to-toe with a cold-blooded assassin.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Jin discovers the truth behind Heihachi and Ogre. As the tournament winds down, a surprising fighter decides to enter the ring.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: With the opportunity for vengeance finally within his reach, Jin unleashes a hellish rage against his final opponent. But at what cost?

episodes.name: Not All Neighbors Are Good Neighbors
episodes.overview: In search of a new beginning, Lee Eun-pyo moves into a new apartment. She finds a note left by a former tenant to beware of Kim Yu-bin's mom.

episodes.name: Adults Don't Make Friends Without Motives
episodes.overview: Eun-pyo grows anxious when she sees her son, Jung Dong-seok, being disruptive in class. Byeon Chun-hui is appointed head of the PTA.

episodes.name: That Dawn Before the Day Breaks
episodes.overview: When Eun-pyo overhears that her son has been blacklisted by the school community, she decides to leave the neighborhood.

episodes.name: Entering Green Mothers' Club
episodes.overview: Eun-pyo tries to get Dong-seok into Yu-bin's group for the Rube Goldberg Competition. Seo Jin-ha's son, Henry Benuel, joins an opposing team.

episodes.name: An Ill-Fated Match Made in Heaven
episodes.overview: At the art exhibit, Eun-pyo encounters someone she was hoping to avoid and Jin-ha meets someone who reminds her of her painful past.

episodes.name: A Letter From the Dead
episodes.overview: As tragedy stirs the community, everyone tries to find out what happened while covering up their own tracks. Eun-pyo discovers a mysterious note.

episodes.name: The Scarlet Letter
episodes.overview: As rumors grow more rampant, the moms are called to attend a group session at school. Jung Jae-ung faces hard truths as his wife's past comes to light.

episodes.name: Your Downright Lie
episodes.overview: Seeing that the case may soon come to a close, Jae-ung moves quickly to find the real cause of death. More gossip bubbles beneath the surface.

episodes.name: Towards the Top 0.01%
episodes.overview: To protect her family and to climb the social ladder, Eun-pyo banks on Dong-seok's abilities. Kim Yeong-mi begins to suspect her husband.

episodes.name: Wind From the Tip of a Sword
episodes.overview: Upon receiving a tip from an informant, Louis Benuel brings in Chun-hui and Lee Man-su for questioning. Dong-seok appears on a TV show for gifted kids.

episodes.name: The Sins We Did Not Find Out About
episodes.overview: Dong-seok sees a child therapist. Chun-hui deals with Yu-bin's unusual behavior. Eun-pyo reaches out to the one person who can help her son feel better.

episodes.name: Can Adults Become Friends Without Motives Too?
episodes.overview: Eun-pyo makes peace with a mom who is on the same boat as her. Chun-hui faces growing financial pressure. Yeong-mi discovers a secret folder.

episodes.name: The Two Faces of Truth
episodes.overview: Eun-pyo turns to Chun-hui with shocking news. When Chun-hui advises her to stay put and be quiet, it only fuels Eun-pyo's drive to expose the truth.

episodes.name: Yellow Light
episodes.overview: Chun-hui gives her husband an ultimatum, but struggles to find a way to support her family alone. Jin-ha's housekeeper entrusts Eun-pyo with a secret.

episodes.name: Human Choice
episodes.overview: While out for drinks, Park Yun-ju witnesses a shady scene. When a message arrives on Jae-ung's phone, Eun-pyo makes an irrevocable decision.

episodes.name: The Warm Hand You Extended
episodes.overview: Brought in for questioning by the police, Chun-hui names who she thinks is the real suspect. Henry makes a devastating confession to his father.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: The first thing Hanzawa needs to do is find an apartment to live in, but it's almost impossible to find one where a murder hasn't taken place.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Hanzawa moves into a very nice apartment and becomes fast friends with a fellow resident. But then, a murder takes place.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Hanzawa heads to the town hall to run some errands, but must also make a pit stop in enemy territory — the local police station.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: It's an emergency: Hanzawa starts taking a nice morning shower, only to realizes that there's no shampoo in the bathroom.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: After waking up in a cold sweat from a nightmare, Hanzawa makes a terrible decision and goes out into the dangerous streets of Beika at night.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Hanzawa needs a job fast, but the only work available is risky, scary, and probably illegal. But desperate times call for desperate measures.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Finally, Hanzawa gets a job at a new video rental shop. But then, the manager gets murdered — and all eyes turn to Hanzawa!?

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: While stopping by a pet shop, Hanzawa has a fateful meeting with an impossibly cute, fluffy and very, very expensive Pomeranian.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: In an effort to look cool, Hanzawa goes out in search of some fashionable clothes. But watch out; in this town, the wrong outfit can get you killed.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Hanzawa’s mother comes to check out Beika — but then a hostage incident occurs, and she might be one of the victims!?

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: It's been a few months since moving to Beika, and Hanzawa hasn't gotten any closer to murdering that certain man.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Hanzawa has finally found the man, which can only mean one thing; it's murder time! But then, a certain master thief shows up.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Han Jun-hee continues to grieve Koo Yeon-jun. When she receives mysterious flowers on her birthday, she has an odd feeling that her late lover may be nearby.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: While investigating her lookalike, Jun-hee receives a strange package. Kwon Min-ju develops a friendship with her crush but soon faces a huge letdown.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Jun-hee tries to make sense of Min-ju's recollections that get jumbled up with her own. Nam Si-heon discovers a new side to Min-ju.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: As Jun-hee struggles to distinguish reality from her dreams, she receives an old diary that contains a shocking truth.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Back in 1998, Jun-hee's bubbly personality shines through Min-ju. Those around her begin to notice — including a mysterious figure who watches from afar.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Si-heon finds himself attracted to the new Min-ju. The love triangle grows when he decides to come clean to Jung In-gyu.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Jun-hee tries to warn the boys of the approaching danger. Meanwhile, a horrifying event takes place at school during the night.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Yeon-jun eventually finds his way to Jun-hee. He does whatever he can to enchant her, but falling in love is not as easy as it seems.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Jun-hee and Yeon-jun enjoy a stretch of happiness. Meanwhile, Si-heon deals with one obstacle after another.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Jun-hee vows to change the past and save Min-ju. Si-heon, while investigating the murder, stumbles upon a chilling truth.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Min-ju turns a blind eye to the dangers ahead and focuses on spending time with Si-heon. Si-heon and In-gyu, however, start to grow suspicious.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: As Min-ju takes her life into her own hands, Jun-hee makes a last-ditch effort. She and Si-heon later decide to finally make things right.

episodes.name: Prelude
episodes.overview: Kim Hye-joo clashes with her daughter after denying her a special opportunity. A shocking discovery throws the family into a painful situation.

episodes.name: The Accident
episodes.overview: An unexpected visitor shows up at Hye-joo's home. Assemblyman Nam Joong-do attempts to divert the public's attention from his family.

episodes.name: The Blame
episodes.overview: Hye-joo attempts to get closer to Kim Soo-bin. Meanwhile, Joong-do deals with the public and personal aftermath of his political actions.

episodes.name: The Visit
episodes.overview: As Soo-bin spends more time at Joong-do's house, she's given a warning. Hye-joo's past begins catching up to her.

episodes.name: Confrontation
episodes.overview: An unexpected encounter at her home leaves Hye-joo feeling distressed. Jin Seung-hee attempts to please her mother amid the hostility.

episodes.name: Pain
episodes.overview: Seung-hee uses her leverage to make things right for her mother. Joong-do asks Jang Woo-jae to investigate Hye-joo's past.

episodes.name: The Promise
episodes.overview: Joong-do finds out the truth about Hye-joo's secret and vows to take care of her. Woo-jae warns Choi Ki-young against rehashing Hye-joo's past.

episodes.name: The Right Thing To Do
episodes.overview: Ki-young asks Hye-joo for an uncomfortable favor, leaving her feeling conflicted. Hye-joo later confronts Joong-do about his TV appearance.

episodes.name: Sincerity
episodes.overview: Hye-joo discovers a shocking piece of information about her son's death. Meanwhile, Soo-bin disappears from Hye-joo's home.

episodes.name: Doubt
episodes.overview: Hye-joo meets with a man claiming to be her late son's friend. Joong-do asks Hye-joo for permission to go public with her painful past.

episodes.name: The Nightmare
episodes.overview: Hye-joo confronts Joong-do about his calculated political decision. Lee Yoo-sin discovers Hye-joo's identity as Joong-do's wife.

episodes.name: Reality
episodes.overview: Joong-do goes against Hye-joo's wishes and publicly announces a shocking development. Hye-joo later demands answers from Soo-bin.

episodes.name: Infidelity
episodes.overview: Hye-joo interrogates Joong-do about his inconsistencies. Seung-hee exposes Hye-joo's past to the world — forcing her to go on the defensive.

episodes.name: Denial
episodes.overview: Hye-joo begins questioning everything around her after hearing a shocking revelation from Soo-bin. Joong-do learns the truth behind his son's death.

episodes.name: The Truth
episodes.overview: Hye-joo goes on TV to reveal her past to the public. Hyeon Yeo-jin later confesses her horrifying secret to Hye-joo — turning her world upside down.

episodes.name: Choice
episodes.overview: As the web of lies unravels, Hye-joo and Joong-do face the consequences of their actions. Seung-hee finally comes around to the truth about her family.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Brilliant attorney Woo Young-woo tackles challenges in the courtroom and beyond as a newbie at a top law firm and a woman on the autism spectrum.

episodes.name: Extraordinary Attorney Woo
episodes.overview: On her first day at a new job, Woo Young-woo meets an ally, a skeptic and an old acquaintance. She takes on an assault case involving an elderly couple.

episodes.name: The Wedding Dress That Slipped Off
episodes.overview: The father of a bride sues a hotel for a wedding that ended in a humiliating disaster. Lee Jun-ho asks Young-woo to share her whale facts over lunch.

episodes.name: This Is Pengsoo
episodes.overview: A tragedy surrounding two brothers forces a family to face a difficult truth. Young-woo attempts to bridge a communication gap with a client.

episodes.name: The Strife of the Three Brothers
episodes.overview: Dong Geu-ra-mi seeks legal advice from Young-woo when her father unknowingly agrees to take on a massive debt. Kwon Min-woo broods in resentment.

episodes.name: Wild Card vs. Tactician
episodes.overview: A copyright battle between two ATM companies stokes a rivalry between Young-woo and Min-woo. Geu-ra-mi teaches Young-woo how to spot a liar.

episodes.name: If I Were a Whale...
episodes.overview: Young-woo joins Choi Su-yeon in her mission to reunite a mother with her daughter. They explore every avenue to reduce a four-year sentence.

episodes.name: A Tale About Sodeok-dong (1)
episodes.overview: Residents of a small town file a class-action lawsuit to stop the construction of a highway. Hanbada Law Firm goes up against their biggest competitor.

episodes.name: A Tale About Sodeok-dong (2)
episodes.overview: Taesan Law Firm keeps a step ahead of Hanbada Law Firm as conditions lean in their favor. Tae Su-mi makes an offer to Young-woo.

episodes.name: The Pied Piper
episodes.overview: A self-proclaimed leader of the children’s liberation movement gets arrested for kidnapping. Young-woo tries to win Jun-ho’s affection.

episodes.name: Holding Hands Can Wait
episodes.overview: A man faces jail time for taking advantage of a woman with a disability. Jun-ho’s peers frown on his relationship. Min-woo pries into Young-woo's life.

episodes.name: Mr. Salt, Ms. Pepper and Attorney Soy Sauce
episodes.overview: Young-woo lands in a tricky legal position after a married couple seeks counsel to help settle a dispute involving a massive lottery win.

episodes.name: Yangtze River Dolphin
episodes.overview: Young-woo encounters Hanbada’s dark side while working on a wrongful termination lawsuit. Jung Myeong-seok fears he has a target on his back.

episodes.name: The Blue Night of Jeju (1)
episodes.overview: A temple on Jeju Island goes to court for charging admission to the public, Young-woo meets Jun-ho’s family, and Myeong-seok reflects on his life.

episodes.name: The Blue Night of Jeju (2)
episodes.overview: The Hanbada lawyers look for the owner of Myeong-seok’s favorite noodle shop. Young-woo faces obstacles at the trial and in her relationship with Jun-ho.

episodes.name: Saying and Doing Things Not Asked
episodes.overview: When Young-woo clashes with her new supervisor during a case for a large online retailer, Myeong-seok advises her to lie low and lean on her peers.

episodes.name: Though Unusual and Peculiar
episodes.overview: Young-woo receives evidence that could make or break her case, while Min-woo changes his plans — and Jun-ho follows his heart.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Heir Gu Won cannot stand fake smiles. When he meets Cheon Sa-rang, her sincere smile is at the ready. The pair seek to create happy moments where they can smile brightly at each other. King the Land is a VVIP business lounge, a paradise catering to wealthy ho…

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Cheon Sa-rang begins her job at King Hotel — despite the occasional hiccups. Gu Won struggles to integrate himself into the family business.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: After an awkward interaction, Sa-rang and Won get off to a bad start — later embarking on a trip together. Sa-rang faces relationship problems.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: During their contentious trip, Sa-rang and Won share a moment of vulnerability. While Sa-rang later earns praise, Won faces hostility from his family.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Won navigates his sudden feelings for Sa-rang. Sa-rang begins her new role — putting her closer to Won.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Won's unexpected attempts to get closer to Sa-rang leave her feeling confused. Meanwhile, Won disapproves of Sa-rang's work responsibilities.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Won hurries to Sa-rang during her time of need. After spending the following days together, Won asks her an important question.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Won continues to court Sa-rang, despite her hesitance. An Arab prince visits the hotel and begins competing with Won for Sa-rang's attention.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Prince Samir arranges a party for Sa-rang — much to Won's jealousy. Won later invites Sa-rang on a date, pulling out all the stops.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Won and Sa-rang navigate their relationship after their momentous night — later having to win the approval of an important figure in Sa-rang's life.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Won takes Sa-rang and her friends on a trip abroad, but struggles to find alone time with her. He later opens up about his past to Sa-rang.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: With much at stake, Won accepts the task of running the hotel's 100th anniversary. Sa-rang meets an employee who may hold clues to Won's past.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Won and Gu Hwa-ran attempt to figure out the future of King Group. Just as Sa-rang and Won's relationship solidifies, an unexpected guest arrives.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: An uncomfortable encounter leaves Sa-rang and Won in an awkward place. Won prepares his presentation — facing his family with his plans for the future.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Won and Sa-rang go into damage control after Hwa-ran's act of sabotage. Sa-rang receives a stern request from Won's father.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Won unexpectedly encounters a figure from his past. After he visits Sa-rang at her new location, he makes a decision about the hotel branch.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Sa-rang finally makes a decisive choice about her future. After delaying his plans to make room for Sa-rang's, Won approaches her with a question.

seasons.name: Class 1
seasons.overview: With the aid of unexpected friends, a gifted but introverted student confronts bullies and violent foes — unaware of how dangerous his world will become.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Si-eun is a model student who is always at the top of his school. Because he only cares about his studies, he has no friends at school. Young-bin, a boy in Si-eun's class, is annoyed by Si-eun's cynical attitude. On a mock test day, Young-bin decides to use B…

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Young-bin wants revenge on Si-eun for putting him in the hospital by hiring a couple of thugs he knows. Meanwhile, Si-eun gets closer to Soo-ho and becomes friends. Later, Soo-ho comes to Si-eun's rescue when he gets confronted by Young-bin and his thugs.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: When Gil-su sees his boys beaten up to a pulp, he gets furious and asks who did it. Young-bin lures Si-eun, Bum-seok, and Soo-ho and takes them to Gil-su. Gil-su threatens them to bring him 15 million won in three days. Si-eun asks Young for advice and inform…

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Si-eun sees Soo-ho's blood on the floor and calls Young-yi for help. Gil-su tells Seok-dae to come, so Young-yi follows him with her GPS tracking app on. Meanwhile, Soo-ho and Bum-seok are tied up by Gil-su's gang.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: While hanging out in a karaoke room with his friends, Bum-seok runs into the bullies from his previous school. Soo-ho makes them apologize, but Bum-seok isn't happy with Soo-ho ordering him around. Si-eun becomes more worried about Bum-seok who seems to be ge…

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Bum-seok befriends with Jeong-chan and Tae-hoon, he reeks of alcohol every day. Si-eun thinks Bum-seok is being used by Jeong-chan and Tae-hoon. He also thinks Bum-seok is behaving that way because he is lonely. Si-eun wants to help Bum-seok, but Soo-ho think…

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Si-eun gets beaten up by the guys Bum-seok paid to beat up Soo-ho. Si-eun gets seriously injured, but he doesn't tell Soo-ho about it to protect Bum-seok. Soo-ho finds out later and decides to confront Bum-seok. Bum-seok pays Woo-young again to beat up Soo-ho.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Si-eun and Young-yi get anxious as they can't get hold of Soo-ho for too long. After Si-eun finishes his exams, he hears the shocking news. Meanwhile, Bum-seok's dad tries to make Bum-seok go study abroad.

seasons.name: Class 2
seasons.overview: After losing his friend to violence, model student Yeon Si-eun vows not to repeat history at his new school in a tale of dazzling growth and desperate survival.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Still affected by what happened to Su-ho, Si-eun withdraws from others. Seo Jun-tae contemplates taking a stand against the bullies — despite the risks.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: After being saved by Si-eun, Jun-tae attempts to befriend him — but both are soon dragged into Choi Hyo-man's revenge plot involving Go Hyun-tak.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: While doing volunteer work as punishment for fighting, Si-eun begins to form a bond with new friends — but trouble continues to find him.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: After Geum Seong-je crosses the line, Si-eun strikes a deal with Na Baek-jin — leaving Park Hu-min, Hyun-tak and Jun-tae alone in the violent crosshairs.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Worried for his father and backed into a corner, Hu-min confronts Baek-jin. Si-eun considers studying abroad after clashing with his distressed mother.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Si-eun, Jun-tae, and Hyun-tak seek out Hu-min, who has decided to work with Baek-jin to keep the peace. Still, Hu-min finds it difficult to comply.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: As Si-eun's absence leaves a gap, Baek-jin presses on with his violent mission. In response, Hu-min rallies his school and challenges him to a showdown.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Hu-min, Hyun-tak and Eunjang students gather to engage in a final confrontation against Baek-jin's gang. In the end, who will prevail?

episodes.name: Hello, Halloween!
episodes.overview: Mr. Roarson invites his teacher, Master Gigi, to Challenge Island to celebrate Halloween, but unfortunately the turtle can't find his way around. Will they meet in time before the day is out?

episodes.name: Dressing up for Halloween
episodes.overview: Walking with Shimajiro across the island to see what costumes his friends are wearing for Halloween, Tamasaburo can't decide what to wear, as he doesn't want to be the same thing as anyone else. What will he dress up as?

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A mother with a heart of gold navigates the cutthroat world of private education when her daughter tries to join a celebrity math instructor’s class.

episodes.name: You and I, the Intersection of Two Universes
episodes.overview: As competition in her class ramps up, Nam Hae-e anxiously awaits her math score. Choi Chi-yeol is embroiled in a scandal involving one of his students.

episodes.name: Probability of Encountering Your Enemy at Your Worst
episodes.overview: Nam Haeng-seon attempts to register Hae-e into The Pride Academy. Desperate for Haeng-seon's food, Chi-yeol visits her store in a disguise.

episodes.name: Number of Outcomes Where Dislike Becomes Like
episodes.overview: Haeng-seon begins fawning over Chi-yeol after discovering his true identity. A change in the Pride Academy's schedule creates a stir among the parents.

episodes.name: Revolt of the Arithmetic Sequence
episodes.overview: Haeng-seon gets a taste of the vicious politics among the academy's parents. She later goes to great lengths to make things right for Hae-e.

episodes.name: The Secret Probability Distribution of X and Y
episodes.overview: Haeng-seon and Chi-yeol work out an arrangement for Hae-e's tutoring. A mysterious tragedy leaves the academy and its parents rattled.

episodes.name: There Are No Correct Answers in Life, Only Best Answers
episodes.overview: A painful past comes back to haunt Chi-yeol. Bang Su-a becomes suspicious of Hae-e after finding her secret worksheets on her desk.

episodes.name: The Very Average Laws of Attraction
episodes.overview: Hae-e ranks first in her class, causing drama among other parents. Chi-yeol and Haeng-seon grow closer as he spends more time with her family.

episodes.name: Chance Becomes Fate through Inductive Reasoning
episodes.overview: Haeng-seon realizes her own feelings after seeing Chi-yeol at the academy. Su-a connects the dots and begins to make sense of Hae-e's recent successes.

episodes.name: The Butterfly Effect of Our Relationship
episodes.overview: Chi-yeol and Haeng-seon deal with the fallout after their secret is discovered — forcing the two to confront what it means for them moving forward.

episodes.name: Emotion, the Variable That Alters Relationships
episodes.overview: A public revelation leaves Haeng-seon and Chi-yeol's relationship in limbo. Meanwhile, Chi-yeol faces the repercussions of recent events.

episodes.name: The Functional Relationship of Our Love
episodes.overview: Tired of her loved ones facing scrutiny, Hae-e makes a bold confession to the world. Haeng-seon and Chi-yeol navigate their road ahead post-scandal.

episodes.name: Point of Intersection between Comedy and Tragedy
episodes.overview: A shocking arrest leaves the academy's parents — and Hae-e — concerned. Haeng-seon and Chi-yeol maneuver the days after their first fight.

episodes.name: How We Approach an Unsolvable Conjecture
episodes.overview: Hae-e attempts to get a hold of Lee Sun-jae after being put in a difficult position at school. Haeng-seon catches Ji Dong-hui in a hostile moment.

episodes.name: Find the Unique Solution
episodes.overview: News about Hae-e leaves those around her feeling rattled. Haeng-seon begins to suspect something's off. Chi-yeol confronts Dong-hui about his behavior.

episodes.name: The Result of Chance and Inevitability
episodes.overview: Lee Sun-jae's confession ignites a scandal at the school. Chi-yeol attempts to put an end to Dong-hui's scheme before it's too late.

episodes.name: You and I, the Union of Two Universes
episodes.overview: Grappling with her mother's return, Hae-e announces a shocking decision. Haeng-seon and Chi-yeol make a pivotal choice about their future.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Flailing at life, Lee Tang panics after he kills a man after work. Soon, Jang Nan-gam is on the case — discovering a disturbing truth about the victim.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: A mysterious woman approaches Tang, claiming to know his secret and begins to blackmail him. The weight of his actions starts taking a mental toll.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Nan-gam struggles to find clear answers as he investigates the latest deaths. After connecting with an enigmatic figure, Tang decides to turn himself in.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Wondering if the same killer is behind all the murders, Nan-gam probes Roh Bin for clues, leading to an unlikely partnership between the two.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: As Nan-gam notices a clear pattern among the recent murders, he searches for Tang — unaware of another mysterious man who is doing the same.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: In his search for Tang, Song Chon confronts Bin — who desperately turns to Nan-gam for help. But Tang agrees to meet with Chon, who has a proposition.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Nan-gam comes face to face with Chon, who recognizes him from the past. As Bin and Tang plan their final escape, Bin receives a menacing phone call.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: The endgame to the chase leads to a final fight — and it's everyone versus Chon. In the process, Nan-gam finally learns the truth about his father.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Spin-off of K-drama/series Strong Woman Do Bong Soon. It's a story of a daughter, mother, and grandmother with superhuman strength who get entangled in a drug case. Same as its original series that make pun from the lead character Do Bong-soon who is from Dob…

episodes.name: Birth of the Strong Girl
episodes.overview: Desperate for a reunion, Hwang Geum-ju seemingly finds her long-lost daughter. After discovering the truth, Gang Nam-soon prepares for her trip to Korea.

episodes.name: Gangnam, Here I Come
episodes.overview: Nam-soon begins her search for her parents in Korea but experiences some roadblocks. Geum-ju suspects something's off with her newfound daughter.

episodes.name: Three Generations
episodes.overview: The incident at the Han River puts a spotlight on Nam-soon. As Kang Hee-sik spends more time with Nam-soon, he connects the dots about her family.

episodes.name: Reunion
episodes.overview: After a dramatic reunion, Nam-soon becomes closer to her family. As Hee-sik continues to investigate a drug case, Nam-soon lends her assistance.

episodes.name: Vigilante of Seoul
episodes.overview: As Nam-soon assists Hee-sik in his drug investigation, she has a run-in with the ominous Ryu Si-o. Ri Hwa-ja plots her revenge against Nam-soon.

episodes.name: Mystery X
episodes.overview: Hee-sik witnesses the jarring effects of the drug when it strikes his team leader. Nam-soon's search for evidence garners attention from foes.

episodes.name: Moonbow
episodes.overview: Geum-ju pays a strategic visit to Si-o, who has his own motives. During a birthday dinner, Nam-soon's family questions her growing kinship with Hee-sik.

episodes.name: Light and Shadow of Gangnam
episodes.overview: Hee-sik begins to worry about Nam-soon after Si-o promotes her into his inner circle. Geum-ju probes deeper into a suspicious businessman.

episodes.name: The Root of Vice
episodes.overview: Nam-soon pulls off a bold heist, putting Si-o on high alert. During a tense meeting, Geum-ju challenges Si-o — who in return begins plotting his revenge.

episodes.name: The Stand-ins
episodes.overview: Geum-ju falls victim to Si-o's attack but proves she's one step ahead of him. As Nam-soon finally tracks down the drugs, her brother succumbs to them.

episodes.name: Breaking Point
episodes.overview: The drug infiltrates Nam-soon's family — prompting a search of the source and an antidote. A mourning Hee-sik furiously goes after Si-o's inner circle.

episodes.name: Diamond Cuts Diamond
episodes.overview: Si-o learns of Geum-ju's ruse and decides to expand his target. As the drug case becomes more intense, Hee-sik asks Nam-soon to move in with him.

episodes.name: Save the Sea Hares
episodes.overview: To find out Nam-soon's identity, Si-o narrows down his search and goes after her family. Hee-sik faces harsh discipline after news of the drug goes wide.

episodes.name: Forewarned Bloodbath
episodes.overview: Si-o vows revenge after discovering the truth about Nam-soon. While Hee-sik continues his investigation, Nam-soon and her family go on a trip to Busan.

episodes.name: Strong Girl Nam-soon
episodes.overview: Mourning the loss of Hwa-ja, Nam-soon directly challenges Si-o. But he refuses to lose, forcing her to endure incredible pain to save her adopted mother.

episodes.name: In the Name of Love and Justice
episodes.overview: With Nam-soon on the brink of death — Hee-sik rushes to find an antidote. Nam-soon faces Si-o once again but witnesses a surprising turn.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Life of Rana Naidu, Mumbai city's go-to-fixer, does the dirty work for the top power players; making the problems of the city's celebrities, superstar athletes, and business moguls disappear. But when his father is suddenly released from prison, the one mess…

episodes.name: He's back
episodes.overview: While burying scandals for cricketers and starlets, Rana Naidu contends with his father’s sudden release from jail. An illicit encounter irks Naina.

episodes.name: Teen karod
episodes.overview: Naga tries to bond with his family. Rana handles Prince’s latest problem, while a tentative friendship forms between Nitya and her neighbor, Rehaan.

episodes.name: Koi mar gaya kya?
episodes.overview: A car accident leaves OB — and his condition — in a vulnerable position. An unexpected meeting leads Naga to the chilling truth about his son.

episodes.name: Baap bete ke rishte
episodes.overview: With a plan and agenda of his own, Naga seeks to coax a confession out of Prince. Rana’s deal with Rehaan’s mother suffers a devastating setback.

episodes.name: Kitna gurda, kitna goo
episodes.overview: Trailed by a dogged cop, Rana takes matters into his own hands. Jaffa is drawn into the darkness when a party at his apartment spirals out of control.

episodes.name: Bheje ku light, gote ku tight
episodes.overview: Mining his past for a blockbuster film, Prince is forced to recall a harrowing night. Rana returns to Hyderabad in search of a notorious figure.

episodes.name: Nitya
episodes.overview: Memories of their late sister on her birthday bring the brothers together. A rebellious Nitya seeks out Rehaan in his childhood home.

episodes.name: Tu kya kiya?
episodes.overview: After asking Prince to accompany Ani to a glamorous award ceremony, Rana’s well-laid plans take a dark turn as Surya finally confronts Naga.

episodes.name: Maharaj
episodes.overview: Scrambling to keep Jaffa out of trouble, Tej and Rana begin to clash. Confined to a hotel room, Naina’s suspicions reach a boiling point.

episodes.name: Game over g*ndu
episodes.overview: As news of Surya’s presence in Mumbai spreads, Rana faces pressure to help him escape. Bullets fly in a bloody confrontation where no one is safe.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Having left behind his turbulent fixer life, Rana Naidu hopes for peace with his family. But when a powerful and ruthless billionaire with an ambitious daughter with her heart set on acquiring a cricket team, and a son squandering money on flop films, hires h…

episodes.name: One Last Job
episodes.overview: Rana faces a deadly mission to rescue his kidnapped son and must — reluctantly — team up with his estranged father while relying on a wealthy benefactor.

episodes.name: Bada Kutta
episodes.overview: As an enraged Rana confronts underworld kingpin Rauf in prison, a dissatisfied Naina confides in her new friend, Naveen.

episodes.name: Well Played, Mr Naidu
episodes.overview: In a tense game of blackmail and manipulation, Rauf pushes Rana to his limit. Family tensions come to a head during Ani's birthday party.

episodes.name: Kacchaa Limbu Saalaa
episodes.overview: Naga and Tej plan a heist at Oberoi Studios to retrieve a valuable item. Naina gets closer to Naveen, putting more strain on an already stressed Rana.

episodes.name: It Will Never Be Okay
episodes.overview: After Tej is brutally beaten in prison, Rana knows he must get him out quickly — all while protecting Nitya, who's caught in a deadly shootout.

episodes.name: Double Dholki
episodes.overview: Deep in Viraj Oberoi's debt, Rana has to clean up after a grisly murder. Meanwhile, Anjali manipulates Naga into taking on a suicidal mission.

episodes.name: Sumdi Mein Lomdi
episodes.overview: Naveen sees an opportunity to put Rana behind bars. Jaffa and Tasneem's wedding celebrations bring the entire family together — for a fateful event.

episodes.name: One Last Job, Again
episodes.overview: After a brutal attack puts some of his family in the hospital, Rana finally goes on the offensive against Rauf and his team.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: After running into an old friend, Miriam joins one last mission for the Inquisition to retrieve a mysterious object hidden at the summer palace.

episodes.name: A Woman Unseen
episodes.overview: After running into an old friend, Miriam joins one last mission for the Inquisition to retrieve a mysterious object hidden at the summer palace.

episodes.name: The Will of the Maker
episodes.overview: A magister seeks to uncover the history of the Circulum Infinitus. The team distracts the palace guards so they can sneak into the temple vault.

episodes.name: The Serpent's Coils
episodes.overview: To survive, Miriam and her team must get past the demons, hordes of undead and other magical forces lurking in the palace walls.

episodes.name: Those Who Falsely Dream
episodes.overview: An unexpected encounter with Rezaren and a shocking discovery thwart the escape plan. The city goes on lockdown as guards search for the thieves.

episodes.name: An Altar of Fire
episodes.overview: Looking for answers, the commander interrogates Hira. Miriam and her team return to the palace to face Rezaren and rescue their friend.

episodes.name: The Price of Salvation
episodes.overview: A betrayal reveals the true purpose of the mission. Determined to perform the ritual at any cost, Rezaren turns to a dark power for help.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Determined to find their mother, the optimistic Shakipiyo believes that anything is possible with hope, grit and friendship — even for the laziest egg.

episodes.name: What a Drag…
episodes.overview: Gudetama meets Shakipiyo, who has big dreams of meeting their mother — but the lazy egg could care less.

episodes.name: So Dizzy
episodes.overview: The duo find themselves in the middle of a bustling, chaotic kitchen. Gudetama accidentally gets separated from Shakipiyo.

episodes.name: Is That the Best This Country Has to Offer?
episodes.overview: Gudetama and Shakipiyo find themselves in the office of the Prime Minister, who receives inspiration from an unlikely aid.

episodes.name: Ahhhh
episodes.overview: As Gudetama falls from the sky, Shakipiyo comes to the rescue — will the determined chick make it in time?

episodes.name: You’re Rotten to the Core
episodes.overview: Gudetama and Shakipiyo continue searching for their mother, but to no avail. One bright sunny day, they bump into a rotten egg.

episodes.name: What a Cool Mascot
episodes.overview: In order to prevent Gudetama from rotting, Shakipiyo tries to mix with a dangerous crowd. But a hard-boiled stranger advises against it.

episodes.name: How Many Eggs are in that Omelet?
episodes.overview: Completely trapped with no way out, Gudetama, Shakipiyo and Hard-boiled make a deal with the Boss Omelet.

episodes.name: Give Up Already
episodes.overview: Separated once again, Gudetama gets taken to a local TV station where Director Inoue desperately tries to come up with a scoop.

episodes.name: We Wanna See Our Mom
episodes.overview: After Director Inoue drops them off at the restaurant, Gudetama has a change of heart, which deeply touches Shakipiyo.

episodes.name: I'm Pooped...
episodes.overview: Gudetama and Shakipiyo finally make it to the chicken coop but must now try to pick their mother out of the flock.

episodes.name: Heliocentrism. How About That?
episodes.overview: A gifted young student plans to study theology at university, but his true passion is astronomy. One day, he meets a mysterious scholar named Hubert.

episodes.name: And Now... I'm Going to Move the Earth
episodes.overview: Rafał is intrigued by Hubert’s heliocentric theory. Later, Hubert is arrested by an inquisitor but he gives Rafał a pendant before being whisked away.

episodes.name: I... Believe in Heliocentrism
episodes.overview: Nowak convinces Potocki to admit to Rafał's heresy. Once arrested, Rafał is given a choice: recant his belief in heliocentrism or submit to torture.

episodes.name: The Fact That This World Is Far More Beautiful Than Heaven
episodes.overview: The duelist Oczy wishes for death so he can escape his hopeless world and go to heaven. His colleague finds meaning in life by observing the stars.

episodes.name: Even If I Die... This World Will Continue
episodes.overview: Gras aborts the mission, placing himself and Oczy in mortal danger from Nowak. They both flee for the mountains, where they find a stone chest.

episodes.name: Move... The World
episodes.overview: Oczy seeks the help of Badeni, the demoted monk who incurred the Church's wrath by turning his curiosity to the riddles of the sky.

episodes.name: Matters of the Truth
episodes.overview: Gifted scholar Jolenta suffers discrimination as the only girl at an astronomy institute. Badeni seeks resources to prove the heliocentric theory.

episodes.name: We Must Become Icarus
episodes.overview: Badeni offers Jolenta a chance to pursue the truth of the skies, but she is overcome with fear. Afterward, she overhears bold words from Count Piast.

episodes.name: This Is What It Means... To Learn Something, I Think
episodes.overview: A middle-aged Piast vows to prove his professor's geocentric model. In the present, he agrees to let Badeni use his records — on one condition.

episodes.name: Truth
episodes.overview: Oczy tells Badeni that he is learning to read and write. Later, Badeni's claim that knowledge should be held by a select few bothers a fellow monk.

episodes.name: Terror
episodes.overview: Nowak gives two rookie inquisitors a terrifying first taste of their new roles. Badeni meets with Jolenta and tells her he has completed his theory.

episodes.name: Heliocentrism Is My Faith
episodes.overview: Nowak asks Badeni to show him his research. He inspects Badeni's premises but doesn't find anything incriminating — until he spots a certain item.

episodes.name: Freedom
episodes.overview: In a medical area within the inquisition chamber, a wounded Oczy awakes to see Nowak, who has kept him alive in hopes of extracting information.

episodes.name: Tonight's Sky...
episodes.overview: Badeni must choose between revealing the location of the heretical documents on heliocentric theory or prolonging Oczy's torture at Nowak's hands.

episodes.name: Is It... My Turn?
episodes.overview: Nowak believes his beloved daughter has been executed as a heretic. Father Grabowski comes across a letter from Badeni containing an unusual request.

episodes.name: It's Time to Begin the Operation
episodes.overview: Twenty-five years later, Captain Schmidt of the extremist Heretic Liberation Front infiltrates a church and steals an important item.

episodes.name: I Could Make a Lot of Money with This Book… Maybe
episodes.overview: A young nomad woman haunted by poverty devotes her life to obtaining wealth. One night, she discovers the book that Frei hid in the abandoned village.

episodes.name: To Liberate Information
episodes.overview: Bishop Antoni orders Draka to hand over the book, but Schmidt’s men suddenly intervene. Determined to change her fate, she takes a bold action.

episodes.name: Wandering Is How You Find What's Right
episodes.overview: Hoping to track down the people who stole the book, an inquisitor seeks advice from Nowak, who now spends his days drowning his sorrows.

episodes.name: I Love Heliocentrism
episodes.overview: As the Heretic Liberation Front prepares to depart, Jolenta entrusts Draka with a letter. Soon after, Nowak and the inquisitors approach the barn.

episodes.name: The Times Are Changing
episodes.overview: Schmidt and the others regroup with their Liberation Front comrades and begin printing the book. However, a traitor brings their operation to a halt.

episodes.name: Neither of You Will Be Known to History
episodes.overview: As Nowak's group attacks the Liberation Front, Draka and Schmidt begin their escape. Upon reaching town, Draka makes a proposition to Bishop Antoni.

episodes.name: Comrades
episodes.overview: A deluded Nowak turns against Antoni and attempts to burn down the church. Draka fights back and escapes but incurs a terrible wound.

episodes.name: Thaumazein
episodes.overview: Albert goes to deliver an order of bread to a church. While there, he encounters a mysterious priest who encourages him to confess his sins.
Albert leaves the academic gathering and returns home to an awful sight. In the present, the priest gives Albert advice and makes his own confession.

episodes.name: What Do You Play Games For?
episodes.overview: What makes you game? For every 100 amazing games, there are a thousand that are not good. This is the story of Rakuro Hizutome, a man who loves, and is loved by, crappy video games, and his journey in the world of Shangri-La Frontier, one of the greatest vide…

episodes.name: A Peculiar One
episodes.overview: Rakuro fights the Ravenous Python, arrives in the game's second town, and explores its weapons crafting system before venturing out at night.

episodes.name: Black Wolf Nightslayer
episodes.overview: The battle with Lycagon the Nightslayer leaves Sunraku in an unexpected situation. Soon after, he's barreling down the rabbit hole to a new adventure!

episodes.name: A Trash Game Realignment of Elevated Tastes
episodes.overview: Sunraku agrees to train under Vysache and he's saddled with the Vorpal Soul Collar which decreases his EXP gain but increases stat point rewards upon leveling up. Afterward Emul offers to join Sunraku's party and they set off for Thirdrema.

episodes.name: Lo, Thou Art Assailed on All Sides
episodes.overview: On their way to Thirdrema, Sunraku an Emul encounter the area boss Mud Digger in the middle of a swamp which greatly reduces their movement. Being at a disadvantage Sunraku needs figure out how his newly evolved skills work so he can take Mud Digger down.

episodes.name: The Writing Tool Knight-Queen
episodes.overview: Sunraku encounters Arthur Pencilgon, whom he knows as Pencil Knight from another game called "Unite Rounds". She brings with her a message that he either publish what he knows about the unique scenario or wear a target on his back.

episodes.name: Remnant of the Divinity: The Aberrant Loser
episodes.overview: Sunraku manages to stave off his attackers and reach Thirdrema, where he and Emul then travel back to Rabituza. Emul then takes Sunraku to the Vorpal Colosseum where he's pitted against 10 opponents to further his training.

episodes.name: The 300-Limit Pandemonium
episodes.overview: The 10th opponent in the Rabituza arena is the Aberrant Woodmage, a powerful foe combining fast attacks with magic. Underleveled and understatted, Sunraku only needs to survive five minutes to win... but can he make it happen?!

episodes.name: A Dazzling Sea of Trees
