episodes.overview: Sunraku has to make it out of town so he can move on to the Prismatic Forest Grotto, but Ashura Kai and Psyger-0 stand in his way. Once he reaches the grotto itself, a dazzling array of sights await him!

episodes.name: Let's Go Tomb Raiding!!
episodes.overview: Sunraku continues his way through the Prismatic Forest Grotto where he encounters the area boss Clown Spider. He tells Emul to stay back as he wants to solo it first try with a no-hit run.

episodes.name: The Glimmer of Truth
episodes.overview: Sunraku speaks with Vysache about their plans to defeat Wethermon the Tombguard. After their discussion Vysache decides to help Sunraku in his endeavor by ascending his weapons.

episodes.name: Regrets Always Lie in the Past
episodes.overview: Pencilgon sends Sunraku and Oikatzo to the Iron Ruins of the Divinity to grind their levels to at least level 50. While there they encounter the Lifestide Lake Serpent monster.

episodes.name: Only Resentments About the End of Life Remain
episodes.overview: Pencilgon, Sunraku, and Oikatzo make their way to find the NPC Setsuna of Bygone Days, Wethermon's former lover. She presents to them the Unique Scenario "From the Living World, With Love" which they accept.

episodes.name: Squish
episodes.overview: Sunraku has encountered a new player named Dragonfly in "BERP". The two engage in a series of matches with bug exploits allowed. Afterwards Sunrakru heads to Rabituza to link his skills at the Skill Garden.

episodes.name: Putting Feelings Into a Moment (1)
episodes.overview: On the night of the new moon, the members of Ashura Kai are ambushed by a group of allied clans including Psyger-0. Meanwhile, Sunraku, Oikatzo, and Pencilgon confront Wethermon the Tombguard at the Hidden Garden.

episodes.name: Putting Feelings Into a Moment (2)
episodes.overview: Sunraku and the others are engaged in a battle against Wethermon the Tombguard, and making full use of resurrection items. Ten minutes have passed since the battle began and Wethermon summons his tactical mount "Kirin".

episodes.name: Putting Feelings Into a Moment (3)
episodes.overview: The battle with Wethermon the Tombguard moves to its next phase. Pencilgon and Oikatzo, exploiting rare items, focus on Kirin who has transformed into a suit of armor. Meanwhile Sunraku goes on the offensive to defeat Wethermon before he crumbles away.

episodes.name: Putting Feelings Into a Moment (4)
episodes.overview: Items are depleted, weapons and gear are on the verge of breaking, and Wethermon continues his Clear Sky Conquest barrage on Sunraku while Pencilgon and Oikatzo continue their efforts to dismantle Kirin Armor. Sunraku goes all-in to finish the fight.

episodes.name: The World Progresses, the Heroes Are Revealed
episodes.overview: Wethermon falls into a slumber and Setsuna of Bygone Days leaves behind a hint that will lead to the truth about SLF. Wethermon's subjugation is reported to all players in game. Now, standing before the battle-weary trio are angry members of Ashura Kai...

episodes.name: Current Situations and Next Steps
episodes.overview: Utopia, SLF's development company, is in a tizzy over the defeat of Wethermon the Tombguard. Sunraku is excited to kick off his bonus unique scenario Vorpal Epic. He then decides to check out the loot he received from defeating Wethermon.

episodes.name: Errands, Cultivation, and Game Progress
episodes.overview: "Unique monsters make money" Pencilgon suggests forming a clan with Sunraku and Oikatzo. After temporarily splitting, Sunraku returns to the Palace of Rabituza with the Non-Standard Ether Reactor he received from Oikatzo and comes up with a great idea."

episodes.name: The Walking Air Purifier
episodes.overview: Bilac accepts Sanraku's proposal and they head to the Canyon of Ancient Souls to obtain the magic operations unit necessary for becoming an Ancient Craftsman. Lycagon's Mark causes weak monsters to flee, then they encounter the rare Dullahan General.

episodes.name: Bird and Rabbits VS Chorus of Skeletons
episodes.overview: Sunraku, Emul, and Bilac face off against the area boss the Humming Lich in the Canyon of Ancient Souls. Struggling to inflict damage, Bilac rushes to rework the Dullahan General's Decapitator into a holy-attribute weapon.

episodes.name: Rare Items, Worth More than Life Itself
episodes.overview: Sunraku returns to the Canyon Ancient Souls, where he encounters a swarm of Crystal Scorpions that are over level 100. Struggling to acquire the rare materials he seeks, Sunraku watches the scorpions' movements and comes up with a secret plan...

episodes.name: Those Who Illuminate the World's Darkness
episodes.overview: Bilac finds jewelry among Sunraku's loot. In order to show them to a jeweler, she introduces Sunraku to Aramiys, the swordsman of Cazzeria, and vice captain of the Musketeers in Boots. Later they head to Eighthold where they encounter the Professor.

episodes.name: Half-Naked Birdman and the Gang in Golem Paradise
episodes.overview: To turn Beelac into an ancestral craftswoman and to get the futuristic toys in Inventoria up and running, Sunraku needs a magic control unit.

episodes.name: The Uncompromising Gatekeeper
episodes.overview: Sunraku and his pals make it into the Divinity-era workshop and retrieve the magic operations unit, but Pencilgon and Oikatzo have a score to settle with him before the quest proceeds any further.

episodes.name: Accelerating Meetings, Surging Desire, and the Start of Various Threads
episodes.overview: It's time for Sunraku to face the music as Pencilgon and Oikatzo force him to come face to face with the various factions he's been ignoring.

episodes.name: When Humanity Dreams of the Impossible and Takes to the Skies
episodes.overview: Pencilgon makes a proposal to the other clans. Sunraku forwards his interests in Rabituza, and faces a setback in his farming of the Crystal Scorpions.

episodes.name: The Impetus of Hunger; the Persistence of Thirst
episodes.overview: Sunraku's attempts to farm the Crystal Scorpions for money are complicated when a giant gold scorpion enters the fray.

episodes.name: After the Fierce Battle, Despair
episodes.overview: In the midst of his god-like run, Sunraku faces a setback that sours him on Shangri-La Frontier, but his sister has some advice to turn things around.

episodes.name: The Wings in a Draw
episodes.overview: In Nephilim Hollow, Rust is slavering for a rematch with Sunraku, but Sunraku himself isn't in top fighting form after three months away from the game.

episodes.name: The Lion Catches a Rabbit with Its Full Strength; the Crab Catches a Phoenix with a Pizza Cutter
episodes.overview: The battle of Crimson Twinewing vs. Fiddler Crab reaches its climax, and Sunraku decides what to do next.

episodes.name: Run, Fueled by Impatience
episodes.overview: Back in Shangri-La Frontier, Sunraku needs to speed through the game to make his appointment with Mold and Rust. To make it in time, though, he'll have to ask a certain someone for aid.

episodes.name: Track It Like a Bloodhound
episodes.overview: Sunraku meets up with Psyger-0 to take on the Lightless Barrens, but can't get his head around his new companion's strange behavior.

episodes.name: Embrace the Lamplight of Ambition (1)
episodes.overview: SF-Zoo shows shocking resilience in the face of the strongest foe they've ever faced, and Sunraku, paired with Psyger-0, must decide how to approach the task.

episodes.name: Embrace the Lamplight of Ambition (2)
episodes.overview: Sunraku and Psyger-0 engage Lycagon the Nightslayer, but Sunraku realizes that the assumptions he's made about the Colossus's patterns may not necessarily hold up.

episodes.name: Embrace the Lamplight of Ambition (3)
episodes.overview: The battle between Sunraku, Psyger-0, and Lycagon continues! But just as the Colossus seems poised to dominate, a new ally joins the fray.

episodes.name: Embrace the Lamplight of Ambition (4)
episodes.overview: Psyger-0's Ultimate is almost ready for release, but first Rei must recite a long incantation. The rest of the team must cover Lycagon in the meantime, with Sunraku revealing the Gilta Brill's own ultimate attack as well.

episodes.name: Embrace the Lamplight of Ambition (5)
episodes.overview: Sunraku receives the consequences of his defeat of Lycagon's shade, and as the group moves on to Fifticia to meet with Rust and Mold, another new twist awaits him.

episodes.name: What Do You Play Games For? Their Answers
episodes.overview: Katzo and Pencilgon reaffirm their motives moving forward, and the defeat of Lycagon's shade has repercussions for the devs.

episodes.name: A Straight Flush Mixed with Jokers
episodes.overview: Sunraku gets an intriguing offer from Kei, then meets up with Rust and Mold to pursue the Ctarnidd quest.

episodes.name: The Crimson Whale Meets the Monster Fish
episodes.overview: Sunraku and his new crew set out on the high seas to confront Ctarnidd and the Disciples of the Abyss.

episodes.name: Revive, Broken City, Your Peace at an End
episodes.overview: Sunraku and his new party fight on the ghost ship and unlock the next stage of the Ctarnidd quest: an underwater city!

episodes.name: Time to Fillet a Dragon Fish
episodes.overview: Sunraku's plan to reunite his party ends with him fighting an overpowered dragon eel.

episodes.name: Venturing Wolves Then from the Seas to the Skyscrapers
episodes.overview: Sunraku joins his teammates at the GGC where he learns more about the favor Katzo needs.

episodes.name: The Light Blazes Brightly, But for Just an Instant
episodes.overview: The miraculous light bursts forth in glory for a moment.

episodes.name: Malice at 100 Meters Per Second
episodes.overview: Rakuro should be training for his tournament match, but finds himself succumbing to the call of SLF.

episodes.name: Great King of the Deep, I Humbly Seek to Crush You
episodes.overview: Sunraku's diversion back to SLF continues with a hair-raising battle against Atlanticus Lepnorca.

episodes.name: The Anonymous (Asinine) A-Team and a Crisis
episodes.overview: Nitro Squad prepares for the exhibition match, but disaster threatens Kei's rematch with Sylvia.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When Nurse Da-eun enters the world of mental health she discovers aching hearts and various stories behind them.

episodes.name: The Darkest Hour Is Just Before the Dawn
episodes.overview: Recently transferred to the Department of Mental Health, Jung Da-eun’s first patient is Oh Ri-na — a woman who appears to be perfectly fine.

episodes.name: Not in the Mood for Work
episodes.overview: Da-eun overhears the hard truth and is hurt by it. As tensions come to a head, doctors and nurses settle their disagreements the old-fashioned way.

episodes.name: Safety Net
episodes.overview: Trainee nurses visit the psychiatric ward, but one of them displays strange behavior. Da-eun accidentally learns a secret about her bestie, Song Yu-chan.

episodes.name: In Search of a Ray of Hope
episodes.overview: A hostile patient accuses Da-eun of stealing money. Meanwhile, Min Deul-re offers Hwang Yeo-hwan a glimpse into her life to show him her reality.

episodes.name: When Life Tells You to Slow Down
episodes.overview: During an emergency, Da-eun sees another side of Dr. Dong Go-yun. Senior nurse Park Soo-yeon relates to a patient juggling motherhood and work.

episodes.name: A Day in the Life of a Mage
episodes.overview: Facing monetary issues, Deul-re distances herself from Yeo-hwan. Da-eun grows concerned about a discharged patient reintegrating into his daily life.

episodes.name: The Left Behind
episodes.overview: Da-eun's friends and colleagues worry for her after a tragedy while the doctors, nurses and patients learn about treating PTSD.

episodes.name: Expiration Date on Grief
episodes.overview: Finding it hard to heal without slowing down, Da-eun tries to face her emotions. Yeo-hwan and Go-yun commiserate over their relationship issues.

episodes.name: I'm a Nurse With Depression
episodes.overview: Deul-re deals with her mother’s return. Da-eun finds herself in her patients’ shoes as she grapples with her own diagnosis.

episodes.name: The Hardest Part of a Journey
episodes.overview: Da-eun learns how to prioritize herself, but faces fears of returning to work — until she receives empathetic words of courage from the head nurse.

episodes.name: And The Journey Continues
episodes.overview: Now the subject of office gossip, Da-eun returns to work. During a night out with friends, Deul-re rediscovers what makes her happy.

episodes.name: Daily Dose of Sunshine
episodes.overview: Da-eun manages to find a unique way to help her patient. Deul-re pursues her passion and Yu-chan takes a bold stand.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A series of mutilated bodies and taunting notes left outside a Delhi jail sends police hunting for a seasoned killer with a grudge against the system.

episodes.name: Tohfe
episodes.overview: In 2006, a stranger leaves a beheaded body outside a Delhi jail with a note challenging the police to catch him. It isn't his first — or last — murder.

episodes.name: Tasveer
episodes.overview: During interrogations, Chandrakant shares his fraught history with the police. Investigators face a challenging search for conclusive evidence.

episodes.name: Tukre
episodes.overview: Ghosai residents offer powerful accounts and photos from Chandrakant's past. Experts discuss the case's mental health and social implications.

episodes.name: Chinatsu Senpai
episodes.overview: Despite a few heart-fluttering encounters, Taiki doubts his crush Chinatsu even knows his name. Later, shocking news forces him to make a bold move.

episodes.name: You Have to Go to Nationals
episodes.overview: Taiki's new housemate quickly makes herself at home. As they grow closer, his attempts to keep the situation a secret cause a misunderstanding.

episodes.name: Chii
episodes.overview: Taiki overhears Haryu calling Chinatsu by a special nickname and gets flustered. Will it affect his upcoming match against the upperclassman?

episodes.name: If He Wins
episodes.overview: A gym uniform mix-up leads to a heart-pounding exchange. Later, Haryu raises the stakes for Taiki’s match, while Kyo makes a secret request to Chinatsu.

episodes.name: Aquarium
episodes.overview: With both players going neck and neck on the court, will Taiki win his match against Kishi — and will Chinatsu invite him to the aquarium?

episodes.name: Wish Me Luck
episodes.overview: On her way to return Chinatsu's mobile phone, Hina makes a shocking discovery. The gymnast faces mounting pressure while struggling with her new feelings.

episodes.name: Can I Have One?
episodes.overview: Chinatsu overhears rival players speak poorly about her recent game. Later, Hina playfully steals a bite from Taiki — and Chinatsu notices from afar.

episodes.name: Score!
episodes.overview: As Taiki strives to make it to the nationals, Chinatsu gives him a word of encouragement. Later, Haryu and Taiki face top players in the doubles match.

episodes.name: I'll Be Rooting for You
episodes.overview: Frustrated with his loss to Sajikawa High, Taiki overworks himself studying for midterms and falls ill, when Chinatsu suddenly appears in his room.

episodes.name: It's Not a Good Thing
episodes.overview: After a sleepless night, Taiki asks Haryu for relationship advice. Later, Chinatsu realizes her recent behavior might hinder her dream and trouble others.

episodes.name: Uncool!
episodes.overview: With the annual fireworks festival approaching, Hina musters the courage to invite Taiki, who's been avoiding Chinatsu since their awkward conversation.

episodes.name: Girls...
episodes.overview: Taiki attends the fireworks festival with Hina and is surprised by her new look and shyness. Later, he unexpectedly bumps into Chinatsu with a lost child.

episodes.name: I Want a Back-and-Forth Rally
episodes.overview: Taiki worries about a potential misunderstanding after Chinatsu departs. At the badminton nationals, he learns more about Karen and Haryu's relationship.

episodes.name: What's the Connection?
episodes.overview: While Chinatsu faces immense pressure at the nationals, Hina cheers up a worried Taiki with a game where the loser shares an embarrassing secret.

episodes.name: August 26
episodes.overview: Despite it being her birthday, Chinatsu still seems a little down. Taiki takes her somewhere special — but the weather might have other plans.

episodes.name: Unfair Woman
episodes.overview: As a new school term begins, the school buzzes with preparations for the upcoming festival. Chinatsu reflects on her restless feelings towards Taiki.

episodes.name: Of Course I Want to See It
episodes.overview: Upon learning of an upcoming practice match with Sajikawa High, Taiki worries about facing Yusa gain. Chinatsu and Hina promise their support.

episodes.name: I Know
episodes.overview: Sajikawa High arrives for the much-anticipated practice match. As Chinatsu watches from the sidelines, she thinks about how far Taiki has come.

episodes.name: I've Got Plans
episodes.overview: Just before the school festival starts, Taiki goes for his usual morning jog and finds Chinatsu practicing nearby. She extends a surprising invitation.

episodes.name: As One of Her Closest Friends
episodes.overview: After a blissful time with Chinatsu, Nishida's ominous fortune comes true! His classmate playing the prince can't perform, so Taiki must take on the role.

episodes.name: A Chance to Blossom
episodes.overview: While rumors swirl around Taiki and Hina, Chinatsu seems unfazed. However, while spending the night at Karen's, the basketballer shares her true thoughts.

episodes.name: Inota!
episodes.overview: After learning about Hina's unrequited feelings for Taiki, Ayame decides to help — and the perfect chance arises at the upcoming autumn training camp!

episodes.name: Spinning
episodes.overview: An exciting card game with friends leaves Taiki's head spinning. He mulls over his feelings for Chinatsu and Hina as the training camp continues.

episodes.name: A Roller Coaster
episodes.overview: Hina experiences a roller coaster of emotions over her affection for Taiki and, thanks to Ayame, gets a chance to be alone with him on the last night.

episodes.name: Even So
episodes.overview: Ayame faces the consequences of her meddling and tries all sorts of ways to console Hina. Meanwhile, Taiki strengthens his resolve and asks Chinatsu out.

episodes.name: Déjà Vu
episodes.overview: Taiki and Chinatsu's outing kicks off at a sports shop. But when an uninvited guest crashes their cafe plans, Taiki hears a name he won't soon forget.

episodes.name: Admiration
episodes.overview: After a tense run-in with Yumeka, Chinatsu opens up about their past on the train ride home. Taiki sets out to learn what tore apart their friendship.

episodes.name: They're One and the Same
episodes.overview: Yumeka snaps at Taiki for overstepping while a teammate's harsh words stir up old memories for Chinatsu. Later, a chance encounter catches her off guard.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Ash and Goh arrive at Canalave City, where they meet Dawn and Cynthia as they participate in the Sinnoh Festival. Meanwhile, Team Galactic corners Heatran at Stark Mountain as Saturn catches it to enact their latest plan.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Ash, Goh and Dawn, after getting a mysterious call for help from the Lake Guardians, meet with Brock. Team Galactic begins their plan to open a portal to bring back their leader Cyrus, but the intense power from the experiment causes Saturn's Heatran to go on…

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Ash, Dawn, and Goh, with help from Cynthia and Brock, try to stop Team Galactic, as well as save Heatran from its frenzied state, to no avail, then Arceus appears to the group's aid.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Arceus uses its powers to impede Heatran as Ash, Goh, Dawn, Brock, and Cynthia work together to save the Legendary Pokemon and defeat Team Galactic's Commanders, leading to the team's rearrest and the five saving the Sinnoh region.

episodes.name: Episode 1: Hot Pot/Tart
episodes.overview: After a crushing loss, Laios, Marcille, and Chilchuck quickly reenter the dungeon to save Falin, but this time, they have a foolproof survival plan.

episodes.name: Episode 2: Roast Basilisk/Omelet/Kakiage
episodes.overview: After waking up to a tantalizing smell, Marcille receives a lecture from Senshi on a balanced diet. The crew helps an adventurer poisoned by a basilisk.

episodes.name: Episode 3: Living Armor
episodes.overview: Laios and crew access a hidden area guarded by mysterious Living Armor, who appear to be protecting something potentially delicious.

episodes.name: Episode 4: Stewed Cabbage/Orcs
episodes.overview: Reaching the third level of the dungeon, Senshi leads the crew to his secret vegetable garden. Later, they are accosted by a band of angry, desperate orcs.

episodes.name: Episode 5: Snacks/Sorbet
episodes.overview: As another group of adventurers discovers a treasure box, a swarm of bone-chilling ghosts chases Laios and his crew. Senshi, however, has a sweet plan.

episodes.name: Episode 6: Court Cuisine/Boiled in Salt Water
episodes.overview: A starving Laios angers a mysterious elf while hunting for food in Living Paintings. Later, Chilchuck finds himself trapped with a crabby Mimic.

episodes.name: Episode 7: Kelpie/Porridge/Broiled with Sauce
episodes.overview: Something's fishy on this new dungeon level! The crew crosses a treacherous lake, encountering vicious seafood and fallen adventurers along the way.

episodes.name: Episode 8: Raspberries/Grilled Meat
episodes.overview: Marcille recalls when she first met Falin as young students. After a quick wash up, an inadvertent misstep lands her in deep water with an angry spirit.

episodes.name: Episode 9: Tentacles/Stew
episodes.overview: The smell of meat lures in uninvited guests — among them, a familiar face emerges. To move forward, they must work together to defeat the Undine.

episodes.name: Episode 10: Giant Frogs/Aboveground
episodes.overview: The crew avoid a stinging descent to the castle town, where the Red Dragon lurks. But to defeat it, they need a tight plan — and a morale-boosting meal.

episodes.name: Episode 11: Red Dragon I
episodes.overview: The crew finally faces the Red Dragon, but their grand strategy quickly unravels. With the beast's fury escalating, who will get the final bite?

episodes.name: Episode 12: Red Dragon II
episodes.overview: A desperate search within the dragon's stomach leads to a gruesome discovery, revealing that resurrection magic alone won't be enough to restore Falin.

episodes.name: Episode 13: Red Dragon III/Good Medicine
episodes.overview: Falin starts acting strange in the middle of the night, leading Laios and crew to a menacing figure who wants them gone.

episodes.name: Episode 14: Sea Serpent
episodes.overview: Back in an upper dungeon level, Kabru and crew wake up to find their supplies missing and are ambushed on their way back to the surface.

episodes.name: Episode 15: Dryad/Cockatrice
episodes.overview: Trapped in the dungeon, a concerned Senshi cooks up a nourishing meal for the famished crew — giving Marcille enough energy to come up with a plan.

episodes.name: Episode 16: Cleaners/Dried with Sweet Sake
episodes.overview: Chilchuck figures out a way to escape the dungeon, but their ascent is halted by an unexpected encounter with an old friend in dire need of sustenance.

episodes.name: Episode 17: Harpy/Chimera
episodes.overview: The parties must band together to fend off an attack by vicious Harpies — but the unexpected appearance of a transformed Falin stuns everyone.

episodes.name: Episode 18: Shapeshifter
episodes.overview: While in pursuit of Falin, Laios and crew seek shelter from a blizzard but are overrun by Shapeshifter copies of themselves. How will they spot the fakes?

episodes.name: Episode 19: Hag/Nightmare
episodes.overview: The crew is cornered by an acquaintance who demands help with a beastly problem. Later, Laios enters Marcille's nightmare and discovers her greatest fear.

episodes.name: Episode 20: Ice Golem/Barometz
episodes.overview: Izutsumi proves to be a useful ally despite her lousy table manners — and aversion to eating monsters. But the crew's kindness slowly opens her up.

episodes.name: Episode 21: Egg/The Golden Country
episodes.overview: With the dungeon's fate hanging in the balance, Kabru negotiates with the elves. Meanwhile, a ghost drags Laios and crew into the cursed Golden Country.

episodes.name: Episode 22: Griffin/Familiars
episodes.overview: Leaving the safety of the Golden Country, Senshi ends up in the clutches of a ferocious griffin. The crew must summon help if they want to save him.

episodes.name: Episode 23: Griffin Soup/Dumplings -1-
episodes.overview: Back at camp, Senshi finally reveals his painful history with the dungeon. The next day, the crew is rudely awakened by a perplexing transformation.

episodes.name: Episode 24: Dumplings -2-/Bacon and Eggs
episodes.overview: Still wrestling with their new forms, the crew must overcome the gargoyles. Later, they descend deeper into the dungeon. What monsters will they try next?

episodes.name: The Murderer
episodes.overview: Police identify a decapitated body as a missing reporter and trace calls to a suspect who makes an unsettling confession — but there's more to his story.

episodes.name: The Cannibal
episodes.overview: Names written in Ram Niranjan's diary suggest a grim pattern. As experts discuss his potential motives for murder, he shares his own side of the story.

episodes.name: The King
episodes.overview: Insider accounts of Ram Niranjan's behavior in jail, plus a closer look at his history, point to his delusions and desires around reality and power.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After a brutal attack, Jeong Su-in learns she may not be the same person as before. Choi Jun-kyung discovers the monsters are forming an organization.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Looking for his sister, Seol Kang-woo investigates Saejin Church, where he finds Su-in. But he soon encounters trouble — and the two fight to escape.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: After raiding Saejin Church, Jun-kyung begins suspecting Kim Chul-min is hiding something — later tracking him down meeting with Su-in and Kang-woo.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: After revealing everything he knows to Chul-min, Kang-woo agrees to help save Su-in. But when the plan goes awry, lives are put at risk.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Despite being on the run, Su-in tries to warn Jun-kyung. But as Team Grey's raid plays out, Su-in and Kang-woo realize it's all part of a bigger plan.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Su-in meets with Seol Kyung-hee, who requests an alliance. But the parasites' ploy for power goes into full effect — and it's up to Heidi to stop them.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: An Yun Su's humble dream of a happy family life is destroyed when her husband is murdered. She struggles to prove her innocence in his mysterious death. Once in prison, Mo-eun, a mysterious figure called a witch among prison inmates due to her uncanny ability…

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Artist Lee Ki-dae is murdered in his studio. His wife, An Yun-su, is held for questioning amid a media frenzy and relentless police investigation.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Prosecutor Baek pressures Yun-su as she is taken back to the crime scene. While she furiously protests her innocence, another woman admits her guilt.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Mo Eun and Yun-su come face to face. After public outcry over the investigation, Baek gets a warrant for the detention center and orders a polygraph test.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Yun-su is given an ankle monitor — and a curfew. After an attorney volunteers to represent Mo Eun, she sends a threatening letter to her new ally.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Yun-su chases a hooded figure just as Mo Eun is reported missing from prison. Baek starts to suspect that the two women may be one step ahead of him.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Yun-su digs up dirt on her target's sinister past and spots a potential clue in the studio. A violent fight breaks out while Mo Eun is left unsupervised.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Both women try to erase evidence which could change the course of the investigation. Meanwhile, Ko Se-hun is reported missing by his grandfather.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Mo Eun shares evidence that complicates Yun-su's case. As Baek uncovers Se-hun's fatal crime, a new arrival in the cell stirs up old secrets.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Mo Eun raises eyebrows after a medical emergency. Attorney Jang Jeong-gu receives a pivotal phone call, and an escape attempt puts an inmate in danger.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: A tense confrontation with Jeong-gu, Baek and Mo Eun reveals vital withheld information about the case. A shocking murder confession hits the news.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: A hidden motive — and fingerprint — in Lee Ki-dae's murder case leads to an unlikely source. Mo Eun orchestrates a plan after news of a kidnapping.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: As the pieces start falling into place in both murder cases, Baek and Jeong-gu receive a chilling video. Mo Eun has a final message for Yun-su.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: With her gloomy demeanor, Sawako has a hard time fitting in. But when an outgoing classmate approaches her, life takes a turn for the better.

episodes.name: First-Time Feelings
episodes.overview: Because of her eerie demeanor, Sawako has been called "Sadako" since the fourth grade. She wishes she can be more like her friendly classmate, Kazehaya.

episodes.name: Rumors
episodes.overview: The new seating arrangements are decided by raffle. Sawako braces for everyone avoiding her again, but then Kazehaya speaks up.

episodes.name: Feelings of Romance
episodes.overview: A pretty girl named Kurumi approaches Sawako and the two become friends. But Kurumi has a history with Kazehaya, and she may have hidden intentions.

episodes.name: Love & Dreams
episodes.overview: Chizuru goes shopping for a birthday present for Ryu. The two of them are really close, but it turns out that Chizuru has feelings for someone else.

episodes.name: Christmas With Friends
episodes.overview: Winter break is just around the corner. Sawako really wants to go to the Christmas party, but her parents want her to celebrate the day with them.

episodes.name: Valentine's Day
episodes.overview: On Valentine's Day, Sawako brings lots of gift-wrapped homemade chocolates to school. She wants to give some to Kazehaya, but she's too nervous.

episodes.name: School Festival
episodes.overview: Worried, Ayane and Chizuru rush out to find Sawako. They find her on the roof of the school, heartbroken over what Kazehaya said to her.

episodes.name: First Kiss
episodes.overview: Things are going so well for Sawako and Kazehaya, and even her parents seem to approve. Chizuru finds out that Ryu has feelings for someone.

episodes.name: Bonds
episodes.overview: Everyone's thinking about their life plans. When Kazehaya tells his father that he wants to take over his business some day, his father isn't happy.

episodes.name: The Road You Want to Travel
episodes.overview: When she finds out that Sawako also wants to become a teacher, Kurumi swallows her pride and asks Sawako for a favor.

episodes.name: Realization
episodes.overview: Kazehaya works hard to show his father he's serious about becoming a sports trainer. Sawako thinks about applying to Sapporo University of Education.

episodes.name: Departures
episodes.overview: Graduation day arrives. Sawako and Kurumi get their university entrance results, and everyone scatters to pursue their various different dreams.

episodes.name: The Journey's End
episodes.overview: The world celebrates the Demon King's defeat at the hands of the Hero and his companions. Now that their great adventure is over, what will Frieren the mage do next?

episodes.name: It Didn't Have to Be Magic...
episodes.overview: Frieren instructs Fern in the use of magic while deciphering a grimoire for Heiter.

episodes.name: Killing Magic
episodes.overview: While retracing the path she took on her adventure with her former traveling companions, Frieren confronts an old enemy.

episodes.name: The Land Where Souls Rest
episodes.overview: Frieren and Fern pay a visit to Eisen, who requests their help in finding the notes of Flamme the Legendary Mage.

episodes.name: Phantoms of the Dead
episodes.overview: Frieren and Fern investigate ghost sightings at a village where people have started going missing.

episodes.name: The Hero of the Village
episodes.overview: Frieren and Fern enlist Stark's help to fight the solar dragon - but is he up to the task?

episodes.name: Like a Fairy Tale
episodes.overview: After reflecting on the transient nature of the past as it exists in people's collective memories, Frieren unexpectedly runs into a sworn enemy.

episodes.name: Frieren the Slayer
episodes.overview: As tensions in Graf Granat's domain reach a breaking point, Fern and Stark find their own resolve - and Frieren resumes an old duty.

episodes.name: Aura the Guillotine
episodes.overview: While Fern and Stark make a temporary retreat with Graf Granat, Frieren's true foe awaits her outside the city.

episodes.name: A Powerful Mage
episodes.overview: Frieren's many years of training under her teacher Flamme are tested in her confrontation with Aura the Guillotine. Will Aura's scales find her wanting?

episodes.name: Winter in the Northern Lands
episodes.overview: Frieren and her companions continue their journey through the northern lands, but obstacles both natural and manmade still stand in their way.

episodes.name: A Real Hero
episodes.overview: Deep in the mountains of the northern lands, Frieren and her party arrive at the Village of the Sword, where they have another job to do.

episodes.name: Aversion to One's Own Kind
episodes.overview: While passing by a village in the woods of the northern lands, Frieren and party meet Sein, a gifted priest who is nonetheless corrupt enough to give even Heiter a run for his money. But what happened in his past?

episodes.name: Privilege of the Young
episodes.overview: The party arrives in a large and lively town with a bustling shopping district that Frieren once visited with Himmel, but something seems to have come up between Fern and Stark.

episodes.name: Smells Like Trouble
episodes.overview: When the party happens upon a town whose inhabitants are all mysteriously asleep, it's time for their newest traveling companion to prove his mettle.

episodes.name: Long-Lived Friends
episodes.overview: Frieren pays a visit to Old Man Voll, a long-lived friend of hers, with traveling companions in tow.

episodes.name: Take Care
episodes.overview: Now that Sein finally has a lead on the whereabouts of his long-lost friend, is it time for him and Frieren's party to part ways?

episodes.name: First-Class Mage Exam
episodes.overview: Frieren and party finally arrive in Äußerst, ready to undergo the first-class mage exam, and meet a number of colorful characters who are there to do the same.

episodes.name: Well-Laid Plans
episodes.overview: Frieren and her new teammates hatch a plan to capture a Stille - but are the other teams just going to stand by and let it happen?

episodes.name: Necessary Killing
episodes.overview: The first-class mage exam intensifies as fighting breaks out between the participants - and what's at stake might even be worth killing for.

episodes.name: The World of Magic
episodes.overview: Frieren, Kanne, and Lawine struggle with the 13th party over possession of the Stille, but there'll be more surprises in store before their battle, and the first test, reach their conclusion.

episodes.name: Future Enemies
episodes.overview: After the conclusion of the first test, the exam participants have some time to kill in town. What do mages get up to on their days off?

episodes.name: Conquering the Labyrinth
episodes.overview: The aspiring first-class mages now face their second test: conquering the Ruins of the King's Tomb. A simple task, or so the proctor claims, but there's a reason this particular dungeon remains unexplored.

episodes.name: Perfect Replicas
episodes.overview: Due to the Spiegel, a legendary monster that can create perfect replicas of others, the test-takers who would conquer the Ruins of the King's Tomb must first face the ultimate enemy: themselves.

episodes.name: A Fatal Vulnerability
episodes.overview: A perfect imitation of Frieren stands between the test-takers and victory, but Fern believes she knows how to win. Is it time for the student to surpass the master?

episodes.name: The Height of Magic
episodes.overview: To defeat Spiegel, Frieren and Fern fight against Frieren's replica, but have a tough time. Meanwhile, Denken, Lavine, and the others fight against the replicas, but the magic of Sense, a first-class mage and the exam's proctor, rages.

episodes.name: An Era of Humans
episodes.overview: With the second test behind them, only one remains - but first, Frieren and Fern need to settle an important matter in town. What awaits them in the third test?

episodes.name: It Would Be Embarrassing When We Met Again
episodes.overview: As the first-class mage exam concludes and the test-takers go their separate ways, farewell leads to departure - but the next stage of Frieren's journey has only just begun.

episodes.name: Shall We Go, Then?
episodes.overview: Frieren, Fern, and Stark leave the magic city of Äußerst behind and travel along a road in the northern lands.

episodes.name: The Hero of the South
episodes.overview: In a village in the northern lands, Frieren’s party are hired to polish a statue of a hero.

episodes.name: Somewhere She'd Like
episodes.overview: Frieren’s party dream of hot springs as they reach Etwas, but the village is abandoned.

episodes.name: Other People's Homes
episodes.overview: Stark only asked Fern out as a joke, but the two end up going on a date.

episodes.name: Logistics in the Northern Plateau
episodes.overview: Frieren is reunited with Fass the dwarf, who has been searching for the Boshaft liquor for over 200 years.

episodes.name: A Demon-Slaying Request
episodes.overview: A village on the Northern Plateau is wiped out, and the victims' distinctive wounds point to a certain demon.

episodes.name: The Divine Revolte
episodes.overview: Frieren, Fern, and Methode enter the woods to look for the four-armed Divine Revolte.

episodes.name: A Magnificent End
episodes.overview: The Divine Revolte appears at the village, while Frieren, Fern, and Methode battle Solide and Hemmung.

episodes.name: Himmel's Memoirs
episodes.overview: When Frieren's party cannot afford the fare to cross Lake Korridor, the captain proposes a trade.

episodes.name: A Beautiful Sight
episodes.overview: Hidden within the massive bridge spanning the Great Canyon Tor is a secret story of Himmel and Gehen.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A psychic vet and a detective join forces to crack small-town cases — but their skills are tested when they unravel a chilling serial killer mystery.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Bong Ye-bun looks for answers after a meteor shower grants her an unexplainable gift. Moon Jang-yeol struggles to find thrills at his new police station.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: After finding herself in another precarious situation, Ye-bun experiences a shocking vision. Jang-yeol scours the town for a potentially exciting case.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: After being brushed off by Jang-yeol, Ye-bun goes on her own dangerous fact-finding mission. But her antics begin confusing those close to her.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: In order to break the next big case, Jang-yeol puts Ye-bun through the ringer. But after a strength-building exercise, Ye-bun's power begins to weaken.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Ye-bun begins questioning her grandfather's intentions. She later recruits Jang-yeol to solve an animal abuse case, in exchange for help in his case.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Jang-yeol investigates a truly perplexing case of disappearing underwear. After Ye-bun aids him in his search, she witnesses a sudden betrayal.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Faced with a tragedy, Jang-yeol tries to track down the person responsible. Ye-bun discovers a shocking scene after experiencing a vision.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: After a surprising shamanic ceremony, the town goes into a frenzy. Meanwhile, Jang-yeol and Ye-bun investigate a missing person case.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: A good deed turns out to be the wrong move - leaving Ye-bun in a tough place. Jang-yeol later joins her in tracking down a dangerous figure.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Jang-yeol and Ye-bun recruit key townspeople to collect important information. But Ye-bun comes across a shocking vision related to her past.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Ye-bun begins learning new information about her mother's death. The search for the perp continues, and everybody becomes a suspect.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Ye-bun ask Jang-yeol for help in finding answers about her past. As a political ally slowly becomes a foe, Ye-bun confronts her grandfather.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: One wedding (is announced) and a funeral. Jang-yeol is unexpectedly sensitive to Ye-bun's suffering. Seon-woo's absence is marked as suspicious. Captain Jong-muk and his team are forbidden from investigating the serial killer case and are directed to "protect…

episodes.overview: Frustration and grief are running high in Mujin as Detective Jang-yeol and the police track down new leads in a dwindling pool of suspects. Yet another murder is committed, and Jang-yeol is maddened with frustration as the serial killer seems to slip again an…

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Another death at the hands of the serial killer leaves both Ye-bun and Jang-yeol stunned, grieving, and guilt-ridden in their own ways. The victim provided them with the evidence to convict the killer, but the killer brags they have one shot left, and demands…

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Before there can be a happy ending, there must be a rescue, a recapture, some goodbyes, a proposal, some baby talk, a television appearance and an invitation to a date.

episodes.overview: Moo-young decides to map the whole organization, and Ro-um uses her eidetic memory to recall the contents of the ledger. The Jeokmok Kids join hands with Prosecutor Ryu and Reporter Woo to bring Jeokmok down. Meanwhile, Moo-young hears the news about his fath…

episodes.overview: Ro-um and her team try to get their hands on Kang-soo's plan for his stock price manipulation. Yeon Tae-hoon gets on Kang-soo's nerves and gets fired. Kang-soo demands a copy of the notebook from Kyung-ja. Meanwhile, Moo-young demands Ro-um to tell him why sh…

episodes.overview: Yo-han and Jae-in disguise themselves as a couple and attend Min Kang-yoon's party. Ringgo also attends the party with fake identification, but he fails to capture her attention. Instead, Kang-yoon shows interest in Ro-um. Meanwhile, Kang-soo manages to get t…

episodes.overview: Da-jung's server gets hacked, and they lose all the data they stole from Navis. The crew thinks it's the president's doing. Moo-young suggests a class action lawsuit, which can have the prosecution search and seize Navis' properties. But this plan doesn't go…

episodes.name: The Last Resolution
episodes.overview: Moo-young learns what his father did to earn the money for his tuition. Su-ho sees the photo Ringgo sent and realizes who the president is. Ro-um receives a gift from Jay, which leaves her staggered. Then she realizes that the only way to end everything is to…

episodes.name: The One You Trust
episodes.overview: Ro-um gets arrested as the prime suspect of Jang Kyung-ja's murder. Moo-young comes up with a plan to get Ro-um out of the prosecutors' office and protect Da-jung, Su-ho, and Ringgo at the same time. Meanwhile, the truth behind Jang Kyung-ja's death gets reve…

episodes.name: The Final Blow
episodes.overview: Da-jung collects all the evidence against Jay and organizes them so they can be used against him. Ro-um faces Jay head-to-head and demands he return the money he made through Navis. The Jeokmok Kids end up in court pleading guilty to their crimes.

episodes.overview: Yahiko's heart is moved by Kenshin and he decides to quit pickpocketing. Yahiko refuses to pay Kanto Shueigumi and resists their demands, but he is beaten up. Kenshin comes to his rescue and settles the matter. Regretful that he could not solve the problem by…

episodes.overview: Kenshin, Kaoru, and Yahiko visit Akabeko, a beef hot-pot restaurant, where a group of democratic rights activists gets into a heated argument. One of them throws a bottle of sake, and it hits Kenshin, causing a commotion. Sanosuke Sagara, who happened to be i…

episodes.overview: Kenshin confronts Sanosuke, who wields the giant Zanbato with ease. However, Sanosuke shows his incredible durability after withstanding a strike from Kenshin with ease. This leads Kenshin to instead launch a barrage of blows at him, and Sanosuke falls to the…

episodes.name: Kurogasa
episodes.overview: Kenshin receives a request from the police chief, asking for his help to take down "Kurogasa," a serial killer who has been repeatedly targeting former Revolutionary warriors. Kenshin and Sanosuke go to escort Jusanro Tani, who received a letter containing a…

episodes.overview: Knowing how strong Kenshin was when he was the Hitokiri Battosai, Jine takes Kaoru hostage in order to fuel Kenshin's anger. The two engage in a fierce battle. However, Jine, believing that Kenshin has not yet regained his former strength, inflicts the Nikaid…

episodes.name: Beauty on the Run
episodes.overview: Sanosuke's friend has died from an opium overdose. However, Kenshin and Sanosuke are perplexed at how he even got his hands on the drug, since opium is banned and too expensive for the average person to afford. Then a mysterious woman, Megumi Takani, appears…

episodes.overview: Hyottoko, a member of the Oniwaban group, raids Kamiya Dojo, where Megumi is hiding. He unleashes his special attack "Fire Breath," in which he breathes fire from his mouth, onto Kenshin and Sanosuke. Anticipating the defeat of Kenshin and the others at the a…

episodes.overview: The pursuers from the Oniwaban Group haven't made an appearance for over a week, and during this time Megumi familiarized herself with the Kamiya Dojo group. Sanosuke, however, was still unsettled and feeling frustrated knowing that Megumi was the one who mad…

episodes.overview: Yutaro sustains a heavy injury from Raijuta's sword, and it is so severe that he will never be able to swing a sword with that arm ever again. Although Yahiko was constantly disagreeing with Yutaro until now, he understood very well what swordsmanship meant t…

episodes.overview: Sanosuke is visiting the sukiyaki restaurant Akabeko, where he always leaves his bill on a tab. One of Akabeko's workers, Tae, asks him to go buy a Nishiki painting from the painting shop on her behalf. Though Sanosuke had no interest in paintings, he finds o…

episodes.name: Tsunan & Nishiki Paintings

episodes.overview: Kenshin and the group are enjoying some tea time together. The group probes Kenshin to entertain them with an interesting story from his travels, specifically requesting "a story that's unusual, fun, and includes a villain's defeat." To answer to their demand…

episodes.overview: The current Kenshin has left his past as a manslayer and wished for a peaceful world. Though Elder looked at him with eyes of confusion, Kenshin knew that Elder also shared this same desire for a healthy society and felt a sense of comradery with him. Meanwhi…

episodes.name: Resurrection of the Wolf
episodes.overview: Kenshin sees a dream recalling the Shinsengumi, who he faced off against back when he was a Revolutionary warrior. The Shinsengumi was a group of highly skilled swordsmen who he fought on equal footing back when he was the Hitokiri Battosai. He feels unsettle…

episodes.overview: After defeating Arundo Akamatsu, Kenshin returns to the Kamiya Dojo and sees Hajime Saito. Hajime had introduced himself to Kaoru and Yahiko as Goro Fujita, the police officer, and they had invited him into the Dojo without any suspicion. Hajime criticizes Ke…

episodes.overview: The person who had sent Hajime to face Kenshin was none other than the Head of the Home Ministry, former Satsuma Domain Revolutionary warrior, Toshimichi Okubo. He asks Kenshin to go to Kyoto to stop the secret plans of a man who claims to be the legitimate s…

episodes.name: To Kyoto
episodes.overview: Making the decision to fight against Shishio, Kenshin leaves Kamiya Dojo and sets off for Kyoto via the Tokaido by himself. Meanwhile, Sanosuke and Yahiko attempt to go to Kyoto to follow Kenshin.

episodes.name: On the East Sea Road
episodes.overview: Megumi is alone in Tokyo and coincidentally encounters Aoshi at Kamiya Dojo, who’s come back for another fight with Kenshin. Aoshi asks Megumi where Kenshin is, but she feigns ignorance. Unhappy with the lack of response, he threatens to kill her if she doesn…

episodes.name: The Abandoned Village
episodes.overview: The name of the girl that Kenshin encounters in the forests is Misao Makimachi, and she came from Kyoto to find Aoshi’s Oniwaban Group. Kenshin is surprised to hear his name. Upon seeing Kenshin’s reaction, she asks him if he knows where Aoshi is, but he keep…

episodes.name: Portrait of the Ambitious
episodes.overview: Kenshin steps into Shingetsu Village, a place where the Mishima brothers escaped from. The village is currently under the control of Senkaku, Shishio’s subordinate, who rules with an iron fist and uses violence to control the villagers. They are frightened of…

episodes.name: To Kyoto, Once More
episodes.overview: Kenshin defeats Senkaku and finally faces off against Shishio. However, Shishio expresses his disappointment at Kenshin's policy of refusing to kill and lets his close associate, Sojiro Seta, deal with Kenshin. He leaves the village with another associate of…

episodes.name: Encounter in the Forest
episodes.overview: Sanosuke makes his way to Kyoto while trudging through the forest and getting lost at the same time. On the road there, he meets Anji Yukyuzan, a fallen monk currently in training. Sanosuke witnesses Anji unleash an astonishing strike up close, a technique th…

episodes.name: Arrival in Kyoto
episodes.overview: Kenshin and Misao arrive in Kyoto, where they’re welcomed by Okina, a grandfather figure to Misao. It turns out, Okina is a former member of the Oniwaban Group. Okina offers his help and Kenshin ask him to help find someone for him.

episodes.name: Cho of the Ten of Swords
episodes.overview: Seeking a replacement for his broken sakabato, Kenshin visits Seiku, the son of highly honored swordsmith Shakku Arai, only to learn that he has quit making swords. Respecting Seiku’s philosophy of peace, Kenshin gives up his request for a new blade. Meanwhil…

episodes.name: Drawing of the Forbidden
episodes.overview: Known as “the Sword Hunter” in the Ten Swords organization, Cho is adept at maneuvering a variety of different and unique swords. As for Kenshin, he continues to risk his life and fight for peace in the new era and to save Seiku’s son, Iori, even though he’s…

episodes.name: Sakabato First Attack
episodes.overview: Going back in time, the 4th year of Keio. Kenshin is suffering from a high fever in the main hall of a desolate shrine. Kenshin falls asleep and when he awakens, he finds himself being nursed back to health by former private detective Giichi and his wife Sats…

episodes.name: Seijuro Hiko
episodes.overview: Kenshin obtains a new sakabato. Having involved Seiku in this conflict, he decides to leave Aoiya before inviting any further danger. Meanwhile, Misao stops by Shirobeko, a beef hot-pot restaurant where Kaoru and Yahiko work part time, where she learns Kaoru…

episodes.name: Meeting of the Warlords
episodes.overview: Kenshin reunites with Kaoru and the rest at Seijuro Hiko's place, who is a master of Hiten Mitsurugi-ryu. Seijuro learns from Kaoru that Kenshin goes around the country acting as a rurouni who helps people, when he then decides to pass down the last ultimate…

episodes.name: Aoshi vs. Okina
episodes.overview: Hoji plans an attack of Aoiya at night using a secret unit, the Owl Clan, in order to capture Okina and catch a hint of Kenshin's whereabouts, but instead the Owl Clan were the ones defeated. Okina challenges Aoshi to a battle via a member of the clan whom he…

episodes.name: Misao's Decision
episodes.overview: Aoshi injures Okina, leaves Misao behind, and shows up at Aoiya. He asks the Oniwaban Group where Kenshin is. Aoshi's in a ghastly state, but accepts what Yahiko and Kaoru tell him and decides to wait for Kenshin where Shishio is. Okina is on the verge of dea…

episodes.name: Between Life and Death
episodes.overview: Kenshin undergoes training so that he can learn the ultimate technique. He barely manages to get in a hit against Seijuro in a bout, where he then learns "Kuzuryuusen,"a powerful technique that launches nine slashes at the same time. Kenshin learns to see thr…

episodes.name: The Ten Swords Summoned
episodes.overview: As a result of passing down the ultimate technique, Seijuro endures a fatal wound.

episodes.name: The Other Objective
episodes.overview: Shishio's underlings inconspicuously prepare for their battle plan when patrols arrive causing them to retreat.

episodes.name: As If in Flight
episodes.overview: Kenshin and Hajime realize that Shishio has another objective in mind that lies in Osaka. They meet up with Sanosuke there. To stop the Great Kyoto Fire, Kenshin asks for help from everyone at Aoiya via a letter while leaving Ryusaku Arato, the chief of polic…

episodes.name: The Great Kyoto Fire (1)
episodes.overview: It is now midnight. Goichi and the others start moving as it is time to put the Great Kyoto Fire plan into action, when they witness Shishio's other underlings being chased by the police. Henya is annoyed that the fires haven't started on time. Meanwhile, an…

episodes.name: The Great Kyoto Fire (2)
episodes.overview: Kenshin and Aoshi engage in a battle on the deck of the ironclad Rengoku. Behind the scenes, Sanosuke manages to board the ship and tries to blow up the engine room with the explosives he got from Tsunan. However, Shishio's underlings Hoji, Shuzo, Toshiro pre…

episodes.name: The Great Kyoto Fire (3)
episodes.overview: The engine room of Rengoku. Hoji manages to catch the explosives and prevents the room from blowing up. However, Sanosuke delivers the Mastery of Two Layers to the ship's Kingston valve, flooding the perimeter. Meanwhile, Usui reveals himself to Kaoru, Yahiko…

episodes.name: Tears
episodes.overview: In Kyoto, Kaoru quickly notices something strange with Misao, as Misao comes back to the location where a fire was put out. At Megumi's clinic, Omi awakens, bringing tears of relief to Juro. Meanwhile, a black tag is put on Tokuji's toe to mark that he is dea…

episodes.name: A Beautiful Night
episodes.overview: Shishio sends a dueling challenge directed at Kenshin, Hajime, and Sanosuke. The duel is to be held the next day on Mt. Hiei, northeast half way up the mountain in a small shrine with a six-storied torii. At Shishio's fortress, Hoji proposes a strategy to Shi…

episodes.name: Change
episodes.overview: After enduring years of abuse from his peers, Park Hyeong-seok moves to a different neighborhood to start a new life. Big changes are coming for him.

episodes.name: New Life
episodes.overview: Hyeong-seok attends school in his new body by day and works a part-time job as his true self by night – only to learn that nothing has really changed.

episodes.name: Friends
episodes.overview: A student by the nickname Basco helps the old Hyeong-seok fight off bullies, while the new Hyeong-seok hangs out with his first-ever group of friends.

episodes.name: Mom
episodes.overview: Hyeong-seok takes his mother out to a cafe as his transformed self. Basco seethes with righteous indignation when he spots the two together.

episodes.name: Kindness
episodes.overview: Hyeong-seok lends a hand to other struggling peers in school, while an enigmatic classmate offers him help and gifts when he needs it most.

episodes.name: Recommendation
episodes.overview: Pyeon Deok-hwa considers performing at the school festival, while others in his class relentlessly try to trample on his dream of becoming a rap artist.

episodes.name: Special Training
episodes.overview: Under Deok-hwa’s direction, Hyeong-seok unlocks his singing potential as their musical collaboration nurtures their blossoming friendship.

episodes.name: Wall
episodes.overview: Competition heats up backstage on the day of the festival. Hyeong-seok and Deok-hwa leave their past and fears behind to deliver a song from the heart.

seasons.name: Limited Series
seasons.overview: With a demonic weapon in hand, a wandering swordsman-for-hire and a samurai brotherhood take on an uprising of the undead.

episodes.name: Demon
episodes.overview: Musashi Miyamoto receives the Oni Gauntlet for 33 days — along with a reluctant chaperone to watch over the precious item.

episodes.name: Mountain Demon
episodes.overview: The men arrive in the village, but it seems to be abandoned. While exploring the area, they come across a little girl who's all on her own.

episodes.name: Nightmare
episodes.overview: While leading the men to lemon's fortress, Sayo notices that there's something strange about the path that they're taking.

episodes.name: Bewitch
episodes.overview: The men arrive at the mountain temple and are confronted by three masked figures. While Musashi fights them, Kaizen, Sahei and Heikuro try to save Sayo.

episodes.name: Yin Soul
episodes.overview: The Yoshioka family isn't through with Musashi and his men yet. With Sayo suffering from a fever, Sahei leaves to forage for medicinal herbs.

episodes.name: Oni
episodes.overview: A strange man named Alfred welcomes Musashi and his friends into the lavish golden mountain before politely — but firmly — asking them to join Iemon.

episodes.name: Harbinger
episodes.overview: Years ago, Kensuke Matsuki acknowledged his young disciple's abilities, giving him the name Iemon and joining him in his wicked ambitions.

episodes.name: Yang Soul
episodes.overview: While escaping with Sayo, Sahei comes across Iemon, who begs and barters with him to save his life. Then, the third traitor reveals themselves.

episodes.name: The Traveling Demon
episodes.overview: While returning from a late-night tryst, Lord Narihira and his entourage encounter an oxcart traveling toward them — but there's no ox pulling the cart.

episodes.name: The Head Minister
episodes.overview: After a demon offers him the chance to embrace a woman of "peerless beauty," a lecherous lord comes before Seimei in need of help.

episodes.name: Ashiya Doman
episodes.overview: Saying a winged mouse sent her, an elderly servant asks Seimei for help; little Kujo and Lady Fujiko have begun to behave very strangely.

episodes.name: A Rumor of Love
episodes.overview: The revengeful spirit of a deceased poet named Tadami has been haunting the area. He's been mostly harmless — until now.

episodes.name: Are You Lovesick?
episodes.overview: When speaking to Tadami's father, Seimei and Hiromasa find out that Tadami had an encounter with a demon years before succumbing to his death.

episodes.name: The Lady Who Loved Insects
episodes.overview: Lord Tachibana consults with Ashiya Doman to cure his daughter of her love of insects, but Seimei is skeptical of her remedy.

episodes.name: Liveliness
episodes.overview: Hiromasa brings a basket of mushrooms to enjoy with Seimei, whom he finds completely engrossed in identifying some dead green insects.

episodes.name: The Fox's Child
episodes.overview: While watching over Seimei, Hiromasa sees visions of his dear friend's childhood and the torment he endured for being so different and gifted.

episodes.name: A Contest of Magic at the Imperial Court
episodes.overview: Lady Tsuyuko suspects an unlikely person of being the half demon. Seimei faces off against Ashiya Doman to see who the better Onmyoji is.

episodes.name: A Lost Curse
episodes.overview: Much to everyone's annoyance, Seimei has been visiting members of the imperial court in the middle of the night in search of the demon who attacked him.

episodes.name: Metamorphosis
episodes.overview: A drastic — and revealing — change comes over Atsumi. As Seimei struggles to accept recent events, Yasunori brings him an object that gives him hope.

episodes.name: The Lord Taizan Ceremony
episodes.overview: With Ashiya Doman's assistance, Seimei begins the Lord Taizan Ceremony. The familiar sound of a flute rings out.

episodes.name: The Demon Within
episodes.overview: As dark forces consume Atsumi, he has flashbacks to the long and enduring friendship he shared with Hiromasa.

episodes.name: The Grave Journey
episodes.overview: Young Kento starts raising a tiny daemon with remarkable powers and names her Anna. But not everyone takes kindly to his new companion.

episodes.name: A Tough Decision
episodes.overview: Kento and Anna's journey is dangerous and difficult. They hitch a ride with kind but mysterious workers also traveling westward.

episodes.name: Friend or Foe
episodes.overview: With relief, Kento and Anna arrive in a vibrant truck stop town in Shizuoka. But even here, they have trouble finding a place to stay.

episodes.name: Corrupted Soul
episodes.overview: When he learns that a child is trapped after being attacked at the abandoned shopping center, Kento steps up to help.

episodes.name: The Collector
episodes.overview: While Kento and Kaede travel through Nagoya, an aircraft crash-lands nearby, and a giant, spider-like daemon suddenly begins rampaging the area.

episodes.name: Awakening
episodes.overview: While trying to save Kento from the spider daemon, Anna suddenly undergoes a transformation. Kaede calls her friend at the Peace Organization.

episodes.name: Impurity of Peace
episodes.overview: In Osaka, Kento and Kaede beg Ichinose to help them get Anna back, but sneaking into the Peace Organization headquarters won't be easy.

episodes.name: Separated
episodes.overview: As Kaede, Ichinose and Kento work to rescue Anna, Kaede and her grandfather discover they have a difference of opinion.

episodes.name: The Little Friendship
episodes.overview: After a rocky start, Kento and Kouya Kokonoe settle into their life together — until Kento feels Anna's presence.

episodes.name: Strong-willed
episodes.overview: With help from Anna's friends, Kento gets a train ticket to Hakata. But the Peace Organization picks up his scent.

episodes.name: For All Departed Souls
episodes.overview: As the Peace Organization continues its search, a strange boy named Kiriko lets Kento and Anna stay at his house.

episodes.name: The Judgement
episodes.overview: Kaede finds Kento and, alarmed by his living situation, tries to get him to leave with her. But first, she has to deal with his mother.

episodes.name: At All Cost
episodes.overview: As everyone evacuates to escape the rampaging Restoration Daemon, Kento treks back to Hakata to speak to Kiriko directly.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: At her unknown uncle’s funeral, Yoon Seo-ha meets Kim Young-ho, a man claiming to be her half brother. Meanwhile, detective Choi Sung-jun chases new leads.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Seo-ha suspects Young-ho may have a hand in a recent tragic murder. An age-old conflict between chief detective Park Sang-min and Sung-jun surfaces.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The police refuse to arrest Young-ho, forcing Seo-ha to ask a private investigator to look for evidence. Sung-jun dives into Young-ho's shamanic past.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Young-ho receives an ominous warning about a family burial ground and runs after Seo-ha. Sang-min hastily orders a search of Young-ho's home.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Seo-ha's attempts at intimidating Young-ho go awry. Sung-jun and Sang-min track down a stranger who may be connected to the killings.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Confronted with the shocking truth about the burial ground, Seo-ha finds herself in peril — and she must devise a last-ditch effort to save herself.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: The shocking courtroom murder of a criminal triggers an investigation around a group of women as an intricate tale of terror and speculation unfolds.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: For over a decade, a terrified community lived in desperate fear of Akku Yadav and his gang. Then, one woman decided to stand up to his menace.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: With little help from the police, the enraged community of Kasturba Nagar hatches a bloody plot, but Yadav won’t be an easy target.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: As a righteous cop pursues a merciless criminal in Bihar, he finds himself navigating a deadly chase and a moral battle mired in corruption.

episodes.name: PATRA PARICHAY !
episodes.overview: Upon arriving in Bihar, police officer Amit Lodha grapples with a tough new way of life — but when a child is kidnapped, he springs into action.

episodes.name: CHANDANWA KA JANM !
episodes.overview: Chandan Mahto's notoriety grows after a bold move. As Amit's career advances, deep-rooted social mindsets and political pressures create hurdles.

episodes.name: AMIT KAUN ???
episodes.overview: In the lead-up to state elections, violence breaks out. Amit stands up to political power but receives backlash. Chandan makes a new adversary.

episodes.name: MOOH DIKHAI !!!
episodes.overview: After a bloody massacre orchestrated by Chandan, Amit is tasked with capturing the criminal — and faces a vexing road ahead.

episodes.name: MEETA JI KI LOVE STORY !!!
episodes.overview: Chandan's elusive whereabouts spark a new plan, with Amit and Ranjan using phone calls to track him. A secret tryst offers crucial clues.

episodes.name: MEETA JI KI LOVE STORY PART 2
episodes.overview: Amit makes a major announcement at a press meet. Chandan sets a trap with deadly consequences, while an explosive revelation stuns the team.

episodes.name: PHACE TO PHACE !
episodes.overview: The chase approaches a dramatic end, but peril lurks at every corner. The question remains: can Amit close the case, or will Chandan slip away?
