episodes.overview: Hye-in, a student of Seonwoo Girls' High School, works as a part-timer to make ends meet. One day, she gets a tutoring job for a wealthy middle schooler who wants to go to Cheongdam International High School. While her student is away, Hye-in takes a photo wi…

episodes.name: The Guilty One
episodes.overview: Hye-in starts posting more pictures taken with Na-yeon's expensive stuff. She goes overboard and even tries on Cheongdam High's uniform. Na-yeon catches her in the uniform and finds the pictures Hye-in's been uploading. Hye-in begs Na-yeon not to tell her mom…

episodes.name: The Witness
episodes.overview: Na-yeon's family makes complaints to Hye-in's school about her forgery and fraud. Hye-in is on the verge of getting expelled, so she meets the school director of Cheongdam High and begs for mercy. There, she witnesses something she shouldn't have.

episodes.name: Barking Up The Wrong Tree
episodes.overview: Hye-in is offered a place in Cheongdam International High School in return for keeping silent about the incident she witnessed. She buys a new pair of shoes for her new school but accidentally loses them. She runs into Je-na, who happened to be wearing the sa…

episodes.name: The Fiery Pit
episodes.overview: Hye-in forcefully takes the designer shoes off of Je-na and hurts her without knowing who she is. Je-na is determined to make Hye-in's life miserable at school. Do-eon sees Hye-in's application for enrolment in his father's study and decides to approach her.

episodes.name: The Sorority Party
episodes.overview: Do-eon asks Hye-in to tell him what happened on the night Hae-in fell from the rooftop. But Hye-in sets a condition in exchange for telling the truth. Hye-in gets invited to the sorority party, an exclusive party for the rich. There, she runs into Je-na again.

episodes.name: The Deal
episodes.overview: Je-na teaches Hye-in a lesson by ruining her dress and humiliating her at the party. After finding out what happened to Hye-in, Do-eon warns Je-na to stop bullying her. But Je-na pushes Hye-in further and tells her to drop out.

episodes.name: The Part-time Job
episodes.overview: Si-eun tells Hye-in about Lee Duk-min who lends money to the kids in urgent need of money. Hye-in ends up borrowing money from Duk-min without knowing the consequences it could bring. Meanwhile, Do-eon asks Hye-in to help him one more time...

episodes.name: Oh Si-eun's True Colours
episodes.overview: Je-na confronts Si-eun, telling her to leave Hye-in alone, but Si-eun backs her off with the story of her brother. Hye-in is shocked to find out what Si-eun wanted in the first place, but she doesn't back down and finds a way to make it through.

episodes.name: Déjà Vu
episodes.overview: So-mang catches Si-eun and Hye-in in the secluded restroom. After hearing how Si-eun blackmailed Hye-in, he promises to help her. On the day of Yul-hee and Woo-jin's anniversary, the ugly truth gets revealed. Hye-in witnesses something she shouldn't have agai…

seasons.name: Bitch X Rich 2
seasons.overview: After the fall of villain Oh Shi Eun in Season 1... The once unshakable hierarchy at Cheongdam International High School is now fractured! Kim Hye In, the witness of two murders the first member of Diamond 6 from an underprivileged class. Baek Je Na, the Quee…

episodes.name: Vengeance Ignited by the Privileged
episodes.overview: After Oh Si Eun's death, Kim Hye In becomes the prime suspect in the murder investigation. At school, her classmates harass her with scorn, labeling her an 'Equal Opportunity loser.' Realizing that she may never be able to change the course of her life, Hye I…

episodes.name: New Members of Diamond 6 Unveiled
episodes.overview: Je Na goes through daily distress caused by her family. Her father is on the verge of divorce, and Cha Jin Uk, a suitor with a contract marriage in mind, suddenly enters the picture. Meanwhile, facing expulsion, Hye In proposes a deal to Je Na to include her…

episodes.name: Secrets Unfold At Cheongdam High School
episodes.overview: With Je Na’s help, Hye In makes it into Diamond 6 and decides to act accordingly. Meanwhile, Hae In regains consciousness in the hospital and returns to Cheongdam International High School, but she appears to have lost her memory. Another new student, Jin Uk…

episodes.name: Secrets Unveiled, Bold Moves At The Party
episodes.overview: Amidst being mistreated and looked down upon for her memory loss, Hae In seems to make up her mind and asks Do Eon to take her as his partner to the party. Meanwhile, Je Na joins the party and reveals her secret in front of everyone. As the main characters ma…

episodes.name: Friend Or Foe, Who Can Be Trusted
episodes.overview: As relationships twist and allegiances shift, Yul Hui begins reaching out to Je Na’s enemies, determined to bring her down. On Je Na’s side, her once dismissive attitude toward Jin Uk begins to soften and the two form a reluctant yet increasingly cooperative…

episodes.name: Rumours Of Baek Je Na
episodes.overview: Hye In interrogates Sa Rang about whether he is actually Black Dog. Ultimately, Sa Rang confesses the truth regarding Oh Si Eun’s cellphone. After hearing Sa Rang’s account, Hye In is convinced that the person who took Si Eun’s phone is the one who pushed Si…

episodes.name: Unravelling The Truth Behind A Murder
episodes.overview: Framed in a drug scandal orchestrated by Yul Hui, Je Na’s downfall seems imminent, until her allies step in. Meanwhile, Hye In follows a clue tied to a wrist injury and begins to suspect who holds Si Eun’s phone. With everyone hiding their true loyalties and…

episodes.name: Ties That Strangle
episodes.overview: Tensions escalate as Hye In is forced into submission, becoming Yul Hui's pawn. However, Yul Hui's schemes unravel when her role in a setup against Je Na is exposed, putting her in a desperate position. Meanwhile, a new strategy emerges to take down Diamond 6…

episodes.name: Truth, Betrayal, And A Choice That Changes Everything
episodes.overview: After Hae In's death, the fragile balance between the characters starts to collapse. Yul Hui pressures Hye In to expose Je Na with a lie during her engagement ceremony with Jin Uk, using a video as leverage. As the fateful day approaches, Hye In stands at a c…

episodes.name: The Reckoning
episodes.overview: Despite the risk of revealing herself, Hye In bravely exposes Yul Hui and the web of corruption festering within the school during Je Na's wedding. As her meticulous plan sets off a chain reaction, buried truths begin to surface, drawing everyone deeper into…

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Twenty years after leaving her medical career, a housewife returns as a first-year resident — struggling to find her footing in a job full of surprises.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Cha Jeong-suk witnesses a frightening incident and freezes amid the chaos. She later receives a scary diagnosis — sending Seo In-ho into a spiral.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Back from the brink of death, Jeong-suk decides to live life differently — claiming her independence by making an ambitious career move.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Jeong-suk's acceptance leaves In-ho and Choi Seung-hi reeling. Jeong-suk attempts to adjust to her new role — but finds opposition from all sides.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: After an eventful night out, Jeong-suk gets closer with Roy Kim — irritating In-ho. At the hospital, she continues to struggle amid the chaos.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Rumors surrounding Jeong-suk and In-ho's relations arise. After Seung-hi puts her through the ringer, Jeong-suk wonders if she's cut out for the job.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Despite being singled out for praise, Jeong-suk faces belittlement from In-ho. Roy confronts In-ho about his behavior, later befriending Jeong-suk.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Jeong-suk clashes with In-ho about their daughter. She later finds evidence of her son's relationship. Seung-hi confronts Roy about his recent discovery.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: In-ho panics after his secret is discovered. Confronted with conflicting requests, Roy faces a difficult decision. Jeong-suk begins connecting the dots.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Finally clued in on In-ho's secret, Jeong-suk begins acting erratically. After In-ho's mother pays her a visit, Seung-hi faces an emergency.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: A public revelation leaves Jeong-suk in a tough spot. Seung-hi confronts In-ho about their future. Jeon So-ra lends Jeong-suk much-needed support.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Having reached her breaking point, Jeong-suk meets with Seung-hi and In-ho. Later, Roy and In-ho lock horns over their complicated emotions.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Seung-hi clashes with In-ho after choosing to hold her ground. Seo Jung-min spirals after experiencing a tragedy. Jeong-suk makes a resolute decision.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Jeong-suk attempts to move forward after making her decision — despite In-ho's persistence. Roy looks to find the truth about his family.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: After finding out the truth, Jeong-suk's mother deals with her health. Seung-hi works hard to find a treatment. In-ho rebels against Jeong-suk's wishes.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Jeong-suk learns shocking news that may bring her career to a halt. In-ho's mother panics about a looming situation — putting In-ho in a tough position.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: As everyone around her worries, Jeong-suk ties up her loose ends leading up to her procedure — all the while preparing for her future.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A tragic accident leaves an ambitious prosecutor with the mind of a child – forcing him and his mother to embark on a journey to heal their relationship.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After a tragedy turns her world upside down, Jin Young-soon raises her son with the aim of steering him away from a life of hardship like hers.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Filled with childhood resentment, Choi Kang-ho navigates his career with ruthless ambition — later approaching Young-soon with a cruel motive.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: A shocking accident leaves Kang-ho's outlook uncertain. Young-soon takes him home and seizes an opportunity for redemption.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: As Kang-ho recovers, he and Young-soon get closer. However, Young-soon later visits Seoul and witnesses unfavorable traces of Kang-ho's life.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: After retuning home, Lee Mi-joo encounters Kang-ho in his new condition. Young-soon faces aggression from an unrelenting neighbor.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Kang-ho experiences a mysterious attack. Mi-joo finds an fortuitous business opportunity. The town convenes to rally against Young-soon.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Young-soon panics about the future after she receives scary news. Another sudden blow forces her to make hard decisions about herself and Kang-ho.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Young-soon pushes Kang-ho to the limits. She later finds a perplexing item from her son's old life. Mi-joo navigates her complex feelings around Kang-ho.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Young-soon and Kang-ho go through recollections of Kang-ho's past — discovering another side to his story.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Young-soon prepares Kang-ho for a safer future. After a startling incident, Mi-joo and Kang-ho share a tender moment — further complicating their lives.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: With Mi-joo by his side, Kang-ho finds out the truth after an alarming moment. Bang Sam-sik gets caught up in a dangerous situation.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: After a frightening incident at the farm, Young-soon discovers more information. As Kang-ho proceeds with his plan, Mi-joo and Sam-sik follow suit.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Mi-joo and Sam-sik risk their safety to track down a key witness. Young-soon finds support from her friends.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Kang-ho enacts his final plan to take down Oh Tae-soo. Young-soon gives Kang-ho and Mi-joo her blessings.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Faced with complaints and an accident, Lee Hong-jo investigates an ominous temple, coming up against the mysterious — and cursed — Jang Sin-yu.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Now in possession of the enigmatic box, Hong-jo finds that opening it is not as easy as it seems. Sin-yu later asks Hong-jo for a favor.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Desperate for love, Hong-jo wonders if her spell was a success. Sin-yu later brings Hong-jo along on a trip for a spell of his own.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Faced with a mix-up, Sin-yu asks Hong-jo to reverse a spell. After coming to Hong-jo's rescue, Sin-yu remembers a clear moment from the past.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Sin-yu finds himself unable to resist the desires of his heart, but a third party complicates the matter. Hong-jo pursues a romantic interest of her own.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Amid a budding love triangle, Sin-yu struggles to remember what happened with Hong-jo. A much-awaited reversal spell doesn't go as planned.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: The love triangle intensifies as Sin-yu and Kwon Jae-gyeong vie for Hong-jo's attention. An unexpected person begins to make Hong-jo uncomfortable.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Hong-jo decides to put up boundaries with Sin-yu. But after she encounters an unsettling situation, he comes to her aid.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: While Hong-jo and Sin-yu both experience illnesses, a sinister plot forms in the dark. Later, they share a tender moment of connection, present and past.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Sin-yu makes a decision after remembering his past, making things harder for Hong-jo. As everything falls into place, an evil plot goes into effect.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: As Hong-jo and Sin-yu grow closer, news of their relationship spreads. But as unsavory information circulates in the midst, Hong-jo navigates a minefield.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Hong-jo experiences a vision after Sin-yu rescues her from a dangerous situation. Hong-jo discovers the true reason behind Sin-yu's worsening symptoms.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Upon realizing the truth about their history, Hong-jo takes distance from Sin-yu — until a frightening incident brings him closer to her.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: As Hong-jo navigates a devastating situation, her past life with Sin-yu comes to light. But just as the worst seems to be over, a threat remains.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Even with their relationship solidified, Hong-jo and Sin-yu meet resistance from his father. Hong-jo confronts Yoon Na-yeon about their past.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Clued in on her next threat, Hong-jo goes head-to-head with her stalker. Hong-jo and Sin-yu make a momentous decision about their future.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Marriage or war of the century? Hong Hae-in, the third-generation heiress to Queens Group and the queen of department stores, has been married for three years to Baek Hyun-woo, Yongdu-ri village chief's son and the prince of supermarkets. As the couple weathe…

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Baek Hyun-woo and Hong Hae-in navigate a tense relationship, both at home and at work. But upon deciding his future, Hyun-woo pays a visit to his family.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: After Hae-in reveals her grim news to Hyun-woo, he begins to treat her nicely. Meanwhile, Hae-in's old classmate returns to Korea and joins Queens Group.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Hyun-woo discovers troubling evidence after saving Hae-in from a boar attack. Meanwhile, the two slowly find their long-lost feelings reigniting.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: As Yoon Eun-sung increasingly interlopes in Hae-in's life, Hyun-woo begins to feel jealous. Hae-in later shows up for Baek Du-gwan in his time of need.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: As Hyun-woo and Hae-in spend time in his hometown, they awkwardly navigate their complex feelings. Hae-in later receives bad news about her diagnosis.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Hyun-woo unexpectedly shows up in Berlin to secure a treatment for Hae-in. Meanwhile in Korea, Hong Man-dae faces a crisis at his company.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Feeling betrayed by Hyun-woo, Hae-in pushes him away and becomes cold. Back in Korea, Hyun-woo begins to unravel a scheme against Hae-in's family.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Despite being in a tense situation with Hae-in, Hyun-woo remains firm about staying in the company as his suspicions towards Eun-sung grow even stronger.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Hae-in and her family go into hiding in Hyun-woo's hometown to figure out their next move. Eun-sung discovers the truth about Hae-in's health.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Eun-sung tracks down Hae-in, presenting her with an ultimatum. Meanwhile, Hyun-woo skillfully uses leverage to get Grace Ko on the Hong family's side.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Hae-in makes a shocking announcement at a press conference. Hyun-woo launches a risky evidence-collecting crusade to save Queens Group.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Hae-in's symptoms worsen as she suffers from hallucinations, which Eun-sung takes advantage of. Soon after, Hyun-woo finds himself captured and in danger.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: The Hong family initiates a counterattack against Seul-hee and Eun-sung. Hyun-woo and Hae-in get to experience a freshly renewed life as 'newlyweds.'

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: After Hae-in shows hesitation about the surgery, her loved ones try to persuade her. Meanwhile, Eun-sung heads to Germany with a sinister plan.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: As Hae-in recovers from surgery, Eun-sung tries to stay right by her side. Meanwhile, Hyun-woo searches for evidence to vindicate himself.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Eun-sung executes his final plan to make Hae-in his own. As she tries to escape from his grasp with the help of Hyun-woo, will they finally find peace?
Fear ripples through Chitradurga when a young woman is murdered amid horrific cases of assault. A frantic probe leads to an unexpected suspect.
In Bangalore, Umesh Reddy continues his lawless streak. Circling the case, police are stumped by some increasingly unusual findings and a bold escape.
As Reddy preys on women, media sensationalism reaches its peak. What will it take to catch the ingenious predator and for justice to prevail?

episodes.name: Inside the Fish Tank vs. Outside the Fish Tank
episodes.overview: In hopes of getting discovered as a singer, Seo Mok-ha recruits Jung Ki-ho to film a video. But as terror strikes both of them, they flee for a new life.

episodes.name: Coincidence vs. Fate
episodes.overview: After a fortuitous rescue, Mok-ha reenters society with a little aid from Kang Woo-hak. Later, Mok-ha gets the chance to help her idol, Yoon Ran-joo.

episodes.name: Cooler Box vs. Drone
episodes.overview: Ran-joo gets closer to Mok-ha — even getting her a chance to audition. But when the meeting doesn't go in their favor, Mok-ha devises another idea.

episodes.name: 2008 vs. 2022
episodes.overview: Ran-joo performs on a television program, a singing competition with her past self. Mok-ha tries to get a message out to Ki-ho, hoping he's listening.

episodes.name: Regret vs. Pride
episodes.overview: After Mok-ha's frightening encounter with Ki-ho's father, Woo-hak begins investigating him. Mok-ha and Ran-joo get a chance to share the stage together.

episodes.name: Secrets vs. Lies
episodes.overview: Woo-hak learns the truth about his past from Kang Bo-geol. Mok-ha confronts Eun Mo-rae, the idol she could have been had she not been stranded.

episodes.name: Seo Mok-ha vs. Eun Mo-rae
episodes.overview: During a television program, Ran-joo makes a confession and forces Mok-ha to face off against Mo-rae. A threatening encounter compels Mok-ha to run away.

episodes.name: First Fan vs. First Fan
episodes.overview: Bo-geol and Woo-hak retreive Mok-ha and take her on a camping trip with their family. Mok-ha tries to track down Ran-joo to make up for a mistake.

episodes.name: Consolation vs. Resolution
episodes.overview: Feeling the imminent threat of his father, Bo-geol confronts him first. After a tense exchange with Ran-joo, Mok-ha signs with RJ Entertainment.

episodes.name: Answers vs. Risks
episodes.overview: A scary encounter with Jung Bong-wan leads to Bo-geol's family getting bad press. Ran-joo asks Mok-ha to make a hard choice about her career.

episodes.name: Giver vs. Taker
episodes.overview: Ran-joo and Mok-ha receive negative press after meeting with reporters. The Kang family interviews with the prosecutor in their case against Bong-wan.

episodes.name: Coincidence vs. Fate
episodes.overview: Bong-wan executes his final attack on the Kang family. Mok-ha prepares to release her debut song — marking the beginning of her singing career.

episodes.name: Part 1
episodes.overview: Sultan is a star buffalo, who is talk of the town and loved by the family for his extraordinary virility. But, the one person who hates Sultan is Deepu, who is a good for nothing, single child of the family who always lurks in the shadows of Sultan.

episodes.name: Part 2
episodes.overview: Impelled by guilt, Deepu jumps into the river, but this in turn puts him in a much more intricate situation where he awekens his virility and takes the position of Sultan in his family. The chaos in Deepu's life returns when Binny asks his help as her husband…

episodes.name: Enter Doctor Maniac
episodes.overview: Baek Kang-hyuk arrives at Hankuk National University Hospital to vitalize the trauma unit — diving headfirst into a stabbing and a hiking accident.

episodes.name: The Birth of Protégé No.1
episodes.overview: During a high-risk helicopter rescue, Kang-hyuk and Yang Jae-won attempt surgery mid-air. But, as the two grow fonder, Kang-hyuk clashes with Han Yu-rim.

episodes.name: Keep On Running
episodes.overview: A multi-car wreck brings critical patients, forcing Kang-hyuk and Jae-won to handle sensitive organ transplants — all while they face internal pushback.

episodes.name: Closer Than You Think
episodes.overview: Amid a contentious budget meeting, Kang-hyuk rushes to save a trauma patient close to Jae-won and Yu-rim. He soon hears a dark rumor about his past.

episodes.name: Code Black
episodes.overview: While facing media ridicule, Kang-hyuk confronts a bridge disaster — forcing all hands on deck and leading to Jae-won's first solo emergency surgery.

episodes.name: Reasons for Not Giving Up
episodes.overview: Even as hospital politics intensify, Kang-hyuk's focus on patients stands firm. Meanwhile, Cheon Jang-mi tries to cheer up a despondent Jae-won.

episodes.name: SOS from South Sudan
episodes.overview: Facing a malpractice investigation, Kang-hyuk's crisis doubles: save a critical patient and defend his reputation. After, he embarks for a case abroad.

episodes.name: Patient: Baek Kang-hyuk
episodes.overview: Amid flying bullets, Kang-hyuk leads his team to save a military captain. Upon his return, he suddenly finds his life in the hands of his protégés.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The snowy, ice-covered planet Coldfoot is home to a precious energy-rich ore called “sig.” On the surface, the planet seems to be a crime-free utopia, but in reality prisoners are used for back-breaking sig mining. Jim, a young prison guard, rushes to the sit…

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Jim prepares for another day at work as a guard at White Prison. During his commute, he notices that something is off.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: As Jim scavenges through broken pieces of equipment, Walter reluctantly lends a hand. They manage to signal for help but must escape discreetly.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Jim has a flashback to his childhood self with Ed and Marnie. Back in reality, an unlikely ally rescues him from the rubble.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Devastated by the horrendous sight, Jim rushes to save Ed. But they are no match against the deadly beast.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Ambushed while using the restroom, Jim regains consciousness behind bars. Worried about Marnie, he must think on his feet.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: After Dr. Hadson blacks out, Marnie attempts to take over the navigation. Meanwhile, Boyd and Rachel provide vital information regarding the Swarm.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: All hope is lost, but nature doesn’t wait — Marnie goes into labor. Walter reveals the truth about his dark past.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: With everyone's support, Jim sets his plan in motion to bait the Swarm. All seems to go well until Howard goes rogue.

episodes.name: Living in the Mist
episodes.overview: An accidental date with Jeong Gu-won leaves Do Do-Hee feeling flustered. She later becomes a victim of an attack — where a rescue requires a contract.

episodes.name: Everyone Has a Demon in Their Heart
episodes.overview: Gu-won inexplicably loses his power — and finds that Do-hee might be the key to regaining it. But his efforts to take back his abilities backfire.

episodes.name: Joining Hands With a Demon
episodes.overview: After another attack, Do-hee asks Gu-won to be her guard — even after his admission as a demon. Do-hee finds the loss of someone close suspicious.

episodes.name: Sweet but Dangerous
episodes.overview: Do-hee proposes to Gu-won, but he refuses. She later recruits him to investigate Ju Cheon-suk's death, but he faces an unexpected power blockage.

episodes.name: Only You
episodes.overview: After a dramatic rescue, Gu-won and Do-hee begin having complex feelings for each other. Do-hee later tries to find a man to marry — frustrating Gu-won.

episodes.name: Into the Wheel of Fortune
episodes.overview: After Gu-won saves Do-hee's life, she receives competing marriage proposals. She ends up choosing one, and finds an alarming face at her wedding.

episodes.name: Stained Relationships
episodes.overview: Do-hee and Gu-won go through newlywed pains as they move in together. Ju Seok-hoon begins to suspect Gu-won's non-human identity.

episodes.name: The Fateful Choice
episodes.overview: After a sudden attack on Gu-won, Do-hee rushes to save his life — and as life around her becomes more dangerous, she makes a surprising career move.

episodes.name: The Unmasked Truth
episodes.overview: As Do-hee and Gu-won's relationship finally blossoms, Gu-won begins to experience a strange change in his powers — all amidst a larger looming threat.

episodes.name: Breaking Through the Shell
episodes.overview: Upon discovering his fate, Gu-won tries to find another way to save himself. But just as he and Do-hee prepare their ritual, she becomes a target.

episodes.name: A Paradise of the Ominous
episodes.overview: Gu-won finds his power restored after rescuing Do-hee from a sure death — but with side effects. With no time to waste, the two investigate the attack.

episodes.name: The Savior of Destruction
episodes.overview: A dream of Gu-won's past life reveals his tragic connection to Do-hee. After the two hear of a death, their suspicions of the Noh family deepens.

episodes.name: The Past, the Original Sin
episodes.overview: As Gu-won and Do-hee enjoy their bliss, he notices her unresolved trauma. The two later join Noh Suk-min for dinner, unaware of his true intentions.

episodes.name: Our Personal Hell
episodes.overview: Gu-won comes to Do-hee's rescue after a frightening confrontation with Suk-min. But Suk-min's revelation about Cheon-suk leaves Do-hee harrowed.

episodes.name: The End of Fate
episodes.overview: Police fails to find Suk-min's body, opening up a concerning possibility. Do-hee attempts to bury her feelings after Gu-won disappears without a trace.

episodes.name: Our Personal Heaven
episodes.overview: Do-hee finds herself catatonic after her loss. Desperate for Gu-won's return, she makes a Christmas wish for her love — which Noh Suk-nyeo hears.

episodes.name: THE BOY'S DEPARTURE
episodes.overview: As Percival turns sixteen, his grandfather tells him about the big world beyond their far-flung home — but the young man seems more interested in dinner.

episodes.name: THE UNKNOWN FORCE
episodes.overview: On a journey to find his estranged father, Percival comes across a group of traveling performers who give him a lift to the nearest village.

episodes.name: THE FOUR KNIGHTS OF THE APOCALYPSE
episodes.overview: Although Percival puts up a good fight, the black knight hasn't unleashed his full powers yet. Suddenly, a mysterious red fox appears.

episodes.name: THE DEMON OF ECHO GORGE
episodes.overview: Percival wakes up to find himself tied up and experimented on. His captor tells him that he's almost perfected the medicine he's been developing.

episodes.name: A RESOLVE FURTHER HONED
episodes.overview: To return his grandfather to his original form, Nasiens will have to defeat another Holy Knight, and Percival is determined to help.

episodes.name: SISTANA SHAKEN
episodes.overview: Percival and his friends come across a fierce young woman named Anne who, against her father's will, dreams of becoming a Holy Knight.

episodes.name: THE NAME OF THE MAGIC
episodes.overview: Although Ironside completely overpowers them, Percival, Anne and Nasiens put up a brave fight. But Donny is nowhere to be seen.

episodes.name: YOUNG HEROES
episodes.overview: While Percival and crew struggle to destroy the Coffin of Eternal Darkness, a powerful mysterious ally faces the monsters raiding the town.

episodes.name: MASTER AND PUPIL
episodes.overview: The group — now joined by an exuberant Anne — make a stop in the rough town of Cant, where Donny has an awkward family reunion.

episodes.name: ROAR OF DESTRUCTION
episodes.overview: While held captive, Howzer, Nasiens and the others find out that Edlin has stolen a dragon's egg, putting the whole town in danger.

episodes.name: A REAL HOLY KNIGHT
episodes.overview: As Percival, Donny and Anne have their hands full trying to stop the rampaging dragon, the still drunk Howzer asks Nasiens to sober him up.

episodes.name: A SINISTER ENDEAVOR
episodes.overview: On the way to Liones Kingdom, Sin experiences a peculiar dream. The next morning, despite a passerby's warning, the crew stumbles upon a strange village.

episodes.name: THE CORNERED
episodes.overview: Percival faces off against Kellie, a powerful and merciless mythical beast. The crew chases Ardbeg into a mysterious cave, only to find out it's a trap.

episodes.name: THE GOAT SIN
episodes.overview: Ardbeg's magic transforms Percival and his crew into helpless babies. The elder of the demon clan village comes to their rescue, presenting an ultimatum.

episodes.name: THE DARK TALISMANS
episodes.overview: Arthur's men, hiding in the distance, ambush Gowther and Ardbeg. Restored to their original forms, Percival and his crew continue their perilous journey.

episodes.name: DEPARTING FROM SIN
episodes.overview: Percival and his crew go head-to-head with the Dark Talismans. However, Fiddick devises a plan to defeat the young crew's source of strength.

episodes.name: THE KING OF LIONES
episodes.overview: Arriving at Liones Kingdom, Percival and his crew head to the castle to meet the king. But they find him absent, and soon Percival strays into trouble.

episodes.name: KIGHTS OF PROPHECY MEET
episodes.overview: The former king has an ominous dream about the Four Knights. Percival and his crew are introduced to Tristan and set off in search of the fourth knight.

episodes.name: LIONES IN FLAMES
episodes.overview: A mysterious girl appears before Lancelot, delivering a prophecy. Meanwhile, a hostile drunkard provokes a fight with a Ruby Holy Knight.

episodes.name: TAMING A WILD HORSE
episodes.overview: The Four Knights of Apocalypse finally gather together in one place. However, they can't agree on how to handle Pellegarde — until Percival steps in.

episodes.name: THE FOUR KNIGHTS VS THE SERVANTS OF CHAOS
episodes.overview: Under Arthur's orders, powerful members of the demon clan wreak havoc in the kingdom. Meliodas seeks to uncover the truth behind King Arthur's motives.

episodes.name: FREEZING, BURNING HEARTS
episodes.overview: The Four Knights collaborate to combat the servants of Chaos. Meanwhile, sensing imminent danger, Lancelot makes his way to the castle.

episodes.name: ROYAL HOLY KNIGHTS VS MELA-GALLAND
episodes.overview: With Lancelot missing, Galland and Melascula resurrect by fusing together. Outmatched, Percival, Tristan and Gawain need all the help they can get.

episodes.name: ADVENT
episodes.overview: Drawing strength from the people's hope, Percival faces Mela-Galland, who proves to be too powerful. Tristan takes a dangerous risk to counterattack.

episodes.name: THE POWER OF THE KING
episodes.overview: King Arthur of Camelot makes a grand entrance and offers an enticing promise to the people of Liones. Later, Arthur and Meliodas cross swords.

episodes.name: PREPARED TO PART WAYS
episodes.overview: After a restless night, Percival and his companions receive Meliodas's summons to the audience chamber. He asks if they are ready to part ways.

episodes.name: GUINEVERE
episodes.overview: While the other Knights prepare for their imminent departure, Lancelot has a fateful meeting with Guinevere, who has a unique ability.

episodes.name: CONFRONTATION
episodes.overview: Guinevere arrives in Camelot just as she's predicted and meets King Arthur. Meanwhile, the Four Knights arrive at their first stop: Wolnack.

episodes.name: CITY OF BATTLE
episodes.overview: As Percival and the rest enjoy the festivities, Tristan is led away by his new roommate. The group splits up to find him, unaware of the looming danger.

episodes.name: FLAMES OF REMINISCENCES
episodes.overview: Percival's group might have captured their enemy, but they can't agree on the next step. Elsewhere, Isolde, Anne and Jade face a deadly surprise attack.

episodes.name: THE CRAZED KING
episodes.overview: While grieving their tragic loss, the Four Knights try to enter Camelot with Teaninich's help but soon discover they must find another way forward.

episodes.name: THE SAVIOR
episodes.overview: The Four Knights and their companions arrive in the demon realm, where they learn more about Percival's mysterious past, and a touching reunion awaits.

episodes.name: BEHEMOTH OF CALAMITY
episodes.overview: While Gawain battles Mortlach's group, the other Knights learn about the perilous path ahead: the door to Camelot is on the back of a monstrous beast.

episodes.name: WAVERING HEARTS
episodes.overview: In preparation for their upcoming quest, Lancelot puts Percival through harsh swordsmanship training. Meanwhile, Schwarz challenges Tristan to a showdown.

episodes.name: THE BOY OF DESTINY
episodes.overview: After unleashing a new form of his power, Percival continues training with Lancelot. Later, hitchhikers threaten the Knights' quest to find the Behemoth.

episodes.name: BANQUET FOR BRAVES
episodes.overview: While in a trance, Percival learns the shocking truth behind his existence. Later, the two factions face off in an intense showdown.

seasons.name: Limited Series
seasons.overview: The drama follows the adventurous life and many trials of Ae-sun (IU), a poor girl wanting to become a poet who was born in Jeju in 1951, and Gwan-sik (Park Bo-gum), a young man who cherishes and loves her. The drama is narrated by their daughter, Yang Geum-m…

episodes.name: Spring in a Heartbeat
episodes.overview: Raised by a tenacious mother, a young, bright-eyed Ae-sun has dreams bigger than her village — until an unexpected tragedy changes everything.

episodes.name: Sassy First Love
episodes.overview: As love blossoms between Ae-sun and Gwan-sik, they make their first bold move together. But their romantic adventure hits a snag.

episodes.name: Yesterday Was Your Spring
episodes.overview: After a dramatic rescue, Ae-sun and Gwan-sik return to Jeju. Soon, Ae-sun resigns herself to a sad fate — leaving Gwan-sik devastated.

episodes.name: The Blazing Summer Sunshine
episodes.overview: Summer brings joy as the newlyweds start a life together, but living with Gwan-sik's family tests their happiness — can they find a path to peace?

episodes.name: A Midsummer Night's Full Nets
episodes.overview: As Gwan-sik struggles to find work, Ae-sun worries for her family — until a lifeline appears. Soon after, Ae-sun sets her ambitions higher in Jeju.

episodes.name: Life Goes on and On
episodes.overview: Just as Ae-sun and Gwan-sik taste the joys of their new life, a summer storm changes everything — testing their will to carry on.

episodes.name: A Fruitful Fall
episodes.overview: As the village chief election approaches, Ae-sun faces corrupt opposition. Geum-myeong receives an unusual request that tests her morals.

episodes.name: The Moon Wanes, Yet the Young Heart Remains
episodes.overview: When Geum-myeong receives a chance to study in Japan, dreams take flight. Now Ae-sun and Gwan-sik must make a tough decision.

episodes.name: The Wind Goes Whoosh, My Heart Goes Boo-Hoo
episodes.overview: Life in a small apartment tests Ae-sun and Gwan-sik as they struggle to parent Yang Eun-myeong. Meanwhile, Geum-myeong juggles love and life in Seoul.

episodes.name: The Storm Sweeps My Heart, the Love Rocks My Heart
episodes.overview: While Geum-myeong grows closer to her quirky colleague, Ae-sun's troubling dreams stir real concerns. Do they hold any meaning?

episodes.name: My Love by My Side
episodes.overview: As Geum-myeong's engagement moves toward marriage, her heart fills with doubt — will her first love story find its happy ending like her mother's?

episodes.name: A Glistening Winter
episodes.overview: Back in Jeju, Geum-myeong mends her heart in familiar surroundings. Ae-sun treasures sweet moments with her loved ones.

episodes.name: Such an Uneven Love
episodes.overview: While facing a career setback during an economic downturn, Geum-myeong encounters a familiar face — sparking an unexpected new beginning.

episodes.name: Spread Your Wings and Fly
episodes.overview: Ae-sun and Gwan-sik grapple with Yang Eun-myeong's misfortune, sacrificing everything they can to help him. But Eun-myeong's self-confidence takes a hit.

episodes.name: A Spring Every Day
episodes.overview: Between new business ventures and career changes, the family faces separate hurdles on their paths — drawing strength from their bond to press ahead.

episodes.name: Here's to All You've Been Through
episodes.overview: As the Yang family finally enjoys the fruits of their labor, sudden agony strikes — testing their resolve and the strength of their enduring love.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: After a scandal shakes her world, a hot shot photographer takes an unexpected detour from the demanding life in Seoul and makes a spontaneous return to her long-avoided Jeju Island hometown.

episodes.name: Tears of the Dragon
episodes.overview: After harshly rebuking her assistant, Jo Sam-dal becomes embroiled in a scandal and faces severe blowback — forcing her to return to her hometown.

episodes.name: The Soulmates' History
episodes.overview: While moping over her career downfall, Sam-dal awkwardly encounters Jo Yong-pil. She later runs into him again — where she must come to his rescue.

episodes.name: Like Wild Birds, Soaring, Dreaming, Descending
episodes.overview: Sam-dal avoids being seen in public as more people find out about her arrival. But she overhears a hurtful conversation, causing her to break down.

episodes.name: The Rotten Apple of My Eye
episodes.overview: As the townspeople talk, Sam-dal sets the record straight to her community. Ashamed by the truth, Sam-dal lies to Yong-pil about her love life.

episodes.name: I See You
episodes.overview: As Yong-pil shows concern for Sam-dal, she confronts him about his insistence. When a reporter shows up to Sam-dal's town, her friends go to bat for her.

episodes.name: "The Dreams" by Jo Yong-pil
episodes.overview: Yong-pil finds competition in Bu Sang-do for Sam-dal's love. Sam-dal finds out about Park Eun-joo's scheme and heads to Seoul to find out the truth.

episodes.name: Breaking Up, With Love
episodes.overview: Sang-do confronts Yong-pil about their shared feelings for Sam-dal. Sam-dal's mother begins to suspect something is happening between Sam-dal and Yong-pil.

episodes.name: The Bracken Rain of Jeju
episodes.overview: Go Mi-ja experiences a frightening moment during a dive amid lingering health problems. After much encouragement, Sam-dal enters a photo competition.

episodes.name: The Story of the Two Mi-jas
episodes.overview: As Mi-ja's condition remains dire, Sam-dal learns she's been unaware about her mother's health — and that Yong-pil's been more present than she'd known.

episodes.name: The Variables We Couldn't Predict
episodes.overview: After a drunken night, Sam-dal agonizes over a tender moment with Yong-pil. But they soon are forced to take a trip around Jeju for the photo contest.

episodes.name: What Doesn't Kill You Makes You Stronger
episodes.overview: A man from Jo Jin-dal's past angers her family with an ill-advised announcement. Sam-dal continues to agonize over her feelings toward Yong-pil.

episodes.name: Welcome Home
episodes.overview: Sam-dal worries about her mother's perception as her relationship with Yong-pil's grows. After uploading a video of Sam-dal, Eun-joo comes to Samdal-ri.

episodes.name: That Damn One-sided Love
episodes.overview: Just as Yong-pil and Sam-dal get closer, his father harshly rebukes them. Amid the tension, Mi-ja finally stands up for herself — and the past.

episodes.name: When Your Tears Dry Out
episodes.overview: After becoming official, Sam-dal and Yong-pil go off on a shoot — but they're joined by guests. Sam-dal later attempts to win over Yong-pil's father.

episodes.name: It Takes a Village to Raise a Dragon
episodes.overview: Eun-joo plants a story about Sam-dal, complicating her role in the photo contest. But Sam-dal's community bands together to aid in her exhibition.

episodes.name: Welcome to Samdal-ri
episodes.overview: As Eun-joo's lies catch up to her, Sam-dal hosts her exhibition. She later finds out about Yong-pil's secret dream — and his hesitation about pursuing it.

episodes.name: Maomao
episodes.overview: After being kidnapped and forced to work as a servant in the rear palace, former apothecary Maomao inadvertently draws the attention of the higher ranks when she investigates what's causing the emperor's infant heirs to fall mysteriously ill.

episodes.name: Chilly Apothecary
episodes.overview: Maomao tries to settle into her promotion to lady-in-waiting and food taster, but struggles to fend off both boredom and the overly-familiar Jinshi. That is, until she gets an assignment of her dreams: to concoct an aphrodisiac.

episodes.name: The Unsettling Matter of the Spirit
episodes.overview: Tasked with investigating a ghostly woman dancing nightly on the palace walls, Maomao finds a sleepwalking Concubine Fuyou. But with no medicinal cure for sleepwalking, she's forced to dig deeper to find the real reason behind Fuyou's affliction.

episodes.name: The Threat
episodes.overview: Under direct orders from the emperor himself, Maomao tries to care for an ailing Concubine Lihua, but finds her work impeded by Lihua's own ladies-in-waiting.

episodes.name: Covert Operations
episodes.overview: A eunuch stricken by a curse comes begging for aid. Meanwhile, the rear palace buzzes with excitement as everyone prepares for the upcoming garden party, and Gyokuyou's ladies-in-waiting aren't about to let Maomao get away without dressing her up.

episodes.name: The Garden Party
episodes.overview: Maomao does her best to navigate the complex social situations at the garden party, including meeting the other Upper First rank concubines. But once she settles down to do her work as a food-taster, she discovers a surprise in a bowl of soup.

episodes.name: Homecoming
episodes.overview: Gaoshun goes to Maomao to get her help in resolving the events of the garden party. Later, Xiaolan explains the purpose of the hairpins Maomao was gifted, and Maomao makes a deal with Lihaku in order to finally visit home.

episodes.name: Wheat Stalks
episodes.overview: Maomao's peaceful morning at home is interrupted when she's called in to investigate an apparent double suicide at one of the local brothels.

episodes.name: Suicide or Murder?
episodes.overview: An older acquaintance of Jinshi's dies while drinking at a party. A servant's body turns up in a moat. Both deaths are written off as self-inflicted, but Maomao's keen observations tell her that there's more to both stories.

episodes.name: Honey
episodes.overview: A tea party hosted by Lady Gyokuyou puts the politics of the rear palace at the forefront, and Maomao learns something new about Lady Lishu. His true intentions unclear, Jinshi sends Maomao to work for Lady Ah-Duo.

episodes.name: Reducing Two to One
episodes.overview: Maomao confronts Fengming about the dark secret she's been hiding from her noble Lady Ah-Duo.

episodes.name: The Eunuch and the Courtesan
episodes.overview: Discovering that Maomao's kidnappers were connected to Fengming's family, Jinshi is faced with a choice between keeping Maomao in the rear palace where he can be near her or releasing her from her service.

episodes.name: Serving in the Outer Court
episodes.overview: To Maomao's surprise, Jinshi brings her directly to his house instead of taking her back to the rear palace, and tells her she's to work in the outer court. Not only is there much to learn, it seems there's many eyes on her as the new hire.

episodes.name: The New Pure Consort
episodes.overview: Ah-Duo's replacement has arrived in the rear palace, and Maomao is assigned to give a certain lecture to all four high concubines. Later, Maomao helps Lihaku investigate a warehouse explosion.

episodes.name: Raw Fish
episodes.overview: Gaoshun requests Maomao's help in solving an apparent poisoning case. Meanwhile, Jinshi deals with an unwelcome visitor who's taken to lingering in his office.

episodes.name: Lead
episodes.overview: A shack, a chest of drawers, and a fishbowl are all that a talented metalworker leaves to his three sons upon his death. Maomao is assigned to investigate how these strange inheritances all fit together.

episodes.name: A Jaunt Around Town
episodes.overview: Covering up Jinshi's otherworldly beauty is no easy task, but after Maomao takes the challenge head-on, she's surprised when she's also asked to don the disguise of a noblewoman and escort "Jinka" outside the palace.

episodes.name: Lakan
episodes.overview: Back at home, Maomao visits an annex building at the Verdigris House that hides one of the brothel's secrets. Lakan continues to antagonize Jinshi as his connection to Maomao becomes clear.

episodes.name: Chance or Something More
episodes.overview: A discussion with Lihaku about recent events leads Maomao to realize that the mysteries she's helped to solve are connected. As the final piece of the puzzle falls into place, she rushes to stop impending disaster.

episodes.name: Thornapple
episodes.overview: Maomao was able to stop the assassination attempt, but was heavily injured in the process. However, the injuries aren't enough to stop her curiosity, driving her to confront the culprit behind the incident.

episodes.name: How to Buy Out a Contract
episodes.overview: Back to work at the rear palace, Maomao listens to Guen talk about his family's business. Meanwhile, Lihaku hears a rumor that whips him into action.

episodes.name: Blue Roses
episodes.overview: Lakan challenges Jinshi to produce blue roses to present at the upcoming garden party, forcing Jinshi to turn once again to Maomao for her help.

episodes.name: Balsam and Woodsorrel
episodes.overview: No longer willing to keep running away from Lakan, Maomao decides to face off against him. She challenges him on his own turf, in a chess match.

episodes.name: Jinshi and Maomao
episodes.overview: Lakan must now choose a courtesan to buy out. As a high-ranking military official, he can afford to freely choose, even from one of the Three Princesses. Who will he choose? Who does Maomao really want him to choose?

episodes.name: Maomao and Maomao
episodes.overview: The spring garden party concludes without incident. Maomao returns to her regular life as Concubine Gyokuyou’s taster. Meanwhile, novels become popular in the rear palace. Maomao wonders how this came to be, as novels were typically considered low-class. But…

episodes.name: Caravan
episodes.overview: The caravan stirs up excitement in the inner palace. The merchants bring all kinds of goods. However, something gives Maomao a bad feeling.

episodes.name: Corpse Fungus
episodes.overview: A concubine passes away, and a woman goes missing. Jinshi sends Maomao to investigate - not these incidents, but mushrooms growing in the rear palace.

episodes.name: Mirror
episodes.overview: The special envoy from a foreign land gifts mirrors - a rarity in this country - to the high concubines. However, they bring mysteries as well.

episodes.name: The Moon Fairy
episodes.overview: In order to realize the seemingly impossible request from the foreign envoy, Maomao speaks to the “Moon Fairy” herself.

episodes.name: The Crystal Pavilion, for the Third Time
episodes.overview: The woman from the clinic finds out that Maomao knows a thing or two about medicine, and asks for her help.

episodes.name: The Shrine of Choosing
episodes.overview: Maomao directs her curiosity towards an old, oddly-shaped building.

episodes.name: The Empress Dowager
episodes.overview: Maomao's reputation for resolving conflicts reaches the empress dowager, who will ask for her help to unravel a mystery that won't leave her mind.

episodes.name: The Late Emperor
episodes.overview: Maomao's investigation of the "curse" reveals more about the late emperor than anticipated.

episodes.name: A Ghost Story
episodes.overview: Maomao joins some women exchanging scary stories on a hot summer night to provide chills.

episodes.name: The Hunt
episodes.overview: Jinshi goes on a hunting trip, and brings Maomao along. He seems ready to share his secret with her.

episodes.name: Ka Zuigetsu
episodes.overview: Maomao discovers Jinshi's secret. She wants nothing to do with whatever the politics behind it is.

episodes.name: The Baths
episodes.overview: Xiaolan's term of service is almost up, so she must find a new job. Maomao and Shisui decide to help.

episodes.name: The Dancing Ghost
episodes.overview: Concubine Lishu reports sightings of a ghost in the baths in her pavilion. Maomao goes to investigate.

episodes.name: Ice
episodes.overview: Xiaolan accidentally ruins an expensive block of ice. Maomao comes up with a delicious backup plan.

episodes.name: Festering Resentment
episodes.overview: Luomen returns to the rear palace. His observations trigger Maomao's curiosity.

episodes.name: The Fox Village
episodes.overview: Suirei smuggles Maomao and Shisui out of the rear palace. Jinshi begins to search for Maomao.

episodes.name: Lantern Plant
episodes.overview: Maomao has been missing for ten days now. Jinshi's investigations lead him to a forgotten graveyard.

episodes.name: Festival
episodes.overview: The village holds a festival. Maomao attends, and Shisui introduces some of the village's history to her.

episodes.name: The Stronghold
episodes.overview: Maomao is taken to a mountain stronghold, where many of the secrets of the Shi clan are revealed to her.

episodes.name: Taibon
episodes.overview: Maomao is accused of attempting to escape, and is tossed into an ancient method of torture and execution.

episodes.name: Royal Guard
episodes.overview: The royal guard, led by Jinshi, arrives, sealing the Shi clan's fate. Maomao wants to save her friend, Shisui.

episodes.name: The Shi Clan
episodes.overview: Jinshi and his forces infiltrate the stronghold, cornering the remaining Shi clan members.

episodes.name: The Beginning
episodes.overview: After the war, Jinshi's work piles up and Maomao returns to the pleasure district.

episodes.name: Locusts
episodes.overview: A locust plague is looming, and mysteriously, a book on insects belonging to the Shi clan appears.

episodes.name: The Fire-Rat Cloak
episodes.overview: An interesting cloak points Maomao's imagination towards international politics.

episodes.name: Let Them Eat Cake
episodes.overview: Maomao treats a sick girl, but food poisoning and malnutrition are not the true problems that need solving.

episodes.name: I'm Haru, the New Concierge!
episodes.overview: For her first day as a concierge at Pokémon Resort, all Haru has to do is enjoy herself on the island as if she were a guest herself!

episodes.name: What's on Your Mind, Psyduck?
episodes.overview: Psyduck suffers from chronic headaches that erupt into disruptive psychic powers. Can Haru come up with a way to help?

episodes.name: I Hope I Can Evolve Too…
episodes.overview: When a Magikarp who can't swim well loses his floatie to a passing Wingull, Haru and Psyduck fly after it on a Dragonite to try and get it back.

episodes.name: Welcome to the Pokémon Resort!
episodes.overview: Haru meets a shy little Pikachu who's trainer really wants him to be more outgoing. But here at Pokémon Resort, everyone is encouraged to be themselves.

episodes.name: A Pokémon to Help Me!
episodes.overview: A change of plans leaves haru alone and in charge of entertaining new guests Shinx and Luxray. How will she and Psyduck keep things running smoothly?

episodes.name: Is That Really the Best Option?
episodes.overview: Tyler's uncle Dan brings his beloved Sealeo to the Pokémon Resort, eager to let her stretch her flippers. But when it's time to leave, Dan can't be found.

episodes.name: I'm a Role Model Now?
episodes.overview: Haru's next task? Showing her new colleague the ropes! But as her little mistakes pile up, she worries if she's the right person for the job.

episodes.name: Where I Belong
episodes.overview: During a sudden storm, Haru tries to save a trapped Eevee but ends up being rescued by Arcanine — whose trainer is none other than her ex!

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After a successful career as a plastic surgeon, Yeo Jeong-woo faces a swift downfall. Nam Ha-neul collapses amid a brutal career as an anesthesiologist.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Jeong-woo moves into a new home and runs into his old rival Ha-neul, who is his neighbor. As her well-being takes a toll, Ha-neul makes a stand at work.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: When Jeong-woo's home gets broken into, Ha-neul asks him to stay at her place. After the two share a night of fun, she decides to help him in his trial.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: After a trip together, Jeong-woo wonders if he was Ha-neul's first love — until she goes on a blind date. Ha-neul goes on an interview for a faraway job.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Jeong-woo travels far to show up for Ha-neul after her interview — and several heart-to-heart moments force her to ask him how he truly feels.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: A run-in with an old classmate leaves Ha-neul feeling jealous. Regardless, she gives Jeong-woo much-needed emotional support, which opens him up.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: While Jeong-woo faces a mysterious attack, Ha-neul finds a crucial clue at his home. Jeong-woo encounters someone who may turn the tides of his trial.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: After holding hands with Jeong-woo, Ha-neul tries to decipher their relationship status — but her mental health begins to take a toll amid sudden news.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Jeong-woo and Ha-neul navigate life without each other after she pushes him away. Jeong-woo panics as he operates for the first time since his trial.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: As Jeong-woo struggles with his trauma, Ha-neul shows up to support him. But after he rejects her help, he discovers what made her break up with him.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: As their love blossoms, Ha-neul and Jeong-woo struggle to keep their relationship a secret. Lee Hong-ran bonds with Bin Dae-yeong during his time of need.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: While on a nostalgic getaway, Ha-neul and Jeong-woo are joined by Hong-ran and Dae-yeong. Ha-neul confronts Min Kyung-min about a potential foul play.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Jeong-woo, alongside Ha-neul's family, awaits the outcome of her surgery. Later, he learns the full depth of Kyung-min's complicated motives.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: Needing an escape, Jeong-woo takes a special trip to Busan with Ha-neul and her family. He later laments as Ha-neul's new job takes her away from him.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: Jeong-woo tries to surprise Ha-neul with a gift, but roadblocks keep getting in his way. Soon, they begin their joint operation and complications arise.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: While Jeong-woo awaits an answer from Ha-neul, she contemplates an opportunity abroad—and he anguishes over the fate of their relationship.

episodes.name: A Diplomatic Mission
episodes.overview: After getting in some trouble, Akira gets approached by an enigmatic recruiter who tells him about the expendable foot soldiers known as Yakitori.

episodes.name: Counterattack
episodes.overview: Ten months ago, Tyrone Baxter, Erland Martonen, Amalia Schulz, Zihan Yang and Akira Ihotsu meet for the first time on Earth before launching to Mars.

episodes.name: Harassment
episodes.overview: The K321 unit heads into enemy territory to carry out their "harassment" mission while 10 months ago, back in the Kitchen, their training begins.

episodes.name: Atrocity
episodes.overview: Back in the Kitchen, the K321 learn that their teamwork is lacking, and they find out that they're being trained differently from everyone else.

episodes.name: The Rear Guard
episodes.overview: After their brutal counter-attack against the enemy, the K321 unit are left to put together their own escape plan. Akira has a risky idea.

episodes.name: Yakitori
episodes.overview: After risking their lives for Shoren, the K321 unit are scapegoated and arrested. During their trial, Vasa Pupkin testifies as a witness.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: A boy is attacked by a wild bear, introducing a plague that affects only males.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: While visiting Edo, a beautiful temple chief named Arikoto catches the eye of Lady Kasuga, who tries to force him into giving up the priesthood.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Together with Gyokuei, Arikoto begins his new life. He learns about a carefully protected secret, and the role he is now expected to play.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Arikoto's wounds finally heal, and he's introduced to the other men in the Ooku, but they don't take kindly to him.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Iemitsu orders the men to dress in women's clothing and amuse her. She remembers how, when she was a child, Lady Kasuga had taken her from her family.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Though blissfully in love, Iemitsu is still not pregnant. Lady Kasuga finds a promiscuous man in town who bears an uncanny resemblance to Arikoto.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: With surprising good will, Arikoto welcomes Sutezo into the Ooku. Just when things seem to be going well, an accident happens.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Iemitsu sees for herself how desperate things have become outside the castle walls. She orders immediate action to prevent a peasant uprising.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Lady Kasuga falls ill, causing worry over what will happen in the event of her passing. The plague finds its way into the Ooku.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Iemitsu steps out into the open and announces her intentions, creating major changes across the country.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Determined to turn the tables, Park Dong-ho attempts to assassinate the president. But Jeong Su-jin swiftly steps in to execute her own agenda.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Armed with leverage, Kang Sang-un approaches Dong-ho with an offer. Dong-ho's attempt to initiate a no-holds-barred investigation encounters a hiccup.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Dong-ho risks everything to reinitiate the investigation before the president awakes. In response, Su-jin resorts to a ruthless tactic to turn the tides.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Dong-ho turns his attention to the presidential election campaign — and sets a trap for Su-jin. He later enlists questionable support for a leg up.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Facing calls to resign, Dong-ho confronts Su-jin privately. He soon debates Jo Sang-cheon, where the issue of North Korea plagues Dong-ho's campaign.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Although Su-jin gains possession of Dong-ho's Achilles' heel, Dong-ho reveals he has a trick up his sleeve. Su-jin then hones in on Park Chang-sik.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Dong-ho enacts a scheme to completely expose Su-jin to the public. But she aims to turn Lee Jang-seok against Dong-ho before her hearing begins.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: With Su-jin in the prime minister's seat, Dong-ho meets with Chairman Kang in a ploy to take her inner circle down — forcing her to plan her own revenge.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Su-jin coaches Sang-un to give a damning testimony against Dong-ho and sway public opinion. Facing impeachment, Dong-ho turns to Chairman Kang.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Dong-ho exposes himself to bring his foes to justice, putting himself at risk for prosecution. In turn, Su-jin stops at nothing to have Dong-ho arrested.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Su-jin derails the investigation into Daejin and turns the scrutiny back onto Dong-ho. As a strike threatens Dong-ho's power, he uses his silver bullet.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Dong-ho's final act forces Su-jin to make the ultimate choice — reveal the truth or go down in disgrace. In the end, will justice prevail?

episodes.name: First Sight, First Swipe
episodes.overview: Racy banter and flirty fun mark the singles' first steps into this social experiment, where they'll seek matches through speed dates and online chats.

episodes.name: The Meet Cute
episodes.overview: The foursome and their connections finally mingle at a colorful bash and pool party. Then, the singles must choose someone for an individual date.

episodes.name: Crushing on You, You and You
episodes.overview: A rickshaw ride takes couples for delicious dates, while sparks fly through online video chats. But who will be lucky in love — and who gets ghosted?

episodes.name: Double Trouble
episodes.overview: Sakshi and Virendra clash over a misunderstood moment. The first set of eliminations take a heartbreaking turn. New arrivals shake up the houses.

episodes.name: Cross-Connections
episodes.overview: The singles go on real dates with virtual matches, while the others have some drunken fun. A sex-themed game night reveals whose connection is real.

episodes.name: Quit Playing Games With My Heart
episodes.overview: Emotions run high as two couples grapple with honest revelations. Heated confrontations mar Ananya and Sakshi's intimate movie dates.

episodes.name: A Rival’s Arrival
episodes.overview: Ananya struggles after Dhruv's decision. Vidushi's attraction to Sahib grows, while she and Chiragg spar over feelings. A new connection arrives.

episodes.name: Holidate for Three
episodes.overview: The singles and their connections head on romantic getaways — but true feelings emerge as explosive conversations lead to frustration and indecision.

episodes.name: Kill, Marry, Hookup
episodes.overview: With only one day left before the singles make their final decisions, some couples navigate new feelings, while others contend with doubts.

episodes.name: Will They, Won't They?
episodes.overview: As the experiment comes to an end, the singles and connections must choose between real-life or virtual love — or will they walk away from it all?

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: In 1992, Ryu Eun-jung clashes with new student Cheon Sang-yeon out of envy. Years later, Sang-yeon returns with news of her illness — and a final request.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Upon rejecting Sang-yeon's request, Eun-jung revisits their past — from her complex friendship to her fondness for Cheon Sang-hak, Sang-yeon's brother.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Eun-jung meets Kim Sang-hak in her college photography club — a man who shares a name with someone from her past. Her timidness soon turns things awkward.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: After years of no contact, Eun-jung and Sang-yeon meet again in college. But old shadows of insecurity soon resurface — rekindling old pain between them.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Sang-hak's enlistment sparks distance — for Eun-jung, ignored calls and secrets online begin to emerge, putting her friendship with Sang-yeon in danger.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Sang-yeon and Sang-hak grow closer as they bond over her brother, and Eun-jung's suspicions grow — leading her to a truth that changes how she sees them.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: After Eun-jung confronts her about Sang-hak, Sang-yeon tries to ease the tension — but soon discovers a shattering secret about her brother.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Left out by Sang-hak and Sang-yeon's secret, Eun-jung feels alone and adrift — until heartbreak and hardship scatter all three in different directions.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Now a film producer, Eun-jung crosses paths with Sang-hak once again — but when disastrous news hits their project, Sang-yeon reappears.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: As filming begins, Eun-jung and Sang-yeon clash over scripts, budgets, and creative style — while both hope to land Sang-hak as their cinematographer.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: A remote location scout leaves Eun-jung and Sang-yeon isolated, and small setbacks and creative clashes spiral into an unresolved, tense standoff.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: An on-set accident puts filming in jeopardy. Eun-jung and Sang-yeon must pull together to keep the project on track — relying on Sang-hak's expertise.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Sang-yeon's resentment for Eun-jung boils over, just as a violent on-set crisis throws the production — and their partnership — into chaos.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: After their friendship ends in anger, Eun-jung shuts Sang-yeon out for good. Years later, Sang-yeon returns, hoping Eun-jung will grant her last wish.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: As Sang-yeon nears her final journey, Eun-jung grapples with a difficult promise. On the eve of goodbye, they share memories from a lifetime of friendship.

episodes.name: Rainbow Hong, Shining Rang - My Brother Hongrang
episodes.overview: Twelve years after Sim Hongrang's sudden disappearance, a man seeming to be him appears — passing all the tests. Yet Sim Jae-yi remains unconvinced.

episodes.name: The One Who Stole Our World
episodes.overview: Jae-yi and Hongrang separately search for a ghost rumored to be abducting children. In their search, peril strikes Jae-yi — but Hongrang is at her rescue.

episodes.name: The Most Authentic Replica
episodes.overview: After Hongrang's act of heroism, Jae-yi begins to question her doubts. Sim Mu-jin schemes to expose Hongrang's identity at his birthday celebration.

episodes.name: Our Reflective Scars
episodes.overview: Learning of Min Yeon-ui's plans, Sim Yeol-guk devises a counterattack. Hongrang struggles with his conscience after being assigned a terrible task.

episodes.name: The Thicker the Veil, the Clearer the Heart
episodes.overview: As she learns more about Hongrang's past, Jae-yi begins to care for him. Later, Hongrang and Mu-jin suspect Lady Min’s scheme to marry Jae-yi off.

episodes.name: Nothing Mu, Finished Jin - Brother Mu-jin
episodes.overview: As plans to stop Jae-yi's arrangement fail, she finds herself in a dangerous bind. The opposition between Yeol-guk and Yeon-ui reaches a boiling point.

episodes.name: Roaring Waves
episodes.overview: As Mu-jin's fate remains dire, Jae-yi attempts to do whatever it takes to save him. Later, news of a dead child returning spreads, alarming Hongrang.

episodes.name: Imperfect Jae, Departing Yi - My Name Is Jae-yi
episodes.overview: Jae-yi decides to leave with Mu-jin despite her feelings for Hongrang. Yeol-guk initiates damage control after discovering a conspiracy against him.

episodes.name: The Living Offering
episodes.overview: A manhunt for Hongrang and Jae-yi ensues, putting them in grave danger. As they hide, their bond deepens, facing threats and challenges together.

episodes.name: A Bittersweet Farewell
episodes.overview: With Hongrang captured, Yeol-guk attempts to restore the guild in his name. But Grand Prince Hanpyeong wastes no time putting his grand plan into motion.

episodes.name: Forever and After
episodes.overview: The truth about Hongrang is revealed, but enemies remain. In the end, will he be able to save Jae-yi and free himself from the shackles of his past?

episodes.name: Newbie Party: Truth or Dare
episodes.overview: Kang Ha enters Jooshin High and quickly ruffles some feathers. He soon attends a rowdy party — and partakes in a provocative game of truth or dare.

episodes.name: Secret: Within a Secret
episodes.overview: After Kang Ha's daring stunt at the party, he faces the vengeful Kim Ri-an at school. Later, at a retreat, Kang Ha and Jung Jae-i begin to get closer.

episodes.name: Hierarchy: A League of Their Own
episodes.overview: As Jae-i and Kang Ha present as a couple, a jealous Ri-an resorts to his own tactics. At the lavish Parent's Night, Yoon He-ra pulls a hostile stunt.

episodes.name: Revenge, Desire, Romance: The Heart of the Matter
episodes.overview: He-ra plants a suspicion about Jae-i in Kang Ha's head. As anonymous threats continue to plague Jae-i, she disappears from school.

episodes.name: Outstanding Outsiders: The Kangs
episodes.overview: After Kang Ha's confession, Jae-i is overwhelmed by the truth and decides to leave. At her farewell party, Ri-an makes an entrance — and a declaration.

episodes.name: An Arrow: To the Heart
episodes.overview: Kang Ha plans a strike to make the school an even playing field. But Jae-i attempts to protect Ri-an from the blow, revealing a hidden secret to Kang Ha.

episodes.name: Spring Time: Our Short, Vulnerable Yet Precious Chapter
episodes.overview: Kang Ha's crusade against the bullies wreaks havoc at the school. As a reckoning unfolds at Jooshin, will Kang Ha finally be able to fulfill his purpose?

seasons.name: Beyblade X
seasons.overview: Aiming to become a professional Blader, Robin Kazami meets former champion Jaxon Cross, also known as Blader X, and forms a team so that they can aim for the top of The X. But what awaits them is a spectacular battle that no one has ever seen before.

episodes.name: X
episodes.overview: After his teammates leave, amateur Blader Robin Kazami has no choice but to join the mysterious Blader X.

episodes.name: Multi-Colored Ambush
episodes.overview: After revealing his true identity and forming Team Persona with Robin, Jaxon signs the new team up for a pro-selection match.

episodes.name: Team Persona

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After a lifetime of abandonment, Ki Ka-young confronts her mother in Dubai. During her trip, she releases Iblis, indifferent to any wish he might grant.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Back at Ka-young's home, Iblis learns about her past from the locals — and navigates modern Korean society while trying to threaten a wish from her.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Iblis agrees to grant Ka-young's first wish — to corrupt others — although she remains an enigma. Meanwhile, Ejllael plots his revenge against Iblis.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: After sharing her first kiss with Iblis, Ka-young searches for any excuse to kiss him again. Ejllael struggles to sway Ka-young to his long-held plan.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Ka-young makes her second wish — this time for her grandmother. Meanwhile, Iblis continues corrupting others in a bid to win his bet with Ka-young.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Iblis seeks Ejllael to probe his missing years with Ka-young. Meanwhile, Ka-young faces memories of her past life — and a fateful wish.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Despite learning of her past, Ka-young suspects there's more to her story with Iblis. Ejllael and Iblis discover a secret force lurking in the shadows.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Iblis and Ka-young travel to Dubai for answers about their unaccounted past. Soon, Ka-young begins to feel an unexpected bond with him.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Ejllael uses Oh Pan-geum as bait to bring down Iblis. As Khalid's threat grows, Iblis and Ka-young uncover a major clue about their past connection.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: With Khalid's next move imminent, Iblis and Ka-young dig into their blurry past. Meanwhile, Pan-geum prepares for her fate, stoking suspicion around her.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: A millennia ago, Ka-young's past self survives certain death — reconnecting with Iblis and falling in love, until greed tragically tears them apart.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: As Khalid's endgame nears, Ka-young, Iblis and their loved ones face grave danger — but their hidden plan can seal a destiny forged over a thousand years.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: With her life turned upside down, Ka-young searches for Iblis to make her final wish. Will they find eternal happiness, or be bound by cruel fate?

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Cha Mu-hee and Joo Ho-jin cross paths in Tokyo, both hoping to leave the past behind. At a ramen shop, Mu-hee begs Ho-jin to translate her feelings.

episodes.overview: Mu-hee becomes a global superstar overnight, but struggles to leave her character behind. A ruffled Ho-jin becomes the subject of an Instagram post.

episodes.overview: Unhappy with his new co-star, Hiro decides to give her a hard time while filming in Canada. Ho-jin becomes supportive of Mu-hee as he gets to know her.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Hiro enjoys time with Mu-hee, despite his determination to dislike her. Meanwhile, a surprise encounter with a new producer stops Ho-jin in his tracks.

episodes.overview: Kim Yong-u and Ji-sun bond over a secret. Mu-hee blames a bold action on Do Ra-mi, before a night out with the crew leaves Ho-jin with mixed emotions.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Hiro goes soul searching in Seoul for clarity about his feelings. After a concert, Kim Young-hwan arranges a meetup with Mu-hee and a reluctant Ho-jin.

episodes.name: Episode 8

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Mu-hee and Hiro share their feelings while filming in Italy. As the crew gossips about Ho-jin's rumored lover, he learns a shocking truth from Do Ra-mi.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: While adjusting to his new relationship, a lavish winery reunites Ho-jin with an important family member. Mu-hee finds the root cause of her problems.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Mu-hee and Ho-jin find themselves confronting their pasts after a scandal hits the media. A resurfaced Instagram post raises important questions.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: While some secrets come out, some romances solidify. Will Mu-hee and Ho-jin get their happy ending — or are some emotions too hard to interpret?

episodes.name: The Eclipse
