seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A man who should not have been born and the unhappiest woman in the world are forced to accompany one another on the final journey of his life. Hae Jo, a man born out of wedlock thrown into a wandering life without family. Jae-mi, Hae Jo's ex-girlfriend and t…

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Hae Jo, who runs an errand center, accepts Noh Yang-hui's request to kidnap her on her wedding day. Later, he unexpectedly runs into an old flame.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Hae Jo sets out to find his sperm donor, the biological father he never knew. He crashes Jo Jae-mi's wedding and drags her along.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Hae Jo recounts his first meeting with Jae-mi. While a huge fight breaks out at the sundae shop, Eo Heung and Wang Chil-seong's gang close in.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Jae-mi makes a tough choice between Hae Jo and her devoted fiancé. Soon they head down to Busan, while a mysterious figure arrives to bail Heung out.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Hae Jo spends meaningful time with Ko Jae-geun up in the mountains. Back in Seoul, Chil-seong corners Kkari and forces him to track down his old partner.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Heung reflects on his relationship with Jae-mi. After Hae Jo steals a boat to escape Chil-seong, they end up stranded on a deserted island.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Shaken by the island ordeal, Hae Jo slips into a slump his friend Yang Bong-suk can't lift. Meanwhile, Heung does everything to stay by Jae-mi's side.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Afraid of hurting Jae-mi again, Hae Jo tries to push her away. Later, he takes on a new errand and meets a young girl looking for her long-lost brother.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: After learning about Hae Jo's severe condition, Jae-mi is determined to help him find his biological father. But when she returns, he's gone.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Now alone with Heung, Hae Jo reflects on his unfortunate life. After a tense reunion at Kkari's workplace, Hae Jo decides to confront his painful past.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: This docuseries follows the rise and fall of Veerappan, a dreaded smuggler whose bloody reign sparked a 20-year-long manhunt in south India.

episodes.name: CHAPTER ONE - THE FOREST KING
episodes.overview: As Veerappan builds his criminal empire, a long-standing rivalry with police is ignited. A rift with a senior officer launches an extensive manhunt.

episodes.name: CHAPTER TWO - THE BLOODBATH
episodes.overview: Violence and bloodshed erupts across the forest and in villages as Veerappan retaliates against the police.

episodes.name: CHAPTER THREE - THE REVOLUTIONARY
episodes.overview: In a brazen move, Veerappan abducts movie star Dr. Rajkumar, stoking fury in Karnataka and sending politicians into chaos in two states.

episodes.name: CHAPTER FOUR - THE WAY OUT
episodes.overview: Seeking to live a quiet life with his family away from police scrutiny, Veerappan plans his next steps — until a covert ruse finally seals his doom.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Noh In-ji receives her next field wife assignment. Han Jeong-won struggles with his separation from ex-wife Lee Seo-yeon and an impending second marriage.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Five years ago, after her fiancé vanishes, In-ji has a fateful meeting. In the present, she learns more about her new husband and his ex-wife.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Jeong-won slowly warms up to his new wife. Sensing a change, Lee Seo-yeon tries to make her ex crack. Meanwhile, someone from In-ji's past resurfaces.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: As In-ji creates a homey life and instills peace around Jeong-won, he grapples with his growing desire for her. Seo-yeon can't handle losing control.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Jeong-won learns about Eom Tae-seong and offers help, but In-ji rebuffs him. Seo-yeon gets a grim warning. Later, the wife and ex-wife clash at a funeral.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Seo-yeon demands an end to their tangled relationship, and In-ji boldly confronts her. Meanwhile, a mysterious figure lurks near Seo Do-ha's apartment.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Shocked by the bloody corridor, In-ji steps into Do-ha's apartment with trepidation. Who or what will she find, and will she finally get closure?

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: After learning of Seo-yeon's betrayal, Jeong-won cuts their toxic ties. In-ji decides to end everything and invites Tae-seong for a decisive moment.

episodes.name: LOG IN
episodes.overview: In the immersive online game Planet, Ichi is a member of the formidable Akabane Family; but offline, his real life family is a dysfunctional mess.

episodes.name: ERROR
episodes.overview: After receiving a Declaration of War from the Pirates, Shiro and his sons go into enemy territory to discuss the matter with the Pirate Captain herself.

episodes.name: INSTALL
episodes.overview: There's something strange about the monster the Akabanes are fighting against. Sensing danger, Shiro orders the family to log out immediately.

episodes.name: UPGRADE
episodes.overview: Pico makes an unexpected decision before breaking through the barrier and confronting Ichi. Then, a mysterious person pays Asuma a visit.

episodes.name: VIRUS
episodes.overview: With players everywhere reeling, Shigatera reveals his true feelings and intentions. Then, Pico returns and demands an explanation.

episodes.name: REMOVE
episodes.overview: Pico has been logging into Planet to escape her oppressively controlling mother. But then, Shiro tells her something that rocks her very foundation.

episodes.name: BAN
episodes.overview: The Black Bird begins appearing in Shigatera's real life world. Taichiro and his mother visit Asuma in the hospital — and are shocked by what they find.

episodes.name: RELOAD
episodes.overview: Taichiro and Asuma reveal some long-held secrets to each other. The mysterious woman appears again and warns Asuma not to log back into Planet.

episodes.name: AR
episodes.overview: Hana tells Taichiro and Asuma about their father's involvement in Planet, Black Bird and more. Then, Taichiro tells Hana about his younger sister.

episodes.name: REGISTRY
episodes.overview: The whole family has been infected and are now back in Planet, but this dark world is nothing like the sunny paradise they once escaped into.

episodes.name: DEBUG
episodes.overview: Kojiro wants to see his family before they leave for a distant shelter, but Asuma tells him to stay away. Then, Sasumata asks Shiro a striking question.

episodes.name: Hello, World
episodes.overview: As Ichi, Taichiro attacks a heartbroken and furious Leon. Meanwhile, Shiro tells Sasumata that he created them under a different name.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A woman who magically switches between her 20s and 50s lands an internship at the Prosecution Service, caught between two generations and a tough boss.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After failing her interview and falling for a scam, Lee Mi-jin falls into a well and finds herself transformed, leaving her desperate to find a cure.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Mi-jin begins work at the Prosecution Service as Lim Sun, running into Gye Ji-ung again. He later investigates a crime scene that leads to a wild chase.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Mi-jin's brief encounter with the killer aids Ji-ung in his efforts to find him. Sun becomes Ko Won's source of comfort during his struggles at work.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Sun reports to duty in Ji-ung's office, where she tackles every test thrown her way. Ji-ung prepares Mi-jin for the dangers she may face as a witness.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Ji-ung looks further into Ko Won's attacker after suspecting something bigger afoot. Sun gets scolded by Ji-ung over a mistake — shaking her confidence.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Mi-jin faces a crisis as she begins to transform into Sun in front of Ji-ung. Later, they make progress in a drug case after confronting violent youths.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Ji-ung questions Mi-jin while Ko Won investigates Sun, both suspecting something's off. Sun encounters a dilemma when she gets drunk at a work outing.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Ji-ung tracks a suspicious person working within his office. Mi-jin, attempting to look into Ji-ung's document, shares an intimate moment with him.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: After Ji-ung reacts unexpectedly to Mi-jin's move, she avoids him out of sheer embarrassment. Ji-ung decides to investigate a suspect in his own way.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: The investigation into the hospital yields suspicious evidence. Ji-ung begins to feel uncomfortable about Mi-jin and Ko Won's relationship.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Baek Cheol-gyu looks into the connection between Sun and Mi-jin. During a raid at the hospital, Sun finds herself in a dangerous predicament.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Sun finds herself in a panic to save herself from Baek Cheol-gyu. But she later implores him for help when she realizes they may have a shared history.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: As their romance blossoms, Mi-jin and Ji-ung navigate their complex relationship. Cheol-gyu requests a meeting with Sun to assist her with her request.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: After Mi-jin oversleeps, she faces her family and Ji-ung as Sun — having to confront her secret. But soon, she deduces the identity of the killer.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: As Mi-jin tries to save her father, she finds herself in danger — forcing Ji-ung to spring into action to track her down before it's too late.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: With nothing left to hide, Mi-jin contemplates her future. After she testifies in her attacker's case, Mi-jin and Ji-ung reconsider their relationship.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After Nam Gi-seok's mysterious death, Nam Gi-jun emerges from seclusion on a mission to find the perpetrator — no matter the cost.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: After tracking down Gi-seok's hit, Gi-jun discovers the scheme's origin — forcing him to enforce a rule he established more than a decade ago.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Despite his father's precautions, Gu Jun-mo underestimates the threat he faces. Frustrated and desperate, he decides to handle Gi-jun himself.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Desperate to save his son, Chairman Gu digs deeper into Gi-seok's hit. After Jun-mo attacks his friends, Gi-jun goes head-to-head with Jun-mo's army.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Gi-jun quickly learns that his problems don't end with Jun-mo. A gang war breaks out after Chairman Lee suspects the real architect behind recent events.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Cha Yeong-do sets his plan in motion. As Lee Geum-son seizes power, Gi-jun faces betrayal, danger, and a race to uncover the truth behind it all.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: With all his obstacles cleared, Geum-son puts his endgame into play. Will Gi-jun succeed in stopping him, or go down trying?

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Bheem and his friends must travel to Sagarpur to protect the Jal Chakra from Damyaan and help King Mahasagar — but danger lurks at every turn.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Bheem and his friends must do whatever it takes to stop Tabora and his evil aunt from finding the Agni Chakra and reviving the villainous Kirmada.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After a Qing-mandated exile, Grand Prince Jinhan returns to a hostile palace. He later encounters an intriguing baduk player who proves to be elusive.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: After facing Yi In in a game of baduk, Kang Hee-soo develops feelings for him. Meanwhile, Yi Seon grows increasingly ill, creating a succession crisis.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Kim Myung-ha urges Hee-soo to stop her ruse. When a royal crisis arises, Kang Hang-soon performs a selfless act — but Kim Jong-bae schemes against Yi In.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: After a confrontation with Yi Seon, Yi In ascends to the throne — but not without opposition. In the process, he cruelly turns a blind eye to Hee-soo.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Yi In summons Myung-ha to the palace and appoints him to a special role. To get the attention of the king, Hee-soo takes part in the baduk examination.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Hee-soo receives a stern warning from Yi In upon becoming his official baduk companion, later becoming entangled in a political ploy by the queen dowager.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Yi In begins to suspect a suspicious relationship between Myung-ha and Hee-soo. Later, Hee-soo joins the Grand Prince on a royal trip with the King.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: After rumors of Yi In's affection toward Hee-soo spread like wildfire, the palace arranges a royal night of intimacy for him — despite true feelings.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: After a night of intimacy, Yi In and Hee-soo navigate their complicated feelings. In an attempt to oust Hee-soo, Park Jong-hwan wages a bet with Yi In.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: The Qing makes a contentious demand, and Yi In's decision in the matter forces Hee-soo to carry out her own plan — but last-minute complications arise.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: As Jong-hwan gets close to catching the faux-princess, Hee-soo puts her faith in Yi In — struggling with her growing feelings for him.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: After lightning ignites a fire, Yi In sees it as a sign from above. As Queen Oh's health falters, Hee-soo strives to protect the Grand Prince's fate.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: A last-minute change of heart gravely injures Hee-soo — prompting questions around her gender. Later, Yi In reveals the fate of her father to her.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: In a vulnerable moment, Yi In shares the secret of his ascension with Hee-soo. Jong-hwan plans a counterattack for Yi In's investigation of past events.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: After Senior Court Lady Dong's tragedy, Yi In aims to punish the one responsible. Queen Dowager Park finally learns the truth about Hee-soo's gender.

episodes.name: Episode 16
episodes.overview: Despite Yi In’s opposition, Hee-soo embarks on a dangerous journey to visit her father. But as months pass, their reunion remains uncertain.

episodes.name: The Man with Loan Shark Debts
episodes.overview: As the debtor faces imminent danger from his loan shark, he enlists Jang Gil-ryong for a diabolical task — one that comes at a high and personal cost.

episodes.name: The Man Who Disposed of a Body
episodes.overview: Distracted by Lee Yu-jeong, Glasses gets into a car accident. When he discovers a witness, he panics and tries to erase any trace of his involvement.

episodes.name: The Unrighteous
episodes.overview: After the witness demands more money, Glasses uncovers inconsistencies in the recent accident. The Debtor panics as Gil-ryong demands his due.

episodes.name: The Woman Trapped in the Past
episodes.overview: Caught in the shadows of her past, Lee Ju-yeon is stirred by a name that echoes old memories, pushing her to confront lingering questions.

episodes.name: Rewind
episodes.overview: Prepared with a plan, the Debtor confronts Gil-ryong — but the plot soon devolves into chaos when the Witness sees an opportunity to exploit.

episodes.name: Karma
episodes.overview: The Witness faces unexpected setbacks after thinking he's in the clear. But with Ju-yeon on his trail, can he break free from the relentless karmic cycle?

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A story that depicts the lives of people at Jongno Yulje Medical Center. The professors, OB/GYN residents, and the friendships between these people are told, including a first year OB/GYN resident.

episodes.overview: Struggling with her finances, Oh Yi-young reluctantly returns to resident life — making blunder after blunder. Soon, she faces her first patient crisis.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: The first-year residents contemplate quitting after burning out from hospital life. When Yi-young is backed into a corner, Ku Do-won comes to her aid.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: As Um Jae-il receives constant compliments, Yi-young, Pyo Nam-kyung and Kim Sa-bi try to find ways to bring comfort to their own patients and families.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Yi-young gets roped into a research paper with Professor Seo, sparking Sa-bi's jealousy. Nam-kyung misguidedly creates tension on the hospital floor.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Though Yi-young's bluntness gets her in trouble, she uses it to comfort a patient's child. Jae-il's need to overachieve becomes a nuisance to others.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Witnessing Do-won being snubbed, Yi-young finds herself getting defensive. Meanwhile, Sa-bi and Nam-kyung can't stop clashing over their differences.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Frustrated by the other departments, the OB-GYN residents decide to push back. Meanwhile, Nam‑kyung finds herself irritated as she oversees an intern.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: After being hospitalized at work, Sa-bi struggles with the fear of missing out. A new patient’s arrival tests Nam-kyung’s patience — and her compassion.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: As a TV crew films the OB-GYN department, Yi-young's superior torments her. Meanwhile, an intern takes advantage of Jae-il and Sa-bi undermines a senior.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Nam-kyung and Yi-young find themselves in the middle of two competitive professors. Sa-bi endures an abusive superior but finds solace in a kinder boss.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: While trying to keep her relationship with Do-won secret from the hospital, Yi-young gets hands-on OB-GYN experience with a demanding professor.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: As their first year nears its end, the residents face the hospital's never-ending bustle — especially Yi-young, who finds herself at a crossroads.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: When a shocking mass shooting shatters Korea's calm, Lee Do races to stop the violence — then realizes the threat of illegal guns is just beginning.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: As shootings spread, Lee Do discovers guns in the hands of everyday citizens. When a victim hits close to home, his investigation grows more urgent.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: A police raid uncovers a cache of military weapons. Lee Do and his new ally Moon Baek close in on the arms network as the city reels from bloodshed.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Lee Do confronts a violent standoff and must decide how far to go to stop the killings, while suspicions about Moon Baek threaten their fragile alliance.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Guns reach bullied students and grieving parents, sparking new tragedies. Lee Do uncovers a network delivering weapons to vulnerable people across Korea.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: A gun in the hands of a student spells crisis at school. As panic spreads, Lee Do and Moon Baek race rush to restore order — but it may be too late.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: As fear and confusion grow, police and gangs rush to recover illegal guns. Lee Do feels powerless as the true scale of the arms crisis comes to light.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Police raid the gun syndicate, and rival gangs and old enemies clash in bloody battles. Lee Do is pushed to the limits as violence hits all of Korea.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: As guns reach new hands and fear sweeps the nation, Moon Baek's message echoes through the media. Across Korea, people must choose how to respond.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: With emotions running high, Lee Do and Moon Baek move toward a crossroads. One final choice will shape Korea's future — or plunge it into darkness.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Swathi dreams of owning a restaurant. But when murder derails her plan, she and her lover take an outrageous step — to replace him with her husband.

episodes.overview: Swathi's illicit affair takes a shocking turn. Dreaming of opening a hotel, Prabhakar looks to his brother Arvind for support.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: A determined Thupalli digs into the case of a newly discovered dead body. Umesh and Swathi take desperate measures to cover their tracks.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: After learning that Prabhakar was blackmailed, an irate Arvind digs into Umesh's past. Inspector Hassan wades into Thupalli's case findings.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The police question Swathi and Umesh, while a new blackmailer emerges. Hassan's hallucinations spark questions and new leads.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Appu and Swathi form an alliance, but a suspicious Lucas intervenes. Arvind has a plan of his own. An explosive showdown leaves a bloody mess.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: At the hospital, tensions run high as secrets threaten to emerge. Hassan makes a startling discovery that changes the course of the case.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Appu takes matters into her own hands, while the police investigate Mehrunisa's connection to Manisha Koirala. Kirtima delivers an ultimatum.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Hassan attempts to crack the case one last time. As the grand opening for Swathi's restaurant approaches, she finally finds her soup's secret ingredient.

seasons.name: Limited Series
seasons.overview: Cashero is a 2025 Netflix K-drama following Kang Sang-woong, a modest civil servant who inherits superpowers that increase in strength based on the amount of cash he carries. As the money disappears with each use, he must balance his financial, romantic life,…

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Unable to afford a place with Kim Min-suk, Kang Sang-ung visits his father — who grants him a power that will test both his morals and his bank account.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Sang-ung calls Park Jeong-ja for help when he finds himself in a crisis — only to end up in danger. Meanwhile, Jo Anna uses Min-suk as bait to lure him.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: After realizing he's become a target, Sang-ung trains with Byeon Ho-in and Bang Eun-mi. Soon after, he contacts Jeong-ja for help to face Anna's army.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Longing for a normal life, Sang-ung considers selling his power to the Mundane Vanguard — but Ho-in attempts to stop him from making a mistake.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: After narrowly escaping danger, Sang-ung, Ho-in and Eun-mi find themselves taunted by Jo Nathan. Soon, they investigate a drug ring at a nightclub.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: After escaping another trap, Sang-ung realizes his regular life is taking a negative impact. But Anna comes forward with an unexpected proposal.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: The bank scheme quickly turns perilous, pitting Sang-ung against Anna and Nathan. But Nathan lures him in by taking what matters most.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Fighting for his love, Sang-ung goes toe-to-toe with the Mundane Vanguard. Will he and his friends finally become the heroes they were meant to be?

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: 2022: A future war has raged for decades between the few human survivors and an endless army of machines. 1997: The AI known as Skynet gained self-awareness and began its war against humanity. Caught between the future and this past is a soldier sent back in…

episodes.name: Model 104

episodes.name: Model 105

episodes.name: Model 106

episodes.name: Model 107

episodes.name: Model 108
episodes.overview: Kenta wrestles with a brutal choice and the Terminator reveals a shocking truth as the future of humankind hangs in the balance.

seasons.name: Season 1

episodes.name: That's a Space Alien, Ain't It?!

episodes.name: It's a Granny vs. Granny Clash!

episodes.name: Like, Where Are Your Balls?!
episodes.overview: Momo and Okarun’s ordeal with Turbo Granny has brought them closer, but things remain awkward between them. Okarun realizes he still has a problem.

episodes.name: A Dangerous Woman Arrives
episodes.overview: Turbo Granny reveals that Okarun's missing organs are contained within golden spheres. Aira, who has found one, now has the ability to see spirits.

episodes.name: To a Kinder World
episodes.overview: Momo and Okarun manage to weaken Acrobatic Silky but make a shocking discovery regarding Aira. Acrobatic Silky suggests a surprising way to help.

episodes.name: I've Got This Funny Feeling
episodes.overview: Aira begins to develop a crush on Okarun. As the three friends' emotions intertwine, they suddenly face another extraterrestrial emergency.

episodes.name: Merge! Serpo Dover Demon Nessie!
episodes.overview: Aira has awakened the powers of Acrobatic Silky within her and fights the Serpoians alongside Okarun and Momo.

episodes.name: Have You Ever Seen a Cattle Mutilation?
episodes.overview: Okarun and the girls try to clean up some misunderstandings with their classmates. The aquatic creature reappears before Momo and Aira.

episodes.name: First Love
episodes.overview: Momo's childhood friend Jiji has come to stay with the Ayases. He explains that he needs Seiko’s help with some strange phenomena at his house.

episodes.name: Let's Go to the Cursed House
episodes.overview: On the way to investigate the Enjoji house, Okarun feels uneasy about Jiji's closeness to Momo but finds himself drawn to his friendly nature.

episodes.name: Like, This Is the Legend of the Giant Snake
episodes.overview: As Momo fends off an attack in the outdoor hot spring, Okarun and Jiji panic over how to handle the mysterious room. The doorbell rings.

episodes.name: The Evil Eye
episodes.overview: In a bid to free Okarun and Momo from the Mongolian Death Worm’s psychic power, Jiji attempts to carry them to safety but runs into a powerful entity.

episodes.name: You Won't Get Away with This!
episodes.overview: Unwilling to leave Jiji behind, Okarun helps Momo escape to the surface. Momo then begins forming a plan to expose the Death Worm to sunlight.

episodes.name: That's, Like, Way Deadly!
episodes.overview: Momo tries to stop the magma, but the Kito family gets in her way. The tsuchinoko shrine priest joins the fray... but so does the possessed Jiji.

episodes.name: We Can All Stay There Together!
episodes.overview: With everyone safely back at Seiko's house, Momo and the others discover that water has a surprising effect on how Evil Eye possesses Jiji's body.

episodes.name: We Became a Family
episodes.overview: The hayashi musicians arrive and begin an energetic exorcism performance. But just when the ritual is about to succeed, Jiji makes a surprising plea.

episodes.name: Feeling Kinda Gloomy
episodes.overview: Okarun has an awkward time at the maid café where Momo works. Seiko tries teaching Jiji how to suppress Evil Eye's possession of his body.

episodes.name: You Can Do It, Okarun!
episodes.overview: Aira and Okarun battle the classical composer spirits. As Okarun struggles to avoid their attacks, Turbo Granny orders him to feel the rhythm.

episodes.name: I Want to Rebuild the House
episodes.overview: Putting his training to the test, Okarun goes all-out and holds his own against Evil Eye, but the effort causes him to revert to his human form.

episodes.name: The Secret Art of Being Attractive
episodes.overview: Momo goes to Okarun's classroom to tell him about the golden ball spotted in the housing complex and finds him speaking with a curious classmate.

episodes.name: Hey, It's a Kaiju
episodes.overview: The sky darkens as Momo, Okarun and Kinta try to evade the giant space monster. They soon run into Aira and Jiji, who give them some much-needed help.

episodes.name: Clash! Space Kaiju vs. Giant Robot!
episodes.overview: As Momo and the others try to pilot the giant Buddha robot and battle the kaiju, Okarun and Jiji are ejected from the robot and land in a rice paddy.

episodes.name: Encountering a Dream
episodes.overview: Pro golfer Kiria crosses paths with the mischievous Gawain — who possesses an astonishing talent for golf even though he's never played the sport.

episodes.name: The Importance of Each Stroke
episodes.overview: Lost in Tokyo, Gawain has a fateful meeting with a sullen young golfer, who shows him the way to Kiria's home — and a new aspect of golf.

episodes.name: Twin Peaks of Talent
episodes.overview: Gawain learns that making the ball fly isn't enough to become the world's best golfer. He asks Kiria to give him a crash course on putting and iron shots.

episodes.name: First Tournament
episodes.overview: With his new skills, Gawain breezes through the first half of his inaugural tournament. But how will he fare when faced with bad weather conditions?

episodes.name: Camelot Academy
episodes.overview: At Camelot Academy, Gawain meets his new classmates, gifted junior golfers from around the world. Riser, unimpressed by Gawain's size, challenges him.

episodes.name: Uncrowned Prince
episodes.overview: To debut on the golf course, Gawain must win a game against Liebel on the D-level training course. But Liebel behaves strangely during the match play.

episodes.name: An Explosive Situation
episodes.overview: With the Camelot Cup coming up, tensions rise with only seven spots open. Some older schoolmates take aggressive measures to cut the competition.

episodes.name: The Tryouts Begin
episodes.overview: On the day of the tryouts, Gawain is up against Li and Todoin in a spiral course where his usual straight drive won't help. Can he master the slice?

episodes.name: Stubbornness and Pride
episodes.overview: Yumiko struggles with a bunker shot, while Kuromine's gift for seeing snake-like putting lines gets her ahead. Lancelot's unexpected visit causes a stir.

episodes.name: Playoffs
episodes.overview: The final playoff will decide who takes the last spot. But first, Riser and Gawain need to conquer a challenging course — and Kanazono's dirty tricks.

episodes.name: A Venerable Visitor
episodes.overview: Gawain stumbles upon an unassuming salaryman wandering around the school grounds who turns out to be their new coach: Hitomi Katase, a former pro golfer.

episodes.name: To the Battlefield!
episodes.overview: Kuromine challenges transfer student Lancelot, staking her pride as a putter and a spot on the team. The Japan team heads to England for the Camelot Cup.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Golf prodigy Gawain and Camelot Academy's Japan team take on gifted young golfers from the U.K. and U.S. schools in the coveted Camelot Cup.

episodes.name: Worthy New Opponents
episodes.overview: Gawain's encounter with Quester from the U.S. team leaves him in shock. Lancelot joins some of his American counterparts for a training session.

episodes.name: The Door to One's Soul
episodes.overview: Still rattled from his previous match with Quester, Gawain keeps duffing his shots. While he deals with his mental block, Platalissa confides in him.

episodes.name: Camelot Cup Competition!
episodes.overview: A surprise change to the U.K. team's order of play disrupts Ms. Aria's strategy for the Japan team, but Gawain and Lancelot rise to the challenge.

episodes.name: An Awakened Power
episodes.overview: As the pairs take on increasingly tricky courses, Gawain struggles with his control and strength — until he begins to see the sparks of a new power.

episodes.name: The Brits Go Into Overdrive
episodes.overview: Quester begins to lose confidence after witnessing Gawain's incredible growth. After coasting in the first half, Sfida and Ice turn the heat up.

episodes.name: The Way to Victory
episodes.overview: Faced with the final two holes, the U.K. and U.S. teams go all out. Will Gawain and Lancelot be able to clinch victory for the Japan team?

episodes.name: The Dark Nobleman
episodes.overview: While Liebel and Todoin brood over their poor performance against Tristan, the other players gear up for the Camelot Cup's main event: individual matches.

episodes.name: Monsters
episodes.overview: The Brits display their monstrous talent: Percival's impressive backswing and Tristan's incredible power and precision fire up Gawain and Lancelot.

episodes.name: An Approaching Destiny
episodes.overview: As the competition grows more heated and the young golfers battle it out on the fairways, Gawain's Gift attracts a mysterious man's attention.

episodes.name: Heart of Glass
episodes.overview: Wanglian's mastery over turbulent winds stuns everyone. Meanwhile, Lancelot's confidence starts to shatter as he loses control of his strokes.

episodes.name: Awaken!
episodes.overview: Gawain enters an injury-induced trance after being hit by Percival's ball, and a profound power emerges from him. Lancelot continues to falter.

episodes.name: A Contest of Gift
episodes.overview: Thanks to Gawain's words, Lancelot gets back his confidence — and his Gift. Gawain's uncanny performance continues and catches Tristan's attention.

episodes.name: To the Top
episodes.overview: Finding himself shaken by Lancelot and Gawain's skills, Tristan reevaluates his motivations. Gawain refuses to back down despite his worsening injury.

episodes.name: See You Again!
episodes.overview: The Camelot Cup draws to a close, and the young golfers reflect on their results. At the hospital, Gawain gets an intriguing invite from Arthur.

seasons.name: Limited Series
seasons.overview: As kids, they were at turns friends and foes. As adults, they're two crazy successful people living on opposite sides of the world. When a chance meeting throws them together again, will their relationship blossom into something more?

episodes.name: Comeback
episodes.overview: Soon-to-be-wed Bae Seok-ryu returns to Korea and runs into her old friend Choi Seung-hyo. But she acts strangely around him, hiding a secret.

episodes.name: Hate
episodes.overview: Even as her loved ones ask for an explanation, Seok-ryu hides her vulnerabilities until a confrontation with her mom forces Seung-hyo to come to her aid.

episodes.name: Stop Line
episodes.overview: As Seok-ryu adjusts to unemployment, she faces anxiety about her stagnant life. Seung-hyo clashes with his partner after a tense business meeting.

episodes.name: Past Perfect
episodes.overview: When Seok-ryu's old company presents a promising opportunity, she and Seung-hyo collaborate. Later, an unsettling encounter leaves Seok-ryu rattled.

episodes.name: Go Back
episodes.overview: Seung-hyo starts acting awkwardly around Seok-ryu as old feelings resurface. To complicate things further, he faces a delicate situation at work.

episodes.name: Your First
episodes.overview: Seok-ryu explores a new career path, tapping into a childhood passion. However, her family faces a crisis when her father's secret comes to light.

episodes.name: Love Is All About Timing
episodes.overview: A figure from Seok-ryu's past appears, leaving those around her looking for clarity — including Seung-hyo, who navigates his own complicated feelings.

episodes.name: His Secret
episodes.overview: As the truth finally comes out, Seung-hyo waits for Seok-ryu's response. Meanwhile, Seok-ryu's parents discover her new endeavor, sparking their fury.

episodes.name: Darkness in Life
episodes.overview: As Seok-ryu deals with an ailment, Seung-hyo and Song Hyeon-jun compete for her affection. But soon, Seung-hyo discovers the real reason for her return.

episodes.name: Bear in the Cave
episodes.overview: Seok-ryu's secret comes to light, leaving her loved ones struggling with the shock. When she goes missing, Seung-hyo desperately sets out to find her.

episodes.name: Belated
episodes.overview: Seung-hyo awaits Seok-ryu's genuine response as time passes since his confession. But suddenly, he receives a shocking announcement from his parents.

episodes.name: Puppy Love
episodes.overview: Seung-hyo and Seok-ryu try to navigate their relationship dynamic. Soon, feelings of jealousy arise, and they struggle to resolve a fight.

episodes.name: Love
episodes.overview: As their relationship blooms, Seung-hyo and Seok-ryu struggle to keep their status a secret. Jung Mo-eum finds out what's behind Kang Dan-ho's coldness.

episodes.name: Sweet Love
episodes.overview: Seung-hyo takes it into his own hands to encourage Seok-ryu's cooking ambitions. Convinced it's the right moment, he asks her an important question.

episodes.name: Bravo, My Life
episodes.overview: Seung-hyo and Seok-ryu face their parents' wrath after their secret is revealed — pushing the tension between their mothers to a boiling point.

episodes.name: The End
episodes.overview: Seung-hyo and Seok-ryu, happy in their relationship, prepare for a lifetime together. They inspire each other as they work toward their personal goals.

episodes.name: Once Upon A Writer
episodes.overview: Psychiatric nurse Patrick cares for his handicapped older brother, Matthew, whose traumatic past has left him terrified of butterflies, shaping their difficult, unusual life. Patrick's world shifts when he meets Mia Hernandez, a famous children's book author…

episodes.name: Wanting
episodes.overview: Gemma seeks Mia's signature to secure approval for her father's care and treatment. Meanwhile, Patrick revisits the painful events following his mother's murder, including the incident that sparked Matthew's fear of butterflies. Despite his reluctance to see…

episodes.name: Dino-Disaster
episodes.overview: Mia invites Matmat to attend her book signing event, hoping that Patrick will take him there. At the event, Patrick lets Matmat fall in line by himself so he can avoid Mia. However, while waiting, Matmat gets in trouble after seeing a little girl wearing a di…

episodes.name: Safety Pin
episodes.overview: Patrick calms Mia down with the butterfly hug technique. An exchange about Patrick distancing himself from Mia makes him reflect on his past. After another PTSD episode of Matmat regarding the butterflies, Patrick and his brother return to Maravida, where the…

episodes.name: Homecoming
episodes.overview: After being impressed by Matthew's illustration skills during their first meeting, Anok advises Patrick to be patient with his brother. Inspired by a fairy tale, Mia goes to OK Hospital to see Patrick, only to face repeated rejections from the nurse aide. Mea…

episodes.name: Reality Tales
episodes.overview: Mia finds an opportunity to get closer to Patrick as she starts teaching at OK Hospital. As he begins his therapy sessions with Anok, Matthew receives an unexpected job offer from the doctor. A new patient brings life to the party at OK Hospital, until his st…

episodes.name: The Fun In Dysfunction
episodes.overview: Mia takes Junjun out of the hospital and brings him to his father's campaign, where he reveals the painful truth about his family. His story triggers memories of Patrick's difficult childhood and his strained relationship with his mother, who pushed him to ca…

episodes.name: Temper, Temper
episodes.overview: Mia runs into Matthew at the hospital and invites him to spend time together, hoping to lure Patrick. When Patrick shows up, he lashes out at Mia and scolds Matthew, scaring his brother away. Later, Mia is attacked by Samuel and leaves dejected, a sight that…

episodes.name: The Guest
episodes.overview: Patrick tries to make amends with Matthew after scolding him, but a clumsy lie infuriates Matthew. This results in the two of them sleeping separately, which benefits Patrick, who keeps mum about Mia staying overnight in their room. The next day, Gemma finds…

episodes.name: Head Above The Water
episodes.overview: Mia convinces Matmat to not only be the illustrator for her new book but also to move in with her at the mansion. Despite Patrick's protests, Matmat insists that he wants to accept the offer. This decision causes a rift between the two brothers, which reminds…

episodes.name: Feeling Blue
episodes.overview: Mia struggles to keep herself together after Elvie mistakes her for her daughter, causing her to lash out during her class. To make matters worse, memories of her turbulent past with her mother resurface. Unable to convince Mia to leave Maravida, Vincent trie…

episodes.name: Frozen
episodes.overview: As he repeatedly fails to convince Mia to leave Maravida, Vincent is relieved to learn that his writer can now work just fine from her home. Anok confides in Patrick about his concerns for Mia and suspends her class at OK Hospital. After receiving treatment,…

episodes.name: Shear Tactics
episodes.overview: Mia decides to finally cut her mother out of her life. When Samuel appears to be haunted by a ghost from his past, Anok assigns Patrick to keep watch over another patient at the hospital. Later, Mia joins Patrick and Matthew on a trip down memory lane as they…

episodes.name: Mine
episodes.overview: Vincent comes up with a way to get closer to Gemma. Matthew finds Satsat in Mia's possession and demands that she return the doll. Although Mia tries to keep her anger in check, Patrick comes home to find the two in the middle of a physical fight. Back at OK…

episodes.name: A Moment To Run
episodes.overview: Patrick gets suspended after the fight with Jerome. He accepts Mia's offer to run away, but his responsibilities to his brother Matmat prevent him from taking a longer vacation. Later, Patrick hears Dipong humming a familiar tune and learns that it is a favor…

episodes.name: Breather
episodes.overview: Anok investigates who helped Kai escape the hospital. Patrick and Mia grow closer at the resort, giving Kai and Bella more time together before Kai returns to the facility. However, tensions quickly escalate between Matmat and his brother when the former reca…

episodes.name: Spaces Between Us
episodes.overview: Conflicted by his growing feelings for Mia and guilt over lying to Matthew about their trip, Patrick sets boundaries with the author just days before her birthday. Back at their apartment, he attempts to make amends with his brother. Samuel suffers a breakdow…

episodes.name: Busybody
episodes.overview: Vincent throws a surprise birthday celebration for Mia. After failing to make amends with Matthew, a disappointed Mia goes home and receives an unexpected visit from a woman bearing a cake for the occasion. At the hospital, Patrick finds Pogi unconscious. Upo…

episodes.name: The Mind Is A Mural
episodes.overview: Patrick recalls the night his mother died and the trauma it caused Matmat. When Mia realizes that Patrick cannot leave his brother's side, she tries to convince Matmat to return to the mansion. Meanwhile, tensions between Eden and Olivia heat up following Zel…

episodes.name: The Older Brother
episodes.overview: Matmat tries his best to be a big brother to Patrick during their meal trip together. Things almost turn sour for him when Mia shows up at the same restaurant. At the hospital, Anok, Eden, and Olivia interview Zelda about the incident during Mia's birthday. H…

episodes.name: The Butterfly Brooch
episodes.overview: Matthew opens up to Patrick and Anok about the night his mother was murdered. He recounts the moments Patrick was away that led up to her death and reveals the origin of his fear of butterflies. Shaken, Patrick begins to suspect the killer may be tied to Mia'…

episodes.name: Faces
episodes.overview: Mia gives Matthew a deadline for his character illustrations. At OK Hospital, Patrick overhears a conversation between Samuel and Eden, in which the patient confesses to horrific crimes. With Zelda's words echoing in his mind, Patrick reaches a disturbing con…

episodes.name: Messages
episodes.overview: Mia confronts Patrick about her mother's possible involvement in his mother's murder. Patrick finally tells Mia what Matthew revealed about the killer-and that Ingrid may still be alive. Shaken by the truth, Mia orders Patrick to leave the mansion with his br…

episodes.name: The Road To Being Okay
episodes.overview: Using an unconscious but unharmed Matmat, Eden lures Patrick to the mansion where she reveals the twisted truth surrounding Tessie's death. Angered, Patrick chokes Eden, but is unable to kill her. Eden then injects him with a sedative just as Mia arrives to c…

episodes.name: Pull Closer
episodes.overview: After learning about her hallucinations, Vincent and Madeth try to force Mia to leave the house, but Patrick steps in.

episodes.name: Clear Moment
episodes.overview: Mia tells Patrick about her dream, while Gemma and Vincent cross paths at a karaoke bar. Later, Dr. Anok asks Patrick about his relationship with Mia.

episodes.name: Meet Satsat
episodes.overview: After coming home drunk, Patrick gives Mia a gift with her nightmares. To find out more about Olivia, Eden suggests bonding over a drinking game.

episodes.name: Unleashed
episodes.overview: Mia returns to the hospital, leading to run-ins with Elvie and her father. Eden finds a curious letter in Samuel's bed.

episodes.name: Little Traces
episodes.overview: Mia makes a decision to change her look, but Matmat doesn't approve. Madeth finds out more about Gemma for a smitten Vincent.

episodes.name: Slowly Together
episodes.overview: Dr. Anok asks Patrick to keep a close eye on Zelda, a patient, after she begins acting strangely. Mia, Patrick and Matmat share a light moment together.

episodes.name: Not Hers
episodes.overview: When Matmat sees Mia holding Satsat, the two begin to fight, tearing the doll in half. Eden has an unsettling conversation with Samuel.

episodes.name: Rivalries
episodes.overview: Vincent and Madeth make themselves at home at Mama Li's house, despite Jason's annoyance. Matmat apologizes to Mia-but it comes with a warning.

episodes.name: Is This Love?
episodes.overview: While discussing Kai's secret relationship, Patrick reflects on his feelings for Mia. Bella grows emotional during Mia's class at the hospital.

episodes.name: Out of Routine
episodes.overview: After Patrick defends Mia from Jerome, he receives a 10-day suspension. But his plan for a romantic getaway soon comes to a screeching halt.

episodes.name: Cut Short
episodes.overview: Mia and Patrick make amends, but their intimate moment is interrupted. Gemma opens up to Macbeth, who gives her some frank advice.

episodes.name: Protecting You
episodes.overview: An agitated Samuel believes someone is out to kill him. As Patrick prepares for his trip with Mia, he has a revealing conversation with Dr. Anok.

episodes.name: Love is Patient
episodes.overview: Patrick and Mia run into Kai and Bella, who want to spend together before it's too late. Eden witnesses a violent encounter at the hospital.

episodes.name: Breaking Chains
episodes.overview: As Patrick begins to show his feelings for Mia, an anxious Matmat awaits his return. Eden grows suspicious of Olivia's behavior toward Samuel.

episodes.name: Death Wish
episodes.overview: Kai and Bella share a tearful farewell, Eden confronts Olivia about violating hospital policy and Matmat overhears a conversation about Patrick and Mia.

episodes.name: Brothers' Rift
episodes.overview: After Matmat's outburst, Mia tries to comfort Patrick, but he remains distraught. The staff worries about the brothers' relationship.

episodes.name: Short-Lived Flame
episodes.overview: While recuperating at the hospital, Matmat finds a curious book with a strange note on it. Mia confronts Patrick over his silence.

episodes.name: Mama Dinosaur
episodes.overview: While Mama Li sends Gemma and Vincent on an errand together, Nurse Eden spends time with Matmat. Gemma offers advice to Patrick.

episodes.name: Rounds of Comfort
episodes.overview: Patrick's tearful apology leads to a heartfelt reunion between brothers. Mia forces Gemma to share a meal — and a few drinks — with her.

episodes.name: When We Miss
episodes.overview: While recalling memories from their childhood days, Mia can no longer avoid the truth — that she misses Patrick's presence in her home.

episodes.name: Birthday Blues
episodes.overview: Triggered by a song, Samuel attacks Zelda and issues a warning to Patrick. Mia seeks comfort from Mama Li on her birthday — but finds a surprise instead.

episodes.name: Secret Greetings
episodes.overview: Mia recalls a birthday from year ago, Eden picks up a cake for someone special and Patrick rushes to find Zelda when Pogi is attacked.

episodes.name: To Her Surprise
episodes.overview: Patrick reaches Mia's home, only to find an ominous scene. As Mia confronts him over his priorities, he stumbles through his feelings for her.

episodes.name: One Fight Day
episodes.overview: Gemma agrees to a coffee date with Vincent. Mia makes a promise to Patrick after he reveals the real reason behind Matmat's trauma.

episodes.name: Bringing Closer
episodes.overview: After clashing with Matmat, Mia seeks his approval. News of Samuel's health devastates the hospital staff, especially Olivia.

episodes.name: His Dream World
episodes.overview: Patrick shares his new outlook on life with Jason. Gemma and Mama Li try to soften Matmat, then discuss Gemma's date with Vincent.

episodes.name: Be My Brother
episodes.overview: Jason complains about his dwindling chances at love with Gemma. Matmat and Patrick share a fancy meal together — but balk when the bill arrives.

episodes.name: Butterfly Effect
episodes.overview: Patrick and Mia discuss the future together while filming a video for her new endorsement. Gemma grows weary as Vincent spends time with her ex.

episodes.name: The Real Butterfly
episodes.overview: Newly discharged from the hospital, Tommy has a terrifying episode in a bus, forcing Matmat to spring into action. Later, Matmat faces his own fears.

episodes.name: Enduring Truths
episodes.overview: As Patrick grapples with a heartbreaking truth, he searches for answers. Gemma urges Mia to visit her dying father, while Eden and Olivia clash again.

episodes.name: Family Picture
episodes.overview: Mia's family photo shoot with the brothers hits a roadblock when Patrick refuses to take part. But a hidden note leads to a change of heart.

episodes.name: Beyond Fear
episodes.overview: As Matmat tries to draw butterflies, he meets a new illustration challenge — crafting facial expressions. Patrick tries to get answers out of Samuel.

episodes.name: Patient Samuel
episodes.overview: An ailing Samuel makes a startling confession to Patrick, Eden and Olivia as he recalls a terrifying night from his past.

episodes.name: The Last Secret
episodes.overview: After an escape at the hospital, the staff searches for the missing patient. Patrick urges Mia to face the truth, while Dr. Anok expresses his doubts.

episodes.name: Your Care, My Care
episodes.overview: The appearance of a butterfly drawing on Matmat's mural causes him to break down. Mia recognizes the unique design, leading to a harrowing realization.

episodes.name: Rekindled
episodes.overview: Vincent urges Mia to meet him, while Patrick finds a book belonging to Ingrid. When Madeth's brother starts to bully her, Jason steps up to defend her.

episodes.name: Dance with Danger
episodes.overview: After checking security footage, Patrick races to find who painted over Matmat's mural. The group debates how to handle Olivia and Eden.

episodes.name: The Real Face
episodes.overview: Mia worries Patrick and the group when she rushes off for an errand. Gemma and Vincent have a heart-to-heart conversation about the future.

episodes.name: Return to Me
episodes.overview: As the truth becomes clear, Patrick urges caution but Mia remains defiant, as she and Matmat attend an interview for the new book.

episodes.name: Face the Monster
episodes.overview: With Matmat in danger, Mia and Patrick rush to the house to save him. Patrick learns new information about his mother's death.

episodes.name: Happy Day
episodes.overview: After a harrowing night, Patrick and Mia find solace in one another, while Matmat finally gets the gift of his dreams.

episodes.name: I HATE YOU and I LOVE YOU
episodes.overview: Puniru follows Kotaro to school to take him something he forgot, but they end up getting into a fight. Puniru turns into an idol to get Kotaro to admit she’s cute. Kotaro tries to enlist Puniru’s help in winning the affections of his crush, Kirara-senpai.

episodes.name: Neither Friend nor Slime
episodes.overview: Kotaro asks Puniru to turn into a first grader and act lost so he can look good in front of Kirara-senpai, but little does he know Kirara’s maternal instincts go into overdrive around children. Puniru later plays a trick using this knowledge.

episodes.name: Kawaii Puniru is a Slime
episodes.overview: Kotaro’s favorite plushie as a child was the adorable Kyuthi-chan, which had a profound (jealous) effect on Puniru. Now he wants to go to the Kyuthi Café, where he gets Puniru to pretend to be his girlfriend so he can order a dish meant for couples.

episodes.name: Alice in Kyuthi Land
episodes.overview: Alice, granddaughter to the president of the toy company that made Kyuthi-chan, challenges Puniru to see whether she or a character Alice created is more adorable—and you could say the competition gets blown into gigantic proportions!

episodes.name: GO! GO! Fabulous Cheer Routine!
episodes.overview: In an attempt to please Alice, Hodai dons a Runrune costume. Meanwhile, Nanpa, Puniru, and Hone-chan fight over Robo Runrune. Then, to put some pep back in the exhausted Kirara-senpai’s step, Puniru and Runrune become cheerleaders.

episodes.name: The Runrune-tastic Grand Prix, Now with Puniru!
episodes.overview: Puniru gets moldy and down in the dumps when Runrune starts ignoring her. Later, she’s determined to get Runrune and Alice to be friends again. Next, AI Runrune hits the scene, and Alice and Puniru face off to see which Runrune is better.

episodes.name: Sweet Bitter Summer
episodes.overview: Kotaro and the boys go to the beach for a day of fun while Puniru and Kirara-senpai are at the school pool. Later, Kotaro asks Puniru to help him cool off with a special transformation, the gang hits a café, and then it’s time to tackle summer homework.

episodes.name: Gather 'Round for the School Festival!
episodes.overview: It’s time for the school festival, but Puniru and Alice get into a fight over Kotaro. Alice tries to win him over with an incredible offer, and Puniru tries to throw the match so he can pursue his dreams.

episodes.name: Let's Start a Band, Punks!
episodes.overview: Kotaro wants to be cool and decides to try his luck with dragons and a rock band. Puniru then lets the cat out of the bag about Kotaro’s feelings for Kirara, which forces him to make a move. Can he get Puniru to help him out?

episodes.name: Merry Punirumas!
episodes.overview: Ever since being teased as kid for liking cute things, Kotaro has never enjoyed Christmas. This year his parents are going on a trip for the holiday, so in order to avoid being stuck home alone with Puniru, he tries to throw a Christmas party.

episodes.name: Scoop Up a Spoonful of Christmas
episodes.overview: Puniru says she’ll spend the holiday with whoever brings her the cutest Christmas cake, but the offerings she gets are... interesting. When a certain someone loses their patience, she may yet get a Christmas to remember.

episodes.name: A Lovely, Puniful Destination

episodes.overview: While hoping for Puniru's return, a lonely Kotaro sees the fruits of her cuteness training from afar. One day, he receives an unexpected package.

episodes.overview: Finding himself transported to a fantasy world, Kotaro learns he must rescue Princess Kyuthi, who has been imprisoned in the Demon Lord's castle.

episodes.name: Rune Rune Dance
episodes.overview: After Runru breaks down, Puniru decides to inject it with some slime-based medicine that has an unexpected side effect: awakening its sense of self.

episodes.overview: Mado succeeds in creating an artificial slime lifeform and names her Gelee. Wanting to become more human, Gelee begins searching for someone to love.

episodes.name: Puniru Powers Up?! See It for Yourself!
episodes.overview: Kotaro has big plans for the summer, but could he be his own worst enemy? Meanwhile, Puniru seeks to power up.

episodes.name: A Human Happy Ending
episodes.overview: Gelee becomes the center of attention among the school's boys, including Kotaro, much to Puniru's chagrin.

episodes.name: A Midsummer's Runrune Resort
episodes.overview: Alice invites Kotaro to stay at Runrune Resort, but all Kotaro can think about is Gelee and her advances.

episodes.name: Trick or Kawaii!
episodes.overview: Gelee joins Kotaro's class as a student, to her chagrin. Meanwhile, Puniru plans a big surprise for Halloween.

episodes.overview: Hodai hatches a scheme to discredit Kotaro in Alice's eyes by having him face Nanpa in an artistic face-off.

episodes.name: Friendly Enough to Always Argue
episodes.overview: Kotaro gets into a big fight with Puniru, who runs away to Mami's apartment and meets the Kirara family.

episodes.name: The Human Condition
episodes.overview: Kotaro holds a study group with friends, but his careless remark to Gelee ends up having dire consequences.

episodes.name: That's What the World Calls Love
episodes.overview: Puniru turns into a perfect human girl, but Kotaro doesn't seem as happy to hear the news as everyone else.

episodes.name: First Day at School / Bubli's Toy Truck
episodes.overview: Making new friends at school can be hard, but Bheem isn't giving up easily! A remote-controlled toy truck leads to a lesson in sharing.

episodes.overview: It's time for cake and gifts as Bheem's class celebrates Tukaram's birthday. Later, Bheem shows his brand new pencil to his friends.

episodes.overview: Bheem and his class are having a picnic — but will naughty monkeys ruin their day? A search for treasure takes the gang on an adventure!

episodes.name: Palace Tour / Art Attack
episodes.overview: On a visit to the palace, Bheem meets a princess as the class gets into mischief. Bheem learns about different kinds of art from his friends.

episodes.name: Bheem Gets the Animal / Trainer's Day
episodes.overview: The class turns into a zoo when the children bring their pets for a wild day at school! The kids play pranks after a new fitness coach arrives.

episodes.name: Ghost in School / Land of Shapes
episodes.overview: A ghost at school who's stealing toys? It's up to Bheem to save the day! Later, a lesson about shapes leaves the kids running in circles.

episodes.name: Genie in the School / Not a Nap Day
episodes.overview: A magical genie brings toys for the kids — but what does he wish for? At nap time, an energetic Bheem distracts an unexpected visitor.

episodes.name: Sports Day
episodes.overview: Get ready for fun, fitness and teamwork as Bheem and his friends compete in their school's sports day!

episodes.name: Dirty Pappu / Mind the Class
episodes.overview: Pappu needs a bath — so the children decide to give him one. Bheem's class must stay quiet to get a sweet, but not everyone follows the rules!

episodes.name: Hot Summer Day / Class Photo
episodes.overview: Can Bheem and his friends beat the heat on a sunny day? Later, the children strike their best poses for a photographer at the school's picture day.

episodes.overview: Tyagi faces a case that could make or break his career. Ananya plans a sting operation to get to the bottom of Nayana's plan. Sujata is caught in a lie.
