episodes.overview: Former deputy Dog roams the land with unlikely companions, but their search for a home is interrupted when they run into the notorious Wade Brothers.

episodes.name: Pied Piper of Hamelin
episodes.overview: The sheltered and precocious Maria is content with her bleak village life until her obsessed teacher shows her an illicit picture from the outside world.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Ju Ga-ram reemerges after a doping scandal to coach the struggling rugby team at his alma mater — facing pushback from colleagues, players and his ex.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Ga-ram risks dismissal after clashing with school staff. After, Yoon Seong-jun quits the team in protest — just before their next match.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The team takes a hit after losing their star player, forcing Ga-ram to quickly find a replacement — but when he does, he's met with resistance.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Ga-ram faces a new challenge when the school sets a trap to block his recruit's admission — a challenging test across multiple sports.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Even with a full roster, the rugby team resorts to unconventional training. But as tensions rise, their team spirit wavers — putting everything at risk.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: With a tournament approaching, Ga-ram steps up to bring in a scout despite his reputation. Meanwhile, rumors of a controversy involving Bae I-ji spread.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: While hiding out in Hokkaido, Juzo rescues travelers from a bear. But his impressive fight puts him on the radar of the law and an illicit group.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: After defeating karate master Ichiro, Juzo narrowly evades the police. But someone is leaking his whereabouts to martial artists who want a piece of him.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Training under Ranbo, Joze struggles to land a single hit. Meanwhile, Juzo confronts his inner beast and reflects on his dark past.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Juzo comes face-to-face with the mysterious Sergeant, who blackmails him into joining the underground tournament KODOKU where he's forced to brawl.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: In the middle of Juzo's first match, Ryuoumaru lands a powerful strike that doesn't resemble any traditional sumo moves — awakening Juzo's inner beast.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Former King of the Cage Mifune has a secret weapon: his son. Juzo must overcome Kaito's uncanny ability to read moves, if he wants to get to the finals.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Bunshichi's quest for ultimate strength leads him to the Takemiya dojo. Juzo is set on confessing to Saeko — but Himekawa stands in his way.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: It's the ultimate face-off: Juzo Fujimaki versus Tsutomu Himekawa. The Takemiya style versus the Hokushinkan school. Has the lone wolf met his match?

episodes.name: Oni's Blood
episodes.overview: Teenager Shiki is attacked by a mysterious man. As his foster father Tsuyoshi helps him flee, he learns of his surprising and legendary heritage.

episodes.name: If You Want to Make It, Keep On Winning
episodes.overview: Shiki wakes up confused in front of Naito, who explains the situation between the Oni and the Momotaro.

episodes.name: Blood Eclipse Release
episodes.overview: The first test the boys face to enter the academy is playing "demon catcher."

episodes.name: Work with Me
episodes.overview: If they want to pass the test their teacher has given them, students must work together.

episodes.name: Bad News
episodes.overview: The students reach the Kyoto underground and discover new things about the war they are involved in.

episodes.name: Even the Loner Path Has Its Limits
episodes.overview: The undead attack the students and Shiki is forced to make a decision that will change his mind.

episodes.name: The Beauty is a Beast
episodes.overview: Yomogi uses his power to seal off the underground and the students must fight to survive.

episodes.name: The Unreliable Hero
episodes.overview: Kuina fights a battle against another ugly, but this time he finds himself in a very delicate situation.

episodes.name: Momotaro Spirit
episodes.overview: The riots affect the security of the temple and the students must evacuate the people as soon as possible.

episodes.name: Kishin's Child
episodes.overview: Samidare visits the Momotaro headquarters in Tokyo. Brushing off fellow agent Shinya's provocations, he declares he will be the one to kill Shiki.

episodes.name: Thank You!
episodes.overview: Overwhelmed by Shiki's intense flames, a wounded Tsubakiri recalls the promise he made to his mentor, Manaka — the man whose corpse he controls.

episodes.name: Day of the Storm
episodes.overview: A storm catches the boys by surprise and they have to stay locked up for a night.

episodes.name: Mikado, Like Gate of the Gods
episodes.overview: The boys have time to go to a local festival and Shiki meets someone mysterious.

episodes.name: Personal Rule
episodes.overview: Momotaro's surveillance network detects what happened in the city center and responds immediately.

episodes.name: Found You
episodes.overview: Shinya is looking for the academy students to carry out the plan he has in mind.

episodes.name: Not So Bad
episodes.overview: A kidnapping, a hostage, and a secret plan intertwine in an attempt to find Shiki's whereabouts.

episodes.name: The Vengeful Oni
episodes.overview: Jin reminisces about everything he experienced during his childhood.

episodes.name: Haunted by Doubt
episodes.overview: The squadrons are set in motion as doubts creep in about what's coming.

episodes.name: The Voice of the Weak
episodes.overview: Mikado meets Shiki and reveals who he is, but Shiki doesn't know why he knows his name or what he's plotting.

episodes.name: Rage vs. Rage
episodes.overview: After awakening as an Oni, Shiki Ichinose must master his power and join the age-old war against the Momotaro.

episodes.name: Flawless Fortune
episodes.overview: The tarot cards and their position can tip the balance of the fight one way or the other.

episodes.name: A Futile Battle
episodes.overview: During the battle, Shinya remembers his past and what motivated him to aspire to get where he is today.

episodes.name: My Friend
episodes.overview: After awakening as an Oni, Shiki Ichinose must master his power and join the age-old war against the Momotaro.

episodes.name: Until We Meet Again
episodes.overview: After the battle, everyone must re-evaluate their destiny and the next steps that need to be taken.

seasons.name: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc
seasons.overview: Sequel of Tougen Anki.

episodes.name: Let the Training Begin
episodes.overview: The students must climb a mountain within 24 hours during a blizzard, dodging two rival professors.

episodes.name: The Path to Growing Strong
episodes.overview: Shiki is caught in an avalanche while shielding Homare, who has injured her leg.

episodes.name: Purpose
episodes.overview: Homare and Shiki reach the summit, followed by Juji, Kuina, and Rokuro. Only Jin and Yaoroshi remain. As Yaoroshi lashes out at those around him, Jin points out that his impatience is causing trouble for his teammates. Just then, Nekosaki and Innami appear.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After receiving a call from Hong Hee-joo's kidnapper, Paik Sa-eon attempts to learn more about him — only to find it's hard to escape his surveillance.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Sa-eon works quickly to track down the caller, forcing Hee-joo to stay hypervigilant. Despite her fears, she continues to play along with the ruse.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: After Sa-eon experiences an attack, he grows wary of Hee-joo's relationship with her friend. Meanwhile, an ominous figure makes his presence known.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: After receiving the ominous call, Hee-joo abandons her clandestine plan. She then undergoes a tough interview with Sa-eon — sharing an intimate moment.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Sa-eon grapples with feelings of betrayal after learning the truth about Hee-joo. However, when she receives good news, they begin to grow fonder.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Hee-joo confronts a figure from her past who wishes to reveal what she knows. She then embarks on a retreat with Sa-eon — who becomes possessive of her.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Sa-eon and Hee-joo's relationship shifts after her harrowing rescue. Determined to catch the kidnapper, Sa-eon goes full force — with the help of 406.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: As Hee-joo and Sa-eon grow closer, the threat from the kidnapper intensifies. Sa-eon discovers an ominous and shocking clue from a past figure.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Hee-joo worries about Sa-eon after learning the truth about him. She later appears on the stage of her dreams, side by side with her love.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: While attempting to rescue Hee-joo, Sa-eon discovers another surprising conspirator — whom he later tries to persuade to help locate the kidnapper.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: After Hee-joo's bold move, her fate and that of her kidnapper remain uncertain. But Sa-eon refuses to give up — leaving no stone unturned to find her.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Sa-eon abandons everything he's worked for, leaving Hee-joo completely alone. But after a clue arrives, she embarks on a journey to reunite with him.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Six years ago, Mi-kyung, who was in a workplace romance at Wonjin Retail, lost both love and her job due to her boyfriend’s betrayal and impulsively ran away to her younger brother’s guesthouse. One day, while researching potatoes in the fresh air of Daegwall…

episodes.name: That Wonhan Bastard
episodes.overview: While facing some internal anger for his harsh corporate changes, So Baek-ho clashes with the fierce Kim Mi-kyung when he visits her potato research lab.

episodes.name: The Hot Director
episodes.overview: After Baek-ho unwittingly moves into Mi-kyung's guest house and sets up an office at her lab, she turns the village against him — resulting in a fiasco.

episodes.name: The Price of a Kiss
episodes.overview: After Mi-kyung panics to avoid running into Baek-ho, he comes to her aid during a potato cooking competition. She later runs into a figure from her past.

episodes.name: This message has been deleted
episodes.overview: Baek-ho deals devastating news to Mi-kyung, forcing her to figure out her next steps. But later, an emergency forces the two to work together.

episodes.name: Person of Interest
episodes.overview: Baek-ho and Mi-kyung see new sides of each other, and feelings begin to blossom. A new arrival at the guesthouse stirs jealousy in Mi-kyung.

episodes.name: False Goat's Beard
episodes.overview: After a shakeup at the potato lab, Baek-ho and Mi-kyung take a business trip together. But soon after, Baek-ho starts avoiding her, leaving her confused.

episodes.name: Softie Sweetie
episodes.overview: With their feelings made clear, Mi Gyeong and Baek Ho head out on their first date. But shortly after, they realize that rumors spread quickly at work

episodes.name: Lethal
episodes.overview: The sudden appearance of an unwelcome visitor wreaks havoc at the guesthouse. Mi Gyeong later panics out after discovering a secret relationship.

episodes.name: I Regret It
episodes.overview: While Mi-kyung struggles with past wounds, Baek-ho worries about her well-being. Later, they share a tender and intimate moment in a potato flower field.

episodes.name: Yes
episodes.overview: After witnessing a surprising moment between Park Ki-se and Mi-kyung, Baek-ho learns the truth about her past — leading him to confess everything.

episodes.name: Disaster
episodes.overview: Feeling betrayed by Baek-ho, Mi-kyung shuts him out. But as the tension between the two escalates, their colleagues scheme to reconcile them.

episodes.name: MK107
episodes.overview: Mi-kyung's lab days dwindle, leaving her future with Baek-ho uncertain. What will their next chapter hold?

episodes.name: Princess Sakuna of the Lofty Realm
episodes.overview: Sakuna, daughter of the war god Takeribi and the harvest goddess Toyohana, was leading a lazy and spoiled life due to her privileged upbringing. However, one day, she inadvertently allowed humans who had wandered into the realm of the gods to enter the capita…

episodes.name: Life on Hinoe Island
episodes.overview: Amidst the raging sea, Sakuna and her companions finally reach the island and head towards the mountain pass where her mother, Toyohana, once lived.

episodes.name: Rice Planting Song
episodes.overview: Sakuna not only has to deal with manure and fertilizer in the fields, but people also cause her various problems. However, through a shared rice-planting song, the group manages to come together again.

episodes.name: Myrthe's Journey
episodes.overview: Myrthe has moved to Yanato in the distant East to teach the residents about the Formos religion. However, when the group makes contact with the Kappa, the blue-eyed foreigner is mistaken for an enemy.

episodes.name: Kinta Repays His Debt
episodes.overview: Sakuna tries to set Yui up with Kinta, but when Yui suddenly disappears and a crane appears instead, she and Kinta set out to search for this mysterious creature.

episodes.name: Flames of Hatred
episodes.overview: The harvest is approaching, but on the volcano, ghosts and skeletons seem to be causing trouble. Ashigumo is injured in battle. Will the harvested rice give Sakuna enough strength to overcome this new challenge?

episodes.name: The Melancholy of Kokorowa
episodes.overview: Sakuna is called back to the capital, where she gets to taste the rice that her mother cultivated. She decides that she wants to produce such delicious rice herself as well.

episodes.name: The Rice Riot That Shook the Capital
episodes.overview: Amahoho becomes tainted in the capital. Sakuna sneaks in to get to the bottom of the rumors that Kokorowa is behind it. Eventually, this leads to a conflict between the two friends.

episodes.name: The One Who Controls the Demons
episodes.overview: Sakuna and the others find an injured Oni and argue about what to do with him. Following Kokorowa's suggestion, they eventually track his trail and discover the root of the evil.

episodes.name: Comeback
episodes.overview: Sakuna and her companions rally after they lose everything.

episodes.name: Light of Forgiveness
episodes.overview: Tauemon confronts Ishimaru, but how can the mountain bandit's hatred be quelled? And how will Sakuna defeat the evil god Omizuchi?

episodes.name: The Blade of Hoshidama
episodes.overview: The only way to defeat Omizuchi is to forge a new Blade of Hoshidama, which requires Tama to be melted down. Will Sakuna sacrifice her beloved Tama for the good of the island?

episodes.name: Sakuna: Of Rice and Ruin
episodes.overview: The time has come to fight Omizuchi. With her family, friends, and allies, she has overcome numerous obstacles, but can she defeat the evil god?

episodes.name: Highway
episodes.overview: After running a dangerous errand for her only friend, Kai finds herself in deep trouble. During a hasty escape, she comes across a mysterious group.

episodes.name: Heartbeat
episodes.overview: Seeking more intel, Kageyama reaches out to the all-seeing Digital Ministry's Justice Bureau. Meanwhile, Kai joins Suma Garage for her first delivery.

episodes.name: Grip
episodes.overview: The city transforms into a circuit for the Tokyo Warp Grand Prix. Hugo takes off on his own investigation while Kai teams up with Spoke for a delivery.

episodes.name: Mask
episodes.overview: After learning that the NARCS are targeting big events, Kai steals a bike and heads to the concert where Ayumi is, hoping to save her.

episodes.name: Compass
episodes.overview: Tensions run high in the hospital waiting room when Kageyama shows up with Yukio and asks for Suma Garage's cooperation in finding a traitor.

episodes.name: Tokyo
episodes.overview: United as a team, Spoke and Watari travel around the city to gather supporting data, while Hugo and Kai race against time to deliver the evidence.

episodes.name: Romance, Action, and Drama
episodes.overview: An upright Tribhuvan Mishra leads a joyful domestic life, until bad news comes knocking. Meanwhile, confectioner Teekaram Jain moonlights as Raja Bhai.

episodes.name: Loser
episodes.overview: Raja Bhai has an adversary. In desperate need of cash, an anxiety-ridden Tribhuvan realizes that he has a gift that could come in handy.

episodes.name: DilDesire.com
episodes.overview: Tribhuvan becomes the man who really knows what women want. He also suggests a cake recipe to Ashoklata, though she is unaware of its origin.

episodes.name: Bunty and Babli
episodes.overview: Ashoklata and Tribhuvan open a bakery. Bindi is being spied on while Inspector Haider Ali has his eyes on Raja Bhai. CA Topper's popularity increases.

episodes.name: Sweet Union
episodes.overview: Egged on by her mother, Ashoklata grows suspicious of her husband. During a rendezvous with Bindi, things go terribly wrong for Tribhuvan.

episodes.name: Male Prostitute
episodes.overview: Inspector Haider Ali makes a solid discovery. Shambhu receives a threat but Shobha comes to his rescue. Raja Bhai and Dhaincha vow to find the culprit.

episodes.name: Balls of Steel
episodes.overview: Dhaincha unearths important information. Tribhuvan makes arrangements to protect his family but chaos ensues when Shobha and Shambhu get involved.

episodes.name: Guns N Roses
episodes.overview: As Raja Bhai tries to woo Bindi, she plans a surprise for him. Tribhuvan decides to make some changes. The police gather more damning evidence.

episodes.name: Family Function
episodes.overview: Dhaincha opens up about his past to Bindi. As mayhem breaks out, will Tribhuvan's carefully constructed secrets be laid bare?

episodes.name: Fresh & Unseen
episodes.overview: Kapil and his dazzling guests are back with never-before-seen moments that will leave you in splits

episodes.name: Comedy Ka Maha Reunion
episodes.overview: When comedy legends Kapil Sharma and Sunil Grover reunite, it’s bound to be a recipe for success.

episodes.name: Ladies Special
episodes.overview: Watch celebrated female guests join Kapil on stage for hilarious wisecracks and some truly relatable conversations.

episodes.name: Games with Guests
episodes.overview: Charades, headphone challenges, guessing games and more keep Kapil’s famous guests on their toes.

episodes.name: Stories of the Stars
episodes.overview: The stars of Kapil’s show are fantastic storytellers as they share everything from heartwarming childhood tales to rib-tickling personal anecdotes.

episodes.name: Dost Ka Roast
episodes.overview: Prepare to laugh out loud as Kapil, the king of comebacks, engages in side-splitting banter with his celebrity friends.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: After his business crashes, a man disappears from his family for 11 years. But when he makes a return as their wealthy landlord, a messy reunion ensues.

episodes.name: A Bolt from the Blue
episodes.overview: A sudden fire claims the landlord's life at Family Villa. As tenants question the cause, Geum Ae-yeon worries about her family and a possible rent hike.

episodes.name: The Return of Yongdong-dong’s Rebel
episodes.overview: Byeon Moo-jin settles at Family Villa, triggering Byeon Mi-rae's old grudges. To escape the tension with her once-estranged dad, she begins a house hunt.

episodes.name: The Great Byeon-sby's Secret
episodes.overview: Moo-jin promises free rent and ends the house hunt for Mi-rae, who's upset he's flaunting his wealth. He clarifies: He's doing it to win Ae-yeon back.

episodes.name: The War of the Byeons
episodes.overview: Moo-jin clears himself of suspicion in the fire accident. Later, Ae-yeon briefly disappears, leading to a chaotic family reunion at the police station.

episodes.name: A Midlife Crisis Begins
episodes.overview: Ae-yeon turns Moo-jin at dinner but can't shake her lingering emotions. Curious, she starts looking into his mysterious 11-year absence.

episodes.name: I Want to Get Closer to You
episodes.overview: Byeon Hyeon-jae moves into his dad's place, as per Mi-rae's wishes. Ae-yeon's tension eases when she learns about Moo-jin's time in Thailand.

episodes.name: Our Home Ground
episodes.overview: Mi-rae leaves a note and goes missing — has she left Family Villa for good? Meanwhile, Moo-jin's unfortunate past begins to catch up with him.

episodes.name: The Promised Eighth Inning
episodes.overview: Ae-yeon is furious after discovering Moo-jin and Mi-rae's bet involving her. But after calming down, she realizes they need to talk about their daughter.

episodes.name: Back to the Mi-rae
episodes.overview: Ae-yeon urges her daughter to lead her own life and even finds her a new place to stay, leaving Mi-rae both angry and confused.

episodes.name: Tears are Saltier than Water
episodes.overview: Things are looking up for the Byeons as Ae-yeon finds a career opportunity. Mi-rae mentors a new recruit at work and Moo-jin faces his past with grace.

episodes.name: Following the Journey of Moo-jin...
episodes.overview: Moo-jin finally shares the story behind his newfound wealth, to the relief of Family Villa residents. But can this confession mend old wounds?

episodes.name: Our Romance
episodes.overview: Moo-jin and Ae-yeon's reunion is on everyone's mind. As Ae-yeon reflects on their relationship, the family contemplates the true meaning of togetherness.

episodes.name: Here's Ranma
episodes.overview: Tendo Dojo master Soun eagerly awaits the arrival of his old friend Genma Saotome and Genma's son Ranma. Instead, a teen girl and a giant panda show up.

episodes.name: I Hate Men!
episodes.overview: On Ranma's first day at Furinkan High School, a group of boys — including the sophomore Kuno — ambushes Akane at the school's entrance.

episodes.name: Because There's Someone He Likes
episodes.overview: To Ranma's horror, Kuno falls head-over-heels for Ranma's female form and starts a relentless pursuit. Meanwhile, Akane deals with unrequited feelings.

episodes.name: The Hunter
episodes.overview: A mysterious martial artist arrives at Furinkan High looking to settle a score with Ranma. Later, the school becomes a battlefield.

episodes.name: Who Says You're Cute
episodes.overview: Akane gets caught up in Ryoga and Ranma's fight and ends up with a shocking new appearance. Ranma, worried, abandons the battle and goes after her.

episodes.name: Kodachi, The Black Rose
episodes.overview: When the Furinkan High rhythmic gymnastics team is injured by a rival school's captain, its members beg Akane to take their place in an upcoming match.

episodes.name: Hot Competition
episodes.overview: With Akane injured, Ranma takes her place and stays up all night practicing. The next day, the match begins with Kodachi's usual underhanded tricks.

episodes.name: Darling Charlotte
episodes.overview: P-chan goes missing and shows up in the arms of a famous martial skater, who refuses to return him. Enraged, Akane challenges Azusa to a battle.

episodes.name: I'll Never Let Go
episodes.overview: A fierce match between Ranma and Akane versus the golden couple Mikado and Azusa begins! Mikado is eager to steal a kiss from Akane, worrying Ranma.

episodes.name: Kiss of Death
episodes.overview: Chaos ensues when the match continues with Ryoga and an injured female Ranma. Later, a Chinese Amazon appears, bent on killing Ranma's female form.

episodes.name: You I Love
episodes.overview: Ranma learns that defeating a Chinese Amazon has messy consequences. P-chan gets served up for dinner, triggering a fight between Shampoo and Akane.

episodes.name: Shampoo Cleans Up
episodes.overview: Shampoo's shiatsu technique and magic hair wash have erased Akane's memory of Ranma. The Chinese Amazon offers a cure — but she has an impossible request.

episodes.name: Ranma's Weakness
episodes.overview: Another of Akane's suitors, the quiet Gosunkugi, begins stalking Ranma to find the martial artist's weakness. Will he unearth Ranma's secret?

episodes.name: Attack of the Wild Mousse
episodes.overview: Ranma's problems continue as he deals with the aftermath of his trance, Shampoo's new secret, her meddlesome great-grandmother and a jealous rival.

episodes.name: Chestnuts Roasting on an Open Fire
episodes.overview: After a heated battle with Mousse, Ranma remains stuck in his female form and must master a difficult technique to obtain the antidote for his condition.

episodes.name: Naval Engagement
episodes.overview: Ranma follows the Cat Café to the beach, where a Martial Arts Watermelon Splitting Race stands in his way of finally retrieving the real Phoenix Pill.

episodes.name: It's Fast or It's Free
episodes.overview: Cologne learns about the annual Martial Arts Delivery Race and signs Shampoo up to compete against Akane and Ranma. Who will reach the final goal first?

episodes.name: The Evil Wakes
episodes.overview: When the lecherous Happosai escapes to Nerima, seeking the disciples who imprisoned him, Akane and Ranma team up to deal with his perverted antics.

episodes.name: Instant Spring
episodes.overview: Shampoo receives a mysterious package. Meanwhile, Soun and Genma's plan to bring Ranma and Akane closer backfires when the real dojo destroyer shows up.

episodes.name: "Okonomiyaki" Means "I Love You"
episodes.overview: Ranma finds himself in a bind when he learns that the new transfer student is the person who attacked his father — and his long-lost childhood friend!

episodes.name: Love Letters in the Sauce
episodes.overview: In order to be with Ranma, Ukyo hatches a scheme to help Ryoga get a date with Akane. Unfortunately, things don't go according to plan...

episodes.name: Not Your Typical Juliet
episodes.overview: After years cast in boyish roles, Akane finally gets to play her dream role: Juliet! But will the prospective Romeos' antics ruin her precious chance?

episodes.name: Abduction of ...Akane?
episodes.overview: Determined to win Shampoo back, Mousse challenges Ranma. He attacks using Spring of Drowned Duck water and traps Akane in a water tank.

episodes.name: Fowl Play
episodes.overview: Despite Ranma's efforts to protect the audience from the cursed spring water, Akane gets doused instead. What emerges is not his fiancée, but a duck.

episodes.name: Training Meals
episodes.overview: Ryoga challenges Ranma, but Ranma's battles with Cologne have made him far stronger. When Cologne appears before the vengeful Ryoga, what is her motive?

episodes.name: The Breaking Point
episodes.overview: Akane tags along for Ranma's training, while Ryoga works to master the deadly "The Breaking Point." How will their clash unfold when Akane gets involved?

episodes.name: Happosai Days Are Here Again
episodes.overview: The Tendo family hits the beach. As Happosai runs wild, Ranma tries to set him up with Cologne — but it seems they share a past tied to an heirloom.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: In a school for elite students, two teens form a complicated bond in the face of ruthless competition, unforgiving expectations and deceptive promises.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After living in a orphanage, Woo Seul-gi transfers to a top-ranking school hoping to find her father - and soon catches the eye of a popular student.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Facing a heartbreaking discovery, Seul-gi struggles to adjust to her demanding schoolwork, while her background makes her a target of bullyng.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Yu Je-i continues to show kindness towards Seul-gi and invites her to her private study space, drawing the two girls closer together.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: A furious Choi Gyung becomes suspicious when Je-i nominates Seul-gi as class monitor. Ju Ye-ri overhears a conversation about Je-i's former seatmate.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: While Seul-gi finds details of her family history on Je-i's phone, Choi Gyung looks into the connection between the two girls'past.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Students take drastic measures to beat the stress of midterms. Choi Gyung shares a discovery with Seul-gi, causing them to question Je-i's intentions.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Ye-ri makes a deal with Je-i's father, Yu Tae-jun, by using his secret against him. Seul-gi worries about a healt checkup following her exams.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Ye-ri steals Seul-gi's father's phone. As she tries to unlock it, the rest of the students head to the school festival.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: An attack at the festival causes panic at the school. Je-i comes to face with a figure from her past as they fight over the stolen cellphone.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: As the police investigate the school's drug problem, Seul-gi comes under suspicion. Je-i makes a deal while seeking to help Seul-gi.

episodes.name: Episode 11

episodes.overview: Eun Chae-ni and her quirky friends Son Gyeong-hun and Kang Ro-bin are baffled by their sudden abilities. A wary Lee Un-jeong confronts his doubts.

episodes.name: The Guardians of Haeseong City Part 2

episodes.overview: In a world where certain humans command mighty supernatural duos called Daemons, it is the birthright of "the children who sunder day and night"—twins Yuru and Asa—to rule over these powerful entities. Separated from a young age and unaware of the truth of th…

episodes.name: Right and Left
episodes.overview: Guided by Dera, Yuru flees from his pursuers and awakens the guardian deities of the village.

episodes.name: Dera and Hana
episodes.overview: Yuru learns the truth about his village and learns the rules of modern society as he rides down the mountain.

episodes.name: Jin and Yuru

episodes.name: Hare and Tortoise
episodes.overview: Yuru and his Daemons track the scent of Asa's blood to a warehouse, where they encounter Jin and his men.

episodes.name: The Kagemori Clan and the Unknown Assailants
episodes.overview: Yuru is reunited with Asa at the Kagemori mansion and asks her about their parents.

episodes.name: Asa and Break

episodes.name: Suspicion and Conviction

episodes.name: Embrace and Whisper

episodes.name: Long-Arm and Long-Leg

episodes.name: Big Brother and Little Brother

episodes.name: Daikyo and Shokyo

episodes.name: Family and Friends
episodes.overview: Yuru and Ken notice someone following them while looking for a place to practice shooting a bow.

episodes.name: Yuru and Danji
episodes.overview: Feeling betrayed by Danji, Yuru asks for space so he can think by himself.

episodes.name: Kagemori and Shingo
episodes.overview: Yuru and Dera head to the warehouses at night to meet Ivan.

episodes.name: Crybaby and Naughty Child
episodes.overview: The traitor attacks Asa while she's alone, but the Kagemoris have set a trap for him.

episodes.name: Fujin and Raijin
episodes.overview: At the Kagemori mansion, the traitor is captured. Meanwhile, Gonzo overpowers the Shingo clan.

episodes.name: Sword and Bow
episodes.overview: Asa rescues the hostages, and Yuru faces off against Ivan.

episodes.name: The Hunted and the Hunter
episodes.overview: After an intense battle, Ivan escapes. He teleports back to Shingo, who appears to be in trouble.

episodes.name: Zashiki-Warashi and Higashi Village

episodes.name: The Kagemori Brothers and the Kuroya Siblings
episodes.overview: Natsuki demands to know why Akio betrayed the Kagemori clan, but he offers no explanation.

episodes.name: Emotion and Reason
episodes.overview: Akio escapes from the Kagemoris, and Yuru comes down with a fever.

episodes.name: Higashi Village and Nishino Village
episodes.overview: Yuru dreams about the day bandits tried to kill him as a kid, and Asa blames herself for the gardener's death.

episodes.name: A Pitch Made in Heaven.
episodes.overview: Aviraaj grapples with the palace's dwindling finances. Sophia's presentation to the royal family is blindsided by a competitor with a pitch of her own.

episodes.name: A Swing and a Ms.

episodes.name: The Ex-Factor.

episodes.name: The Maharaja and the CEO.

episodes.name: The Maharaja who Loved.

episodes.name: Lights, Camera, AUCTION!
episodes.overview: A steadfast Sophia throws her efforts into a fundraiser for the palace. Padmaja confronts the mysterious Maurice, and family secrets come to light.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Morihito Otogi, a high schooler with the strength of an ogre, lives a peaceful life until his childhood friend and witch-in-training, Nico Wakatsuki, moves in; Nico, excited about their reunion, makes Morihito her familiar.

episodes.name: Witch's Return
episodes.overview: Morihito Otogi is a teenager with ogre strength. His childhood friend, Nico, is coming home after completing her witch training! Following an old pact, they begin living together. Can Morihito protect the clumsy Nico from a dire prophecy?

episodes.name: A Giant Rookie / Let's Go to a Diner / The Flying Classroom
episodes.overview: On the first day of school, Morihito urges Nico to hide the fact that she's a witch, but she tries using magic to secretly help him out in class.

episodes.name: Fresh Transparent Fashions for Spring / Witch's Delivery Service / Lost Dogs and the Patter of Rain
episodes.overview: Nico's mother sends Morihito a letter containing a worrying prophecy. Unable to decipher the meaning, Morihito spends the rest of the day on his toes.

episodes.name: Kanshi Kazamatsuri, the Tengu
episodes.overview: Kanshi explains that Nico's mother sent him to protect her. He and Morihito clash, but he takes a moment to warn him of an enemy within the school.

episodes.name: My Student Is My Favorite Artist / My Tummy Is Tender Today / Cat Scout
episodes.overview: Closet manga fan Ms. Makuwa loses her composure when she realizes that one of her students is a popular fan artist for her favorite series.

episodes.name: Under the Lovers' Tree
episodes.overview: After realizing Morihito is getting popular with the girls at school, Nico learns of a so-called lovers' tree near the site of an upcoming field trip.

episodes.name: Kan and Nico's Channel / The Tea Ceremony Is a Piece of Tea Cake
episodes.overview: Nico and Kanshi start an online video channel, but Morihito is annoyed by their lack of originality and asks their hipster classmate Magami for help.

episodes.name: Kanshi’s Part-Time Job Diaries ~The Superhero Show~ / Kanshi’s Part-Time Job Diaries ~The Side Job~
episodes.overview: When Kanshi can’t pay his share of the living expenses, Morihito hands him a flyer from an amusement park hiring performers for a superhero show.

episodes.name: Dear Kara / New Friends / Date with the Knight
episodes.overview: Nico and Morihito's classmate Kara asks them to restore a letter from her deceased mother, which her father put through a paper shredder.

episodes.name: Trope-tacular Student Council / A Stray Cat’s Bubble of Bliss
episodes.overview: After a student council vice president makes a dramatic entrance to forbid Nico from using magic, the council’s other larger-than-life members arrive.

episodes.name: Dogs and Raindrops (1)
episodes.overview: Kanshi saves Keigo from a bully who claims to be using a candy with a stimulant effect. A self-proclaimed witch appears before Nico and Morihito.

episodes.name: Dogs and Raindrops (2)
episodes.overview: A transformed Keigo attacks the isolated Morihito. Surrounded by Wolf's "Dogs," Kanshi and Nico devise a plan to locate and neutralize the warlock.

episodes.name: Keigo Magami, the Werewolf / Kind Tiger, Proud Wolf / Easy Spices for Enthralling Cooking
episodes.overview: Morihito and the others decide to get rid of any crescent-shaped objects to minimize the risk of Keigo transforming into a werewolf in the house.

episodes.name: Uron Mirage Chapter 119: The Phasey Hunt, Part 4 / Diary of My Favorite Artist
episodes.overview: In Episode 119 of Uron Mirage, swordsmen Utsuro, Oboro, Sagiri and Zack decide to split up and search the buildings of an abandoned research facility.

episodes.name: Summer Demon
episodes.overview: Ibuki's newest prophecy advises seeking a family that dispels evil. Nico and her friends set out in search, treating the journey like a summer trip.

episodes.name: Miharu Kiryu, the Vampire / Missing Parasol / I'm So Glad You're Here
episodes.overview: Vampire Miharu moves into the Otogi house, but as a night person with different energy needs, he may struggle to adjust to communal living.

episodes.name: We Got Trapped in a Death Game, But It Sucked / Long Long a Go Go
episodes.overview: Morihito and the other guys awake in an unknown place. A mysterious figure tells them they must play a game — and that Nico is being held hostage.

episodes.name: Kara and Shiki / Mega Marble Mania Madness / Scramble Scrap Squad
episodes.overview: Nico and Kukumi help Kara out at the shrine run by her father. When Nico casts a spell to make a paper cat move around, Kara gets an idea.

episodes.name: Letter from a Friend
episodes.overview: When tidying the house, Morihito finds a letter Nico wrote to him when they were kids. Nico shares her memories of those days with Nemu and the guys.

episodes.name: The Lost Wolf and the Stray Cat
episodes.overview: Noticing that Keigo seems sad, Nico gives him a ring imbued with a levitation spell. As he secretly trains to use it, Nemu approaches him.

episodes.name: Secret Urges / Keiko's Carefree Style / Jekyll Visits the Otogi House
episodes.overview: As Keigo wonders why his channel isn't getting more views, Nico casts a spell on him that she believes will help make his videos more interesting.

episodes.name: The Incredible Shrinking Adventure / The Hamazaki Fall Bread Festival / Lucky Birthday
episodes.overview: While sharing donuts with Kara and Morihito, Nico decides to shrink herself and Morihito down so they can experience eating a giant pastry.

episodes.name: Our First Offline Meetup / Fave Artist File: Creative Surge / Fave Artist File: Crazy Event Arc
episodes.overview: When Kukumi mentions that she will be meeting a friend from social media in person for the first time, a worried Ms. Makuwa decides to tail her.

episodes.name: Moi’s Denim Devotion / Date With the Guide
episodes.overview: When Morihito declares it's time to give his favorite pair of jeans a second wash, Miharu asks to know more about denim — much to the others' chagrin.

episodes.name: Freshman Witch and Her Familiars
episodes.overview: Needing an attraction for the upcoming school festival, Nico's class decides to use her quirky spells to run a café with a spooky theme.

episodes.name: Mi-ji, Yet Unknown
episodes.overview: Lee Ho-su returns home and runs into Yu Mi-ji, who's flailing through life. He convinces her to visit her twin, Yu Mi-rae, who is quietly suffering.

episodes.name: Review and Reassess
episodes.overview: Mi-ji finds Mi-rae's corporate job dull — until she accepts a difficult project. Meanwhile, Mi-rae coasts through farm life, butting heads with her boss.

episodes.name: Knock, Knock! Please Open Your Heart
episodes.overview: Mi-ji stops at nothing to persuade the restaurant owner to sell her shop. Meanwhile, Ho-su deals with being iced out after angering his boss.

episodes.name: My Nemesis
episodes.overview: Deflated by unemployment, Ho-su searches for his next move. Meanwhile, Mi-ji sets up a crucial meeting between her company and the landlord.

episodes.name: Alone with You
episodes.overview: Ho-su's sudden revelation leaves Mi-ji unsure about their dynamic. Meanwhile, Mi-rae struggles over swirling rumors about her and Han Se-jin.

episodes.name: The Silent, Ever-Present Fool
episodes.overview: Park Ji-yun increasingly pursues Ho-su, who's still processing Mi-ji's drunken confession. After abruptly quitting her job, Mi-rae becomes despondent.

episodes.name: A Child Underneath It All
episodes.overview: Ho-su makes a surprise visit to Mi-rae, demanding answers. But when an incident draws Mi-ji back to their hometown, their web of lies deepens.

episodes.name: An Unconventional Whole
episodes.overview: Now aware of each other's feelings, Mi-ji and Ho-su begin an awkward romance. Later, a shocking appearance at work leaves Mi-ji stunned.

episodes.name: Back Again, Once More
episodes.overview: Mi-ji and Mi-rae swap back places—forcing Mi-ji to temporarily move in with Ho-su. Mi-rae returns to her company, only to confront her past yet again.

episodes.name: Reading You
episodes.overview: With her motivation reignited, Mi-rae decides to fight back. While job hunting in Seoul, Mi-ji and Ho-su uncover the truth about Kim Ro-sa.

episodes.name: At the End of the Sentence
episodes.overview: Ho-su's health takes a sudden turn, forcing him to reevaluate his relationship with Mi-ji. Meanwhile, Mi-rae takes a bold step toward the future.

episodes.name: The End Is a New Beginning
episodes.overview: Mi-ji and Mi-rae make it through a difficult chapter, finding new purpose on the other side—and confronting new challenges, both alone and together.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Eun-ho, a free-spirited gumiho, avoids good deeds and romance to steer clear of becoming human. Her carefree life takes an unexpected turn after a fateful encounter with a self-absorbed soccer star.

episodes.name: An Inevitable Event
episodes.overview: Eun Ho lives a glamorous life granting the wishes of the wealthy. Until one day, she crosses paths with Kang Si Yeol, a high school soccer player.

episodes.name: The Hour of Transfer
episodes.overview: Without explanation, Eun Ho's power drains away after her encounter with Si Yeol. She soon appears before him again, demanding that he make a wish.

episodes.name: The Rise and Fall
episodes.overview: After giving away his wish to Hyun U Seok, Si Yeol enrages Eun Ho — and wakes up to unintended consequences as he tries to understand his new reality.

episodes.name: The Price of Good Deeds
episodes.overview: Desperate for his life back, Si-yeol pleads with Woo-seok to reverse the wish. But Jang Do-cheol kidnaps Si-yeol - putting him and Eun-ho in peril.

episodes.name: The Changer, the Changed, and the Lacking
episodes.overview: Eun-ho and Si-yeol head to the mountains in search of another fox that could help. But they encounter a figure from her past that shocks her.

episodes.name: The False Kindness
episodes.overview: Si-yeol and Eun-ho clash over Geum-ho's plan, each trying to persuade the other that their way is better — and what it means to be human.

episodes.name: The Revenge of Memory
episodes.overview: After surviving a near disaster, Eun-ho and Si-yeol begin to develop a bond. Soon, they try to turn their luck around by stepping up their good deeds.

episodes.name: The Hobby Called Love
episodes.overview: Eun-ho's confession and subsequent actions leave Si-yeol feeling overwhelmed. But after spending quality time together, they end up going on a date.

episodes.name: Love Attack
episodes.overview: After their kiss, Eun-ho and Si-yeol navigate the awkward aftermath. Meanwhile, Do-cheol uses Woo-seok to get one step closer to Eun-ho.

episodes.name: From Chance to Destiny
episodes.overview: Pagun approaches Eun-ho with a sobering truth about Si-yeol and Woo-seok's fate — forcing her to find a way to change destiny as her feelings evolve.

episodes.name: The Way of Humans
episodes.overview: During a date at a soccer game, Eun-ho runs into Lee Yoon — shocking Si-yeol. Meanwhile, Do-cheol uses Geum-ho to obtain the fox bead.

episodes.name: Love Without Regret
episodes.overview: Eun-ho makes a fateful decision to save a dying Si-yeol. Now facing eternal separation, will they ever find their happily ever after?

episodes.name: Rintaro and Kaoruko
episodes.overview: While helping at his family's patisserie, Rintaro meets Kaoruko. He fears his appearance has scared her off — but she returns the next day to see him.

episodes.name: Chidori and Kikyo
episodes.overview: Tensions between the two schools escalate during a commotion at Chidori's gates. Later, Rintaro finds a surprise visitor waiting at the patisserie.

episodes.name: A Kind Person
episodes.overview: Desperate to improve their grades, Rintaro and Shohei cram in the library. There, Rintaro runs into Kaoruko, but their tender moment gets interrupted.

episodes.name: Warmth of the Heart
episodes.overview: Though Rintaro becomes more comfortable with Kaoruko during their study session, he faces unexpectedly strong opposition to their growing bond.

episodes.name: Premonition of a New Beginning
episodes.overview: Pressure mounts as Rintaro's friends discover a note from Kaoruko hidden in his notebook. Saku's frustration towards Rintaro's reticence grows.

episodes.name: Self-Loathing / I Love You!
episodes.overview: It's an important night of confessions, apologies and cherished memories when Subaru and Kaoruko catch up at the park where they used to play as kids.

episodes.name: Coolest Guy Ever
episodes.overview: Noticing Rintaro's strange behavior, Shohei, Saku and Ayato follow him after school and try to eavesdrop on his meeting with Kaoruko and Subaru.

episodes.name: The Meaning of These Feelings
episodes.overview: Despite the awkwardness, Rintaro manages to introduce his friends to the girls. Later, Kaoruko makes a bold suggestion on how Rintaro could repay her.

episodes.name: Blond Hair and Pierced Ears
episodes.overview: While Rintaro struggles with his tangled emotions about Kaoruko, he invites his friends over to his home — but two unexpected visitors shake things up.

episodes.name: Summer Storm
episodes.overview: To prepare for their finals, the six Chidori and Kikyo students hold a joint study session. Later, Shohei makes a sharp observation about Rintaro.

episodes.name: A Morsel of Warmth
episodes.overview: Kaoruko's birthday is in two weeks, and Rintaro is unsure of a gift until his mother gives valuable advice. Can he bake the perfect cake for her?

episodes.name: Bewilderment at the Beachside
episodes.overview: While everyone else is having fun at the beach, Subaru seems down. When prodded, she reveals her worries and makes a request to the four Chidori boys.

episodes.name: Kaoruko and Rintaro
episodes.overview: With things still left unspoken between them, Rintaro arranges to meet Kaoruko and express his true feelings. Kaoruko has her own thoughts to share.

episodes.name: Khamoshi
episodes.overview: In Mumbai, a girl named Anamika Prakash dies by suicide, leaving behind a note stating that she was raped. How will the police investigate and solve this case?

episodes.name: Dafan
episodes.overview: Anirudh and Shantanu battle for the legal rights to the land belonging to the Tripathi family. During the investigation, a skeleton is unearthed. Whose skeleton is it, and what will the police uncover?

episodes.name: The Cold File Case Indore 2024
episodes.overview: Zubeida Sheikh is severely burned in a cylinder blast at house no. 777 while her husband, Ubaid, is at the office. Was this an unfortunate accident or a carefully orchestrated act of crime?

episodes.name: Lapata
episodes.overview: In Ahmedabad, Gujarat, Dr. Pooja approaches the police to file a missing person report for her patient, Jahnvi Shah. Where could Jahnvi be, and what happened to her?

episodes.name: Mayajaal
episodes.overview: In Mumbai, Maharashtra, Sumit Thakkar has gone missing, yet his family hasn’t reached out about the investigation. Meanwhile, Ravi murders his girlfriend and flees with cash and jewellery. What could be the connection in this case?

episodes.name: Eun-su
episodes.overview: When a watch goes missing, Jo Eun-su spots a mysterious customer and boldly tracks him down. She then visits her mother, who shows troubling signs at home.

episodes.name: Hui-su
episodes.overview: Jo Hui-su endures years of relentless abuse from Noh Jin-pyo, despite attempts to escape. When she reaches a breaking point, Eun-su steps into action.

episodes.name: Eun-su, Hui-su and Jin-pyo
episodes.overview: After witnessing Hui-su's mistreatment, Eun-su teams up with her to stop Jin-pyo — recruiting one of Jin So-baek's employees to execute their plan.

episodes.name: Eun-su and Hui-su
episodes.overview: A confrontation with Jin-pyo forces Eun-su and Hui-su to hurry and cover their tracks. But in trying to be thorough, they navigate several obstacles.

episodes.name: Eun-su and Hui-su and Jin So-baek
episodes.overview: With their problem seemingly over, Eun-su and Hui-su attempt to rebuild their lives. But trouble soon finds Eun-su — and So-baek unexpectedly appears.

episodes.name: Eun-su, Hui-su and Jang Kang
episodes.overview: An unexpected visitor terrifies Hui-su, forcing her and Eun-su to handle a new crisis. Meanwhile, So-baek begins to question their strange behavior.

episodes.name: Eun-su, Hui-su and Jin-young
episodes.overview: With Noh Jin-young on Eun-su and Hui-su's tails, So-baek offers his help. But Eun-su takes matters into her own hands, putting everyone in jeopardy.

episodes.name: Eun-su, Hui-su and Us
episodes.overview: Pressured by Jin-young, Hui-su does the unthinkable. Can Eun-su find a way out of their hellish situation and finally break the cycle?

episodes.name: Jane Doe
episodes.overview: After Sarah Kim is discovered dead, Jeong Yeo-jin recounts her memories of the elusive woman to Park Mu-gyeong — who suspects something is askew.

episodes.name: Sarah Kim
episodes.overview: Mu-gyeong probes Sarah's past through Woo Hyo-eun and finds that her "Sarah Kim" is nothing like the woman others recall — and Boudoir looks even shadier.

episodes.name: Mok Ga-hui
episodes.overview: Sarah's buried past surfaces: a down-on-her-luck woman with aspirations for luxury, who'll stop at nothing to reach her goal — no matter the cost.

episodes.name: Kim Eun-jae
episodes.overview: Mu-gyeong presses Kang Ji-hwon about his link to Sarah, and a tangled history begins to emerge — one that also leads to power broker Hong Seong-shin.

episodes.name: Boudoir
episodes.overview: Determined to put Sarah away, Mu-gyeong prepares to go public with the case — only to find that every new glimpse of "Sarah Kim" makes his path less clear.

episodes.name: Unregistered Person
episodes.overview: Mu-gyeong races to lock Sarah away for murder before time runs out — turning to Choi Chae-u for help, even if trusting her may cost more than he expects.

episodes.name: Kim Mi-jeong
episodes.overview: Mu-gyeong tries to shake Sarah by going after what she guards most: Boudoir's name. Pushed to the edge, she drops a new name into the case.

episodes.name: The Art of Sarah
episodes.overview: As the clock runs down, Sarah fights to protect everything she's built — and Mu-gyeong follows her ever-shifting story, hoping to finally reach the truth.

episodes.name: Oxfordshire
episodes.overview: The lives of the kingfishers, otters, and other animals in a river garden. Life here seems idyllic, but all are at the mercy of seasonal floods.

episodes.name: Bristol
episodes.overview: The hidden lives of foxes, hedgehogs, blue tits, and frogs, each making a life for themselves in a small urban garden in Bristol.

episodes.name: The Lake District
episodes.overview: The hidden struggles of swallows, field mice, newts, and moles as they race to breed in a beautiful country garden in Cumbria.

episodes.name: The Wye Valley
episodes.overview: How tawny owls, badgers, dormice, and bumblebees have made a home in a beautiful woodland garden hidden at the bottom of a steep-sided Welsh valley.

episodes.name: The Western Highlands
episodes.overview: How a remote garden on Scotland’s west coast has become an oasis for barn owls and pine martens as they battle the elements to feed, breed, and survive.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Lady Cho masks her unease when Lord Yoo takes a young concubine for an heir. Later, she writes to her cousin Cho Won with an idea.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Lady Cho and Cho Won, the era's most notorious seducer, begin a dangerous game. They set their sights on a virtuous woman who may not bend so easily.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Cho Won approaches Hui-yeon directly, stirring her grief and testing her faith. He then provokes Lady Cho with a move that could give him the upper hand.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Cho Won once hid his longing for Lady Cho with nights spent with courtesans, yet the void remained. As he pursues Hui-yeon, his facade begins to fade.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Lady Cho exploits So-ok's secret feelings for another man. Meanwhile, complicated emotions overwhelm Cho Won as his relationship with Hui-yeon deepens.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Lady Cho warns Cho Won that the bet will stain his honor and family name — but he vows to see their dangerous game through as feelings grow.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Cho Won and Hui-yeon grow closer as they enjoy a brief respite together away from the public eye — until a royal order threatens their peace.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: As the scheme spirals out of control, Lady Cho faces a reckoning with Cho Won and Hui-yeon. How far will she go to see her plan through to the end?

episodes.name: Threshold
episodes.overview: Serious about corporate life, Kim Nak-su sets his sights on upward mobility — but finds himself weighed down by favored juniors and office politics.

episodes.name: Caught in the Middle
episodes.overview: Nak-su's ruthless ambition breeds tension for those around him, including his family. Soon, a sudden corporate scandal makes him HR's target.

episodes.name: MVP
episodes.overview: Nak-su's corporate disaster worsens as he scrambles for damage control — forcing Baek Jeong-tae to make a decisive choice about his career.

episodes.name: Hanging by a Thread
episodes.overview: Forced into a career crisis, Nak-su tries to make the best out of his situation. But he soon faces Jeong-tae — who delivers a momentous blow.

episodes.name: Serving My Own Bowl
episodes.overview: Now officially demoted, Nak-su agonizes over a daily grind that feels punishing. But just when he can't take it anymore, he finds a glimmer of hope.

episodes.name: Lifeline
episodes.overview: Nak-su, full of new energy, pushes to return to headquarters. Meanwhile, his family faces changes unfolding in their own lives that test their bonds.

episodes.name: Caught in the Downpour
episodes.overview: As Nak-su's behavior grows erratic, he manages rising employee anxiety amid a concerning company-wide notice — forcing him to make a bold decision.

episodes.name: All In
episodes.overview: As Nak-su tries to adjust to his bleak new reality, he searches for ways to get back on his feet — betting everything he has on a risky new venture.

episodes.name: Worst Enemy
episodes.overview: Even as stress takes a physical toll, Nak-su hides his struggles from those around him — enduring humiliation to survive and keep up appearances.

episodes.name: Patient in Unit 102
episodes.overview: When the truth comes to light, Park Ha-jin confronts Nak-su over betrayal. While apart from his wife, he finds courage to contact his estranged brother.

episodes.name: B+
episodes.overview: Nak-su's pride crumbles as he endures humiliating moments at his brother's workplace. Then Baek Jeong-tae reappears — with an irresistible offer.

episodes.name: Rain Shower
episodes.overview: With peace in mind, Nak-su returns to his old company in a completely new role — standing tall before his former colleagues with renewed pride.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: The National Assembly and the Minister of Education passes the Amendment to the Act on the Protection of Teachers' Rights. With the passage of the law, a new government organization, the Educational Rights Protection Bureau, is formed. Na Hwa-jin belongs to t…

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Inspector Na Hwa-jin steps into the chaos and takes control of a school plagued by the spoiled son of a powerful politician — to teach him a lesson.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: With unassuming Bong Geun-dae on his side, Hwa-jin uses his special ops skills to handle a school gang and defend a student who just wants to study.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: When a teen influencer spreads false claims about her teachers, the team's loose-cannon Inspector Im Han-rim steps in to set the record straight.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Choi Gang-seok weathers a political attack on his bureau. Hwa-jin's team visits an elite school to uncover why a student attacked a respected teacher.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: When an elementary school teacher's spirit wears down under pressure, Hwa-jin steps in to be her substitute — turning the tables to solve the case.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Four juvenile delinquents think they're above the law — until the team takes an interest in their extracurricular crimes and gives a harsh reality check.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Geun-dae goes undercover to help a father find his gambling addict son. To undermine the bureau politically, Hwang Gi-tae visits a juvenile inmate.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: After a pre-med student collapses in class, Hwa-jin investigates his obsessive mother, whose access to illicit pills hints at a larger conspiracy.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: To help a student escape his exploitative friends, Han-rim adopts a new persona to join his circle. Cho Gyu-cheol's return puts the bureau in danger.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: After public backlash hits the bureau, Hwa-jin and his team go rogue to expose a deadly conspiracy led by a violent student-run gang.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Yeon Tae-seo heads to the countryside with his younger brother to stay with their grandparents. There, he meets Mo Eun-a and the two form a special bond.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Tae-seo and Eun-a's relationship continues to blossom, progressing from romance to intimacy. But adulthood soon separates them, testing their connection.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: From school to relationships and work, Tae-seo struggles to juggle his responsibilities. Meanwhile, Eun-a’s career begins to reshape her life.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Ten years later, Tae-seo and Eun-a live completely different lives. One day, they cross paths again by chance — stirring old feelings.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Eun-a and Tae-seo slowly settle back into their rekindled rhythm. Meanwhile, they both navigate challenging personal and family issues.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Eun-a and Tae-seo slowly settle back into their rekindled rhythm. Meanwhile, they both navigate challenging personal and family issues.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Despite help from Bae Seong-chan, Eun-a struggles to find her place in the world. Tae-seo deals with unease as he confronts his family’s health issues.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Eun-a makes a decision that forces her and Tae-seo apart again. Soon after, a major misunderstanding leaves him heartbroken and betrayed.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Before long, Tae-seo's life returns to how it was before he reunited with Eun-a. But the question of why they broke up still lingers in his mind.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Eun-a decides where she will go, while Tae-seo decides how to say goodbye. Will their love endure -- even until the very last moment?

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Six months ago, Hikaru vanished for a week. Now, as his best friend Yoshiki senses something amiss and confronts him, the harrowing truth emerges.

episodes.name: Replacement
episodes.overview: Yoshiki confronts Hikaru about his suspicions and discovers the terrifying truth. Even though they try to live normally, eerie incidents begin to occur.

episodes.name: Suspicion
episodes.overview: While Yoshiki and Hikaru accompany their classmates to a creepy mountain trail, a mysterious man arrives at Kubitachi Village and begins investigating.

episodes.name: Denial
episodes.overview: Recalling childhood memories with Hikaru, Yoshiki continues to struggle with his complex emotions. Desperate, he reaches out to Kurebayashi.

episodes.name: Summer Festival
episodes.overview: As Yoshiki attends the summer festival with Hikaru, the village elders fret over the recent death and Tanaka ends up with more questions than answers.

episodes.name: Wig Ghost
episodes.overview: When Yoshiki's sister spots a creepy clump of hair in the bathroom, Hikaru visits the Tsujinaka home to investigate — but things take a deadly turn.

episodes.name: Asako
episodes.overview: Yoshiki and his classmates discuss a story their teacher assigned them. Later, at a sleepover, Asako's sharp observations put her in grave danger.

episodes.name: Determination
episodes.overview: After the sobering realization that Hikaru is truly dangerous, Yoshiki decides that he must act and invites his best friend to skip school together.

episodes.name: Contact
episodes.overview: Yoshiki and Hikaru investigate Nonuki-sama and its link to Kubitachi's history. While at the library, they get an important lead from a surprising source.

episodes.name: Old Man Takeda
episodes.overview: Kurebayashi shares her knowledge about impurities with the boys. Later, the elder Takeda loses his temper over Hikaru's ignorance of the Indo's history.

episodes.name: Truth
episodes.overview: The boys' surprise encounter with Tanaka lands them in the hospital. When they return to school, Yoshiki pieces together the truth behind Nonuki-sama.

episodes.name: Indo's Sin
episodes.overview: Though hesitant, Yoshiki asks his father about the Indo family's murky past and secret ritual. Later, Hikaru loses control at school and feels deeply shaken.

episodes.name: Its Place
episodes.overview: While everyone else attends the school assembly, Asako finds Hikaru wandering the halls. Alone at the beach, Hikaru reveals his final plans to Yoshiki.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Set during a fictionalized Joseon Dynasty, it follows Gu-cheon, an arrogant ghost-slayer who can walk between worlds, and Saeng-gang, a lowly court lady who hears the dead, as they team up to save the last royal heir.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After a mysterious death, the king summons the spirit slayer Gu-cheon to banish the pond spirit. Saeng-gang, who hears the dead, also appears before him.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: After a close call while pursuing the pond spirit, Gu-cheon makes a pact with Saeng-gang. Later, they uncover the truth behind the salt storehouse ghost.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The king orders Gu-cheon to save the prince — or die. Forced to enter the spirit realm, he comes face-to-face with the ghost of a former royal guard.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Gu-cheon and Saeng-gang attempt to seal the pond spirit for good. Still suspicious about the crown princes' deaths, Gu-cheon returns to Saeng-gang.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Gu-cheon escapes danger with Saeng-gang's help. As the king falls ill, Gu-cheon fights the evil spirit — only for a guardian spirit to stand in his way.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: During Gu-cheon's fight, Saeng-gang comes under threat — bringing them closer to the truth. But Gu-cheon loses his sight, putting their mission at risk.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: The king and queen dowager clash over the tragedies as resentful spirits close in. Gu-cheon and Saeng-gang steel themselves for a final confrontation.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Chaos engulfs the palace as the vengeful spirit moves to devour everything in its path. Can Gu-cheon and Saeng-gang stop him before it's too late?

episodes.name: The Snake
episodes.overview: In 1981, Sunil Kumar Gupta joins Tihar Jail as a warden and learns more about its workings from DSP Rajesh Tomar. A surprise inspection leads to chaos.

episodes.name: Gallows
episodes.overview: As a death warrant is issued against prisoners Ranga and Billa, journalist Pratibha Sen seeks to interview them. Sunil makes a statement to the media.

episodes.name: Macho
episodes.overview: An investigation into a jailbreak holds Mangat responsible. Meanwhile, Sunil learns more about the inmates who call Tihar home.

episodes.name: Team Player
episodes.overview: When an incident sparks a gang war, Tomar urges the Haddis and Tyagis to reconcile. Dahiya harbors a secret that later leads to a brawl with Sunil.

episodes.name: Prison Food
episodes.overview: Sunil pushes for legal aid reforms for prisoners, but an irate Tomar decides to punish him, even as both grapple with personal troubles.

episodes.name: The Blanket
episodes.overview: The prisoners stage a hunger strike amidst poor living conditions. A high-profile inmate faces execution. Sunil makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.name: Double Life Sentence
episodes.overview: As nationwide riots break out, the prison falls into disarray and Tomar's leadership is questioned. Sobhraj asks Sunil for a favor.

episodes.name: I'm Here
episodes.overview: Koichi is convinced he'll never manage to become a hero, until he meets someone with an odd take on justice.

episodes.name: Takeoff
episodes.overview: Some people frown upon vigilante activities, but the least they could do is remember The Crawler's name.

episodes.name: Bee
episodes.overview: The drug Trigger is wreaking havoc all over town, but figuring out who's dealing it is easier said than done.

episodes.name: Top Runner
episodes.overview: What happens when pro heroes and vigilantes target the same villain? Is it possible to work as a team?

episodes.name: Judgment
episodes.overview: Koichi and Pop each find themselves considerably influenced by various events from their pasts.

episodes.name: Crossing Lines
episodes.overview: Hachisuka tries manipulating Stendhal into fighting targets of her choosing, but can anyone control him?

episodes.name: Makoto/Truth
episodes.overview: Makoto offers to help a struggling Koichi with his studies, but she requests something surprising in return.

episodes.name: Major
episodes.overview: The American hero Captain Celebrity sets up shop in Japan, and it isn't long before trouble begins.

episodes.name: Mom Descends!
episodes.overview: Koichi's mother is in town, and he's willing to take drastic measures so that she'll let him stay in Tokyo.

episodes.name: Event Announcement!
episodes.overview: Pop receives a request to perform at an upcoming local event, and she finds herself in need of guidance.

episodes.name: The Day Of
episodes.overview: Preparing for Narufest proves to be an uphill battle. Will teamwork be what gets everyone to the finish line?

episodes.name: Goodbye to Dad
episodes.overview: There's trouble when the power goes out at Narufest, all while Knuckleduster fights a very personal battle.

episodes.name: What a Man Takes with Him
episodes.overview: Narufest turned out to be a huge success, but our vigilantes must decide whether it's time for some changes.

episodes.name: Day-Tripping Down to Naniwa!
episodes.overview: Pop gets invited to a mascot-idol event in Osaka, and Koichi accompanies her.

episodes.name: Crabtastic Rampage!
episodes.overview: Koichi and Pop get dragged into an incident when a Trigger dealer unleashes a cast of rampaging robotic crabs!

episodes.name: Public and Private
episodes.overview: Tsukauchi's investigation into the Trigger network has hit a wall, and he turns to All Might for advice.

episodes.name: A Rational Man
episodes.overview: Koichi's in double trouble, facing down a villain who might clobber him, and Eraser Head who might arrest him!

episodes.name: The Man Returns
episodes.overview: Koichi and Pop get into more Trigger trouble, and we learn where Knuckleduster has been.

episodes.name: Rain and Clouds
episodes.overview: Koichi encounters Eraser Head, who reminiscences about his student days.

episodes.name: Glass Sky
episodes.overview: When he was young, Aizawa's inexperience and awkward Quirk forced him to grapple with his self-esteem.

episodes.name: A Sky with No Rain Left
episodes.overview: When Aizawa was a younger, he and his friend Shirakumo were forced into a fight with a giant villain...

episodes.name: Farewell Party!
episodes.overview: With his legal problems soon to be taken care of, Captain Celebrity makes plans to return to America.

episodes.name: Zero Hour
episodes.overview: Captain Celebrity's farewell party begins, but the Scarred Man has some unpleasant surprises in store...

episodes.name: Balloon Soul
episodes.overview: Captain Celebrity tries to save the Sky Egg with Koichi's help, while reminiscing on what brought him here.

episodes.name: This Is a Hero!
episodes.overview: The Sky Egg falls as Captain Celebrity hits his limit, with only one person capable of saving the day...

episodes.name: Graduation and Career Path
episodes.overview: Captain Celebrity returns to the United States, and Koichi must decide what to do with his future.

episodes.name: Course Nº 1 Gochujang Butter Bibimbap
episodes.overview: After winning a French cooking competition, Yeon Ji-young time-travels through an old cookbook and clashes with King Yi Heon upon arrival.

episodes.name: Course N° 2 Sous Vide Cuisine
episodes.overview: Held captive in harsh conditions, Ji-young prepares a feast to win her freedom — but even her talent can't save her when a crisis puts her life in peril.

episodes.name: Course N° 3 Haute Cuisine
episodes.overview: Ji-young becomes Yi Heon's new chief royal cook after impressing him with her French cuisine. But Kang Mok-ju, consumed by jealousy, plots against her.

episodes.name: Course N° 4 **** and Spinach Doenjang Soup
episodes.overview: A high-stakes royal cooking competition awaits Ji-young and her fate at court hangs in the balance. Later, a troubled Yi Heon drunkenly summons her.

episodes.name: Course N° 5 Snowflake Schnitzel
episodes.overview: After an intimate moment together, Yi Heon begins rejecting Ji-young's meals — but soon find their minds wandering toward each other amid the distance.

episodes.name: Course N° 6 Black Sesame Macaron
episodes.overview: When the Ming envoy demands a cooking contest, Ji-young rises to the challenge to represent Joseon — and win what Yi Heon has promised her.

episodes.name: Course N° 7 Dongnae Pajeon on a Rainy Day
episodes.overview: In order to gain an edge in the cooking competition, Ji-young sets out to create a unique pot. However, finding the right craftsman proves difficult.

episodes.name: Course N° 8 Rice Wine Beef Bourguignon
episodes.overview: Barely making it to the competition, Ji-young begins cooking — only to find her crucial ingredients missing. Can she overcome the crisis?

episodes.name: Course N° 9 Pressure-Cooked Ogyetang
episodes.overview: Yi Heon shocks everyone by asking chefs to judge their own dishes. As time slips away in the intense battle, Ji-young considers plan B for her recipe.

episodes.name: Course N° 10 Joseon Restaurant
episodes.overview: Yi Heon and Ji-young's bond deepens as he fights to prove her innocence — but can they uncover the cause of Grand Prince Jinmyeong's illness in time?

episodes.name: Course N° 11 Soy Meat Gujeolpan & Eggplant Pie
episodes.overview: Yi Heon unravels after discovering the truth about his mother, the deposed queen — leaving Ji Yeong to fight against history repeating itself.

episodes.name: Course N° 12 Hwanseban
episodes.overview: Trapped by Grand Prince Jesan's coup, Yi Heon and Ji Yeong fight to survive. But can their love endure against the forces of history and time?

episodes.name: Induction
episodes.overview: Despite a rocky start at Yullim Law Firm, Kang Hyo-min joins Yoon Seok-hoon's team — and impresses him when she finds a discrepancy in their first case.

episodes.name: Hot Water Is the Test for Tea and Love
episodes.overview: Seok-hoon and Hyo-min take on a case involving a man who broke into a fertility clinic — earning trust in a tangled battle of love, health and injustice.

episodes.name: Butterfly Chrysalis
episodes.overview: A complex no-contact car accident involving a child sends Seok-hoon and Hyo-min digging for clues. Seok-hoon receives a bold offer from Yullim's founder.

episodes.name: Lex Talionis
episodes.overview: While defending a CEO accused of child abuse, Hyo-min and Seok-hoon clash over their morals. Soon, Seok-hoon's sudden disappearance worries her.

episodes.name: Salieri's Monologue
episodes.overview: Hyo-min takes on her first solo case over a painting's copyright, leaning on Seok-hoon for mentorship — until a mid-trial revelation shakes her stride.

episodes.name: Love Is an Impairment
episodes.overview: Seok-hoon and Hyo-min handle a tricky consent case for a client suing her ex. Meanwhile, Kwon Na-yeon's sudden appointment creates waves at Yullim.

episodes.name: Love in All Its Colors
episodes.overview: After a man is arrested for aiding his wife's assisted suicide, Seok-hoon takes on the case. Meanwhile, Yullim's new performance system sparks fury.

episodes.name: Wonder Woman
episodes.overview: At Yullim, Ko Tae-seop's plot to oust Seok-hoon escalates. When a famous news anchor is charged with assaulting her husband, Hyo-min digs for the truth.

episodes.name: The Right to Life
episodes.overview: Seok-hoon and Hyo-min defend a doctor who faces possible murder charges for failing to save a man she abhors. Meanwhile, Na-yeon looks into a shady deal.

episodes.name: Bystander
episodes.overview: After a murder suspect blames her for the crime, Hyo-min hunts for their connection. Na-yeon and Seok-hoon pursue the truth behind Yullim's CEO's ploy.

episodes.name: The Two-Legged Beast
episodes.overview: When a personal privacy case spirals, Seok Hun's fury grows as the client crosses the line. Meanwhile, Na Yeon uncovers proof to back her suspicions.

episodes.name: Beyond Love's Vow
episodes.overview: A divorce case turns complicated when the court contemplates their unusual relationship. Seok Hun and Na Yeon make their final move for justice.

episodes.name: A Taste of Familiarity
episodes.overview: On a quest to earn a three-star review, Han Beom-woo traces a copycat of his dish to a humble restaurant—where he clashes with its owner, Mo Yeon-joo.

episodes.name: The Stubbornness of Jungjae
episodes.overview: Yeon-joo signs a deal with Beom-woo—under certain conditions. They soon fight over every detail, from hiring to plating, until they find their groove.

episodes.name: Partially Soaked
episodes.overview: As false rumours of Jungjae's failure spread through town, Yeon-joo and Beom-woo hit snag after snag—until a frightening incident shakes the restaurant.

episodes.name: Love is Like a Spark
episodes.overview: As the Jungjae team preps for the food truck competition, Yeon-joo and Beom-woo clash over their approach—but soon join forces for a shot at victory.

episodes.name: Neither Hot nor Cold
episodes.overview: After a tender moment between Yeon-joo and Beom-woo, an unexpected figure appears. The Jungjae team prepares for an international wedding tasting.

episodes.name: Jungjae Manual
episodes.overview: Beom-woo, Jin Myung-sook and Shin Choon-seung struggle to fill Yeon-joo's void when she unexpectedly disappears—until Beom-woo sets out to find her.

episodes.name: The Restaurant I Loved
episodes.overview: In Japan, Beom-woo and Yeon-joo grow closer as she prepares a recipe for her former boss. Beom-woo confronts Jeon Min about his intentions with Yeon-joo.

episodes.name: Scorched Recipe
episodes.overview: As Beom-woo scrambles to clean up a mess of his own making, the Jungjae team heads out on a trip—and his feelings for Yeon-joo deepen even more.

episodes.name: Imperfect Cooking
episodes.overview: The shocking truth shatters Yeon-joo and Beom-woo's relationship, leaving them both devastated. But soon, they receive surprising news about Jungjae.

episodes.name: Tastefully Yours
episodes.overview: Jungjae goes head-to-head with Motto in a showdown of taste. Can Beom-woo and Yeon-joo overcome their differences to come out on top?

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When he suddenly gains the ability to see ghosts, a quiet lawyer recruits an ambitious rival to help his quirky spectral clients find corporeal justice.

episodes.name: A Haunted Law Office
episodes.overview: Rejected by law firms, Shin I-rang rents an eerie old office and lands his first job: a medical malpractice case for a ghost and his grieving wife.

episodes.name: An Unholy Alliance
episodes.overview: After ghostly client Lee Gang-pung possesses him, I-rang reconsiders their arrangement — until a crisis renews his conviction.

episodes.name: Death Of High School Girl
episodes.overview: The ghost of a teenage girl haunts I-rang in his office, demanding he acknowledge her existence and find out who she was.

episodes.name: Harmony of the Dead
episodes.overview: I-rang vows to reveal the true perpetrator behind Su-a's case. With this in mind, he enters a temporary alliance with his lawyer nemesis, Na-hyun.

episodes.name: Guilty Or Innocent?
episodes.overview: I-rang's new case involves a gifted scientist who died at the hands of his wife. The wife's defense lawyer turns out to be none other than Na-hyun.

episodes.name: New Suspect
episodes.overview: Mistakenly linked to a murder, I-rang must race against time to solve the case and prove his innocence.

episodes.name: Na-hyun's Past
episodes.overview: When I-rang loses his ability to see ghosts and Na-hyun suffers a career setback, the two cross paths again at the courthouse.

episodes.name: I-rang Meets So-hyun
episodes.overview: A possessed I-rang acts out at a crime scene and gets arrested. While locked up, he discovers the identity of the ghost who caused his outburst.

episodes.name: Na-hyun's Family
episodes.overview: Na-hyun spends precious time with her sister thanks to I-rang. But her emotional wounds deepen behind the facade of a happy family reunion.

episodes.name: The Secret Of I-rang's Old Friend
episodes.overview: I-rang and Na-hyun officially launch their partnership. On their first day, a vegetable vendor arrives at their office seeking legal help.

episodes.name: Seon-hwa's Past
episodes.overview: Attorney Yang Do-kyung complicates Na-hyun's case. I-rang and his partner bond and uncover crucial evidence that couldturn the trial in their favor.

episodes.name: The Missing Child
episodes.overview: I-rang discovers the tragic truth behind a child's death. Meanwhile, Do-kyung seethes with jealousy as he realizes Na-hyun's heart belongs to another.

episodes.name: The Truth Revealed
episodes.overview: After a violent encounter leaves I-rang in a critical state, a desperate Na-hyun confesses a secret as she stands by his side.

episodes.name: The Past Of My Father
episodes.overview: The ghost of I-rang's father appears, unaware of the heartache he caused his son. Can they find a way to overcome their painful past?

episodes.name: The Truth Of Gi-jung's Death
