episodes.overview: As l-rang learns a shocking truth from his father, Do-kyung adds pressure and pushes him toward a breaking point.

episodes.name: The Final Confrontation
episodes.overview: To solve his father's case, I-rang secures a key piece of evidence. But when a new threat jeopardizes his findings, he makes a dangerous gamble.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Kong Ji Hyeok works as the leader of the Mother TF team at a baby products company. He is sharp, calm, and executes passionately. One day, a team member, Ko Da Rim, suddenly kisses him. This places him in a difficult position because she is a married woman. M…

episodes.name: Nitric Acid, Sulfuric Acid, and Dynamite
episodes.overview: Ahead of her sister's wedding, Ko Da Rim heads to Jeju Island, where a sudden encounter leaves her reeling — until she meets Kong Ji Hyeok by a cliff.

episodes.name: Gone With a Kiss
episodes.overview: As their ruse turns into a real spark, Da Rim and Ji Hyeok go on an actual date. Meanwhile, Da Rim's mother collapses after a shocking confrontation.

episodes.name: Ping, Pong, Ping, Pong
episodes.overview: Da-rim and Ji-hyeok's unexpected reunion at work takes a tense turn when he learns of her "marriage" — becoming a ruthless boss as punishment.

episodes.name: His Black Card
episodes.overview: A tense escape from loan sharks brings Ji-hyeok and Da-rim closer, reigniting their spark. Later, Da-rim makes a heartfelt plea to keep her job.

episodes.name: Go Da-rim Is Mine! From Head to Toe!
episodes.overview: After Ji-hyeok pays off Da-rim's debt, he starts meddling in every part of her life — leaving her torn between frustration and affection.

episodes.name: Swayed, Driven Mad
episodes.overview: After witnessing Kim Seon-u's apparent romantic rendezvous with Yu Ha-yeong, Ji-hyeok debates telling Da-rim while caring for Da-rim during her illness.

episodes.name: I Want to Get Married, As Soon as Possible.
episodes.overview: Ji-hyeok and Da-rim's bond deepens as they team up at a company event for newlyweds. Later, Da-rim falls in the mountain amid an unexpected crisis.

episodes.name: Love Is Hell
episodes.overview: News of Ji-hyeok's engagement shocks Da-rim — and his coldness only deepens the hurt. A company trip soon forces them back into close proximity.

episodes.name: Don't Go. I Don't Want You to Go.
episodes.overview: When Ji-hyeok learns the truth about Da-rim, he feels relieved yet deceived — and his unpredictable behavior pushes her to confess everything.

episodes.name: The Reason I Like You
episodes.overview: Da-rim grows wary of Ji-hyeok's constant affection. Later, when their mothers gather at Seon-u's home, Ji-hyeok's competitive streak flares up.

episodes.name: Master of the Poker Face
episodes.overview: After a confession, Ji-hyeok and Da-rim begin a secret romance — but not without close calls. Meanwhile, someone at work learns that Da-rim is unmarried.

episodes.name: Very Sweet
episodes.overview: Racked with guilt, Da-rim decides to resign — but Ji-hyeok won't let her go. When a colleague catches their affection, Da-rim decides to tell the truth.

episodes.name: Flirting Master of the Orchard
episodes.overview: After being forced to admit she was spying, Da-rim says goodbye to Ji-hyeok before disappearing. Heartbroken, he focuses on clearing her name.

episodes.name: Dynamite Kiss
episodes.overview: Ji-hyeok makes his final move to take down his foes, but a vengeful act puts him in danger and erases his memory. Can he and Da-rim find happiness?

episodes.name: The Futures of You and Me
episodes.overview: Webtoon producer Seo Mi-rae's ordinary life is disrupted by workplace stress — and by the enchanting opportunity to test a new virtual dating service.

episodes.name: Cliche or Classic
episodes.overview: Mi-rae's first virtual date sweeps her off her feet and into a high-society fantasy — and helps to wage a war when she is pitted against Park Kyeong-nam.

episodes.name: First Love 101
episodes.overview: Mi-rae's second date unfolds on a college campus, but her match plays hard to get while memories of her first love keep coming back.

episodes.name: No Risk, High Return
episodes.overview: After her free trial abruptly ends, Mi-rae pays the high price to make the most of virtual dating — an investment with sweet returns and zero risk.

episodes.name: The Caveats of Perfection
episodes.overview: Mi-rae reconnects with someone from her past and their date feels new. A Naemo team workshop sparks an awkward confession.

episodes.name: The Hybrid Man
episodes.overview: Mi-rae's dream date with the next match leaves her unimpressed — but she returns to the service after hearing some sobering advice.

episodes.name: The Algorithm of Feelings
episodes.overview: While the virtual and real worlds begin to blend for Mi-rae, she is tasked to create a game plan for Yun Song — leading to a surprise group gathering.

episodes.name: The Odd or Even Game
episodes.overview: As a real-life connection challenges Mi-rae's devotion to virtual dating, her defenses begin to crumble and the fear of being alone resurfaces.

episodes.name: Like or Love
episodes.overview: Under pressure from Naemo, Author Yun scrambles for the top spot as a scandal brews. Meanwhile, Kyeong-nam comes face-to-face with Mi-rae's secret.

episodes.name: An Utterly Normal Future
episodes.overview: After misunderstandings and mixed messages, Mi-rae turns to the virtual world for advice. Can she find answers and a new way to open her heart?

episodes.name: What's This? My Heart Is Pounding
episodes.overview: Tired of being overshadowed, Kuromi steals precious ingredients from her rival. My Melody ventures into the forest and stumbles upon a strange discovery.

episodes.name: Fluffy and Soft
episodes.overview: Up in the clouds, My Melody has an ominous encounter with a giant, fluffy bear. Back in Mariland, Flat encourages her to join the upcoming sweets contest.

episodes.name: Kuromi's Great Recipe Heist
episodes.overview: My Melody's new creation is delightfully light and airy with a satisfying crunch. Unhappy with her own recipes, Kuromi sneaks into her rival's home.

episodes.name: Honey Car Chase!
episodes.overview: Everyone loves My Melody's new cupcakes, but mean online reviews upset her. Determined to uncover her baking secrets, Tanba and Sasage chase her down.

episodes.name: The Sweets Contest Begins
episodes.overview: Ready, set... bake! My Melody, Flat and Piano impress the crowd with their teamwork. Can Kuromi steal the spotlight with her wild creation?

episodes.name: The Secret of Kuromi's Dorayaki
episodes.overview: Kuromi's wildest dreams have come true! She's now the most popular patissier in Mariland. But Mr. Pistachio's help might be a recipe for trouble...

episodes.name: What Should I Do?
episodes.overview: Chased into the forest by ravenous villagers, My Melody and Kuromi find themselves in a jam — until a thunderous voice comes to their rescue.

episodes.name: Time for Teamwork
episodes.overview: As My Melody faces her home and town in ruins, Tanba and Sasage get punished for coming clean about their past. Kuromi turns to her friend for help.

episodes.name: To the Cloud Kingdom!
episodes.overview: Amidst the rubble, My Melody shares her honest feelings with Kuromi. They decide to return to the Cloud Kingdom together to set things right.

episodes.name: Pistachio's Past
episodes.overview: While Flat and Piano continue researching the Cloud Kingdom's history and the tragedy that befell it, My Melody and Kuromi confront Pistachio.

episodes.name: All for Our Best Friend
episodes.overview: Kuromi desperately tries to awaken My Melody while Pistachio moves forward with his plan. But things turn sour as an uncontrollable rot spreads.

episodes.name: My Melody & Kuromi
episodes.overview: For three days, My Melody's friends struggle to stay awake, watching over her as she dreams of her Mama's words of wisdom. Will Mariland be saved in time?

episodes.name: City of Joy
episodes.overview: When a kidnapping forces politician Barun Roy to take action against Bagha, a dangerous don, he hires the best man for the job — Officer Saptarshi Sinha.

episodes.name: Gurudakshina
episodes.overview: Steely cop Arjun Maitra takes over Bagha's case. Opposition leader Nibedita Basak demands justice for Saptarshi's fate. Barun has an offer for Sagor.

episodes.name: Jay-Veeru
episodes.overview: As Nibedita visits a figure from her past, Arjun receives unsettling intel from a mysterious informant. The authorities want Arjun out of their way.

episodes.name: Rakshabandhan
episodes.overview: Arjun receives a promotion while Sagor gets ready to make his political debut. An enraged Ranjit commits an unthinkable crime.

episodes.name: City of Bhoy
episodes.overview: A grief-stricken Sagor goes on a brutal rampage. Arjun is reinstated as the head of the SIT to put an end to Sagor's crimes.

episodes.name: The Mole
episodes.overview: Sagor's incriminating “insurance” video is brought into play. Ranjit goes to meet Sagor. Arjun learns the shocking identity of the mole within the SIT.

episodes.name: Lanka Dahan
episodes.overview: Arjun learns more about the mole within his force. As Ranjit devises an escape plan with an unexpected ally, will Arjun be able to stop him?

episodes.name: Lines and Walls
episodes.overview: After her classmates run off in fear, Koyuki makes faces in a mirror to figure out why everyone finds her scary. Suddenly, a boy sneaks up behind her.

episodes.name: Locksmith
episodes.overview: To Koyuki's relief, Yota comes to her rescue. After their initial study session, they grow more comfortable with each other — which unsettles Minato.
Bothered that Koyuki still has her guard up around him, Minato tries to make small talk. As Miki grows suspicious of his intentions, she confronts him.

episodes.name: Impenetrable
episodes.overview: At Miki's prodding, Minato clarifies his interest in her best friend. An unexpected visitor triggers Koyuki's bad memories, leading to a harsh outburst.

episodes.name: Change
episodes.overview: Koyuki mulls over the tense exchange in the infirmary. After Yota clears the air, she tries to have an honest conversation with Minato for the first time.

episodes.name: New Semester
episodes.overview: As winter break ends, the usually calm Minato begins to realize his feelings are changing. Miki notices how close Yota and Koyuki have become.

episodes.name: Loneliness and Solitude
episodes.overview: After reflecting on her own loneliness and worrying that Yota is bottling everything up, Koyuki reaches out and asks about his true feelings.

episodes.name: On Equal Footing
episodes.overview: Determined not to mess up high school, Miki has faked her persona since day one. But not being herself around her classmates starts to wear her down.

episodes.name: Self-Awareness
episodes.overview: Minato realizes how Koyuki is always on his mind. Later, while hanging out at the new mall, the misunderstanding between the four friends deepens.

episodes.name: Spring
episodes.overview: A spring break trip to the amusement park brings the four friends closer. Back at school, Koyuki's surprised by a familiar face — and Minato takes notice.

episodes.name: Inversion
episodes.overview: Koyuki broods over her complicated past with Akine's sister, Manatsu, and what the first year might know. Meanwhile, Momoka sets her sights on Minato.

episodes.name: Thunder
episodes.overview: As Koyuki slowly notices her new, surprising feelings towards Minato, first-year Momoka suddenly tries to cozy up to her — for reasons she can't grasp.

episodes.name: Perception
episodes.overview: With Akine's words ringing in her head, Koyuki's feelings become complicated. Later, an accident causes something to shift between Miki and Yota.

episodes.name: Bombshell
episodes.overview: Unsure of how to move forward, Miki avoids Yota and confides in her colleagues. A bold Momoka confronts Koyuki about Minato and lights a fuse.

episodes.name: Clouds and Rain
episodes.overview: Gray skies mirror the group's uneasy mood. Momoka senses a chance to get closer to Minato, while Miki can barely face Yota after turning him down.

episodes.name: Stop and Go
episodes.overview: Cultural festival prep begins and Miki and Yota ease back to normal. But as Minato grapples with his desire to stay close to Koyuki, Momoka makes a move.

episodes.name: True Feelings
episodes.overview: Reeling from the news that Minato and Momoka are dating, Koyuki fights to keep her composure. Miki, meanwhile, confronts Minato about his true intentions.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When unlucky Subbu is assigned to teach sex ed in a hostile village, he must find a way to succeed while avoiding his conservative father's wrath.

episodes.name: Subbu S/o Kukku
episodes.overview: Subbu struggles to free himself from his strict father's watch and commit to a future with his girlfriend. But an unexpected opportunity soon arises.

episodes.name: Welcome to Makhipur
episodes.overview: After a month of training, Subbu arrives in Makhipur and meets Kantha Rao. A session on consent for the village women draws the anger of their husbands.

episodes.name: Virginee!
episodes.overview: Subbu faces mockery after a classroom demonstration goes wrong. Desperate to educate himself, he seeks help but his own guilt gets in the way.

episodes.name: The Man, The Mission
episodes.overview: A lie leads to Subbu becoming an overnight hero. Swathi and Kantha Rao help him connect with the women of Makhipur. A hazy night leaves Subbu anxious.

episodes.name: Family Planning
episodes.overview: Subbu's family surprises him as he scrambles to meet his targets and hide his profession. An unexpected development leaves him stunned.

episodes.name: The Mystery Girl
episodes.overview: Subbu's teaching efforts finally start to pay off. A heartbroken Swathi turns to him for comfort. At a celebration, Ramesh Babu makes a major claim.

episodes.name: Subbu vs Kukku
episodes.overview: A secret turns Makhipur against Subbu. As his relationships with his father and Swathi evolve, will luck finally side with him?

episodes.name: K.O.
episodes.overview: Brothers Dev and Ravi return to Shaktigarh to hunt for the perpetrator of a brutal attack, while facing their callous father after years apart.

episodes.name: Counterpunch
episodes.overview: The brothers join forces in their search for vengeance. After returning to the scene of the crime, they stumble upon key evidence.

episodes.name: Sparring Partner
episodes.overview: A suspect's death leads to questions as Dev confronts Joyna. Raka seeks support elsewhere, while the rival boxing clubs prepare for an emergency trial.

episodes.name: Rope-a-Dope
episodes.overview: Ravi begins his training — and uses a surprise inspection to coerce a confession. Kookie toys with life and death, unleashing his wrath on Dev.

episodes.name: Low Blow
episodes.overview: Dev and Ravi's infiltration into a dangerous hideout turns explosive. A violent interrogation leads to an unexpected run from the law.

episodes.name: Underdog
episodes.overview: After breaking the rules, Ravi pleads his case ahead of the Olympic trials. Dev and Joyna search for clues and Arvind spirals after a shocking find.

episodes.name: Suckerpunch
episodes.overview: As the truth emerges, Dev must escape danger at every turn. Ravi claws his way to the final to face an old nemesis, but an attack may threaten his rise.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: As the Kargil War erupts between India and Pakistan, the Golden Arrows squadron of the Air Force takes flight on a dangerous mission behind enemy lines.

episodes.name: Peace and War
episodes.overview: Flight commander Ajay Ahuja is called in to train the Golden Arrows. As the Indo-Pak peace talks begin, General Musharraf considers his next move.

episodes.name: Sada-e-Sarhad
episodes.overview: Baldy struggles to get his head in the game, but a unique bonding exercise brings the squad together. As they celebrate, trouble looms in the mountains.

episodes.name: Safed Sagar
episodes.overview: General Musharraf and the prime minister lock horns. The Golden Arrows race to uncover the infiltrators, but a shocking incident jolts the squadron.

episodes.name: Golden Arrows
episodes.overview: Panic grips the Indian forces as the Kargil War quickly escalates and Ahuja is pulled into peril. Amid nationwide outrage, a plan to fight back emerges.

episodes.name: Bombs Away
episodes.overview: A high-altitude bombing strategy brings new challenges for the Golden Arrows. As Dhali grapples with guilt, General Musharraf's plans begin to unravel.

episodes.name: Line of Control
episodes.overview: As international pressure mounts, a bold formation tactic could signal a momentous shift as the war reaches a turning point.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After their newborn disappears from the hospital, Anvita and Alok receive disturbing birthday packages each year that keep the search alive.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: A potential lead forces Anvita to question her search for her missing daughter. Meanwhile, Madhu escalates her efforts to halt the investigation.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Anvita's suspicions grow as she examines an old photo for clues, while her visions intensify. A mysterious death raises flags for Inspector Khurana.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: An unexpected confession adds a new layer to the case. Apeksha's birthday party is thrown into turmoil when Anvita makes a shocking accusation.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: A threatening message deepens the rift between Anvita and Alok while she seeks crucial evidence. The police track down a woman tied to Rhea's birth.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: As the mystery behind Anvita's hallucinations unravels, Madhu finds herself cornered. A tragic incident disrupts the investigation.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Shreya's revelation begins to connect the pieces of Apeksha's disappearance as the truth finally comes to light.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When a lawyer and fangirl's favorite idol is accused of murder, she jumps to his defense to prove his innocence.

episodes.name: An Unexpected Variation
episodes.overview: By day, Maeng Se-na is a top lawyer — but by night, she's a secret K-pop mega fan. Do Ra-ik's world unravels when he faces a deadly crisis.

episodes.name: Sound and Fury
episodes.overview: Facing dividing loyalties and backlash from all corners, Se-na questions Ra-ik as he insists on his innocence while his fandom erupts.

episodes.name: I Can't Stop for Death
episodes.overview: Ra-ik spirals into despair. Private detective Park Chung-jae investigates the case, while Se-na follows her instincts over evidence.

episodes.name: Pandora's Box
episodes.overview: Ra-ik begs Se-na to keep a figure from his past away from the case — but she soon notices a connection between the two.

episodes.name: Beneath the Tickling Tree
episodes.overview: Unexpected feelings begin to grow as Ra-ik tends to Se-na after her injury. Meanwhile, Se-na learns crucial information about the accident.

episodes.name: A Blatant Lie
episodes.overview: Se-na makes a breakthrough, finding motives tied to the music industry. Ra-ik makes an unsettling discovery about Se-na.

episodes.name: Empty from What I Couldn't Let Go
episodes.overview: Ra-ik distances himself from Se-na after discovering her secret. Se-na receives startling news about one of the band members.

episodes.name: When the Bell Rings in the Dark
episodes.overview: Se-na finds new evidence — and a new suspect — that could exonerate Ra-ik completely. But their investigation soon leads to a dark truth.

episodes.name: GO BACK
episodes.overview: In a rare moment of vulnerability, Ra-ik drops his facade and confides in Se-na as their connection grows more intense.

episodes.name: The One I Like
episodes.overview: As Ra-ik finally confesses his feelings, Se-na's awkwardness leads to tender moments — but new and confusing information sparks chaos between the two.

episodes.name: The Truth Moving Forward
episodes.overview: A miraculous development pulls Se-na and Ra-ik closer to the truth — and the real story behind the killer's motive.

episodes.name: UN:ENDING
episodes.overview: After reaching a verdict and exposing new truths, Se-na embraces her identity as a fan and lawyer, while Ra-ik tries to piece his life back together.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After Girigo grants Choi Hyeong-wook a wish, he introduces the app to his friends, who brush him off. But soon, his behavior grows concerning.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: After a sudden tragedy, Yoo Se-ah realizes Kim Geon-woo may be next and rallies her friends to find a solution. But Girigo proves too sinister to stop.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Seeking to cast out evil, Kang Ha-joon takes Se-ah to his shaman sister — sending her to a cursed space filled with fear, trauma and abandonment.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Ha-joon, Se-ah and Bangwool investigate Girigo's origins, chasing an online friend of Hyeong-wook's. They soon discover a house that may hold clues.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: After a wild night out, Lim Na-ri discovers a terrifying truth. Soon, her jealousy takes hold of her as she navigates her feelings for Geon-woo.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Born from innocence, Kwon Si-won's friendship with Do Hye-ryung — steeped in jealousy, resentment and revenge — gives rise to Girigo and the curse.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Facing sabotage from spirits, the group hunts for the original phone. But as they close in on their goal, danger and darkness lurk at every turn.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: On the brink of defeat, Se-ah confronts the evil behind the curse. Can she stop the unending deaths once and for all?

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A workaholic home shopping host heads to the countryside to get her show back on top, but a mysterious farmer shakes up her plans — and her heart.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Dam Ye-jin's shopping host career is on the rise — until she loses her primetime slot. Determined to find a new hit item, she heads to the countryside.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Ye-jin realizes farmer Matthew Lee may be able to help her. But her efforts to persuade him prove futile, until she bumps into the perfect opportunity.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Strange phone calls keeps Matthew up at night. Meanwhile, Eric Seo and Ye-jin double down on their plans to get Matthew to work with L'Étoile again.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: When crisis hits the farm, Ye-jin improvises a way to help. Matthew starts to see Ye-jin in a different light after a surprisingly close encounter.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Matthew and Ye-jin make a pact to work together. When Matthew discovers some pressing information, Ye-jin is forced to make an important choice.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: As Ye-jin deals with the fallout of her decision, Matthew invites her to Deokpung Village to get her mind off things — and be his temporary roommate.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Everyone gathers in the village, sparking new realizations and emotions. Ye-jin confronts Matthew about the mixed signals he's been giving her.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: With their feelings revealed, Matthew and Ye-jin explore their new relationship. But secrets from the past start to threaten their newfound happiness.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: After coming clean about his past, Matthew pushes Ye-jin away. But keeping a distance gets harder when Ye-jin learns about her late-night calls.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Matthew gets jealous when he learns that Eric is Ye-jin's new neighbor. Sparks fly in the village, keeping spirits high — until someone goes missing.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Matthew enlists Ye-jin's help to develop a new skincare cream. Everything looks promising — until a smear campaign triggers an attack on the village.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: With the truth behind the scandal from five years ago revealed, Matthew and Ye-jin prepare for their home shopping launch. Will they be able to sell out?

episodes.name: Aakhri Call
episodes.overview: Months after a young woman's death, five students receive calls from her number. But the case turns murky when a decapitated body is found on campus.

episodes.name: Hotel Blood Stone
episodes.overview: After being missing for 10 days, a woman appears in a disturbing viral video taken at Hotel Blood Stone. Will the police be able to track her down in time?

episodes.name: Ek Kaatil, 15000 DNA
episodes.overview: When a woman named Naina is found dead, police question people living in the housing complex. Soon a criminal web begins to unravel.

episodes.name: 48 Ghante, Tukdo Mein Sach
episodes.overview: The founder of Pro Life Insurance, Subodh Khanna, goes missing under mysterious circumstances. When his wife presents a suicide video to the police, questions arise.

episodes.name: Garba Mein Maut
episodes.overview: Amid the vibrant celebrations of Navratri in a small Gujarat town, a devoted mother sets out to prove her son's innocence when he is accused of murdering a young girl.

episodes.name: Sard Murder
episodes.overview: When Harshdeep Kochchar's (Harry) body is found in a freezer at his brother's restaurant, the investigation spirals into a web of lies, love, and betrayal.

episodes.name: Mitti Mein Dafan Sach
episodes.overview: When the wife and daughters of a distinguished judge vanish overnight, the evidence emerges in layers-one burial at a time-the case turns into a nightmarish puzzle full of deception, misdirection, and unsettling truths.

episodes.name: Slimming Pill, Bloody Kills
episodes.overview: Superstar Randhir Raii is kidnapped, and ACP has 24 hours to save him. As the investigation unfolds, it exposes a deadly pharma scandal and a grieving father's fight for justice.

episodes.name: Ratna
episodes.overview: Sanju arrives at his home to attend his sister Ratna's wedding ; only to see a sight that will shock him forever and suffer an attack that will handicap him forever. Sanju's whole family has been killed.

episodes.name: Charu
episodes.overview: A maid is dead. But her secrets lived on in the lives of those who thought they never knew her. Her shocking ties to multiple elite residents come to light.

episodes.name: Shruti
episodes.overview: When a young woman vanishes while delivering food, her search leads the cops into the hidden mysteries of the city's largest slum. Can the cops find out the terrible truth about the young girl?

episodes.name: Salma
episodes.overview: Salma , a cook at a street-food cart is found beaten and unconscious in an auto; on regaining consciousness , she says that she got into a fight with her ex-boyfriend who has fled.

episodes.name: Roshni Behnaaz, Part 1
episodes.overview: Set in the Parsi community, Roshni, a new mother is killed and the suspects are many - her husband, her maid, her neighbor amongst many others. Cops are not able to find the killer and now an expert is empanelled to investigate further.

episodes.name: Roshni Behnaaz, Part 2
episodes.overview: Behnaaz is Roshni's best friend. Her quest for finding Roshni's murder intensified. What complicated the case further is that she herself was a victim of domestic violence.

episodes.name: Shagun
episodes.overview: Shagun Sandhu disappears the morning after celebrating her 20th birthday, just hours after her father receives a threatening call. The next day, her body is discovered in a park. Who made the call, and why was Shagun targeted?

episodes.name: Sujata
episodes.overview: Newlyweds Ramesh and Sujata arrive in Mumbai to start a new life. But joy turns into dread when Ramesh vanishes without a trace. Sujata seeks help, but the case takes a darker twist after a woman's body is found. What mystery lies ahead?

episodes.name: Kundan Mayuri, Part 1
episodes.overview: Terror grips the village when a headless body is discovered, leaving the locals stunned and fearful. As the police launch their investigation, unsettling questions begin to surface - who was the victim, and what dark secret lies behind this gruesome act?

episodes.name: Kundan Mayuri, Part 2
episodes.overview: When Naveen's severed head is discovered in his home freezer, the police launch an investigation and question his wife about Mayuri's whereabouts. As they track Dipika in hopes of reaching the culprit, the clock is ticking. Will they find her before it's too…

episodes.name: Sarthak
episodes.overview: Aspiring dancer Sarthak is found dead under a bus stop bench. As the mystery unfolds, his sister-in-law reveals a police constable had visited him a month ago. What led to his tragic end?

episodes.name: Farheen Naseem
episodes.overview: A routine fishing trip takes a dark turn when a corpse is found floating in the water. Shock and confusion follow as the police arrive to investigate. Who was this person, and how did they end up here?

episodes.name: Preeti Sunil
episodes.overview: In Nashik, Maharashtra, Preeti Deshmukh is found murdered in her home. The prime suspect, a firecracker seller, goes on the run and takes children in a chawl hostage. Can the police crack the case?

episodes.name: Shourya Dhiraj
episodes.overview: In Nashik, Maharashtra, wheelchair-bound Dheeraj is found dead in a swimming pool. While it appears to be a suicide, the police suspect foul play. Can they uncover the truth with barely any clues?

episodes.name: Kaan Kaat Killer - Part 1
episodes.overview: Discovery of a severed ear in a scrap dealer's bag leads the police into a complex investigation to find the victim and track down the culprit.

episodes.name: Kaan Kaat Killer - Part 2
episodes.overview: A missing body ? A young girl kidnapped? As police continue their investigation, they must determine whether there is a connection between the two cases

episodes.name: Ria - Sagai Se Pehle Qatl
episodes.overview: On her wedding day, a bride is found dead in a palanquin. Later, her friends' reveal she was unhappy. Can the police determine the cause of her death?

episodes.name: Kya Zindagi Degi Second Chance?
episodes.overview: A minor scrape in a parking lot leads to a harrowing ordeal for a mother and daughter when a violent man begins pursuing them.

episodes.name: Double Kidnapping Case
episodes.overview: Pari is harassed by Raman and later by Raghav at Ria's birthday party. Soon after, Pari goes missing, prompting her father to approach the police. Later, Ria also gets kidnapped. Are Raman and Raghav behind the disappearances, or is something more sinister at…

episodes.name: Ankita Murder Case
episodes.overview: During a live theatre performance, an actress named Ankita is killed in the middle of a scene. Her co-actor Kaushik becomes the prime suspect and goes on the run. How will the police track him down?

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Na Bo-bae is a struggling writer — and human electrical conductor. Suddenly, she bumps into Baek Ho-rang, the first person who's immune to her sparks.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: When Ho-rang realizes that Bo-bae's strange powers could be the solution to his heart-battery needs, he tries to make her an offer she can't refuse.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Ho-rang and Bo-bae become roommates and make things official. As per their contract, they go on their first date for Bo-bae's romance research.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Bo-bae ends up as Ho-rang's personal assistant. After a tense birthday lunch with his family, Ho-rang is moved by Bo-bae's simple surprise.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Han Seol-hee comes to Ho-rang with a marriage proposal, but he makes his disinterest clear. Meanwhile, Ji Eun-ho tries to draw closer to Bo-bae.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Bo-bae impresses with her writing skills, but seeing Bo-bae and Eun-ho's bond up close ignites jealous sparks within Ho-rang. Eun-ho makes a bold move.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Worried about endangering yet another person she cares about, Bo-bae keeps her distance from Ho-rang. Do-yoon and Seol-hee's schemes come to a head.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Bo-bae and Ho-rang finally start dating. Ho-rang prepares for his succession announcement — but on the day of the event, Bo-bae is nowhere to be found.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Ho-rang's collapse puts him in serious danger — until Bo-bae arrives in the nick of time. But she soon finds out a dangerous truth about her powers.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: When Bo-bae learns her powers may be gone, she wonders what it means for her — and her future with Ho-rang. Will her story have a happy ending after all?

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: After 20 years trying to make his debut film, Hwang Dong-man flails through life, irritating his director friends — until one day he meets Byeon Eun-a.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: While Dong-man deals with rock bottom, Ko Hye-jin delivers devastating news. Meanwhile, Eun-a seeks counseling as she struggles at work.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Dong-man slowly grows closer to Eun-a. Later, he makes an enemy of Park Gyeong-se — whose film opens to negative critical reception.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Gyeong-se sets his revenge against Dong-man in motion — playing dirty. Meanwhile, Eun-a faces mounting hostility and pressure at work.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Tired of enduring contempt from his peers, Dong-man confronts Gyeong-se. He later chastises Ma Jae-yeong over his relationship with Eun-a.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Dong-man rushes to share a meal with Eun-a — but is met with a surprise. Later, Eun-a receives a phone call that stops her in her tracks.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: As Dong-man and Eun-a's bond deepens, they both make decisions about their scripts. Eun-a and Oh Jeong-hui finally come face-to-face in a tense moment.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: When Dong-man learns that Jae-yeong is about to begin filming, he becomes consumed by envy. Meanwhile, Eun-a decides to confront Jeong-hui directly.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Just as Dong-man is about to debut, his fears haunt him — but Eun-a offers her brand of support. Meanwhile, Eun-a's secret script garners interest.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Desperate to cast Noh Kang-sik, Dong-man takes matters into his own hands. Meanwhile, Eun-a grows uneasy as Jeong-hui involves herself in her project.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: An envious man seeks inner peace while feeling isolated in a world where others seem to always succeed.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Eun-a takes a bold step forward in resilience. As Dong-man grows increasingly impatient with production timing, will he finally release his film?

seasons.name: Limited Series
seasons.overview: Je Moon-jae, a reclusive novelist who becomes desperate after a mysterious figure known as "The Rat" steals his identity and financial assets. To reclaim his life, he forms an unlikely alliance with Noja, a loan shark-turned-private investigator, leading them…

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: While hiding from society, a reclusive genius novelist Je Moon-jae falls victim to identity theft — only to be confronted by his doppelganger.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Noja uncovers the world of identity laundering after Moon-jae escapes his grip. Meanwhile, Detective Park Sun-yong pieces together the link between them.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Suspicious but intrigued, Noja takes Moon-jae on as both a client and a hostage. Their uneasy alliance leads them to setting up a carefully planned trap.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Moon-jae suspects The Rat may be a figure from his past. Following his newly recovered memory, he and Noja head to the island where the man once stayed.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: A shocking tie surfaces between Noja and The Rat, while Sun-yong closes in on crucial evidence. Later, The Rat appears publicly, cornering Moon-jae.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Moon-jae reaches out to his longtime editor, hoping she can vouch for him. Lost in confusion, a text from Noja becomes his only lifeline.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: After barely escaping, Moon-jae joins a frantic race for someone who can reveal his identity. Later, Sun-yong discovers a shocking truth about his past.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Moon-jae sinks deeper into trouble. Sun-yong heads to a nursing home for answers — only to find his witness gone. Later, Noja's past buries him alive.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Moon-jae evades police to meet The Rat where it all began. Noja leaves him with heartfelt advice as Sun-yong continues to pursue a key witness.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Moon-jae stands at the center of a trap a lifetime in the making. Every lie and stolen identity surfaces as he questions: Is he the predator or the prey?

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Go Eun-sae wakes up in the hospital with no recollection of who she is. Suddenly, scruffy-looking Jang Tae-ha shows up claiming to be her boyfriend.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: From quirky villagers to shady little details, everything feels off to Eun-sae — especially Tae-ha. Later, she tries to figure out if he can be trusted.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Tae-ha takes Eun-sae on a fun day out to cheer her up. However, news starts to get back to mafia boss Baek Sang-gil about what happened with Eun-sae.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Eun-sae heads to Seoul in search of answers, only to be confronted with the ugly truth about who she used to be — and the painful past of Tae-ha.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Eun-sae and Tae-ha's relationship grows sweeter, but some sticky encounters with Tae-ha's old friends put their newfound intimacy to the test.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Tiny misunderstandings snowball into wild rumors all over town. The village trio tries to fix it, only to worsen things — and Eun-sae corners Tae-ha.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: When Eun-sae vanishes, the village searches for her. Meanwhile, her doctor An Gi-jun turns up at Tae-ha's door at night with questions about her past.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Sang-gil finally realizes what Tae-ha has done. Realizing Eun-sae's safety is in danger, Tae-ha makes plans to help her escape.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: With her memories revived, Eun-sae buckles down on her plan to go after Sang-gil. But her very existence now puts the whole town in danger — Tae-ha included.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Eun-sae busies herself with putting Sang-gil away. But with Eun-sae held up at work, Tae-ha wonders if there's any space left for him in her life.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Tae-ha and Eun-sae reunite with everyone in the village, but things take a turn when Sang-gil shows up — only to discover a shocking truth.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Tae-ha confronts Sang-gil to save his grandmother. Despite Sang-gil's constant threats, will Tae-ha and Eun-sae stay happily stuck together forever?

episodes.name: Dekho, mujhe kya mila?
episodes.overview: While newly divorced Gaurav Gehlot is out enjoying single life, he finds a baby in the back of his car — and decides to do whatever it takes to keep him.

episodes.name: Love nahi, lovest!
episodes.overview: Shlok agrees to help Gaurav navigate the application process. But first, he has to win over the adoption agency — and his disapproving family.

episodes.name: Dikha denge apni power!
episodes.overview: Gaurav moves out of his parents' and baby-proofs his new home. When he learns Mrs. Nehra has other plans in mind for Amul, he begs for a second chance.

episodes.name: Asli Single Papa
episodes.overview: Jatin grows suspicious of Poonam. A change in Gaurav's circumstances prompts Mrs. Nehra to issue an ultimatum — meet her demands, or lose Amul forever.

episodes.name: Chattan nahi, Parbat!
episodes.overview: Sharanya finds a nanny for Amul who isn't what Gaurav was expecting. A flurry of surprise visitors creates an awkward situation for the new dad.

episodes.name: "Papa bola"!
episodes.overview: As her big day approaches, Namrata begs her family to reconcile — but as the truth about Amul threatens to be revealed, will the wedding even go ahead?

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Pickpocket Lee Ga-kyung has just one goal — to flee colonial Joseon. But she soon ends up unexpectedly entangled with the Korean independence movement.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Ga-kyung's language skills shock Yoo Philip and Yoo So-ran. Meanwhile, Kim Tae-ung's insistence that Ga-kyung return his wallet raises her suspicions.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Despite Ga-kyung's initial reservations about So-ran, the two join hands. On her first day at work undercover, Ga-kyung meets a familiar face.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Tae-ung remains suspicious of Ga-kyung, but also strangely captivated — or even charmed? Meanwhile, the Gugukdan start making big plans.

episodes.name: The Woman Known as the Witch of Yeouido
episodes.overview: While investigating Hanmin Investment & Securities, Hong Geum Bo faces a setback after meeting an informant — forcing her to go undercover.

episodes.name: Between Recruitment and Infiltration
episodes.overview: Disguised as a 20-year-old employee, Geum Bo cozies up to Ko Bok Hui for intel — until her heart skips a beat when Sin Jeong U arrives at work.

episodes.name: Right Under the Nose and in the Line of Fire
episodes.overview: While avoiding Jung-woo, Keum-bo continues investigating leads undercover. Meanwhile, she clashes with Bok-hee - causing tension at home.

episodes.name: Sleeping With the Enemy
episodes.overview: Despite preventing a disaster at work, Keum-bo faces imminent termination. While trying to secure her employment, she tries to track down "yehppee."

episodes.name: Ready or Not, Here I Come
episodes.overview: A new arrival at the residence bothers Keum-bo. After learning of a spy, Chairman Kang orders an internal hunt — pushing Keum-bo to find "yehppee" first.

episodes.name: The Silence of the Misses
episodes.overview: To get closer to the truth about the slush fund, Keum-bo tries hard to win the top employee contest. Later, Jung-woo confronts her in a stuck elevator.

episodes.name: I Know What You Did Last Summer
episodes.overview: Keum-bo witnesses a secret meeting between Albert Oh and a nefarious man from her past. Her suspicions grow as she closes in on what he's hiding.

episodes.name: Money Monster
episodes.overview: Keum-bo finally tracks down "yehppee," who won't cooperate. But when the IMF crisis hits Korea, her investigation takes a sudden turn.

episodes.name: Two Letters
episodes.overview: The brutal IMF financial crisis shakes the lives of four roommates. Meanwhile, Jung-woo begins a cutthroat restructuring of the company.

episodes.name: Clash of the Titans
episodes.overview: Committed to her mission, Keum-bo moves forward with her plan to protect Hanmin employees — but Jung-woo keeps getting in her way.

episodes.name: The Masked Pirate
episodes.overview: Keum-bo and Bok-hee bravely set their plan in motion to handle slush funds. Meanwhile, they find a puzzling online community.

episodes.name: Money Never Sleeps
episodes.overview: Now with a team assembled, Keum-bo launches an operation to go after corrupt company executives. The first target? Albert's father Oh Deok-gyu.

episodes.name: Witch Hunt
episodes.overview: Song Ju-ran erupts in anger upon discovering a hidden truth. Meanwhile, Keum-bo sets her sights on taking down Chairman Kang's allies one by one.

episodes.name: The Era of Great Pirates
episodes.overview: Keum-bo approaches Jung-woo with an intriguing offer. Meanwhile, Ju-ran schemes to pin her failures on a scapegoat.

episodes.name: No Mercy
episodes.overview: After a violent attack on Keum-bo and the roommates, the Yeouido Pirates plot a new plan — striking Chairman Kang from within as a Hanmin shareholder.

episodes.name: We of the New Millennium
episodes.overview: As Chairman Kang continues to reign amid betrayal, can Keum-bo and the Yeouido Pirates finally deliver justice and a better future?

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: On her first day at the hospital, Gye Su-jeong quickly ruffles feathers when she weighs in on an upcoming surgery — only to jump in when a crisis arises.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Faced with two pancreatic cancer patients — a wealthy chairman and a teenager — hospital staff clash over who to prioritize. But Su-jeong wastes no time.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The hospital staff grow suspicious of Su-jeong's past. When a cleaner suddenly collapses, Su-jeong must make a decision as no surgeon is available.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: After a new surgeon arrives at the hospital, Jang Hui-suk and Su-jeong keep a close eye on him. Meanwhile, a pharmaceutical rep suffers an emergency.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Manager Kim is an ordinary salaryman whose biggest worry is how to connect with his daughter Kim Min-ji — until she suddenly goes missing.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Frantic to find where Min-ji is, Manager Kim uses his skills from his days as Agent Kim — a secret agent who specialized in ruthless enemy takedowns.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Manager Kim reconnects with Sung Han-soo and Park Jin-cheol — his fellow dad friends (and former secret agents) — on his search for Min-ji.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Manager Kim's risky actions put him on the radar of enemies past and present. When danger strikes, Han-soo and Jin-cheol step up to help save the day.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Manager Kim trades blows with the enemy agent chasing him — only to realize he is an old friend. Meanwhile, Min-ji attempts an escape of her own.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Min-ji finds herself in a dire situation — until special agent Jung Sang-a shows up. The Special Missions Directorate tries to lure out Manager Kim.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Manager Kim and Min-ji finally reunite, but the path to safety is far from smooth. Later, Manager Kim is forced to make a difficult decision.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Manager Kim is captured and tortured — until the Special Missions Directorate steps in with a final mission. Ju Gang-chan makes a plan to get revenge.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: With Manager Kim's mission a failure, the three agent dads team up with Sang-a to fight their way out — but Gang-chan has another trick up his sleeve.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Pushed to the brink by Gang-chan, Manager Kim must now make a crucial choice with Han-soo and Jin-cheol. Will Manager Kim be able to keep Min-ji safe?

episodes.name: THE SAVIOR WHO COULD NOT BRING SALVATION
episodes.overview: Tetsuo Yabusame, an unlikely defender of Earth, heads into a furious battle against 20,000 kaiju.

episodes.name: ENCOUNTERS
episodes.overview: In search of life in frozen ruins, Tetsuo encounters human survivors that he's been searching for.

episodes.name: MY FIRST FRIEND
episodes.overview: Tetsuo joins Ao's group, then confronts new intergalactic kaiju alone until who should appear but...

episodes.name: THE KAIJU TAMER AND THE CAN OF PINEAPPLE
episodes.overview: Tetsuo is welcomed by the survivors at the Mishima Mall. But why is it so warm in a frozen world?

episodes.name: GOOD JOB!
episodes.overview: A new enemy seeks out the Mishima Mall as a targeted Testsuo visits Hagane's late mother's lab.

episodes.name: BEYOND THE MADNESS
episodes.overview: Driven by jealousy, a former member of E-RDE commands a merciless attack on Tetsuo and the others!

episodes.name: THE COST OF COURAGE
episodes.overview: Overwhelmed by the powerful kaiju, Hercules, Tetsuo turns the tide of battle with... Communication!

episodes.name: MISHIMA MALL ACTIVATES
episodes.overview: The Boss activates a secret defense system against the kaiju, but can the Mall hold out for Tetsuo?

episodes.name: THE GREAT KAIJU WAR
episodes.overview: Ao returns to the Mall and takes on the enemy while the Boss recounts Sagami's past!

episodes.name: WOUNDS YOU CAN FACE
episodes.overview: A rematch with Hercules begins. The Mishima Mall vs. VIERDE battle reaches its climax!

episodes.name: I WANT TO BE A SAVIOR
episodes.overview: After a fierce battling, Tetsuo defeats Hercules. In a daze, Sagami confesses a shocking truth… !

episodes.name: A CALM AND GENTLE WORLD
episodes.overview: Sagami loses his will to fight. VIERDE's story unfolds their survival during the Big Freeze.

episodes.name: DRINK TOGETHER
episodes.overview: Turns out Nadare is the humanoid behind the Big Freeze. Tetsuo and Yukio fight the ultimate enemy.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Akane Osaki, captivated since childhood by the magical performances of her father, Shinta Arakawa, witnesses a shocking incident during his decisive performance for promotion to shin'uchi (master rank). Six years later, now a high school student, she sets her…

episodes.name: That Day
episodes.overview: Young girl Akane Osaki falls in love with rakugo comic storytelling through watching her father perform. One day, a shocking event derails his career.

episodes.name: First Performance
episodes.overview: Hearing that Master Shiguma is secretly meeting with a young girl, Futatsume Guriko investigates and finds him teaching Akane at a karaoke parlor.

episodes.name: Senior Apprentices
episodes.overview: Akane joins Shiguma's school as an apprentice. The earnest Kyoji Arakawa is tasked with guiding her, but she finds herself stuck doing menial chores.

episodes.name: Beyond Joy
episodes.overview: Akane performs at a nursing home, displaying all she has learned. Kyoji goes next, determined to show her his skill as her elder fellow apprentice.

episodes.name: Her Path Forward
episodes.overview: Akane gets career counseling from her teacher Iwashimizu, known as the Ice Lady, who refuses to acknowledge Akane's dream of becoming a Rakugoka.

episodes.name: Terakoya
episodes.overview: After learning that Issho will judge the annual student Rakugo championship, Akane gains Shiguma's permission to compete — but on one condition.

episodes.name: Karaku Cup
episodes.overview: At the Karaku Cup preliminaries, all eyes are on defending champion Karashi and rising voice actor Hikaru Koragi, but Kaisei picks Akane to win.

episodes.name: What They Want
episodes.overview: As the Karaku Cup finals begin, Karashi wins over the crowd with his bold adapted Rakugo, but head judge Issho's verdict remains to be seen.

episodes.name: Performer
episodes.overview: At the Karaku Cup finals, Hikaru Koragi performs a sentimental story to prove she is more than just a pretty face. Next, Akane takes the stage.

episodes.name: Jugemu
episodes.overview: Akane's performance of "Jugemu" takes a subdued approach, providing a pleasant respite for the spectators caught up in the excitement of the contest.

episodes.name: Answer
episodes.overview: Following Akane's bold question, the shrewd Issho makes the reporters leave the room, then reveals the truth about the expulsion incident.

episodes.name: Graduation
episodes.overview: Akane's Karaku Cup win draws attention at school. As graduation nears, her friends chase their own dreams, and Shiguma ponders a stage name for her.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Haunted by the gift of seeing ghosts, Cheon Yeo-ri keeps others at a distance — except prosecutor Ma Gang-uk, whom she can't seem to stop bumping into.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Gang-uk meets Yeo-ri at yet another crime scene, increasing his suspicions. Kang Min-hwan invites Yeo-ri to his hotel, but strange things occur at night.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: A troubled, tipsy Yeo-ri finds solace in Gang-uk and his coworkers. But the liquid courage causes her to let her guard down — and take her gloves off.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: After experiencing Yeo-ri's ghost-seeing abilities firsthand, Gang-uk begins to understand her burden. Yeo-ri coaches Gang-uk on handling ghosts.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Determined to keep Gang-uk safe from any more deadly trouble, Yeo-ri tells him not to keep in touch — but a new case brings them back together.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Gang-uk and Yeo-ri grow closer. But Cheon Ha-ri's schemes and a health scare threaten Yeo-ri's position — forcing her to come up with an unlikely plan.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Yeo-ri and Gang-uk's sudden engagement shocks everyone. To allay suspicions, they go on a series of sweet dates — sparking mixed emotions in Min-hwan.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Yeo-ri's grandma suggests moving up the wedding, giving Gang-uk the perfect chance to confess. Min-hwan makes a last-ditch effort to win Yeo-ri over.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Gang-uk and Yeo-ri throw a successful engagement party — but the happy couple are forced apart when Yeo-ri's position at work is suddenly threatened.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Gang-uk surprises Yeo-ri on her trip, lifting her spirits. Meanwhile, Gang-uk's grandma changes her mind about their marriage. Min-hwan starts plotting.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Gang-uk spots Yeo-ri at the prosecutor’s office but struggles to approach her. A pendant gives him the chance to get close again and show her how he truly feels.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: A comatose Yeo-ri meets some familiar faces. Meanwhile, the truth behind the yacht accident unravels - but someone is determined to keep things hidden.

seasons.name: Series 1
seasons.overview: Two of London's most prestigious rival firms – Cathcarts and Taylor & Byrne – go head-to-head in the divorce case of the century: tech titan Morgan Henderson and his estranged wife, international film star Carla Duval. Each side is certain they'll win. But as…

episodes.name: It's Done
episodes.overview: As Morgan and Carla's 10-year marriage hurtles toward divorce, their respective attorneys begin to ramp up their war rooms.

episodes.name: No More Nasty Surprises
episodes.overview: As Johnny starts his first day, each team attempts to gain the upper hand during mediation. Later, Serena tries to control the narrative.

episodes.name: Chip Off the Block
episodes.overview: With the prenup thrown into question, Morgan's relationship with his stepson, Gabe, becomes central to both firms' plans.

episodes.name: Sing
episodes.overview: Nick's insecurities resurface during a crucial arbitration session. Morgan begins to question Cathcarts' tactics.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Following the conclusion of the greatest father-son fight on earth, Baki and other legendary fighters are overcome with unbearable boredom. Meanwhile, 364 meters beneath Tokyo Skytree, a secret plan is set into motion that seeks to revive the master swordsman…

episodes.name: The Unstoppable Yawn
episodes.overview: With the greatest father-son battle on earth concluded, Baki experiences overwhelming boredom. Meanwhile, Tokugawa advances his unprecedented experiment.

episodes.name: THE BEAT
episodes.overview: As the other martial artists battle restlessness, Kaoru Hanayama asks Tokugawa for a favor. Deep underground, the cloning project enters its final phase.

episodes.name: The Countenance of Musashi
episodes.overview: As Professor John accepts Sabuko's arcane methods against scientific reasoning, Hanayama gears up for an all-out fistfight with Yujiro on Tokyo's streets.

episodes.name: Boy
episodes.overview: After facing Japan's greatest modern swordsman, the peerless Musashi Miyamoto demands the most skilled fighters in the country. Baki steps forward.

episodes.name: Otherworldly Strength
episodes.overview: Baki unleashes his fastest strike — but the samurai is faster. Later, as Musashi roams the city, his actions catch the attention of other martial artists.

episodes.name: Real Sword
episodes.overview: The first to move is Doppo Orochi. After a brief tussle, he asks Musashi to use a real blade. How will God's Hand fare against the sword saint's steel?

episodes.name: Feather
episodes.overview: Sea King Retsu arrives to face Musashi and trains intensively under the watchful eye of Sea Emperor Kaku to master the secret technique: Xiaoli.

episodes.name: You Are Defeated!
episodes.overview: The battle between kenpo master Retsu and sword master Musashi Miyamoto begins! While Retsu unleashes long-range weapon attacks, Musashi closes in!?

episodes.name: Sea King Retsu
episodes.overview: Barely standing after Musashi's barrage of brutal attacks, Retsu forces his broken body forward and adopts a familiar stance. Can he turn the tide?

episodes.name: Sekigahara
episodes.overview: The deathmatch between Retsu and Musashi comes to a devastatingly brutal conclusion. Baki visits Izo Motobe for guidance and flies into a rage.

episodes.name: Buddy
episodes.overview: After defeating Japan's kendo champ, Musashi faces jujutsu master Goki Shibukawa, who greets the samurai with a firm handshake — and a punch to the face.

episodes.name: Tough Body
episodes.overview: The strongest being on Earth clashes with the strongest samurai in history at the Tokugawa estate! Yujiro demands Musashi face him with two swords.

episodes.name: Practical Fighter
episodes.overview: Jack Hammer arrives at the Tokugawa estate hoping to fight Musashi, but first must defeat Motobe, who's determined to be the next to take on the samurai.

episodes.name: Pickle
episodes.overview: To prevent further chaos, Pickle is sedated and brought to the Skytree lab. Musashi shocks everyone by slapping the prehistoric man in the face.

episodes.name: Death Match
episodes.overview: Tokugawa reunites Musashi with his legendary blade and meets with a resolute Motobe. Meanwhile, Pickle starves himself for the upcoming match.

episodes.name: The Beast and the Warrior
episodes.overview: The Sengoku era's strongest swordsman clashes with the Cretaceous' mightiest warrior — but what happens when Pickle himself takes up a sword?

episodes.name: Protection
episodes.overview: At last, Motobe sees the culmination of his years of training. He throws every trick from the Sengoku period at Musashi to protect his comrades.

episodes.name: Cutting Off the Country
episodes.overview: After Musashi "slashes" the host on national TV, the Japanese police move to apprehend him. The samurai leaves the Tokugawa mansion and begins a rampage.

episodes.name: Un-Severable
episodes.overview: The bloodbath continues as Musashi cuts through a platoon of the police's elite. Meanwhile, the President of the USA prepares for a meeting with Yujiro.

episodes.name: For the Country
episodes.overview: Musashi continues to resist, leaving a mountain of bodies in his wake. Later, Police Commissioner Utsumi asks one unlikely person to fight for the nation.

episodes.name: The Scar and the Sword
episodes.overview: In Shinjuku, Hanayama stares into endless darkness and takes his signature stance. As he swings, Musashi seems blinded by his pure fighting spirit...

episodes.name: That Man, Hanayama
episodes.overview: Punching, pinning, crushing — Hanayama throws everything he has at Musashi. But can his iron muscles withstand every cut, slice and rip Musashi inflicts?

episodes.name: Eliminate
episodes.overview: Baki resolves to eradicate the samurai from this world and hones his body at a dojo. Meanwhile, Musashi prepares for the match with a visit to the sewers.

episodes.name: Exquisite Skill
episodes.overview: The day of the showdown arrives. Before this once-in-a-lifetime match begins, an unimaginable sight unfolds before Musashi. Baki is ready to let loose.

episodes.name: The Way of the Sword
episodes.overview: Musashi retaliates brutally, proving that even barehanded, he is unmatched under heaven. But Baki will not back down until he buries the samurai.

episodes.name: Let's Go to School
episodes.overview: Mysteriously transformed in a kid, legendary hitman Juzo poses as a student to investigate a middle school. Later, he encounters a suspicious intruder.

episodes.name: Noren Mitsuoka
episodes.overview: Juzo discovers Mitsuoka Pharmaceuticals created the wasp and befriends the president's aloof daughter Noren. As he slowly befriends her, she's kidnapped.

episodes.name: Wipe Your Own Butt
episodes.overview: Juzo turns to a classmate to catch up on his studies and joins the home economics club with Noren. Mitsuoka Pharmaceuticals makes a big announcement.

episodes.name: The Pacifier Duel
episodes.overview: Juzo's cover as Noren's boyfriend comes under fire when a young assassin transfers in and challenges Juzo to a duel in a bid to become Noren's fiancé.

episodes.name: There's a Unicorn Up Ahead
episodes.overview: While on an errand, the Home Economics Club runs into Tenma, a brash multi-sport ace who challenges Juzo to a futsal match. Will Juzo take him on?

episodes.name: How About a "Thank You"?
episodes.overview: Juzo and Tenma’s futsal showdown begins. With his astonishing physical ability, Tenma overwhelms the Home Ec Club team of Juzo, Shin, and Kito. Sensing that Juzo is no ordinary opponent, Tenma drops the handicap and starts playing for real. Juzo and the other…

episodes.name: Doki-Doki Double Date
episodes.overview: Juzo and Noren end up on a double date with Chisato and Tenma. The four enjoy shopping and lunch, but the moment the movie starts, Juzo mysteriously reverts to his adult body! He rushes to the restroom, only for Noren to be kidnapped again. Chasing the culpri…

episodes.name: Versus the Rindou Brothers
episodes.overview: Kazuma wields powerful hypnosis, while Eiji launches a brutal assault with explosive golf balls. They, too, are assassins chasing Mitsuoka Pharmaceutical’s secrets. Juzo struggles as Kazuma turns civilians against him. And Kazuma has already placed a certain…

episodes.name: The Impossible Aftermath of an Impossible Game
episodes.overview: Juzo races to Noren’s side. Meanwhile, Tenma and Eiji clash in an outrageous soccer-vs.-explosive-golf battle. Tenma prepares to end the fight with a move he developed in practice. But at the end of the life-or-death struggle against Kazuma and Eiji, the unco…

episodes.name: DEATH OR KISS
episodes.overview: After Kazuma’s hypnosis makes Noren fall deeply for Juzo, she launches an all-out attack on his heart. But when Juzo gently turns her down, she tries to jump from the roof! Desperate to undo the spell, Juzo takes Noren to meet Kazuma at an amusement park, onl…

episodes.name: The First Hitman Summit
episodes.overview: With more assassins gathering at school, Ogami organizes the first-ever Hitman Summit in hopes of keeping everyone under control. However, the meeting quickly descends into chaos as the eccentric personalities clash. Meanwhile, a heated ramen challenge draws…

episodes.name: Life Paths
episodes.overview: Unicorn Mai Otohime is a marine-sports prodigy with expert-level ocean knowledge. She has come for a Mitsuoka Duel too, but her target is Juzo. This leads to Noren challenging Mai herself. As the duel nears, Juzo and the others face parent-teacher conferences…

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A former gangster's run for apartment president to exploit hidden funds spirals into an unexpected corruption investigation, triggering his moral redemption and personal growth.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Desperate to raise a fortune, Park Hae-kang tries every scheme imaginable. But when he still comes up short, a tip leads him to an apartment complex.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: After discovering the apartment's reserve fund, Hae-kang sets out to steal it. But first, he must somehow win the election to join the association.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Hae-kang enters a tight and competitive election. While a nosy opponent tries to sway voters, he spots a unique opportunity to win over the residents.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: After winning the election, Hae-kang aims for the presidency. But when his gangster past is exposed, a new subway entrance becomes his lifeline.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Having finally reached his goal, Hae-kang prepares to disappear without a trace. But when he heads to the bank to claim the cash, everything unravels.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: With Jang Suk-jin on their tail, Hae-kang and Kang Ha-ri scramble to keep their secret safe. Soon, they launch a crusade to find the missing funds.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Lee Chung-won watches Hae-kang's every move, including his push to raise maintenance dues. Ha-ri struggles with the guilt of deceiving her sister.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Conflict erupts between owners and rental tenants after outsiders are caught using the sauna, forcing Hae-kang to find a way to bridge the divide.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Chung-won orders Hae-kang to deliver the ledger, putting Ha-ri's sister in danger. When Hae-kang reveals the truth to Ha-ri, she grapples with betrayal.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Police arrest Hae-kang after accusing him of stealing the repair fund. But to get back at Chung-won, Hae-kang returns with a strategic counterattack.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: A tragedy drives Hae-kang to take down Chung-won, who moves ahead with his new development. He joins forces with Suk-jin to uncover the embezzled funds.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Despite setbacks, Hae-kang sets his endgame in motion to bring down Chung-won once and for all. Will justice finally come to the apartment complex?

episodes.name: Four Crowns, One Kingdom
episodes.overview: Four rival families - leopards, hyena, wild dogs and lions - all try to claim a rich corner of Zambian paradise as their home. Who will succeed in ruling this precious kingdom?

episodes.name: Storm's Retreat
episodes.overview: Leopard Mutima's relationship with her mother is at breaking point, and as the balance of power in Nsefu tips towards the lions, the hyenas and wild dogs fight to raise their young.

episodes.name: The Lions Fall
episodes.overview: Leopard Olimba finds a mate, but fortunes turn against the lions. Extreme flooding leads to disaster for the hyena clan, and the time has come for leopard Mutima to leave.

episodes.name: Flint and the Crocodile
episodes.overview: Injured wild dog Flint helps care for Storm's largest ever litter of pups. Leopard Mutima searches for a home, and the lions are challenged by forces beyond their control.

episodes.name: Olimba's Last Chance
episodes.overview: The final chapter. Olimba struggles with old age, and the wild dog story takes an unexpected turn. The lions and the hyenas both enjoy a baby boom – but who has the power to rule?

episodes.name: The Secret Story of Kingdom
episodes.overview: Meet the people that made filming Kingdom possible and uncover the extraordinary acts of conservationists and anti-poaching teams protecting South Luangwa and all its inhabitants.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A legendary Joseon villainess reincarnated in a modern actress’s body clashes with a cold-blooded chaebol heir, sparking a chaotic love-hate romance across centuries.

episodes.name: The Vixen and the Beast
episodes.overview: Royal Concubine Kang Dan-sim is sentenced to death by poison. But when she wakes, she finds herself in a very different place: modern-day Korea.

episodes.name: A Guide to Optimizing Your Fate
episodes.overview: As Dan-sim tries to adapt to the new world, her strange ways attract the attention of chaebol heir Cha Se-gye — who approaches her with a proposal.

episodes.name: A Whole New Reality
episodes.overview: Se-gye finds he can't stop thinking about Shin Seo-ri — especially after a weird dream sparks some foreign emotions within him.

episodes.name: Beyond Understanding
episodes.overview: Dan-sim learns more about Seo-ri's past. As Se-gye and Seo-ri spend more time together, mixed signals push them to put their feelings to the test.

episodes.name: Forbidden Fruit
episodes.overview: Confused by Seo-ri's mind games, Se-gye pulls out all the stops to win her heart. Later, Seo-ri deals with a pesky co-star and politics on set.

episodes.name: One Magical Night
episodes.overview: Seo-ri and Se-gye fly out to Jeju, but an emergency leaves Se-gye rattled. Later, Seo-ri goes missing and a worried Se-gye heads out in search of her.

episodes.name: The Dark Side of the Moon
episodes.overview: Seo-ri's feelings for Se-gye grow, but she starts having doubts when Mo Tae-hee stakes her claim on Se-gye as well. Suddenly, Se-gye runs into trouble.

episodes.name: Screw This World
episodes.overview: Tae-hee announces her engagement to Se-gye to the press, angering Se-gye and fueling Seo-ri's jealousy. Choi Mun-do threatens Seo-ri with a demand.

episodes.name: That's First Love for You
episodes.overview: Se-gye confronts Seo-ri about her identity — who is Dan-sim? Forced to face her past, Seo-ri makes up her mind about her relationship with Se-gye.

episodes.name: Hope, Despair, and Longing
episodes.overview: With the link between Seo-ri and Dan-sim revealed, Se-gye and Dan-sim make things official. A furious Mun-do goes to extreme lengths to take revenge.

episodes.name: What Lies on the Hidden Path
episodes.overview: Dan-sim wakes to find herself back in the Joseon era. While she tries to return to the present, Se-gye deals with the fallout from Mun-do's scheming.

episodes.name: Reclaiming Lost Time
episodes.overview: Dan-sim and Seo-ri's worlds start to collide. Se-gye takes Dan-sim to meet someone important to him, but she reveals that they're running out of time.

episodes.name: Twist of Fate
episodes.overview: Seo-ri's grandmother's health takes a bad turn. Later, Dan-sim is presented with a difficult ultimatum — that puts her future with Se-gye on the line.

episodes.name: My Royal Nemesis
episodes.overview: Dan-sim's choice sends her back to the Joseon era, leaving Se-gye heartbroken and alone in the modern world. Will fate allow them to reunite?

episodes.name: From Another World
episodes.overview: Three girls meet on a school trip and find themselves transported to a world of monsters and magic.

episodes.name: The Legend Begins
episodes.overview: The girls flee a sorceress determined to eliminate them before they gain the strength to fight back.

seasons.overview: Twelve exceptional talent, chosen from all across India, step into the spotlight for a groundbreaking musical journey.

seasons.name: I-Popstar Vol 2
seasons.overview: A dozen emerging artists craft original songs during weekly challenges — with Neha Kakkar, Aditya Rikhari and King mentoring them along the way.
