episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Kang Pi-o is known around school as an unrivaled talent — until he meets the mysterious Choi Jeong-yo and realizes he may have finally met his match.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: With Jeong-yo now his classmate, a bitter Pi-o keeps his distance. But when the two are tasked with a joint performance, Pi-o finds himself warming up.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: When crisis strikes right before the joint stage, Pi-o improvises a fix — only to wonder if it was a mistake when Jeong-yo's skills outshine his own.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: With Pi-o determined to reclaim his love for music, Jeong-yo shows Pi-o how to have fun on the piano. Jeong-yo's family troubles catch up to him.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Intent on proving himself, Pi-o joins the Prague Harmonie International Competition and asks Jeong-yo to join too. Pi-o's obsessive practice takes a toll.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Years later, Pi-o is successful and world-renowned — but miserable. Hong Jae-in tries to let Pi-o know how she feels. Pi-o hunts down news of Jeong-yo.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Pi-o finds himself stuck deep in a slump, but can't seem to overcome his fears alone. Later, a familiar face suggests collaborating on a performance.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Pi-o faces increasing pressure to do the joint performance, but his issues with the piano only get worse. Jeong-yo finally steps in to help.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Pi-o learns the shocking truth behind Jeong-yo's kidnapping. Jeong-yo asks for Pi-o's help with a piano piece, but his harsh words leave Pi-o rattled.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Pi-o realizes Jeong-yo has been hiding a huge secret. With everything revealed, Jeong-yo turns even more cruel, and Pi-o falls deeper into despair.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: As the Korean Symphony’s 80th anniversary concert begins, Jeong-yo and Pi-o face a turning point — but when the performance ends, only one person remains on stage.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: After painful losses, Pi-o considers leaving music behind, but Jeong-yo shares his final feelings as their last four-hands performance begins.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A Japanese exchange student travels to England to enroll in the prestigious Saint Thomas Art Academy. Determined to become a painter, she arrives under pressure: her parents expect her to rise to the top of her class within six months or return home.

episodes.name: Black Bread and Iridescent Hope
episodes.overview: After weeks at sea, Lili Ichijoin finally arrives in London. She ends up lost, but a stranger shows the way to the academy — and a breathtaking sketch.

episodes.name: Feeling Blue
episodes.overview: Lili adjusts to her new life and tackles her first assignment: painting the sky. As she ponders the theme, she notices that her blue paint is missing.

episodes.name: Lilies
episodes.overview: Hoping to unearth the secret behind Kit's talent, Lili joins his quest to find the cave, but instead she discovers the beauty of the English countryside.

episodes.name: His Rough Sketch
episodes.overview: Lili hides her struggles in letters home. While preparing for a prestigious competitive show, she has a fateful meeting with a new student from Japan.

episodes.name: Views of a Honey Gold Summer
episodes.overview: The group visits Kit's sprawling family estate in the Lake District. There, Lili catches a glimpse of the pressures he faces as an aristocrat.

episodes.name: An Asymmetrical World
episodes.overview: After an afternoon with Kit's prized mare, the group attends a lavish ball, but Lili is missing. When Kit learns why, he arranges a surprise.

episodes.name: A Red Rose Has Thorns
episodes.overview: Back in London and desperate to make ends meet, Lili drowns in work with no time to paint until Catherine suddenly appears with a lucrative proposal.

episodes.name: The Perspective of Childhood Friends
episodes.overview: While Lili paints the portrait over and over again, their initial friction fades as Catherine opens up. Later, Lili overhears a startling confession.

episodes.name: A Gradation of Talent and Effort
episodes.overview: As she watches him leave, Catherine thinks back on her childhood with Kit. Lili finds Peter brooding over his lack of talent, which soon boils over.

episodes.name: Outlines of Triangles
episodes.overview: After her outburst, Kit disappears, leaving Lili wracked with guilt. Shin takes her out to cheer her up. Later, Catherine drags her to Astoria House.

episodes.name: A Portrait in Sepia
episodes.overview: Catherine stands up to Richard and stands up for her new friend. Thinking that Kit has been locked away, Lili rushes to Drunnheim Hall to rescue him.

episodes.name: The Golden Ratio Between Them
episodes.overview: Though it's her last chance to prove herself and stay in London, Lili abandons the final assignment and races to find Kit, who's absent from class.

episodes.name: A Collage of Joy and Sorrow
episodes.overview: During a weekend in Dorothy's hometown, Lili faces her feelings. When they return to school, she's shocked by the results of the final assignment.

episodes.name: Farewell on the Sea
episodes.overview: While Lili sends a victory letter home, Kit faces the weight of aristocratic duty as Richard shares his worries about their role in the looming conflict.

episodes.name: Stormy Crossroads
episodes.overview: Despite a sense of unease, everyone works on their final pieces as Kit attempts a brand new approach. Shin receives a confusing telegram from home.

episodes.name: Colorless Cubism of the Heart
episodes.overview: Lili also receives orders to return to Japan. In the rain, she searches for Kit, hoping for one more chance to tell him how she truly feels.

episodes.name: A Confession Gone with the Waves
episodes.overview: As Lili prepares to depart, Peter also announces his plans to transfer. At their farewell party, Catherine arrives with news: Kit's ship is leaving now!

episodes.name: Five Years Later, an Engagement Ring
episodes.overview: Five years later. After receiving devastating news, Lili gives up on her two loves: Kit and painting, and seeks solace in Shin. He proposes to her.

episodes.name: Drawn by Destiny
episodes.overview: Lili stumbles upon an important letter and confronts Shin. After he reveals his strange sighting, they comb the harbour for Kit, hoping for a reunion.

episodes.name: Love Through a Prism
episodes.overview: Resolving to pursue art again, Lili and Shin break off their engagement. Meanwhile, Kit returns home. Will the two star-crossed lovers ever reunite?

episodes.name: Customs vs Popat
episodes.overview: Amid mounting pressure to curb smuggling at Mumbai airport, officer Prakash Kumar takes charge and ends Arjun Meena's suspension so he can lead the team.

episodes.name: Bada Choudhary
episodes.overview: Arjun forms his A-Team with formerly suspended officers Mitali and Ravinder, as Prakash tasks them with taking down the Bada Choudhary syndicate.

episodes.name: The Priya Story
episodes.overview: Caught smuggling gold by Arjun, flight attendant Priya goes undercover for him. The World Customs Conference offers a chance to trap the smugglers.

episodes.name: Operation Longshot
episodes.overview: The customs team mounts a large-scale sting to intercept gold smugglers converging on Mumbai. Bada Choudhary senses something is wrong.

episodes.name: Hum Coin Hain
episodes.overview: Prakash is sent to Bangkok, where he meets an unexpected visitor. The search of a suspect's home leads the officers to a troubling incident.

episodes.name: Darr Ka Dhandha
episodes.overview: The Choudhary syndicate strikes back with violence and intimidation against the customs officers. Ravinder's reckless move drags him deeper into trouble.

episodes.name: Kahani Khatam
episodes.overview: Arjun gets crucial information from Srikant Saxena. As the syndicate tries one final gold smuggling run, can the officers stop them before it's too late?

episodes.name: I'm Yani Neko, Nya
episodes.overview: Catgirl Yani struggles to pay rent and spends what little she has on cigarettes — until an urgent text from her sister Imoko sparks a far greater crisis.

episodes.name: Meet My Juniors, Nya
episodes.overview: Yani wants to continue her carefree life, but she receives a job offer as financial pressure builds. Will she commit to this opportunity or her freedom?

episodes.name: I'm More Straight Than Funny, Nya
episodes.overview: After another clash with her landlord, Yani agrees to tend his garden to cover her rent. It seems like a perfect fix — until she faces his cabbage patch.

episodes.name: Freaks All Around Me, Nya
episodes.overview: Yani lands a job assisting Saori Tatsuro, a risque manga artist. After Yani mistakenly burns her manuscript, an unexpected police visit follows.

episodes.name: We're Off to a Secret Place, Nya
episodes.overview: Despite her sister's attempts to take away her cigarettes, Yani refuses to quit. At the same time, Imoko navigates a youthful romance.

episodes.name: Summer Starts and Ends Here, Nya
episodes.overview: Yani's fellow tenant Aruko disappears during a drinking party while three new assistants arrive at Tatsuro's workplace as her deadline looms closer.

episodes.name: I Was Born to Parents Too, Nya
episodes.overview: Yani takes a cleaning job at a shady underground facility. Meanwhile, her landlord welcomes a new houseguest, quickly followed by an unexpected mishap.

episodes.name: Even We Run Around in December, Nya
episodes.overview: Yani expects a lonely birthday, unaware that Imoko is planning a surprise party for her. Elsewhere, Yani's landlord becomes trapped in a foul time loop.

episodes.name: My Little Sis Is Popular, Nya
episodes.overview: Yani's peculiar toilet habits spark chaos around her while Imoko receives a gift from a secret admirer who turns out to be anything but ordinary.

episodes.name: I'm Gonnya Enjoy the Outing Too, Nya
episodes.overview: Yani's neighbors Yakuneko and Hameneko head to a mystical waterfall — but Hameneko's selfishness drives Yakuneko to hatch a wild revenge plan.

episodes.name: We're in Kyoto, Nya
episodes.overview: Yani and her flatmates set off on a Kyoto and Nara getaway — but her antics lead to an encounter with the "King of Deer," a creature of ancient wisdom.

episodes.name: I'm Gonnya Smoke Even in the Last Episode, Nya
episodes.overview: As her issues push the other residents to the edge, a worn-out Yani lashes out at her landlord — triggering the biggest brawl in the building's history.

episodes.name: Arrival
episodes.overview: Sudha sweeps Chander off his feet, but they choose to stay friends. Now, he runs a hilltop café with Preeti by his side.

episodes.name: Stay
episodes.overview: While living with Chander, Sudha grows closer to him, but an opportunity in Mumbai may reshape their future. Preeti reveals her plans to expand the café.

episodes.name: Choice
episodes.overview: Sudha grapples with a difficult choice between her career and love life, as Chander opens up about his plans for the future.

episodes.name: Trip
episodes.overview: Rahil plants seeds of doubt in Preeti's mind, leading her to question Chander about his past. Sudha and Chander take a major step in their relationship.

episodes.name: Surprise
episodes.overview: When his mother arrives unexpectedly, Chander scrambles to hide his relationship. Meanwhile, Rahil and Chander look back on how far they've come.

episodes.name: Truth
episodes.overview: Preeti and Chander receive a surprising offer for the café. A conversation with her mother leaves Sudha reflecting on an important choice.

episodes.name: Distance
episodes.overview: While vacationing at a homestay, Sudha and Chander scout locations for the café, but a decision creates tension. Mark gives Chander a ring for Preeti.

episodes.name: Arrival
episodes.overview: A surprise guest unsettles Preeti, while Chander finds his past unexpectedly colliding with the present.

episodes.name: Those Who Laugh at Pudding Will Cry over Pudding
episodes.overview: Angels Tetsuo Tanba and Misaki Kurogane of the Dandelion Clan chase after a spirit who won't pass on to the afterlife until he apologizes to his wife.

episodes.name: To Know Him Is to Punch Him
episodes.overview: As the other Clans rush to meet their quotas, Tetsuo and Misaki slack off until an odd robot sends them after a ring-hardened, quick-fisted spirit.

episodes.name: You Only Live Once - So Die Laughing!
episodes.overview: The Dandelion Clan welcomes a new, uptight member and helps an utterly charming spirit pass on by relaying a final message to her comedian husband.

episodes.name: The Dirtier the Mire, the Prettier the Lotus
episodes.overview: When Masaki finds Misaki spending her day off in the human realm, Tetsuo shares the surprising story of how they both wound up in the Dandelion Clan.

episodes.name: We Were All Geniuses
episodes.overview: After they encounter a spirit separated from his body, the Dandelion angels meet the scientist behind the experiment. Masaki's childhood memories surface.

episodes.name: Why Do the Worst People Never Stop Smiling?
episodes.overview: Hoping to keep the Dandelion Clan in operation, Masaki introduces its newest member: Proto. But is the AI robot truly helpful or part of a shadowy plot?

episodes.name: Seize the Moment! Do It Now
episodes.overview: The chairman's agenda rapidly reduces the number of earthbound spirits but the collection tank overloads, releasing vengeful souls into the mortal realm.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Opulent homes, posh parties and luxury shopping sprees - with the City of Gold as their playground, nothing is too extravagant for these wealthy Indians.

episodes.name: A Dazzling New World
episodes.overview: Newcomers Karan and Tejasswi experience Dubai's opulence. Binda catches up with an old friend and a Holi party brings reunions and revelations.

episodes.name: Hearts on the Rocks
episodes.overview: Pamala and Lailli share a tense moment. Iryna and Dyuti spar over their social lives. The ladies have a pool day while Satish hosts the men on a yacht.

episodes.name: The End of Us?
episodes.overview: Lines are drawn after the Father's Day party. Tejasswi pursues her restaurant dream. Lailli plans a drama-free wellness day - but Alizey has a surprise.

episodes.name: When the Glitter Fades
episodes.overview: Karan considers his future after a heart-to-heart with Dyuti. Binda confronts Satish about the rumors surrounding him. The twins try to comfort Iryna.

episodes.name: This Circle is on... FIRE
episodes.overview: A blow-up at the Bollywood party causes friction in the group. Pamala looks for clarity with AP. A birthday celebration goes up in (literal) flames.

episodes.name: Eeny, Meeny, Miny, Moe
episodes.overview: Tennis pro Sania Mirza heats up a padel game. Tejasswi questions her life in Dubai as Karan makes his own plans. A fishy gift leaves a bad taste.

episodes.name: The Future is Ours
episodes.overview: The Sanpals look to grow their family. The group lets loose at a glitzy launch. As Karan plans a big surprise, Binda shares her doubts.

episodes.name: The Grand Return
episodes.overview: Jani Master returns for an electrifying Grand Launch, as the Star Masters and a new wave of talent set the stage for a season demanding double the skill.

episodes.name: The choice
episodes.overview: As the Double Impact competition gets fully underway, the Star Masters size up the new dance talent. Who will stand out enough to secure a spot?

episodes.name: The Real Test
episodes.overview: The contestants take on their first major challenge, pushing themselves to deliver performances that showcase what makes each dancer unique.

episodes.name: The Reveal
episodes.overview: The competition intensifies as contestants strive to show what they're truly capable of. But will their performances justify the Star Masters' choices?

episodes.name: The Viral Battle
episodes.overview: For their next challenge, contestants battle to create a viral dance move as the judges try to predict which signature step could take over social media.

episodes.name: The Golden Hook Step
episodes.overview: Fahadh Faasil makes a special appearance as the pairs continue their efforts to create a hook step with viral potential and claim the Gold Dhee Badge.

episodes.name: Passenger Vehicles for Kids
episodes.overview: Open surprise eggs with Mr. Harlo and pals to discover motorcycles, cars, scooters and more while learning the names of the vehicles that get us around.

episodes.name: Aa Okkati Adakku
episodes.overview: Determined to see his son, Teja, wed, Nivasa Rao takes a friend's advice and sends him to Hyderabad, hoping a job will make him a more suitable match.

episodes.name: Pellichoopulu
episodes.overview: Teja lands a job at a software company, unaware his new boss, Madhu, is the woman his father has secretly chosen as his prospective bride.

episodes.name: Tom and Jerry
episodes.overview: Teja and Madhu agree to live together for six months before deciding on marriage, but she insists they keep it secret from their coworkers.

episodes.name: Kirrak Party
episodes.overview: A celebration at Teja's house takes an awkward turn when guests discover Madhu's belongings and start teasing him, leaving her embarrassed.

episodes.name: Premiukula Roju
episodes.overview: On their Vagamon getaway, Gopi makes a bold move with the mysterious "model girl" as Teja and Madhu begin to develop feelings for each other.

episodes.name: Life Is Beautiful
episodes.overview: With Madhu preparing to leave for America, Teja struggles to celebrate his birthday and finally confides in Gopi about his growing feelings for her.
